Our results show, among other things, that: (i) dealing with space cyber attack cascading effects is essential to space cyber risk management; (ii) the framework can effectively harden space missions; (iii) National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) security controls can effectively mitigate space cyber risks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个太空网络风险管理（SCRM）框架，用于系统性地分析与缓解太空网络风险，并通过针对卫星通信（SATCOM）基础设施中真实太空网络攻击的案例研究验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 太空基础设施（如卫星通信）在现代社会中扮演关键角色，但类似互联网，其易受网络攻击（太空网络攻击）威胁，因此管理太空网络风险至关重要。然而，如何充分管理太空网络风险仍是一个未解决的开放问题。
AI.method: 提出首个太空网络风险管理（SCRM）框架，对太空基础设施、太空任务及太空网络攻击进行建模，并提供太空任务风险分析与加固算法；通过在自建测试平台上针对真实世界SATCOM基础设施的网络攻击开展案例研究来验证框架。
AI.result: 案例研究结果表明：(i) 处理太空网络攻击的级联效应对于太空网络风险管理至关重要；(ii) 该框架能有效加固太空任务；(iii) 美国国家标准与技术研究院（NIST）的安全控制措施能有效缓解太空网络风险。
AI.conclusion: SCRM框架为太空网络风险的系统化分析与缓解提供了首个解决方案，验证了应对级联效应、任务加固及采用NIST安全控制在太空网络风险管理中的有效性与必要性。

title: When Evidence Changes: Evaluating Memory Repair and Re-reading in Language-Model Agents
summary: When documents supporting an agent's derived facts are revoked or replaced, should it repair memory or re-read current evidence? We introduce an evidence-revision evaluation on medication- and problem-list tasks from public ICU records. Under revocation, replacement and control events, we compare full and source-filtered re-reading with caching, rebuilding and graph-local repair across two 7B models. Memory is supplied in full without retrieval, and costs include ingest, revision and every use. On short records, local repair uses 5-10$\times$ fewer revision tokens than rebuilding, yet every memory pipeline costs at least twice full re-reading in held-out conditions. In a small pre-specified development sweep, adding task-ineligible documents extended records to about 10,000 tokens; at that length, memory's mean cumulative cost fell below full re-reading's after 2-14 uses, partly through truncated extraction, while source-filtered re-reading remained cheapest. In the replacement study, none of the four primary confirmatory tests reached statistical significance. These results show why the cost of agent memory after evidence revision must be assessed against source-filtered re-reading over the full pipeline.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"证据修订"评测,比较在事实被撤销/替换时,智能体应修复记忆还是重读当前证据。在ICU用药与问题清单任务上对比全量重读、来源过滤重读与多种记忆流水线(缓存、重建、图局部修复)。短记录下局部修复的修订token比重建少5-10倍,但任何记忆流水线在留出条件下成本至少是全量重读的两倍;约1万token长记录下记忆平均累计成本在2-14次使用后低于全量重读,而来源过滤重读始终最便宜;替换研究中四项主要验证性检验均不显著。
AI.motivation: 动机:当支撑智能体衍生事实的文档被撤销或替换时,需要明确智能体应修复其记忆还是重新读取当前证据,而现有实践缺乏对记忆维护与重读在成本与效果上的系统比较。
AI.method: 方法:在公开ICU记录的用药与问题清单任务上引入证据修订评测,覆盖撤销、替换与控制事件;在两个7B模型上对比全量重读与来源过滤重读,以及缓存、重建、图局部修复三种记忆方式。记忆全量提供(无检索),成本计入摄取、修订与每次使用。
AI.result: 结果:短记录下局部修复的修订token比重建少5-10倍,但所有记忆流水线在留出条件下成本至少为全量重读的两倍。在预设的小型开发扫描中,加入任务不合格文档将记录延长至约1万token,此时记忆的平均累计成本在2-14次使用后低于全量重读(部分源于截断式抽取),而来源过滤重读仍最便宜。替换研究中四项主要验证性检验均未达统计显著。
AI.conclusion: 结论:证据修订后智能体记忆的成本必须在完整流水线上与来源过滤重读对照评估;来源过滤重读在多数条件下更经济,记忆修复的收益依赖于记录长度与使用次数。

title: WAMJET: A Harness for World Action Model Acceleration
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) leverage pretrained video foundation models for robot manipulation, but their large backbones and video-action co-prediction are expensive. Although existing acceleration techniques offer many ways to reduce this cost, selecting and composing them requires substantial engineering for each model and hardware platform. To tackle this bottleneck, we present WAMJET, an agentic harness that accelerates WAM inference by equipping coding agents with reusable optimization guidance and measurement and validation tools. WAMJET follows a bottleneck-driven workflow where the agent profiles inference, modifies targeted code, validates effects, and iteratively refines the acceleration stack as bottlenecks shift, while preserving action quality. Experiments span six WAMs, three coding agents, and two GPU architectures. WAMJET achieves up to 9.95x lossless speedup over upstream implementations. Approximation and hardware-aware optimization yield additional latency reductions, with comparable success rates. The results show that WAMJET can produce effective acceleration stacks for WAM deployment.

AI.tldr: WAMJET 是一个智能体框架，通过给编码智能体配备可复用的优化指南与测量验证工具，自动加速世界动作模型（WAM）的推理，最高实现 9.95 倍无损加速。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型借助预训练视频基础模型进行机器人操作，但其庞大骨干网络与视频-动作联合预测代价高昂。现有加速方法虽多，却需要针对每个模型和硬件平台投入大量工程来选择和组合，成为部署瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 WAMJET，一个智能体驱动的加速框架。它为编码智能体提供可复用的优化指导、测量与验证工具，采用瓶颈驱动的工作流：智能体对推理进行性能分析、修改针对性代码、验证效果，并随瓶颈变化迭代优化加速栈，同时保持动作质量。
AI.result: 实验覆盖 6 个 WAM、3 个编码智能体和 2 种 GPU 架构。WAMJET 相较上游实现取得最高 9.95 倍的无损加速；近似与硬件感知优化进一步降低延迟，且成功率相当。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 WAMJET 能为 WAM 部署生成有效的加速栈，验证了智能体驱动的自动化优化在机器人基础模型推理加速上的可行性。

title: Behavioral History Outperforms Descriptions of the Person for LLM Synthetic Personas
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as synthetic personas representing survey respondents. Their validity as substitutes for particular respondents depends on whether they reproduce individuals' decisions. We examine what information helps synthetic respondents predict each individual's later choices, using five conditions that add progressively richer information: no personal information, demographics, personality traits, cognitive scores, and finally the respondent's earlier survey choices as behavioral history. We use a two-wave panel of 845 US adults who completed measures of 14 behavioral biases (spanning risk, time preferences, overconfidence, and reasoning), so each respondent's earlier answers provide a human test-retest benchmark; in the behavioral-history condition, all items that score the target bias are withheld. At the population level, the average number of biases per respondent in every condition is close to the human average (7.1-8.1 biases, against 7.1 for humans). This aggregate similarity masks differences in variance: persona descriptions recover only 53-67% of human between-person variation, whereas adding behavioral history restores it to approximately the human level. At the individual level, description-based personas achieve only 7-12% of the informedness observed in human test-retest responses, while adding behavioral history raises this to 28%. The condition including behavioral history has the highest estimated informedness in all 17 demographic groups, whereas description-based conditions provide little or no information for some groups. Synthetic responses also exhibit stronger education- and income-related differences than human responses. For LLM synthetic personas, a respondent's past answers add more to individual-level prediction than a description of who they are.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了LLM合成受访者在不同信息条件下的预测效度，发现过去行为历史比人口学、人格或认知描述更能提升个体层面预测，但整体仍远低于人类重测水平。
AI.motivation: LLM increasingly serve as synthetic survey respondents, and their validity as substitutes for specific individuals hinges on whether they reproduce those individuals' decisions. The study asks what information helps synthetic respondents predict each individual's later choices.
AI.method: 使用845名美国成年人的两波面板数据，测量14种行为偏差（风险、时间偏好、过度自信、推理）。设置五个渐进增加信息的条件：无个人信息、人口学、人格特质、认知分数、受访者早期问卷选择作为行为历史。以人类重测作为基准，行为历史条件下扣留用于计分目标偏差的所有题目。
AI.result: 总体层面各条件平均偏差数为7.1-8.1，接近人类的7.1。但聚合相似掩盖了方差差异：描述型persona仅恢复53-67%的人际变异，加入行为历史后接近人类水平。个体层面，基于描述仅达人类重测67%的7-12% informedness，加入行为历史提升至28%。含行为历史条件在全部17个群体中估计informedness最高，而描述型条件对部分群体几乎无信息。合成回答还表现出更强的教育与收入相关差异。
AI.conclusion: 对于LLM合成persona，受访者过去的回答对个体层面预测的贡献大于对其身份的描述；基于描述的方法在个体层面效度有限，且可能加剧人口学群体间差异。

title: Communication Shapes Collective Inference in Self-Adapting LLM Societies: Evidence from Mafia
summary: When does communication help a group identify hidden adversaries, and how does its value change as the group adapts? In Mafia, an informed minority hides inside an uninformed majority whose only evidence is open play. The zero-information game, where each day's vote eliminates a random player, is exactly solved and scores every society; matched-casting comparisons between protocols identify the effect of communication. Societies of 8-100 claude-haiku-4-5 agents (7,416 analyzed games, 1.9M model calls) adapt by rewriting and inheriting private strategy notes. Simultaneous broadcast improves adversary identification over silence in all nine compositions tested (8-46 players). Turn-taking removes most of this advantage; its voting landslides are as frequent as broadcast's but land on mafia near chance (1.08x versus 2.53x). At 70 players, agents reading eight statements per day identify adversaries worse than silent ones, and limited talk is worth less than at 46 players. Adaptation is fast but need not help. In their first broadcast games, citizens announce their role far more often than mafia (91% vs. 30%) and first-day votes find mafia at three times chance; within two generations citizens stop announcing and the cue fades, a change the inherited notes carry. In controlled redeployments at 16 players, societies carrying sixty generations of their own notes score below societies with none. Communication shapes both collective inference and the signals it depends on, so a protocol's value must be measured together with the adaptation that changes those signals.

AI.tldr: 以《Mafia》游戏为实验平台，用 8–100 个 claude-haiku-4-5 智能体进行 7,416 局对抗（190 万次模型调用），通过"零信息基线"与协议对照，量化沟通对识别隐藏对手的价值及其随群体适应而发生的变化。
AI.motivation: 沟通何时有助于群体识别隐藏的对手，其价值又如何随群体适应而变化，这一问题的因果效应难以在自然场景中干净地测量；需要一个可精确求解基线、能操纵沟通协议、且允许长期适应的受控社会系统。
AI.method: 构建 Mafia 多智能体社会：信息较少的少数派隐藏于信息较多但仅凭公开发言判断的多数派中。先精确求解"零信息博弈"（每日随机淘汰一人）作为评分基线；在 8–100 人的社会中让智能体改写并继承私有策略笔记以实现跨代适应；对同时广播、轮流发言、沉默、以及每天八条发言等协议与不同人数（8–70）做匹配选角对比。
AI.result: 同时广播在全部九种构成（8–46 人）中都比沉默更能识别对手；轮流发言消掉大部分优势，其投票雪崩频率与广播相当，但命中 mafia 接近随机（1.08 倍 vs. 2.53 倍）。70 人时，每天读八条发言的智能体识别对手反而差于沉默者，有限发言的价值低于 46 人时。适应很快但不必然有益：首局广播中公民报出身份的频率远高于 mafia（91% vs. 30%），首日投票命中 mafia 达随机三倍；两代之内公民停止报身份，该线索随之消退，并被继承的笔记持续携带。16 人受控再部署中，携带自身六十代笔记的社会得分低于无笔记社会。
AI.conclusion: 沟通既塑造群体的集体推断，也塑造它所依赖的信号本身；因此协议的"价值"不能孤立测量，必须与改变这些信号的适应过程一起评估——适应虽快，却可能侵蚀沟通赖以奏效的初始线索。

title: Practical Runtime Enforcement of First-Order Temporal Requirements
summary:
Runtime enforcers observe a system's behavior and exert control over it to ensure that the system always adheres to its requirements. Many natural requirements not only formulate restrictions on the system's present behavior, but also impose obligations on its future behavior; for instance, agentic security may require personal data collected during a run to be erased by some deadline. In an ever-growing compliance landscape, real-world systems may be subject to hundreds of such requirements. However, existing enforcement mechanisms supporting complex policies are often too slow for production software; instead, developers may resort to non-temporal access control mechanisms and ad-hoc instrumentation, but these scale poorly with requirement complexity.
  To address this problem, we introduce an efficient algorithm and tool for enforcing complex temporal requirements and demonstrate its performance. Specifically, we identify a fragment of Metric First-Order Temporal Logic (MFOTL) that can be enforced with low runtime complexity while supporting a rich family of practically relevant requirements, including obligations. We then design an enforcement algorithm for this fragment and implement it in EnfFlash, a novel tool that enforces requirements with latency up to 44x lower than EnfGuard, the previous state-of-the-art enforcer, on standard benchmarks, and up to three orders of magnitude lower on security policies for LLM agents. This performance is achieved by compiling requirements into imperative programs that we efficiently interpret. We evaluate EnfFlash both standalone, on existing benchmarks, and integrated in web applications as an enforcement backend. We demonstrate that it can enforce a substantial 400-line MFOTL formula specifying the GDPR on a social network while adding under 15 ms to each page view, which is sufficient for most interactive and real-time applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种高效算法与工具 EnfFlash，用于在运行时强制执行复杂的时间性需求（含未来义务），通过识别一个可在低运行时复杂度下执行的 MFOTL 片段，并将其编译为命令式程序进行解释执行，从而显著降低延迟，可满足多数交互式与实时应用。
AI.motivation: 现实系统面临日益增多的合规需求（可达数百项），其中许多不仅约束当前行为，还对未来行为施加义务（如限期删除数据）。但现有的支持复杂策略的执行机制对生产软件而言过慢，开发者退而使用非时间性访问控制与临时插桩，难以随需求复杂度扩展。因此需要一种既能处理复杂时间性需求又高效的强制执行方法。
AI.method: 识别出一个可低运行时复杂度强制执行的 Metric First-Order Temporal Logic（MFOTL）片段，该片段仍能支持包括义务在内的丰富实用需求；针对该片段设计强制执行算法，并实现为工具 EnfFlash。其核心思路是将需求编译为命令式程序并高效解释执行。
AI.result: 在标准基准上，EnfFlash 的延迟比先前最先进的执行器 EnfGuard 低至多 44 倍；在面向 LLM 智能体的安全策略上，延迟降低达三个数量级。集成到 Web 应用中时，可在社交网络上执行一条约 400 行、描述 GDPR 的 MFOTL 公式，每次页面浏览仅增加不到 15 毫秒。
AI.conclusion: EnfFlash 证明了高性能强制执行复杂时间性需求是可行的，既能支撑丰富的实际合规策略（含未来义务），又能满足交互式与实时应用的延迟要求，可作为 Web 应用的强制执行后端使用。

title: SERA-IDS: Structured Experience Retrieval-Augmented Intrusion Detection with Small Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer a flexible approach to network intrusion detection, but direct classification of numerical flow records can be unreliable without traffic- specific decision boundaries. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables LLMs to leverage external experience; however, free-form textual experience requires the model to infer the numerical conditions that distinguish traffic classes. We propose SERA-IDS, a Structured Experience Retrieval-Augmented Intru- sion Detection framework that learns decision knowledge from classification errors. A Small Language Model (SLM) analyzes misclassified flows and generates structured rules containing behavioral descriptions, feature conditions, class-confusion infor- mation, tool-derived confidence, and provenance. A confidence gate admits supported rules into the Experience Library. During testing, the library is frozen, and retrieved class-diverse rules are condition-matched to the query flow and provided as evidence to the decision SLM. The same library is evaluated with three small, locally deployable SLMs, namely Llama 3.1, Phi-4:14B, and Qwen2.5:7B, without fine-tuning or paid hosted inference. On the test sets, SERA-IDS improves macro F1 on NF-BoT- IoT from 11.66%, 9.26%, and 7.83% to 86.46%, 69.50%, and 83.51%, respectively, and on NF-ToN-IoT from 3.82%, 6.17%, and 1.94% to 84.16%, 87.66%, and 83.37%. These results show that structured experience retrieval enables small, free, and locally deployable SLMs to achieve strong intrusion-detection performance, including performance exceeding that of the re- ported existing work used in our comparison.

AI.tldr: SERA-IDS：从分类错误中学习结构化决策规则，通过检索增强让小语言模型实现强入侵检测性能。
AI.motivation: LLM可直接分类数值流记录，但缺乏流量特有的决策边界，结果不可靠；RAG虽能引入外部经验，但自由文本经验需模型自行推断区分流量类别的数值条件，效果受限。
AI.method: 提出SERA-IDS结构化经验检索增强框架：小语言模型分析误分类流，生成含行为描述、特征条件、类别混淆信息、工具置信度与来源的结构化规则；置信门控将受支持的规则纳入经验库。测试时冻结经验库，检索类别多样且条件匹配的规则作为证据供决策SLM使用。在Llama 3.1、Phi-4:14B、Qwen2.5:7B上评估，无需微调或付费托管推理。
AI.conclusion: 结构化经验检索使小型、免费、可本地部署的SLM实现强入侵检测性能，并超过所对比的现有工作报告结果。

title: General Decision Models: Benchmarking and Insights Beyond Jev
summary: General decision models, such as Jev, have recently emerged as efficient alternatives to LLMs for structured judgment and selection. But what kinds of decisions can these models reliably make, and how does their behavior change when individual decisions are composed into larger systems? To study this, we introduce JEVal, a bilingual benchmark comprising 11,257 instances from 36 datasets across 10 application domains, and evaluate 25 model configurations spanning general decision models and generative LLMs. Our results show that (1) general decision models are most competitive when decisions can be resolved from available evidence, but weaken when they require specialist knowledge or faithful uncertainty estimation: they can often identify the most likely outcome while substantially overstating its probability. (2) In more dynamic and realistic systems involving long-horizon, multi-step interactions, the advantages of fast local decision making are offset by reliability failures at the system level. on $τ$-bench, faster local decisions reduce median episode time but lower task success as decision errors accumulate over long trajectories. (3) In large-scale social simulation, decision models approach strong generative LLMs on individual response prediction at substantially lower inference cost, yet remain weaker in user profiling and exhibit larger aggregate estimation errors and systematic bias. Finally, we propose InnerJev-4B and InnerJev-27B, which internalize an open-weight LLM's own reasoning into a single-pass first-token decision through Reasoning-to-Readout Self-Distillation, with InnerJev-27B performing on par with Jev on JEVal while answering a typical query in about 0.1 s.

AI.tldr: 论文提出双语基准 JEVal 评估 25 种通用决策模型与生成式 LLM，发现通用决策模型在可依据证据解决的问题上具竞争力，但在专业知识、不确定性估计与系统级可靠性上较弱，并提出 InnerJev 系列模型。
AI.motivation: 近期 Jev 等通用决策模型被视为 LLM 在结构化判断与选择任务上的高效替代方案，但其可靠决策的边界、以及在将单个决策组合为更大系统时行为如何变化尚不清楚，需要系统性评估。
AI.method: 构建 JEVal 双语基准，含来自 36 个数据集、10 个应用领域的 11,257 个实例；评估 25 种模型配置（通用决策模型与生成式 LLM）；在 τ-bench 上测试长程多步交互；开展大规模社会模拟；并提出 InnerJev-4B/27B，通过 Reasoning-to-Readout 自蒸馏将 LLM 推理内化为单次首 token 决策。
AI.result: (1) 通用决策模型在证据可判定时最具竞争力，但依赖专家知识或需忠实不确定性估计时变弱，常能识别最可能结果却大幅高估其概率；(2) 在长程多步系统中，快速局部决策虽缩短 τ-bench 中位任务时间，却因误差累积降低任务成功率；(3) 大规模社会模拟中，决策模型以显著更低推理成本接近强生成式 LLM 的个体响应预测，但在用户画像、聚合估计误差与系统性偏差上更弱；InnerJev-27B 在 JEVal 上与 Jev 相当，典型查询约 0.1 秒。
AI.conclusion: 通用决策模型适合证据充分的结构化判断，但在专业知识、不确定性校准及系统级长程可靠性上存在明显短板；通过自蒸馏可将其推理能力压缩为高效单次决策，InnerJev-27B 在保持性能的同时实现约 0.1 秒响应。

title: StepCAD: Mesh-to-CAD Code Generation via LLM Policy and Geometry-Guided Search
summary: Recovering executable CAD programs from 3D meshes is challenging due to the compositional nature of CAD construction and the interaction between discrete modeling choices and continuous parameters. Many learning-based methods predict complete programs in a single pass and rely predominantly on sketch-extrude representations, limiting operation diversity and opportunities to correct geometric errors during reconstruction. We introduce StepCAD, a generative optimization approach that combines a state-conditioned CAD policy with geometry-guided search. Given an input mesh, the policy predicts construction actions conditioned on both target and intermediate geometry, and an IoU-guided tree search refines the resulting program through local edits. We also introduce ARCADE-1.5M, a large-scale dataset of 1.5M executable CAD programs spanning diverse operations, sequences with a maximum length of 150+ counted operations, and 12.5M intermediate state-action transitions. Experiments across multiple CAD reconstruction benchmarks show that StepCAD achieves state-of-the-art geometric reconstruction accuracy with consistently high validity, yielding up to 87.2% relative IoU improvement over the strongest evaluated baseline, with particularly large gains on complex shapes. Project page: https://ghadinehme.com/stepcad.github.io/

AI.tldr: StepCAD 提出一种状态条件 CAD 策略与几何引导搜索相结合的生成式优化方法，从 3D 网格恢复可执行 CAD 程序，并发布 ARCADE-1.5M 数据集，实现 SOTA 重建精度。
AI.motivation: 从 3D 网格恢复可执行 CAD 程序具有挑战性，原因在于 CAD 构建的组合性以及离散建模选择与连续参数之间的交互。现有学习方法多为一次性预测完整程序，且主要依赖 sketch-extrude 表示，限制了操作多样性与重建中纠错的机会。
AI.method: 提出 StepCAD，将状态条件 CAD 策略与几何引导搜索相结合：给定输入网格，策略以目标几何和中间几何为条件预测构建动作，并通过 IoU 引导的树搜索以局部编辑方式优化程序。同时构建 ARCADE-1.5M 大规模数据集，包含 150 万可执行 CAD 程序、最长 150+ 计数操作的序列以及 1250 万中间状态-动作转移。
AI.result: 在多个 CAD 重建基准上，StepCAD 取得 SOTA 几何重建精度并保持高有效性，相对最强基线 IoU 提升最高达 87.2%，在复杂形状上增益尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 状态条件策略与几何引导搜索的结合能够有效提升 CAD 程序恢复的精度与有效性，配合大规模多样化数据集可显著改善复杂形状的重建表现。

title: SkillScriptBench: Benchmarking Self-Evolution of Executable Agent Skill Packages Beyond Markdown
summary: Executable Agent Skills combine natural-language instructions and scripts into reusable packages for LLM agents, and revising them requires fixing errors without breaking correct behavior. Existing benchmarks do not systematically distinguish documentation repair, script repair, and preservation when evaluating skill self-evolution. We introduce SkillScriptBench, a 350-task benchmark designed to evaluate these capabilities separately. From a survey of over 35,000 GitHub-hosted Skill roots, we select 100 packages and construct 150 repair tasks. Each task pairs a package containing injected script faults with a maintenance request and executable checks of the required behavior. A complementary controlled track contains 200 tasks from 50 packages, each evaluated under the same maintenance request in four states: clean, documentation faults, script faults, and faults in both. Across four LLMs, methods that edit both documentation and scripts can repair script faults but do not consistently outperform Markdown-only revision on documentation repair or preservation. We therefore introduce AST-Guided Skill Revision, which uses abstract syntax trees and calling relationships to link maintenance requirements to relevant code locations. It restricts script edits to these locations and updates the documentation to match the revised scripts. Averaged across models, this revision stage yields absolute gains in repair success of 21.9% for Raw Package and 27.7% for CoEvoSkills on faulty packages. Absolute gains in the proportion of tasks solved in all three runs reach 20.8% and 31.5%, respectively, indicating more consistent repair success across repeated runs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SkillScriptBench 基准，将可执行 Agent 技能的自我进化能力拆分为文档修复、脚本修复与保持性三类分别评测，并提出 AST-Guided Skill Revision 方法，利用抽象语法树与调用关系定位需修改的代码位置，在修复脚本的同时同步更新文档。
AI.motivation: 现有基准未系统区分文档修复、脚本修复与正确行为保持三类能力，导致无法清楚评估技能自我进化中"修错但不破坏正确行为"的效果，因此需要专门的评测基准与更可靠的方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建 SkillScriptBench：从 35,000+ GitHub Skill 仓库中选取 100 个包，构造 150 个修复任务，每个任务含注入脚本缺陷的包、维护请求与可执行检查；另设受控赛道 200 个任务（50 个包），在 clean、文档缺陷、脚本缺陷、二者皆有四种状态下用同一维护请求评测。2) 提出 AST-Guided Skill Revision：用抽象语法树和调用关系将维护需求映射到相关代码位置，限制脚本编辑范围，并同步更新文档以匹配修改后的脚本。
AI.result: 在四个 LLM 上，同时编辑文档与脚本的方法能修复脚本缺陷，但在文档修复和保持性上并未稳定优于仅改 Markdown 的方案。AST-Guided Skill Revision 在模型平均下，对有缺陷包，修复成功率绝对提升 21.9%（Raw Package）和 27.7%（CoEvoSkills）；三次运行均成功的任务比例绝对提升 20.8% 和 31.5%，说明重复运行的修复一致性更强。
AI.conclusion: 系统区分修复与保持能力对评测技能自我进化十分必要；AST-Guided 的定位式修改能同时提升修复成功率与跨运行稳定性，为技能自动维护提供了更可靠的方案。

title: templar: agentic induction and evolution of standardized radiology reporting templates from large-scale clinical corpora
summary: Structured radiology reporting mitigates the heterogeneity of free-text reports, yet its benefits depend on high-quality reporting templates. In practice, such templates are conventionally built through labor-intensive expert consensus and therefore vary across institutions and lag behind evolving clinical practice. Large language models (LLMs) enable automated template induction, but existing approaches remain limited: single-LLM induction is constrained by context length, and the corpus-scale method ASTAR produces a static, closed-corpus template without external grounding or downstream adaptation. To address these limitations, we propose TEMPLAR, a TEMPLate-centric Agentic framework for inducing and evolving standardized Radiology reporting templates from large-scale clinical corpora. TEMPLAR treats the template as a persistent central state maintained alongside two provenance-aware knowledge graphs, namely an anatomical graph that constrains template construction and a diagnostic graph that supports finding-to-diagnosis reasoning. Three agents operate on this state. The Induction Agent derives canonical clinical slots from anatomy-constrained Span-Triple atoms via dual-view similarity clustering; the Evolution Agent then assembles these slots into a hierarchical template and revises it under consistency constraints, external clinical evidence, and downstream structuring feedback; and the Clinical Agent applies the evolved template to report structuring, reconstruction, and diagnostic reasoning. Across four datasets, TEMPLAR outperforms ASTAR, three medical LLMs, and six general-purpose LLMs in coverage, information fidelity, and diagnostic fidelity, while achieving the highest or tied-highest LLM-rated template quality. Its fidelity advantages over ASTAR persist under cross-dataset transfer, and cumulative ablations support complementary contributions of its key components.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 TEMPLAR，一个以模板为中心的智能体框架，可从大规模临床语料中自动归纳并演化结构化放射报告模板，在两个来源感知知识图谱支撑下由三个智能体协同工作，并在多数据集上超越 ASTAR 及多种 LLM 基线。
AI.motivation: 结构化放射报告依赖高质量模板，但传统模板由专家共识人工构建，成本高、跨机构差异大且滞后于临床实践。现有 LLM 自动归纳方法存在不足：单 LLM 归纳受上下文长度限制，语料级方法 ASTAR 生成的模板静态、封闭，缺乏外部依据与下游适配。
AI.method: TEMPLAR 将模板视为持续维护的中心状态，并配以两个来源感知知识图谱：约束模板构建的解剖图谱与支持"征象到诊断"推理的诊断图谱。三个智能体协同：归纳智能体通过双视角相似度聚类，从解剖约束的 Span-Triple 原子中提取规范临床槽位；演化智能体在一致性约束、外部临床证据和下游结构化反馈下构建并修订层级模板；临床智能体将演化后的模板应用于报告结构化、重建与诊断推理。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上，TEMPLAR 在覆盖度、信息保真度和诊断保真度上均优于 ASTAR、三个医学 LLM 和六个通用 LLM，并获得最高或并列最高的 LLM 评分模板质量。其相对 ASTAR 的保真度优势在跨数据集迁移下依然保持，累积消融实验支持各关键组件的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: TEMPLAR 通过智能体化、知识图谱锚定与下游反馈驱动的模板归纳与演化，有效克服了现有方法的静态性与封闭性，验证了自动化构建高质量放射报告模板的可行性。

title: When Talk Isn't Code: Comparing LLM Agents That Simulate and Develop Software
summary: LLMs are used both to simulate network protocol implementations, as honeypots do, and to write them. Prior work evaluates the two uses separately, from a model's answers or conversations in one case and from its generated code in the other. We observe that a knowledge probe (asking the model which security checks an implementation needs) and a conversation can credit security checks that the generated program lacks, but no study has compared them with the code the same model writes. To fill this gap, we present the first such comparison between simulation mode (S-mode), where the model plays the implementation in a conversation, and development mode (D-mode), where the model writes the program and the program is attacked, with a knowledge probe as a baseline. We design and implement a harness that judges all three with one attack suite and one oracle, and evaluate 15 LLMs on four protocol implementations. We find that with the full security specification, the median model's attack success is at most 4\% on reassembly, HTTP, and firewall implementations in both modes, but 13\% in S-mode and 15\% in D-mode on DNS. In D-mode, adding the missing DNS requirement to the specification cuts that attack from 100\% to 34\% and changes only that check, whereas deleting a stated rule weakens the program on other checks too. Asking the model beforehand does not predict which checks a program has, since 13 of the 14 models that write a DNS resolver name the check, yet all 42 programs lack it. S-mode is a useful first filter, flagging 82\% of the real DNS vulnerabilities and leaving 96\% of the safe cases unflagged. It errs in both directions, over-reporting security checks that D-mode does not implement and under-reporting checks that D-mode does. S-mode can screen but not replace D-mode testing, and security requirements should be written down even when a model can recite them.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在同一攻击套件与判定标准下，系统比较了大模型在"模拟模式（S-mode）"与"开发模式（D-mode）"下的协议实现安全性，并以知识探针为基线。
AI.motivation: 已有研究分别评估LLM模拟网络协议实现（如蜜罐）和编写协议代码两种用途，二者独立进行；知识探针或对话可能会"认可"生成程序实际缺失的安全检查，但没有研究将二者与同一模型写出的代码进行比较。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 设计并实现统一测试框架，用同一攻击套件与同一判定标准评估S-mode、D-mode与知识探针三种方式；对15个LLM在四种协议实现上进行评测，并分析安全规范增删对攻击成功率的影响。
AI.result: 在完整安全规范下，中位模型在重组、HTTP、防火墙实现上的攻击成功率≤4%，但DNS在S-mode为13%、D-mode为15%；D-mode中补充缺失的DNS要求可将攻击从100%降至34%，仅改变该项检查。事先询问模型无法预测程序是否具备该检查——14个写DNS解析器的模型中有13个能说出该检查，但42个程序全部缺失。S-mode能标记82%的真实DNS漏洞，同时对96%的安全案例不予标记。
AI.conclusion: S-mode可作为初步筛选但不能替代D-mode测试；模型可能双向误判（高报未实现、低报已实现的检查）；即使模型能背诵安全要求，也应将其明确写入规范。

title: The TellTail of Embeddings: Fingerprinting Retrievers in Black-Box Systems
summary: Dense embedding models are core to modern text retrieval, enabling systems ranging from web search to retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Yet, retrievers are usually deployed within opaque systems, exposing only ranked results, cited sources, or generated answers. This opacity prevents users from verifying which retrievers providers serve and may create a false sense of robustness against retrieval attacks. We show that attackers can infer retrievers' identity only through queries. We introduce TellTail, a fingerprinting attack for identifying retrievers behind black-box systems across a spectrum of access levels. Despite sharing many properties, retrievers can be steered to emit distinct results. When retrieved passages are exposed, TellTail compares retrieval overlap to deduce the underlying model. When only the final generated response is exposed, TellTail optimizes model-specific queries that induce a chosen retrieval behavior on the target retriever but transfer poorly to others. Interestingly, the poor transferability that limits attacks elsewhere is exactly what makes them useful for fingerprinting. We evaluate TellTail using 53 retrievers under three increasingly restrictive settings. TellTail perfectly identifies the deployed retriever from full retrieval rankings; in 94.3% of attempts with unordered top-3 results; and in 92.5% of cases from language-model-generated answers alone. Furthermore, fingerprinting succeeds against a popular RAG system (OpenWebUI). Overall, TellTail shows that retrieval-based systems leak the identity of their embedding model---exposing intellectual property and enabling reconnaissance ahead of model-specific attacks such as corpus poisoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TellTail，一种黑盒检索器指纹攻击，仅通过查询即可识别系统背后的嵌入模型，在多种受限访问条件下实现高准确率识别。
AI.motivation: 现代文本检索依赖密集嵌入模型，但检索器通常部署在不透明系统中，仅暴露排序结果、引用来源或生成答案。这种不透明性使用户无法验证服务方实际使用的检索器，也可能造成对检索攻击鲁棒性的错误判断，存在知识产权泄露与安全侦察风险。
AI.method: TellTail 面向不同访问层级设计攻击：当检索到的文本片段被暴露时，通过比较检索重叠度推断底层模型；当仅暴露最终生成回答时，优化模型特定查询，使其在目标检索器上诱发特定检索行为，而对其他检索器迁移性差，从而利用低迁移性实现指纹识别。
AI.result: 在 53 个检索器、三种日益受限的设置下评估 TellTail：完整检索排名下可完美识别部署的检索器；无序 top-3 结果下 94.3% 识别成功；仅凭语言模型生成的答案时 92.5% 成功。此外，对流行 RAG 系统 OpenWebUI 的攻击也成功。
AI.conclusion: TellTail 表明基于检索的系统会泄露其嵌入模型身份，造成知识产权暴露并为语料投毒等模型特定攻击提供前置侦察。低迁移性这一通常限制攻击的特性，恰好成为指纹识别的有效工具。

title: A Step Towards Forgetting: Optimiser History and the Loss of Answer Mass
summary: During fine-tuning, a language model can assign less probability to previously learned answers even when the current gradient acts to preserve that probability. With momentum, each update also carries gradients computed at earlier model states, and these stored contributions can push the model in the opposite direction. We investigate how this optimiser memory contributes to forgetting by separating old-task loss into confusion among its answers and leakage of probability outside the answer set. Across three language-model families, answer mass consistently declines while discrimination among old answers usually improves: the model becomes less likely to produce answers that it can still distinguish correctly. Decomposing Adam updates reveals opposing contributions to this loss of answer mass. Over training, accumulated history favours leakage, while the current gradient opposes it. Resolving history by age shows that the harmful contributions come mainly from older gradients of the new task, whereas recent gradients tend to protect the old answers. Changes in history's effect are dominated by its orientation relative to the old-task gradient. Interventions that reset momentum while matching the initial update norm establish that stored history affects retention, with state-dependent immediate effects and lower final old-task loss over longer Adam continuations, mainly through recovered answer mass. Finally, integration along finite updates shows that most sampled large loss increases are captured by local projections, while curvature along history amplifies some events. Together, these findings reveal how an optimiser's memory can erode learned behaviour even as its current gradient acts to preserve it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究优化器动量记忆如何导致语言模型微调中的遗忘，将旧任务损失分解为答案混淆与概率泄漏，发现历史梯度主要促进泄漏，较旧的新任务梯度有害、近期梯度则起保护作用。
AI.motivation: 微调时即使当前梯度意在保持旧答案概率，模型仍会降低对已学答案的分配概率；作者希望澄清优化器动量中存储的早期梯度如何促成这种遗忘。
AI.method: 将旧任务损失分解为旧答案间的混淆与答案集外的概率泄漏；在三个语言模型家族上分析Adam更新，按梯度年龄分解历史贡献，并通过重置动量同时匹配初始更新范数的干预实验，以及沿有限更新的积分分析（局部投影与曲率）。
AI.result: 答案质量一致下降而旧答案判别力通常提升；Adam历史累积偏向泄漏，当前梯度反对泄漏；有害贡献主要来自较旧的新任务梯度，近期梯度保护旧答案；历史影响的变化由其相对于旧任务梯度的方向主导；重置动量可影响保持效果，较长Adam延续下最终旧任务损失更低，主要通过恢复答案质量实现；多数大幅损失增加可由局部投影捕捉，曲率沿历史会放大部分事件。
AI.conclusion: 优化器的历史记忆会侵蚀已学行为，即使当前梯度在保护它；动量中的旧梯度是关键因素，其方向与年龄决定遗忘程度。

title: Beyond Token Accuracy: Prioritizing What Matters for Visual Reconstruction
summary: Tokens have become a unified interface for multimodal foundation models, making visual-token communication a natural paradigm for efficient image delivery. However, existing methods typically rely on static policies that cannot jointly adapt to image content and channel conditions. Moreover, their token-level utility objectives do not necessarily translate into improved image reconstruction quality. In this paper, we propose AdapToC, an adaptive, reconstruction-oriented visual-token communication framework. At the transmitter, an adaptive selector jointly models image content, channel state, and communication budget to perform instance-wise resource allocation. Rather than using a fixed token rate and protection policy, it dynamically determines how many tokens should be transmitted and assigns different protection levels according to token importance and current channel conditions. At the receiver, an adaptive MaskGIT receiver incorporates channel reliability into contextual token modeling. It distinguishes tokens with different reliability levels, preserves high-confidence observations, corrects potentially corrupted tokens, and iteratively reconstructs missing content from the received evidence and global visual context. By co-designing token quantity, unequal protection, and reliability-aware recovery for image-level reconstruction quality, AdapToC achieves a peak mean PSNR gain of 4.20 dB over the strongest static baseline under matched communication costs and state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated visual-token communication methods.

AI.tldr: 提出AdapToC自适应、以重建为导向的视觉Token通信框架，联合自适应Token数量、非等保护与可靠性感知恢复，在匹配通信开销下PSNR最高提升4.20 dB。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉Token通信方法多采用静态策略，无法同时适应图像内容与信道条件；且其Token级效用目标未必能转化为更好的图像重建质量。
AI.method: 发送端自适应选择器联合建模图像内容、信道状态与通信预算，实现实例级资源分配，动态决定传输Token数量，并依据Token重要性与信道条件分配不同保护等级；接收端采用自适应MaskGIT接收器，将信道可靠性纳入上下文Token建模，区分不同可靠性Token，保留高置信观测、纠正可能受损Token，并基于已接收证据与全局视觉上下文迭代重建缺失内容。
AI.result: 在匹配通信开销下，相比最强静态基线峰值平均PSNR提升4.20 dB，在所评估的视觉Token通信方法中达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过协同设计Token数量、非等保护与可靠性感知恢复以服务图像级重建质量，可显著提升视觉Token通信效率与重建效果。

title: Exploration-Preserving Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves reasoning, while the allocation of learning signal shapes which solutions remain accessible under repeated sampling. Group-relative objectives assign equal advantages to equally rewarded responses, making aggregate credit proportional to sampled mode frequency. We introduce Exploration-Preserving Policy Optimization (ExPPO), a lightweight advantage-shaping rule that redistributes credit using prompt-relative, length-normalized response surprisal and prompt pass rate. ExPPO combines bounded shaping with shared normalization to preserve verifier polarity and approximately maintain each prompt group's total absolute sequence-advantage mass. Our analysis characterizes response-level credit allocation alongside sampled mode updates, deriving local conditions for gains in entropy and correct-mode discovery. Experiments show improved in-domain and out-of-domain reasoning coverage, higher aggregate response accuracy, and strong coverage at large sampling budgets. A controlled multi-answer evaluation further demonstrates increased correct-mode yield and gains in diversity among verified-correct responses. Code is available at https://github.com/jinhangzhan/ExPPO

AI.tldr: 提出ExPPO，一种轻量的优势塑形规则，通过长度归一化的响应surprisal与提示通过率重分配信用，在保持验证器极性和总优势质量守恒的前提下提升探索与推理覆盖。
AI.motivation: 可验证奖励强化学习能提升推理能力，但学习信号的分配方式决定了重复采样下哪些解仍可被触及；组相对目标给同等奖励响应相同优势，使聚合信用与采样模式频率成正比，从而抑制探索。
AI.method: ExPPO使用提示相对的、长度归一化的响应surprisal和提示通过率来重新分配信用；结合有界塑形与共享归一化，保持验证器极性并近似维持每个提示组的总绝对序列优势质量；分析刻画响应级信用分配与采样模式更新，推导熵增与正确模式发现的局部条件。
AI.result: 实验显示域内与域外推理覆盖提升、总体响应准确率更高、大采样预算下覆盖强；受控多答案评测显示正确模式产出增加，验证正确响应间多样性提升。
AI.conclusion: ExPPO以轻量优势塑形在保持优化稳定性的同时增强探索，提升推理覆盖与多样性，代码已开源。

title: Synergizing Drone Delivery Order Pooling and Road Network Monitoring through Monitoring-Task Orderization
summary: This paper investigates the real-time dispatch of a shared drone fleet for on-demand food delivery and urban road network monitoring. We consider a courier-drone collaborative setting in which couriers transport orders to launchpads and drones complete the final delivery leg to kiosks. Drones may consolidate multiple origin-destination orders within one flight and make monitoring-aware route adjustments to collect real-time traffic information subject to delivery-time constraints. This yields a joint decision problem coupling dynamic order-to-drone matching, multi-order pooling, routing, and time-varying monitoring under fleet-level competition and uncertainty. We propose monitoring-task orderization, which periodically converts road-network nodes with high congestion and stale information into virtual monitoring orders. Pooling these virtual tasks with food-delivery orders creates a unified heterogeneous task set and transforms the coupled matching-and-routing problem into an order-level decision process. Building on this abstraction, we formulate a decentralized graph-interdependent Multi-Agent Markov Decision Process and develop Graph Multi-Agent Q-Learning (Graph-MAQL), which captures localized inter-agent dependencies through bipartite match coordination graphs. Agent-task value estimates are then used as edge weights in a dynamic heterogeneous bipartite matching program for globally feasible execution. Experiments using real-world data reveal strong operational synergy between delivery and monitoring. Monitoring-task orderization improves monitoring performance by 25.1% with less than a 1% reduction in delivery performance, while Graph-MAQL improves the aggregate objective by up to 20.8%, reduces deadline violations by over 40%, and transfers zero-shot to higher demand intensity without retraining.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究共享无人机机队在即时外卖配送与城市路网监测中的实时调度问题，提出监测任务订单化与图多智能体Q学习（Graph-MAQL）方法，实现配送与监测的协同优化。
AI.motivation: 共享无人机机队可同时服务外卖配送与城市路网监测，但配送时限约束下的动态订单匹配、多订单合单、路径规划与时变监测存在强耦合，且面临机队竞争与不确定性，现有方法难以统一求解这一联合决策问题。
AI.method: 提出监测任务订单化：周期性将高拥堵且信息过时的路网节点转化为虚拟监测订单，与外卖订单合并为统一异构任务集，把耦合的匹配-路径问题转化为订单级决策过程。基于此构建去中心化图互依赖多智能体马尔可夫决策过程，并设计Graph-MAQL，通过二部匹配协调图刻画局部智能体依赖；智能体-任务价值估计作为动态异构二部匹配的边权，实现全局可行执行。
AI.result: 真实数据实验显示配送与监测存在显著协同效应：监测任务订单化使监测性能提升25.1%，配送性能下降不足1%；Graph-MAQL使综合目标提升最多20.8%，超期违约减少逾40%，并可零样本迁移至更高需求强度而无需重训练。
AI.conclusion: 配送与监测任务可协同完成，监测任务订单化与Graph-MAQL能有效解耦并求解复杂联合调度问题，在几乎不牺牲配送性能的前提下显著提升监测效果与整体目标，并具备良好的泛化能力。

title: Back to the Future: Regressing Readability Features from LLMs
summary:
Code readability supports software understanding, review, and maintenance. As AI coding agents become more widely used, readable code helps both humans review agent-generated output and agents maintain code within limited context windows. Yet existing readability models do not consistently agree with human judgements across datasets.
  We introduce BTTF (Back To The Future), pairing linear regression with information-theoretic features. Rather than using language models as black-box judges, BTTF uses them as measurement instruments. It combines traditional code measurements, embedding-based semantic organisation, and causal-LM predictability to capture source structure, semantic coherence, and contextual surprise.
  We evaluate BTTF on five publicly available human-rated readability benchmarks and our manually annotated MBJP development set, totalling 1,100 samples. BTTF improves average Spearman correlation over the strongest baseline by up to 0.101. Across 13 controlled readability-reducing transformations on production code, it achieves response rates of 93.8% in Java and 87.6% in Python, outperforming Dorn by 14% and 19.2%. It performs best among local models and trails the strongest cloud-LLM response by 1.7% in Java and 5.1% in Python. The direct-LLM baselines require an average of 1,083 prompt tokens per evaluation while remaining opaque. BTTF combines state-of-the-art benchmark performance and strong transformation robustness with feature-granular interpretability: every feature coefficient matches its theoretical directional effect across all evaluated model configurations.

AI.tldr: BTTF 用线性回归结合信息论特征来度量代码可读性，将语言模型作为测量工具而非黑箱评判，在多个基准和变换测试上超越基线，兼具高性能与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 随着 AI 编码代理的普及，可读代码有助于人类审查代理输出、也有助于代理在有限上下文窗口中维护代码。但现有可读性模型在不同数据集上与人类判断不一致，因此需要更可靠的度量方法。
AI.method: 提出 BTTF（Back To The Future），将线性回归与信息论特征结合。不同于把语言模型当作黑箱评判者，BTTF 把语言模型当作测量仪器，融合传统代码度量、基于嵌入的语义组织以及因果语言模型的可预测性，从而捕捉源码结构、语义连贯性与上下文意外度。
AI.result: 在五个公开人工评分可读性基准及自建的 MBJP 开发集（共1100个样本）上评估。BTTF 相对最强基线的平均 Spearman 相关性提升至多0.101。在生产代码的13种受控降可读性变换上，Java 响应率93.8%、Python 响应率87.6%，分别比 Dorn 高14%和19.2%。在本地模型中表现最佳，Java 仅落后最强云端 LLM 1.7%，Python 落后5.1%。直接使用 LLM 的基线每次评估平均需1083个提示词元且不透明。
AI.conclusion: BTTF 兼具最先进的基准性能、强变换鲁棒性与特征粒度的可解释性：在所有评估的模型配置中，每个特征系数都符合其理论方向效应。

title: Auditing the Privacy of Synthetic Gene Expression Data: A Unified Weighted-Distance Framework for No-Box Membership Inference
summary: Synthetic gene expression data is increasingly proposed as a privacy-preserving substitute for controlled-access genomic repositories, but its safety depends on empirical auditing. Membership inference attacks (MIAs) provide that audit by testing whether a patient's gene expression profile was used to train a generative model. We report a red-team study on synthetic gene expression data derived from bulk RNA-seq profiles in The Cancer Genome Atlas, released by the ELSA Health 2026 Challenge. We unify five no-box attacks under a single weighted-distance framework in which each variant differs only in how it weights genes: uniformly (baseline), by variance, by synthetic-versus-reference KL divergence, by spectral residualization removing dominant principal components, and by curated pathway membership. Against a conditional variational autoencoder, spectral residualization raises AUC from 0.8251 to 0.8951 and TPR at 1% FPR from 0.3842 to 0.5970 on pan-cancer TCGA. Biological pathway priors did not transfer across targets.

AI.tldr: 本文对ELSA Health 2026挑战赛发布的TCGA合成基因表达数据进行了红队审计，在统一的加权距离框架下比较五种无盒成员推理攻击，发现谱残差化加权显著提升攻击效果。
AI.motivation: 合成基因表达数据被 increasingly 提议作为受控访问基因组数据库的隐私保护替代品，但其安全性依赖经验审计；成员推理攻击（MIA）正是检验患者基因表达谱是否被用于训练生成模型的手段，因此需要系统评估此类数据的隐私泄露风险。
AI.method: 基于TCGA bulk RNA-seq数据衍生的合成基因表达数据（ELSA Health 2026 Challenge发布），在统一加权距离框架下整合五种无盒攻击，仅改变基因加权方式：均匀（基线）、按方差、按合成-参考KL散度、去除主成分的谱残差化、以及基于精选通路成员关系。目标模型为条件变分自编码器（cVAE）。
AI.result: 在泛癌TCGA上，针对条件变分自编码器，谱残差化将AUC从0.8251提升至0.8951，并将1%假阳性率下的真阳性率（TPR）从0.3842提升至0.5970。生物学通路先验未能在不同目标间迁移。
AI.conclusion: 去除主导主成分的谱残差化加权能显著增强成员推理攻击效果，表明该合成数据存在可被利用的隐私风险；而基于生物学通路的加权缺乏跨目标泛化能力。

title: BAIBAICHUCHU at the NTCIR-19 FinArg-3 Task: When Is Maximum Possible Profit Predictable from Investor Text?
comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Both authors contributed equally. Selected for oral presentation at NTCIR-19 (FinArg-3 Social Media Subtask)
summary:
The BAIBAICHUCHU team participated in the Social Media Subtask of NTCIR-19 FinArg-3, ranking Chinese investor posts by Maximum Possible Profit (MPP). A three-track ensemble of lexical features, a FinArg-2-pre-finetuned MacBERT ranker, and an LLM judge reaches 0.734 in post-grouped development evaluation, but our best official run scores 0.517. All twelve submitted runs lie between 0.4598 and 0.5402, and our 26 unanimous three-track pairs score 0.500.
  A post-hoc audit finds that the submitted judge applied a long-only rule to bearish posts although MPP is stance-aware. Correcting it changes 28 of 87 official predictions without changing accuracy, yet lowers development accuracy from 0.680 to 0.622: a regime-specific semantic shortcut improved validation fit.
  We decompose ranking into directional text, volatility and horizon, and pairwise margin. A running-extremum model predicts $σ\sqrt{T}$ scaling, observed ex post in 502 price-aligned posts from a separate July 2026 collection. Pre-posting volatility scaled by the post-specific observation horizon, $σ_{\mathrm{pre},20}\sqrt{N_i}$, is associated with a later truncated-horizon MPP proxy (Spearman $ρ=0.320$; ticker-cluster 95% CI [0.133,0.466]) and correctly orders 61.4% of unequal-outcome pairs. Transferred text is nearly uncorrelated with the July outcome ($ρ=0.055$) and adds little conditional on this score and stance. Development reliability rises from about 0.60 to 0.93 as the labeled MPP gap widens. An earlier ERAI result of 0.6207 rules out universal unpredictability as a simple explanation. Evaluation should jointly consider text, market regime, historical volatility, horizon, and pair composition.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了团队在NTCIR-19 FinArg-3社交媒体子任务中的表现：验证集得分为0.734，但官方提交成绩仅0.517，怀疑存在语义捷径与评估设计问题。
AI.motivation: 按最大可能收益（MPP）对中文投资者帖子排序时，验证集与官方测试成绩出现明显落差（0.734对0.517），需要审计原因并理解排序究竟由文本信号还是市场结构因素驱动。
AI.method: 采用三路集成：词汇特征、经FinArg-2预微调的MacBERT排序器、以及LLM评判器；事后审计LLM评判器对看跌帖误用long-only规则的影响，并将排序分解为方向性文本、波动率与时间跨度、成对边际三个成分，提出基于运行时极值模型的$\sigma\sqrt{T}$标度与预发布波动率$\sigma_{pre,20}\sqrt{N_i}$作为MPP代理。
AI.result: 十二个官方提交成绩介于0.4598–0.5402，26个三路一致对为0.500；修正long-only错误改变87个预测中的28个但准确率不变，验证准确率反而从0.680降至0.622。预发布波动率与截断时间跨度MPP代理的Spearman $\rho=0.320$（ticker聚类95% CI [0.133, 0.466]），正确排序61.4%的不等结果对；迁移文本与7月结果近乎无关（$\rho=0.055$）；标注MPP差距增大时验证可靠性从约0.60升至0.93；早期ERAI结果0.6207排除了“完全不可预测”的简单解释。
AI.conclusion: 该任务并非普遍不可预测，但当前评估与模型存在市场制度特定的语义捷径；评估应同时考虑文本、市场制度、历史波动率、时间跨度与成对组成，以避免验证拟合被短期制度偏差所误导。

title: Are We Measuring Anticipation? Auditing Privileged Information in Procedural Video Evaluation
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?
summary:
Benchmark scores license claims about the capabilities being evaluated. We audit the inference licensed by an evaluation protocol, rather than the predictive model alone. Using procedural action anticipation as a controlled case study, we study a broader evaluation-validity failure mode: a protocol can remain temporally causal and free of classical target leakage while still supplying a privileged intermediate representation. The failure is not merely optimistic accuracy, but a mismatch between the capability claimed and the construct actually measured.
  On Breakfast, matched recognizer-history and GT-history regimes score 30.3% and 62.3% (Delta_PH(R_BA) = +32.0, 95% Student-t interval [+24.1, +39.8]). A fixed-checkpoint 2 x 2 intervention isolates a +14.6-point test-time oracle contrast; a matched no-video provenance probe yields a +26.8-point gap; and a boundary-independent query/history control retains a +19.4-point gap. We refer to this discrepancy as a privileged-information gap, defined relative to a specified non-oracle recovery pipeline, and propose a reusable four-condition audit. Across five evaluation settings the gap is heterogeneous; a standard 50 Salads long-term-anticipation re-implementation provides cautious support beyond the audit-specific next-action construction.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过"程序化动作预判"这一受控案例，指出评估协议即使满足时间因果性、无经典目标泄漏，仍可能向模型提供"特权中间表征"，导致所声称能力与实际测量构念不匹配；作者将这种差距定义为"特权信息缺口"（privileged-information gap），并提出可复用的四条件审计方法。
AI.motivation: 基准分数常被用来为被评估能力背书，但现有审计主要关注预测模型本身，而忽略了评估协议所"授权"的推断是否成立。作者希望揭示一种更广泛的评估效度失效模式：协议可以时间因果且无经典目标泄漏，却仍通过GT历史等特权中间表征"作弊"，使声明的能力与实际测量的构念脱节——这不仅是精度乐观问题，而是构念错配。
AI.method: 以程序化动作预判为受控案例，在Breakfast数据集上设计多组干预实验：匹配的"识别器历史"与"GT历史"两种机制对比；固定检查点的2×2干预以分离测试时oracle对比；匹配的无视频来源探针；以及边界无关的查询/历史控制。并据此提出一个可复用的四条件审计框架，随后在五种评估设置中检验缺口的异质性，并对50 Salads长期预判任务进行标准重实现以验证其普适性。
AI.result: 在Breakfast上，识别器历史与GT历史机制分别得分为30.3%与62.3%（Delta_PH(R_BA)=+32.0，95% Student-t区间[+24.1,+39.8]）。固定检查点2×2干预分离出+14.6个百分点的测试时oracle对比；匹配的无视频来源探针呈现+26.8个百分点差距；边界无关的查询/历史控制仍保留+19.4个百分点差距。在五种评估设置中该缺口呈异质性；50 Salads长期预判的标准重实现为该审计提供了超出特定下一动作构念的谨慎支持。
AI.conclusion: 评估协议的效度审计不能止于检查时间因果性与目标泄漏，还需识别其所提供的特权中间表征。作者提出的"特权信息缺口"概念（相对于指定的非oracle恢复流程定义）及四条件审计框架，可揭示能力声明与测量构念之间的错配；跨设置结果异质，且50 Salads上的重实现表明该失效模式可能超出单一任务构念，具一定普适性。

title: Beyond the Parameter Monolith: Reconstructive Memories, Executable Skills, and Residual Assembly for Language Models
summary: Language-model systems can separate contextual computation, persistent storage, and exact execution instead of updating all capabilities through one shared parameter system. We investigate FEM-ASM, a finite-element-method-inspired organization in which independently constructed document states and deterministic executable skills contribute typed proposals to a shared language-model state. An explicit residual operator reconciles proposals attached to common interface nodes. We evaluate this organization through controlled experiments and negative results rather than claiming a physical finite-element formulation of language. An attention-free Multi-Mesh prototype learns causal language modeling but does not establish competitive general capability. A versioned store contains 52,809 reconstructive memory elements near a 1.7-billion-floating-value budget; reconstruction is incomplete, with approximately 75\% token accuracy. Support-aware lexical indices make these elements addressable under provenance-controlled query construction. For executable arithmetic, positional result observations substantially improve neural rendering relative to a repeated global result vector, and output substitutions change the model's preferred answer. A bounded attachment demonstration further measures the effect of making selected evidence available, without establishing the utility of loading an entire multi-billion-value store. The results support a separation of storage, execution, and neural coordination, while identifying unresolved limitations in question-only retrieval, unrestricted answer generation, and end-to-end efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 FEM-ASM，一种受有限元方法启发的语言模型组织方式，将上下文计算、持久存储与精确执行分离，通过受控实验和负面结果评估其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型系统通常通过单一共享参数系统更新全部能力，作者希望探索将上下文计算、持久存储和精确执行分离的组织方式，以避免所有能力耦合在同一参数系统中。
AI.method: 构建 FEM-ASM 组织：独立构造的文档状态与确定性可执行技能向共享语言模型状态提交带类型的提案，并用显式残差算子协调连接到公共接口节点的提案。通过受控实验评估，包括无注意力 Multi-Mesh 原型、版本化存储、支持感知词法索引、算术执行的可视化实验以及有界附件演示。
AI.result: 无注意力 Multi-Mesh 原型能进行因果语言建模，但未建立有竞争力的通用能力；版本化存储包含 52,809 个重构记忆元素，接近 17 亿浮点值预算，重构不完整，token 准确率约 75%；支持感知词法索引在溯源控制的查询构造下使元素可寻址；在可执行算术中，位置化结果观测显著优于重复的全局结果向量，输出替换会改变模型偏好的答案；有界附件演示测量了使选定证据可用的效果，但未证明加载整个数十亿值存储的效用。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持存储、执行与神经协调的分离，同时指出在仅问题检索、无约束答案生成和端到端效率方面仍存在未解决的局限。

title: Distributed Algorithms for $α$-Potential Functions in General-Sum Games
summary:
We study the problem of computing the tightest \(α\)-potential approximation of a general-sum game over continuous action spaces, within a prescribed class of potential functions and when each player has access only to its own utility function. The difficulty is twofold: the approximation error involves a worst-case search over an infinite set of unilateral deviations, and the required utility information is distributed across players.
  For a linear-in-parameters potential class, we use an exact finite-tuple reformulation that separates the problem into a global outer search over deviation tuples and distributed convex inner problems. We develop a primal--dual inner oracle tailored to this structure and establish a uniform one-sided accuracy guarantee. This oracle can be combined with global outer search to obtain an end-to-end guarantee on the outer optimization error. We also develop a projected zeroth-order outer method as a computationally lighter alternative for higher-dimensional problems. Numerical experiments illustrate the accuracy--computation tradeoff between the two outer-search methods and show that the proposed optimization framework can improve upon analytical \(α\)-potential constructions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在连续动作空间的一般和博弈中，计算给定势函数类下最紧的α-势近似，且各玩家仅能访问自身效用函数。
AI.motivation: 计算最紧α-势近似存在两重困难：近似误差涉及对无限单边偏离集合的最坏情况搜索，且所需效用信息分散在各玩家手中。
AI.method: 针对线性参数势函数类，采用精确有限元组重构，将问题分解为偏离元组的全局外层搜索与分布式凸内层问题；设计了适配该结构的原对偶内层oracle并建立一致单边精度保证，结合全局外层搜索获得端到端外层优化误差保证；还提出投影零阶外层方法作为高维问题的轻量替代。
AI.result: 数值实验展示了两种外层搜索方法在精度与计算量之间的权衡，并表明所提优化框架可改进解析α-势构造。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架能够在仅依赖分布式效用信息的条件下，有效计算并改进α-势近似。

title: RETRACE: From Entangled Repair Histories to Reusable Experience for CI Repair
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly reuse prior experience, but most approaches assume that problems and solutions are already aligned. Software histories rarely provide this alignment: a pull request (PR) may contain multiple continuous integration (CI) problems, failed attempts, reverted edits, and unrelated changes, obscuring which changes resolve each problem. We present RETRACE, a framework for reconstructing problem-level repair experience from such histories. RETRACE combines an endpoint view that reasons backward from changes retained in the passing revision with a development view that traces repair evolution forward through commit history. CI execution evidence reconciles the two views, and the recovered experience is represented at three abstraction levels, from concrete fixes to transferable repair patterns. For new failures, RETRACE retrieves relevant problem-level experience to guide repair. On CI-REPAIR-BENCH, comprising 565 PR-level repairs from 101 repositories across 12 failure categories, RETRACE improves mini-SWE-agent Pass@1 from 19.6% to 31.9% with MiniMax-M2.5 and from 23.3% to 32.8% with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. On a matched subset, Codex improves from 15.5% to 27.5%. Combining both views consistently outperforms either alone, showing that recovering problem-change alignment enables historical CI repairs to serve as reusable repair experience.

AI.tldr: RETRACE 从软件历史中重建问题级修复经验，用于指导新 CI 失败的修复。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体复用历史经验时通常假设问题与解决方案已对齐，但实际 PR 历史中混杂多个 CI 问题、失败尝试、回滚编辑和无关改动，难以确定哪些改动解决了哪个问题。
AI.method: 结合端点视角（从通过版本中保留的改动反向推理）与开发视角（沿提交历史正向追踪修复演化），用 CI 执行证据调和两视角，并在三个抽象层级表示恢复的经验（从具体修复到可迁移修复模式）；新失败时检索相关问题级经验指导修复。
AI.result: 在包含 101 个仓库、12 类失败的 565 个 PR 级修复基准 CI-REPAIR-BENCH 上，RETRACE 将 mini-SWE-agent Pass@1 从 19.6% 提升至 31.9%（MiniMax-M2.5），从 23.3% 提升至 32.8%（DeepSeek-V4-Flash）；匹配子集上 Codex 从 15.5% 提升至 27.5%。
AI.conclusion: 联合两种视角稳定优于单独使用任一视角，表明恢复问题-改动对齐能让历史 CI 修复成为可复用修复经验。

title: What Gradients Add to Text Leakage in Split Language Models, Counted per Token and per Document
summary: Split learning lets a client train a language model on a server without sending its text. The client runs the first layers itself and sends the server only their output, a vector of numbers for each token. During training, the server sends gradients back. We show that an observer at the split can rebuild most of the client's text from this traffic, and we measure how much the gradients help. On GPT-2, an attacker who holds only the publicly released weights of the client's layers recovers 94.20% of tokens from the activations alone and 97.38% when it also sees the gradients, 3.17 percentage points more 95% interval [2.72, 3.64]. Counted by document, the difference is much larger. The attacker rebuilds 13.71% of 32-token documents exactly without the gradients and 37.77% with them, because a document only counts when every token is right. How we count also changes how good a defence looks. Secret mixup, which blends each outgoing vector with a decoy, stops the attacker from rebuilding almost any document exactly, yet the attacker still recovers 83-91% of tokens. In a second experiment on GPT-2 and Qwen3-0.6B, where the server trains only a run of consecutive layers, the layer at which the run starts changes both model quality and leakage, even when the run's length is fixed. We recommend reporting leakage both per token and per document, and treating what a split model sends as being as sensitive as the text itself.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示拆分学习（split learning）中客户端发送的中间激活与回传梯度会严重泄露原始文本，并提出按token与按文档两种泄露度量标准及防御评估启示。
AI.motivation: 拆分学习允许客户端在不发送原始文本的情况下训练语言模型，客户端运行前几层并仅向服务器发送每个token的输出向量，训练时服务器回传梯度。作者质疑这种"隐私保护"假设，希望量化该通道到底泄露多少文本，以及梯度在其中的额外贡献。
AI.method: 作者训练一个观察者（攻击者）模型，仅持有客户端层的公开权重，从拆分点截获的激活向量重建客户端文本；并在有/无梯度两种条件下对比。度量上同时采用"按token"和"按文档"两种口径（文档需每个token都正确才算重建成功）。此外评估了Secret mixup（将每个输出向量与诱饵混合）防御效果，并在GPT-2与Qwen3-0.6B上进行第二个实验：服务器只训练一段连续层，考察该层段起始层位置（层段长度固定）对模型质量与泄露的影响。
AI.result: 在GPT-2上，仅凭公开权重，攻击者从激活中恢复94.20%的token；同时看到梯度后升至97.38%，提高3.17个百分点，95%置信区间[2.72, 3.64]。按文档计算差异更大：32-token文档的完全重建率从无梯度时的13.71%升至有梯度时的37.77%。防御方面，Secret mixup几乎阻止了文档级完全重建，但攻击者仍能恢复83-91%的token。第二个实验中，层段起始层位置同时影响模型质量与泄露程度，即使层段长度固定。
AI.conclusion: 作者建议泄露评估应同时报告按token和按文档两种指标，并应将拆分模型所发送的内容视为与原始文本同等敏感。

title: Do Language Models Need a Trainable Input Embedding Table? Fixed Minimal Token Codes at 1.7B-Class Scale
summary: A trainable input embedding table assigns each vocabulary item an independently adjustable vector. We investigate whether this token-specific parameterization is required for substantial language-modeling capability, or whether a shared Transformer can learn from fixed token identities. We compare three decoder-only language models trained from scratch with the same tokenizer, contextual backbone, untied output-head architecture, and training recipe, with a target budget of 100 billion prediction tokens per model. Their input interfaces are a learned table, canonical 16-bit token-ID codes, and one fixed invertible recoding over GF(2). The fixed codes are repeated to model width without an additional trainable input projection. Both fixed-code models acquire substantial capabilities: canonical codes achieve 52.40\% HellaSwag normalized accuracy, 70.51\% PIQA accuracy, and 42.75\% LAMBADA accuracy. The learned-input control performs better on several evaluations, including HellaSwag and LAMBADA, so these results establish viability rather than performance parity. The fixed interfaces remove 100.7 million trainable parameters, yielding 1.711B-parameter models, but parameter reduction is not the central result. These single-run experiments distinguish architectural necessity from empirical utility: independently trainable token-specific input vectors are not required for the observed capabilities. A fixed identity interface also provides a controlled setting for studying representation learning downstream of an immutable input, without establishing where particular capabilities are localized.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言模型是否必须使用可训练的词元嵌入表，发现用固定词元身份编码（16位词元ID码或GF(2)可逆编码）替代可学习输入嵌入后，模型仍能获得显著语言建模能力，说明可独立训练的、特定于词元的输入向量并非获得这些能力的必要条件。
AI.motivation: 标准语言模型通过可训练输入嵌入表为每个词表项分配可独立调整的向量。作者想探究这种词元特定的参数化是否是获得实质性语言建模能力的必要条件，还是说共享的Transformer可以从固定的词元身份中学习。
AI.method: 对比三个从零训练的仅解码器语言模型，使用相同分词器、上下文骨干、非绑定输出头架构和训练配方，目标预算约1000亿预测词元/模型。输入接口分别为：可学习嵌入表、规范的16位词元ID码、GF(2)上的一个固定可逆重编码。固定编码被直接重复到模型宽度，不添加额外的可训练输入投影。
AI.result: 两个固定编码模型均获得实质性能力：规范编码达到52.40% HellaSwag归一化准确率、70.51% PIQA准确率、42.75% LAMBADA准确率。可学习输入对照组在HellaSwag和LAMBADA等若干评测上表现更好，因此结果确立的是可行性而非性能持平。固定接口移除1.007亿可训练参数，得到1.711B参数模型，但参数减少并非核心结果。
AI.conclusion: 这些单次运行实验区分了架构必要性与经验效用：观察到这些能力并不要求可独立训练的词元特定输入向量。固定身份接口也为研究不可变输入下游的表示学习提供了受控环境，但未确定特定能力定位于何处。

title: Streaming Multi-Track Timeline Control for 3D Human Motion Generation
summary: Text-driven human motion generation has advanced substantially, yet most methods assume instructions are available before synthesis. Interactive applications require responding to new instructions while continuing ongoing actions, such as answering a phone while walking. Existing approaches address streaming generation or simultaneous composition without explicitly combining streaming instruction arrival with independently timed, overlapping actions. We introduce streaming multi-track timeline control and propose TimelineControl to incorporate new instructions alongside ongoing actions. Interval-aware conditioning preserves instruction timing, while causal part-structured representations and part-aware denoising coordinate concurrent actions across body regions. We also construct TimelineMotion, a dataset with overlapping instruction intervals and body-part annotations. Experiments on TimelineMotion and MTT demonstrate improved semantic alignment and temporal adherence over evaluated streaming baselines, including models retrained on the same data. Ablations and human evaluations validate our design, complemented by spatial conditioning and humanoid execution demonstrations. Our code, data and models will become publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出流式多轨时间线控制任务及 TimelineControl 方法，可在动作进行中接入新指令，实现重叠动作的协调生成，并构建 TimelineMotion 数据集验证效果。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动人体动作生成多假设指令在合成前已给定，无法支持交互式应用中动作进行时接收新指令（如边走边接电话）的需求；已有的流式生成或同步组合方法未显式结合"流式指令到达"与"独立定时的重叠动作"。
AI.method: 提出 TimelineControl：采用区间感知条件化保留指令时序；使用因果部件结构化表示与部件感知去噪，协调身体不同区域的并发动作。同时构建 TimelineMotion 数据集，包含重叠指令区间与身体部件标注。
AI.result: 在 TimelineMotion 与 MTT 上的实验表明，相较评估的流式基线（含在同一数据上重训练的模型），语义对齐与时间遵循性均有提升；消融实验与人工评估验证了设计有效性，并补充了空间条件化与人形机器人执行演示。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效支持流式多轨时间线控制下的重叠动作生成，代码、数据与模型将公开。

title: A Quantitative Analysis of Graph Representation Strategies for Cyber Attack Detection
summary: Graph based cyber attack detection studies employ various graph construction and representation strategies across different cybersecurity application domains. This diversity motivates a quantitative examination of how representation strategies are distributed across these application domains. This study presents a quantitative analysis of 37 original studies published between 2019 and 2026. Each study was coded according to publication year, application domain, graph representation type, feature extraction strategy, learning paradigm, algorithm, and dataset. Frequency analysis, cross tabulation, and statistical association tests were applied. Automated representation learning was the most frequently employed strategy, accounting for 73.0% of the studies, while handcrafted representation strategies accounted for 27.0%. The Fisher Freeman Halton exact test revealed a statistically significant association between application domain and representation strategy (exact p = 0.008; Cramer's V = 0.540). The findings indicate that automated representation learning predominates within the analyzed corpus and that the distribution of representation strategies differs across cybersecurity application domains.

AI.tldr: 本文对2019—2026年间37项基于图的网络攻击检测研究进行量化分析，统计其图表示策略、应用领域等编码信息，发现自动表示学习占主导（73.0%），且表示策略的分布在不同网络安全应用领域间存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 基于图的网络攻击检测研究在各网络安全应用领域中采用了多样的图构建与表示策略，这种多样性促使作者对表示策略在不同应用领域中的分布进行量化考察，以厘清研究现状与领域间差异。
AI.method: 选取2019至2026年间发表的37项原创研究，按发表年份、应用领域、图表示类型、特征提取策略、学习范式、算法和数据集进行编码，并采用频数分析、交叉列表和统计关联检验（Fisher-Freeman-Halton精确检验、Cramer's V）进行分析。
AI.result: 自动表示学习是最常采用的策略，占73.0%，手工设计表示策略占27.0%；Fisher-Freeman-Halton精确检验显示应用领域与表示策略之间存在统计显著关联（精确p = 0.008；Cramer's V = 0.540）。
AI.conclusion: 在所分析的研究集合中，自动表示学习占据主导地位，且表示策略的分布在不同网络安全应用领域之间存在差异。

title: Can CaMeLs Talk? Securing Multi-Agent Systems Against Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks
summary: Indirect prompt injection attacks - malicious instructions embedded in content processed by large language models - remain a major obstacle to safely deploying tool-using agents. CaMeL [Debenedetti et al., 2025] mitigates this threat for an individual agent by separating trusted control flow from untrusted data and enforcing capability-based security policies at runtime. In this work, we investigate whether CaMeL's security guarantees compose in hierarchical multi-agent systems, where agents invoke other agents as tools. We find that CaMeL's guarantees do not compose. We construct a concrete prompt-injection attack that succeeds despite all constituent agents individually operating CaMeL. Our attack exploits the fact that untrusted data can be reinterpreted as trusted input by a downstream agent. We then introduce multi-CaMeL, an agent-to-agent communication protocol that preserves provenance across agent boundaries by separating trusted natural-language instructions from untrusted data passed through a distinct data channel. We evaluate multi-CaMeL's utility on AssetOpsBench and its security-utility tradeoff on MultiAgentDojo, a benchmark we develop by extending AgentDojo to the multi-agent setting. We find that multi-CaMeL reduces attack success rate (ASR) to 0.0%, compared with 0.2% for individual-agent CaMeL and 12.9% with no CaMeL. Multi-CaMeL incurs a utility cost, but this cost trends downward as model capability increases and is modest for the strongest models, suggesting that more capable models better accommodate the constraints imposed by the protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文研究CaMeL的安全保证在层次化多智能体系统中是否能组合，发现不能组合（可构造成功攻击），并提出multi-CaMeL协议恢复安全保证，将攻击成功率降至0.0%。
AI.motivation: 间接提示注入攻击是部署工具型智能体的一大障碍。CaMeL通过分离可信控制流与不可信数据并在运行时执行基于能力的安全策略，为单个智能体提供缓解。但实际系统常为层次化多智能体（智能体把其他智能体当作工具调用），因此需要探究CaMeL的安全保证能否在多智能体系统中组合。
AI.method: 首先构造具体的提示注入攻击，证明当所有组成智能体各自运行CaMeL时攻击仍可成功，其利用了不可信数据被下游智能体重解释为可信输入这一漏洞。随后提出multi-CaMeL——一种智能体间通信协议，通过将可信自然语言指令与不可信数据分离到不同数据通道，跨智能体边界保留来源（provenance）。在AssetOpsBench上评估效用，并在扩展AgentDojo得到的多智能体基准MultiAgentDojo上评估安全-效用权衡。
AI.result: multi-CaMeL将攻击成功率（ASR）降至0.0%，而单个智能体CaMeL为0.2%，无CaMeL为12.9%。multi-CaMeL带来一定效用损失，但该损失随模型能力提升而下降，对最强模型而言损失不大。
AI.conclusion: CaMeL的安全保证无法在多智能体系统中组合，存在被利用的漏洞。multi-CaMeL通过保留来源的智能体间通信协议可有效消除该类攻击，且其效用代价随模型能力增强而减小，表明更强模型更能适应协议带来的约束。

title: Towards Automatically Pruning Logging Code with Coding Agents: How Far Are We?
summary: Logging code supports debugging, monitoring, and software maintenance, but excessive logging can add noise, impose runtime overhead, and obscure diagnostic information. While prior research has extensively studied logging code generation and modification, logging removal remains comparatively underexplored. In this paper, we study developer logging removal practices and explore the use of coding agents for this task. We extract and manually validate logging removal cases from Python and Java repositories and derive 10 removal patterns and 11 removal reasons that characterize how and why logging code was removed in real-world software changes. We further construct LogRem, a dataset of 387 real-world cases covering direct logging statement removal, logging infrastructure removal, and logging replacement. We evaluate four coding agents with multiple model settings and compare their outputs with accepted real-world changes. Although 95.6% to 100.0% of outputs pass validity checks, only 11.1% to 19.6% remove the same logging code as the corresponding real-world change while preserving unrelated code. Agents differ through missed removals, extra removals, and unrelated code edits, with substantial variation across logging removal categories and trajectories. Execution cost varies widely, but higher cost does not consistently yield closer alignment. Commit messages and developer discussions provide the largest alignment gains, while taxonomy guidance consistently reduces runtime. Overall, our study establishes logging removal as a distinct software maintenance task and shows that reliable automation depends on accurately determining removal scope while preserving necessary code. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to examine logging code removal from this perspective.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究日志代码删除（logging removal）这一被忽视的软件维护任务，从Python和Java仓库提炼出10种删除模式与11种删除原因，构建387个真实案例数据集LogRem，并评估四个编码智能体在该任务上的表现，发现自动化可靠性仍取决于准确界定删除范围。
AI.motivation: 日志代码支持调试、监控与维护，但过度日志会引入噪声、运行时开销并掩盖诊断信息。已有研究多集中于日志代码的生成与修改，日志删除研究相对不足，因此本文从开发者实践与自动化工具两个角度填补这一空白。
AI.method: 从Python与Java仓库提取并人工验证日志删除案例，归纳出10种删除模式与11种删除原因；构建包含387个真实案例的数据集LogRem，覆盖直接删除日志语句、删除日志基础设施与日志替换三类；在多种模型设置下评估四个编码智能体，并与真实被采纳的变更进行对比。
AI.result: 95.6%至100.0%的智能体输出通过有效性检查，但仅11.1%至19.6%的输出去掉了与真实变更相同的日志代码且保留无关代码。智能体在漏删、多删和无关代码编辑上表现各异，不同删除类别与执行轨迹差异显著。执行成本波动大，但更高成本并未带来更接近的对齐效果。提交信息与开发者讨论带来最大的对齐提升，分类法指导则持续降低运行时开销。
AI.conclusion: 本文将日志删除确立为一项独立的软件维护任务，表明可靠的自动化依赖于准确判定删除范围并保留必要代码。据作者所知，这是首个从该视角考察日志代码删除的研究。

title: From Temporary Access to Persistent Surveillance: Why Matter Matters in Smart Homes
summary: Matter aims to unify smart home ecosystems through an open, interoperable, and secure standard, relying on cryptographic mechanisms for device authentication and data confidentiality. However, its openness also exposes protocol details, credential structures, and implementation characteristics to adversaries. We show that an attacker with temporary physical access can exploit design and implementation flaws to extract credentials and impersonate devices and controllers. These replicas integrate seamlessly into the fabric, enabling persistent surveillance and control even after the attacker departs. Notably, the attack is vendor-agnostic and requires no device-specific reverse engineering, as long as the device is not physically secured. We validate its practicality through a proof-of-concept on a simulated smart home with both commercial devices and development boards. Our findings uncover previously underestimated attack surfaces in Matter, particularly under physical access scenarios, and motivate four targeted mitigation strategies.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示Matter智能家居标准在临时物理访问下存在设计缺陷，攻击者可提取凭证并克隆设备/控制器，实现持久监控与控制，且攻击与厂商无关，只需概念验证即可在商用设备与开发板上复现。
AI.motivation: Matter旨在以开放、可互操作、安全的标准统一智能家居生态，其安全性依赖密码学机制进行设备认证与数据机密性。但开放性同时暴露了协议细节、凭证结构与实现特征，使攻击者有机可乘。论文关注此前被低估的物理访问攻击面。
AI.method: 利用临时物理访问条件，寻找Matter协议的设计与实现缺陷，提取凭证并克隆设备与控制器；采用模拟智能家居环境（含商用设备与开发板）进行概念验证，验证攻击的可行性与厂商无关性。
AI.result: 克隆实体能无缝接入fabric，即使攻击者离开后仍可实施持久监视与控制；攻击无需设备特定逆向工程，只要设备未被物理加固即可实施。概念验证在模拟环境中成功复现。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了Matter在物理访问场景下被低估的攻击面，并据此提出四项针对性缓解策略。

title: Periscope: Extending Frozen Language Models Beyond Their Context Window
summary: A language model reads long text in one quadratic forward pass, stops at the context window, and loses accuracy with length before reaching it. We ask whether the read can be factorized when deciding over a finite set: which document is relevant, which option is supported, which passage is the evidence. Periscope, a training-free inference method, arranges the $N$ chunks of a text on a $K{\times}K$ grid with $K{=}\lceil\sqrt{N}\rceil$ and asks a frozen model the same question about $K$ local spans of consecutive chunks and $K$ strided spans that sample the whole text, reading the log-odds of every answer at one token. Each answer takes its best local and strided score, and scoring every chunk by its two spans gives an evidence map at no further cost, whose peak is the chunk behind the answer. Every probe is about $\sqrt{sc}$ tokens for a text of $s$ tokens and chunk size $c$, so a window of $W$ tokens reaches $W^{2}/c$ tokens at $s^{1.5}$ cost. The map replaces the long read. On LongBench v2, reading only the $K$ chunks the map ranks highest, 9k tokens, matches the same model's best window read across windows from 32k to 1M tokens, and on InfiniteBench, where the median context is 150k tokens, it leads the best window read by 5 points. The same map ranks BRIGHT's long-document corpora with the best NDCG@10 of six methods. Each call caches only one probe, so a 27B model reads 4.5M-token contexts on one 80GB GPU, where a single pass would need 296GB of cache. A long read then needs a GPU that holds the model, not one that holds the text.

AI.tldr: Periscope 是一种免训练推理方法，通过网格化分块探测将长文本的二次前向读取分解，实现低显存下的长上下文处理。
AI.motivation: 语言模型读取长文本时采用单次二次前向，受限于上下文窗口，且长度增加会导致精度下降。作者希望探究：当决策针对有限选项集合（如哪篇文档相关、哪个选项被支持、哪段是证据）时，长文本读取能否被分解。
AI.method: Periscope 将文本的 N 个块排列在 K×K 网格上（K=⌈√N⌉），对冻结模型就 K 个连续块局部跨度和 K 个采样全文的跨步跨度问同一问题，在单 token 处读取每个答案的对数几率。每个答案取最佳局部与跨步得分，对每个块用其两个跨度打分即可免费生成证据图，其峰值即答案对应的块。每次探测约 √(sc) 个 token（文本 s 个 token、块大小 c），因此 W token 的窗口以 s^1.5 代价覆盖 W²/c 个 token，用该图替代长读取。
AI.result: 在 LongBench v2 上，仅读取证据图排名最高的 K 个块（9k token）即可匹配同模型 32k 至 1M token 窗口的最佳读取；在 InfiniteBench（中位上下文 150k token）上比最佳窗口读取高 5 分。同一图在 BRIGHT 长文档语料上取得六种方法中最优的 NDCG@10。每次调用仅缓存一个探测，因此 27B 模型可在单张 80GB GPU 上读取 4.5M token 上下文，而单次前向需 296GB 缓存。
AI.conclusion: 长读取所需的 GPU 只需能容纳模型本身，而非能容纳全部文本。Periscope 通过证据图替代长读取，在降低显存需求的同时保持甚至超越窗口读取性能。

title: DABACO: A Multi-Camera Dataset and Benchmark for Screen Localization and Pointing Estimation
comment: 21 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22797835. Code and toolkit: https://domondo.github.io/dabaco-dataset-toolkit/
summary:
Screen localization and pointing estimation are key to low-cost interactive devices. Yet developing and evaluating these algorithms requires realistic data: synthetic captures cannot fully reproduce the optical distortion, rolling shutter, motion blur, and display processing of a physical acquisition, and most existing datasets provide static images rather than the video needed to assess continuous pointing. In this paper, we introduce the DABACO Dataset. Developed within the DABACO (Dispositivo Apuntador de BAjo COste, or Low-Cost Pointing Device) project, this dataset supports the development and evaluation of screen detection and camera-based pointing algorithms for embedded systems. It comprises video sequences captured with multiple low-cost camera sensors, including monochrome global-shutter and color rolling-shutter modules, on embedded platforms such as the Raspberry Pi 4B and ESP32-S3.
  We present a systematic annotation pipeline combining temporary visual watermarking, optical-flow tracking, manual verification, and marker removal. Both the original marked captures and the marker-free images, together with explicit corner annotations and modification masks, are released to support auditing and the study of potential reconstruction bias.
  In addition, we release an open-source evaluation toolkit with two reference baselines: a classical screen-detection pipeline based on edge and contour geometry, and a closed-vocabulary, off-the-shelf YOLOv8 segmentation model evaluated without dataset-specific training. Both are evaluated on a general-purpose computer using Intersection over Union, corner error, and pointing error, establishing initial reference results for future embedded implementations. Overall, DABACO addresses a gap in existing resources and is intended to support the development and evaluation of new low-cost screen-localization and pointing systems.

AI.tldr: 提出DABACO数据集，用低成本相机采集视频序列，支持屏幕定位与指向估计算法的开发与评估，并附带标注流程、评估工具包与两个基线结果。
AI.motivation: 屏幕定位与指向估计对低成本交互设备至关重要，但算法开发与评估缺乏真实数据：合成采集无法复现光学畸变、卷帘快门、运动模糊与显示处理等真实效应，且现有数据集多为静态图像，难以评估连续指向。
AI.method: 构建DABACO数据集，使用多种低成本相机传感器（黑白全局快门与彩色卷帘快门模块）在Raspberry Pi 4B、ESP32-S3等嵌入式平台采集视频序列；采用临时视觉水印、光流跟踪、人工校验与标记移除的系统化标注流程，同时发布带标记原始采集、去标记图像、角点标注与修改掩码；并提供开源评估工具包及两个基线（基于边缘与轮廓几何的经典屏幕检测流程，及未经数据集特定训练的闭词表YOLOv8分割模型）。
AI.result: 在通用计算机上以IoU、角点误差与指向误差评估两个基线，给出初始参考结果。
AI.conclusion: DABACO填补了现有资源空白，可支持新型低成本屏幕定位与指向系统的开发与评估。

title: The Reported Engagement with AI Level (REAL) Rating: A Framework for Disclosing Human-AI Collaboration
summary: Generative artificial intelligence has become increasingly incorporated into digital media and more generally into production workflows with which the public frequently interacts. Current provenance standards and disclosure methods frequently rely on binary categorizations, differentiating only between entirely human-authored and AI-generated content, or depend on technical watermarking that lacks user-facing clarity. However, there are very different risks and outcomes depending on the different uses of AI in the creation and consumption of end products. Therefore, we propose the Reported Engagement with AI Level (REAL) Rating framework which addresses these concerns by introducing a six-tier scale (Levels 0-5) that discloses the extent of AI involvement in both product creation and user experience. This paper details the structural methodology of the REAL Rating system and the specifics of its application across text, image, audio, video, and software products.

AI.tldr: 提出REAL评级框架，用六级量表披露AI在产品创作与用户体验中的参与程度。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI已广泛融入数字媒体与生产流程，但现有溯源标准和披露方法多依赖二元分类（完全人工或AI生成），或依赖缺乏用户清晰度的技术水印。AI在创作和消费中的不同使用方式会带来差异很大的风险与结果，因此需要更细致的披露机制。
AI.method: 提出Reported Engagement with AI Level（REAL）评级框架，采用六级量表（Level 0-5），分别披露AI在产品创作和用户体验两方面的参与程度，并阐述其结构化方法以及在文本、图像、音频、视频和软件产品中的应用细节。
AI.result: 论文详细说明了REAL评级系统的结构化方法论及其在多种媒介产品（文本、图像、音频、视频、软件）中的具体应用方式。
AI.conclusion: REAL评级框架通过多级、双维度的披露方式，弥补了现有二元分类和技术水印的不足，为AI参与度的透明披露提供了可推广的方案。

title: Scalar Communication via Random Direction Refreshing for Distributed Optimization
summary: Distributed optimization over networks requires agents to repeatedly exchange decision variables with their neighbors. When the decision dimension $d$ is large, these exchanges dominate the communication cost, which is critical for bandwidth-constrained agents. Existing remedies quantize or sparsify the exchanged vectors, yet each message still scales with $d$ and the compression error must be compensated by additional states. To address this limitation, we propose a scalar-communication mechanism in which every neighbor message carries a single real number regardless of $d$. Agents regenerate a common random direction from a shared seed, transmit only the inner product of their state with that direction, and act on the resulting rank-one surrogate of their neighbors' states while retaining full local gradients. We develop and analyze the mechanism for an existing continuous-time distributed optimization algorithm. For strongly convex local costs with Lipschitz gradients, we show that the optimizer remains the unique consensus equilibrium, that a fixed direction admits spurious equilibria, and that refreshing the direction at a sufficiently high rate yields exponential mean-square and almost-sure convergence with constant gains and no residual error. The framework admits any isotropic fixed-norm direction distribution, including Rademacher, scaled-coordinate, and sphere-normalized Gaussian directions; all three attain lower fresh-encoding variance than unnormalized Gaussian directions. The effects of the direction distribution and the refresh interval are illustrated in~simulations.

AI.tldr: 提出标量通信机制：每次邻居消息只传一个实数，与决策维度无关，仅发送状态与共享随机方向的内积；在连续时间分布式优化中，高频刷新方向可实现指数均方与几乎必然收敛。
AI.motivation: 分布式优化中智能体需反复交换决策变量，当决策维度d很大时通信开销大；现有量化/稀疏化方法每条消息仍随d增长，且压缩误差需额外状态补偿。
AI.method: 基于共享种子生成公共随机方向，智能体只传输状态与该方向的内积，用秩一代理重建邻居状态，同时保留完整局部梯度；为已有连续时间分布式优化算法开发并分析该机制。支持任意各向同性固定范数方向分布（Rademacher、缩放坐标、球面归一化高斯）。
AI.result: 对强凸局部代价与Lipschitz梯度：优化器仍是唯一一致均衡；固定方向会产生伪均衡；足够高频率刷新方向可获指数均方与几乎必然收敛，常数增益且无残差误差；三种方向分布的新鲜编码方差均低于未归一化高斯方向；仿真展示了方向分布与刷新间隔的影响。
AI.conclusion: 标量通信机制可将每消息代价降至与d无关，且通过高频方向刷新避免伪均衡、实现无残差的指数收敛，为带宽受限网络提供高效替代方案。

title: Asymmetric Repository Lineage Modeling and Verifier-Guided Coordination in Concurrent AI Coding Agents
summary: Concurrent AI coding agents create a coordination problem in which cheap signals may prioritize work, but only an executable checker can establish the property being claimed. We study this separation through a property-scoped verification contract and MERGEGYM, a three-track benchmark for open-time scope forecasting, replay- conditioned conflict resolution, and scheduling. On a stratified 715-pair lineage set (167 textual conflicts), 79 conflicts (47.3%) occur despite disjoint authored file sets. This is an operationally important proxy mismatch expected from three-way merge: authored PR diffs are measured against PR-specific bases, whereas the checker compares both heads to their common merge base. A standalone lineage-union rule reaches held-out AUROC 0.877; a 12-feature logistic model reaches 0.882 [0.845, 0.917] with PR-AUC 0.661, and an untuned random forest on the same decision-time features reaches 0.902 [0.875, 0.928] with PR-AUC 0.701. At a 33.3% held-out replay budget, the logistic and random-forest models recover 81.2% and 82.9% of conflicts, respectively. Patch reconstruction succeeds for 48/79 zero- overlap conflicts and all 48 become clean; the other 31 cases are inconclusive, so this check validates the expected three-way-merge explanation rather than claiming a new Git mechanism. In T1, a zero-shot LLM reaches AUC 0.704 and LLM-plus- metadata fusion 0.740. In T3, a decision-time gate de-overlaps a median 91.7% of labeled scope collisions at 65.0% makespan inflation under frozen-label replay. Because local git merge-tree replay is already cheap in our logs (median 0.02 s), we do not claim that lineage triage saves this checker alone: when exact replay is cheap, verify everything. All empirical guarantees in this paper remain limited to textual mergeability or the explicitly stated frozen-label scheduling target.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究并发AI编码代理的协调问题，提出按属性划分的验证契约与MERGEGYM三轨基准，实证显示廉价的谱系信号可预测冲突但无法替代可执行检查器。
AI.motivation: 并发AI编码代理带来协调问题：廉价信号（如谱系/元数据）可对工作进行优先级排序，但只有可执行检查器才能真正确立所声称的性质。作者希望厘清"信号预测"与"检查器验证"之间的分离与边界。
