We further show that RFT can also improve social influence, including tasks that require agents to steer votes, team approvals and collective decisions, although these gains depend more strongly on behaviourally specific rewards and structured interaction settings. Finally, we show that LLMs' ability to play social deduction games can be further improved through multi-agent social-cognitive reinforcement fine-tuning, which combines social-reading and social-influence signals during same-side multi-agent training. These learned behaviours also receive more favourable human evaluations of strategic competence, persuasiveness and social usefulness. Together, these results enrich our understanding of how RFT changes LLMs' social behaviour and provide a step toward a behavioural learning theory for machine social intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文利用社会推理游戏研究强化微调（RFT）如何改变大语言模型的社会行为，发现终局胜负信号稀疏且有噪声，难以可靠习得社会推理能力；但RFT能有效提升社会阅读，并在特定奖励与结构化互动下改善社会影响，多智能体社会认知RFT可进一步提升表现并获得更优人类评价。
AI.motivation: 随着RFT在LLM与人类及其他智能体交互中的应用日益增多，需要理解RFT如何改变LLM的社会行为。作者选择隐藏角色类社会推理游戏作为研究场景，因为这类游戏需要隐藏状态推断、社会阅读与投票引导等核心社会能力。
AI.method: 让微调后与基座的LLM智能体参与隐藏角色游戏，考察其在隐藏状态推断、社会阅读与投票引导上的表现；对比直接优化终局胜负的结果奖励与更行为特异化奖励的效果；并进一步提出多智能体社会认知强化微调，在同侧多智能体训练中结合社会阅读信号与社会影响信号。
AI.result: 直接优化终局胜负结果时，LLM智能体无法可靠获得社会推理能力，说明最终游戏结果是稀疏且噪声较大的信号。RFT对社会阅读提升尤为有效，包括从公开讨论推断隐藏角色、随时间更新信念、预测其他智能体未来决策。RFT也能提升社会影响（引导投票、团队批准与集体决策），但这类收益更依赖行为特异的奖励和结构化互动环境。多智能体社会认知RFT可进一步提升游戏表现。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的行为在人类评估中获得更高的策略能力、说服力与社会有用性评价。研究增进了对RFT如何改变LLM社会行为的理解，并朝机器社会智能的行为学习理论迈进一步。

title: LLM-Based Test Generation: Information Sources, Generation Strategies, and Quality Evidence
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to generate test scenarios, executable test suites, assertions, interaction sequences, and fuzzing infrastructure. These artifacts serve different purposes and rely on different sources of information about correct behavior. A test that increases implementation coverage, a test that agrees with a reference program, and a test that detects a requirements violation therefore provide distinct kinds of evidence. We present a structured narrative survey that connects the generation process to the evidence used to justify test quality. Drawing on 95 curated source records through 29 September 2026, we organize the field along four dimensions: testing objectives and artifacts, information available during training and generation, generation and learning mechanisms, and evaluation evidence. We synthesize work on unit and requirements-based testing, test oracles, API and GUI testing, fuzzing, and learned test generators. The resulting framework explains how execution feedback can improve executability while also affecting the independence of an oracle, why specification provenance and training-time reference supervision matter for comparisons, and how downstream code-selection gains differ from test correctness. We use these distinctions to organize benchmarks and derive a research agenda for independent oracle assessment, budget-aware generation, repository-scale evaluation, and test maintenance.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇结构化叙事综述，通过连接“测试生成过程”与“用于评估测试质量的证据”，对基于大语言模型的软件测试生成研究进行系统梳理，并提出研究议程。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型已被广泛用于生成测试场景、可执行测试套件、断言、交互序列和模糊测试基础设施。然而这些产物目的不同、依赖的正确行为信息来源也不同：提高实现覆盖率的测试、与参考程序一致的测试、检测需求违规的测试所提供的证据类型彼此不同，现有研究缺乏统一框架来区分这些差异。
AI.method: 采用结构化叙事综述方法，基于截至2026年9月29日的95条精选来源记录，沿四个维度组织该领域：测试目标与产物、训练与生成阶段可用的信息、生成与学习机制、评估证据。工作综合了单元测试与需求驱动测试、测试预言、API与GUI测试、模糊测试以及学习型测试生成器等方面的研究。
AI.result: 该框架解释了若干关键问题：执行反馈如何提升测试可执行性同时影响预言（oracle）的独立性；规格来源和训练时参考监督为何对比较研究至关重要；下游代码选择带来的收益为何不同于测试正确性。基于这些区分，论文还整理了相关基准并推导出研究议程。
AI.conclusion: 论文为LLM测试生成研究提供了以“证据”为核心的组织框架，并据此提出四个方向的研究议程：独立预言评估、预算感知的测试生成、仓库级评估以及测试维护。

title: COPEX: Benchmarking LLM Robustness to Adversarial Context Across Model Context Protocol Layers
comment: Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Agents in the Wild
summary: Large language models increasingly mediate tool use in Model Context Protocol (MCP) systems, where adversarial influence may enter through user instructions, tool schemas, tool outputs, or protocol messages. Existing benchmarks often evaluate deployed agents, conflating model susceptibility with guardrails, orchestration, and general task capability. We introduce COPEX (COntext Provider EXploitation), a controlled benchmark that isolates the model as an MCP client by fixing the surrounding agent stack and varying only the tool-selecting model. COPEX covers 25 attack types instantiated as 125 scenarios across four entry surfaces: model/agent, client, server/tool, and transport. Across nine models and 3,375 trials, the mean attack success rate is 64.4%, with surface-level means ranging from 58.3% to 71.4%. Some client- and transport-level attacks succeed partly outside the model's observation or control, separating system exposure from model susceptibility. Combined input and context scanning reduces mean attack success by 49.6% on an eight-attack defense subset relative to the undefended setting. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/inspire-center/copex.

AI.tldr: 提出COPEX基准，通过固定代理栈、仅变换工具选择模型，将模型作为MCP客户端隔离评估，涵盖4个入口面、25种攻击类型共125个场景。九模型3,375次试验平均攻击成功率为64.4%，输入与上下文扫描可将8类攻击子集的成功率降低49.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多评估已部署的代理系统，把模型自身的易感性与其护栏、编排逻辑和通用任务能力混为一谈，难以定位风险究竟来自模型还是外围系统。因此需要一个能剥离外围因素、单独衡量模型作为MCP客户端脆弱性的受控基准。
AI.method: 构建COPEX受控基准：固定周边代理栈，仅替换执行工具选择的模型，从而隔离模型变量。基准覆盖25种攻击类型，实例化为125个场景，分布于模型/代理、客户端、服务器/工具、传输四个入口面；在9个模型上进行3,375次试验，并设置含8类攻击的防御子集用于对比。
AI.result: 平均攻击成功率为64.4%，各入口面均值介于58.3%至71.4%之间。部分客户端层与传输层攻击的成功在一定程度上超出模型的观察或控制范围，从而将系统暴露与模型易感性区分开来。在八攻击防御子集上，输入与上下文联合扫描使平均攻击成功率相对无防御设置下降49.6%。
AI.conclusion: 将模型作为MCP客户端单独评估，可更清晰地界定模型易感性与系统暴露的边界；客户端与传输层的部分风险不完全受模型控制，需在系统层面防护。输入与上下文扫描是一种有效的缓解手段，基准已开源。

title: Trajectory-Derived Confidence for Reliable, Resource-Aware Clinical Text-to-SQL Agents
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Resource-Aware Agentic AI (RAAAI). 19 pages, 7 figures
summary: LLM agents for clinical text-to-SQL applications reason autonomously over multiple steps but cannot assess whether their own reasoning or outputs can be trusted. In high leverage applications such as healthcare, this presents a critical risk where system mistakes can be costly. These reliability failures are also resource failures: an incorrect reasoning trajectory spends computation budget on outputs that must be discarded. We introduce Sentinel, a trajectory-derived, classifier-based confidence layer that analyzes an agent's reasoning, code and database outputs to decide at three points whether to stop: refusing unanswerable questions before the agent runs, halting doomed trajectories mid-run, and withholding untrustworthy answers at delivery. Here, utilizing Chow's rule, we optimize decisions under the EHRSQL shared task's Reliability Score, which penalizes incorrect answers given a utility weighting, and find on the benchmark EHRSQL that Sentinel raises this score from +0.08 to +0.24 when mistakes have a low utility weighting, well above the +0.03 earned by refusing every question, with delivered-answer accuracy rising from 54% to 69% as coverage falls from 84% to 55%. At higher stakes the agents we test rarely answer reliably enough to deliver, and Sentinel detects this on its own, abstaining to that same +0.03 where the unmonitored agent scores -3.02. The same stopping decisions cut computation: at low stakes, where the system still answers, Sentinel eliminates 13-28% of agent steps at little or no reliability cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Sentinel，一种基于轨迹的置信度分类层，用于在多步推理的临床 text-to-SQL 智能体中于运行前、运行中、交付时三个节点判断是否停止，从而提升可靠性并减少无效计算。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在临床 text-to-SQL 等高风险场景中会自主多步推理，但无法判断自身推理或输出是否可信。错误不仅带来医疗风险，还浪费计算资源于必须丢弃的输出上，因此需要一种可靠性监控机制。
AI.method: Sentinel 是一个从智能体轨迹中导出的分类器置信度层，分析推理、代码与数据库输出，在三个决策点决定是否停止：运行前拒答不可回答问题、运行中终止注定失败的轨迹、交付时拒绝不可信答案。方法利用 Chow 规则，在 EHRSQL 共享任务的 Reliability Score（对不同效用权重下的错误答案进行惩罚）下优化决策。
AI.result: 在 EHRSQL 基准上，当错误效用权重较低时，Sentinel 将 Reliability Score 从 +0.08 提升至 +0.24，远高于一律拒答所得的 +0.03；已交付答案的准确率从 54% 升至 69%，覆盖率由 84% 降至 55%。在高风险设定下，未监控智能体得分 -3.02，而 Sentinel 能自主识别并弃答，达到 +0.03。低风险场景下，Sentinel 在几乎不损失可靠性的前提下减少 13-28% 的智能体步骤。
AI.conclusion: Sentinel 通过对轨迹进行置信度建模和停止决策优化，能够在高风险临床 text-to-SQL 场景中显著提升可靠性，并在必要时自动弃答，同时降低计算开销。

title: ClasSAE: Class-Aligned Sparse Autoencoders via Differentiable Feature-Class Affinity
summary: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) began as an unsupervised tool for decomposing neural representations into sparse, interpretable features, and are increasingly used not only for passive analysis but also for active interventions such as unlearning, bias mitigation, and concept editing. A central challenge for these editing and steering methods is reliably matching features to target concepts; most current approaches address this by computing post-hoc scores over an already-trained, frozen dictionary. We instead introduce ClasSAE, a novel method that both automatically assigns classes to features and guides the encoder toward class-separable representations during training. Specifically, we apply a differentiable top-$k$ operator to a trainable feature--class affinity matrix with per-feature budgets, coupling the features selected for each sample to the classes they are trained to represent. Because gradients flow through the selection of active features rather than only through their magnitudes, the encoder and the affinity matrix co-adapt rather than being fit in separate stages. The result is a dictionary that is both class-separable and class-annotated, with no need for post-hoc probing. We propose three variants for enforcing sparsity within this framework, which achieve comparable overall performance with slightly different trade-offs. Using CLIP ViT-L/14 embeddings on ImageNet, we show that the learned affinity matrix agrees closely with an independently estimated post-hoc feature-class matrix computed on held-out data. The model also supports direct class prediction from the encoder and affinity matrix alone, without a separately fitted classifier, and its more class-aligned encoder yields improved separation in Targeted Probe Perturbation evaluations. https://github.com/St0pien/ClasSAE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ClasSAE，在稀疏自编码器训练过程中同时自动为特征分配类别标签并引导编码器学习类别可分的表示，无需事后探测。
AI.motivation: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）已从被动分析神经表征扩展到主动干预（如遗忘、偏见缓解、概念编辑），但这些编辑与引导方法的核心难题是可靠地将特征与目标概念匹配。现有方法多依赖在已训练、冻结的字典上计算事后分数，属于分离的两阶段流程，特征与概念的对应关系不够可靠。
AI.method: 提出 ClasSAE：构造可训练的特征—类别亲和度矩阵，并对该矩阵施加带每特征预算的可微 top-k 算子，使每个样本选中的特征与其被训练代表的类别耦合。由于梯度通过"活跃特征的选择"而非仅通过其幅值回传，编码器与亲和度矩阵得以共同自适应，而非分阶段拟合。此外提出三种在该框架内施加稀疏性的变体。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 上使用 CLIP ViT-L/14 嵌入时，学到的亲和度矩阵与在留出数据上独立估计的事后特征—类别矩阵高度一致；模型可仅凭编码器与亲和度矩阵直接进行类别预测，无需单独训练分类器；更具类别对齐性的编码器在 Targeted Probe Perturbation 评估中表现出更好的分离度。三种稀疏变体总体性能相当，仅在权衡上略有差异。
AI.conclusion: ClasSAE 得到的字典同时具备类别可分性与类别标注能力，无需事后探测，为 SAE 的概念编辑与引导提供了更直接可靠的特征—概念匹配方案。

title: The Independence Prior of SAEs Fragments Visual Concepts
summary: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) decompose model activations into sparse combinations of interpretable dictionary atoms. Although SAEs are grounded in the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH), their objective smuggles in an additional prior: concepts across patches are treated as independent, an assumption clearly violated by natural images and by the activations they induce. We therefore specialize LRH to vision through the Markov-Field Linear Representation Hypothesis (MFLRH), which adds the missing spatial dependencies to the LRH assumptions. We thus propose Spatial-SAE as an amortized MAP estimator under the MFLRH. Spatial-SAE consistently outperforms standard SAEs in concept recovery and interpretability. Across four variants, it achieves a 96% average win rate on synthetic concept recovery and improves interpretability on DINOv2 activations, at a reconstruction cost concentrated in high spatial frequencies.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Spatial-SAE，通过在稀疏自编码器目标中显式建模空间依赖，更符合视觉表示假设，在概念恢复与可解释性上优于标准 SAE。
AI.motivation: 标准 SAE 虽基于线性表示假设（LRH），但其目标隐含假设不同 patch 的概念相互独立，这与自然图像及其激活的空间相关性不符。
AI.method: 将 LRH 专门化到视觉领域，提出马尔可夫场线性表示假设（MFLRH），为 LRH 补充缺失的空间依赖；并据此提出 Spatial-SAE，将其视为 MFLRH 下的摊销 MAP 估计器。
AI.result: 在四种变体上，Spatial-SAE 于合成概念恢复任务中取得 96% 的平均胜率，并在 DINOv2 激活上提升可解释性，重建代价主要集中在高空间频率。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模空间依赖的 Spatial-SAE 在概念恢复和可解释性上一致优于标准 SAE，但重建代价偏向高空间频率。

title: Evidence and Intervention: A Coupled Active-Inference Extension of Rational Speech Act Models
summary: Identical utterance choices can arise from different communicative causes, and identical interpretations can leave different traces in what a listener learns. Rational Speech Act (RSA) models treat interpretation as inference over speaker meaning, but standard one-shot RSA does not intrinsically distinguish these causal update targets. We develop a coupled active-inference model of dialogue in which a listener's likelihood for an utterance is the policy distribution attributed to the speaker, placing the speaker's expected free energy within the listener's variational free energy. Each utterance is therefore both evidence about and an intervention on a partner. The model separates four updates that RSA approaches typically collapse: inference about the partner's current pragmatic state; learning of partner-specific parameters; prospective evaluation of clarification or repair; and a policy prior shaped by habit and a context-sensitive price of time. Under one-step, exact-inference restrictions, the model recovers the RSA speaker and listener, with RSA as the restricted single-turn limit of the coupled process. Outside these restrictions, the updates obey distinct rules and timescales, predicting which adaptations persist, remain partner-specific, or transfer. Worked examples show audience design reversing after clarification, self-confirming misunderstanding in which both interlocutors have low free energy while disagreeing about reference, and rational closing before uncertainty is resolved. Consistent with critiques of equating natural language with communication, the model treats communication as a downstream use of linguistic structure and recasts production and interpretation as coupled inference: speaking is both an intervention on a partner and an epistemic action that samples evidence for the speaker's model of that partner.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个耦合主动推理的对话模型，将听者对 utterances 的似然设为说话者的策略分布，从而区分标准RSA中被合并的四种更新过程，并在单步精确推理限制下还原RSA。
AI.motivation: 相同的言语选择可能出于不同交际原因，相同的解释也可能给听者带来不同的学习痕迹。标准单次RSA将解释视为对说话者意义的推理，但无法内在区分这些因果更新目标，因此需要更细粒度的模型。
AI.method: 构建对话的耦合主动推理模型：听者对某言语的似然等于归因于说话者的策略分布，将说话者的期望自由能置于听者的变分自由能中。模型分离四种更新：对伙伴当前语用状态的推理、伙伴特定参数的学习、澄清或修复的前瞻性评估、由习惯和情境敏感时间成本塑造的策略先验。
AI.result: 在一步精确推理限制下，模型还原RSA说话者与听者，RSA成为耦合过程的受限单轮极限。在限制之外，各更新遵循不同规则和时间尺度，可预测哪些适应会持续、保持伙伴特定或迁移。示例展示澄清后受众设计反转、双方自由能低却对指称不一致的自我确认误解，以及不确定性解决前的理性结束。
AI.conclusion: 该模型将沟通视为语言结构的下游使用，把产出与解释重构为耦合推理：说话既是对伙伴的干预，也是为说话者伙伴模型采样证据的认识行动，与将自然语言等同于沟通的批评一致。

title: Rethinking Tool Design for Agentic RCA: A Controlled Empirical Study
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly explored for root cause analysis (RCA) in microservice systems, yet empirical guidance on how to design and combine their tools remains limited. We conduct a controlled empirical study of tool abstraction and composition across models and microservice environments. We implement 24 structured tools for metric access (L1), evidence analysis (L2), and diagnosis (L3), alongside a Python-based reference setting (L0). Using 375 failure cases from three microservice systems, we evaluate eight configurations with Qwen3.7-Plus and compare four Qwen models on a shared subset of four configurations. Our results show that tool configurations affect root cause localization and failure type identification differently. With Qwen3.7-Plus, L3 achieves 82.8% top-1 localization accuracy compared with 85.4% for L0, while requiring less than half the time per case. Adding tool levels can improve type identification while reducing localization accuracy. Trajectory analysis reveals cases in which agents override correct diagnostic recommendations after consulting additional evidence. Model choice also changes tool benefits: adding L3 to L1+L2 improves diagnosis for three models but hurts Qwen3-8B, which rarely invokes L3. Tool configuration rankings further change across microservice systems. These findings provide an empirical foundation for designing and using RCA tools, guiding tool selection and composition according to the model, diagnostic objective, and target system.

AI.tldr: 本文对微服务根因分析（RCA）中的LLM智能体工具抽象与组合进行了受控实证研究，实现24个分三级（L1度量访问、L2证据分析、L3诊断）的结构化工具，并在三个微服务系统、375个故障案例上评估八种工具配置。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在微服务RCA中应用日益广泛，但关于如何设计和组合其工具仍缺乏实证指导，需要系统性地理解工具抽象与组合对诊断效果的影响。
AI.method: 为度量访问（L1）、证据分析（L2）和诊断（L3）实现24个结构化工具，并设置基于Python的参考基线（L0）。使用来自三个微服务系统的375个故障案例，以Qwen3.7-Plus评估八种配置，并在四种配置的共享子集上比较四个Qwen模型，同时进行轨迹分析。
AI.result: 工具配置对根因定位和故障类型识别的影响不同。Qwen3.7-Plus下L3的top-1定位准确率为82.8%，L0为85.4%，但每案例耗时不到一半。增加工具层级可提升类型识别却降低定位准确率。轨迹分析发现智能体在查阅额外证据后会推翻正确的诊断建议。模型选择改变工具收益：在L1+L2上加入L3对三个模型均有改善，但损害了很少调用L3的Qwen3-8B。工具配置排名还随微服务系统而变化。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为设计和使​​用RCA工具提供了实证基础，可指导根据模型、诊断目标和目标系统来选择与组合工具。

title: JASPER: Special Session on Joint Reliability And Security Assessment of SPlit Computing for Edge Robustness
comment: 11 pages, 9 figures. Accepted as a special session paper at the 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Defect and Fault Tolerance in VLSI and Nanotechnology Systems (DFT)
summary: Split Computing (SC) enables efficient deployment of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) by partitioning inference between edge devices and cloud servers. However, intermediate feature representations are simultaneously exposed to hardware faults and adversarial attacks, which are traditionally evaluated independently. This paper presents a unified framework for the joint assessment of reliability and security in Split Computing. First, reliability is characterized through neuron-level fault injection using the Mean Relative Accuracy Degradation (MRAD) while security through feature-map-aware adversarial attacks simulations using the Attack Success Rate (ASR). Based on these complementary analyses, the Joint Vulnerability Score (JVS) is introduced, along with a confidence-aware extension that jointly captures prediction errors and confidence degradation. The framework is evaluated on ten Split Computing configurations based on ResNet-50 trained on ILSVRC-2012. Experimental results show substantial differences across compression strategies, with MRAD ranging from 44.3% to 61.2% under fault injection, while adversarial attacks achieve up to 98.8% ASR. Furthermore, the proposed joint metrics reveal vulnerability trends that remain hidden when reliability and security are analyzed independently, providing a more comprehensive methodology for designing dependable Split Computing systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一框架，同时评估分割计算中的可靠性与安全性，通过神经元级故障注入和特征图感知对抗攻击，提出联合脆弱性评分（JVS）及其置信度感知扩展，实验揭示独立分析时被掩盖的脆弱性趋势。
AI.motivation: 分割计算将推理在边缘设备与云服务器间划分，但中间特征表示同时面临硬件故障与对抗攻击的威胁，而这两者传统上被独立评估，缺乏统一的联合分析视角。
AI.method: 采用神经元级故障注入，以平均相对精度退化（MRAD）表征可靠性；以特征图感知对抗攻击，用攻击成功率（ASR）表征安全性。基于这两类互补分析提出联合脆弱性评分（JVS）及置信度感知扩展，可同时捕捉预测误差与置信度下降。在基于ResNet-50、ILSVRC-2012训练的十种分割计算配置上评估。
AI.result: 不同压缩策略差异显著：故障注入下MRAD为44.3%–61.2%，对抗攻击ASR最高达98.8%。所提联合指标揭示了可靠性与安全性独立分析时被隐藏的脆弱性趋势。
AI.conclusion: 该统一框架为设计可靠的分割计算系统提供了更全面的方法论，表明必须联合考虑可靠性与安全性。

title: Can LLMs Separate Pasted Artifacts from User Speech? Absorption at Unmarked Prompt Seams
summary: Large language models (LLMs) receive each user message as plain text, even when it combines text from different sources. For example, a user may paste text into a prompt and keep typing a comment directly below it. We study absorption: a phenomenon where the model treats a trailing user comment as part of the pasted text, returning it inside the edited text. This happens even though the user did not intend the comment to become part of that text. Existing instruction-data separation benchmarks tell the model which text is instruction and which is data, then test whether it obeys that separation. They do not test harmless user speech following an unmarked paste. We introduce SEAM, a controlled benchmark of 300 editing examples. Each example is tested under six matched conditions that vary how the boundary between pasted text and later user speech is expressed. Across 20 models, absorption at a bare newline ranges from 7.7% to 66.7%. Adding a blank line does not significantly reduce absorption in any model, while boundary markers reduce it in 19 of 20 models. Comments that fit the pasted text, such as a code comment typed after code, are absorbed significantly more often in 17 of 20 models. Models often fail to separate pasted material from later user speech, and explicit boundaries reduce but do not remove this failure.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"吸收"现象：模型将粘贴文本后的用户评论误当作粘贴内容的一部分，并提出SEAM基准进行评测。
AI.motivation: 现有指令-数据分离基准会明确告知模型哪部分是指令、哪部分是数据，因此无法测试用户粘贴无标记文本后随后附上无害评论时的分离能力，这一空白正是本文关注的问题。
AI.method: 提出SEAM受控基准，包含300个编辑示例，每个示例在六种匹配条件下测试，这些条件改变粘贴文本与后续用户话语之间边界的表达方式；并在20个模型上进行评测。
AI.result: 在仅用裸换行分隔时，吸收率在7.7%至66.7%之间；添加空行未显著降低任何模型的吸收率；边界标记在20个模型中19个有效降低吸收；与被粘贴文本风格相符的评论（如代码后的代码注释）在20个模型中17个被更频繁吸收。
AI.conclusion: 模型常常无法分离粘贴材料与后续用户话语，显式边界可减轻但无法消除这一失败。

title: Learning Subject-Specific Anatomical Representations via Manifold Expansion: Application to Accelerated Multi-Contrast MRI
summary: Clinical MRI routinely acquires multiple contrast-weighted images of the same anatomy for complementary tissue characterization. However, current accelerated MRI methods typically reconstruct each contrast independently, without fully exploiting shared anatomical information. This work aims to learn anatomical representations invariant to contrast-dependent appearance for reconstruction of accelerated multi-contrast MRI. We propose MAX (MAnifold eXpansion), a subject-specific framework that learns anatomical representations from a single fully sampled reference contrast. To address the under-constrained separation of shared anatomy and contrast-dependent components from a single image, MAX expands the multi-contrast manifold using anatomy-preserving intensity augmentations. A disentangled implicit neural representation models augmented samples using shared spatial coordinates for anatomy and spatially invariant coordinates for contrast appearance. The learned anatomical representation is then fixed, with the contrast representation adapted to the undersampled target data, followed by unrolled refinement. Theoretical analyses further provide insight into the disentangled representation learning and explain how the learned anatomical representation improves the target contrast reconstruction. At R = 8 for brain MRI and R = 6 for knee MRI, MAX achieves the highest mean PSNR and SSIM across all tasks, improving PSNR by more than 1 dB over the strongest baseline for both brain contrasts. MAX more faithfully recovers subtle anatomical and pathological structures and remains robust to inter-contrast motion, structural heterogeneity between reference and target contrasts, and measurement noise. Therefore, MAX provides a general strategy for leveraging high-quality reference scans in accelerated MRI and has the potential to be extended to other reference-assisted MRI inverse problems.

AI.tldr: 提出MAX框架，利用单张全采样参考对比图像学习解剖表征，并通过流形扩展与解耦隐式神经表征实现加速多对比MRI重建。
AI.motivation: 临床MRI常采集同一解剖部位的多种对比加权图像以互补表征组织，但现有加速MRI方法通常独立重建每个对比，未充分利用共享的解剖信息。
AI.method: MAX从单张全采样参考对比中学习解剖表征；针对单图分离共享解剖与对比相关成分的不适定性，用保解剖的强度增强扩展多对比流形；用解耦隐式神经表征建模增强样本（共享空间坐标表解剖、空间不变坐标表对比外观）；固定解剖表征、适配对比表征至欠采样目标数据，再进行展开式细化。
AI.result: 脑MRI R=8、膝MRI R=6时，MAX在所有任务取得最高平均PSNR与SSIM；脑对比PSNR较最强基线提升超过1 dB；更忠实恢复细微解剖与病理结构，对对比间运动、参考与目标对比的结构异质性及测量噪声稳健。
AI.conclusion: MAX为加速MRI中利用高质量参考扫描提供通用策略，并有望扩展到其他参考辅助的MRI逆问题。

title: CUAWright: A Minimal Unified Interface for Digital Agents
summary: The prevailing approach to computer-use agents couples a model with a domain-specific harness: a browser or desktop environment equipped with human engineered tools that are fixed before task execution. As models' coding capabilities improve, the GUI native and static harness prevents them from direct programmatic operation on system state, as well as flexible construction of tools. To this end, we introduce CUAWright, a minimal terminal harness of roughly 3K lines of code that uses bash commands as its sole action interface, and a file system as its evolvable space for dynamically creating tools and managing the context. We conduct comprehensive experiments across a wide range of digital tasks, and demonstrate that by giving the agent a minimal, programmable interface, it achieves substantially stronger results compared to their GUI or hybrid CLI interface across a wide range of tasks. On OSWorld 2.0, CUAWright delivers a 33.2% relative improvement in partial reward while reducing estimated cost by 37.5% compared with the published GPT-5.5 baseline. On Online-Mind2Web and the long horizon Odysseys benchmark, CUAWright substantially outperforms GUI native harness by 4.7% and 44.0% in success rate, respectively. Furthermore, we found the gains extend to CAD applications that require accurate visual understanding and CLI interaction: on CADGenBench and BenchCAD, our unified harness yields 8.1%-41.6% relative improvements over other CLI based harnesses with GPT-5.5. Together, these results suggest digital environments are far more programmable than their GUI interfaces imply, and a minimal terminal-focused harness is the key for better performance and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出CUAWright——一个约3K行的最小化终端harness，仅用bash命令作为操作接口、文件系统作为可进化工具空间，在多个数字任务基准上显著超越GUI原生harness。
AI.motivation: 现有computer-use agent将模型与领域特定的harness耦合（浏览器或桌面环境配人工预设工具），工具在任务执行前固定。随着模型编码能力提升，GUI原生且静态的harness阻碍了其对系统状态进行直接程序化操作以及灵活构建工具。
AI.method: CUAWright：约3K行代码的最小化终端harness，以bash命令为唯一动作接口，以文件系统作为可进化的空间，用于动态创建工具和管理上下文。
AI.result: OSWorld 2.0上部分奖励相对提升33.2%、成本降低37.5%（对比GPT-5.5基线）；Online-Mind2Web和长程Odysseys基准成功率分别超出GUI原生harness 4.7%和44.0%；CADGenBench和BenchCAD上相对其他CLI harness提升8.1%-41.6%。
AI.conclusion: 数字环境的可编程性远超其GUI界面所暗示，最小化的终端导向harness是获得更优性能与效率的关键。

title: TrustMed-RL: Long-Horizon Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Clinical Diagnosis
summary: Medical language models can produce correct diagnoses despite incomplete investigations and unsupported reasoning. To support long-horizon, evidence-grounded diagnosis, we introduce \textbf{TrustMed-RL}. Built from PubMed rare-disease cases and over 24,000 manually annotated image panels, it integrates interviews, examinations, testing, specialist consultation, and literature search through state-dependent actions. Our 8B vision--language policy, trained with clinically adapted GiGPO and coverage-adjusted diagnostic rewards, achieves 37.1\% diagnostic accuracy on 2,500 evaluation cases, outperforming all evaluated open-weight baselines and improving over supervised fine-tuning by 12.4 percentage points.. When success additionally requires acquiring at least 50\% of supporting test evidence, TrustMed-RL achieves 32.5\%, exceeding GPT-4o by 6.8 percentage points. Furthermore, it surpasses all evaluated baselines on MTMedDialog and multiple larger 27--32B models on AgentClinic. In physician review of 200 diagnostically accepted test-set trajectories, 83.0\% receive evidential-grounding scores of 4--5 out of 5. Physicians' assessments suggest that these diagnostic trajectories are trustworthy and aligned with human diagnostic reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出TrustMed-RL，一个基于PubMed罕见病病例与2.4万+标注图像面板的医学诊断模型，通过状态依赖动作整合访谈、检查、检验、会诊与文献检索，8B视觉语言策略经临床适配GiGPO与覆盖调整奖励训练，在2500例评估中达37.1%诊断准确率。
AI.motivation: 医学语言模型常能在检查不完整、推理缺乏依据的情况下给出正确诊断，缺乏长程、证据支撑的诊断能力。为支持可证据溯源的长期诊断流程，需要新的方法与数据集。
AI.method: 构建TrustMed-RL，数据来自PubMed罕见病病例与超24,000个人工标注图像面板；通过状态依赖动作整合访谈、查体、检验、专科会诊与文献检索；采用临床适配的GiGPO与覆盖调整诊断奖励训练8B视觉语言策略。
AI.result: 在2,500例评估中诊断准确率37.1%，优于所有评估的开源基线，较监督微调提升12.4个百分点；当额外要求获取至少50%支持性检验证据时达32.5%，超GPT-4o 6.8个百分点；在MTMedDialog及AgentClinic上优于多个27–32B模型；200例可接受轨迹的医师评审中83.0%获得4–5分（满分5分）的证据支撑评分。
AI.conclusion: 医师评估表明该模型的诊断轨迹可信，与人类诊断推理相一致，验证了证据驱动的长程医学诊断路径的有效性。

title: Characterizing Security Effects of OSS Vulnerabilities in Agent Systems
summary:
Software agents increasingly depend on open-source components when executing tools and interacting with external systems. Security flaws in these dependencies may therefore influence more than the software process in which they occur: their consequences can be carried through tool outputs, agent state, and information subsequently exposed to the model. Determining whether such a consequence is actually realized in a particular execution, and where its influence stops within the agent system, remains challenging.
  We investigate how known OSS vulnerabilities behave when exercised as part of agent workflows. Our study reveals recurring patterns in the way security-relevant consequences emerge and propagate across runtime layers. Building on these observations, we use vulnerability-aware semantic information, differential executions of vulnerable and corrected software, and runtime provenance spanning multiple layers to determine whether a vulnerability produces an observable security effect and to identify the furthest layer at which that effect remains manifested.
  Our evaluation shows that this approach can accurately distinguish realized vulnerability effects and determine their manifestation boundaries across a diverse collection of vulnerability scenarios. We additionally apply the analysis to documented workflows in a real-world agent framework and uncover multiple security effects originating from known vulnerabilities in its OSS dependencies. These results highlight the importance of reasoning about vulnerable dependencies in terms of their execution-level consequences rather than vulnerability presence alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究智能体（agent）所依赖的开源软件（OSS）漏洞在执行工作流时如何产生并传播安全后果，提出结合漏洞语义信息、差分执行与多层运行时溯源的方法，用以判定漏洞是否产生可观测安全效应及其传播的最远边界。
AI.motivation: 软件智能体在执行工具调用和与外部系统交互时日益依赖开源组件，这些依赖中的安全漏洞影响范围可能超过其所在的软件进程，后果会通过工具输出、智能体状态以及随后暴露给模型的信息传递。然而，判断某一具体执行中这种后果是否真正发生、其影响在智能体系统内终止于哪一层，仍具有挑战性。
AI.method: 作者研究了已知OSS漏洞在作为智能体工作流一部分被执行时的行为，发现安全相关后果在运行时各层出现和传播的重复模式。基于此，方法使用三类信息：漏洞感知的语义信息、漏洞版本与修复版本的差分执行、以及跨多层的运行时溯源，来判定漏洞是否产生可观测的安全效应，并识别该效应仍然体现的最远层级。
AI.result: 评估表明，该方法能够在多样化的漏洞场景集合中准确区分已实现的漏洞效应并确定其表现边界。此外，作者将分析应用于一个真实世界智能体框架中有文档记录的工作流，发现了源自其OSS依赖中已知漏洞的多种安全效应。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果说明，对于易受攻击的依赖，应当从执行层面的后果来推理，而不能仅依据漏洞是否存在的问题来判断其安全意义。

title: Guess My Weight: Profiled Side-Channel Recovery of Floating-Point Neural-Network Weights
summary: Neural-network parameters deployed on embedded devices may be exposed through physical side-channel leakage during inference. Existing side-channel attacks on floating-point neural-network parameters have often targeted reduced numerical precision, while recovering the complete IEEE-754 representation remains considerably more challenging because of the large and structured 32-bit candidate space. We present a profiled template attack for bit-exact recovery of an IEEE-754 single-precision neural-network weight from power measurements. The attack targets the floating-point multiplication between a known input and a first-layer weight. During profiling, multivariate Gaussian templates are learned from randomized network configurations using Hamming-weight classes of the multiplication result, while the remaining network parameters act as nuisance variables. To efficiently search the structured 32-bit floating-point candidate space, we use a hierarchical coarse-to-fine-to-exact procedure that progressively increases both the numerical and leakage-model resolution. Experiments on a ChipWhisperer-Lite with an Arm Cortex-M4 demonstrate recovery of the exact float32 representation of the target weight. In the evaluated setting, the attack reaches a bit-exact success rate of 99% with 171 traces and 100% from 263 traces onward. These results demonstrate that profiling can enable practical full-precision extraction of floating-point neural-network parameters from physical leakage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种模板攻击方法，可从功耗测量中逐位精确恢复IEEE-754单精度神经网络权重。
AI.motivation: 嵌入式设备上部署的神经网络参数可能通过推理过程中的物理侧信道泄漏。已有针对浮点神经网络参数的侧信道攻击多针对降低的数值精度，而由于32位候选空间庞大且结构复杂，完整恢复IEEE-754表示仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 针对已知输入与第一层权重之间的浮点乘法，采用模板攻击。在profiling阶段，利用乘法结果的Hamming-weight类别从随机化网络配置中学习多元高斯模板，其余网络参数视为干扰变量。为高效搜索结构化的32位浮点候选空间，采用分层"粗到细到精确"（coarse-to-fine-to-exact）流程，逐步提高数值分辨率与泄漏模型分辨率。
AI.result: 在ChipWhisperer-Lite与Arm Cortex-M4上的实验成功恢复了目标权重的精确float32表示。在评估设置下，攻击以171条轨迹达到99%的逐位精确成功率，从263条轨迹起达到100%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，profiling可使从物理泄漏中实际提取全精度浮点神经网络参数成为可能。

title: Conformal Prediction with Paraphrase-Aware Scoring for LLM Uncertainty Quantification
summary: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) for large language models (LLMs) aims to provide reliable measures of predictive confidence, yet current methods are often unstable under meaning-preserving perturbations. Semantically equivalent paraphrases can induce substantial variability in predictive confidence, even for methods with formal guarantees, such as conformal prediction. To address this issue, we propose a paraphrase-aware UQ framework robust to semantic rewordings. Our approach trains a lightweight proxy model on LLM hidden states and aggregates its predictions across paraphrases to construct label-wise nonconformity scores. Under score exchangeability, conformal calibration retains marginal coverage. This guarantee can also hold under test-only rewording, provided that the paraphrase pipeline satisfies an additional distributional alignment condition. We evaluate three settings (normal, fully reworded, and semi-reworded) which apply rewording to neither dataset, both calibration and test datasets, or only the test dataset, respectively. Across seven multiple-choice QA benchmarks and multiple model families, our method produces compact prediction sets with empirical coverage generally near the nominal target, even in the semi-reworded setting. Ablation studies show that the learned proxy accounts for most of the reduction in set size, while paraphrase-augmented training and inference-time aggregation improve stability under rewording. Code is available at https://github.com/Raina-Xin/PA_Score.

AI.tldr: 提出一种对语义改写鲁棒的同义改写感知不确定性量化框架，通过轻量代理模型聚合改写预测构建非一致性分数，保持共形覆盖。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的不确定性量化方法在保持语义的改写扰动下往往不稳定，即使有形式化保证的方法（如共形预测），语义等价改写也会导致预测置信度大幅波动。
AI.method: 训练轻量代理模型于LLM隐状态上，跨多个同义改写聚合其预测以构建标签级非一致性分数；在分数可交换性下共形校准保持边际覆盖，仅在测试端改写时，若改写流程满足额外分布对齐条件，该保证仍然成立。实验设三种场景（正常、全改写、半改写）。
AI.result: 在七个多项选择QA基准和多个模型家族上，方法产生紧凑预测集，经验覆盖接近名义目标，半改写场景下亦然。消融表明学习到的代理模型贡献大部分集合大小缩减，改写增强训练与推理时聚合提升改写下的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 所提同义改写感知UQ框架能有效应对语义改写导致的置信度不稳定，在保持共形覆盖保证的同时生成更紧凑的预测集。

title: MAGEFormer: Learning Metric-Consistent Representations for Anisotropic CT Segmentation
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have shown strong performance in volumetric segmentation, but their effectiveness on clinical CT is limited by an isotropic Euclidean lattice assumption. This conflicts with anisotropic CT acquisition, leading to two key issues: (1) a metric mismatch between voxel indices and physical anatomy, and (2) accuracy degradation from isotropic resampling. To address this, we propose MAGEFormer, a geometry-calibrated framework that embeds physical metric constraints directly into representation learning. Our method introduces Metric-Adaptive Spatial Embedding (MASE) to calibrate positional frequencies using voxel spacing, Geometry-Constrained Attention (GCA) to suppress physically implausible feature correlations, and Geometric View Voting (GVV) to reduce discretization bias during inference. We evaluate MAGEFormer on two multi-organ abdominal CT benchmarks, BTCV and FLARE 22, under a unified protocol against strong CNN and Transformer-based baselines. MAGEFormer achieves the strongest boundary accuracy among the compared methods, with 10.58 mm HD95 on BTCV and 3.40 mm HD95 on FLARE 22, and shows consistent gains in Dice under the same protocol. These results show that geometry-aware internal calibration is more effective than relying on conventional isotropic preprocessing alone for anisotropic CT segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出MAGEFormer几何校准框架，将物理度量约束嵌入表示学习，提升各向异性CT体积分割性能。
AI.motivation: ViT在体积分割表现强，但临床CT的各向异性采集与ViT的各向同性欧氏格点假设冲突，导致体素索引与真实解剖间的度量不匹配，以及各向同性重采样带来的精度下降。
AI.method: MAGEFormer包含三个模块：度量自适应空间嵌入（MASE）用体素间距校准位置频率；几何约束注意力（GCA）抑制物理上不合理的特征相关性；几何视图投票（GVV）在推理阶段减小离散化偏差。
AI.result: 在BTCV和FLARE 22两个多器官腹部CT基准上，采用统一协议与强CNN及Transformer基线对比，MAGEFormer取得最佳边界精度：BTCV HD95为10.58 mm，FLARE 22 HD95为3.40 mm，且Dice指标一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 对于各向异性CT分割，几何感知的内部校准比仅依赖传统各向同性预处理更有效。

title: InvestigationWorlds: An Agentic Environment for Legal Investigation
summary: We introduce InvestigationWorlds, an agentic environment for legal investigation. We build on an underused artifact of U.S. civil litigation: the summary judgment motion. This motion relies upon a record composed of real evidence exhibits, and results in a court-adopted hypothesis that is treated as ground truth for the purposes of deciding the motion. Each environment is built from a real U.S. Federal Court case retrieved from Public Access to Court Electronic Records (PACER) and augmented by an attorney-validated generation pipeline that synthesizes role-tagged documents around the original record. The resulting corpus admits multiple coherent factual readings, only one of which matches the court-adopted hypothesis. Evaluating on 100 cases, we find agents often commit to incorrect hypotheses despite retrieving relevant evidence, struggling to distinguish the court-adopted hypothesis from alternative hypotheses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 InvestigationWorlds，一个面向法律调查的智能体环境，基于美国民事诉讼中简易判决动议构建，用于评估智能体能否从多重自洽的事实解读中识别出法院采纳的假设。
AI.motivation: 法律调查需要从真实证据记录中辨别唯一正确的事实假设，但现有环境缺乏此类需要区分多个自洽假设的复杂推理任务，因此需要一个基于真实司法记录的智能体评测环境。
AI.method: 以美国联邦法院简易判决动议为依托，利用 PACER 检索的真实案件，构建由真实证据展品组成的记录；并通过经律师验证的生成流程，围绕原始记录合成带有角色标签的文档，形成允许多重自洽事实解读、但仅有一个匹配法院采纳假设的语料库。
AI.result: 在 100 个案例上评估发现，智能体尽管能检索到相关证据，却常常锁定错误假设，难以将法院采纳的假设与替代假设区分开来。
AI.conclusion: InvestigationWorlds 揭示了当前智能体在法律调查中区分正确假设与替代假设的能力不足，为未来研究提供了具挑战性的评测基准。

title: Towards Credible Agent-Based Policy Simulations: Disentangling Opportunities and Preferences in a Financial Inclusion Case Study of Egypt
summary: Credibility is a central topic for agent-based models intended to support policy-making. Simulations must not only represent the target scenarios and their core dynamics but also demonstrate that their assumptions, parameters, and outputs are empirically grounded and sufficiently accurate for their intended use. This paper addresses this challenge by presenting a general modelling framework, aligned with the Capability Approach, for building credible policy simulations that rely on data and domain-expert knowledge. It then demonstrates how it can be contextualised and implemented to study the social challenge of financial inclusion in Egypt, building on an agent-based model that represents heterogeneous individuals and firms behaving according to their financial states, barriers, opportunities, and preferences. The model is fitted to real-world data in two stages, initialisation and calibration, which respectively build representative synthetic populations and estimate behavioural parameters. By fixing the feasibility parameters, which determine agents' opportunities, and calibrating preference parameters across different population groups, we are able to distinguish and analyse the role of institutional and social barriers in the system, as well as the role of agents' motivations and priorities. This calibration stage provides transparent and group-specific hypotheses about the drivers of observed financial-inclusion gaps, which can further be analysed as gaps between agents' opportunities and realised outcomes, a very relevant insight for policy-making. This paper is thus a step towards improving the credibility and usefulness of policy simulations, strengthening the relationship between the model, the real target system, and the stakeholders who will use it. The code is available at: \url{https://www.comses.net/codebase-release/df8383cb-f49b-4f09-8cce-73603b59adcc/}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于能力方法（Capability Approach）的通用建模框架，用于构建可信的政策仿真，并以埃及金融普惠问题为案例，通过两阶段数据拟合提升模型可信度。
AI.motivation: 面向政策制定的基于主体模型（ABM）需要具备可信度：不仅要能表示目标场景及核心动态，还必须证明其假设、参数和输出有实证依据，且精度足以支撑预期用途。如何提升这种可信度是本文的核心挑战。
AI.method: 提出与能力方法对齐的通用建模框架，用于构建依赖数据和领域专家知识的可信政策仿真；并将该框架情境化、实现于埃及金融普惠问题。模型基于异质性个体与企业主体，其行为依据财务状况、障碍、机会与偏好。模型分两阶段拟合真实数据：初始化（构建具代表性的合成人口）和校准（估计行为参数）。通过固定决定主体机会的可行性参数，并跨不同人群校准偏好参数，从而区分制度性/社会性障碍与主体动机和优先项的作用。
AI.result: 校准阶段给出了透明且分群体特定的假设，用以解释观察到的金融普惠差距；这些差距可进一步分析为主体机会与实际结果之间的落差，对政策制定具有重要启示意义。
AI.conclusion: 本文是提升政策仿真可信度与实用性的一步，强化了模型、真实目标系统与使用者（利益相关者）之间的关系。代码已公开。

title: Beyond Task Completion: Measuring Interaction Cost in Terminal User Interfaces
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used through terminal user interfaces (TUIs), yet task completion alone does not capture how difficult an interface is to understand and operate. Existing human assessments and LLM-generated ratings or reports do not provide repeatable measurements of interaction effort grounded in verified task execution.
  We propose Agent-as-a-User, an evaluation paradigm that places an LLM agent in the user role. Agent-KLM separates agent-side interpretation and operation costs and relates them structurally to human interaction. TUINaut operationalizes the paradigm by recording interaction trajectories and verifying outcomes with actor-independent oracles.
  Using TUINaut-Bench, we study 84 tasks across 15 real-world TUIs with six human participants and five observation-evaluator configurations, and evaluate 45 TUIs generated by three leading stacks. Similar aggregate success rates mask differences in which tasks humans and agents complete, whereas interpretation and operation costs follow correlated task rankings, especially for operation. This pattern persists across configurations. Generated TUIs can implement correct functionality while still requiring usability improvements. These results position Agent-as-a-User as a repeatable, execution-grounded paradigm for measuring task-based usability.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"Agent-as-a-User"评估范式，用LLM智能体充当用户角色，通过Agent-KLM分解解释成本与操作成本，并用TUINaut记录交互轨迹、以独立预言机验证任务结果，实现可重复、基于真实执行的任务型可用性度量。
AI.motivation: LLM日益通过终端用户界面（TUI）使用，但仅看任务完成情况无法反映界面理解与操作的难度；现有人工评估及LLM生成的评分/报告无法提供可重复、且以已验证任务执行为基础的交互成本测量。
AI.method: 提出Agent-as-a-User评估范式：Agent-KLM将智能体侧的解释成本与操作成本分离，并与人类交互建立结构性关联；TUINaut将该范式落地，记录交互轨迹并用与执行者无关的预言机（actor-independent oracles）验证结果。基于TUINaut-Bench，在15个真实TUI的84个任务上，结合6名人类参与者与5种观察-评估配置开展研究，并评估了由三种主流技术栈生成的45个TUI。
AI.result: 相似的整体成功率掩盖了人类与智能体所完成任务的差异；解释成本与操作成本呈现相关的任务排序，操作成本尤为明显，且该模式在不同配置下保持一致。生成的TUI可实现正确功能，但仍需可用性改进。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明Agent-as-a-User是一种可重复、以执行为基础的任务型可用性测量范式。

title: CHAMP: Cayley HAshing with Matrix Products
summary: Cayley hash functions hash binary strings by representing the bits of the message as elements of a semigroup and multiplying the corresponding elements. This gives Cayley hash functions useful homomorphic properties. Here, we propose CHAMP, a Cayley hash function based on products of 2 by 2 matrices over a finite field, and discuss its security, implementation, and performance.

AI.tldr: 提出基于有限域上2×2矩阵乘积的Cayley哈希函数CHAMP，并讨论其安全性、实现与性能。
AI.motivation: Cayley哈希函数将消息比特映射为半群元素相乘，具有同态性质。作者希望在此基础上构造新的哈希方案并评估其实际可行性。
AI.method: 将二进制串的比特表示为半群元素，通过在有限域上对2×2矩阵进行连乘来构造Cayley哈希函数CHAMP。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅说明对CHAMP的安全性、实现方式与性能进行了讨论。
AI.conclusion: CHAMP是一种基于有限域矩阵乘法的Cayley哈希函数，具备同态特性，其安全性和性能有待正文进一步评估。

title: Dynamic Quadtree Tokenization and Transformer for Adaptive Mesh PDE Forecasting
summary: The quadratic attention cost of Vision Transformers (ViTs) forces a trade-off between spatial resolution and rollout horizon, particularly for fine-scale PDEs where shocks, reaction fronts, and material interfaces occupy small, evolving regions of the domain. Conventional neural surrogates also lack mechanisms to adapt resolution dynamically. We propose WAMRViT, a ViT that tokenizes inputs as balanced quadtrees using a wavelet-inspired refinement criterion, jointly encodes position and refinement level with 3D rotary positional embeddings, and regrids in cell space during inference for stable long-horizon rollouts. A multi-scale variant retains each leaf at its native source resolution and lets the model learn across resolution levels. Unlike fixed-budget adaptive-tokenization methods, WAMRViT imposes no predetermined token count and supports fully adaptive topology throughout autoregressive rollout. To our knowledge, it is the first machine-learning surrogate to natively tokenize multi-level Adaptive Mesh Refinement (AMR) data. On uniform-grid benchmarks, uniform-patch WAMRViT improves finest-level region-of-interest VRMSE over a finest-patch uniform ViT while using substantially fewer tokens. The multi-scale variant achieves the lowest first-step full-field RMSE and VRMSE on both benchmarks and improves rollout-averaged full-field and refined-region accuracy at long horizons. With parallelized regridding, its end-to-end rollout cost lies between finest-patch and approximately token-matched coarser-patch ViTs. On a complex AMR combustion problem whose finest features cannot be represented natively by the evaluated uniform-grid baselines, WAMRViT operates directly on adaptive cells and substantially reduces finest-level error at matched transformer capacity. Code: https://github.com/tonyzyl/wamrvit

AI.tldr: WAMRViT 是一种基于小波启发四叉树自适应的视觉 Transformer 代理模型，首次原生支持多级自适应网格细化（AMR）数据，在精细尺度 PDE 长时程预测中优于均匀网格基线。
AI.motivation: Vision Transformer 的二次注意力开销迫使空间分辨率与 rollout 时程之间存在权衡，尤其对冲击、反应前锋、材料界面等仅占据小范围且不断演化区域的精细尺度 PDE 不利；此外传统神经代理模型缺乏动态调整分辨率的机制。
AI.method: 提出 WAMRViT：以平衡四叉树对小波启发式细化准则进行输入分块；用三维旋转位置嵌入联合编码位置与细化层级；推理时在单元空间重网格以稳定长时程 rollout。多尺度变体保留每个叶节点在原始分辨率下，让模型跨分辨率学习。与固定预算自适应分块不同，不预设 token 数量，支持自回归 rollout 中完全自适应拓扑。
AI.result: 在均匀网格基准上，均匀 patch 版 WAMRViT 以显著更少 token 提升最细层 ROI 的 VRMSE；多尺度变体在两个基准上取得最低首步全场 RMSE 与 VRMSE，并提升长时程 rollout 平均全场与细化区域精度。并行重网格后端到端 rollout 开销介于最细 patch 与近似 token 匹配的粗 patch ViT 之间。在复杂 AMR 燃烧问题上，WAMRViT 直接作用于自适应单元，在相同 Transformer 容量下显著降低最细层误差。
AI.conclusion: WAMRViT 是首个原生分块多级 AMR 数据的机器学习代理模型，通过小波启发四叉树分块、3D 旋转位置编码与单元空间重网格，实现无预设 token 数的自适应拓扑长时程 rollout，在多项基准与 AMR 燃烧问题上取得精度与效率优势。

title: Auditing Pairwise Equivalence Judgments: Self-Critique Effects and Diversity Measurement in Multi-Agent Hypothesis Generation
comment: Accepted at the Agentic AI for Biological Discovery Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Multi-agent systems built on large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to scientific discovery and hypothesis generation. Both the effect of refinement and the diversity of the delivered set are hard to interpret before experimental ground truth exists, and both are typically reported by deciding whether pairs of generated hypotheses describe the same underlying mechanism. We study two evaluation questions that rest on this pairwise equivalence judgment: (1) how much self-critique changes delivered hypotheses beyond run-to-run variability, and (2) how the equivalence rule used to group hypotheses affects measured diversity. Across four proprietary instances, we hold opening hypotheses fixed, rerun the downstream workflow with 0, 1, and 5 critique rounds, and score matched hypothesis pairs with an LLM-as-a-judge. Relative to matched same-depth reruns, moving from 0 to 1 round produces 34.5 percentage points (pp) of additional mechanism-level divergence, whereas 1 to 5 rounds adds 1.3 pp. We then compare three equivalence rules: term frequency--inverse document frequency (TF--IDF) similarity, dense embeddings, and the same LLM-as-a-judge. We construct controlled hypothesis pairs that either preserve the causal explanation through wording or biological-terminology changes, or replace one component of the causal chain while holding the rest fixed. All three rules are invariant to meaning-preserving edits, but when the initiating event is replaced, the LLM-as-a-judge identifies 83% of valid pairs as different mechanisms, versus 0% for TF--IDF and 8% for embeddings; varying only the rubric that defines same mechanism moves this figure from 38% to 96%. Together, these results show that pairwise equivalence judgments are a measurement choice: how mechanism equivalence is defined affects both the estimated effect of self-critique and the measured diversity of generated hypotheses.

AI.tldr: 该研究把"配对等价判断"作为测量选择来考察：它同时影响自批判效应的估计幅度与生成假设的多样性度量。基于四个专有模型实例，固定初始假设后以0/1/5轮批判重跑流程，并用LLM评判配对；结果显示0→1轮带来34.5个百分点（pp）的机制级分歧增量，而1→5轮仅增1.3 pp。随后比较TF-IDF、稠密嵌入与LLM评判三种等价规则：三者对保义改写均不变，但当替换触发事件时，LLM评判识别出83%为不同机制，TF-IDF为0%、嵌入为8%；仅改动"同一机制"的评分细则，该比例即从38%升至96%。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统被越来越多用于科学发现与假设生成，但"精炼的效果"与"交付集合的多样性"在实验真值出现前都难以解释，二者又都依赖对生成假设配对是否描述同一底层机制的判断。因此需要研究这一配对等价判断本身如何影响两项评估问题：自批判带来的变化是否超过运行间波动，以及用于分组假设的等价规则如何影响测得的多样性。
AI.method: 在四个专有模型实例上固定起始假设，用0、1、5轮批判重跑下游流程，并用LLM-as-a-judge对匹配的假设对打分（问题1）。随后比较三种等价规则——TF-IDF相似度、稠密嵌入、LLM-as-a-judge，构造受控假设对：或通过措辞/生物术语变化保留因果解释，或替换因果链中的一个组件而固定其余部分（问题2）。
AI.result: 相对同深度的匹配重跑，从0到1轮批判产生34.5个百分点（pp）的额外机制级分歧，而从1到5轮仅增加1.3 pp。三种等价规则对保义编辑均不变；但替换触发事件时，LLM-as-a-judge将83%的有效对判为不同机制，TF-IDF为0%，嵌入为8%；仅改变定义"同一机制"的评分细则，该比例从38%变动到96%。
AI.conclusion: 配对等价判断是一种测量选择：如何定义机制等价，会同时影响自批判效应的估计值和对生成假设多样性的度量。因此报告此类结果时需明确并交代所采用的等价规则。

title: When Debate Helps: Proposal Supply and Verification-Aware Readout in Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Multi-agent debate can improve reasoning, yet often fails to beat simple majority voting. We argue that successful debate requires two distinct mechanisms: proposal supply must surface a correct answer, and readout must identify that answer when voting misses it. We formalize the first requirement through recoverable headroom, which measures cases where a correct proposal is available but the majority answer is wrong. For the second, we develop Latent Verification Debate (LVD), an accounting model in which candidate proposals receive answer-specific verification evidence before final generation. Controlled fixed-proposal interventions estimate this latent effect in equivalent peer-support units and show that correct evidence changes answer probabilities and generated decisions while proposal supply remains fixed. To improve proposal supply, we construct societies from neural-thicket agents using labeled and label-free coverage objectives. Across two backbones and matched-budget reasoning benchmarks, coverage-selected societies increase complementary proposal supply and improve aggregate accuracy in repeated stochastic evaluations. Round-level controls further show that interaction provides gains beyond applying the same finalizer directly to the initial proposals. These results identify proposal coverage and truth-sensitive evidence use as complementary conditions for debate to outperform voting. Code is available at https://github.com/Wang-ML-Lab/when-debate-helps.

AI.tldr: 多智能体辩论常难以超越简单多数投票，本文提出辩论成功需两个机制：提案供应需提供正确答案、读出需在投票失败时识别该答案，并通过可恢复余量、潜验证辩论（LVD）及神经丛社会构建来验证。
AI.motivation: 多智能体辩论能提升推理能力，但常常无法击败简单多数投票。作者认为辩论要奏效需满足两个独立条件，而此前研究缺乏对这两个机制的明确形式化与分离验证。
AI.method: 1) 用"可恢复余量"形式化提案供应的第一条要求，衡量正确答案已被提出但多数答案错误的情形；2) 提出潜验证辩论（LVD），一种记账模型，在最终生成前让候选提案获得针对答案的验证证据，并通过受控固定提案干预以等效同伴支持单位估计其潜在效应；3) 为提升提案供应，基于神经丛智能体，使用有标签与无标签覆盖目标构建社会。
AI.result: 在两种骨干模型与匹配预算的推理基准上，覆盖选择的社会提升了互补提案供应并在重复随机评估中改善总体准确率；固定提案干预显示正确证据会改变答案概率与生成决策，而提案供应保持不变；轮级对照进一步表明交互带来的增益超过将同一finalizer直接应用于初始提案。
AI.conclusion: 提案覆盖与对真实性敏感的证据使用是辩论超越投票的两个互补条件。代码已开源。

title: SpecAgent: Empowering Program Verification with Agentic Synthesis of Formal Program Specifications
summary: Formal specifications are essential for deductive program verification, providing semantic abstractions for compositional verification of complex software. However, manually constructing specifications is labor-intensive, motivating automated synthesis. Despite recent advances in large language models (LLMs), existing approaches often rely on forward-only workflows and localized repair, limiting their effectiveness on real-world programs with complex dependencies among functions and loops. Verification failures may stem from previously generated specifications, causing cascading failures that local refinement cannot resolve. To address these challenges, we present SpecAgent, an agentic framework for synthesizing high-quality ACSL specifications for real-world C programs. SpecAgent integrates four components: dependency-aware planning to identify specification targets, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to provide relevant specification patterns and program context, agentic repair to diagnose defects and revisit dependent specifications, and agentic critique to assess and refine semantic strength beyond proof success. We evaluate SpecAgent on specification synthesis and program verification tasks. On 50 programs from 14 real-world repositories, SpecAgent with DeepSeek-V4 achieves 96.82% precision and 88.95% recall in synthesizing correct and strong specifications, outperforming all baselines. On 811 real-world verification targets, it successfully discharges 604, also surpassing existing baselines. These results demonstrate SpecAgent's effectiveness in synthesizing high-quality specifications and facilitating real-world program verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SpecAgent，一个面向真实 C 程序的智能体框架，用于自动化合成高质量的 ACSL 规约，通过依赖感知规划、检索增强生成、智能体修复和智能体评审四大组件，显著提升规约合成质量与程序验证成功率。
AI.motivation: 形式化规约是演绎程序验证的核心，但人工构建规约耗费巨大，因此需要自动合成。现有基于大语言模型的方法多采用单向流程和局部修复，难以应对函数与循环间存在复杂依赖的真实程序，且验证失败可能源于先前生成的规约，导致级联失败，局部改进无法解决。
AI.method: SpecAgent 集成四个组件：（1）依赖感知规划，用于识别规约目标；（2）检索增强生成（RAG），提供相关规约模式与程序上下文；（3）智能体修复，诊断缺陷并回溯修订存在依赖关系的规约；（4）智能体评审，在证明成功之外进一步评估和优化语义强度。
AI.result: 在来自 14 个真实代码仓库的 50 个程序上，SpecAgent 结合 DeepSeek-V4 在合成正确且强规约方面达到 96.82% 精确率和 88.95% 召回率，超过所有基线。在 811 个真实验证目标上，成功验证 604 个，同样优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: SpecAgent 能有效合成高质量规约并促进真实程序的验证，验证了智能体化、依赖感知与迭代式工作流在规约合成任务中的价值。

title: Attestable Audit: Property-Based Attestation for Proprietary Workloads without Artifact Disclosure
comment: Accepted at the International Workshop on Hardware and Architectural Support for Security and Privacy 2026 (HASP 2026), held in conjunction with MICRO 2026
summary: Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) prove the integrity of code and data to a remote peer through remote attestation: the TEE issues an attestation report by signing, with a hardware-bound key, its configuration information, including measurements (cryptographic digests) of the code loaded inside it. A verifier appraises the report by matching these measurements against reference values. When the measured artifact is proprietary, however, the verifier cannot derive the reference values itself: it can only confirm that something with a given measurement is running inside the TEE---not that the program behaves as expected---forcing full trust in the reference value provider. We propose an architecture that closes this gap without disclosing the artifact, composing two TEE workloads: attestable build (Hugenroth et al., 2025), which binds a source code digest to a build artifact measurement, and attestable audit (proposed in this paper), which binds the same source code digest to the verdicts of automated audits---fuzzing, static analysis, AI code auditing, formal methods---executed inside a TEE. Both are instances of Confidential Computing Proofs: TEE attestation viewed as a hardware-backed zero-knowledge proof. Chaining the two certificates lets the verifier conclude that the running artifact was built from source code satisfying the audited properties, without disclosing either the source code or the build artifact. A proof-of-concept implementation on Intel SGX with the Gramine Library OS, running the Bandit security analyzer on Python code, demonstrates the practicality of the approach.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在不泄露专有产物的前提下验证TEE内运行程序行为符合预期的架构，通过组合"可验证构建"与"可验证审计"两个TEE工作负载并链接证书实现。
AI.motivation: TEE通过远程认证向远端证明代码与数据完整性，但验证者只能匹配度量值与参考值。当被测产物为专有软件时，验证者无法自行推导参考值，只能确认"某个具有特定度量值的程序在TEE中运行"，而无法确认程序行为符合预期，被迫完全信任参考值提供方。本文旨在弥合这一信任缺口，且不泄露产物本身。
AI.method: 提出组合两个TEE工作负载的架构：1）可验证构建（attestable build，Hugenroth et al., 2025），将源代码摘要绑定到构建产物度量值；2）可验证审计（attestable audit，本文提出），将同一源代码摘要绑定到在TEE内执行的自动化审计结论（模糊测试、静态分析、AI代码审计、形式化方法）。两者均被视为"机密计算证明"（Confidential Computing Proofs）——将TEE认证看作硬件支持的零知识证明。链接两份证书即可让验证者得出运行产物由满足被审计属性的源代码构建而成。
AI.result: 在Intel SGX与Gramine Library OS上实现概念验证，对Python代码运行Bandit安全分析器，证明了该方法的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 通过链接可验证构建与可验证审计的证书，验证者可在不披露源代码和构建产物的情况下，确信运行中的产物源自满足被审计属性的源代码，从而消除对参考值提供方的盲目信任，且概念验证表明方案具有实际可行性。

title: AI-Enabled Quality Assurance for Multiple-Choice Assessment Items
comment: 8 pages, 2 tables, Full paper accepted to the AIME Conference 2026
summary: Generating multiple-choice questions is increasingly scalable, but establishing their assessment quality remains difficult. We present a focused narrative review of automated item-writing flaw detection, revision, psychometric screening, and NLP benchmark auditing. Database searches, citation retrieval, and nominated sources yield fourteen research reports reviewed in full text. We distinguish surface checks from content-sensitive judgments and map a 19-criterion rubric to detection methods and reported evidence. High label-level accuracy often coexists with weak positive case detection, while rubric definitions and reference standards vary. Revision evidence is mixed, and the associations reported in prior work do not establish the effects of repair. We propose evaluating quality assurance as a sequence of independently validated decisions, with criterion-specific reporting, calibrated human review, and outcome-based assessment of revisions.

AI.tldr: 本文对自动选择题题目质量保障（缺陷检测、修订、心理测量筛查、NLP基准审计）进行聚焦性叙述性综述，检索并全文评阅14篇研究报告，区分表层检查与内容敏感判断，并将19项标准评分表映射到检测方法与证据，提出以“独立验证的决策序列”评估质量保障。
AI.motivation: 自动生成选择题的规模不断扩大，但其评估质量难以确立，且现有缺陷检测与修订研究的证据可靠性、标准一致性存在疑问，因此需要系统梳理这一领域的证据现状与评价框架。
AI.method: 采用聚焦性叙述性综述：通过数据库检索、引文追溯与提名来源获得14篇研究全文评阅；区分表层检查与内容敏感判断；构建19项标准的评分表并映射到相应检测方法及已报告证据。
AI.result: 高标签级准确率常与阳性个案检测能力薄弱并存；评分表定义与参照标准各异；修订证据混杂，既往研究报告的关联性并不能确立“修复”产生的效果。
AI.conclusion: 应将质量保障评价为一连串可独立验证的决策，采用针对具体标准的报告方式、经过校准的人工复核，以及基于结果的修订效果评估。

title: ASD-FEAT: A Multi-Modal Infant Video-Derived Dataset for Early ASD Risk Prediction
summary: Accurate early screening for Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a precursor to timely intervention, which is critical for improving cognitive and behavioral outcomes. We present ASD-FEAT (ASD - Feature Extraction And Tracking), a multimodal dataset derived from video recordings of infant-adult interaction sessions. The key contribution of ASD-FEAT is the combination of longitudinal coverage from infancy through 36 months, repeated interaction sessions, clinically validated developmental outcomes, expert frame-level behavioral annotations, and privacy-conscious multimodal feature representations. To the best of our knowledge, existing ASD behavioral datasets do not jointly provide these characteristics at comparable scale. To demonstrate the utility of ASD-FEAT, we use it to evaluate a computer-vision-based end-to-end pipeline relying on machine learning techniques to automatically identify ASD risk. ASD-FEAT integrates both expert-defined and deep-learned features, including face and eye landmarks, facial action units, gaze direction, head position, mel-spectrogram audio representations, and optical flow, to identify behavioral markers of social interaction. Our automated pipeline achieves an ASD classification accuracy of 76.2% and an Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic (AUROC) of 0.82, compared to classifiers trained on manually labeled behaviors, which yielded 81.3% accuracy and an AUROC of 0.88. We further introduce a within-visit partner contrast: a per-visit signal contrasting examiner-directed and parent-directed social behavior which, when added to the classifier, lifts the fully automated Look Face + Smile and Look Face + Vocal configurations to Matthews correlations of 0.49 and 0.45 respectively, exceeding the human-coded single-partner baseline of 0.42.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASD-FEAT多模态数据集，涵盖0-36个月婴幼儿纵向互动视频、专家标注与隐私友好的多模态特征，并用其构建自动化ASD风险识别流程，分类准确率达76.2%、AUROC为0.82，引入"同一访视内对象对比"信号后性能超过人工编码基线。
AI.motivation: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）的早期准确筛查是及时干预的前提，对改善认知与行为结果至关重要。然而现有ASD行为数据集难以在可比规模上同时具备纵向覆盖、重复会话、临床验证结果、专家帧级标注及隐私友好的多模态特征等特性，限制了自动化筛查研究的发展。
AI.method: 本文构建了ASD-FEAT多模态数据集，来源于婴幼儿-成人互动会话的视频记录，集成了专家定义特征与深度学习特征，包括面部与眼部关键点、面部动作单元、注视方向、头部位置、梅尔频谱音频表示及光流等，用于识别社交互动中的行为标记。基于该数据集，作者评估了一个计算机视觉驱动的端到端机器学习流程，并提出"同一访视内对象对比"（within-visit partner contrast）信号，用以对比婴幼儿面向检查者与面向家长时的社交行为差异。
AI.result: 自动化流程实现ASD分类准确率76.2%、AUROC为0.82；而基于人工标注行为训练的基线分类器准确率为81.3%、AUROC为0.88。加入同一访视内对象对比信号后，全自动Look Face + Smile与Look Face + Vocal配置的Matthews相关系数分别提升至0.49和0.45，超过人工编码单对象基线（0.42）。
AI.conclusion: ASD-FEAT在纵向覆盖、重复会话、临床验证结果、专家帧级标注与隐私友好多模态特征方面具备综合优势，可作为评估自动化ASD风险识别方法的有力平台；引入对象对比信号能有效提升全自动流程性能并超越人工编码基线，展示了多模态自动化筛查的潜力。

title: Agentic Cognitive Depth: Operational Criteria for Evaluating LLM Agents
comment: The 5th International Conference on Human and Artificial Rationalities
summary: Agentic large language model (LLM) systems are commonly implemented as an LLM in a loop with Planning, Memory, Tools, and Control Flow. This application-focused view connects agentic LLM research with deployable systems and leaves open how such systems should be evaluated beyond end-to-end task success. Building on this view, we define agentic cognitive depth as a trajectory-level profile across five operational criteria. The profile contains context sensitivity ($C$), temporal continuity ($T$), multimodal coordination ($M$), adaptive interaction ($A$), and metacognitive monitoring ($Mc$). The first four criteria measure how well Control Flow, Memory, Tools, and Planning are used across a trajectory. The fifth measures whether the system monitors and regulates the full run. For each criterion, we give operational proxies and a perturbation procedure, then connect the profile to the agent's world model. We provide the structure needed to extend benchmarks such as GAIA, SWE-bench, WebArena, and TRIP-Bench with per-criterion diagnostics. Symbolic verifiers, structured memory, planner coupling, and tool constraints provide practical ways to build and test these capacities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"智能体认知深度"概念，从轨迹层面用五个操作化标准刻画LLM智能体系统，并为每个标准提供代理指标与扰动流程，以扩展现有基准测试的诊断能力。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体LLM系统常以"LLM循环+规划、记忆、工具、控制流"实现，评价多局限于端到端任务成功率，缺乏对系统运行过程与认知能力的深入评估。
AI.method: 定义"智能体认知深度"为轨迹级画像，包含五标准：上下文敏感性C、时间连续性T、多模态协调M、自适应交互A、元认知监控Mc。前四项衡量控制流、记忆、工具、规划的使用情况，第五项衡量系统对完整运行的监控与调节。为每项标准给出操作化代理与扰动流程，并将画像与智能体世界模型关联。
AI.result: 提供了可扩展GAIA、SWE-bench、WebArena、TRIP-Bench等基准的结构，使它们具备按标准划分的诊断能力；并指出符号验证器、结构化记忆、规划器耦合与工具约束是实现和检验这些能力的实用途径。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将智能体评估从单一任务成功扩展到多维度认知深度诊断，为智能体系统的构建、测试与基准扩展提供了结构化方向。

title: Formalizing the Moral Evaluation of Speech Acts: Truthfulness, Lies and Ethical Dilemmas
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 27th International Conference on Principles and Practice of Multi-Agent Systems (PRIMA 2026). Kumamoto, Japan
summary: In life-or-death situations, a benevolent lie may appear more moral than telling the truth. Yet such lies can backfire, producing unintended and sometimes fatal consequences. This tension, famously disputed by Kant and Constant in 1797, applies not only to lying but to assertive speech acts in general, raising the question of which utterance should be chosen when moral stakes are high. We present a logical framework for the ethical evaluation of speech-act utterances based on agents' beliefs. Implemented in Answer Set Programming (ASP), the framework assesses utterances under deontologism, consequentialism, and principialism, and is illustrated on Sartre's The Wall (1939), a reworking of that controversy in which lying leads alternately to rescue and to death. Our setting is general by design: as two variants show, accommodating a new moral situation amounts to adjusting parameters, not rules.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于主体信念的言语行为伦理评估逻辑框架，用答案集编程（ASP）实现，能依据义务论、后果论和原则主义三种伦理立场评估话语选择，并以萨特《墙》为例进行说明。
AI.motivation: 在生死攸关情境中，善意的谎言可能看似比说真话更道德，但此类谎言可能适得其反，造成意外甚至致命的后果。这一张力源自康德与贡斯当1797年的著名争论，不仅涉及说谎，也涉及一般性的断言性言语行为，由此引出在道德代价高昂时应选择何种话语的问题。
AI.method: 构建一个基于主体信念的言语行为伦理评估逻辑框架，并采用答案集编程（ASP）实现。框架在义务论、后果论和原则主义三种伦理理论下评估话语，同时通过在《墙》案例上的应用加以说明。
AI.result: 框架成功应用于萨特《墙》（1939）——该作品是对上述争论的再创作，其中说谎交替导致救援或死亡。此外，两个变体表明，容纳新的道德情境只需调整参数，而无需修改规则。
AI.conclusion: 该框架具有通用性设计，能够灵活适应不同道德情境，为高风险情境下的言语行为伦理评估提供了可计算的形式化工具。

title: StateWise: Diagnosing and Repairing Persistent Operational State Before Agent Actions
summary: LLM agents combine reasoning, tool use, and persistent memory to support work across tasks by reusing stored operational records as premises for later actions. However, environmental or requirement changes can invalidate these records, while existing action review, provenance tracking, and clarification mechanisms may leave the underlying persistent state uncorrected. Our audit of coding-agent trajectories identifies candidate failure chains in which invalid records are reused, leading to task failures and unsafe modifications. We propose StateWise, a framework for diagnosing and repairing persistent operational state before action execution. StateWise uses record-level counterfactual replanning to identify decision-critical records, then establishes their current validity through reliability checks, read-only verification of machine-observable facts, and targeted clarification of developer-owned intent. Typed evidence grounding binds evidence to specific records and scopes, enabling persistent corrections with repair lineage. The agent then replans from the repaired state, followed by an independent state-action check before execution. We evaluate StateWise on 150 executable coding-agent cases across diverse runtime environments, workspace configurations, and repository settings, complemented by cross-model evaluations. Under corrupted persistent state, StateWise achieves 93.3% overall correctness, compared with 38.7% for the baseline agent, with no unsafe actions. Component ablations, multi-task experiments, and transfer evaluations further demonstrate effective recovery, persistent corrections, and transferability across repositories and tool interfaces.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出StateWise框架，用于在执行前诊断并修复LLM智能体的持久化操作状态，通过反事实重规划、可靠性验证与证据溯源实现状态修正，在150个编码智能体案例中达到93.3%正确率。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体依赖存储的操作记录作为后续行动前提，但环境或需求变化会使这些记录失效。现有的行动审查、溯源追踪与澄清机制无法修正底层持久状态，导致无效记录被复用，引发任务失败和不安全修改。
AI.method: StateWise框架包含：记录级反事实重规划识别决策关键记录；通过可靠性检查、机器可观测事实的只读验证及开发者意图的针对性澄清来确立记录有效性；类型化证据绑定将证据关联到具体记录与范围，实现带修复谱系的持久修正；修复后从修正状态重规划，并在执行前进行独立的状态-行动检查。
AI.result: 在150个可执行编码智能体案例（涵盖多样运行时环境、工作区配置与仓库设置）及跨模型评估中，面对被污染的持久状态，StateWise达到93.3%总体正确率，基线智能体仅为38.7%，且无任何不安全行动。组件消融、多任务实验与迁移评估进一步验证了有效恢复、持久修正及跨仓库和工具接口的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: StateWise通过在行动执行前诊断和修复持久操作状态，显著提升LLM智能体在状态被污染情况下的任务正确性与安全性，并具备良好的持久修正与迁移能力。

title: The Same Zero: Why Identical ASR Can Imply Different Guarantees in LLM-Agent Security
comment: v1: applies Verification Autonomy Levels (VAL) to 22 agent-security defenses; first controlled deployment-value comparison (VAL-guided vs intuition stack) across three testbeds; ~17k LLM calls; an honest out-of-ODD boundary is reported. Writing was assisted by an AI language model; all experiments and research decisions are the author's own
summary: LLM-agent security has produced a dense landscape of defenses - prompt hardening, content filters, permission gates, sandboxes - yet no framework tells a deployer what a defense actually guarantees, or where that guarantee comes from. We apply Verification Autonomy Levels (VAL) - L0: LLM self-declaration; L1: deterministic rules; L2: objective ground truth; L3/L4: decidable completeness; L5: impossible - to 22 agent-security defenses; the taxonomy is falsifiable (10/10 prediction hits on frozen cards, flagged). We run the first controlled deployment-value comparison: at equal budget, a VAL-guided stack (confirmation gate + schema sandbox) versus a mainstream intuition stack (prompt hardening + keyword filter), 50 scenarios, 12 attack variants, adaptive/white-box/PAIR escalation (~7,000 testbed calls; ~10,000 harness calls on AgentDojo/JADE). The VAL stack holds 0.000 attack success at 1.000 benign success (0.5% ASR at 79.7% utility on AgentDojo banking vs 4.3% undefended); the intuition stack reaches 0.000 ASR but kills all benign actions - security by model-behavior luck, not structure. Across testbeds of rising attack-surface hardness the intuition stack's zero drifts (0->1.9%->6.2%, n=16 on JADE) while the VAL stack's holds within its ODD (0->0->0), its only breach a disclosed out-of-ODD password gap (0.5%). The same zero, two different guarantees: zero is an outcome, not a guarantee.

AI.tldr: 本文将验证自主等级（VAL）分类法应用于22种智能体安全防御措施，并首次开展受控的部署价值对比实验，证明"零攻击成功率"可能是侥幸而非法定保证。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体安全领域堆叠了大量防御手段（提示加固、内容过滤、权限门、沙箱等），但没有任何框架能告诉部署者某项防御究竟能保证什么、保证从何而来——防御效果缺乏可验证的保证来源。
AI.method: 1）将VAL等级（L0自我声明、L1确定性规则、L2客观真值、L3/L4可判定完备性、L5不可能）映射到22种智能体安全防御；分类法可被证伪（冻结卡片10/10预测命中）。2）在同等预算下进行首个受控部署价值对比：VAL引导栈（确认门+模式沙箱）对比主流直觉栈（提示加固+关键词过滤），50个场景、12种攻击变体，并升级自适应/白盒/PAIR攻击（约7000次测试台调用、约10000次AgentDojo/JADE测试）。
AI.result: VAL栈在1.000良性成功率下保持0.000攻击成功率（AgentDojo银行场景79.7%效用下ASR仅0.5%，无防御时为4.3%）；直觉栈虽达0.000 ASR但扼杀全部良性动作。随着攻击面难度上升，直觉栈的零值发生漂移（0→1.9%→6.2%），而VAL栈在其ODD内保持稳定（0→0→0），唯一突破是已披露的ODD外密码缺口（0.5%）。
AI.conclusion: 同样的"零"代表两种不同的保证：零是一个结果，而不是一种保证；VAL框架能揭示防御保证的真实来源与边界（ODD），为部署者提供可判定的安全承诺。

title: Evaluating Modeling Approaches for Experience-Level Classification in Job Description
summary: This paper investigates the task of predicting job experience levels in recruitment texts, aiming to automatically identify the qualifications required for positions. Unlike traditional text classification, recruitment texts typically possess explicit internal structures, with different paragraphs playing disproportionate roles in conveying experience clues. To address this, we propose a structure-aware Section-Aware BERT approach that segments and encodes key paragraphs (titles, responsibilities, requirements) for integrated modeling, building upon rule-based systems and classical baselines TF-IDF. Simultaneously, we evaluate large language models under both few-shot and fine-tuning settings on the same dataset to compare the capability boundaries of different modeling paradigms. Experimental results demonstrate that explicitly leveraging text structure significantly improves experience level prediction performance, particularly in scenarios with ambiguous job titles. Further error analysis reveals systemic challenges in this task, including confusion between Entry and Senior levels and the blurred boundaries of Mid-level positions. This research provides an effective modeling approach and analytical framework for understanding structured recruitment texts.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究招聘文本中的岗位经验等级预测任务，提出结构感知的Section-Aware BERT方法，通过分段落编码标题、职责、要求等关键部分进行建模，并与TF-IDF基线及大语言模型（few-shot与微调）对比，证明显式利用文本结构能显著提升预测性能。
AI.motivation: 招聘文本具有显式的内部结构，不同段落在传达经验线索时作用不均衡，而传统文本分类方法未充分利用这一结构性特征。作者希望自动识别岗位所需资历，并探索不同建模范式（规则系统、经典基线、大语言模型）的能力边界。
AI.method: 提出Section-Aware BERT结构感知方法，将招聘文本切分为标题、职责、要求等关键段落分别编码并整合建模；同时以规则系统和TF-IDF作为经典基线，并在同一数据集上评估大语言模型在few-shot与微调两种设置下的表现。
AI.result: 实验表明，显式利用文本结构能显著提升经验等级预测性能，尤其在岗位标题模糊的场景下效果突出。错误分析进一步揭示了该任务的系统性挑战，包括Entry与Senior等级之间的混淆以及Mid-level职位边界的模糊性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为结构化招聘文本提供了一种有效的建模方法和分析框架，验证了结构感知建模的价值，并指出岗位经验等级预测中仍需解决的系统性难点。

title: A Theory of Shape Reconstruction from Heat Conduction and Shading
summary: Shape from shading using a single image of a Lam- bertian surface is inherently ambiguous. When the light source direction is known, the surface normal estimation has a cone- ambiguity, which worsens when the source is unknown. Recently, shape from heat conduction has emerged as an approach that leverages heat transport equations to estimate the Shape Lapla- cian operator, an intrinsic measure of shape. However, deriving surface normals from the Laplacian operator encounters a local binary convex/concave ambiguity. Our contribution introduces a novel theory to resolve these local shape ambiguities (excluding a few degeneracies) without relying on priors like smoothness, by combining the cues from shading and heat conduction. Our method ensures the mathematical constraints of both shading and the Laplacian are satisfied simultaneously, even with an unknown light source. We validate our theory through simulations of complex shapes and analyze its performance in the presence of noise, as well as on a noisy single thermal video of real-world objects with complex shapes and material properties, including varying albedo.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种结合明暗恢复形状与热传导线索的新理论，在不依赖光滑性等先验、且光源未知的情况下，解决表面法向估计中的局部歧义（锥形歧义与凹凸二值歧义）。
AI.motivation: 单一图像的Lambertian表面明暗恢复形状存在固有歧义：光源已知时法向估计有锥形歧义，光源未知时更严重；而基于热传导的Shape from heat conduction虽可估计Shape Laplacian，但从Laplacian推导法向会遇到局部凹凸二值歧义。作者希望无需先验地同时消除这两类歧义。
AI.method: 将明暗线索与热传导线索相结合，构建能同时满足明暗约束与Laplacian数学约束的求解框架，从而在光源未知条件下解决局部形状歧义（排除少数退化情形）。
AI.result: 通过复杂形状的仿真验证了理论的正确性，并分析了噪声条件下的性能；同时在包含复杂形状、不同材质属性（含变化反照率）的真实物体单张含噪热视频上进行了测试。
AI.conclusion: 融合明暗与热传导线索可在无先验、光源未知时同时满足两类数学约束并解决局部形状歧义，仿真与真实热视频实验均表明该方法有效，并对噪声与变化反照率具有一定鲁棒性。

title: SHarP: Saliency-based Pruning of Agent Harnesses
summary: Agent harnesses are systems that coordinate model calls, tool use, and task execution to help large language models complete complex tasks. To meet task requirements and address failures, these systems are often iteratively refined by amending and patching their instructions, tools, and workflows, continuously increasing harness complexity. It is therefore unclear whether some resulting harness modules are redundant, introducing substantial token overhead with little, if any, performance gain. Inspired by neural network pruning, in this paper, we study harness pruning as a means of striking a better balance between task performance and token cost. We propose SHarP (Saliency-based Harness Pruning), a simple yet effective pruning strategy based on the saliency of each harness module with respect to performance and efficiency. Specifically, we first identify tools, instructions, and supporting mechanisms as components that can be individually disabled. We then estimate the saliency of each module by ablating it and assessing its task performance and token cost relative to the full set of single-module ablations. Modules with the smallest contribution to performance or largest computational overhead are subsequently pruned. Our evaluation across various harnesses on held-out validation sets reveals a surprising finding: most harnesses that we studied are highly redundant and can maintain comparable performance and efficiency even after a substantial portion of their modules are pruned. Our pruning approach and empirical findings provide new perspectives on agent harness design and optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SHarP（基于显著性的 harness 剪枝），借鉴神经网络剪枝思想，将 agent harness 中的工具、指令和支撑机制视为可单独禁用的模块，通过消融评估各模块对任务性能与 token 成本的显著性，从而剪除贡献小或开销大的模块，在性能与成本间取得更优平衡。
AI.motivation: Agent harness 为满足任务需求并修复失败，常通过不断修补指令、工具和工作流来迭代改进，导致复杂度持续上升。这引出一个疑问：部分 harness 模块是否已冗余，只带来大量 token 开销却几乎没有性能收益。作者希望借鉴神经网络剪枝的思路，重新审视 harness 中性能与 token 成本的权衡问题。
AI.method: 提出 SHarP 剪枝策略。首先将工具、指令和支撑机制识别为可单独禁用的组件；然后通过逐个消融模块，并对照全部单模块消融的结果，估计每个模块相对于性能与效率的显著度；最后剪除对性能贡献最小或计算开销最大的模块。
AI.result: 在多种 harness 上、于留出验证集进行评估，得到一个意外的发现：所研究的大多数 harness 具有高度冗余性，即使剪除相当大比例的模块，仍能保持与原来相当的性能和效率。
AI.conclusion: 该剪枝方法与实证发现为 agent harness 的设计与优化提供了新的视角，说明精简 harness 模块结构是提升性能与成本平衡的可行方向。

title: Agent Behavior as Code: Efficient and Robust LLM Agents with Programmatic Specifications
summary: AI agents based on foundation models (FMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities to perform complex open-ended tasks. However, they face some common challenges in practice: (a) agent behavior can deviate drastically even for semantically similar tasks, leading to catastrophically propagated errors; (b) high cost and latency due to FM calls, repeated in full whenever a task recurs with different inputs; (c) FMs' limited context and instruction following capability confine how well agents manage the ever-growing execution context and follow complex plans. We introduce $\textbf{A}$gent $\textbf{B}$ehavior as $\textbf{C}$ode $\textbf{Agent}$ (ABCAgent), which uses a symbolic program (e.g., Python code with potential neural functions) to fully specify the agent's behavior at runtime, with a powerful FM agent editing that program for flexibility. Behavior is thus specified without premature variable binding, and its execution is deterministic. We evaluate ABCAgent on six agent benchmarks, two of which we construct to test how well a derived program generalizes to variants of the task it was written for. ABCAgent matches a model-matched neural agent on GAIA and augmented GAIA, and surpasses it where robustness and long control flows matter: 98.3% against 97.3% on GSM-Symbolic ($p = 0.001$), 71.9% against 47.4% $\mathrm{Pass}^4$ on the telecom domain of $τ^2$-bench ($p = 0.0001$), and more records written correctly at every loop length on our control-flow-augmented WorkArena benchmark. For more parametric task families, ABCAgent is also significantly superior in efficiency. Without authoring a new program, ABCAgent solves 92.6% of GSM-Symbolic instances and 20.1% of augmented GAIA variants, which yields $5.2\times$ lower latency and $7.0\times$ lower cost on GSM-Symbolic, 19% lower cost on augmented GAIA, and $9.5\times$ lower agent latency on $τ^2$-telecom.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ABCAgent，用符号程序（如Python代码）完整刻画智能体行为，由强大的基础模型智能体编辑程序以保持灵活性，从而实现确定性和高效执行。
AI.motivation: 现有基于基础模型的AI智能体在实践中有三大挑战：(a) 语义相似任务间行为差异大，导致错误灾难性传播；(b) 基础模型调用成本高、延迟大，任务重复时需反复执行；(c) 基础模型的上下文和指令遵循能力有限，难以管理不断增长的执行上下文和复杂计划。
AI.method: 提出ABCAgent，将智能体行为在运行时用符号程序（如含潜在神经函数的Python代码）完整指定，避免过早变量绑定，执行具有确定性；同时由强大的基础模型智能体编辑该程序以实现灵活性。
AI.result: 在六个智能体基准上评估（其中两个为自建，用于测试程序对任务变体的泛化）。在GAIA及增强GAIA上匹配同模型神经智能体，在鲁棒性和长控制流上更优：GSM-Symbolic达98.3%对97.3%（p=0.001），τ²-bench电信域Pass⁴达71.9%对47.4%（p=0.0001），控制流增强WorkArena各循环长度记录写入更正确。效率上，无需编写新程序即可解决92.6%的GSM-Symbolic实例和20.1%的增强GAIA变体，GSM-Symbolic延迟降5.2×、成本降7.0×，增强GAIA成本降19%，τ²-电信智能体延迟降9.5×。
AI.conclusion: ABCAgent通过符号程序指定智能体行为，在不牺牲灵活性的前提下提升了鲁棒性、泛化能力和执行效率。

title: Mind the Gaps: From Failure Attribution to Closed-Form Repair of Code Language Models
summary: Code language models must be maintained like the software around them: when a library evolves, a model keeps writing the interface that it saw during training. Repairing the model itself lets one correction reach all downstream uses. Existing repair methods attribute a failure to neurons, select the highest-ranked ones, and apply a generic update. This pipeline assumes that the attributed neurons are the ones to patch and that a generic update fits every failure, and neither assumption has been examined. We examine both on executable API evolution tasks in Python and Rust with three code models and identify two gaps. The targeting gap separates the neurons that failure attribution targets from the neurons that can carry a patch: their top sets have a Jaccard overlap of only 0.15 to 0.20. The tailoring gap separates a generic update from a patch built for the failure: the patches that different carrier neurons need are nearly orthogonal. To address both gaps, we propose ASTRA. It targets neurons by contrastive semantics, an attribution that scores a neuron by its contribution to the logit contrast between the target token and the produced token. It then tailors the patch by solving one small linear system in closed form, which corrects all failing tokens of a sample jointly and needs neither an optimizer nor a backward pass. Contrastive semantics selects significantly better carrier neurons than gradient-based attributions in 3 of 6 settings and comparable ones in the others. On average, ASTRA reaches 66.7 percent Pass@1, against 48.4 percent for the best of AlphaEdit, STAR and low-rank adaptation, and repairs a sample in 2.7 seconds. It is the best method in all 6 settings and for every type of API change, and this advantage persists under an unseen phrasing of the test prompt. Its side effects on unrelated code are small on the large models and larger on the small one.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ASTRA，通过对比语义定位神经元并用闭式线性系统定制补丁，修复代码模型在 API 演化任务中的失败。平均 Pass@1 达 66.7%，优于 AlphaEdit、STAR 和 LoRA。
AI.motivation: 代码语言模型在库演化后会继续沿用训练时看到的旧接口，因此需要像维护软件一样维护模型。修复模型本身能让一次修正惠及所有下游用途。然而现有修复方法默认两个未经检验的假设：一是归因定位到的神经元就是应当修补的神经元，二是通用更新适用于所有失败。
