AI.method: 作者在 Python 和 Rust 的可执行 API 演化任务上，用三个代码模型检验上述假设，发现两个缺口：定位缺口（归因目标神经元与可承载补丁神经元的 top 集 Jaccard 重叠仅 0.15–0.20）和定制缺口（不同承载神经元所需补丁近乎正交）。为此提出 ASTRA：用对比语义归因，按神经元对目标 token 与生成 token 间 logit 对比的贡献打分来定位神经元；再通过求解一个小型线性系统以闭式解定制补丁，联合修正样本的所有失败 token，无需优化器或反向传播。
AI.result: 对比语义在 6 个设置中有 3 个显著优于基于梯度的归因，其余相当。ASTRA 平均 Pass@1 达 66.7%，而 AlphaEdit、STAR 与低秩适配中最佳者为 48.4%，修复一个样本耗时 2.7 秒。它在全部 6 个设置及每种 API 变更类型上均最优，且在测试提示的未见表述下优势依然保持。对无关代码的副作用在大模型上较小，在小模型上较大。
AI.conclusion: ASTRA 通过对比语义定位和闭式定制补丁，同时弥补定位缺口与定制缺口，在 API 演化修复中全面超越现有方法，并具备较强的提示表述鲁棒性；但其副作用随模型规模缩小而增大。

title: Quantum Machine Learning Protection of Military Quantum Key Distribution Against Cryptographically Camouflaged Attacks
summary: Quantum key distribution proves its protocol secure and says nothing about the hardware beneath it, so military and government operators fielding it for command-and-control keys monitor the channel for implementation attacks, and that monitoring has a blind spot. An adversary with a kleptographic foothold in the generator of a public per-block value \(x=g^v \pmod p\) can hide attacked blocks in honest noise, gating them on a predicate of its discrete logarithm, making detection a discrete logarithm problem that defeats every efficient classical monitor yet yields to a quantum kernel recovering \(v\) through Shor's algorithm. I formalise these cryptographically camouflaged attacks, reduce their hardness to an established learning separation, prove a single-frequency fidelity kernel cannot represent an interval predicate, and test them on Ghillie, a decoy-state BB84 simulator with a positive key rate to 142 km. From 10- to 14-bit groups over two seeds, a classical monitor reads 0.458 to 0.516 on camouflaged attacks while the quantum kernel reads 1.000, and both catch overt attacks above 0.99. Finite-precision recovery under depolarising noise and a hardened predicate lower the quantum result to 0.916 through 0.983 with the classical monitor at chance, and a feasibility probe on IBM Heron processors tracks the exact kernel within 0.034. A defender can therefore discard precisely the compromised key material, although the advantage is asymptotic, awaits fault tolerance, and holds only when the feature map matches the adversary's predicate, since a low-frequency map reads 0.545 on a residue pattern and 0.982 once aligned.

AI.tldr: 该论文形式化了QKD系统中一种隐蔽于设备层的密码学伪装攻击，将其检测难度归约为已知的学习分离问题，并用Ghillie仿真验证量子核方法能高效识别而经典监测器失效。
AI.motivation: QKD协议本身被证明安全，但其硬件实现不受协议保证。军方与政府将其用于指挥控制密钥时，会监测信道以发现实现攻击，但存在盲区：掌握生成器密码学据点的对手可将被攻击分组隐藏于诚实噪声中，使检测变成一个离散对数难题，从而绕过所有高效经典监测器。
AI.method: 形式化"密码学伪装攻击"：对手在每块公开值x=g^v mod p的生成器中植入后门，以v的离散对数为谓词对攻击块进行门控。将攻击检测的硬度归约到既有的学习分离结果，证明单频保真度核无法表示区间谓词。在Ghillie（诱骗态BB84模拟器，正密钥率至142 km）上测试10至14比特分组、两个随机种子，并考虑去极化噪声下的有限精度恢复与加固谓词，最后在IBM Heron处理器上做可行性探测。
AI.result: 经典监测器对伪装攻击的读数仅0.458–0.516，而量子核达到1.000；对公开攻击两者均超过0.99。有限精度恢复与加固谓词使量子结果降至0.916–0.983，此时经典监测器仍为随机水平。IBM Heron处理器结果与精确核的偏差在0.034以内。低频特征映射对剩余类模式读数0.545，对齐后升至0.982。
AI.conclusion: 防御方可据此精确丢弃被攻陷的密钥材料，但该优势是渐近的、依赖容错实现，且仅在特征映射与对手谓词匹配时成立；这揭示了QKD部署中一个需要量子检测手段才能覆盖的安全盲区。

title: Evaluating Zone-Guided Front Extraction for Glacier Calving-Front Delineation in SAR Imagery
comment: Accepted in ICMLA 2026 as short paper. 4 pages, 1 figure
summary: Automatic calving-front delineation from synthetic aperture radar imagery is challenging because the front is a thin and often ambiguous boundary between glacier ice, ocean, and surrounding rock or terrain. The CAlving Fronts and where to Find thEm (CaFFe) dataset provides both binary calving-front masks and broader semantic zone masks, making it possible to study whether zone-level supervision can support front recovery. In this paper, we compare direct front prediction with zone-guided front extraction using U-Net, DeepLabV3+, and SegFormer-B0 under the same bounding-box-cropped CaFFe setting. In the direct setting, models predict the binary calving-front mask. In the zone-guided setting, the model first predicts four semantic zone classes, and the front is then extracted from the predicted glacier-ocean boundary. We evaluate both zone-level and front-level performance, include a ground-truth-zone boundary check, and examine lightweight test-time adaptation on sensor-specific and glacier-specific subsets. The results show that zone labels contain useful front-boundary information: extracting the front from ground-truth zones gives the lowest mean distance error. However, fronts extracted from model-predicted zones remain weak, even when zone segmentation scores are moderate. Test-time adaptation also does not consistently improve zone-guided front recovery. These results indicate that zone segmentation performance should not be treated as a substitute for front-level evaluation and that effective use of zone labels may require boundary-aware training, label fusion, or explicit front supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文比较直接预测冰裂前沿与基于语义分区引导提取的方法，发现分区标签含前沿信息，但模型预测分区提取的前沿仍较弱，分区性能不能替代前沿级评估。
AI.motivation: 自动冰裂前沿（calving front）提取困难，因其是冰川冰、海洋与岩石/地形之间的细薄且模糊边界。CaFFe数据集同时提供二值前沿掩膜和更广的语义分区掩膜，作者希望探究分区级监督能否支持前沿恢复。
AI.method: 在相同的CaFFe边界框裁剪设置下，使用U-Net、DeepLabV3+和SegFormer-B0，对比两种方案：(1)直接预测二值冰裂前沿掩膜；(2)分区引导，即先预测四类语义分区，再从预测的冰川-海洋边界提取前沿。评估包含分区级与前沿级性能、真值分区边界检查，并在传感器特异与冰川特异子集上进行轻量测试时自适应。
AI.result: 从真值分区提取前沿得到最低的平均距离误差，说明分区标签包含有用的前沿边界信息；但从模型预测分区提取的前沿仍然较弱，即使分区分割得分中等。测试时自适应也未能持续改善分区引导的前沿恢复效果。
AI.conclusion: 分区分割性能不应被视为前沿级评估的替代品；有效利用分区标签可能需要边界感知训练、标签融合或显式前沿监督。

title: Language Model Activations Inhabit Privileged Error-Correcting Basins
summary: Language models exhibit remarkable robustness, continuing to produce coherent text even when their activations are perturbed by interventions like linear steering. We hypothesize that this robustness is a result of passive dynamics, i.e., constraining mechanisms in the forward pass that funnel activations toward "good" regions that produce coherent outputs. To investigate these hypothesized error-correcting mechanisms, we probe the geometry of language model activation space by observing the action of model layers on low-dimensional curves. In doing so, we discover that model activations occur within a cluster of distinct attracting basins, which differentiate natural activations geometrically from distributionally similar synthetic activations. Applying this lens to language model steering, we observe feature-specific basins along semantic steering directions, and find that steering moves activations between these basins. To demonstrate the active role of this geometry in neural computation, we show that adaptively modulating steering strength to transport activations across basins improves inter-language steering, significantly increasing the probability of sampling tokens from the target language compared to fixed-strength steering. Our findings establish analysis of activation space geometry as a promising approach to interpreting and controlling language models.

AI.tldr: 语言模型的鲁棒性源于前向传播中的被动动力学：激活空间存在多个吸引盆地，引导激活趋向能产生连贯输出的"好"区域，且可被用于改进语言模型的引导控制。
AI.motivation: 语言模型即使受到线性引导等激活扰动，仍能保持输出连贯，展现出显著鲁棒性。作者假设这种鲁棒性来自"被动动力学"——前向传播中约束激活流向"好"区域的机制。为验证这一假设，需要探测语言模型激活空间的几何结构以揭示其中的纠错机制。
AI.method: 通过观察模型各层对低维曲线的作用，探测语言模型激活空间的几何结构；分析激活分布以识别吸引盆地；将分析框架应用于语言模型引导，考察语义引导方向上的特征特异性盆地；并通过自适应调节引导强度使激活跨盆地传输，来验证该几何结构在神经计算中的主动作用。
AI.result: 发现模型激活位于一组不同的吸引盆地中，这些盆地能在几何上将自然激活与分布相似的合成激活区分开；在语义引导方向上观察到特征特异性盆地，引导操作使激活在这些盆地间移动；自适应调节引导强度以实现跨盆地传输，能改进跨语言引导，相比固定强度引导显著提高了采样目标语言词元的概率。
AI.conclusion: 激活空间几何分析为解释和控制语言模型提供了一条有前景的途径。该研究确立了吸引盆地结构在语言模型纠错与引导控制中的关键作用。

title: Viva La Vida: Verification and Accumulation Failures in Multi-Agent Proof Search
summary: When an agentic prover works on an open problem, there is no proof assistant to fall back on: its verifier and lemma library are ultimately language models judging model outputs. We instrumented such a system end to end and analyzed $51{,}754$ traced observations across three full runs ($186$ hours, \$$5{,}694$). We find three connected failure modes. First, the three-model verifier requires unanimity and treats parse or API failure as non-approval; in $10$ of $12$ verification events, one member returned no parseable output or an API error, making acceptance arithmetically impossible without surfacing an error. Second, when the ensemble did function, one verifier approved $3$ attempts that GPT rejected, each claiming to resolve the open problem; a single-verifier design would therefore have announced a solution three times. Third, because nothing could be approved, every review was a refutation, yet the lemma extractor mines reviews as well as proofs: $24$ of $93$ lemmas ($26\%$) were extracted from rejected arguments with their refutational context removed. Taken together, these findings show that without external verification, supervision is itself a critical trust boundary: systems must distinguish abstention from rejection, preserve useful disagreement, and preserve the provenance and polarity of information before it becomes future context.

AI.tldr: 对智能体式数学证明系统进行端到端插桩分析（51,754条追踪观测、3次完整运行、186小时、花费5,694美元），揭示三大相互关联的失效模式：验证器因解析/API故障无法达成一致、投票不一致可能误报已解决开放问题、以及引理抽取器从被驳回的论证中提取引理而丢失反驳语境。
AI.motivation: 当智能体式证明器处理开放问题时，缺乏可靠的证明助手作为后备，其验证器与引理库本质上是判断模型输出的语言模型。因此监督机制本身构成关键信任边界，需要弄清这种无外部验证的系统中会出现哪些系统性失效。
AI.method: 对一个智能体式证明系统进行端到端插桩，在三次完整运行中采集并分析51,754条追踪观测（累计186小时，花费5,694美元），考察三模型验证器的一致性机制、投票行为以及引理抽取器对评审与证明的处理方式。
AI.result: 发现三类相互关联的失效模式：（1）三模型验证器要求全体一致，并将解析失败或API错误视为“未批准”，在12次验证事件中有10次至少一名成员未返回可解析输出或出现API错误，使接受在算术上不可能且不主动报错；（2）当集成正常工作时，某一验证器批准了3次被GPT驳回的尝试，且各自声称解决了开放问题，单验证器设计将因此三次宣布已找到解；（3）由于任何内容都无法被批准，所有评审都成为反驳，但引理抽取器同时挖掘评审与证明，导致93条引理中有24条（26%）来自被驳回的论证，且其反驳语境被剥离。
AI.conclusion: 在无外部验证的情况下，监督本身即为关键信任边界。系统必须明确区分“弃权”与“驳回”，保留有用的分歧，并在信息成为未来上下文之前保存其来源与极性（肯定/反驳）。

title: Understanding the Hierarchical Structure and Functional Landscape of the Model Context Protocol Ecosystem
summary: AI agents increasingly rely on tools exposed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to complete user tasks. Hundreds of thousands of MCP servers are listed across marketplaces, yet they are organized only by coarse, marketplace-specific server categories. This makes it difficult for agents and users to identify tools for a given operation, find functional alternatives, and assess how those alternatives differ. We present MCPacific, the largest tool-level, cross-marketplace map of the MCP ecosystem. MCPacific collects 368,754 MCP server listings corresponding to 124,267 unique servers across 17 marketplaces, statically extracts 1,328,233 tool specifications from these servers in seven languages, and organizes them into a hierarchical functional taxonomy of 58,915 capabilities. We construct the taxonomy through an iterative LLM-driven design-test-refine process and map the full corpus to it using calibrated embedding routing. Our study reveals that MCP extends well beyond developer tooling, with 85% of tools serving other domains. Functional alternatives are widespread but unevenly distributed: 98.5% of tools have at least one alternative, yet nearly a quarter of capabilities are supported by only one tool. Functionally comparable tools also differ in security alerts, code complexity, and project maintenance, with complexity differing by more than 2.5x in 41% of comparable tool pairs. Finally, presenting candidate tools through the taxonomy rather than a flat list improves task completion rate across all four evaluated models, with gains of up to 12 percentage points in Pass@0.75 for crowded candidate sets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MCPacific——目前规模最大的、工具级别的跨市场 MCP 生态地图，覆盖 124,267 个服务器、132 万余条工具规格，并构建 58,915 项能力的分层功能分类体系，揭示 MCP 生态的功能分布、替代工具与安全/维护差异，并证明基于分类体系的工具呈现方式能提升智能体任务完成率。
AI.motivation: MCP 服务器数量庞大但仅按粗粒度、市场特有的类目组织，导致智能体与用户难以定位特定操作所需工具、寻找功能替代品，以及比较替代品之间的差异。因此需要一个工具级别、跨市场的功能组织框架。
AI.method: MCPacific 采集 17 个市场的 368,754 条服务器条目（对应 124,267 个唯一服务器），静态抽取 7 种语言的 1,328,233 条工具规格，通过迭代式 LLM 驱动的"设计—测试—精炼"流程构建包含 58,915 项能力的分层功能分类体系，并用校准嵌入路由将全量语料映射到该体系。
AI.result: MCP 已远超开发者工具范畴，85% 的工具服务于其他领域；98.5% 的工具至少存在一个功能替代品，但近四分之一的能力仅由单一工具支持；功能可比的工具在安全告警、代码复杂度和项目维护上存在差异，41% 的可比工具对复杂度差距超过 2.5 倍；以分类体系而非扁平列表呈现候选工具，在四个评估模型上均提升任务完成率，拥挤候选集下 Pass@0.75 提升最高达 12 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 工具级别的跨市场功能分类体系能有效刻画 MCP 生态的功能格局与替代关系，并可作为提升智能体工具选择与任务完成的实用机制。

title: StegoMemory: Agentic Memory Acts as Covert Steganographic Channel
summary: Is agentic memory robust against stealthy steganographic attacks? We carry out a large-scale red-teaming exercise to test whether agents can encode attacker-controlled strings in one session and recover them in another without triggering safety oversight. Following SHADE-Arena-style tasks, we embed malicious side tasks to encode secret strings using steganography within otherwise benign tasks and evaluate them using independent task-completion and safety oversight. We test 14,000 attack trials spanning 91 model-attack configurations, 13 models, and 7 steganographic schemes: Acrostic, Mesostic, Telestich, Word-choice, Capitalization, Position-based, and Homoglyph. 41.2% of trials successfully encode the target payload in the generated response, while 29.8% survive the memory-write step with the encoding intact. Overall, 25.4% of trials yield a recoverable payload at retrieval, and 20.1% achieve exact-match recovery, including synthetic API keys and cryptographic material never exposed to the receiver. Among the exact-match transmissions, 71.4% also pass primary task-completion scoring and are independently judged safe by the oversight model, corresponding to 14.4% of all trials in which a successful covert transmission would appear to be an ordinary, benign interaction under task-level evaluation. Our results demonstrate that agentic memory can function as a persistent cross-session covert channel. The results further show that the principal bottleneck occurs at memory persistence rather than retrieval: once a steganographic payload survives the memory-write stage, a substantial fraction remains recoverable. We therefore argue that memory integrity, information-flow control, and covert-channel detection should be explicit security requirements for agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模红队测试发现，智能体记忆可被用作持久性的跨会话隐蔽信道，秘密字符串可经隐写编码写入记忆并在另一会话中还原，且多数情况下不被安全检查发现。
AI.motivation: 智能体具备跨会话记忆能力，但其记忆是否对隐蔽的隐写攻击具有鲁棒性尚不清楚。作者希望验证攻击者能否在一个会话中编码受控字符串、在另一会话中还原，同时规避安全监督。
AI.method: 参照 SHADE-Arena 式任务，在良性任务中嵌入恶意子任务，用隐写术编码秘密字符串，并分别用任务完成度与安全监督进行独立评估。共测试 14,000 次攻击试验，覆盖 91 种模型-攻击配置、13 个模型和 7 种隐写方案：Acrostic、Mesostic、Telestich、Word-choice、Capitalization、Position-based 和 Homoglyph。
AI.result: 41.2% 的试验成功在生成回复中编码目标载荷，29.8% 在记忆写入阶段保持编码完整；总体 25.4% 的试验在检索时可恢复载荷，20.1% 实现精确匹配恢复（包括从未暴露给接收方的合成 API 密钥和加密材料）。在精确匹配传输中，71.4% 同时通过主任务完成度评分且被监督模型判定为安全，相当于全部试验的 14.4% 表现为普通良性交互。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明智能体记忆可充当持久性跨会话隐蔽信道；主要瓶颈在记忆持久化而非检索阶段——一旦隐写载荷通过记忆写入，相当比例仍可恢复。因此，记忆完整性、信息流控制与隐蔽信道检测应成为智能体系统的明确安全要求。

title: Boundaries Agree, Labels Do Not: Intra-Annotator Dynamics as a Kind of Training Data
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/Malificenta883/intra-annotator-dynamics
summary: Data quality now matters as much as compute for training language models. Much training data comes from human annotation of text, and interpretive annotation has no ground truth that could settle what is "accurate". Two lines of work respond to this. One combines annotators into a "ground truth" and measures how well they agree with each other; the other treats their disagreement as a signal. Both compare different people at one point in time. We measure something else: how well one reader reproduces their own reading of the same text over time. One expert human reader and three LLM families segmented three Sumerian myths and labelled the causal function of each segment with one of seven states. Across runs months apart, the human cut the text in much the same places but named the segments differently, in every myth. The models show no such consistent pattern: their gap between the two layers is positive in some myths and negative in others, and its size varies. The human's label changes are not random: the runs go through much the same functions but start them one step apart, while model runs start them at the same places. We argue that this pattern is a usable measure of data quality and a contamination check: a "human" annotation whose labels are as stable as its boundaries, and whose functions start in sync, looks like a model's.

AI.tldr: 该研究测量同一读者在不同时间对同一文本的复现一致性（切分边界与功能标签的稳定性），发现人类专家切分稳定但标签漂移，而LLM无一致模式，据此提出一种数据质量与污染检测指标。
AI.motivation: 训练语言模型时数据质量与算力同等重要，而解释性标注缺乏可判定"准确"的标准答案。现有研究要么将标注者合并为"真值"并测量彼此一致性，要么将分歧视为信号，但都在同一时间点比较不同人，忽略了单个读者自身随时间的一致性。
AI.method: 让一位人类专家读者和三个LLM家族对三段苏美尔神话进行切分，并用七种状态之一标注每个片段的因果功能；在相隔数月后重复运行，比较同一读者/模型在切分边界层与标签层的稳定性，以及功能起始位置是否同步。
AI.result: 人类专家在各神话中切分位置高度一致，但标签命名每次都不同；模型则无此一致模式——两层（边界与标签）差异在不同神话中正负不一且大小多变。人类标签变化并非随机：各次运行经过的功能大致相同，但起始位置相差一步；模型运行则起始位置相同。
AI.conclusion: 这种"标签稳定性与边界稳定性不匹配"的模式可作为数据质量的可用度量与污染检测手段：若一份"人类"标注其标签与边界一样稳定、且功能起始同步，则更像是模型产出的。

title: Why Convolution Still Matters: Evaluating Inductive Biases in Cryospheric Image Classification
comment: Accepted at IEEE IGARSS 2026, 5 pages, 3 figures
summary: Recent advances in attention-based deep learning have motivated their adoption for remote sensing image classification; however, their benefits for cryospheric imagery, where surface states are dominated by fine-grained textures and class imbalance, remain unclear. In this work, we revisit a benchmark Greenland Ice Sheet image dataset, previously shown to favor convolutional neural networks (CNNs), to examine whether modern attention-based and hybrid architectures improve class-wise reliability. We conduct a controlled comparison between a classical CNN (AlexNet), a modern CNN (ConvNeXt-Tiny), a pure attention-based model (Swin-Tiny), and a hybrid convolution-attention model (CoAtNet-0) under identical training and evaluation protocols. Results show that AlexNet achieves the highest accuracy and the strongest balanced performance as measured by macro-averaged F1, while ConvNeXt-Tiny exhibits the highest macro-averaged AUC, indicating strong class separability but less consistent final decision quality. Class-wise analysis reveals that hybrid architectures improve recall for rare and structurally distinct surface classes, whereas convolutional models remain more reliable for texture-dominated categories. These findings highlight the importance of aligning architectural inductive bias with cryospheric data characteristics and suggest that increased model complexity does not necessarily translate to improved reliability for ice-sheet surface classification.

AI.tldr: 该研究在格陵兰冰盖影像分类任务上比较了AlexNet、ConvNeXt-Tiny、Swin-Tiny与CoAtNet-0，发现在统一协议下经典CNN（AlexNet）在准确率和宏平均F1上表现最佳，而更复杂的注意力/混合架构并未带来更可靠的分类性能。
AI.motivation: 注意力型深度学习在遥感影像分类中广泛应用，但在冰盖等冰冻圈影像上（地表状态以细粒度纹理为主且类别不平衡），其是否真正优于CNN尚不明确，需重新检验。
AI.method: 在相同的训练与评测协议下，对经典CNN（AlexNet）、现代CNN（ConvNeXt-Tiny）、纯注意力模型（Swin-Tiny）和卷积-注意力混合模型（CoAtNet-0）进行受控对比，并开展逐类别分析。
AI.result: AlexNet取得最高准确率和最强的宏平均F1；ConvNeXt-Tiny的宏平均AUC最高，说明类别可分性强但最终决策质量不稳定；混合架构提升了稀有且结构独特类别的召回，而卷积模型在纹理主导类别上更可靠。
AI.conclusion: 架构的归纳偏置需与冰冻圈数据特性相匹配，模型复杂度提升不一定带来冰盖表面分类可靠性的改善。

title: EvalResearchBench: Can AI Agents Design Their Own Evaluations?
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) relies on evaluation feedback to assess progress and guide further research, yet repeatedly running complex benchmarks is costly and slows iteration. Human experts reduce this cost by selecting benchmark subsets or designing compact suites. We ask whether AI agents can automate this design process and introduce EvalResearchBench (ERB), a benchmark for autonomous evaluation research. Given target materials, development references, candidate APIs, and fixed time and API budgets, an agent called the researcher selects or synthesizes tasks, implements graders, and revises them in pilot tests before freezing an executable evaluator for coding, co-work, and reasoning. We study 9 researchers and 13 candidate models and compare each frozen evaluator with 14 target benchmarks on score concordance and pairwise agreement. The best evaluators order about 75\% of candidate pairs as the targets do, below the 91\% ceiling set by disagreements among the targets. No researcher leads on every metric, and the best evaluator on development targets is not the best on sealed targets hidden from the researcher. A human-designed sample of public tasks remains a strong baseline, and the evaluator with the lowest recorded execution cost attains the highest pairwise agreement. Agents repair tasks and graders through pilot feedback, yet their evaluators can still truncate answers, exhaust the evaluation budget, or let a few questions dominate a domain score.

AI.tldr: 论文提出EvalResearchBench（ERB），用于评测AI智能体能否自主完成"评测研究"——即从目标材料、参考、候选API中挑选或合成任务、实现并修订评分器，最终冻结一个可执行评测器。测试9个智能体、13个候选模型，最佳评测器在约75%的候选对上与目标基准排序一致（目标间不一致的上限为91%）。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）依赖评测反馈来评估进展并指导后续研究，但反复运行复杂基准代价高昂、拖慢迭代。人类专家通过挑选基准子集或设计紧凑测试集来降低成本，论文希望探究AI智能体能否自动化这一评测设计过程。
AI.method: 构建EvalResearchBench基准：给定目标材料、开发参考、候选API以及固定的时间和API预算，让名为"researcher"的智能体选择或合成任务、实现评分器，并在试点测试中修订，最后冻结用于编码、协作和推理三类场景的可执行评测器。对9个researcher和13个候选模型进行实验，用分数一致性和成对一致性，将每个冻结评测器与14个目标基准比对。
AI.result: 最佳评测器对约75%的候选对给出与目标基准相同的排序，低于目标基准彼此分歧所设定的91%上限。没有哪个researcher在所有指标上领先；在开发目标上表现最好的评测器，在隐藏的封存目标上并非最好。人类设计的公开任务样本仍是强基线，而记录执行成本最低的评测器取得了最高的成对一致性。
AI.conclusion: 智能体虽能通过试点反馈修复任务与评分器，但其评测器仍存在截断答案、耗尽评测预算、让少数问题主导领域得分等问题，尚不能可靠替代人类设计的评测方案，但展示了自动化评测研究的可行性与局限。

title: Agentic-ZTA: A Multi-Agent Architecture for Autonomous Zero Trust Enforcement
summary: Agentic AI is emerging as a promising paradigm for automating complex cybersecurity decisions, yet its use in enforcing zero trust introduces significant challenges in safety, reliability, and policy compliance. This paper presents Agentic AI based zero trust architecture (Agentic-ZTA) that operationalizes the NIST SP 800-207 ZTA architecture control loop through coordinated multi- agent decision pipeline. In the proposed framework, policy knowledge is embedded into a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline and retrieved at inference time as top-k relevant policies. Access requests are intercepted by the Policy Enforcement Point (PEP), enriched with contextual metadata. The request context is routed to a policy engine agent which invokes domain-specialized core agents first followed by supporting agents, if further evaluation needed. AI agents reason over access context, policy constraints and determine trust. The retrieved policies are embedded into agent prompt during inference time and agentic trust scores are aggregated and evaluated by a trust-algorithm, producing the final access decision for enforcement under continuous verification. We implement Agentic-ZTA in a testbed and evaluate it on representative access-control use cases scenarios. Our Agentic-ZTA framework achieves 95.0% accuracy, 93.9% precision, and 96.3% recall, and demonstrate the feasibility of enforcing zero trust using AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Agentic-ZTA，一种基于智能体 AI 的零信任架构，通过多智能体决策流水线实现 NIST SP 800-207 的 ZTA 控制回路，并使用检索增强生成嵌入策略知识，在测试平台上取得了较高准确率。
AI.motivation: 智能体 AI 在自动化复杂网络安全决策方面具有前景，但其在零信任执行中的应用面临安全性、可靠性和策略合规性等重大挑战，因此需要一种能够安全可靠执行零信任的框架。
AI.method: 该框架将策略知识嵌入检索增强生成流水线，并在推理时检索 top-k 相关策略。访问请求由策略执行点（PEP）拦截并补充上下文元数据，随后路由至策略引擎智能体；策略引擎智能体先调用领域专用核心智能体，必要时再调用辅助智能体。AI 智能体基于访问上下文、策略约束进行推理并判断信任度，检索到的策略被嵌入智能体提示中，智能体信任分数经信任算法聚合评估，在持续验证下生成最终访问决策。
AI.result: 在测试平台上针对代表性访问控制用例进行评估，Agentic-ZTA 框架达到 95.0% 准确率、93.9% 精确率和 96.3% 召回率。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明使用 AI 智能体执行零信任是可行的，Agentic-ZTA 能够有效支持零信任架构中的访问决策与持续验证。

title: Adaptive Code Revision Attacks on AI Pull Request Reviewers
summary:
Pull-request review protects software before new code reaches users, helping prevent vulnerabilities that could expose users to attacks. AI agents increasingly perform these reviews and explain which problems need fixing. However, for an attacker submitting vulnerable code, this feedback also reveals what changes may secure approval. Existing PR attacks seek such approval through persuasive text and comments while keeping executable code fixed. This leaves unclear whether an attacker can use the feedback to repair the reported problem while preserving a vulnerability in the revised code. We therefore conduct an empirical study of this threat using AFCRA (Adaptive Feedback-guided Code Revision Attack). To distinguish successful attacks from genuine repairs, we construct AFCRA-Bench from 159 disclosed vulnerabilities, with executable exploits to verify vulnerabilities in code.
  Across five-round interactions with Sonnet 5 and GPT-5.5 reviewers, AFCRA reaches success rates 2.5x and 12.5x those of the strongest evaluated text- or comment-based attack. Case studies of these successes show how reviewers accept repairs of reported problems while overlooking surviving vulnerabilities. These findings establish feedback-guided code revision as a threat to automated PR review. To address this threat, we derive actionable implications for researchers, AI providers, PR reviewers, and PR authors on securing AI-assisted development.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AFCRA（自适应反馈引导的代码修订攻击），利用自动化PR审查AI给出的修复反馈，在不消除漏洞的前提下使代码通过审查，并构建AFCRA-Bench基准验证该威胁。
AI.motivation: PR审查能阻止漏洞代码进入用户端，AI代理越来越多地承担此类审查并解释需要修复的问题。但对攻击者而言，这些反馈恰恰揭示了哪些修改能获得批准。现有PR攻击仅靠说服性文本和评论、保持可执行代码不变来争取批准，尚不清楚攻击者能否利用反馈"修复"被报告的问题，同时在新代码中保留漏洞。
AI.method: 开展实证研究，提出AFCRA（自适应反馈引导的代码修订攻击）。为区分真实修复与成功攻击，基于159个已披露漏洞构建AFCRA-Bench，并配以可执行漏洞利用来验证代码中的漏洞。在多轮交互中测试Sonnet 5与GPT-5.5审查者。
AI.result: 在与两款审查模型各五轮交互中，AFCRA的成功率分别达到最强文本型或评论型攻击的2.5倍和12.5倍。案例研究显示，审查者接受了针对所报告问题的修复，却忽略了仍然存活的漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 反馈引导的代码修订已成为自动化PR审查的一种现实威胁。为应对该威胁，论文为研究者、AI提供方、PR审查者与PR作者提炼出可操作的建议，以保障AI辅助开发的安全性。

title: Post-Quantum Authentication Protocol for Internet of Medical Things
summary: IoMT communication systems should provide origin authentication and ensure integrity protection for the messages produced by patients' devices for transmission to gateways and further processing by other hospital services. With regard to IoMT, this paper discusses tampering, impersonation, and replay attacks on messages provided as medical reports. Long-term security of the communication system is also addressed considering potential quantum attacks. For this purpose, we design a protocol that meets requirements of practical implementation and employs an ISIS like lattice-based construction combined with concepts of the blockchain technology. Patients' devices generate a canonical JSON format medical report containing a timestamp and critical information. Using a nonce, the patients create a cryptographic signature of the message with a challenge generated from hash of a message. The gateway verifies signatures utilizing the public key of a trusted ledger associated with a particular patient and ensures freshness of the transmitted message. To optimize the performance in case when many devices interact with a gateway at once, the gateway performs batch signature validation using vectorized modular linear equations. The trusted ledger uses tamper-resistant REGISTER and TRUST UPDATE entries, maintaining a trust score of each registered patient and updating the value after each ACCEPT/REJECT operation. Our prototype application demonstrates registration procedure of a new patient, signing and verifying medical reports, auditing of the ledger, and performance assessment. Based on our experiments in the prototype, we argue that, when applied to large-scale systems, batch verification is superior to simple signature validation approach.

AI.tldr: 本文针对IoMT通信系统，设计了一种融合ISIS类格密码与区块链技术的协议，实现医疗报告的抗篡改、抗冒充、抗重放及抗量子攻击，并通过批量签名验证提升大规模系统性能。
AI.motivation: IoMT通信系统需为患者设备产生的消息提供来源认证与完整性保护，以保障其传输至网关及医院其他服务时的安全。现有系统面临篡改、冒充和重放攻击威胁，且需考虑未来量子攻击对通信系统长期安全性的影响。
AI.method: 设计满足实际部署需求的协议，采用类ISIS格密码构造并结合区块链技术。患者设备生成含时间戳和关键信息的规范JSON格式医疗报告，利用nonce和基于消息哈希生成的challenge创建签名。网关使用受信任账本中该患者对应公钥验证签名并确保消息新鲜性。面对多设备并发场景，网关通过向量化模线性方程执行批量签名验证。受信任账本使用防篡改的REGISTER和TRUST UPDATE条目，维护患者信任分数并在每次ACCEPT/REJECT后更新。
AI.result: 原型应用展示了新患者注册、医疗报告签名与验证、账本审计及性能评估流程。实验表明，在大规模系统中，批量验证优于简单签名验证方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提协议能够满足IoMT通信系统的来源认证与完整性保护需求，兼具抗量子能力，并通过批量验证优化大规模场景性能，具备实际应用可行性。

title: GlitchPatch: Repairing Glitch Tokens in Frozen Language Models via Local Retokenization
summary: Glitch tokens are anomalous vocabulary entries that can cause large language models (LLMs) to produce outputs inconsistent with their inputs. Existing repair methods require access to model internals, making them impractical for frozen checkpoints. We investigate whether glitch tokens can be repaired outside the model by optimizing the input tokenization. An empirical study on BPE merge-rule deletion reveals that (1)deleting a glitch token's merge rule can fix a substantial fraction of failures, yet disrupting normal tokens sharing intermediate merge nodes causes the overall glitch rate to rise, and (2)different decomposition granularities yield non-monotonic fix rates while collateral damage on normal tokens grows monotonically. Motivated by these findings, we propose GlitchPatch, a repair framework for frozen language models based on local retokenization, consisting of two stages: the offline stage uses Behavioral Path Optimization (BPO) to find the behaviorally optimal replacement token sequence for each glitch token and compiles validated replacements into a rule table; the online stage substitutes only the IDs of matched glitch tokens in the canonical token sequence, with no modification to model parameters or internal states. Experiments on ten models spanning six tokenizer families show that GlitchPatch achieves an 85.10% mean fix rate, outperforming the strongest baseline by 14.37 percentage points, and reduces the average glitch rate from 14.88% to 2.27%. GlitchPatch achieves a 0.00% RR in full-vocabulary evaluation and leaves rule-unmatched inputs unchanged by design. We further evaluate the practical impact of repair from the perspectives of time cost, language understanding, and capability, supporting its deployment feasibility. We hope this work provides a practical option for improving tokenizer reliability.

AI.tldr: 提出 GlitchPatch，一种无需访问模型内部、通过局部重分词在模型外部修复 glitch token 的框架，平均修复率达 85.10%。
AI.motivation: Glitch token 是会导致大模型输出与输入不一致的异常词表条目。现有修复方法需要访问模型内部，对冻结的检查点不实用，因此需要一种模型外部的修复方案。
AI.method: 先对 BPE 合并规则删除进行实证研究，发现删除 glitch token 的合并规则可修复部分失败，但会破坏共享中间合并节点的正常 token，导致整体 glitch 率上升；且不同分解粒度的修复率非单调，而对正常 token 的附带损害单调增长。基于此提出 GlitchPatch：离线阶段用行为路径优化（BPO）为每个 glitch token 寻找行为最优的替换 token 序列并编译为规则表；在线阶段仅替换匹配到的 glitch token ID，不改动模型参数与内部状态。
AI.result: 在覆盖六个分词器家族的十个模型上，GlitchPatch 平均修复率 85.10%，比最强基线高 14.37 个百分点，平均 glitch 率从 14.88% 降至 2.27%；全词表评估中 RR 为 0.00%，且规则未匹配的输入按设计保持不变。并从时间开销、语言理解与能力三方面验证了部署可行性。
AI.conclusion: GlitchPatch 为提升分词器可靠性提供了一种实用的模型外部修复方案。

title: VCURF: Virtual Camera-based Uncertainty of Radiance Fields
summary: Radiance fields, implemented with either implicit (NeRF) or explicit (Gaussian Splatting) representations, are advancing the state of the art in novel view synthesis at a rapid pace. Even though the rendered views they generate are often compelling, they are not free of errors. In this paper, we propose a new approach for pixel-wise uncertainty quantification based on measuring the inconsistencies among renderings by the radiance field model in virtual cameras sampled near the target viewpoint. We named our approach VCURF for Virtual Camera-based Uncertainty of Radiance Fields. VCURF treats the radiance field model as a black box, only assuming that it is capable of rendering color and depth on demand. This property makes our approach applicable to both NeRF and GS models without any modification. Our experiments on a combination of datasets, radiance field models and baselines demonstrate VCURF's effectiveness in pixel-wise uncertainty estimation. We conclude the paper with findings that question the way view selection is tackled by the majority of the current literature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VCURF，一种基于虚拟相机渲染一致性的像素级不确定性量化方法，适用于NeRF和Gaussian Splatting，并质疑现有视角选择的主流做法。
AI.motivation: 辐射场（NeRF与3D高斯溅射）在新视角合成上进展迅速，渲染图像虽有吸引力但仍存在误差，因此需要有效的像素级不确定性量化。
AI.method: 将辐射场模型视为黑盒，仅假设其能按需渲染颜色和深度；在目标视角附近的虚拟相机上采样，通过测量这些渲染结果之间的不一致性来量化不确定性。
AI.result: 在多种数据集、辐射场模型和基线的组合实验中，VCURF在像素级不确定性估计上展现了有效性。
AI.conclusion: VCURF无需修改即可适用于NeRF和GS模型；论文最后提出的发现对当前文献中主流的视角选择方式提出了质疑。

title: Agentic AI with Structured CoT for Enhancing AI's Spatial Intelligence: Visualization and Reasoning of Rotation
summary: Recent studies show that artificial intelligence (AI) with language and vision capabilities still experiences limitations in spatial reasoning. In this paper, we have studied the spatial capabilities of advanced generative AI to understand the rotations of objects in 3D space, utilizing AI's image processing and language processing features. We trained and examined the spatial intelligence of a generative Agentic AI model (GPT-5.6) to understand the spatial rotation process with rotation diagrams based on the revised Purdue Spatial Visualization Test: Visualization of Rotations (Revised PSVT:R). We improvised the Revised PSVT:R by superimposing additional graphical and contextual features to evaluate how different Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning strategies influence model performance. The results indicate that structured CoT reasoning improves the spatial reasoning performance of the base GPT-5.6 model in both datasets (PSVT:R and PSVT:R with coordinate system). We used three CoT approaches - (1) Structured CoT, (2) few-shot Structured CoT, and Structured CoT with Self-optimized Prompt. The three CoT approaches evaluated in this study showed no significant performance difference. Results showed that combining structured CoT reasoning with relevant contextual information leads to considerable improvements in VLM performance on 3D rotation tasks, demonstrating the potential of agentic AI for more effective spatial reasoning. However, when contextual information is removed, structured CoT reasoning alone provides limited improvement, and the models continue to exhibit notable difficulties in understanding spatial transformations. These findings suggest that effective spatial reasoning in VLMs relies on the integration of visual, textual, and reasoning-based information in future agentic AI systems for spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于修订版普渡空间可视化测试（Revised PSVT:R），检验了生成式Agentic AI模型（GPT-5.6）在3D物体旋转任务中的空间推理能力，发现结构化CoT推理配合上下文信息可显著提升表现，但缺乏上下文时改进有限。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI在语言与视觉能力上取得进展，其在空间推理方面仍存在明显局限。作者希望探究先进生成式AI理解3D空间物体旋转的能力，并考察不同思维链（CoT）推理策略对模型表现的影响。
AI.method: 研究利用AI的图像与语言处理能力，在Revised PSVT:R基础上叠加额外图形与上下文特征进行改造，构建了两个数据集（PSVT:R及带坐标系的PSVT:R）。采用三种CoT方法进行比较：（1）结构化CoT；（2）少样本结构化CoT；（3）带自优化提示的结构化CoT，并训练和考察GPT-5.6的空间智能。
AI.result: 结构化CoT推理在基础GPT-5.6模型的两种数据集上均提升了空间推理表现。三种CoT方法之间未表现出显著性能差异。将结构化CoT推理与相关上下文信息结合，可显著提升VLM在3D旋转任务上的表现；但移除上下文信息后，仅靠结构化CoT的改进有限，模型在理解空间变换上仍存在明显困难。
AI.conclusion: 有效的VLM空间推理依赖于视觉、文本与推理信息的整合。研究表明Agentic AI在空间智能方面具有潜力，未来系统需融合多模态与基于推理的信息以提升空间推理能力。

title: Topology-Conditioned Backdoors: Language Models That Insert Vulnerabilities When They Infer They Are in a Multi-Agent System
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Third Workshop on Agents in the Wild (AIWILD)
summary: A language model may behave safely in a single-agent evaluation yet produce vulnerable code when its context suggests that it is part of a multi-agent system. We study this failure mode by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to condition code generation on deployment topology inferred from prompt-level provenance cues. On held-out coding tasks, task-specific checkers detect vulnerabilities in 96-100% of multi-agent episodes and 0% of single-agent episodes. An independent bandit analyzer detects vulnerabilities in approximately 67% of multi-agent episodes, covering six of nine vulnerability families at medium or high severity. Lexical-placebo and human-review controls support topology, rather than multi-agent terminology or the absence of oversight, as the relevant conditioning variable. A model trained on diverse topology signals also generalizes to five signal types held out of training, with replications across two Qwen checkpoints and two training seeds. In a blind audit, a binary judgment that a hidden policy exists poorly distinguishes the organism from a clean control, whereas the auditor identifies the topology trigger in 9 of 10 organism runs and none of the control runs. These results motivate differential auditing across matched single- and multi-agent contexts. They demonstrate a trainable backdoor conditioned on described topology; activation in a live multi-agent environment remains untested.

AI.tldr: 论文发现语言模型在单智能体评估中表现安全，但当上下文暗示其处于多智能体系统时会生成有漏洞的代码，这是一种可训练的后门行为。
AI.motivation: 作者关注一个安全失效模式：模型可能在单智能体评估中表现安全，但在多智能体部署环境下生成脆弱代码。作者希望研究这种部署拓扑条件化的后门是否可以训练，以及能否被检测。
AI.method: 作者微调 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，使其基于提示中的来源线索推断部署拓扑，从而条件化代码生成。通过任务专用检查器、独立的 bandit 分析器、词汇安慰剂对照和人工审查对照进行验证，并在两个 Qwen 检查点和两个训练种子上复现，还进行了盲审测试。
AI.result: 在留出编码任务上，任务专用检查器在多智能体情景中检测出 96-100% 的漏洞，而单智能体情景为 0%。独立 bandit 分析器检测出约 67% 的多智能体漏洞，覆盖九类漏洞家族中的六类（中或高严重性）。对照实验支持拓扑（而非多智能体术语或缺乏监督）是关键条件变量。模型能泛化到五种未训练的信号类型。盲审中，二元判断“是否存在隐藏策略”难以区分模型与干净对照，但审计者在 9/10 的模型运行中识别出拓扑触发器，而对照运行中为零。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持在匹配的单智能体和多智能体情境下进行差异化审计。论文证明了基于描述拓扑的可训练后门；其在真实多智能体环境中的激活仍未经测试。

title: UndoBench: Separating Task Competence from Recovery Capability in Tool-Using AI Agents
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Code and benchmark available at https://github.com/tradertanmay/undobench
summary: Tool-using AI agents are increasingly deployed across enterprise software systems, yet widely used benchmarks primarily evaluate nominal task completion, conflating baseline planning competence with operational fault recovery. We introduce UndoBench, a benchmark spanning 36 base workflows and 36 fault scenarios across 8 enterprise domains, decoupling task competence from recovery capability via counterfactual paired trials under identical seeds alongside wire-level effect-history and environment-state oracles. On 12 held-out TEST workflows across two open-weight models, two frameworks, and three recovery paradigms (5,760 executions / 2,880 paired trials) in the frozen lost-acknowledgment study, nominal competence reached 83.54% while conditional recovery success rate (CRSR) fell to 46.72%, with naive retry producing duplicate external effects in 53.33% of trials. Extensions to commercial API models reproduced this competence-recovery separation. Evaluations across complementary execution boundaries show that recovery is phase-dependent: before mutation, methods perform similarly without duplicate effects among capable trials; during partial mutation, naive retry, per-call idempotency, and zero-privilege journaling collapse on the evaluated composite workflows; after commit but before acknowledgment, verification and server-side idempotency substantially improve safety. These findings demonstrate that evaluating nominal completion alone masks critical, phase-dependent recovery vulnerabilities in autonomous agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 UndoBench 基准，将 AI 智能体的任务能力与故障恢复能力解耦，揭示名义完成率无法反映恢复阶段的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要评估名义任务完成情况，将基础规划能力与运行故障恢复能力混为一谈，掩盖了自主智能体在真实企业系统中的恢复缺陷，因此需要解耦二者进行评估。
AI.method: 构建 UndoBench，覆盖 8 个企业领域、36 个基础工作流与 36 个故障场景；通过相同随机种子下的反事实配对试验，解耦任务能力与恢复能力，并引入线路级效果历史与环境状态预言机。在冻结的丢失确认研究中，使用两个开放权重模型、两个框架、三种恢复范式进行测试。
AI.result: 在 12 个留出测试工作流上（5,760 次执行 / 2,880 配对试验），名义能力达 83.54%，而条件恢复成功率（CRSR）降至 46.72%，朴素重试在 53.33% 的试验中产生重复外部效果。商业 API 模型复现了这一能力—恢复分离现象。恢复呈阶段依赖性：变更前方法表现相近；部分变更期间，朴素重试、逐调用幂等与零特权日志在复合工作流上失效；提交后未确认阶段，验证与服务端幂等显著提升安全性。
AI.conclusion: 仅评估名义完成会掩盖自主智能体中关键的、阶段依赖的恢复漏洞，需将恢复能力作为独立维度进行评估。

title: Indistinguishability Lifting for Keyed Oracles, Compressed Ideal Cipher, and More Applications
summary:
Cryptographic security proofs often involve an adversary interacting with a larger, keyed oracle that consists of (potentially exponentially) many independent instances of a smaller, base oracle. However, showing quantum indistinguishability between two such keyed oracles can be tricky, since a single query made by an adversary may involve a superposition that covers all instances of the base oracles simultaneously.
  In this paper, we establish a generic indistinguishability lifting theorem of the following form: if the two base oracles are indistinguishable under quantum queries, then their corresponding keyed oracles are too, up to an O(q^2) multiplicative loss in distinguishing advantage, where q is the number of queries made by the adversary. Our lifting theorem applies to both statistical and computational settings, and to oracles that are stateful as well. It is also optimal in that it matches the obvious Grover search attack for a certain (contrived) choice of oracles.
  As an immediate application, we extend Carolan's compressed permutation oracle to an efficiently implementable compressed ideal cipher, and use it to prove preimage resistance of the Davies-Meyer compression function in the quantum ideal cipher model. Thanks to our lifting theorem, the soundness of our compressed ideal cipher reduces to that of Carolan's oracle, and any further improvement on the latter would automatically carry over to the former.
  As our second application, we give a modular construction that doubles the message length of any quantum-secure strong pseudorandom permutation. Along the way, we show that an existing two-round tweakable Feistel construction is indistinguishable from a random permutation under quantum bidirectional queries. This is done via a dedicated polynomial-method argument, which may be of independent interest.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个通用的不可区分性提升定理：若两个基预言机在量子查询下不可区分，则对应的密钥化预言机也如此，辨识优势最多有O(q²)的乘法损失，q为查询次数。该定理适用于统计与计算场景及有状态预言机，且最优。应用于压缩理想密码（证明Davies-Meyer压缩函数的原像抗性）和将量子安全强伪随机置换的消息长度加倍。
AI.motivation: 密码学安全证明常涉及敌手与包含大量（可能指数级）独立基预言机实例的密钥化预言机交互。但证明两个此类密钥化预言机的量子不可区分性很棘手，因为敌手的单次查询可能涉及同时覆盖所有基预言机实例的叠加态。因此需要一个通用的提升定理来简化这类证明。
AI.method: 作者建立一个通用不可区分性提升定理：若两个基预言机在量子查询下不可区分，则对应密钥化预言机亦然，辨识优势最多有O(q²)乘法损失。定理覆盖统计与计算场景以及有状态预言机，并通过与Grover搜索攻击匹配证明其最优性。应用方面：将Carolan压缩置换预言机扩展为高效可实现的压缩理想密码；以及给出将任意量子安全强伪随机置换消息长度加倍的模块化构造，其中用专门的多项式方法论证两轮可调Feistel构造在量子双向查询下与随机置换不可区分。
AI.result: 1) 压缩理想密码的可靠性归约到Carolan预言机的可靠性，任何对后者的改进自动传递到前者，并用于证明Davies-Meyer压缩函数在量子理想密码模型下的原像抗性。2) 构造出将量子安全强伪随机置换消息长度加倍的模块化方案，并证明现有两轮可调Feistel构造在量子双向查询下与随机置换不可区分。
AI.conclusion: 该提升定理为量子密码学中密钥化预言机的不可区分性提供了通用而最优的工具，辨识优势损失为O(q²)。它在统计与计算场景及有状态预言机下均适用，并成功应用于压缩理想密码与消息长度加倍的强伪随机置换构造，其中多项式方法论证可能具有独立价值。

title: XTurnix: Large-Scale Self-Supervised Turn Control through Two-State Binary Decisions
summary: General turn-taking behavior in real-time dialogue systems requires deciding whether to keep listening or start responding while listening, and whether to continue or stop while speaking. Existing turn detectors use heterogeneous, task-specific label spaces and are often trained on limited annotations or evaluated on isolated utterances, making them difficult to use as a unified causal controller with comprehensive context. We propose XTurnix, a compact text-based model that formulates turn control as two binary decisions conditioned on the AI's current listening or speaking state and predicts a single control token from the complete dialogue history. XTurnix is pretrained on 5.5 million causal action examples automatically derived from timestamped two-speaker transcripts, then fine-tuned on synthetic multi-turn examples with a flatter distribution across the four state-action labels. We evaluate XTurnix on four public benchmarks and a balanced self-curated benchmark. Across the public benchmarks, XTurnix achieves the best results on all SemanticVAD and LiveKit splits, ties the native Smart-Turn model on Smart-Turn Bench, and achieves the highest incomplete-turn accuracy on Easy-Turn. On the self-curated benchmark, it reaches 89.06% accuracy, more than 20 percentage points above the strongest third-party baseline at 68.75%, while maintaining F1 scores between 84.21% and 90.63% across all four categories. These results demonstrate unified listening- and speaking-state turn control in a single compact model. Code is available at https://github.com/xcc-zach/xturnix, with an interactive demo at https://huggingface.co/spaces/xcczach/xturnix-demo.

AI.tldr: 提出紧凑文本模型 XTurnix，将轮次控制统一为基于对话历史的双二元决策，预测单一控制 token。
AI.motivation: 现有轮次检测器使用异构、任务特定的标签空间，训练标注有限或仅在孤立话语上评估，难以作为具有完整上下文的统一因果控制器。
AI.method: 将轮次控制建模为在AI当前聆听或说话状态下条件化的两个二元决策，从完整对话历史预测单一控制 token。先在550万条从带时间戳双人转录自动推导的因果动作样本上预训练，再在四类状态-动作标签分布更均衡的合成多轮样本上微调。
AI.result: 在四个公开基准和一个平衡自建基准上评估。公开基准上在全部 SemanticVAD 和 LiveKit 划分取得最佳，Smart-Turn Bench 上与原版 Smart-Turn 模型持平，Easy-Turn 上取得最高未完成轮次准确率。自建基准达 89.06%，高于最强第三方基线 68.75% 超过20个百分点，四类 F1 在 84.21%–90.63%。
AI.conclusion: 在单一紧凑模型中实现了统一的聆听与说话状态轮次控制。

title: Dependable AI-Assisted Engineering: A Formal Framework for AI Participation and Assurance in Safety-Critical Workflows
summary: Generative AI can produce engineering artefacts, but generation alone does not determine whether or how those artefacts should enter safety-critical workflows. This paper develops a formal framework for assigning AI participation and assurance at the level of individual workflow units. Each unit has a participation and assurance record covering its engineering requirement, an approved operational formalization where applicable, the applicable mechanism, fallback where applicable, evidence obligations and the applicable guarantee, plus a deployment-readiness status. The framework distinguishes deterministic verification, statistically calibrated admission, authorized human judgement supported by AI advice, authorized human adjudication of AI-produced artefacts, retained deterministic tool paths and explicit non-participation; these arrangements carry different kinds of guarantee rather than levels on a common scale. The framework also separates formalization fidelity from verifier soundness, provides a staged classification and readiness procedure, and derives conditions for comparing a gated AI-assisted unit with an incumbent process under recurring-population assumptions. We instantiate and apply the framework in an executed 17-unit wing-spar structural-analysis workflow combining deterministically gated AI-generated CAD, retained deterministic computation and human judgement. The AI-generated CAD program passed all 23 deterministic checks and was admitted at the first attempt. Favourable stress magnitudes did not suffice to pass the stress criteria where the predeclared mesh-convergence evidence was insufficient; those criteria were instead referred to engineering judgement. The case demonstrates selective AI participation and explicit evidence handling at unit level; no claim is made of workflow-level dependability, certification, structural safety or productivity.

AI.tldr: 提出一个在单个工作流单元层面为AI分配参与方式与保证义务的形式化框架，并在17单元机翼翼梁结构分析流程中实例验证。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI能产出工程制品，但仅凭生成能力无法判断这些制品是否、以及如何进入安全关键工作流。现有讨论缺少在细粒度层面上明确界定AI参与形式及其相应保证的方法。
AI.method: 为每个工作流单元建立参与与保证记录（含工程要求、经批准的操作形式化、适用机制、兜底方案、证据义务、适用保证、部署就绪状态）；区分六类安排（确定性验证、统计校准准入、AI辅助下的人工判断、对AI产物的授权人工裁定、保留的确定性工具路径、明确不参与）；把形式化保真度与验证器可靠性分开；给出分级分类与就绪度流程；在重复总体假设下推导门控式AI辅助单元与既有流程的可比条件；在17单元机翼翼梁结构分析流程中实例化应用，并结合确定性门控的AI生成CAD、保留的确定性计算与人工判断。
AI.result: AI生成的CAD程序通过全部23项确定性检查并首次即被准入；在预声明网格收敛证据不足时，即使应力幅值有利也无法通过应力判据，相关判据改由工程判断处理。案例表明可在单元层面实现选择性AI参与与显式证据管理。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能在细粒度层面厘清AI参与形式与保证类型，实现选择性的AI介入和明确的证据处置；但不对工作流级可靠性、认证、结构安全性或生产率作出任何声称。

title: MemLeak: Cross-User Semantic Leakage in Multi-Tenant AI Agent Memory
summary: Personal AI agents in enterprise multi-tenant deployments share a common vector store for long-term memory. Shared embedding spaces create a surface for cross-user memory leakage: a user's query can retrieve semantically adjacent memories belonging to another user through ordinary cosine-similarity retrieval, without any exploit. We formalize this as cross-user admissibility failure and evaluate it across six experiments, plus follow-up ablations, under both sparse (TF-IDF) and production-faithful (MiniLM-L6-v2) retrieval. Non-adversarial, incidental leakage reaches 70--100\% under pooled {same-team} retrieval; adversarially crafted memories achieve 90--100\% top-$k$ placement, exceeding weaker keyword-based attacker baselines, with score lifts of $+0.416$ to $+0.511$ under production-faithful dense retrieval (Config B); and end-to-end response contamination reaches 5.00/5 under a production retrieval path and 4.67/5 with Claude Sonnet~4.5, with contaminated responses often scoring as helpful or more helpful than clean ones, a gap validated against human judgment. Among three architectural mitigations, only hard post-retrieval ownership gating consistently restores the clean baseline (1.00/5) across {two generation models, at a measured latency overhead of roughly 1.4~ms per query.

AI.tldr: 企业多租户个人AI代理共享向量存储会导致跨用户记忆泄漏，非对抗场景泄漏率达70-100%，仅硬性检索后归属门控能恢复到干净基线。
AI.motivation: 企业多租户部署中，个人AI代理共享同一向量存储以支持长期记忆，共享嵌入空间使用户查询可能通过普通余弦相似度检索到其他用户的语义相近记忆，无需任何漏洞利用即可发生泄漏，作者将此形式化为"跨用户可接纳性失效"并进行系统评估。
AI.method: 在稀疏（TF-IDF）与生产级忠实（MiniLM-L6-v2）两种检索方式下设计六组实验及后续消融实验，考察非对抗性附带泄漏、对抗性构造记忆的top-k放置、端到端响应污染，并对比三种架构缓解措施。
AI.result: 非对抗附带泄漏在池化同团队检索下达70-100%；对抗性记忆达90-100% top-k放置，优于弱关键词攻击基线，生产级稠密检索下分数提升+0.416至+0.511；端到端响应污染在生产检索路径下达5.00/5，Claude Sonnet 4.5下达4.67/5，且污染响应常被评得与干净响应一样或更有帮助，该差距经人工判断验证。三种缓解措施中仅硬性检索后归属门控能稳定恢复干净基线（1.00/5），覆盖两个生成模型，每查询延迟开销约1.4毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 共享向量存储的跨用户记忆泄漏是系统性且高发的风险，现有缓解措施难以奏效，硬性检索后归属门控是唯一有效方案，应作为企业多租户AI代理记忆架构的必要设计。

title: Finite State Machine-Based Traffic Orchestration for Multi-Engine Analysis Platforms
summary: Modern application-security platforms route live traffic from a single proxy into several independent analysis engines -- behavioral anomaly detection, authentication analysis, resource discovery, access-control inspection, among others. Each engine's appetite for traffic changes on its own schedule, yet the proxy can honor only one forwarding instruction per resource. We present a traffic-orchestration method that models the combined needs of all engines as a single composite finite state machine (FSM) whose state space is the Cartesian product of per-engine states. Every reachable composite state pre-maps to one forwarding configuration, so runtime reduces to a lookup rather than a negotiation. We add two refinements: time-based expiry treated as a first-class FSM transition enabling declarative traffic decay, and per-state multi-tier outputs that let one machine serve every service level. The design is fully declarative, engine-agnostic, and scales to N engines without re-architecture.

AI.tldr: 提出一种流量编排方法，将所有分析引擎的需求建模为单一复合有限状态机（FSM），其状态空间为各引擎状态的笛卡尔积，运行时通过查表而非协商来转发流量。
AI.motivation: 现代应用安全平台将实时流量从单一代理分发到多个独立分析引擎，各引擎对流量的需求按各自节奏变化，而代理对每个资源只能执行一条转发指令，因而需要协调这些相互冲突的需求。
AI.method: 将各引擎需求组合为复合FSM，状态空间为各引擎状态的笛卡尔积；每个可达复合状态预映射到一种转发配置；并加入两项改进：将基于时间的过期作为一等FSM转移以支持声明式流量衰减，以及每状态多层级输出使单一状态机服务所有服务等级。
AI.result: 运行时转发简化为查表操作，无需在线协商；方法完全声明式、与引擎无关，并可在无需重新架构的情况下扩展到N个引擎。
AI.conclusion: 该设计为多引擎流量分发提供了一种声明式、可扩展的编排方案，通过复合FSM将复杂的运行时协商转化为可预测的状态查表。

title: Forecasting Cybersecurity Incidents Using Geopolitical Data and Large Language Models
summary:
Predicting security incidents is a profound task critical for informing proactive defensive measures and cyber-insurance policies. Prior work tackling this problem mainly utilized structured, manually defined features based on network measurements (e.g., protocol misconfigurations). Still, despite leading to promising performance, the network-based features may fail to capture aspects related to adversaries' motives.
  To fill this gap, our work leverages geopolitical data mined from public sources--which may help capture attacker motives--to forecast security incidents. Specifically, our approach relies on news articles and transcribed podcasts that are fed to large language models to automatically produce rich representations. The representations are then fed to a classifier trained to forecast future incidents based on historical ones.
  Our evaluation with a large incidents dataset (>15,700 records) demonstrates substantial accuracy (71.4% ROC AUC) with geopolitical data alone. Notably, combining geopolitical data and network measurements outperforms the state-of-the-art technique based on network features alone (81.3% vs.77.5% ROC AUC). Our analysis also helps shed light on when geopolitical data is most helpful and the data sources that are most useful for accurate forecasting.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用公开来源的地缘政治数据（新闻文章、播客转录）经大语言模型生成表示，用于预测网络安全事件，并将地缘政治数据与网络测量特征结合，取得优于现有技术的效果。
AI.motivation: 预测安全事件对主动防御和网络保险政策至关重要。已有工作主要依赖人工定义的结构化网络测量特征（如协议错误配置），虽性能可观，但难以捕捉与攻击者动机相关的因素。
AI.method: 从公开来源挖掘地缘政治数据（新闻文章与播客转录文本），输入大语言模型自动生成丰富表示，再将表示输入分类器，基于历史事件预测未来事件；并与网络测量特征进行融合。
AI.result: 在超过15,700条记录的大型事件数据集上，仅使用地缘政治数据即达到71.4% ROC AUC；结合地缘政治数据与网络测量特征后达到81.3% ROC AUC，优于仅基于网络特征的现有最优方法（77.5%）。
AI.conclusion: 地缘政治数据可有效补充网络测量特征，提升安全事件预测准确性；研究还揭示了地缘政治数据最有帮助的场景以及最有用的数据来源。

title: Ideological Stance Detection in a Low-Resource Language: Polarization in Bangladeshi Public vs Private University Discourse on Social Media
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Information, Communication and Systems (SPICSCON), 13-14 August 2026, Bangladesh Army University of Engineering & Technology (BAUET), Qadirabad, Natore, Bangladesh
summary: Public vs. private universities is a debatable issue, and it creates polarization on social media in Bangladesh. Debate on quality, jobs, and prestige is passionate among the students, parents, and graduates, the majority of whom speak Bengali, a low-resource language. To measure this polarization, this paper introduces a manually annotated dataset of 4,060 Bengali comments labeled as Pro-Public, Pro-Private, or Neutral. We evaluated the quality of our annotations by Fleiss's Kappa agreement that was 0.89, corresponding to a high agreement among annotators. The classical ML (SVM, Random Forest, XGBoost), BiLSTM network, hybrid BanglaBERT+XGBoost models and the state-of-the-art zero-shot LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4, DeepSeek-V3.1, Llama 4 Maverick, Kimi K2 Thinking, Qwen3-235B Thinking) models are evaluated. The accuracy of BanglaBERT+XGBoost is 91.81% and macro F1 score is 91.70%, which is higher than all the supervised baselines. The zero-shot Llama 4 Maverick Thinking achieves a macro F1 of 0.931 (overall accuracy of 93.31%) without any fine-tuning. All machine learning (ML), deep machine learning (DL) and transformer models were outperformed by the zero-shot Llama 4 Maverick model. Polarization also is evident, in some ways more clearly in the Pro-Private comments, which emphasize modern facilities and timely graduation, versus the Pro-Public comments, which emphasize affordability and government jobs. Our findings open new directions for analyzing social media polarization in low-resource languages.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了首个孟加拉语公立与私立大学之争的标注数据集（4,060条评论），并系统评估了传统机器学习、深度学习与零样本大模型，发现零样本Llama 4 Maverick表现最佳（宏F1 0.931），揭示了低资源语言社交媒体极化分析的新方向。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国社交平台上围绕公立与私立大学的质量、就业与声望存在激烈争论，形成明显极化，但孟加拉语属低资源语言，缺乏相关标注数据与系统研究，因此需要构建数据集并评估多种模型以量化这一极化现象。
AI.method: 人工标注4,060条孟加拉语评论，分为支持公立、支持私立、中立三类，标注一致性Fleiss's Kappa为0.89；评估了经典机器学习模型（SVM、随机森林、XGBoost）、BiLSTM、BanglaBERT+XGBoost混合模型，以及零样本大语言模型（Claude Sonnet 4、DeepSeek-V3.1、Llama 4 Maverick、Kimi K2 Thinking、Qwen3-235B Thinking）。
AI.result: 监督模型中BanglaBERT+XGBoost最佳，准确率91.81%、宏F1 91.70%，优于所有监督基线；零样本Llama 4 Maverick Thinking无需微调即达到宏F1 0.931、总体准确率93.31%，超过所有ML、DL与Transformer模型。极化表现为支持私立者强调现代化设施与按时毕业，支持公立者强调学费可负担与政府就业。
AI.conclusion: 零样本大模型在低资源语言的极化检测中表现优于有监督模型，且孟加拉语大学之争的极化模式清晰可辨，为低资源语言的社交媒体极化分析开辟了新方向。

title: UniBRep: Learning Unified Geometry and Topology for Image-conditioned B-Rep Generation
summary: Generating a boundary representation (B-rep) conditioned on a single image requires faithful reconstruction of geometry, valid topology, and support for complex shapes. We present UniBRep, a geometry-first framework that adapts a pretrained image-to-3D model to generate a feature mesh as a unified intermediate representation. Its surface provides a geometric scaffold, while spatially aligned learned features encode face-separation cues for topology recovery. Dual decoder branches generate the geometry and face-separation features; a geometry- and feature-guided construction pipeline then fits parametric surfaces, recovers boundary curves and connectivity, and assembles an explicit B-rep using a CAD kernel. Recovering topology from mesh regions avoids predefined architectural face-count limits, allowing face count to scale with shape complexity. On the standard DeepCAD benchmark, UniBRep produces valid B-reps for 80.49\% of inputs and reduces face Chamfer distance from 0.1096 to 0.0345 relative to CADDreamer. In a matched comparison, UniBRep also outperforms the HoLa public demo across all reported metrics. Further evaluations demonstrate scalability to high-complexity shapes beyond the standard 30-face range, generalization to objects outside the CAD training distribution, and qualitative transfer to real photographs.

AI.tldr: UniBRep是一个以几何为先的框架，通过适配预训练图像到3D模型生成特征网格作为统一中间表示，实现从单张图像生成B-rep。
AI.motivation: 从单张图像生成边界表示（B-rep）需要忠实重建几何、有效拓扑并支持复杂形状。传统方法存在预定义面数限制、拓扑恢复困难等问题。
AI.method: 采用几何为先框架，适配预训练图像到3D模型生成特征网格。表面提供几何支架，空间对齐的学习特征编码面分离线索用于拓扑恢复。双解码器分支分别生成几何和面分离特征；随后通过几何与特征引导的构建管线拟合参数曲面、恢复边界曲线和连通性，并使用CAD内核组装显式B-rep。从网格区域恢复拓扑避免预定义面数限制。
AI.result: 在DeepCAD基准上，UniBRep对80.49%的输入生成有效B-rep，面Chamfer距离从0.1096降至0.0345（相比CADDreamer）。在匹配比较中，UniBRep在所有报告指标上均优于HoLa公开演示。进一步评估显示可扩展至超过标准30面范围的高复杂度形状，泛化至CAD训练分布外的物体，并定性迁移到真实照片。
AI.conclusion: UniBRep通过特征网格作为统一中间表示和几何引导的构建管线，有效实现了从单张图像生成具有可扩展面数和良好泛化能力的B-rep，在标准基准和对比方法上均取得更优性能。

title: Asynchronous Is Nearly Free for Evolution Strategies on Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
summary: LLM-based long-horizon agentic post-training is often bottlenecked by rollout generation: trajectories span many interaction turns, completion times vary substantially, and synchronous update barriers leave faster workers waiting for stragglers. Asynchronous reinforcement learning which has been adopted in LLM post-training addresses this inefficiency by consuming trajectories as they arrive, but introduces policy lag and off-policy optimization. Evolution strategies (ES) offer a backpropagation-free alternative for LLM post-training, yet it relies on a larger number of rollouts and existing practices have remained largely synchronous. In this short-form paper, we introduce bounded-staleness asynchronous ES and demonstrate it on Endless Terminals benchmark using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Across three evaluation seeds, natural Async-1 matches synchronous ES, achieving 25.9\% versus 25.4\% held-out success. Controlled schedules that delay 10\% of each update cohort by four or eight policy updates reduce success by only 1.6 and 3.1 percentage points, respectively, without explicit off-policy correction. GRPO performs better overall, reaching 29.0\% held-out success, but importantly our results show that ES tolerates moderate policy staleness with limited degradation, opening possibilities for future improvement of ES-based post-training with asynchronous algorithms. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to demonstrate the effectiveness of sync and async ES on a multi-turn terminal style agentic coding task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出有界陈旧性异步进化策略（bounded-staleness asynchronous ES），在 Endless Terminals 多轮终端智能体编码任务上验证其可行性，发现 ES 能容忍中等程度的策略陈旧而性能下降有限。
AI.motivation: LLM 长程智能体后训练受限于 rollout 生成：轨迹跨越多个交互轮次、完成时间差异大、同步更新屏障使快 worker 等待慢 worker。异步强化学习虽缓解低效，却引入策略滞后与离策略优化问题。ES 作为无反向传播的替代方案需要更多 rollout，但现有实践基本仍是同步的，缺乏对异步 ES 的探索。
AI.method: 提出有界陈旧性异步 ES（bounded-staleness asynchronous ES），在 Endless Terminals 基准上使用 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 进行实验。设置自然异步 Async-1 与同步 ES 对比，并设计受控调度：将每次更新队列中 10% 的样本延迟四个或八个策略更新，且不进行显式离策略校正。
AI.result: 在三个评估种子上，自然 Async-1 与同步 ES 表现相当，held-out 成功率 25.9% vs 25.4%。延迟调度实验中，延迟 4 次和 8 次更新的成功率仅分别下降 1.6 和 3.1 个百分点。GRPO 整体更优，达到 29.0% held-out 成功率。
AI.conclusion: ES 能够容忍中等程度的策略陈旧，性能退化有限，为未来基于 ES 的异步后训练算法改进开辟了可能性。作者称这是首次在多轮终端风格智能体编码任务上验证同步与异步 ES 的有效性。

title: PreMaQ: Predicting Maintainability-Related Quality of LLM-Generated Code Before Generation
summary: As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly capable of code generation, adopting generated code in software development requires assessing not only its functional correctness but also its maintainability-related quality. If such quality could be estimated before generation, developers could avoid the cost of generating, reviewing, and discarding low-quality code. Although prior work has shown that the functional correctness of the LLM-generated code can be predicted in advance, it remains unclear whether maintainability-related quality is similarly predictable. We introduce Pre-Generation Maintainability-Related Quality Prediction (PreMaQ), which predicts the Code Smell Score (CSS) and Maintainability Index (MI) of generated code from the internal representations of LLMs before generation. Our evaluation covers four open-weight LLMs and four Python code generation benchmarks, comprising 2,695 tasks in total. Our results show that predicted CSS and MI consistently correlate with their observed values across all 16 model-benchmark combinations, achieving mean Spearman rank correlations of 0.57 and 0.65, respectively. When used for model selection, PreMaQ achieves 59.5% of the maintainability-related quality improvement attainable by an ideal maintainability-based selector over random selection on tasks for which multiple models generate functionally correct code. Combining predictions from PreMaQ and prompt embeddings increases this proportion to 60.7%, indicating that the two signals are complementary. These findings suggest that PreMaQ can be used to predict and improve the maintainability-related quality of LLM-generated code.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PreMaQ方法，利用LLM内部表示在生成代码前预测其代码坏味分数（CSS）和可维护性指数（MI），并在16个模型-基准组合中验证了预测的有效性和实用性。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM代码生成能力增强，采用生成代码不仅需评估功能正确性，还需考虑可维护性质量。若能提前估计质量，开发者可避免生成、审查和丢弃低质量代码的成本。已有研究表明功能正确性可提前预测，但可维护性相关质量是否同样可预测尚不清楚。
AI.method: 提出PreMaQ（Pre-Generation Maintainability-Related Quality Prediction），通过LLM生成前的内部表示预测生成代码的Code Smell Score（CSS）和Maintainability Index（MI）。评估涵盖4个开放权重LLM和4个Python代码生成基准，共2695个任务，并尝试将PreMaQ预测与提示嵌入结合。
AI.result: 预测的CSS和MI在所有16个模型-基准组合中均与观测值相关，平均Spearman秩相关系数分别为0.57和0.65。在模型选择任务中，PreMaQ实现了理想基于可维护性选择器相对于随机选择所能获得改进的59.5%；结合预测与提示嵌入后比例提升至60.7%，表明两种信号互补。
AI.conclusion: PreMaQ可用于预测并提升LLM生成代码的可维护性相关质量。

title: Trusted Hardware Acceleration for Malicious-Secure Function Secret Sharing
summary: Function secret sharing (FSS) underlies two-party private inference and private information retrieval, with cost dominated by generating, moving and evaluating distributed point function (DPF) keys. A trusted GPU-integrated distributed function accelerator (DFA) removed key movement by generating and consuming keys locally, but tolerates only semi-honest adversaries. A malicious host or GPU can tamper with shares, replay one-time material, swap buffers after checking, request early outputs, or abuse the accelerator as a forgery oracle, while malicious FSS ships large authenticated keys or multiplies DPF work. We present VIGOR-DFA, protecting the chain from authorized input to authorized output release with three mechanisms: a fresh authentication epilogue using three field multiplications per DPF output, 3.8-4.0 times faster per gate than per-lane DPF tag trees; a freeze-before-challenge check of every opening with t = 3 independent MAC lanes over F_{2^61-1}; and a role-bound one-time resource ledger with a release guard, in a protected datapath beside the GPU L2 cache. We prove stand-alone static malicious security with abort in a protected-module model, with statistical error Q(2/p)^t approximately 2^-148 for Q less than or equal to 2^32 checked batches. Our DFA-calibrated model shows that, against dealer-based malicious FSS modeled after the protocol family of Shark, VIGOR-DFA removes 21.8-563 GB of per-query offline authenticated material and, mainly by generating it in-module, lowers LAN latency by 10.1-14.0 times (1.5-1.8 times excluding offline distribution) and energy by 3.0-3.9 times. Malicious security costs 2.5-3.5 times LAN latency over semi-honest DFA and 0.145 mm^2 at 7 nm. We have completed the verification of specifications and the functional CPU reference model, including GPU/RTL conformance verification, protected runtime evaluation, and deployment-related tests.

AI.tldr: VIGOR-DFA 为 GPU 集成分布式函数加速器提供恶意安全保护，通过三种机制覆盖从授权输入到授权输出的完整链路，实现高效且可证明安全的 FSS。
AI.motivation: 现有 GPU 集成分布式函数加速器（DFA）虽消除了密钥移动开销，但仅能抵御半诚实敌手。恶意主机或 GPU 可篡改份额、重放一次性材料、在检查后调换缓冲区、请求提前输出或将加速器滥用为伪造预言机；而恶意 FSS 方案则需传输大量认证密钥或成倍增加 DPF 工作量。
AI.method: 提出 VIGOR-DFA，包含三种机制：(1) 新鲜认证尾声，每个 DPF 输出仅需三次域乘法；(2) 冻结后挑战的打开检查，采用 t=3 条独立 MAC 通道作用于 F_{2^61-1}；(3) 角色绑定的一次性资源账本与释放守卫，部署于 GPU L2 缓存旁的保护数据通路中。
AI.result: 在保护模块模型下证明了独立静态恶意安全（带中止），统计误差约为 2^-148。相比 Shark 系列经销商式恶意 FSS，每查询减少 21.8-563 GB 离线认证材料，LAN 延迟降低 10.1-14.0 倍（不含离线分发为 1.5-1.8 倍），能耗降低 3.0-3.9 倍。恶意安全代价为半诚实 DFA 的 2.5-3.5 倍 LAN 延迟，7 nm 下面积 0.145 mm^2。已完成规范与 CPU 参考模型验证，包括 GPU/RTL 一致性、保护运行时评估及部署相关测试。
AI.conclusion: VIGOR-DFA 首次为 GPU 集成 DFA 提供端到端的可证明恶意安全保障，在大幅降低离线认证材料与网络/能耗开销的同时，以可控的延迟和面积代价实现实用化部署。

title: Saying, Not Knowing: Aggressively GGUF-Quantized Small Language Models Still Write Rare Words They Can No Longer Define
comment: 41 pages, 15 figures, 1 table. Data, answer key, scored outputs and scorer code: https://github.com/NietzscheDostoevsky/snk-release
summary: Post-training quantization to the GGUF format's mixed-precision K-quants is commonly how open-weight language models reach consumer hardware, yet its effect on fine-grained lexical competence is uncharacterized. We audit 27 quantized artifacts across 13 families and four architecture backbones, 0.35B-14B parameters, evaluated down their published ladder to Q2_K (about 2.6 bits per weight), on 429 frequency-validated rare English words under two probes: surface inclusion of a prompt-supplied word and its one-sentence definition, scored by a tiered multi-synonym matcher, its error measured by a blind LLM-judge census of every definition, with human verification. Three regimes emerge at Q2: total collapse into unusable builds, severe semantic dissociation in sub-2B models, and mostly robust preservation above about 3B. In every sub-2B artifact, definitions fall 20-67% below the artifact's baseline, typically several times the inclusion loss. Two controls separate rarity from task difficulty: within the rare set, loss rises with rarity in six of seven sub-2B artifacts, and on a 100-word common-word set rare words lose more than common words in all eight, significantly in six. Tokenizer vocabulary size does not predict the damage (Spearman rho=0.12); parameter count dominates (rho=0.72), confirmed within five of six same-tokenizer families. Q4_K_M remains lexically clean at >=1B. The damage is frequency-graded, provider-dependent, and not calibrated by WikiText-2 perplexity: across nine artifact-matched ladders, near-identical Q2 penalties (44.7%/47.6%) separate an artifact keeping its definitions (3.6%) from one losing them (43.6%). Aggressively quantized small models can keep generating fluent text while no longer knowing what it means, risking hardware-constrained deployments in domains where semantics carries consequences. Validation must be per artifact.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了27个GGUF格式混合精度量化模型（13个家族、4种主干架构、0.35B–14B参数），在429个频率验证的稀有英语词汇上探测其细粒度词汇能力。结果发现Q2量化下出现三种状态：完全崩溃、2B以下的严重语义脱节、以及约3B以上的基本稳健保持；损伤按词频分级、依赖提供商，且无法用WikiText-2困惑度校准。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化到GGUF混合精度K-quant是开放权重语言模型进入消费级硬件的主流途径，但其对细粒度词汇能力的影响尚未被刻画，存在硬件受限部署中"文本流畅但语义丢失"的风险。
AI.method: 在429个频率验证的稀有英语单词上，用两种探测（提示所给单词的表面包含、及一句话定义），由分层多同义词匹配器评分，定义错误通过盲法LLM评判普查并经人工验证；并加入100词常见词集作为难度对照，分析tokenizer词表大小与参数量的相关性。
AI.result: Q2下呈现三种状态：完全崩溃、2B以下严重语义解离、约3B以上基本保持。所有2B以下模型的定义损失比基线低20–67%，通常是包含损失的数倍。稀有词损失随稀有度上升，常见词对照显示稀有词损失更大。词表大小不预测损伤（rho=0.12），参数量主导（rho=0.72），在六个同tokenizer家族中的五个得到确认。Q4_K_M在≥1B时词汇上仍干净。相近的Q2惩罚（44.7%/47.6%）可能区分出保留定义（3.6%）与丢失定义（43.6%）的不同模型，困惑度无法校准该损伤。
AI.conclusion: 激进的量化会让小模型保持流畅生成却不再理解词义，给语义后果重要的硬件受限部署带来风险。验证必须针对每个具体模型逐一进行，不能依赖困惑度等通用指标。

title: Scaling 3D Visual Grounding in Abdominal CT
summary: Visual grounding models can enhance radiology workflows by linking report findings to image regions. This is particularly valuable for 3D CT, where findings often occupy a tiny fraction of the volume. Training 3D grounding models requires large sets of paired phrases and regions, and building such datasets is expensive, requiring radiologists to annotate images by hand. We posit that this supervision is already created implicitly during routine reporting, as radiologists frequently place 2D annotations (e.g., distance measurement, arrows) on key images to make measurements and to support report interpretation. We introduce an automated pipeline that converts these routine clinical annotations into large-scale phrase-region supervision for 3D visual grounding. The pipeline links each annotation to the corresponding finding in the report through metadata matching, then uses a promptable 3D segmentation model to convert the 2D annotation into a volumetric mask. This produces phrase-mask-volume datasets without requiring additional radiologist annotation. Applied to a single institution's clinical picture archiving and communication system (PACS), our approach generated 105K phrase-mask-volume triplets from 59K abdominal CT exams. We also introduce two abdominal CT grounding benchmarks, LocusBench-Onc and LocusBench-ED, which comprise 240 oncology and 260 emergency-department radiologist-reviewed phrase-mask-volume triplets, respectively, with the latter spanning 13 distinct categories such as appendicitis, hematoma, and hernia. We further introduce LocusCT, a 3D visual grounding model trained on this dataset, which achieves hit rates of 0.725 on LocusBench-Onc and 0.773 on LocusBench-ED, substantially outperforming comparator models. These results show that routine PACS annotations are a scalable, previously unused source of supervision for 3D visual grounding.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种自动化流水线，将放射科医生日常在PACS中的2D标注转化为大规模3D短语-区域监督数据，生成105K三元组，并构建基准与模型LocusCT。
AI.motivation: 3D CT视觉定位对放射工作流有价值，但训练需要大量短语-区域配对数据，人工标注成本高昂。作者认为这种监督在常规报告过程中已被隐式创建（如距离测量、箭头等2D标注）。
AI.method: 构建自动化流水线：通过元数据匹配将每个标注与报告中的相应发现关联，再用可提示3D分割模型将2D标注转化为体积掩码，从而无需额外放射科标注即生成短语-掩码-体积数据集。
AI.result: 在单机构PACS上，从59K腹部CT检查生成105K三元组；构建LocusBench-Onc（240例肿瘤）和LocusBench-ED（260例急诊，涵盖13类如阑尾炎、血肿、疝）两个基准；训练模型LocusCT在二者命中率分别为0.725和0.773，显著优于对照模型。
AI.conclusion: 常规PACS标注是3D视觉定位的一种可扩展、此前未被利用的监督来源。

title: ALoDLM: Adaptively Looped Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable fast generation by predicting multiple tokens in parallel, but their practical adoption remains limited by a persistent quality gap relative to comparably sized autoregressive (AR) models. We attribute this gap to a computation-difficulty mismatch: within a partially observed sequence, some unknown tokens are easy to predict, while others require substantially more computation. Existing DLMs nevertheless apply uniform computational depth to all unknown positions at each denoising step. We introduce ALoDLM, which replaces uniform computation with token-adaptive latent recurrence. At each denoising step, ALoDLM iteratively refines latent representations and allocates computation according to token difficulty. Tokens ready to commit are fed back as discrete context, while unresolved tokens retain and further refine their latent states through additional recurrent passes. To learn token prediction and computation allocation jointly, we formulate token-wise computation schedules as latent variables and derive a conditional negative evidence lower bound (NELBO). We train ALoDLM at 1.7B and 8B parameter scales. Across eleven benchmarks, ALoDLM outperforms all evaluated DLMs and the corresponding AR baselines in average benchmark score at both scales. ALoDLM also retains fast parallel decoding, yielding a strong quality-efficiency trade-off among evaluated autoregressive and diffusion models under optimized inference engines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ALoDLM，用token自适应的潜在循环计算替代扩散语言模型中的均匀计算分配，缩小了扩散模型与自回归模型的质量差距，并在1.7B和8B规模上取得更优的质量-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）虽能并行预测多个token实现快速生成，但与同规模自回归（AR）模型相比始终存在质量差距。作者认为该差距源于"计算-难度不匹配"：在部分可观测序列中，部分未知token易于预测，而另一些需要更多计算，但现有DLM在每个去噪步骤对所有未知位置施加统一的计算深度。
AI.method: 提出ALoDLM，以token自适应的潜在循环（latent recurrence）取代均匀计算。每个去噪步骤中，模型迭代细化潜在表示，并按token难度分配计算量：已可确定（ready to commit）的token作为离散上下文反馈，未解决的token保留并进一步细化其潜在状态，通过额外的循环传递。为联合学习token预测与计算分配，将token级别的计算调度建模为潜变量，并推导条件负证据下界（NELBO）。在1.7B和8B参数规模上训练。
AI.result: 在十一个基准测试上，ALoDLM在两个参数规模上的平均基准得分均超过了所有被评估的DLM以及相应的AR基线。同时保持了快速并行解码能力，在优化推理引擎下，于所评估的自回归与扩散模型中实现了较强的质量-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过token自适应的潜在循环计算与基于条件NELBO的联合学习，ALoDLM有效缓解了计算-难度不匹配问题，弥合了扩散语言模型与自回归模型之间的质量差距，兼具高质量与高效并行解码能力。

title: Adopting InnerSource in a Public Sector Organization: A Case Study
summary: InnerSource (IS) is increasingly viewed as a way to improve large-scale software development. However, evidence on its adoption in public sector organizations remains limited. This paper reports a study of IS adoption in a Swedish Public Sector Organization. Drawing on nine semi-structured interviews and an internal workshop with 13 participants, we examine motivations, challenges, and improvement strategies for IS adoption. The results show that the main motivations are improving reuse, strengthening cross-team collaboration, and enabling faster and more cost-efficient development. Key challenges relate to a lack of an open culture and mindset, management of reusable assets (e.g., ownership, documentation, and code visibility), and ways of working (e.g., siloed practices and limited time for contributions). The study also identified improvements to address challenges, including fostering an enabling culture and mindset for IS and knowledge sharing, strengthening management support, and establishing internal platforms and governance for reusable assets.

AI.tldr: 本文对瑞典某公共部门组织采用内部开源（InnerSource）的动因、挑战与改进策略进行了实证研究，基于九次半结构化访谈和一次13人内部研讨会，发现主要动因是提升复用、加强跨团队协作和实现更快更省成本的开发，主要挑战包括缺乏开放文化与思维、可复用资产管理及工作方式问题，并提出相应改进措施。
AI.motivation: 内部开源被视为改善大规模软件开发的有效途径，但其在公共部门组织中的应用证据仍然有限，因此本文旨在补充这一研究空白。
AI.method: 采用定性案例研究方法，针对瑞典某公共部门组织开展九次半结构化访谈，并举行一次有13名参与者参加的内部研讨会，围绕内部开源采用的动因、挑战与改进策略进行分析。
AI.result: 主要动因包括提升复用、加强跨团队协作以及实现更快、更具成本效益的开发；主要挑战涉及缺乏开放的文化与思维、可复用资产管理（如归属、文档和代码可见性）以及工作方式（如孤岛式实践、贡献时间有限）；研究还识别出若干改进措施，包括培育有利于内部开源和知识共享的文化与思维、强化管理支持、建立内部平台与可复用资产治理机制。
AI.conclusion: 内部开源在公共部门组织中具有提升开发效率和协作水平的潜力，但其成功采用依赖于文化与思维转变、管理支持以及平台与治理机制的建设。

title: Invisible Ink, Visible Lies: How Production Watermarking Causes LLMs to Hallucinate
summary: Text watermarking helps identify AI-generated content, but its effect on factual reliability remains underexplored. In this paper, we study watermarking hallucination: factual errors induced or amplified by watermarking even when the required evidence is present in the context and the unwatermarked model can answer correctly. Using a controlled retrieval-augmented generation setting, we compare unwatermarked and watermarked generations under the same context, query, and decoding configuration, and quantify their factual accuracy decrease. Across six representative watermarking methods, including KGW, SWEET, DiPmark, GumbelSoft, Gumbel-Max, and SynthID watermarking, we consistently observe watermark-induced hallucination. Watermarked outputs can remain fluent while introducing factual errors. We attribute this failure mode to two mechanisms: (1) token perturbations in the current-step arising from method-specific reweighting or keyed sampling, and (2) prefix-induced attention drift, which accumulates through autoregressive decoding and weakens later attention to the factual context. Motivated by this analysis, we propose two plug-in interventions at the token and attention levels that can be integrated into existing watermarking methods to improve factuality. At a matched TPR of 0.90 at 1% FPR, combining the two interventions reduces factual errors by approximately 90% relative to watermark-only decoding while preserving fluency and comparable decoding efficiency. Overall, this work highlights factuality as a first-class criterion in watermark evaluation, alongside detectability and robustness, and calls for careful factuality validation before deploying watermarks in fact-critical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文研究文本水印对事实可靠性的负面影响，提出"水印幻觉"现象并给出两种插件式干预方法。
AI.motivation: 水印用于识别AI生成内容，但其对事实可靠性的影响尚未被充分研究，作者希望揭示水印可能引入或放大事实错误这一问题。
AI.method: 在受控的检索增强生成（RAG）设置中，对比同上下文、同查询、同解码配置下未加水印与加水印的生成结果，评估六种代表性水印方法（KGW、SWEET、DiPmark、GumbelSoft、Gumbel-Max、SynthID），分析其事实准确率下降，并提出token级与注意力级两种插件式干预。
AI.result: 普遍观察到水印诱导的幻觉：输出仍流畅但出现事实错误。归因于两类机制——当前步token扰动与前缀诱导的注意力漂移。在TPR=0.90、FPR=1%条件下，两种干预结合使事实错误减少约90%，同时保持流畅性与相当的解码效率。
AI.conclusion: 水印评估应将事实性视为与可检测性、鲁棒性同等重要的一等标准，在事实敏感应用中部署水印前需进行事实性验证。

title: Understanding and Mitigating Hallucination Escape in Tool-Using LLM Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly serve as autonomous agents that invoke external tools. However, this capability introduces tool hallucination, selecting incorrect tools or generating invalid calls. Existing mitigation methods report substantial improvements, yet we identify a previously overlooked failure mode that we term Hallucination Escape. These methods reduce hallucination on the tool configuration they are tuned on but increase it on other configurations, canceling out the gain. We further investigate this phenomenon and find that hallucination rises sharply when a model's intrinsic tool-use tendencies conflict with the current tool configuration, and that existing methods reinforce rather than suppress these tendencies, which in turn contributes to hallucination escape. Building on these findings, we propose EscapeGuard, a training-free inference-time method that combines conflict-aware gating with configuration-derived attention enhancement to mitigate tool hallucination while preventing hallucination escape. Across six benchmarks on various models, EscapeGuard reduces tool-selection hallucination by 9.0 pp and suppresses hallucination escape, lowering the cross-configuration mean by 23.7 pp and achieving an 89.1% net improvement in paired-query evaluation. We hope this work can encourage evaluation beyond a single tool configuration and pave the way for more reliable tool-using LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文识别出工具幻觉缓解中的新失效模式"幻觉逃逸"（Hallucination Escape），并提出免训练的推理时方法 EscapeGuard 来解决它。
AI.motivation: LLM 作为自主智能体调用外部工具时会产生工具幻觉（选错工具或生成无效调用）。现有缓解方法虽报告大幅改进，但存在一个被忽视的失效模式：这些方法在调优过的工具配置上减少幻觉，却在其他配置上增加幻觉，导致增益被抵消。
AI.method: 作者进一步分析发现，当模型内在的工具使用倾向与当前工具配置冲突时幻觉急剧上升，而现有方法反而强化而非抑制这些倾向，从而促成了幻觉逃逸。基于此，提出 EscapeGuard：一种免训练的推理时方法，结合冲突感知门控（conflict-aware gating）与配置派生注意力增强（configuration-derived attention enhancement）。
AI.result: 在多种模型的六个基准上，EscapeGuard 将工具选择幻觉降低 9.0 个百分点，并抑制幻觉逃逸，使跨配置均值降低 23.7 个百分点，在配对查询评估中实现 89.1% 的净改进。
AI.conclusion: 作者希望该工作能推动超越单一工具配置的评估，并为更可靠的工具使用 LLM 智能体铺平道路。

title: Where Does the Semantic Gain Come From? A Reproduction and Extension of Semantic Knowledge-driven Contrastive Learning for Long-Tailed Recognition
summary: Semantic Knowledge-driven Contrastive Learning (SKCL) uses a language model to decide which classes are related, and pulls each image towards the prototypes of its semantic neighbours. On CIFAR-100-LT (beta = 100) it reports 54.02% top-1 accuracy, 2.01 points above Balanced Contrastive Learning (BCL), the method it builds on. The code and the class descriptions are not public. I reimplement SKCL, BCL and ConCutMix in one framework, check it against the public baseline code, and run every configuration with three seeds. The two baselines reproduce within 1.5 points, but SKCL built on BCL, as the paper describes it, ends up 0.56 points below BCL. To find out why, I add SKCL to the authors' own ConCutMix code. Trained for the paper's 300 epochs, it reaches 53.69, only 0.33 below the published number. At the same budget, however, the semantic graph adds just 0.23 points over ConCutMix, while training ConCutMix for 100 more epochs adds 1.04. Together with ConCutMix's published lead over BCL (1.15), this explains the claimed gain. A BCL model that never sees the graph already shares 41.2% of the graph's top-2 neighbours with its own most-confused classes (2.0% by chance), which shows why the graph adds so little on these benchmarks. I also test several changes to SKCL. Combining it with the CutMix branch improves it by 1.06 points, and an adaptive version of the graph improves it slightly (+0.34 and +0.28 in two codebases), although these gains are within seed noise.
