AI.tldr: 复现SKCL发现其增益主要来自基线选择与训练预算差异，而非语义图本身。
AI.motivation: SKCL声称语义知识驱动的对比学习比BCL提升2.01个百分点，但代码与类描述未公开，需独立复现验证其真实增益来源。
AI.method: 在同一框架中重实现SKCL、BCL和ConCutMix，与公开基线代码校验，每配置跑3个种子；将SKCL加入作者自己的ConCutMix代码；分析BCL模型与语义图邻居的一致性。
AI.result: SKCL基于BCL比BCL低0.56个百分点；加入ConCutMix后300轮达53.69，仅比发表值低0.33；同预算下语义图仅加0.23，而多训练100轮加1.04；BCL与图top-2邻居重叠41.2%（随机2.0%）；结合CutMix分支提升1.06，自适应图仅+0.34和+0.28且在种子噪声内。
AI.conclusion: SKCL的表面增益可由ConCutMix基线领先与更长训练预算解释，语义图在基准上贡献有限。

title: Fine-Tuning VLM for Enhancing AI's Spatial Intelligence: Understanding 3D and 2D Rotations
summary: Spatial intelligence is a fundamental skill in multiple domains, such as Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM), Medicine, Architecture, and Construction. Recent studies indicate that Vision-Language Models (VLMs) still face limitations in spatial reasoning, which inhibits artificial intelligence (AI) from performing practical spatial tasks. Using multiple object-rotation datasets developed for training and evaluation, our experiments demonstrated promising improvements in both 2D and 3D rotation detection. Fine-tuned Google DeepMind-built Gemma-4 mixture-of-experts (MoE) models significantly outperformed fine-tuned Gemma-4 generalist models in predicting rotations defined by both their axes and angles. Fine-tuning also substantially improved angle estimation for 2D representation without requiring an explicit coordinate system. Furthermore, identifiable objects did not improve angle-detection accuracy; instead, objects with prominent linear features showed improved performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过微调 Gemma-4 的 MoE 模型与通用模型，在 2D 和 3D 物体旋转检测任务上取得改进，MoE 模型在轴与角度预测上显著优于通用模型。
AI.motivation: 空间智能在 STEM、医学、建筑与建造等领域至关重要，而现有视觉语言模型在空间推理上仍有局限，制约了 AI 执行实际空间任务的能力。
AI.method: 使用多个专为训练与评估设计的物体旋转数据集，对 Google DeepMind 构建的 Gemma-4 MoE 模型与通用模型分别进行微调，并对比其在 2D 与 3D 旋转检测中的表现。
AI.result: 微调后的 Gemma-4 MoE 模型在依据轴和角度定义的旋转预测上显著优于微调的通用模型；微调也大幅提升了 2D 表示下的角度估计（无需显式坐标系）；可识别物体并未提高角度检测准确率，而具有显著线性特征的物体表现更好。
AI.conclusion: MoE 架构结合微调可有效提升 VLM 的空间旋转推理能力，且角度检测更依赖线性几何特征而非物体语义可识别性，为改进 AI 空间智能提供了方向。

title: Mechanizing the User's Eye: Pre-Registered Deployment of a Sabotage-Validated Fail-Plausible Observer in a Production LLM Agent Runtime
comment: Follow-up to arXiv:2606.14589. 20 pages, 4 figures. Labeled incident corpus, detector source, sabotage-validation harness, and pre-registration texts publicly available at https://github.com/bisdom-cell/openclaw-model-bridge
summary: A prior longitudinal study of silent failures in a production LLM agent runtime (arXiv:2606.14589) found that about 70% were discovered by a human looking at the product as a user while thousands of tests and governance checks stayed green, and posed mechanizing part of what the human eye does as an open problem. This paper reports our attempt. We built an automated user-viewpoint observer targeting the most dangerous class, fail-plausible failure, in which an internal error becomes fluent, plausible output to the user. It is a two-layer pipeline: five deterministic signals distilled from incident postmortems escalate to an LLM judge whose verdicts must cite verbatim evidence or be discarded. Ground truth is 24 labeled production postmortems with explicit honesty boundaries: 16 of 24 are structurally invisible to any content-reading observer, and we say so. Offline, the deterministic layer achieves 6/6 regression detection with 0/4 false positives, each detector proven load-bearing by sabotage; held-out recall on novel patterns is 0/4. It is, so far, a regression engine. Deployment followed pre-registration: shadow mode caught and retired one systematic false positive on its first run, the 26-day shadow window then ran clean, flip criteria were fixed before the shadow data was read, and the analysis protocol was frozen before the enforcing-mode window opened. That window (12 observed days) fired zero verdicts; per the pre-registered path we report live precision as undefined rather than narrating quiet as success. The observer also produced ten silent failures of its own, confirming that the judge inherits the taxonomy it judges. We release the corpus, detector, and scorecard as a runnable bench: mechanization today retires the human's regression scanning so the eye can specialize in novelty; prediction remains open but is now measurable under frozen rules.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个自动化"用户视角观察器"，用五条确定性信号加LLM裁判（判决须引用原文证据）来检测LLM智能体运行时中最危险的"看似合理型失败"。离线回归检测6/6命中、0假阳性，但对新模式召回0/4；预注册部署后影子期干净、强制期12天零判决，作者如实报告"实时精确率未定义"而非粉饰为成功。
AI.motivation: 先前关于生产环境LLM智能体运行时"静默失败"的纵向研究发现，约70%的失败是人类以用户身份查看产品时发现的，而数千项测试与治理检查全部通过。论文将此——即把人类肉眼所做的部分工作机械化——作为开放问题，尝试给出一个自动化方案，重点针对最危险的一类失败：内部错误被转化为流畅、看似合理的用户可见输出（fail-plausible failure）。
AI.method: 采用两层流水线：第一层是从事故复盘中提炼的五条确定性信号，第二层是LLM裁判，其判决必须逐字引用证据，否则被丢弃。真值来自24份带明确"诚实边界"标注的生产事故复盘，其中16/24在结构上对任何"读内容"的观察器都不可见，作者明确承认这一点。部署遵循预注册流程：影子模式、校正判据预先固定、分析协议在强制模式窗口开启前冻结。
AI.result: 离线阶段确定性层实现6/6回归检测、0/4假阳性，每个检测器通过"破坏测试"证明其不可或缺；对新颖模式的留出召回为0/4。部署中，影子模式首轮即捕获并淘汰一个系统性假阳性，随后26天影子窗口运行无异常；强制模式窗口（12个观测日）触发零判决，按预注册路径将实时精确率报告为"未定义"，而非把安静叙述为成功。观察器自身也产生了十次静默失败，说明裁判继承了它所评判的分类体系。作者发布了语料、检测器与评分卡作为可运行的bench。
AI.conclusion: 当前的机械化只能替代人类的"回归扫描"工作，使人的肉眼得以专注于新颖性；失败预测仍未解决，但在冻结规则下已变得可度量。该工作以高度诚实的方式界定了自动化观察器的能力边界，并将自身缺陷（包括十次静默失败）一并公开。

title: Bounded Reasoning: Cognitive Hierarchy in Human-versus-AI Cyber Defense
comment: 9 pages, accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Human-AI Coevolution (HAIC)
summary: Human-agent evaluations often compress interaction into a single performance score, even when human and automated policies adapt differently over time. We study this in a sequential cyber-defense game on an attack graph, where a human or reinforcement-learning defender protects cloud assets against a Deep Q-Network (DQN) attacker. We compare four defender settings: a human reward-only game operationalizing the DQN information structure, a human reward-plus-transition game operationalizing the Cognitive Hierarchy Theory-driven DQN (CHT-DQN) information structure, an automated DQN defender, and an automated CHT-DQN defender. In the reward-only game, participants receive payoff and reward feedback. In the reward-plus-transition game, they also see attacker-aware transition probabilities from the CHT-DQN model. Across 80 Mechanical Turk participants and matched automated simulations, human defenders adapted to outcomes in a way the automated defenders did not: they were more likely to reselect a node after a successful defense than after a failure, in both games, an asymmetry we interpret as consistent with Prospect Theory and Cumulative Prospect Theory. The 40-round average also mixes early rounds, where the DQN attacker acts mostly at random, with late rounds, where it mostly exploits; in the final stage, mean protection ranks the reward-plus-transition human game above the reward-only human game, then the automated CHT-DQN defender, then the automated DQN defender, an ordering the overall mean hides. By contrast, the reward-plus-transition game does not produce a statistically reliable overall gain in weighted data protection over the reward-only game. These results suggest that evaluating human-agent cyber-defense systems only by an averaged task score can miss behaviorally meaningful differences in adaptation, action allocation, and bounded human reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过序贯网络防御博弈发现，仅用单一平均分数评估人机交互会掩盖防御者随时间变化的适应性差异，人（而非自动化策略）在成功防御后更倾向重选同一节点，且后期阶段防护排名与总体均值不同。
AI.motivation: 现有的人机（human-agent）评估常将交互压缩为单一性能分数，但人类与自动化策略在时间维度上的适应方式可能不同，这种压缩会掩盖行为上有意义的差异。本文以云资产防护的序贯网络防御博弈为场景，考察这一问题。
AI.method: 在攻击图上构建序贯网络防御博弈，防御方为人或强化学习者，攻击方为DQN（及其认知层级理论驱动的CHT-DQN）。比较四种防御设置：仅奖励的人类游戏（对应DQN信息结构）、奖励+转移的人类游戏（对应CHT-DQN信息结构，额外显示攻击者感知的转移概率）、自动化DQN防御者、自动化CHT-DQN防御者。共80名Mechanical Turk参与者与匹配的自动化模拟，进行40轮。
AI.result: 人类防御者在两种游戏中均表现出与自动化防御者不同的结果适应性：成功防御后比失败后更可能重选同一节点（该不对称性与前景理论及累积前景理论一致）。40轮平均混合了早期（DQN攻击者近乎随机）与后期（主要利用）阶段；在最终阶段，平均防护水平的排名为：奖励+转移人类游戏 > 仅奖励人类游戏 > 自动化CHT-DQN > 自动化DQN，这一排序被总体均值掩盖。而奖励+转移游戏在加权数据防护上相比仅奖励游戏并未产生统计上可靠的总体增益。
AI.conclusion: 仅用平均任务分数评估人机网络防御系统，会遗漏适应性、动作分配和有界人类推理方面的行为性重要差异；评估应关注阶段性与过程性指标。

title: DV-Lens: Revealing the Functional Organization of Language Model Parameters
summary: Understanding parameter functions helps elucidate the internal mechanisms of large language models (LLMs). However, how to connect parameters from different modules to verifiable output effects and further characterize the relationship between their functional organization and model capability remains to be explored. To this end, we introduce the downstream vocabulary lens (DV-Lens), a parameter-level interpretability framework that links native parameter directions to their downstream vocabulary responses. Specifically, we first estimate module-specific downstream Jacobians over a reference prompt set for attention query, key, value, and output (Q/K/V/O) projections and feed-forward networks (FFNs). Second, we use these mappings to project native parameter columns into the final vocabulary space, obtaining signed readouts that characterize their average local output responses. Third, we group parameter columns by their vocabulary readouts and introduce downstream vocabulary complexity (DV-Complexity), which quantifies within-group structural variation using normalized reconstruction residuals of the original weights. At the parameter level, randomized controls and finite-difference tests show that DV-Lens readouts capture non-random vocabulary structure and predict local logit changes with 98.0% coordinate-orientation agreement across 720 cases from nine models. These readouts further guide parameter ablation, steering, and swapping across 21 models, shifting target-token probabilities in the predicted directions under controlled conditions. At the model level, the joint-parameter score of DV-Complexity achieves a Spearman correlation of 0.904 with benchmark-based capability rankings across 48 language models. Together, these results provide intervention-based evidence for DV-Lens interpretations and reveal an association between DV-Complexity and model capability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DV-Lens参数级可解释性框架，将原生参数方向映射到下游词表响应，并通过DV-Complexity刻画功能组织与模型能力的关系。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏将不同模块参数连接到可验证输出效果的方法，也未能刻画参数功能组织与模型能力之间的关系，因此需要构建参数级可解释性框架。
AI.method: 首先在参考提示集上估计Q/K/V/O投影与FFN的模块级下游雅可比矩阵；再用这些映射把原生参数列投影到最终词表空间，得到带符号的读数；最后按词表读数对参数列分组，并引入DV-Complexity，用原始权重的归一化重构残差量化组内结构变异。
AI.result: 随机对照与有限差分测试表明DV-Lens读数捕捉到非随机词表结构，在9个模型的720个案例中以98.0%的坐标方向一致性预测局部logit变化；读数进一步指导21个模型的参数消融、引导与交换，在受控条件下按预测方向改变目标token概率；DV-Complexity的联合参数得分与48个语言模型的基准能力排名达到0.904的Spearman相关。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为DV-Lens解释提供了基于干预的证据，并揭示了DV-Complexity与模型能力之间的关联。

title: From Sight to Foresight: Predictive Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Predicting future spatial states supports collision avoidance and timely decision-making in dynamic environments. However, existing vision-language models (VLMs) and benchmarks for spatial reasoning primarily focus on observed scenes, leaving predictive spatial reasoning beyond the observed interval underexplored. To this end, we introduce SpatialMind, a metric-scale VLM for spatial reasoning and future prediction. Its metric depth adapter anchors spatial reasoning to real-world scale, while its progressive state chain establishes current spatial states and observed dynamics as the foundation for future prediction. Given a video prefix, SpatialMind predicts distances, motion directions, and spatial relations in both observed and unseen future frames. For training and evaluation, we build a scalable data engine that grounds entity descriptions in metric geometry to generate question-answer pairs and state supervision. Using this engine, we construct the SpatialMind-30K dataset and the SpatialMind-2K benchmark, both covering driving and everyday egocentric scenes. The benchmark spans eight tasks across three levels: current-state understanding, observed-dynamics understanding, and future prediction. Experiments show that SpatialMind substantially outperforms both general and spatially specialized models on our benchmark while achieving competitive zero-shot performance on VSI-Bench, OSI-Bench, and VLM4D.

AI.tldr: 提出 SpatialMind，一个度量尺度的视觉语言模型，用于空间推理与未来预测，并配套构建数据集与基准，覆盖当前状态、观测动态与未来预测三个层次。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型与空间推理基准主要聚焦已观测场景，忽视了超出观测区间的预测性空间推理，而预测未来空间状态对动态环境中的避障与及时决策至关重要。
AI.method: SpatialMind 通过度量深度适配器将空间推理锚定到真实世界尺度，并通过渐进式状态链将当前空间状态与观测动态作为未来预测的基础。给定视频前缀，模型预测已观测帧与未见未来帧中的距离、运动方向与空间关系。同时构建可扩展数据引擎，将实体描述锚定到度量几何以生成问答对与状态监督，据此构建 SpatialMind-30K 数据集与 SpatialMind-2K 基准。
AI.result: 在 SpatialMind-2K 基准上，SpatialMind 显著优于通用模型与空间专用模型，并在 VSI-Bench、OSI-Bench 与 VLM4D 上取得有竞争力的零样本性能。
AI.conclusion: SpatialMind 将度量尺度空间推理与未来预测相结合，配合数据集与多层级基准，推动了超出观测区间的预测性空间推理研究。

title: TCMClinicalReason-Bench: Can Language Models Reason from Pathogenesis to Prescription over Real-World Clinical Cases?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate clinical narratives that are insufficiently grounded in patient-specific evidence. In traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), errors can propagate from etiology and pathogenesis through syndrome diagnosis and treatment principles to prescription generation. We developed TCMClinicalReason-Bench using 2,000 multicenter electronic health record cases to distinguish case-grounded responses from fluent but unsupported diagnostic and therapeutic conclusions. Five general-purpose and two TCM-specific LLMs were evaluated in zero-shot settings. An evidence-constrained rubric assessed seven diagnostic and therapeutic components and three cross-block relations, allowing case-supported alternatives. Qwen3.7-Plus with TCM retrieval served as the automated judge, alongside parallel blinded ratings by five senior TCM clinicians on a 600-case subset. Structural completeness was nearly saturated (99.3-100.0%), but normalized content scores ranged from 40.7% to 54.1%. The five general-purpose models averaged 50.0%, versus 41.3% for the two smaller TCM-specific models. Cross-block logic consistency ranged from 60.8% to 66.8% and correlated moderately with content across cases (Pearson's r = 0.515-0.656). Deficits were greatest in prescription generation, prescription analysis, and symptom-guided modification. In judge stress testing on 100 independent cases, perturbation detection rates across the three relations were 57%, 56%, and 31%, with contradictions detected more reliably than omissions. Separating component quality from cross-block consistency localizes failures missed by endpoint and completeness metrics and identifies where clinician oversight remains necessary.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了TCMClinicalReason-Bench，用2000份多中心电子病历评估9个LLM（5个通用、2个中医专用）的中医临床推理能力，发现结构完整性接近饱和但内容接地性不足，处方生成等环节缺陷最大。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的中医临床叙述常缺乏患者特异性证据支撑，错误会从病因病机逐级传播到证候诊断、治则和处方。传统端点式与完整性指标无法识别这类"流畅但无依据"的结论，需要细粒度的评估框架来定位失败环节。
AI.method: 构建TCMClinicalReason-Bench，使用2000份多中心电子病历。在零样本设置下评估5个通用LLM和2个中医专用LLM。采用证据约束型评分量表，评估7个诊断与治疗组件及3个跨模块关系，允许病例支持的替代答案。以Qwen3.7-Plus结合中医检索作为自动评判，并由5位资深中医临床医生对600份子集进行平行盲评。另在100份独立病例上做评判压力测试。
AI.result: 结构完整性接近饱和（99.3%-100.0%），但归一化内容得分仅40.7%-54.1%。5个通用模型平均50.0%，两个较小的中医专用模型为41.3%。跨模块逻辑一致性60.8%-66.8%，与内容得分中度相关（Pearson's r=0.515-0.656）。缺陷最大的是处方生成、处方分析和症状引导调整。压力测试中三个关系的扰动检出率分别为57%、56%、31%，矛盾比遗漏更易检出。
AI.conclusion: 将组件质量与跨模块一致性分离，可定位被端点指标和完整性指标遗漏的失败，并明确仍需临床医生监督的环节。

title: From Trust-by-Design to Continuous Trust in the Era of Artificial Intelligence
comment: 9 pages, 16 figures, submitted to the PoEM 2026 Forum as part of the 19th IFIP WG 8.1 Working Conference on the Practice of Enterprise Modeling (PoEM 2026), December 1-3, 2026, Mytilene, Lesvos, Greece
summary: Trust is crucial in the digital world, particularly in the age of systems based on artificial intelligence. Traditionally, system correctness is demonstrated by proving that the system satisfies the required properties. However, digital systems involve humans, who can make mistakes, break rules, or even intentionally cheat the system. Technical devices may also malfunction or cause errors. Therefore, external stakeholders need to trust a system throughout its operation. To address this challenge, we propose the concept of continuous trust. In this paper, we present a detailed explanation of this concept, based on a running example of a business's refund department. The paper concludes with a discussion of related work, such as compliance checking and certification, as well as an outlook on further questions regarding the formalization and the necessary tool support.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"持续信任"（continuous trust）概念，以企业退款部门为例详细阐释，并讨论合规检查、认证等相关工作及形式化与工具支持的未来方向。
AI.motivation: 数字世界尤其是人工智能系统中，信任至关重要。传统上系统正确性通过证明其满足所需属性来体现，但数字系统涉及可能犯错、违规甚至欺骗的人，技术设备也可能故障或出错，因此外部利益相关者需要在系统整个运行过程中持续信任系统。
AI.method: 提出"持续信任"概念，并基于一个企业退款部门的运行案例对该概念进行详细阐述。
AI.result: 给出了"持续信任"概念的详细解释，说明其在系统运行全过程中对外部利益相关者信任建立的作用。
AI.conclusion: 论文最后讨论了合规检查与认证等相关工作，并展望了关于形式化及必要工具支持的进一步问题。

title: WLPA: A Network Management Framework for Allocating Scarce Quantum-Safe Link Postures under Weakest-Link Exposure
comment: Network resource management; Quantum-safe network design; Post-quantum migration; Cloud and cluster network operations; Quantum key distribution; Security allocation algorithms; Zero Trust architecture
summary: Network operators migrating distributed systems to post-quantum and quantum-safe cryptography face a resource-management problem: quantum key distribution (QKD) gives the strongest guarantee available but is hardware-scarce and costly, so only a fraction of a deployment's links can receive it. Default practice -- ranking links by traffic or centrality and upgrading the top scorers -- optimizes each link in isolation, while a distributed job's real security is set by whichever active link ends up weakest. We present WLPA (Weakest-Link Posture Assignment), an implementation-ready decision framework and algorithm for allocating scarce quantum-safe postures under hardware, latency, and compliance constraints. WLPA computes the optimal weakest-link posture in closed form and returns an assignment in O(|E| log |E|) time -- 125 ms for a 20,000-link network on a laptop -- with a breach-aware refinement matching an exact integer program under common conditions. Our central contribution is a dichotomy telling operators exactly when existing per-link heuristics already match this optimum and when they systematically fail: under constant upgrade cost and uniform traffic-driven risk the two coincide exactly; once costs vary or an adversary concentrates on weak targets, heuristics leave the weakest link unprotected, unboundedly. We validate WLPA across 19 experiments: four microservice topologies, a real enterprise network (SNAP email-Eu-core), a post-quantum latency benchmark, a Qiskit BB84 simulation and a real-hardware BB84 run on IBM's ibm_marrakesh processor, checks against real production traffic traces, a CVE-calibrated correlated-compromise study, Bayesian uncertainty quantification, and seven baseline methods. A concrete-security reduction grounds the framework as theoretical foundation, not primary contribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WLPA（最弱环节姿态分配）决策框架与算法，用于在硬件、时延和合规约束下分配稀缺的量子安全/后量子密码资源，通过闭式求解最优最弱环节姿态并在O(|E| log |E|)时间内完成分配，核心贡献是揭示启发式方法与最优解何时一致、何时系统性失效的二分定理。
AI.motivation: 网络运营商在将分布式系统迁移到后量子与量子安全密码学时面临资源管理难题：QKD安全性最强但硬件稀缺且昂贵，只有少数链路能获得。默认做法（按流量或中心性对链路排序并升级高分者）孤立地优化每条链路，而分布式作业的真实安全性由最弱的活跃链路决定，因此需要一种从"最弱环节"视角出发的分配方法。
AI.method: 提出WLPA算法：以闭式形式计算最优最弱环节姿态，在O(|E| log |E|)时间内返回分配（2万链路网络笔记本上耗时125 ms），并加入违规感知（breach-aware）的细化步骤，在常见条件下可匹配精确整数规划。同时给出一个具体安全性归约作为理论基础，并通过19组实验进行验证：包括四个微服务拓扑、真实企业网络、后量子时延基准、Qiskit BB84仿真与IBM真实硬件BB84运行、真实生产流量追踪、CVE校准的相关性泄密研究、贝叶斯不确定性量化以及七种基线方法。
AI.result: WLPA在2万链路网络上仅需125 ms即可完成分配，其违规感知细化在常见条件下匹配精确整数规划。核心二分定理表明：在升级成本恒定且风险由统一流量驱动时，逐链路启发式与最优解完全一致；一旦成本变化或对手集中攻击弱点，启发式会无限度地使最弱链路失去保护。实验覆盖19项，验证了框架的有效性与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: WLPA是一个可直接落地的决策框架，帮助运营商在量子安全资源稀缺时以最弱环节为优化目标进行分配，并明确了现有逐链路启发式何时已足够、何时会系统性失败。

title: Emoji-Emotion Ranking System Using Twitter Data
summary: Nowadays, emojis are often replacing words. Yet computational systems still oversimplify them. Most existing approaches treat emojis as static sentiment indicators and overlook their emotional distributions. In this study, we propose an emoji-aware emotion analysis framework based on a Twitter (X) dataset of 100,000 emoji-containing replies collected between 2020-2025. After preprocessing and text cleaning, we applied text-to-emotion classification to detect five primary emotions (Happy, Angry, Sad, Fear, and Surprise) for each message. By aggregating emotion scores across contexts in which each emoji appears, we estimate emoji-emotion association distributions and construct an emoji-emotion ranking system reflecting relative emotional dominance. Furthermore, we project emojis into the Russell valence-arousal space to enable continuous affective interpretation. Our results demonstrate that emojis exhibit probabilistic, context-sensitive emotional profiles rather than fixed sentiment polarities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于10万条含emoji推文回复的emoji情感分析框架，通过文本到情感分类、情感关联分布聚合及Russell价-唤醒空间投影，揭示emoji具有概率性、情境敏感的情感画像，而非固定情感极性。
AI.motivation: 现今emoji常被用来替代文字，但计算系统对它们的处理仍过于简化。多数现有方法把emoji当作静态情感指标，忽视了其情感分布特性。因此作者希望建立更细致的emoji情感分析框架。
AI.method: 构建基于Twitter（X）2020-2025年间10万条含emoji回复的数据集；经预处理和文本清洗后，对每条消息进行文本到情感分类，检测五种主要情感（Happy、Angry、Sad、Fear、Surprise）；通过聚合每个emoji出现语境中的情感得分，估计emoji-情感关联分布并构建情感排序系统以反映相对情感主导性；进而将emoji投影到Russell价-唤醒空间以实现连续情感解释。
AI.result: 结果表明，emoji展现出概率性、情境敏感的情感画像，而不是固定的情感极性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出并验证了一个emoji感知的情感分析框架，说明应以概率分布和连续情感空间来理解emoji的情感含义，而非简单的静态情感标签。

title: Watermarks and Fingerprints as Soft Bindings for Content Provenance: An Open-Licence Benchmark for Images, Audio and Video
comment: 59 pages. Code, recorded results and manuscript source: https://github.com/Original-Pictures/soft-bindings-benchmark (v1.0)
summary: Content-provenance standards such as C2PA let a platform recover a stripped manifest through a soft binding: an invisible watermark read from the content, or a fingerprint looked up in a registry. We benchmarked both families under one protocol, restricted to openly available models whose licences we audited, on public media, with false-match rates calibrated on held-out negatives and source-level bootstrap intervals for performance estimates. For watermarking we evaluated 25 image, 7 audio and 7 video configurations from 12 methods on perceptual quality, robustness, false positives and cost; for fingerprinting, 35 methods on registries of up to 98,985 images, partial edits and adversarial attacks. PixelSeal gave the best balance for image and video watermarks and AudioSeal for audio, but the error-correcting detector of every TrustMark variant fired on 5.9 to 15.3% of unmarked images, so a verifier should test the expected payload. Among fingerprints, copy detectors trained on non-commercial data detected up to 75.5% of transformed images at a pair-level false-match rate of $10^{-7}$ and DINOv2, the best permissively licensed method, 65.0%; near-copies in a product catalogue dominated the false matches, and no detection improvement from geometric verification was observed under a matched calibration false-binding constraint in the evaluated image pipelines. On the same attacked copies the two families failed differently: the union of watermark and fingerprint successes covered 69% of image copies; fingerprints covered more audio queries, whereas expected-key watermark verification covered more video queries. Embedding a watermark moved the ISCC code of 62.0% of images past its match threshold, and platform-dependent colour conversion changed watermark bits between x86 and ARM hosts.

AI.tldr: 该论文在同一协议下对软绑定（水印与指纹）两大内容溯源技术族进行了基准测试，覆盖图像、音频、视频多模态，审计了开源模型许可，并系统评估了质量、鲁棒性、误报与成本。
AI.motivation: C2PA等内容溯源标准允许平台在清单被剥离后通过软绑定（读取隐形水印或在注册库中检索指纹）恢复清单，但缺乏统一协议下的公开、可信基准，难以判断两族方法的实际性能与适用边界。
AI.method: 在统一协议下仅使用许可经审计的公开模型与公开媒体，误匹配率用留出负样本校准，性能估计采用源级bootstrap区间。水印方面评估12种方法的25种图像、7种音频、7种视频配置，考察感知质量、鲁棒性、误报与成本；指纹方面评估35种方法，注册库规模达98,985张图像，并测试局部编辑与对抗攻击。
AI.result: 水印中PixelSeal在图像与视频、AudioSeal在音频表现最佳，但所有TrustMark变体的纠错检测器在5.9%–15.3%未标记图像上误触发，验证方应测试预期载荷。指纹中非商用数据训练的拷贝检测器在成对误匹配率10⁻⁷下可检出高达75.5%的变换图像，许可最宽松的DINOv2为65.0%；产品目录中的近拷贝主导误匹配，几何验证在匹配校准约束下未见提升。两族失败模式不同：水印与指纹成功并集覆盖69%图像拷贝；指纹覆盖更多音频查询，预期密钥水印验证覆盖更多视频查询。嵌入水印使62.0%图像的ISCC编码越过匹配阈值，平台相关色彩转换会在x86与ARM主机间改变水印比特。
AI.conclusion: 水印与指纹在溯源上互补而非替代，需按模态与场景选择；水印纠错检测器需验证预期载荷以避免高误报，指纹性能受近拷贝与许可限制，且平台色彩转换与ISCC编码漂移是实际部署的关键风险点。

title: On the Steering Dimensionality of Refusal in Language Models
summary: Existing activation steering methods often assume that a high-level concept can be mediated by a single steering direction. To support this, two complementary interventions should be achieved: additive steering should induce the target behavior, while directional ablation should suppress it. Yet behaviors may occupy richer activation geometries beyond a single direction, and semantically similar behaviors may be represented by distinct directions. In this work, we study how many directions can reliably control two different types of refusal behaviors: refusal triggered by the safety alignment and refusal in general contexts. Given the limited expressive capability of a single steering vector, we study the general setting of steering subspaces and introduce the notion of steering dimensionality as the minimum subspace dimensionality required to reliably control a behavior. We characterize sufficient steering subspaces that cover the full extent of the target behavior through both the (monotonic) improvement before the sufficient dimensionality, and the saturation beyond it. Empirically, we find that refusal triggered by safety alignment is 1-dim steerable, while multiple distinct steering directions can achieve comparable control. In contrast, refusal in general contexts exhibits substantially richer activation geometry where even 5-dim steering subspaces fail to reliably capture its full steerable variation. Our results reveal that the activation geometry underlying refusal is highly context-dependent and can be substantially more complex than a single linear steering direction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究激活引导方向维度问题，提出"引导维度"概念，发现安全对齐触发的拒绝行为是1维可引导的，而一般语境下的拒绝行为激活几何更复杂，即便5维子空间也难以可靠捕捉。
AI.motivation: 现有激活引导方法通常假设高层概念可由单一引导方向中介，但行为可能占据更丰富的激活几何结构，且语义相似的行为可能由不同方向表示。作者希望探究控制不同类型拒绝行为所需的方向数量。
AI.method: 针对两类拒绝行为——安全对齐触发的拒绝与一般语境下的拒绝，研究更一般的引导子空间设定，引入"引导维度"概念（可靠控制某行为所需的最小子空间维度），并通过充分维度前的单调提升与超出后的饱和来刻画充分引导子空间。
AI.result: 实验发现安全对齐触发的拒绝是1维可引导的，多个不同引导方向均可实现相当的控制效果；而一般语境下的拒绝行为激活几何远更丰富，即使5维引导子空间也无法可靠捕捉其全部可引导变化。
AI.conclusion: 拒绝行为背后的激活几何高度依赖语境，可能远比单一线性引导方向复杂，这对激活引导方法的单方向假设提出了挑战。

title: AgentSpy: Making AI Agent Behavior Observable
summary: AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) run shell commands, read and write files, and reach the network, typically with their user's privileges. However, what an agent does during an execution is difficult to understand: tests assert on the result, and the agent's trajectory records only what the agent reports about itself, which may omit behavior executed by its subprocesses. We present AgentSpy, an approach that observes an agent from outside the agent. AgentSpy runs the agent in an isolated environment, configured by a declarative specification, and records the system calls and network traffic of the agent and of every process it executes. Based on this monitoring, AgentSpy supports two families of analyses: conformance analyses, which measure obligations, i.e., what an agent execution should do, and safety analyses, which check prohibitions, i.e., what an agent execution must never do. We instantiate one analysis of each family. The reliability analysis uses rules to summarize each run by the environment resources the agent uses: the commands it executed, the files it accessed, and the hosts it contacted. The security analysis applies deterministic rules to the system calls of an execution. For reliability, we evaluated AgentSpy on 77 tasks with the codex harness and three recent LLMs, executing each task three times. Sets of repeated runs of the same task are more similar than sets that include runs of another task in 92.2% of the comparisons. Among tasks for which all three runs pass outcome-based tests, the agent performs task-unrelated activities in 18% of the cases, reads the grading files in 7%, and does not use the developers' guidance in 17%. For security, the generic rules of AgentSpy detect four of five attack categories we considered, with no false positives across 50 runs.

AI.tldr: AgentSpy 通过在隔离环境中从外部监控 AI agent 及其所有子进程的系统调用与网络流量，支持一致性（可靠性）和安全性分析，并验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 基于 LLM 的 AI agent 以用户权限运行 shell 命令、读写文件、访问网络，但其执行过程中的行为难以理解：现有测试只断言结果，agent 轨迹仅记录它自我报告的内容，可能遗漏子进程执行的行为。
AI.method: 在隔离环境中运行 agent，通过声明式规范配置，记录 agent 及其执行的每个进程的系统调用和网络流量；支持一致性分析（衡量应做的义务）和安全性分析（检查禁止行为），分别实现了可靠性分析和安全分析。
AI.result: 可靠性方面，在 77 个任务、codex harness 和三个 LLM 上各执行三次：92.2% 的比较中，同一任务重复运行比跨任务更相似；在所有三次均通过结果测试的任务中，18% 出现任务无关活动，7% 读取评分文件，17% 未使用开发者指引。安全方面，通用规则检测出五类攻击中的四类，50 次运行无误报。
AI.conclusion: AgentSpy 提供了一种从外部观察 agent 行为的有效方法，可发现结果测试和自报轨迹无法揭示的可靠性问题，并为安全监控提供低误报的检测能力。

title: Static Bootstrap Placement for Encrypted Language Model Decoding
summary: Language models increasingly serve prompts that carry private data, and secure inference under homomorphic encryption lets a client outsource the computation without revealing the prompt. Existing secure inference systems run a forward pass without consuming a token under encryption, and generating text with them requires a client round trip at every generated token. Keeping the loop on the server instead requires selecting and consuming a token under encryption, and placing bootstraps for a loop body that grows with the context. We build AR-HE, which runs the whole loop on the server, selects each token under encryption, retrieves its embedding, and writes it back into the encrypted state. The client sends one prompt and remains offline until the output. One rule places every bootstrap in the run, without search, so the bootstrap cost of a token is a formula in the context length that is known before the run starts. The schedule skips work whose result cannot reach the output, packs bootstraps that share an operand, and keeps the keys and values of past positions in an encrypted cache. With every optimization applied, generating a GPT-2 small token costs 544 seconds on one NVIDIA H100, down from 4715 seconds without optimization. The prompt step before it costs 4630 seconds. The cache alone takes a generated step from 11751 bootstraps to 1072. The formula predicts every step we measured, including steps of a model it was not derived from.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AR-HE，一种在服务器端完成整个自回归生成循环的全同态加密（HE）安全推理系统，客户端只需发送一次提示并离线等待输出。
AI.motivation: 现有安全推理系统在加密下只执行单次前向传播，逐 token 生成需要每个 token 一次客户端往返通信；若把循环留在服务器上，则需在加密状态下选择并消耗 token，并为随上下文增长的循环体放置自举（bootstrap），成本难以控制。
AI.method: AR-HE 在服务器上运行完整循环，在加密状态下选择每个 token、检索其嵌入并写回加密状态。采用一条规则无需搜索地为整个运行放置所有自举，使每 token 的自举成本成为运行前即可知的上下文长度公式；该调度还跳过结果无法到达输出的工作、打包共享操作数的自举，并在加密缓存中保存过去位置的键和值。
AI.result: 应用全部优化后，在单块 NVIDIA H100 上生成一个 GPT-2 small token 耗时 544 秒，未优化时为 4715 秒；之前的提示步骤耗时 4630 秒。仅缓存一项就将生成步骤的自举次数从 11751 降至 1072。该公式能预测所测量的每一步，包括并非由其推导的模型步骤。
AI.conclusion: AR-HE 实现了服务器端全程加密自回归生成，客户端仅需一次提示即可离线等待结果，并通过可预测的自举调度显著降低生成成本。

title: Correctness Is a Direction: Geometric Answer Selection in Language Models
summary: Answer correctness is encoded as a recoverable geometric direction in the hidden states of language models. We show that the mean displacement from incorrect to correct answer representations, computed at approximately 70\% of model depth from fifty labeled examples with no parameter updates, yields a scoring direction that outperforms zero-shot log-probability scoring by up to +32.0 percentage points on factual benchmarks (ARC-Challenge and MMLU) and by +38.1 to +51.8 percentage points on TruthfulQA, across five models spanning 1B to 8B parameters in three architecture families (Llama, Qwen, Gemma). The method requires one forward pass and one dot product per candidate; no generation is performed at inference. Applied as a hallucination detector on individual (question, answer) pairs, the recovered direction achieves 0.693~AUROC versus 0.578 for log-probability scoring. We additionally find that correctness directions for factual reasoning, domain knowledge, and calibrated truthfulness are near-orthogonal in representation space, revealing that language models allocate geometrically independent subspaces to qualitatively distinct notions of correct answer, with architecture-dependent variation in the degree of separation. This structure explains the observed transfer pattern---the direction calibrated on factual questions transfers within task type but not across it---and suggests that LLM calibration failures may reflect a routing problem: the model's internal representation contains more correctness signal than its output behaviour exploits.

AI.tldr: 论文发现语言模型隐藏状态中"答案正确性"被编码为可恢复的几何方向：用50个标注样本、无需参数更新，在约70%深度处计算"错误→正确"的均值位移，即得到优于零样本对数概率的打分方向。
AI.motivation: 语言模型常被认为校准不佳，输出行为未能充分利用内部正确性信号。作者希望探究正确性是否在隐藏状态中以线性几何方向的形式被编码，并据此提升答案打分与幻觉检测能力。
AI.method: 在五个模型（1B–8B，Llama/Qwen/Gemma 三种架构族）上，取约70%深度处的隐藏状态，用五十个标注样本计算"错误答案→正确答案"的平均位移向量作为打分方向，无需任何参数更新。推理时仅需一次前向传播与一次点积，不做生成；并对比零样本对数概率打分，同时分析不同任务类型正确性方向间的夹角与迁移性。
AI.result: 打分方向在事实类基准（ARC-Challenge、MMLU）上比零样本对数概率最高提升32.0个百分点，在 TruthfulQA 上提升38.1–51.8个百分点。作为幻觉检测器，其AUROC为0.693，而对数概率为0.578。事实推理、领域知识与校准真实性对应的正确性方向近似正交，且分离程度随架构而异。方向在同一任务类型内可迁移，跨任务类型则不能。
AI.conclusion: 答案正确性在LLM隐藏状态中是可恢复的几何方向，且不同"正确性"概念占据近似独立子空间。跨任务迁移失败与校准失效可解释为一种路由问题——模型内部表征蕴含的正确性信号多于其输出行为所利用的，这为无需训练的答案评分与幻觉检测提供了新途径。

title: Kepler4D: Controllable Future Video Generation via 4D Scene State Evolution
summary: Video world models aim to preserve scene structure and predict how dynamic objects evolve beyond visual observations. We present Kepler4D, a framework for future video generation through explicit 4D scene state evolution. Given a monocular video, Kepler4D constructs a shared 3D representation of background geometry, object motion histories, coarse spatial supports, and semantic context. Chain-of-Motion summarizes observed motion and uses a vision-language model to select structured speed and heading decisions and decide whether to bound object-center height from below. A deterministic rollout converts these decisions into future object trajectories for inspection and editing before synthesis. We render the evolving proxies into geometric controls for a pretrained video generator, separating coarse object motion from the synthesis of appearance and articulation. Experiments on real-world videos demonstrate that Kepler4D enables controllable object motion and plausible future rollout while preserving scene consistency.

AI.tldr: Kepler4D 通过显式 4D 场景状态演化实现未来视频生成，将对象运动与外观合成解耦，实现可控对象运动和合理的未来推演。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型旨在保留场景结构并预测动态对象的演化。现有方法需要更强的可控性和场景一致性，本文提出通过显式 4D 场景状态演化来改进未来视频生成。
AI.method: 给定单目视频，Kepler4D 构建共享 3D 表示，包含背景几何、对象运动历史、粗略空间支撑和语义上下文。Chain-of-Motion 总结观测到的运动，并使用视觉语言模型选择结构化的速度和朝向决策，决定是否对对象中心高度设置下界。确定性 rollout 将这些决策转换为未来对象轨迹，用于合成前的检查与编辑；随后将演化代理渲染为几何控制信号，驱动预训练视频生成器。
AI.result: 在真实世界视频上的实验表明，Kepler4D 能够实现可控的对象运动与合理的未来推演，同时保持场景一致性。
AI.conclusion: Kepler4D 通过显式 4D 场景状态演化与运动-外观解耦，为未来视频生成提供了可控且保持场景一致性的框架。

title: Spec2Game: Can LLMs Generate Complete Playable Games from Detailed Specifications?
summary: Generating an executable program does not necessarily mean that it correctly implements the behavioral requirements specified in natural language. To evaluate large language models' ability to realize detailed specifications as complete interactive programs, we introduce Spec2Game, a benchmark that requires models to generate complete Pygame projects from detailed natural-language game specifications. Spec2Game comprises 15 game families and 150 task instances, with one canonical task and nine controlled rule variants per family, spanning three levels of implementation complexity. Using source-code, runtime, and visual evidence, we evaluate generated projects along four dimensions---Executability, Specification Realization, Code Quality, and User-Facing Quality. Across 14 LLMs and 3,330 generated projects, we find that high executability does not imply faithful specification realization. Component-level analysis further shows that models perform substantially better on Game Element Modeling than on Rule and Mechanism Modeling or Goal and Termination Modeling, indicating that faithfully implementing game rules and termination logic remains a major challenge.

AI.tldr: 提出Spec2Game基准，要求模型从详细自然语言游戏规格生成完整Pygame程序，覆盖15个游戏族、150个任务，通过四维度评估14个LLM的3330个生成项目。
AI.motivation: 生成可执行程序不等于正确实现了自然语言描述的行为需求，需要评估LLM将详细规格转化为完整交互式程序的能力。
AI.method: 构建Spec2Game基准，包含15个游戏族、每族1个标准任务和9个受控规则变体，共150个任务实例，覆盖三个实现复杂度层级。基于源代码、运行时和视觉证据，从可执行性、规格实现度、代码质量和用户感知质量四个维度进行评估。
AI.result: 评估14个LLM、3330个生成项目后发现：高可执行性并不代表忠实的规格实现。组件级分析显示，模型在游戏元素建模上表现显著优于规则与机制建模、目标与终止建模。
AI.conclusion: 忠实实现游戏规则和终止逻辑仍是LLM的主要挑战，可执行性与规格实现度之间存在明显差距。

title: Experimentation Practices in Indie Game Startups
summary: Small independent (indie) game startups face fierce competition when developing games with limited time, budget, and resources. Continuously testing and experimenting with new ideas, features, and content is essential to validate and guide development toward a viable and successful game. Such continuous experimentation (CE) requires access to users and user data, which is often very limited in the early stages of development, both in general and, in particular for indie game companies. We provide insights and recommendations on how to perform experimentation and game testing in pre-release stages of indie game development based on an exploratory interview survey with 10 independent game developers from different companies. We provide a framework for CE that highlights key parts to consider when planning and implementing an experiment. Current practices for experimentation within indie game development are also described for the early development stages of ideation, preproduction, feature production, and content production. Our empirical findings offer insights and recommendations into how to conduct experiments during pre-release stages of game development, specifically for Indie game companies. Other software startups, particularly those with a value proposition centred around interactive and satisfying user experiences, can also benefit from our research.

AI.tldr: 通过访谈10家独立游戏公司，研究其在发布前阶段的持续实验与游戏测试实践，并提出相关框架与建议。
AI.motivation: 独立游戏初创公司面临时间、预算和资源有限的激烈竞争，需通过持续测试新想法和功能来验证并引导开发。但持续实验需要用户和用户数据，而独立游戏公司在早期阶段获取这些资源往往十分有限。
AI.method: 对来自不同公司的10位独立游戏开发者进行探索性访谈调查。
AI.result: 提出了一个持续实验框架，突出规划和实施实验时需考虑的关键部分；并描述了在构思、预制作、功能制作和内容制作等早期开发阶段的独立游戏实验实践。
AI.conclusion: 研究为独立游戏公司在发布前阶段如何开展实验提供了实证见解和建议，对其他以交互性和令人满意的用户体验为价值主张的软件初创公司也具有借鉴意义。

title: Hidden Risks of Jev: An Empirical Study of Security, Privacy, and Dual Use
comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables; The source code is available at \url{https://github.com/shihe98/Security_Privacy_Jev}
summary:
Jev turns natural-language questions into typed answers and probabilities with low latency and cost, enabling applications to route requests and select tools. While this interface allows Jev to integrate naturally into application workflows as a decision layer, the security and privacy implications of this emerging use remain largely unexplored. To address this gap, we conduct the first systematic study of these implications using the official Jev API and NanoJev, a local model with controllable training data and updates, focusing on three research questions: (1) What security threats arise when Jev is deployed as an application decision layer? (2) What private information can Jev reveal despite returning constrained typed outputs? (3) How can Jev's general-purpose decision capability be used for beneficial purposes or misused?
  Jev's decisions depend on application state and may be influenced by user-provided inputs. We therefore adapt prompt injection and adversarial suffixes to manipulate its decisions. Open-source Jev distribution and updates introduce supply-chain risks, which we examine by implanting backdoors in NanoJev through training data poisoning. Since Jev's outputs reflect both application state and information learned during training, we further adapt membership, private attribute, and internal knowledge inference attacks to recover sensitive information despite its constrained output format. Finally, Jev can serve as a general-purpose decision oracle for defensive and malicious workflows. We examine this dual use through four detection tasks covering prompt injection, jailbreak inputs, harmful content, and AI-generated text, alongside misuse scenarios involving jailbreak and model extraction. Our empirical evaluation shows that Jev remains vulnerable to the examined security and privacy threats, while its decision capability can support beneficial and malicious uses.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究将 Jev 作为应用决策层时的安全与隐私影响，通过官方 API 和可控本地模型 NanoJev 开展三类研究，发现其易受决策操纵、信息泄露及双重用途风险。
AI.motivation: Jev 能将自然语言问题转化为带概率的类型化答案，低延迟低成本，适合作为应用工作流中的决策层（路由请求、选择工具）。然而这种新兴用途带来的安全与隐私影响尚缺乏系统研究，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 使用官方 Jev API 与本地可训练/可更新模型 NanoJev，围绕三个研究问题展开：（1）适配提示注入与对抗后缀操纵其决策；（2）通过投毒训练数据在 NanoJev 中植入后门以研究开源分发与更新的供应链风险；（3）适配成员推断、私有属性推断与内部知识推断攻击，从受限输出中恢复敏感信息；并以四个检测任务及越狱、模型提取等误用场景考察其通用决策能力的双重用途。
AI.result: 实证评估表明，Jev 对所考察的安全与隐私威胁仍然脆弱（决策可被操纵、供应链后门可行、受限输出仍可泄露敏感信息），同时其决策能力既可支持有益的检测任务，也可被用于恶意用途。
AI.conclusion: 将 Jev 用作应用决策层存在实质的安全与隐私风险，其通用决策能力具有明显的双重用途特性，需在部署与应用中加以重视与防护。

title: From Probe Scores to Alarm Policies: Operational Validity of Activation Monitors for Language-Model Agents
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at the Eighth International Conference on Distributed Artificial Intelligence (DAI 2026)
summary: Activation probes can predict safety-relevant properties of language models with high area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve (AUROC), but deployed agent monitors make thresholded alarm decisions under tight false-alarm budgets. These are different estimands. We introduce an Operational Validity Contract that fixes a monitor's target, observability, identity, timing, intervention unit, comparator, calibration, and cost. We formalize risk at the semantic request or trajectory level: when one task contains repeated alarm opportunities, row-level AUROC and false positive rate do not identify semantic-unit any-alarm risk. A confidence-certified threshold also requires enough independent negative units, a tie-safe rule, and transport to deployment. Across Models Under Pressure, LASR refusal prediction, immutable AgentDojo, and a prospectively protocol-frozen ST-WebAgentBench replication, joint activation-observable monitors reach AUROC 0.957 and 0.935 on the first two benchmarks, yet their locked 5%/10% detection rates are only .642/.742 and .719/.782, respectively. On AgentDojo, the secondary mean-activation rollout monitor reaches AUROC 0.922 but detects none of 38 positive semantic cases at the locked 5% operating point; thresholds intended for 10% false alarms realize 18.7-20.0% on test. Because the test misses its prospectively frozen 40-positive support gate, we label it support-insufficient. On ST-WebAgentBench, activation reaches AUROC .874, but 23 independent calibration negatives cannot identify even a 10% controller; the locked policy abstains rather than reporting its mechanical zero FPR as a success. An exploratory counterexample also lowers full AUROC while improving realized 10% utility. The fail-closed compiler caps MUP and LASR at restricted predictive value and AgentDojo and ST-Web at representation accessibility; no setting reaches alarm-policy validity.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出激活探针的高AUROC与部署监控器在严格误报预算下的阈值报警决策属于不同估计目标，提出"操作有效性契约"来规范监控器评估，并在多个基准上证明高AUROC不能保证有效的报警策略。
AI.motivation: 现有工作用AUROC衡量激活探针预测安全相关属性的能力，但实际部署的代理监控器需要在严格误报预算下做出阈值化报警决策。行级AUROC和误报率无法识别语义单元（请求或轨迹）级别的"任意报警"风险，导致评估与部署目标错位，可能高估监控器的实际安全性。
AI.method: 提出"操作有效性契约"，固定监控器的目标、可观测性、身份、时机、干预单元、比较对象、校准和成本；将风险形式化到语义请求或轨迹层面；要求置信认证阈值需有足够的独立负样本单元、防并列规则及向部署环境的迁移验证。在Models Under Pressure、LASR拒绝预测、AgentDojo以及前瞻性协议冻结的ST-WebAgentBench复现上进行评估。
AI.result: 联合激活可观测监控器在前两个基准达到AUROC 0.957和0.935，但锁定5%/10%检测率仅为.642/.742和.719/.782。AgentDojo上平均激活rollout监控器AUROC 0.922，但在锁定5%操作点未能检出38个正例中的任何一个；本意为10%误报的阈值在测试集上实际达到18.7-20.0%。ST-WebAgentBench上激活AUROC为.874，但23个独立校准负样本无法识别10%控制器，策略选择弃权。探索性反例在降低整体AUROC的同时提升了实际10%效用。
AI.conclusion: 高AUROC不能推出有效的报警策略。失效关闭编译器将各基准限制在受限预测价值或表征可达性上，没有任何设定达到报警策略有效性。评估必须从AUROC转向语义单元级别的操作有效性验证。

title: Diagnosis-Conditioned Spatial Gating and Decoder-Level Supervised Contrastive Learning for Radiology Report Generation
summary: Radiology report generation models can produce fluent text while still containing finding-level inaccuracies. Diagnosis-driven methods improve generation by conditioning on predicted findings, but these predictions do not directly modify the visual patch features provided to the decoder, and global gating applies the same modulation across spatial locations. We introduce a Position-Aware Gate (PAG) that uses predicted finding representations to modulate visual patches spatially without region supervision. We also propose a Decoder-level Supervised Contrastive Loss (DSCL) that structures decoder representations using shared positive findings rather than instance identity. On MIMIC-CXR, PAG+DSCL improves clinical efficacy (CE) F1 from 0.484 to 0.502 over a matched global-gate reference, while PAG and DSCL individually reach 0.491 and 0.495. Without additional fine-tuning, the combined model achieves 0.226 CE F1 on IU X-Ray, compared with 0.211 reported by PromptMRG.

AI.tldr: 提出位置感知门控(PAG)与解码器级监督对比损失(DSCL)，通过预测发现表征空间性地调制视觉patch特征，提升放射报告生成的临床准确性。
AI.motivation: 诊断驱动的报告生成方法依赖预测发现进行条件化，但这些预测并未直接修改提供给解码器的视觉patch特征，且全局门控对所有空间位置施加相同调制，缺乏空间针对性。
AI.method: 引入位置感知门控(PAG)，利用预测发现表征在无区域监督下对视觉patch进行空间调制；并提出解码器级监督对比损失(DSCL)，基于共享阳性发现而非实例身份来组织解码器表征。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-CXR上，PAG+DSCL将临床有效性(CE) F1从匹配的全局门控基线的0.484提升至0.502，PAG与DSCL单独分别达0.491和0.495。无需额外微调，组合模型在IU X-Ray上取得0.226 CE F1，高于PromptMRG报告的0.211。
AI.conclusion: 空间化的发现调制与基于发现结构的对比学习能有效提升放射报告生成的临床准确性，并具备良好的跨数据集泛化能力。

title: CADForge: Agentic Single-View CAD Reconstruction with Explicit Geometry Reasoning
summary: Reconstructing editable parametric CAD models from a single-view image is of great practical value for modern manufacturing, yet remains challenging due to incomplete geometric observations and complex inter-part relationships. To address it, we propose CADForge, an agentic framework that progressively converts a single image into CadQuery programs. CADForge decomposes an object into CAD-meaningful components and performs explicit geometric reasoning for each component, a process that first identifies CAD-relevant constraints and then translates them into precise modeling parameters through mathematical code. The inferred parameters then drive component-wise synthesis of executable CadQuery programs, with a review agent evaluating the resulting geometry and providing targeted feedback for iterative refinement. To further improve robustness and efficiency, CADForge incorporates a failure-guided toolkit construction mechanism to distill accumulated experience into tools, and maintains a compact parametric CAD memory for retrieving modeling context on demand. Experiments on diverse single- and multi-part objects show that CADForge consistently outperforms existing baselines in reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality, demonstrating an effective approach to accurate single-view CAD reconstruction.

AI.tldr: CADForge：一种agentic框架，将单视图图像逐步转换为可编辑的CadQuery程序，在重建保真度和感知质量上超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 从单视图图像重建可编辑的参数化CAD模型对现代制造业具有重要实用价值，但因几何观测不完整和零件间关系复杂而极具挑战。
AI.method: 提出CADForge框架：将物体分解为CAD有意义的组件，对每个组件进行显式几何推理——先识别CAD相关约束，再通过数学代码转化为精确建模参数；参数驱动组件级合成可执行CadQuery程序，由评审agent评估几何并提供反馈迭代优化；引入失败引导的工具箱构建机制，将积累经验蒸馏为工具，并维护紧凑的参数化CAD记忆以按需检索建模上下文。
AI.result: 在多种单部件与多部件物体上的实验表明，CADForge在重建保真度和感知质量方面持续优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: CADForge为实现准确的单视图CAD重建提供了一种有效途径。

title: Let the Agent Do It? How Software Practitioners Understand and Make Permission Decisions in Agentic AI Assistants
summary: Agentic AI assistants increasingly act on developers' behalf by modifying files, executing commands, and accessing external resources. These actions often require permission, yet little is known about how practitioners make permission decisions while still benefiting from agent autonomy. To address this gap, we conducted a sequential mixed methods study, interviewing 18 practitioners who use AI agents and then surveying 115 practitioners based on the interview findings. We find that practitioners often understand agent behaviour through what they can directly observe and review, while decisions, data use, and other activity behind the scenes remain less clear. This uncertainty also shapes permission decisions, which depend on the scope and risk of an action, whether it fits the task, familiarity with the agent, and the environment in which it operates. Practitioners respond by adjusting how closely they oversee agents, from setting limits in advance to monitoring execution and reviewing work afterwards. How much scrutiny they apply depends on factors such as trust, task importance, time pressure, and the consequences of an action. Our findings suggest that permission systems should make consequential actions easier to review, distinguish what an agent is allowed to do from what the user intended, make reversibility clearer, avoid treating repeated approvals as stable preferences, and distinguish rejecting a single action from rejecting an entire approach.

AI.tldr: 通过对18位从业者的访谈与115位从业者的问卷调研,本文揭示了开发者在使用Agentic AI时如何做权限决策,并提出权限系统的设计建议。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI助手能自主修改文件、执行命令并访问外部资源,这类操作常需授权,但从业者如何在享受自主性的同时做权限决策尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用顺序混合方法研究:先访谈18位使用AI Agent的从业者,再基于访谈结果对115位从业者进行问卷调查。
AI.result: 从业者主要通过可观察和可审查的部分理解Agent行为,幕后决策与数据使用较难知晓;权限决策受操作范围与风险、任务契合度、对Agent的熟悉度及运行环境影响;监督方式从预设限制到执行监控再到事后审查,scrutiny程度取决于信任、任务重要性、时间压力与后果。
AI.conclusion: 权限系统应让重要操作更易审查、区分Agent被允许做的事与用户意图、明确可逆性、避免将重复批准视为稳定偏好,并区分拒绝单个操作与拒绝整体方案。

title: ContractLens: Latent Security Knowledge for Malicious Smart Contract Detection
summary: Detecting malicious smart contracts is essential to safeguarding the Web3.0 ecosystem. However, existing auditing methods based on large language models (LLMs) largely rely on prompt engineering or attack-specific fine-tuning, while the internal representations that support malicious logic detection remain poorly characterized. To address this gap, we propose ContractLens, a framework that localizes and uses latent security knowledge in pretrained LLMs for interpretable malicious smart contract detection. Specifically, we first use layerwise linear probes to identify candidate layers that distinguish malicious from benign contracts, then select critical layers based on their sensitivity to malicious logic removal and stability under behaviour-preserving surface modifications. Next, within these critical layers, we combine activation contrast, malicious-logic specificity, and probe weights into a tri-factor importance score and adaptively select malicious contract-discriminative units (MCDUs) using the knee point of the ranked score curve. Finally, we concatenate the selected units' activations into a compact representation and train a lightweight classifier for detection, keeping the pretrained model frozen throughout. Neuron masking experiments show that masking MCDUs causes larger drops in detection performance than masking randomly selected neurons or neurons matched in activation magnitude. ContractLens achieves higher average detection accuracy than the evaluated methods on all three pretrained models. Further evaluations demonstrate generalization to unseen malicious intents and show that, with the identified MCDUs fixed, a classifier trained on few labelled samples can still achieve strong detection performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ContractLens 框架，通过定位并利用预训练大语言模型中潜在的安全知识，实现可解释的恶意智能合约检测。
AI.motivation: 恶意智能合约检测对保护 Web3.0 生态至关重要。现有基于大语言模型的审计方法多依赖提示工程或针对特定攻击的微调，而对支撑恶意逻辑检测的内部表征缺乏刻画。
AI.method: 先用逐层线性探针找出能区分恶意与良性合约的候选层，再依据其对恶意逻辑移除的敏感性和在保持行为的表面改动下的稳定性筛选关键层；在关键层内，将激活对比度、恶意逻辑特异性和探针权重结合为三因子重要性评分，利用排序评分曲线的拐点自适应选取恶意合约判别单元（MCDU）；最后拼接所选单元激活形成紧凑表示，训练轻量分类器进行检测，且全程冻结预训练模型。
AI.result: 神经元掩蔽实验显示，掩蔽 MCDU 造成的检测性能下降大于掩蔽随机神经元或激活幅度匹配的神经元。ContractLens 在三个预训练模型上均取得高于所评估方法的平均检测准确率，并能泛化到未见过的恶意意图；在固定已识别的 MCDU 后，仅用少量标注样本训练的分类器仍可获得较强检测性能。
AI.conclusion: ContractLens 通过定位和利用预训练大语言模型中的潜在安全知识，实现了可解释、可泛化且样本高效的恶意智能合约检测。

title: SIFT: Robust Meta-Faithfulness Verification of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Under Distribution Shift
comment: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) faithfulness detectors are widely used to audit reasoning models, yet a detector is itself a predictor whose verdicts are treated as stable properties. We ask whether a detector is faithful to itself under distribution shift. We formalize meta-faithfulness as an invariance principle: a valid detector must return identical verdicts on traces that differ only by transformations preserving ground-truth faithfulness. We prove three results: (i) no detector using only intervention-response profiles can separate faithful from epiphenomenal mechanisms with identical signatures; (ii) any detector relying on shift-sensitive features violates invariance at a rate independent of its in-distribution accuracy; (iii) an asymptotic certified selective-risk guarantee enables confident abstention. We operationalize the principle in FaithShift, a stress-test protocol spanning ten shift axes, and propose SIFT, a hidden-state trajectory detector trained with cross-environment invariance objectives and certified abstention. Across 14,996 traces, four domains, and eight models, three findings emerge. First, transfer collapse is real: all existing detectors show gaps $\geq 0.15$ AUROC. Second, the dominant bottleneck is sampling stochasticity, not shift: over 80% of detector instability stems from random seed variation, falsifying our preregistered prediction that shift-attributable violations exceed 0.25. Third, SIFT cuts invariance violations by 64% over the best single-seed baseline, but a four-seed ensemble of any detector narrows the margin to 0.01 (indistinguishable at matched coverage, $p=0.21$), and SIFT needs a 51% abstention rate. Cross-model transfer degrades from within-family to cross-family to open-weight-to-API, partly closed by multi-model training. We offer a framework for auditing auditors: the real barrier is detector variance, not distribution shift.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"元忠实性"（meta-faithfulness）不变性准则来审计CoT忠实性检测器本身，证明三个理论结果，并通过FaithShift压力测试与SIFT检测器实验发现：检测器不稳定的主因是采样随机性（超80%）而非分布偏移。
AI.motivation: CoT忠实性检测器被广泛用于审计推理模型，但检测器本身也是预测器，其判定被当作稳定属性。作者追问：检测器在分布偏移下是否对自身忠实？即检测器的判定是否具备不变性。
AI.method: 形式化"元忠实性"为不变性原则：有效检测器对仅经保持真实忠实性的变换而得到的不同轨迹必须给出相同判定。提出FaithShift压力测试协议（覆盖十个偏移轴），并设计SIFT——一种用跨环境不变性目标训练的隐状态轨迹检测器，具备认证弃权机制。实验涵盖14,996条轨迹、四个领域、八个模型。
AI.result: 三条理论结果：(i)仅用干预-响应特征的检测器无法区分签名相同的忠实与附带机制；(ii)依赖偏移敏感特征的检测器违反不变性，且速率与分布内精度无关；(iii)给出渐近认证选择性风险保证以支持自信弃权。实验发现：现有检测器迁移崩塌（AUROC差距≥0.15）；主要瓶颈是采样随机性（超80%不稳定源于随机种子），推翻了预注册预测；SIFT将不变性违反降低64%，但任意检测器的四种子集成可将差距缩小至0.01（匹配覆盖下无显著差异，p=0.21），且SIFT需51%弃权率。跨模型迁移从同家族到跨家族再到开放权重到API逐步退化，多模型训练可部分缓解。
AI.conclusion: 真正障碍是检测器方差而非分布偏移。论文提供了一套审计审计者的框架，提示CoT忠实性检测的有效性主要受随机性制约，应重视方差控制与集成策略。

title: Referring Multi-Object Tracking in Moving-Camera Videos via Global Motion Compensation
summary: Referring multi-object tracking (RMOT) takes a video and a language expression as input and tracks all referred objects. Many tracking requirements involve how an object moves rather than how it appears. However, in a video captured by a moving camera, a parked vehicle may appear to move, while a moving vehicle may show little displacement. Existing RMOT methods relate motion with text but do not explicitly remove camera-induced motion. In this paper, we propose extracting residual motion across frames by estimating camera motion in driver-view videos and compare motion characteristics with the query expression. We consider the motion-matching extent and integrate it with the RMOT method's prediction result through late fusion. In the evaluation, we verify the performance gain of taking the motion compensation module as a plug-in across different RMOT hosts.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对参考多目标跟踪（RMOT）中相机运动干扰物体真实运动判断的问题，提出通过估计相机运动来提取帧间残差运动，并与查询表达式的运动特征进行匹配，以即插即用方式提升现有RMOT方法性能。
AI.motivation: 许多跟踪需求关注物体的运动方式而非外观。然而在移动相机拍摄的视频中，静止车辆可能看似在移动，而运动车辆可能位移很小。现有RMOT方法虽将运动与文本关联，但未显式去除相机引起的运动，导致运动判断失真。
AI.method: 在行车视角视频中估计相机运动，从而提取跨帧的残差运动；将残差运动的特征与查询表达式的运动特征进行比较，计算运动匹配程度；再通过后期融合（late fusion）将该匹配程度与RMOT方法的预测结果整合。该运动补偿模块设计为即插即用形式。
AI.result: 在评估中验证了将运动补偿模块作为插件接入不同RMOT宿主方法时均能带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式去除相机诱导运动、利用残差运动与文本表达进行运动匹配，可有效增强多种RMOT方法的表现，且模块具有良好的通用性与可移植性。

title: Dense Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning in a Unified Geometry State
summary: Geometry reasoning is naturally stateful: solving a problem repeatedly alternates between structural proposals and exact deductions. We formulate this process as dense neural-symbolic coupling, in which neural guidance and symbolic execution share a typed state and communicate through executable actions at every search step. Neural proposals contribute theorem instances, constructions, and algebraic bridges; the symbolic runtime applies registered rules, propagates exact constraints, and records provenance. A nested controller allocates computation first between neural and symbolic proposal sources and then among admitted actions. We instantiate the framework in OmniGeo, a single solver for plane, analytic, and solid geometry. With Claude Sonnet 4.6, OmniGeo reaches 94.2%, 88.5%, and 89.8% on FormalGeo7K, Conic10K, and SolidFGeo, respectively (90.8% macro average), and solves 21/30 IMO-AG-30 problems.

AI.tldr: 本文将几何推理建模为带状态的稠密神经-符号耦合过程，神经引导与符号执行共享类型化状态并在每步通过可执行动作通信，提出 OmniGeo 统一求解平面、解析与立体几何，在多项基准上取得约 90.8% 的宏平均成绩并解决 IMO-AG-30 中的 21/30 题。
AI.motivation: 几何推理本质上具有状态性：求解过程在结构提议与精确演绎之间反复交替。现有方法往往将神经与符号割裂，缺少在搜索每一步的紧密耦合与状态共享，因此需要一种能在统一类型化状态上协同神经引导与符号执行的框架。
AI.method: 提出稠密神经-符号耦合框架：神经模块提议定理实例、构造与代数桥梁；符号运行时应用注册规则、传播精确约束并记录溯源；嵌套控制器先分配神经与符号提议源之间的计算，再在允许的动作间分配。将该框架实例化为 OmniGeo，统一处理平面、解析与立体几何。
AI.result: 在 Claude Sonnet 4.6 下，OmniGeo 在 FormalGeo7K、Conic10K、SolidFGeo 上分别达到 94.2%、88.5%、89.8%，宏平均 90.8%，并解决 IMO-AG-30 中的 21/30 道题。
AI.conclusion: 稠密神经-符号耦合与嵌套计算分配能有效统一多种几何类型的求解，并在标准基准与竞赛级问题上展现较强性能。

title: Where Does the Budget Go? Structural Concentration in Learning-Based Mutant Selection
summary: Learning-based mutant selection is used to reduce the cost of mutation testing by ranking and selecting the mutants that seem to be the most promising. Prior work has shown great potential for this approach in fault revelation and subsuming-mutant selection. However, the risks and benefits of these approaches -- especially the distribution of selected mutants across code locations and how that distribution affects behavioral diversity and fault revelation -- remain unclear. We investigate this distribution and its effects, and introduce LinePool, a simple, model-agnostic stratification step that distributes selections across source lines while retaining the underlying ranking signal. Across two datasets and budgets (2% and 5% of the mutants), we find that learning-based selection concentrates the budget on a few code locations, and may thereby systematically introduce 'blind spots', untested code areas, allowing faults to escape detection. On larger programs, the selected mutants also exhibit substantial overlap in kill behavior. LinePool substantially increases spatial coverage and reduces kill-set overlap. It also improves fault revelation at tight budgets and makes selection more robust to imperfect or shifted ranking signals. Comparisons with clustering and established diversification methods show that none consistently outperforms LinePool across datasets, supporting its use as a simple diversification step. In general, our results suggest that behavioral diversity should be considered alongside effectiveness when designing and evaluating mutant-selection methods, and that exploiting structural elements of the program is one simple way to obtain such diversity while maintaining effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于学习的变异体选择的风险与收益，提出LinePool分层策略，将选择分布到不同源码行以提升行为多样性。
AI.motivation: 基于学习的变异体选择能降低成本，但此前不清楚所选变异体在代码位置上的分布，以及这种分布如何影响行为多样性和故障揭示，可能存在盲点。
AI.method: 提出LinePool——一种简单、与模型无关的分层步骤，在保留底层排序信号的同时，将变异体选择分布到各源码行；在两个数据集及2%和5%预算下评估。
AI.result: 基于学习的选择会集中于少数代码位置，引入盲点，使故障逃逸；在较大程序上所选变异体kill行为重叠明显。LinePool显著提升空间覆盖、降低kill集重叠，在紧张预算下改善故障揭示，并对不完美或偏移的排序信号更具鲁棒性；与聚类及现有多样化方法相比，LinePool表现更一致。
AI.conclusion: 设计评估变异体选择方法时，应将行为多样性与有效性并重；利用程序结构元素是获得多样性同时保持有效性的简单途径。

title: Toward Lightweight Aerial 5G gNBs: Reproducible OAI Testbed on Commodity ARM Platforms
summary: For a battery-powered UAV base station, every gram and watt devoted to RAN-compute competes with flight-duration margin. We therefore keep the 5G Core (5GC) and central unit (CU) on the ground and design the airborne unit around only the backhaul endpoint, distributed unit (DU), and radio. The key question is then a practical one: can widely available commodity ARM computers sustain a real radio OpenAirInterface (OAI) 5G DU with useful performance over heterogeneous F1? We answer it with Raspberry Pi~5 and Jetson Orin Nano as DUs, a USRP B210, a commercial handset, and Ethernet, Wi-Fi/GRE, and 5G/WireGuard backhaul. Jetson preserves 88.4% of x86 split-DU Ethernet DL throughput and 87.5-89.0% across all three bearers; 5G/WireGuard preserves 76.4-77.1% of each host's wired DL rate. The validated Jetson/B210/RM500Q-GL electronics weigh 657.4 g and draw about 28 W under sustained traffic (757.4 g with integration allowance). A controlled link adaptation intervention raises split DL from 23.4 to 99.4 Mb/s as the dominant Modulation and Coding Scheme (MCS) moves from 3 to 26. Finally, synchronized radio, F1-U, CPU, and UHD evidence narrows the remaining monolithic-split gap to split-path scheduling/timing behavior. Beyond performance, this capability serves the emergency-response use case that motivates the aerial cell: once deployed above an affected area, it can broadcast a PWS warning message. We release the OAI patch that carries the single-segment Write-Replace Warning over F1 from CU to DU, where SIB8 is scheduled to the handset. The public artifact makes the payload, performance, and emergency-broadcast baseline reproducible with laboratory-accessible hardware.

AI.tldr: 以树莓派5与Jetson Orin Nano作为分布式单元（DU），验证商品级ARM计算机可承载真实OAI 5G DU，并给出性能、重量功耗与应急广播基线。
AI.motivation: 电池供电的无人机基站中，每克重量与每瓦功耗用于RAN计算都会挤占续航余量，因此将5GC与CU置于地面，空中单元仅保留回传端点、DU与射频，并需回答商品ARM计算机能否支撑可用性能的OAI 5G DU。
AI.method: 地面部署5GC与CU，空中仅含回传端点、DU与射频；以Raspberry Pi 5和Jetson Orin Nano为DU、USRP B210为射频、商用手机为终端，测试以太网、Wi-Fi/GRE与5G/WireGuard三种回传，并进行受控链路自适应干预与同步的radio、F1-U、CPU、UHD证据采集。
AI.result: Jetson保留x86 split-DU以太网下行吞吐的88.4%，在三种承载下为87.5–89.0%；5G/WireGuard保留各主机有线下行速率的76.4–77.1%。Jetson/B210/RM500Q-GL组合重657.4 g，持续流量约28 W（含集成余量757.4 g）。链路自适应干预使split下行从23.4升至99.4 Mb/s，主导MCS由3升至26。
AI.conclusion: 商品ARM DU具备实用性能，剩余单体-分离差距主要源于分离路径调度/时序行为；该能力支撑空中基站的应急响应场景，可广播PWS告警，并公开携带单段Write-Replace Warning经F1从CU到DU、由SIB8调度至手机的OAI补丁，使载荷、性能与应急广播基线可复现。

title: Stance Drift: How AI-mediated Communication Distorts Our Message
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate human communication, from drafting emails to summarizing scientific reports, yet whether they faithfully preserve a speaker's position remains largely untested. We model AI-mediated communication as a two-step generation-extraction pipeline: one LLM produces an argument from a specified stance, and a second LLM extracts the stance from that argument. We represent the pipeline as a probabilistic state transition over five Likert-type stance categories and define the stance preservation rate (SPR) as the average probability that the extracted stance matches the initial stance. Across 112 debate propositions, none of the nine LLMs tested exceeded an SPR of 0.7 under the default configuration. Three drift patterns accounted for most of the drift: polarization, deviation from neutrality, and flipping. Among the mitigation strategies tested, including in-context learning, multiple extraction with shuffled options, assertion, and reflection, only adding medium reasoning effort to a reflection prompt for GPT-5.4 substantially improved the SPR, to 0.775, yet polarization remained the largest pattern, with 0.119 of the transition mass. An exploratory comparison with human extraction on a single proposition suggests that drift arises at both the generation and the extraction stage. These results point to a fidelity gap in AI-mediated communication, with implications for journalism, policy deliberation, scientific communication, and other domains where opinion-laden messages pass through language models.

AI.tldr: 本文将AI中介传播建模为"生成-抽取"两步流程，定义立场保持率（SPR），测试9个LLM在112个议题上的立场保真度，发现均未超过0.7，并识别出三种漂移模式。
AI.motivation: LLM日益承担人际沟通中介角色（起草邮件、总结报告等），但它们是否能忠实保留说话者立场尚未被系统检验，存在"保真度缺口"。
AI.method: 将AI中介传播建模为两步生成-抽取流程：一个LLM按指定立场生成论点，另一个LLM从中抽取立场；用五类Likert式立场状态的概率转移表示，定义立场保持率SPR为抽取立场与初始立场一致的平均概率。在112个辩论议题、9个LLM上测试，比较多种缓解策略（上下文学习、打乱选项的多次抽取、断言、反思），并与单议题上的人工抽取做探索性对比。
AI.result: 默认配置下9个LLM的SPR均未超过0.7；漂移主要归为三种模式：极化、偏离中立和翻转。缓解策略中仅GPT-5.4在反思提示加中等推理努力将SPR显著提升至0.775，但极化仍最大（转移质量为0.119）。单议题人工抽取对比提示漂移在生成与抽取两阶段均存在。
AI.conclusion: AI中介传播存在系统性立场保真度缺口，对新闻、政策审议、科学传播等依赖LLM传递含观点信息的领域具有重要影响。

title: CellSplat4D: PSF-Aware 4D Gaussian Splatting for Sparse Robotic Live-Cell Imaging
summary: A robotic microscope watching living cells cannot afford to look as often as it would like. Every volume it acquires costs photons the specimen does not get back, and time owed to other wells. What such a platform exists to produce is a record of individual cells through time: which cell is which from one volume to the next, and which cell divided into which two. Sampling sparsely breaks that record exactly where it matters, and the fault lies in the acquisition schedule rather than in the analysis software. We fill the gaps by reconstructing them, fitting a 4D Gaussian model to whatever volumes the hardware could afford. The model is a cloud of light-emitting blobs, each carrying a position, a shape and a lifetime. Being continuous in time, it renders any missing volume on demand, decoupling how often the robot analyses from how often it can afford to look. The microscope's point-spread function is measured from the data rather than inherited from acquisition metadata or left to the optimizer, because metadata inflates it and the optimizer cannot recover it at all: a wider blur around a smaller blob fits the images equally well. Each blob's lifetime is stored in frames rather than as a fraction of the recording, so that it denotes a fixed duration on any sequence. Unmeasured timesteps are supervised at coarse scale by a 3D U-Net that predicts the intermediate volume directly and estimates no motion field, since a dividing cell becomes two and no motion describes that. On two Cell Tracking Challenge sequences, a C. elegans embryo and a Chinese Hamster Ovarian (CHO), with fidelity scored per cell nucleus, our reconstruction holds the highest nucleus fidelity at every distance from an acquired frame, has the flattest decay across the gap, and best recovers focal planes it was never shown with graceful degradation across the gap.

AI.tldr: 提出用4D高斯模型重建稀疏采样的显微体积序列，在缺失时间点渲染细胞图像，解耦成像频率与分析频率。
AI.motivation: 机器人显微镜难以频繁成像：每次采集体积都消耗标本的光子并占用其他样本孔的时间。稀疏采样会破坏细胞追踪记录（细胞身份对应关系与分裂关系），而这是问题根源在采集计划而非分析软件。
AI.method: 将4D高斯点云拟合到已采集的体积上，每个光斑携带位置、形状和寿命；时间连续因而可按需渲染任意缺失体积。点扩散函数从数据中测量而非取自采集元数据或交给优化器（元数据会高估，优化器无法恢复，因为更宽的模糊配更小光斑同样拟合良好）。寿命以帧为单位存储而非占录制长度比例，以表示固定时长。未测量时间步由3D U-Net在粗尺度监督，直接预测中间体积而不估计运动场（细胞分裂为二无法用运动描述）。
AI.result: 在两个Cell Tracking Challenge序列（线虫胚胎与CHO细胞）上，以细胞核为单位评分，重建在距已采集帧的每个距离上均保持最高细胞核保真度，跨间隙衰减最平缓，并能最好地恢复从未见过的焦平面，跨间隙性能退化平缓。
AI.conclusion: 通过连续时间4D高斯重建填补稀疏采样缺口，可在不增加光子代价的前提下获得高质量的细胞时序记录。

title: VIGIL: Verifier-Informed Gated Improvement Loop for Spreadsheet Question Answering
summary: Enterprise agents should improve from delayed feedback without allowing every correction to rewrite system behavior. We study continual harness learning for corpus-level spreadsheet question answering. Building on FiCo (Find-then-Compute), a static retrieval-and-execution backbone, we introduce VIGIL (Verifier-Informed Gated Improvement Loop). Within a question, VIGIL verifies and repairs diversely prompted Structured Query Language (SQL) candidates. Across episodes, delayed labels update only a contract calibrator and query/result-column selector. The base model, prompts, retriever, and recorded candidate pool remain fixed in the continual-learning protocol. With the gold workbook and expected type supplied, the ungated and dual-gated full-replay variants reach 82.4% and 82.0% forward accuracy over 79 documents, from a 75.8% static baseline. The dual gate has the larger retrospective gain (2.7 versus 2.3 points), and its 6.3-point forward gain has a 95% t-interval of 5.6-6.9. In a separate stricter split that excludes 16 documents and 380 questions from fitting and online promotion, the accuracy-only gate raises mean held-out accuracy across ten final harnesses from 80.3% to 86.7%. Calibrator-only adaptation gains 5.9 points, close to the combined 6.4-point gain. Yet three of 26 gate-approved updates reduce held-out accuracy relative to their incumbents, so replay-buffer non-regression does not imply held-out non-regression. MiMoTable and external-task case studies test within-task verification and reuse the same promote-or-retain discipline. Overall, the results support bounded, auditable harness adaptation while revealing where finite replay gates fail to generalize beyond their promotion buffers.

AI.tldr: 提出VIGIL框架，实现语料级表格问答的持续harness学习：仅更新校验器与选择器，冻结基座模型、提示、检索器与候选池，在79篇文档上把前向准确率从75.8%提升到82.4%。
AI.motivation: 企业智能体需要从延迟反馈中持续改进，但不应让每一次修正都改写整个系统行为。本文关注在语料级电子表格问答中，如何实现一种有界、可审计的持续学习，只让延迟标签影响少量可控组件，而保持基座模型与检索执行主干不变。
AI.method: 在静态的"先找后算"（FiCo）检索-执行主干之上构建VIGIL。问题内部：对多样提示生成的多路SQL候选进行校验与修复。跨回合：延迟标签只更新契约校准器（contract calibrator）和查询/结果列选择器；基座模型、提示、检索器与已记录的候选池在持续学习协议中保持冻结。并设计门控（ungated、dual-gated、accuracy-only）与全回放变体。
AI.result: 提供金标工作簿与期望类型时，ungated与dual-gated全回放变体在79篇文档上分别达到82.4%与82.0%的前向准确率，静态基线为75.8%；dual gate的回溯增益更大（2.7 vs 2.3点），前向增益6.3点，95% t区间为5.6–6.9。在排除16篇文档、380个问题的更严格划分中，accuracy-only门控把十个最终harness的平均留出准确率从80.3%提升到86.7%。仅校准器自适应增益5.9点，接近组合的6.4点。但26次门控通过的更新中有3次降低了留出准确率，说明回放缓冲的非退化并不保证留出集非退化。MiMoTable与外部任务案例研究验证了任务内校验并复用同一"晋升或保留"纪律。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持有界、可审计的harness自适应，同时揭示有限回放门控在其晋升缓冲之外泛化失败的情形。回放缓冲的非退化不等同于留出集非退化，提示需要更谨慎的晋升机制。

title: Correct Code, Broken Contributions? SWE-CC: Benchmarking Repository Policy Compliance for Coding Agents
comment: 39 pages, 6 figures. Benchmark and source code: https://github.com/dangtruong01/swe-cc-arxiv
summary: Autonomous coding agents now resolve a substantial share of real-world GitHub issues. However, passing functional tests differs fundamentally from producing a high-quality contribution acceptable for merging. Mature open-source projects publish repository-specific contribution policies, spanning style, git, testing workflows, to ensure code quality and long-term maintainability. Because existing benchmarks evaluate patches solely on unit tests, agent compliance with repository governance remains unknown. In this paper, we introduce SWE-CC, a benchmark evaluating code and process compliance in autonomous software engineering. We develop a semi-automated pipeline that converts developer documentation across 12 open-source repositories into 823 machine-checkable atomic policies. SWE-CC introduces two features: 1) lightweight, deterministic checker functions that represent each policy, 2) a comprehensive auditing mechanism that inspects both agent runtime behaviors and final deliverables. We evaluate the compliance of agent workflows in 500 end-to-end software contribution tasks extended from SWE-bench Verified. Our evaluation of four LLMs under two agent scaffolds shows that modern agents suffer from coding compliance issues: although agents produce functionally correct patches, they still violate 43.1 percent of applicable project policies, with nearly half of all violations occurring during intermediate execution steps. These results show that functional correctness does not guarantee real-world readiness, highlighting that future software engineering agents must reliably conform to repository governance to enable safe and trustworthy deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SWE-CC基准，评估自主编码代理在真实开源仓库贡献中对代码与流程规范的遵循度，发现功能正确的补丁仍违反43.1%的适用政策。
AI.motivation: 现有基准仅用单元测试评估补丁，忽略了成熟开源项目发布的仓库级贡献政策（风格、git、测试流程等），导致代理对仓库治理的合规性未知。
AI.method: 构建半自动化流水线，将12个开源仓库的开发者文档转换为823条可机器检查的原子政策；为每条政策引入轻量确定性检查函数，并设计审计机制同时检查代理运行时行为与最终交付物；基于SWE-bench Verified扩展出500个端到端贡献任务。
AI.result: 在四种LLM和两种代理框架下评估，代理虽产出功能正确的补丁，仍违反43.1%的适用项目政策，且近一半违规发生在中间执行步骤。
AI.conclusion: 功能正确性并不保证真实世界可用性，未来软件工程代理必须可靠遵循仓库治理，才能实现安全可信的部署。

title: Cross-chain Access Control for Permissioned Blockchain Interoperation
summary: As enterprise blockchains become increasingly interconnected, access control must extend beyond the boundaries of a single network. Existing approaches mainly focus on controlling access within one blockchain, while cross-chain interactions involve multiple networks that may follow different access-control policies and administrative rules. In this paper, we propose InterAcct, an end-to-end access-control framework for secure interactions across permissioned blockchain networks. To avoid exposing sensitive internal information, InterAcct converts outgoing requests into a consortium-level representation before they are shared with another network. When a response is returned, the framework securely maps it back to the original requester within the source consortium, preserving confidentiality throughout the interaction. Our experimental results show that InterAcct can enforce end-to-end access control for cross-chain request-response interactions with low additional overhead and can continue to operate effectively as the workload increases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 InterAcct，一个面向许可制区块链跨链交互的端到端访问控制框架，通过联盟级表示隐藏敏感信息并安全映射请求响应，实验表明其开销低且可扩展。
AI.motivation: 随着企业区块链日益互联，访问控制需突破单一网络边界。现有方法主要关注单链内部访问控制，而跨链交互涉及遵循不同访问控制策略与管理规则的多个网络，缺乏端到端的安全访问控制方案。
AI.method: 提出 InterAcct 框架：在请求发出前，将出站请求转换为联盟级（consortium-level）表示，以避免暴露敏感内部信息，再与其他网络共享；当响应返回时，框架将响应安全映射回源联盟内的原始请求者，从而在整个交互过程中保持机密性。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，InterAcct 能够以较低的额外开销为跨链请求-响应交互实现端到端访问控制，并且在负载增加时仍能有效运行。
AI.conclusion: InterAcct 为许可制区块链网络间的安全交互提供了低开销、可扩展的端到端访问控制解决方案。

title: Does Neural Complexity Improve Health Misinformation Detection? A Leakage-Controlled Cross-Corpus Benchmark
comment: 18 pages, 3 tables. Reproducibility materials and source code are available from the author
summary: Increasing architectural complexity is often assumed to improve health misinformation detection, yet reported gains are difficult to interpret when studies use different corpora, preprocessing pipelines, data splits, and leakage controls. This study provides a controlled cross-corpus benchmark of five compact neural architectures (1D-CNN, LSTM, BiLSTM, CNN-LSTM, and CNN-BiLSTM), a soft-voting neural ensemble, and three classical machine-learning baselines using COVID19-FNIR and CONSTRAINT. Exact-text duplicate controls were applied before modelling; all neural systems used a common preprocessing and optimisation protocol, and neural results were repeated across three random seeds. On COVID19-FNIR, the deep ensemble achieved a mean macro-F1 of 0.9963 and ROC-AUC of 0.9994, while individual neural models ranged from 0.9945 to 0.9957 macro-F1. On CONSTRAINT, the ensemble achieved macro-F1 of 0.9272 and ROC-AUC of 0.9811, whereas a linear SVM achieved macro-F1 of 0.9574 and ROC-AUC of 0.9931. Architecture rankings changed across corpora, and simple sparse linear models remained highly competitive. The findings show that model complexity does not provide a stable performance advantage and that benchmark construction can dominate architecture choice. The study contributes a reproducible, leakage-controlled basis for evidence-driven model selection in health misinformation classification

AI.tldr: 本研究通过跨语料库的受控基准测试发现，在健康虚假信息检测中，模型复杂度的提升并不能稳定带来性能优势，基准构建方式对结果的影响可能超过架构选择本身。
AI.motivation: 通常认为增加架构复杂度能提升健康虚假信息检测性能，但已有研究报告的性能提升难以解读，因为不同研究使用了不同的语料库、预处理流程、数据划分和泄漏控制方式，缺乏可比性。因此需要一项受控的跨语料库基准研究来公正评估架构复杂度与性能之间的关系。
AI.method: 研究在 COVID19-FNIR 和 CONSTRAINT 两个语料库上，对五种紧凑神经架构（1D-CNN、LSTM、BiLSTM、CNN-LSTM、CNN-BiLSTM）、一个软投票神经集成模型以及三种经典机器学习基线进行受控基准测试。建模前应用了精确文本重复控制；所有神经模型采用统一的预处理与优化协议，并在三个随机种子上重复实验。
AI.result: 在 COVID19-FNIR 上，深度集成模型取得平均 macro-F1 0.9963、ROC-AUC 0.9994，单个神经模型 macro-F1 在 0.9945–0.9957 之间。在 CONSTRAINT 上，集成模型 macro-F1 为 0.9272、ROC-AUC 为 0.9811，而线性 SVM 达到 macro-F1 0.9574、ROC-AUC 0.9931。架构排名在不同语料库间发生变化，简单稀疏线性模型仍具高度竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，模型复杂度并不提供稳定的性能优势，基准构建方式可能主导架构选择。该研究为健康虚假信息分类中基于证据的模型选择提供了可复现、受泄漏控制的基础。

title: Sparse-GS2Mesh: 3D Gaussian Splatting Guided by Novel Stereo Views and 2DGS for Sparse View Surface Reconstruction}
comment: 13, pages, 7 figures, accepted to NIPS 2026 PhysWorldAI workshops
summary: Surface reconstruction under sparse-view settings remains challenging due to limited geometric cues. Volume rendering methods based on signed distance functions often produce over-smoothed surfaces, while 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), though time-efficient, suffers from incomplete geometry due to the lack of reliable depth supervision and the limitation of being optimized only from given input views. In this paper, we present Sparse-GS2Mesh, a stereo-aware framework for surface reconstruction from sparse views. While 3DGS and stereo matching have been leveraged for surface reconstruction under dense view settings, we extend them to operate effectively under sparse view conditions by first initializing 3DGS using epipolar depth priors to mitigate the 3DGS overfitting problem, followed by our three key components: (I) adaptive baseline selection, (II) fine-tuning with a stereo matching network, and (III) 2D/3D co-regularized fine-tuning. Given a warmed-up 3DGS initialized with epipolar depth, the adaptive baseline selection automatically determines a baseline to synthesize for each sparse view. We then fine-tune 3DGS by backpropagating depth-refining gradients from the stereo matching network, effectively specializing the 3DGS for stereo matching. The 2D/3D co-regularization further helps obtain stable reconstruction, addressing weak geometric cues in close stereo views. Sparse-GS2Mesh achieves a 15\% improvement over state-of-the-art methods in little-overlap settings and comparable results in large-overlap settings. Codes will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: Sparse-GS2Mesh：一个立体感知框架，通过极线深度先验初始化3DGS并引入自适应基线选择、立体匹配网络微调和2D/3D协同正则化，实现稀疏视图下的表面重建。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视图下几何线索有限，基于SDF的体渲染易过度平滑，3DGS虽高效但缺乏可靠深度监督且仅从输入视图优化，导致几何不完整。
AI.method: 先用极线深度先验初始化3DGS以缓解过拟合；再引入(I)自适应基线选择、(II)立体匹配网络微调、(III)2D/3D协同正则化三个关键组件完成优化。
AI.result: 在低重叠设置下相比SOTA提升约15%，在大重叠设置下取得可比结果。
AI.conclusion: 将3DGS与立体匹配从密集视图扩展到稀疏视图，可有效提升表面重建的完整性与稳定性，代码将公开。

title: LMBuild: Evaluating LLM Agents for Generating Buildable and Functional Structures
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly capable of generating complex 3D structures, with the potential to reshape how objects are designed and realized in the physical world. Yet, producing elegant geometry is fundamentally different from producing objects that can be built and perform their intended functions. Existing evaluations largely focus on geometric quality while overlooking physical realizability. We introduce LMBuild, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on generating buildable and functional structures. LMBuild represents generated objects as assembled structures comprising part decompositions, joints, materials, and sequences. To support reproducible evaluation, we provide a unified framework consisting of: (1) an interactive environment in which agents can use tools to retrieve, create, and place components to construct objects; (2) a curated benchmark that repurposes established CAD datasets and augments them with knowledge from Wikipedia; and (3) a evaluation framework covering structural soundness, functional affordance, design quality, and physical realization.
