Evaluations across 30 systems reveal several intriguing findings: (a) Soundness and alignment are no longer the primary bottlenecks for frontier closed-source models, while functional affordance and physical operability remain substantially more challenging; (b) stronger models more effectively create new components, whereas weaker models tend to rely on retrieval; and (c) providing functional specifications substantially improves part completeness, kinematics, and physical operability. These results show that generating real-world structures requires deeper reasoning about functional affordances, mechanics, and designing and creating novel components. We expect LMBuild to provide a foundation for measuring progress and incentivizing research toward agents that generate buildable and functional structures.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LMBuild 基准，用于评估 LLM 智能体生成可建造且具功能性结构的能力，覆盖结构稳固性、功能可供性、设计质量与物理可实现性。
AI.motivation: 现有评估多关注几何质量，忽视物理可实现性；生成优雅几何与生成可建造、能执行预期功能的物体本质不同。
AI.method: 将生成物体表示为含部件分解、关节、材料与装配序列的组装结构；提供统一框架，包括可交互环境（检索、创建、放置组件的工具）、基于既有 CAD 数据集并用维基百科知识增强的策划基准，以及涵盖结构稳固性、功能可供性、设计质量、物理实现性的评估框架。
AI.result: 对 30 个系统的评估发现：(a) 对前沿闭源模型而言，稳固性与对齐已非主要瓶颈，而功能可供性和物理可操作性仍具挑战；(b) 更强模型更能有效创建新组件，较弱模型倾向依赖检索；(c) 提供功能规格说明可显著提升部件完整性、运动学与物理可操作性。
AI.conclusion: 生成真实世界结构需要深入推理功能可供性、力学机制以及设计与创造新组件；LMBuild 为衡量进展并激励相关研究提供基础。

title: LLM Non-Determinism in Deterministic Processes: A Controlled Variation Space for Constraining the Propagation of Non-Determinism
summary: Large Language Models are increasingly used in software development processes that rely on defined states, rules, and approvals. This creates a tension between the flexibility of LLMs and the need for reliable and traceable process states. We introduce Controlled Non-Determinism, a process-oriented approach that allows variation without letting it directly determine the authoritative process state. We place LLM-based processing within a controlled variation space that is bounded by a Deterministic Envelope. Before execution, we define the process-relevant properties of the result and the exit conditions. We also record the task configuration. These elements remain fixed during execution. At the end of the variation space, an exit check determines whether the result satisfies the predefined conditions and may become the next authoritative state. Different runs may produce different admissible results while the transition to an authoritative state remains controlled. We illustrate the approach with regulated software development and derive design guidelines for LLM-based changes whose results can be checked before they become part of the authoritative software state.

AI.tldr: 提出"受控非确定性"方法，通过确定性包络约束LLM的变异空间并设置退出检查，使结果可校验后再成为权威状态。
AI.motivation: LLM日益用于依赖既定状态、规则和审批的软件开发流程，其灵活性与流程状态所需的可靠性和可追溯性之间存在矛盾。
AI.method: 将基于LLM的处理置于由"确定性包络"限定的受控变异空间内；执行前定义结果中与流程相关的属性和退出条件，并记录任务配置，这些要素在执行期间保持固定；在变异空间末端通过退出检查判断结果是否满足预设条件、可否成为下一个权威状态。
AI.result: 不同运行可产生不同但均可接受的结果，而向权威状态的转换过程保持受控。以受监管软件开发为场景进行了说明。
AI.conclusion: 提出了面向流程的受控非确定性方法，并据此推导出针对基于LLM的变更的设计准则，使其结果在成为权威软件状态前可被检查。

title: Cooldown Landmines: Cross-Tenant Interference Attacks on LLM Gateways
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures. Main text in ICLR format; includes appendices
summary: LLM gateways enforce separate tenant quotas while sharing model deployments and cooldown records that temporarily exclude failing backends. However, a tenant's request failure can update these shared records and restrict other tenants' access to serviceable deployments. We identify two attacks that exploit this gap in LiteLLM. The first uses requests rejected at the key's requests-per-minute (RPM) limit: caller-supplied identifiers for known registered deployments reach failure handling, allowing two rejected requests to redirect another tenant to fallback with zero upstream calls from those requests. The second uses admitted traffic to create cooldown records that persist after backend capacity recovers. To address these failures, we design an origin check that blocks deployment updates from key RPM rejections and tenant-scoped cooldown that preserves the triggering tenant's back-off while retaining shared records for backend faults. Experiments with authenticated proxies and self-hosted vLLM demonstrate that the attacks can force fallback or denial while deployments remain serviceable. Across five paired four-worker runs, tenant scoping reduces victim fallback after recovery from 54/60 to 0/60, while increasing attempts against exhausted shared quotas. These findings show that tenant isolation must cover both request admission and the failure handling that governs shared deployment availability.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示 LLM 网关（以 LiteLLM 为例）在共享部署与冷却记录机制下存在的跨租户隔离漏洞，提出两种攻击并可迫使他租户回退或拒绝服务，随后设计源检查与租户级冷却修复，实验显示可将受害回退从 54/60 降至 0/60。
AI.motivation: LLM 网关虽对租户配额做隔离，但共享模型部署与冷却记录。某租户的请求失败会写入共享记录，从而限制其他租户访问本可用的部署。作者希望指出这一隔离缺口，并说明租户隔离需覆盖请求准入与失败处理两个环节。
AI.method: 针对 LiteLLM 识别两种攻击：(1) 利用 key 的 RPM 限制拒绝请求，使调用方提供的已知已注册部署标识进入失败处理，仅两次被拒请求即可将另一租户重定向至回退，且这些请求未产生上游调用；(2) 利用被准入流量创建冷却记录，使其在后端容量恢复后仍保留。防御方案包括：源检查（阻止由 key RPM 拒绝触发的部署更新）与租户级冷却（保留触发租户的退避，同时对后端故障保留共享记录）。
AI.result: 在带认证代理与自托管 vLLM 的实验中，攻击可在部署仍可用时强制回退或拒绝。在五组四 worker 配对运行中，租户级冷却将恢复后受害回退从 54/60 降至 0/60，同时增加了针对已耗尽共享配额的尝试次数。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，租户隔离必须同时覆盖请求准入与支配共享部署可用性的失败处理机制，否则单方面配额隔离不足以防止跨租户的服务可用性影响。

title: Grounding Probes: Generator-Independent Hallucination Detection from Observer Model Hidden States
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Code and per-sample predictions: https://github.com/MRathmayr/LettuceDetect
summary: Detecting responses that retrieval-augmented generation does not ground in its context trades speed against accuracy: surface checks miss paraphrased fabrication, sampling-based methods cost extra generations. Hidden-state probes sit between the two, but every existing one reads the generating model's own activations, so a change of generator invalidates the detector and a closed-weight generator is out of reach. This paper removes that coupling. The Grounding Probe is logistic regression over the mean-pooled middle-layer hidden states of an observer language model that reads the context, question, and response in one forward pass and generates nothing, with the recipe it needs: pool over response tokens, read a middle layer, and control capacity, which closes the train-test AUROC gap from 0.087-0.202 to 0.009-0.013. Asking the observer outright, rather than reading its hidden state, costs at least +0.166 AUROC in every one of four models. Fitted on 15,090 annotated responses it reaches 0.879-0.894 AUROC on RAGTruth test across four observers, and 0.924 AUROC with 0.820 F1@0.5 averaged with a supervised span detector, 0.060 above that detector alone. One probe holds across six generators, and hold-out controls, including one in which no evaluation prompt appears in training, bound the cost of removing a generator at about 0.02 AUROC. Code, probes, and predictions are released.

AI.tldr: 提出 Grounding Probe，一种解耦生成器的隐藏状态探针，用观察者语言模型的中间层平均池化表示做逻辑回归，检测 RAG 无依据生成，AUROC 达 0.879-0.894，且跨六种生成器可用。
AI.motivation: 现有检测 RAG 无依据回答的方法存在速度与精度的权衡：表面检查漏掉改写式编造，采样方法需额外生成；已有隐藏状态探针读取生成模型自身激活，导致换生成器即失效，闭权重模型无法使用。
AI.method: 用观察者语言模型一次前向读取上下文、问题和回答且不生成，取其响应 token 的中间层隐藏状态做平均池化后进行逻辑回归；关键配方为池化响应 token、读取中间层、控制容量，并提供训练-测试 AUROC 差距的消融对比。
AI.result: 容量控制将训练-测试 AUROC 差距从 0.087-0.202 降到 0.009-0.013；直接询问观察者比读隐藏状态至少低 0.166 AUROC；15,090 条标注数据训练后在 RAGTruth 测试上达 0.879-0.894 AUROC，与有监督跨度检测器平均后 0.924 AUROC、0.820 F1@0.5，比单独检测器高 0.060；单个探针跨六种生成器，去除生成器代价约 0.02 AUROC。
AI.conclusion: Grounding Probe 消除了探针与生成模型的耦合，无需生成即可高效检测 RAG 无依据内容，并在跨生成器场景保持稳定性能，代码、探针和预测均已开源。

title: FlashGaze: Training-Free Multi-Scale Patch Pruning For Efficient Video Understanding
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in video understanding, yet efficiently processing long, high-resolution videos remains challenging. Such videos often contain substantial spatiotemporal redundancy, and processing redundant visual tokens can incur avoidable computational overhead. Many existing methods prune visual tokens during or after vision transformer (ViT) encoding, leaving much of the encoding cost unaddressed. Some approaches prune patches before encoding but rely on learned auxiliary networks for patch selection, incurring additional training and inference overhead. To address these limitations, we propose FlashGaze, a training-free method that reduces spatiotemporal redundancy before ViT encoding without introducing auxiliary networks. FlashGaze uses pixel-space differences as a proxy for information loss and employs Quadtree Dynamic Programming to jointly optimize patch dropping, merging, and keeping under a fixed budget. Experiments on two MLLM backbones across multiple benchmarks demonstrate substantial efficiency gains while largely preserving accuracy. On Qwen3-VL-8B, FlashGaze retains 98% of the full-input baseline accuracy on LongVideoBench while achieving up to 5.4x and 17x speedups in ViT encoding and MLLM prefill, respectively, and reducing peak GPU memory usage by a factor of 1.8. These efficiency gains enable the model to process videos with more frames and higher resolutions on the same GPU hardware, unlocking video understanding at scales previously out of reach.

AI.tldr: FlashGaze：一种无需训练的视觉token剪枝方法，在ViT编码前利用像素差异和四叉树动态规划减少时空冗余，大幅提升MLLM视频处理效率。
AI.motivation: 长时高分辨率视频存在大量时空冗余，处理冗余视觉token带来多余计算开销。现有方法多在ViT编码期间或之后剪枝，未能解决编码成本；而编码前剪枝的方法依赖学习型辅助网络，增加训练与推理开销。
AI.method: 提出FlashGaze，无需训练、无需辅助网络，在ViT编码前减少时空冗余。以像素空间差异作为信息损失代理，采用四叉树动态规划，在固定预算下联合优化patch的丢弃、合并与保留。
AI.result: 在两个MLLM主干和多个基准上验证，效率显著提升且精度基本保持。在Qwen3-VL-8B上，LongVideoBench保留全输入基线98%精度，ViT编码最高加速5.4倍，MLLM prefill加速达17倍，峰值GPU显存降低1.8倍。
AI.conclusion: FlashGaze在相同GPU硬件下支持更多帧数和更高分辨率视频处理，实现此前难以企及规模的视频理解。

title: Language-Conditioned Token and Reasoning Efficiency in Large Language Models: A Paired Cross-Lingual Study Protocol
comment: 32 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Prospective paired study protocol; no confirmatory model outcomes are reported
summary: Large language models incur language-dependent representation and inference costs, but existing comparisons often conflate input language, assigned observable-trace language, and answer realization. We specify a prospective paired study that separates these interfaces while holding the semantic item, checkpoint, and answer oracle fixed. The initial design instantiates 240 exactly scored items rendered from templates in English and seven non-English languages, three distinct-lineage open-weight checkpoints, three trace-token budgets, 22 input- and trace-language conditions, a fixed answer reserve, and a separately counted delimiter: 47,520 initial core runs before prospective sample-size selection. RQ1-RQ3 estimate input and trace effects by intention-to-treat with failure-inclusive terminal accounting and test answer realization by cloning a sealed prefix and runtime-native KV state into eight crossed branches. Pre-freeze independent language review, fixed-form ASCII selectors, and code/surface/solver agreement constrain the realization test. H1-H5 share one Holm family and a global simultaneous component band. A secondary randomized experiment compares one-long-attempt and complete K-short-attempt policies at equal trace allowance under frozen seeds and oracle-blind aggregation; it is a full-policy contrast because answer capacity differs. Outcomes include exact token spans, correctness, latency, runtime-exposed memory, and qualified same-host operating-system-reported energy over prespecified hardware rails. The protocol separates tokenizer expansion, observable-trace cost, and answer-realization cost without treating visible traces as internal cognition or operating-system estimates as physical cross-device energy. No confirmatory model outcome is reported; result fields remain disabled until the frozen evidence ledger passes independent verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一项前瞻性配对研究方案，将大语言模型的语言相关表示与推断成本拆分为输入语言、可观测轨迹语言和答案实现三个接口，并给出固定语义项、检查点与答案判据的实验设计。
AI.motivation: 现有跨语言比较常将输入语言、可观测轨迹语言与答案实现混为一谈，导致难以区分tokenizer扩展、可观测轨迹成本与答案实现成本。研究动机在于通过分离这些接口，获得更清晰的因果解释与成本归因。
AI.method: 设计240个精确评分项目，以英语和七种非英语模板渲染；使用三个不同谱系的开源权重检查点、三种轨迹token预算、22种输入与轨迹语言条件、固定答案预留和单独计数的分隔符，初始核心运行为47,520次。RQ1-RQ3以意向性治疗估计输入与轨迹效应，采用包含失败的终端核算；答案实现检验通过克隆密封前缀与运行时原生KV状态到八个交叉分支完成。另设次要随机实验，在冻结种子与判据盲聚合下比较一次长尝试与完整K次短尝试策略。
AI.result: 结果字段在冻结证据账本通过独立验证前保持禁用，因此本文未报告任何确证性模型结果，仅给出预注册式协议与统计约束。
AI.conclusion: 该协议能够分离tokenizer扩展、可观测轨迹成本与答案实现成本，同时避免将可见轨迹等同于内部认知，或将操作系统能耗估计等同于跨设备物理能耗。

title: Choosing an energy-efficient software architecture for building system diagnostic support
summary:
Around 30\% of global energy expenditure can be attributed to the building sector, where a large portion of energy-consumption could be avoided by repairing existing faults. Fault detection and diagnosis (FDD) software addresses this issue; however, its creation and operation also have an environmental impact. The magnitude of this impact is influenced by the diagnosis architecture, as different architectures and methods have different energy demands. Yet, simply considering the energy consumed by the software itself is not sufficient to assess its overall environmental impact, since the diagnostic performance, e.g., number of detected faults or number of faults missed, also contributes to its ecological footprint.
  In this paper, we propose an energy-consumption model that considers FDD performance and energy spend directly by the diagnosis software. In an initial experiment, we compare several FDD architecture families, i.e., rule-based, model-based, classical machine learning, and large-language-model-based, in simulation using performance and energy-consumption values collected from prior literature. The results show that considering the computational energy and accuracy of FDD can change the relative benefit of the different approaches. Computationally efficient machine learning methods, such as random forest, provide the largest net savings on smaller buildings, whereas more resource-intensive approaches, such as fine-tuned large language models, become advantageous as building size increases. Our findings suggest that overall energy efficiency depends not only on the computational demand of the FDD software, but also on its diagnostic performance and the scale of the building.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个综合考虑故障检测与诊断（FDD）性能及其软件自身能耗的能量消耗模型，并对比规则、模型、经典机器学习与大语言模型四类FDD架构，发现整体能效取决于计算需求、诊断性能与建筑规模，小建筑宜用随机森林，大建筑则适合微调大语言模型。
AI.motivation: 全球约30%的能源消耗来自建筑领域，修复现有故障可避免大量能耗；FDD软件虽能解决该问题，但其创建与运行本身也有环境影响。该影响受诊断架构影响，且仅考虑软件自身能耗不足以评估整体环境足迹，因为诊断性能（如检出或漏检的故障数量）同样构成生态足迹。因此需要构建同时考虑性能与能耗的评估模型。
AI.method: 提出一个同时考虑FDD性能与诊断软件直接能耗的能量消耗模型；在初始实验中，基于既有文献收集的性能与能耗数值，在仿真环境中对比四类FDD架构族：规则型、模型型、经典机器学习以及基于大语言模型的方法。
AI.result: 结果表明，纳入计算能耗与FDD准确率会改变不同方法的相对优劣。计算高效的机器学习方法（如随机森林）在较小建筑上提供最大的净节能；而资源密集型方法（如微调大语言模型）随着建筑规模增大而变得更具优势。
AI.conclusion: 整体能效不仅取决于FDD软件的计算需求，还取决于其诊断性能与建筑规模。评估FDD环境效益时需综合考量这些因素。

title: VulValidate: Auditing Function-Level Vulnerability Labels with Executable Evidence
summary: Reliable learning-based vulnerability detection requires high-quality labels, yet datasets built from vulnerability-fixing commits may label functions as vulnerable simply because they were changed by a security patch. We present VulValidate, a framework that uses LLM agents to coordinate dynamic analysis tools and construct vulnerability-triggering experiments from runtime feedback. Given a labeled function and its fixing patch, VulValidate reconstructs vulnerable and fixed revisions, selects suitable tools and execution paths, refines triggering inputs, and compares runtime behavior to assess function-level attribution. We audit all 35,849 instances originally labeled vulnerable in BigVul, PrimeVul, and DiverseVul. We confirm 20,510 (57.2%), correct 6,819 labels (19.0%), leave 7,981 attacked but undecided (22.3%), and cannot successfully measure 539 (1.5%). After conflict resolution and byte-exact deduplication, the corrected release contains 15,890 distinct confirmed vulnerable function bodies. In a blinded review of 581 sampled decisions, expert consensus supports 90.0%--92.0% of confirmations and 92.6%--99.0% of label corrections. With model parameters fixed, corrected evaluation lowers F1 for all five tested detectors on both BigVul and DiverseVul; retraining with corrected labels improves F1 for four of five detectors on each dataset. We also release a reusable VulValidate skill, corrected datasets, and reproducible evidence for future vulnerability-detection research.

AI.tldr: VulValidate 用 LLM 智能体协调动态分析工具，从运行时反馈构建触发漏洞的实验，审计三大漏洞数据集的错误标签，并发布修正后的数据集与可复用技能。
AI.motivation: 基于漏洞修复提交构建的数据集常将被安全补丁改动的函数直接标为脆弱，导致标签质量不可靠，而可靠的基于学习的漏洞检测依赖高质量标签。
AI.method: 给定带标签函数及其修复补丁，VulValidate 重建脆弱与修复版本，选择合适工具与执行路径，精炼触发输入，并比较运行时行为以进行函数级归因；由 LLM 智能体协调动态分析工具。
AI.result: 审计 BigVul、PrimeVul、DiverseVul 中 35,849 个原标为脆弱的实例：确认 20,510（57.2%），纠正 6,819（19.0%），攻击但未决 7,981（22.3%），无法测量 539（1.5%）。冲突消解与字节精确去重后含 15,890 个确认脆弱函数体。581 个抽样决策的盲审中，专家共识支持 90.0%–92.0% 的确认与 92.6%–99.0% 的纠正。固定模型参数下，修正评估使五个检测器在 BigVul 与 DiverseVul 上 F1 均下降；用修正标签重训练使每个数据集上五个检测器中的四个 F1 提升。
AI.conclusion: 发布可复用的 VulValidate 技能、修正数据集与可复现证据，以支持未来漏洞检测研究。

title: Extracting Persona Subspaces Through Iterative Nullspace Projection For Modulation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can adopt distinct personas to tune their semantics, expertise, and perspective to different users and tasks. Precise control over these traits is critical to ensure safety and reliability in model behavior. Existing methods like activation steering and prompt-based persona induction reduce a persona to a single dominant direction, missing the finer, nested traits that emerge only once that dominant signal is factored out. We introduce modulation as a setting where the persona context is already embedded in the content being manipulated, requiring control methods to amplify or suppress a trait already present rather than inject it from scratch. PaSS is an inference-time control paradigm that models personas as multi-dimensional subspaces in a model's latent space without supervised contrastive examples. The persona subspaces are extracted via iterative concept erasure and applied to modulate persona-guided generation without retraining. To extract this subspace, we use Iterative Nullspace Projections (INLP) to linearly and iteratively isolate persona-specific directions. We causally evaluate six personas against diverse tasks like MATH-500, TinyAlpaca, GSM8K, and IFEval, showing that discriminative, iterative subspace extraction captures diverse traits underlying a given persona, enabling stronger and larger modulation than single-direction additive methods, while maintaining content fidelity. We further study individual peeled directions within each subspace to uncover the distinct aspects of persona behavior they encode. Overall, we show that persona subspaces offer a controllable, interpretable, and generalizable framework for modulating LLM behavior without sacrificing task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"调制(modulation)"新设定与PaSS范式，将人格建模为潜空间中的多维子空间，通过迭代零空间投影(INLP)提取并控制人格特征，实现无需重训练的推理时行为调制。
AI.motivation: 现有方法(激活引导、提示式人格诱导)将人格简化为单一主导方向，忽略了在剥离主导信号后才显现的更精细、嵌套的人格特质；同时现实中人格语境往往已嵌入内容中，需要的是放大或抑制已有特质，而非从零注入。
AI.method: 提出PaSS推理时控制范式，将人格建模为模型潜空间中的多维子空间，无需监督对比样本；利用迭代零空间投影(INLP)，通过迭代式概念擦除线性地逐步分离出人格专属方向，并将其应用于调制人格引导的生成过程，全程无需重训练。
AI.result: 在MATH-500、TinyAlpaca、GSM8K、IFEval等多样化任务上对六种人格进行因果评估，结果表明迭代式子空间提取能捕捉人格背后多样的特质，相比单方向加性方法实现更强、更大幅度的调制，同时保持内容保真度；并进一步分析子空间内各剥离方向所编码的不同人格行为侧面。
AI.conclusion: 人格子空间为调制LLM行为提供了一个可控、可解释且可泛化的框架，且不牺牲任务性能。

title: OctMesh: A Unified Octree-Hierarchical Framework for Lossless Triangle Mesh Compression
summary: Lossless triangle mesh compression must preserve both vertex positions and connectivity. Octrees support learned point cloud geometry coding and progressive refinement, but extending them to meshes requires a compatible connectivity representation. Unlike the eight occupancy decisions of a voxel, a parent edge can develop into varied child connections, making edge refinement difficult to model with a compact prediction prior. We propose OctMesh, a learned framework that codes geometry and connectivity on a shared octree hierarchy. Its key observation is that octree pooling produces parents with either one child or two to eight children. Child edges are then grouped by their endpoint parents' types and whether the endpoints share a parent. Each candidate group contains children from just one parent or two connected parents. The resulting four categories define small, fixed-shape prediction tasks: connections uniquely determined by the parent graph are inherited without bits, while three neural predictors estimate probabilities for the remaining candidates. These probabilities guide arithmetic coding of the actual edge symbols. Binarized predictions of within-parent connections provide context for predicting connections between different parents. A graph-aware parent feature extractor combines local geometry, parent connectivity and global shape. The connectivity models use dedicated weights at coarse levels and share weights at fine levels. Residual edges and a finest-level face-selection payload complete the reconstruction. On 256 frames from eight MPEG V-DMC test sequences, OctMesh losslessly recovers the finest-level vertex-coordinate, edge and unoriented face sets at an average of 7.033 bits per face, 12.8% below V-Mesh. The same hierarchical representation supports nine levels of progressive vertex-and-edge refinement.

AI.tldr: OctMesh：在共享八叉树层级上学习编码网格几何与连接关系，实现无损三角形网格压缩，平均7.033 bits/face，较V-Mesh降低12.8%，并支持九级渐进式细化。
AI.motivation: 无损三角形网格压缩需同时保留顶点位置与连接关系。八叉树支持学习式点云几何编码与渐进细化，但将其扩展到网格需要兼容的连接表示。与体素的八种占用决策不同，父边可发展为多样的子连接，使边细化难以用紧凑的预测先验建模。
AI.method: 提出OctMesh，在共享八叉树层级上编码几何与连接。观察到八叉树池化产生的父节点只有一子或二至八子；按端点父节点类型及是否共享父节点对子边分组，得到四类小规模定形预测任务：父图唯一确定的连接无比特继承，其余候选由三个神经预测器估计概率并引导算术编码。组内连接的二值化预测为跨父连接提供上下文；图感知父特征提取器融合局部几何、父连接与全局形状；连接模型在粗层级用独立权重、细层级共享权重；残差边与最细层级面选择载荷完成重建。
AI.result: 在八个MPEG V-DMC测试序列的256帧上，OctMesh无损恢复最细层顶点坐标、边与无向面集合，平均7.033 bits/face，较V-Mesh降低12.8%。
AI.conclusion: 同一层级表示支持九级渐进式顶点与边细化，验证了共享八叉树层级联合编码几何与连接的有效性。

title: EnvDreamer: Large-Scale Multimodal-to-Environment Generation for Embodied AI
summary: Large datasets and high capacity models have accelerated progress in vision and language. This work introduces a platform aimed at bringing comparable gains to embodied learning, world models, and robotics. We present EnvDreamer, a framework that uses large language and vision language models to generate Unreal Engine 5 environments for embodied AI and robot training. EnvDreamer enables sampling of large, diverse, interactive, customizable, and validator passed virtual environments for training and evaluation across navigation, interaction, and manipulation. We illustrate the platform with a large set of generated scenes and simple baselines. Policies trained on EnvDreamer generated environments, without explicit mapping or human task supervision, achieve competitive results on multiple embodied benchmarks spanning navigation, rearrangement, and manipulation. EnvDreamer also supports image-conditioned reconstruction for real-to-sim studies. Finally, we release EnvDreamer-20k, a dataset of 20,000 validator passed environments with task programs, scene graphs, trajectories, and metadata to support reproducible benchmarking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EnvDreamer，一个利用大语言与视觉语言模型生成 UE5 虚拟环境的平台，用于具身学习、世界模型与机器人训练，并发布 20k 环境数据集。
AI.motivation: 大模型在视觉与语言领域进展迅速，但具身学习与机器人领域缺乏大规模、多样化、可交互的训练环境，本文希望将类似收益引入该领域。
AI.method: 使用大语言模型和视觉语言模型，自动生成 Unreal Engine 5 环境；支持采样大量多样、可定制、可交互且通过校验的虚拟场景，覆盖导航、交互与操作任务，并支持图像条件下的真实到仿真重建。
AI.result: 在 EnvDreamer 生成环境上训练的策略，无需显式建图或人工任务监督，即在导航、重排与操作等多项具身基准上取得具竞争力结果；同时展示大量生成场景与基线。
AI.conclusion: EnvDreamer 为具身 AI 与机器人提供可扩展的虚拟环境生成平台，并发布 EnvDreamer-20k 数据集（含任务程序、场景图、轨迹与元数据），支持可复现的基准评测。

title: Blocking at the Boundary: Auditing Long-Horizon Agents against Staged Prompt Injection
comment: 29 pages, 10 figures, 20 tables. Code and data: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/audit-artifact-E593
summary:
Long-horizon agents consume external content, invoke tools, and modify persistent state. Indirect prompt injection can exploit task-specific context, propagate across causally connected stages, and alter a consequential action while the workflow continues; we term this staged prompt injection.
  We build an automated, feedback-guided attack generation pipeline and apply it to Claude Code and Codex in their native runtimes. The confirmed attacks span eight workflow scenarios, seven attack goals, and six injection surfaces, showing that production agents are vulnerable to context-aware, multi-step injection over long horizons. Stopping such attacks requires a decision before each consequential action: input screening and completed-run evaluation cannot locate the intervention point, and existing pre-action methods use incompatible units and labels. We therefore formulate boundary action auditing: given initial context, a trajectory prefix, and a fully specified pending message or tool call, an auditor predicts Pass or Block before its effect occurs. Pairing attacked and benign executions yields a 479-pair, 3,112-unit benchmark.
  We further propose Path-Aligned Attribution (PAA), a training-free auditor that decomposes pending actions into operative elements and traces what supplied each value and guided each decision. PAA blocks only when the model attributes an unwarranted, material effect on an element to an attacker-reachable source that either provides unqualified steering or conflicts with visible evidence. Under full-benchmark fail-open scoring with Claude Sonnet 5, PAA reaches 86% Block recall at a 6-8% false-block rate (FBR), whereas ARGUS reaches 44-47% recall at 16-33% FBR. Under the same backend, on the tool calls that all three auditors natively support, PAA has higher recall and lower FBR than VIGIL and ARGUS; all paired 95% confidence intervals exclude zero.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"分阶段提示注入"(staged prompt injection)概念，揭示长周期智能体在跨阶段因果链中易受间接注入影响，并构建自动攻击生成管线在Claude Code与Codex真实运行时验证；进而提出"边界动作审计"任务及免训练审计器PAA，在479对基准上以86%拦截召回率和6-8%误拦率显著优于ARGUS等基线。
AI.motivation: 长周期智能体会消费外部内容、调用工具并修改持久状态，间接提示注入可借助任务特定上下文在因果相连的各阶段间传播，并在工作流持续推进时改变关键动作。现有的事前输入筛查与事后运行评估都无法定位干预点，且既有事前方法使用不兼容的单位与标签，因此需要一个能在每个关键动作发生前做出通过/拦截决策的审计机制。
AI.method: 作者首先构建自动化、反馈引导的攻击生成管线，在Claude Code和Codex的原生运行时中实施攻击。为应对攻击，提出"边界动作审计"任务：给定初始上下文、轨迹前缀以及一个完全指定的待执行消息或工具调用，审计器须在其产生效果前预测Pass或Block。通过配对受攻击与良性执行，构建479对、3112单元的基准。进一步提出免训练审计器PAA（Path-Aligned Attribution），将待执行动作分解为操作性元素，追踪每个值的来源与每个决策的引导依据；仅当模型将某元素上不合理的实质性影响归因于攻击者可及来源（该来源要么提供无条件引导，要么与可见证据冲突）时才拦截。
AI.result: 确认的攻击覆盖8个工作流场景、7个攻击目标和6个注入面，表明生产级智能体在长周期上面临上下文感知的多步注入风险。在Claude Sonnet 5后端、全基准fail-open评分下，PAA达到86%的Block召回率，误拦率(FBR)仅6-8%；而ARGUS召回率44-47%、FBR达16-33%。在同一后端下，对三种审计器均原生支持的工具调用，PAA的召回率高于VIGIL与ARGUS且FBR更低；所有配对的95%置信区间均不包含零。
AI.conclusion: 长周期生产级智能体确实易受分阶段提示注入攻击，且此类攻击需要动作发生前的即时决策才能阻止。边界动作审计被证明是可行的问题形式化，所提PAA作为免训练审计器在召回率与误拦率上均优于现有基线，为长周期智能体的安全防护提供了有效路径。

title: Steering Speech-Language Models: Training-Free Task Specialization via Contrastive Activation Addition
summary: Activation steering has proven effective for controlling the behavior of Large Language Models (LLMs) at inference time, but its application to SpeechLLMs remains new, and training-free steering approaches for such models are still largely unexplored. We propose a training-free Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) protocol that derives steering vectors for common speech tasks (e.g. transcription) in SpeechLLMs from a small number of labeled utterances. We showcase that adding these vectors in the representation space, at inference time, enforces better the targeted speech task. We further show that, when combined with prompting, these vectors yield to consistent improvement over prompting alone on most evaluated tasks such as Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) or Emotion Recognition (ER), and transfer to out-of-domain data. We additionally demonstrate the usefulness of script-normalization directions to enforce the target script of a specific language.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种免训练的对比激活添加（CAA）协议，通过少量标注语音样本为 SpeechLLM 推导引导向量，在推理时于表示空间注入以强化目标语音任务，结合提示可在 ASR、情感识别等任务上稳定提升并具备跨域迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 激活引导在 LLM 推理阶段控制行为已被验证有效，但在 SpeechLLM 上仍是新兴方向，尤其缺乏免训练的引导方法，因此作者希望填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出免训练的对比激活添加（CAA）协议：利用少量带标签的语音样本，为转录等常见语音任务推导引导向量；在推理时将这些向量加到表示空间中；并与提示（prompting）结合使用；此外还构造“脚本归一化方向”以强制特定语言的书写系统。
AI.result: 在表示空间加入引导向量能更好地强制目标语音任务；与提示结合后，在 ASR、情感识别（ER）等多数评测任务上相较单独提示有一致提升，并可迁移到域外数据；脚本归一化方向被证明可有效强制目标脚本。
AI.conclusion: 免训练 CAA 是控制 SpeechLLM 行为的有效手段，与提示互补，兼具跨域泛化与语言脚本控制能力。

title: A Geometric-Transformation Feature-Adaptive Manifold Restoration Method for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation of Remote Sensing Images
summary: The semantic information of objects in remote sensing images is typically invariant to geometric transformations from the dihedral group D4. However, SAM3-based open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) methods often exhibit inconsistent responses to different geometric transformations. To exploit this property and improve the stability of OVSS for remote sensing images, we propose a feature-adaptive manifold repair method based on dihedral-group geometric transformations. First, we introduce multi-scale harmonic-guided D4 view selection (MH-D4VS) to select complementary candidate views from a set of geometrically transformed views. Next, we propose original-view-anchored adaptive manifold repair (OAMR), which uses the original view as an anchor and reliable cross-view information to selectively repair locally unreliable visual features. Finally, we develop pixel decoder test-time adaptation (PD-TTA) for SAM3, which fine-tunes only the parameters of the GroupNorm layers online during inference, thereby enhancing the model's ability to adapt to sample-level distribution shifts. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves an average mIoU of 55.6% across eight remote sensing semantic segmentation benchmarks and delivers consistent performance improvements under different SAM3-based inference frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对SAM3开放词汇语义分割对D4几何变换响应不一致的问题，提出基于二面体群几何变换的特征自适应流形修复方法，包含MH-D4VS、OAMR和PD-TTA三个模块。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像中目标的语义信息通常在二面体群D4的几何变换下保持不变，但基于SAM3的开放词汇语义分割方法对不同几何变换的响应往往不一致，导致分割稳定性不足。
AI.method: 提出特征自适应流形修复方法：(1) 多尺度谐波引导D4视图选择（MH-D4VS），从几何变换视图集中选取互补的候选视图；(2) 原视图锚定自适应流形修复（OAMR），以原视图为锚点，利用可靠的跨视图信息选择性修复局部不可靠的视觉特征；(3) 面向SAM3的像素解码器测试时自适应（PD-TTA），推理时在线仅微调GroupNorm层参数，增强对样本级分布偏移的适应能力。
AI.result: 在八个遥感语义分割基准上平均mIoU达到55.6%，并在不同基于SAM3的推理框架下均取得一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用D4几何变换不变性并修复特征流形，可有效提升SAM3在遥感图像开放词汇语义分割中的稳定性与性能。

title: MOIRA: Mass-Oriented Indexing with Ragged Attention for Long-Context Decoding
summary: Long-context decoding is limited by memory bandwidth, because every output token reads the KV cache of every layer. Sparse decoding reduces this cost by reading only part of the KV cache. We observe that the number of pages a query needs varies widely across KV heads, layers and steps. Fixed budgets are simple, but they are sized for demanding cases and tuned per workload; adaptive budgets follow this variation more flexibly, but existing designs pay for it with extra selection cost or training. At the kernel level, FlashAttention-3 (FA3) and FlashInfer are designed for rows of similar length: with page lists whose length differs per KV head, they either pad the lists (forfeiting much of the sparse saving), leave thread blocks unbalanced, or rely on a host-side plan that runs outside the CUDA graph. We propose MOIRA, a training-free sparse decode path in vLLM whose budget adapts per KV head and per layer. For every request, layer, KV head and step, a coverage rule keeps the smallest set of pages whose estimated attention mass reaches a fraction $γ$. A new kernel, self-planning attention, lets each thread block derive its own share of the work from the list lengths, so the whole decode step stays inside the CUDA graph. On an H200, at RULER's 128k context, MOIRA with $γ=0.99$ matches dense accuracy while reading about 30% of the pages and reduces the time per output token (TPOT) by 2.2-2.5$\times$ relative to dense FA3; with $γ=0.98$ it reduces TPOT by 2.7$\times$ and stays within the noise of dense. Under high serving load it raises throughput by up to 51%. These results suggest that a budget adapted per head and layer, paired with a kernel that keeps such budgets inside the CUDA graph, makes sparse decoding both flexible and fast.

AI.tldr: MOIRA：一种免训练的稀疏解码方案，预算按KV头和层自适应，配合自规划注意力内核，使稀疏解码既灵活又高效。
AI.motivation: 长上下文解码受内存带宽限制，因为每生成一个token都需读取所有层的KV缓存。稀疏解码可减少读取量，但存在两大问题：(1) 查询所需的页数在不同KV头、层和步骤间差异很大，固定预算需按最苛刻情形设定且需逐工作负载调参，现有自适应预算方案则以额外选择开销或训练为代价；(2) 内核层面，FA3和FlashInfer针对等长行设计，面对每KV头页列表长度不同的情况会填充列表（损失稀疏收益）、导致线程块不均衡，或依赖CUDA图之外的宿主端计划。
AI.method: 提出MOIRA——vLLM中免训练的稀疏解码路径，预算按KV头和层自适应。对每个请求、层、KV头和步骤，用覆盖率规则选取最小页集合，使估计注意力质量达到比例γ。新内核“自规划注意力”让每个线程块根据列表长度自行推导工作量，使整个解码步骤保持在CUDA图内。
AI.result: 在H200上、RULER的128k上下文中，γ=0.99时MOIRA匹配稠密精度，仅读取约30%的页，且相对稠密FA3将每输出token时间(TPOT)降低2.2-2.5倍；γ=0.98时TPOT降低2.7倍且在稠密噪声范围内。高负载下吞吐量提升最高达51%。
AI.conclusion: 按头和层自适应的预算，配合能将其保持在CUDA图内的内核，使稀疏解码既灵活又快速。

title: What a Policy Gate Can and Cannot Know: Measured Boundaries of Cross-Platform Command Adjudication
comment: 13 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Supplementary material and reproducibility artifact are included as ancillary files
summary: Gateways that adjudicate an agent's actions before they execute are only as good as their understanding of the action. We study a policy gate that never parses shell syntax: it consumes a typed, realised action (verb, operands, resolved zones, program-object identity) and decides ALLOW, ASK or DENY. Working on a Linux twin of the Windows benchmark of our previous study [1], we ask how faithfully it adjudicates, what survives translation, and whether deciding stays affordable as the system is used. A frozen 61-case table scores 61/61 in two rounds with no false allow; a 50-operator mutation campaign kills 46 of 50 mutants (92.0%), with all four surviving mutants classified. An 82-row audit yields 43 re-expressions, 21 carrier differences, 16 study-specific inapplicable rows and two unresolved cases; of 25 rows labelled "no counterpart," four remain unmapped here. Consulted by the executor, 25 escapes become zero with no benign payload blocked. In an exploratory one-gateway snapshot, three unauthenticated endpoint labels produce case-level non-refusal majorities of 81.8-98.0%, but immediate-execution majorities of 4.0-52.5%. Adjudication reads no accumulating state; credential verification does, scanning its whole ledger. We report that cost and the fix we would make.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一种不解析 shell 语法的策略网关，通过类型化的已实现动作做 ALLOW/ASK/DENY 裁决，并在 Linux 环境下复现 Windows 基准，评估其裁决忠实度、跨平台可迁移性与运行开销。
AI.motivation: 现有网关在代理动作执行前做裁决，但其效果完全取决于对动作的理解程度。作者希望摆脱易出错的 shell 语法解析，转而基于语义化的动作表示，并验证该方案在换平台后的可靠性与可负担性。
AI.method: 以类型化的已实现动作（动词、操作数、解析后的区域、程序—对象身份）作为输入，实现从不解析 shell 语法的策略网关，输出三态裁决。在 Windows 基准的 Linux 孪生版本上，用冻结的 61 案例表、50 算子变异活动和 82 行审计进行评估，并将网关接入执行器验证逃逸拦截，另做单网关探索性快照与凭证验证成本分析。
AI.result: 冻结 61 案例表两轮均得 61/61，无错误放行；50 个变异体中击杀 46 个（92.0%），4 个存活变异体均已归类。82 行审计得到 43 处重表达、21 处载体差异、16 行研究特有不可适用项和 2 个未决案例；标为"无对应项"的 25 行中有 4 行仍未映射。接入执行器后 25 次逃逸降为 0，且无误伤良性载荷。探索性快照中，三个未认证端点标签的案例级不拒绝多数为 81.8–98.0%，但立即执行多数仅为 4.0–52.5%。裁决不读取累积状态，而凭证验证需扫描整个账本。
AI.conclusion: 基于类型化已实现动作的裁决在跨平台迁移后仍保持高忠实度与低误放行率，并能有效消除逃逸且不阻断正常载荷；其开销与凭证验证的状态扫描成本构成实际约束，作者据此报告了相应成本及拟采取的修复方案。

title: Understanding Errors in LLM-Based Question Answering over Imperfect Tables
summary: We investigate error discovery and handling in question answering over imperfect tables through controlled studies across three large language models (LLMs) on human-reviewed RADAR-T examples. Answering questions over these tables requires handling errors that can affect the answer. We vary row order and compare original, error-marked, and repaired tables to test whether discovery depends on where errors appear and whether providing their locations is sufficient for accurate question answering. First, reordering rows changes error discovery even when the table contents and gold answer remain unchanged. Complete discovery is higher for back than front placements and, averaged over the tested mean positions, for compact than widely spaced layouts. Second, providing verified error locations alone is insufficient for accurate QA, leaving a substantial accuracy gap between error-marked and repaired tables. Providing tables with human-reviewed repairs already applied raises code-assisted QA accuracy by 39.0-59.1 percentage points over the error-marked tables across the three systems. GBDI, a simple workflow, puts these findings into practice by combining error discovery across shuffled table views with explicit guidance for verifying and handling the reported errors. On RADAR-T, GBDI raises observed QA accuracy by 3.8-18.5 percentage points over a code-agent baseline across five systems. These results highlight the importance of both reliable error discovery and effective error handling in question answering over imperfect tables. Our anonymous repository is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/GBDI-ICLR-2027-85BD/

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在不完美表格上问答时的错误发现与处理问题，发现行顺序影响错误发现，仅标注错误位置不足以提升问答准确率，而提供修复后的表格可大幅提高准确率；据此提出GBDI工作流。在新数据上GBDI相比代码智能体基线提升3.8-18.5个百分点。
AI.motivation: 在包含错误的表格上进行问答需要处理影响答案的错误。作者想探究：(1)错误发现是否依赖于错误出现的位置；(2)仅提供错误位置是否足以实现准确问答。这两个问题对于设计可靠的表格问答系统至关重要。
AI.method: 在人类审核的RADAR-T示例上，针对三个大语言模型进行受控实验。通过改变行顺序，并对比原始表格、错误标注表格和修复后表格来测试错误发现与问答准确率。基于发现提出GBDI工作流：结合多个打乱表格视图中的错误发现，并显式引导验证与处理报告的错误。
AI.result: (1)重排行顺序会改变错误发现，即使表格内容和标准答案不变；靠后放置的完整发现率高于靠前放置，紧凑布局高于分散布局。(2)仅提供经验证的错误位置不足以实现准确问答，错误标注与修复表格间存在显著准确率差距；提供人工审核修复后的表格使代码辅助问答准确率提升39.0-59.1个百分点。GBDI在RADAR-T上相比代码智能体基线提升3.8-18.5个百分点（五个系统）。
AI.conclusion: 在不完美表格问答中，可靠的错误发现和有效的错误处理都至关重要。仅定位错误是不够的，实际修复才能带来大幅准确率提升，GBDI验证了这些发现的实际可行性。

title: Rethinking Long-Video Efficiency: A Joint Allocation Perspective on Frames, Pixels, and Front-End Latency
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://sixundong.com/projects/lohi
summary: Efficient long-video understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) is often framed as selecting informative frames or visual tokens at a fixed native resolution. We show that per-frame resolution can instead be traded for denser temporal coverage, while front-end decoding latency depends on the size of the candidate pool rather than the final token budget. An empirical study across multiple VLMs and long-video benchmarks yields three findings: dense low-resolution sampling outperforms sparse native-resolution sampling at matched token budgets; resolution-sensitive tasks benefit from selected high-resolution frames; and front-end decoding dominates wall time for hour-long videos. Motivated by these findings, we introduce LoHi, a training-free, single-pass framework that combines a dense low-resolution video stream with sparse high-resolution image frames through the VLM's native video and image pathways. LoHi-Anchor selects high-resolution frames using codec I-frame metadata, while LoHi-SemDiv uses query relevance and visual diversity over CLIP features. Across three long-video benchmarks, LoHi improves average accuracy by 10.6 percentage points over the native-resolution baseline at a matched token budget and by 5.2 percentage points over the strongest prior efficiency method. It also reduces front-end decoding latency by up to 7x on hour-long videos. Project page: https://sixundong.com/projects/lohi

AI.tldr: LoHi：无需训练、单次通过的框架，用密集低分辨率视频流+稀疏高分辨率帧，在同等token预算下提升长视频理解准确率并大幅降低解码延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频VLM效率方法多在固定原生分辨率下选择信息帧或视觉token，未考虑分辨率与时序密度的权衡，且忽略了前端解码延迟对总耗时的主导影响。
AI.method: 基于实证发现，提出LoHi：结合密集低分辨率视频流与稀疏高分辨率图像帧，通过VLM原生视频/图像通路处理。两种变体：LoHi-Anchor用编解码I帧元数据选高分辨率帧；LoHi-SemDiv用CLIP特征的查询相关性和视觉多样性选帧。
AI.result: 在三个长视频基准上，同等token预算下平均准确率较原生分辨率基线提升10.6个百分点，较最强先有效率方法提升5.2个百分点；小时级视频前端解码延迟最多降低7倍。
AI.conclusion: 将每帧分辨率换取更密集的时序覆盖是高效长视频理解的有效方向；LoHi以训练-free单次通过方式同时提升准确率并显著降低前端解码延迟。

title: From Latent Space to Jacobian Space: Measuring, Evading, and Training Against Safety-Content Accessibility
summary: Output-only safety monitoring sees only the end of a model's computation, yet the model computes its answer before emitting it: what it is internally poised to say is safety-critical. Jacobian-space (J-space) readouts, linear maps from hidden states to the output vocabulary via the model's input-output Jacobian, have been proposed as a window on behaviorally accessible internal content, and a first safety protocol (JADR) showed that danger recognition is readable there. What remains unknown is how this accessible content relates to the latent-space safety geometry studied by representation engineering, and how safety training shapes it. We introduce two quantitative bridges: (i) a transport-amplification profile $A_\ell$, measuring how strongly a latent safety direction is carried toward output space by each layer's Jacobian, and (ii) a paired base-vs-tuned protocol that attributes accessibility to training provenance. Across four small model pairs (135M to 1.5B, three lens-fit seeds), tuned checkpoints concentrate recognition in upper-middle layers, and at 0.5B DPO installs refusal while J-space recognition drops to chance: training can widen the accessibility gap exactly where behavioral safety looks best. A deployment audit closes the loop: monitor-aware GCG-style suffixes suppress the prompt-side monitor at zero behavioral cost at every scale; only a learned monitor rung resists its own adaptive re-attack; the training-time defense fails its re-attack at every penalty weight; steering shows the amplification profile is descriptive, not causal; and continuous-prefix optimization fails where discrete search succeeds. Safety monitoring, training, and evaluation must operate on accessibility itself, not on outputs alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Jacobian空间(J-space)读出与表征工程所研究的潜在安全几何之间的关系,以及安全训练如何塑造这种关系,并提出两个定量桥梁:传输放大剖面A_ℓ与基座-微调配对协议。
AI.motivation: 输出端安全监控只能看到模型计算的末端,而模型在输出前就已内部计算好答案,其内部"准备说"的内容对安全至关重要。虽然J-space读出被提出作为观察行为可及内部内容的窗口,且首个安全协议JADR显示危险识别可在此读出,但该可及内容与表征工程所研究的潜在安全几何的关系,以及安全训练如何塑造它,仍属未知。
AI.method: 提出两个定量桥梁:(i)传输放大剖面A_ℓ,测量潜在安全方向被每层Jacobian携带至输出空间的强度;(ii)基座-微调配对协议,将可及性归因于训练来源。在四个小型模型对(135M至1.5B、三个lens拟合种子)上进行实验,并开展部署审计,包括monitor-aware GCG式后缀、学习型监控、训练时防御、steering与连续前缀优化等测试。
AI.result: 微调检查点将识别集中于中上层;在0.5B上DPO安装了拒绝行为,而J-space识别降至随机水平——训练恰好在行为安全表现最佳处扩大了可及性鸿沟。部署审计发现:monitor-aware GCG式后缀在所有规模上以零行为代价压制提示侧监控;只有学习型监控能抵抗其自身的自适应再攻击;训练时防御在所有惩罚权重下都无法抵御再攻击;steering表明放大剖面是描述性的而非因果性的;连续前缀优化在离散搜索成功处失败。
AI.conclusion: 安全监控、训练与评估必须针对可及性本身,而非仅针对输出。训练可能在行为安全看起来最好的地方反而扩大内部可及性差距,因此需要以可及性为核心的监控与评估框架。

title: Functionally Equivalent or Not? Graph-Grounded Differential Surrogate Execution for Code Equivalence
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables, accepted by NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Verifiable Coding
summary: Determining whether two programs are functionally equivalent is central to code modernization, patch validation, refactoring, and code-generation evaluation. Yet the usual signals are incomplete: tests cover only finite inputs, textual similarity confuses implementation with behavior, and unconstrained LLM judgments are difficult to audit. Direct execution is often impossible when a program depends on an obsolete, licensed, unavailable, or unsafe environment. We introduce FEAgent, a selective equivalence assessor agent that combines typed program-graph evidence with differential surrogate execution. FEAgent first aligns public interfaces and behaviorally relevant graph anchors, then issues bounded queries over call-flow, control-flow, data-flow, type, import, and effect relations. Next, a branch-aware generator agent proposes discriminating inputs, and two blinded LLM surrogates independently predict source and target observables. Every claim and predicted divergence is recorded in an evidence ledger. A deterministic reconciler then returns EQUIVALENT, INEQUIVALENT, or UNCLEAR rather than forcing a verdict when paths are uncovered or evidence conflicts. We evaluate FEAgent on function-level equivalence and repository-level bug patches, where the existing oracle is a benchmark label or a passing test suite. Every disagreement with that oracle is adjudicated by direct execution, revealing errors in benchmark labels and behavioral divergences missed by unit-test-only scoring. On EquiBench, execution confirms FEAgent's disagreements with published labels on 216 of 1,200 evaluated pairs (18.0%); on SWE-bench Verified, 94 of 331 test-passing agent patches (28.4%) diverge from the reference patch. FEAgent thus serves as an audit layer between testing and formal verification, keeping its evidence reviewable and its uncertainty explicit without claiming a proof of equivalence.

AI.tldr: 提出FEAgent，一种选择性程序等价性评估智能体，融合类型化程序图证据与差分代理执行，输出EQUIVALENT/INEQUIVALENT/UNCLEAR三态判定，并在基准上揭示标签错误与测试遗漏的行为分歧。
AI.motivation: 判断两个程序是否功能等价对代码现代化、补丁验证、重构与代码生成评估至关重要，但现有信号不完整：测试仅覆盖有限输入、文本相似度混淆实现与行为、无约束LLM判断难以审计；且当程序依赖过时、受限、不可得或不安全环境时无法直接执行。
AI.method: FEAgent先对齐公共接口与行为相关的图锚点，再围绕调用流、控制流、数据流、类型、导入与效应关系发出有界查询；随后由分支感知生成器提出判别性输入，两个盲化LLM代理独立预测源与目标的观测结果；所有主张与预测分歧记录在证据账本中；最后由确定性协调器返回三态判定，在路径未覆盖或证据冲突时不强行下结论。
AI.result: 在函数级等价性与仓库级bug补丁上评估（以基准标签或通过测试套件为现有oracle），对每个分歧用直接执行裁决。EquiBench上，执行确认FEAgent与已发表标签的分歧达1200对中的216对（18.0%）；SWE-bench Verified上，331个通过测试的智能体补丁中有94个（28.4%）与参考补丁存在行为分歧。
AI.conclusion: FEAgent可作为测试与形式化验证之间的审计层，保持证据可复核、不确定性显式，同时不宣称等价性证明。

title: Who Is Your Agent Serving? Provider-Side Indirect Prompt Injection in Proactive Agents
summary: Proactive personal agents increasingly decide what to recommend, how to personalize advice, and what follow-up assistance to offer, creating a new user-decision attack surface for provider-side indirect prompt injection. We show that an external provider need not access private user context, compromise the agent, or gain additional permissions: by controlling only content associated with its own target, it can redirect an otherwise benign agent to advance that target, recruit legitimately available user context to justify it, and proactively reduce the friction of adoption. We characterize this failure mode through Target Control, Private Binding, and Prospective Support, which respectively steer what the agent advances, how it connects the target to the user, and what target-specific assistance it offers next. Across three proactive-agent environments and six simulated user models, the full attack increases target authorization in all tested environment-user-model combinations, with a macro gain of up to 77.4 percentage points. Controlled replay shows that correct user-target binding is more consequential than additional proposal detail alone, while a multi-turn extension reveals that provider objectives can remain influential even without final authorization by reshaping how the agent responds to user constraints and resistance. These findings expose a broader trust boundary: capabilities designed to serve the user can be redirected toward objectives originating outside the user-agent relationship.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了主动式个人代理存在的供应商侧间接提示注入攻击面：外部供应商仅通过控制与自身目标相关的内容，无需访问用户隐私上下文或提升权限，即可引导代理推进其目标并利用合法用户上下文进行辩护，最高带来77.4个百分点的目标授权提升。
AI.motivation: 主动式个人代理越来越多地决定推荐内容、个性化建议和后续协助，这为用户决策引入了新的攻击面。作者希望证明外部供应商无需入侵代理、无需额外权限、也无需访问用户私密上下文，仅通过控制与自身目标相关的内容，就能实现对新用户决策攻击面的利用。
AI.method: 将攻击表征为三个要素：Target Control（目标控制，决定代理推进什么）、Private Binding（隐私绑定，将目标与用户上下文关联以证明合理性）、Prospective Support（前瞻支持，提供降低采纳阻力的目标专属协助）。在三个主动代理环境和六个模拟用户模型上进行测试，并开展控制重放实验和多轮扩展实验。
AI.result: 完整攻击在所有测试的环境—用户—模型组合中均提升了目标授权，宏观收益最高达77.4个百分点。控制重放表明，正确的用户—目标绑定比单纯增加提案细节更具决定性；多轮扩展显示，即便最终未获授权，供应商目标仍可通过改变代理对用户约束和抗拒的响应方式而保持影响力。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了一个更广泛的信任边界问题：本应服务于用户的能力可能被重定向，用于推进源自用户—代理关系之外的目标。这提示主动式代理的设计需重新审视供应商内容的信任假设。

title: WNet: Discrete Wavelets Transform for Efficient Token Mixing
summary: In a Transformer, token mixing is the step that lets each token draw information from other tokens, and it dominates the cost of encoding long sequences. Self-attention does this mixing very well: every token weighs every other token by content, which gives strong contextual modeling. That all-pairs comparison is also why its cost grows quadratically with sequence length. We introduce WNet, a Transformer encoder that replaces self-attention with token mixing based on the discrete wavelet transform (DWT). Three attention-free mixers recombine the scales: by linear fusion, by learned gating, or by letting each token choose its scales. A hybrid adds self-attention in the last layer only. A receptive-field analysis shows that wavelet mixers built from two-tap filters, such as Haar, never relate tokens outside fixed blocks, however deep the network, even when the filters are learned. Longer filters reach the whole sequence within two layers. We pre-train every model with masked language modeling on a fixed-token subset of C4 and fine-tune on GLUE, using one controlled setup with size-matched BERT and FNet baselines and a control that cannot mix tokens. The token-gated mixer trains as fast as attention at 256 tokens and 2.7 times faster at 4,096.

AI.tldr: WNet 是一种用离散小波变换（DWT）替代自注意力的 Transformer 编码器，通过三种无注意力混合器实现 token 混合，并分析感受野，发现 Haar 等两抽头滤波器无法跨固定块交互，而更长滤波器两层内可达全序列。
AI.motivation: 自注意力通过全对比较实现强上下文建模，但其代价随序列长度二次增长，成为长序列编码的主要开销来源，因此需要一种更高效的 token 混合方式。
AI.method: 提出 WNet，用基于离散小波变换（DWT）的 token 混合替代自注意力，包含三种无注意力混合器：线性融合、学习门控、以及让每个 token 自行选择尺度；另设仅在最后一层加入自注意力的混合变体。通过感受野分析研究不同滤波器的信息传播范围。在 C4 固定 token 子集上以掩码语言建模预训练，并在 GLUE 上微调，与规模匹配的 BERT、FNet 基线及一个无法混合 token 的对照进行受控比较。
AI.result: 感受野分析表明，基于两抽头滤波器（如 Haar）的小波混合器无论网络多深、滤波器是否可学习，都无法关联固定块之外的 token；更长的滤波器则可在两层内覆盖整个序列。token 门控混合器在 256 token 时训练速度与注意力相当，在 4,096 token 时快 2.7 倍。
AI.conclusion: 用 DWT 的小波混合替代自注意力是可行的，滤波器长度决定感受野范围，token 门控混合器在长序列上具有明显的速度优势。

title: Trust the View That Sees the Target: Mining Cross-View Conflicts for Reliability-Gated Disaster Damage Assessment
comment: 4 pages, 3 figures; Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 5th ACM SIGSPATIAL International Workshop on Searching and Mining Large Collections of Geospatial Data (GeoSearch '26), held November 3-6, 2026, in Riverside, California, USA
summary: After a disaster, building damage is assessed from overhead tiles and ground-level photographs, and most methods fuse the two views symmetrically, trusting both equally for every building. This paper focuses on the samples where that assumption fails: the conflict cases, on which two independently trained single-view models disagree. We mine such cases from three paired collections (inspection photographs from the 2025 Eaton wildfire and street-view panoramas from Hurricanes Ian and Milton, each matched to very-high-resolution overhead tiles), where they make up 10-33% of the data. On these samples an oracle that simply trusts the correct view beats every fusion method we tested by 0.37-0.41 accuracy, and the gap survives longer training, calibration, and backbone changes. We recover part of it with a visibility-conditioned reliability gate: a linear model that decides which view to trust from building-visibility features, calibrated per-view confidences, and the disagreement itself. On the wildfire data the gate is the only method that significantly beats calibrated probability averaging (+0.051 on conflicts, p=0.0001) and end-to-end fusion (+0.072, p<10^-4); on the panoramic datasets it matches them. A controlled field-of-view experiment explains why: cropping panoramas toward the building doubles the benefit of fusion, whereas random crops of the same size do not. Finally, the spatial density of conflicts predicts tile-level damage without labels (Spearman r=0.615, p=0.001). Mining conflicts turns "does fusion help?" into "which view should be trusted, where, and why?".

AI.tldr: 该论文研究灾后建筑损毁评估中双视角（航拍与地面）融合失效的"冲突样本"，并提出基于可见性条件的可靠性门控方法来决定信任哪个视角。
AI.motivation: 大多数灾后损毁评估方法对称地融合航拍与地面两个视角，对每栋建筑同等信任两者，但这一假设在部分样本上失效（即两个单视角模型判断不一致的冲突样本），作者希望聚焦这些失败样本。
AI.method: 从三个配对数据集（2025年Eaton野火的检查照片、飓风Ian和Milton的街景全景图，各自匹配超高分辨率航拍瓦片）中挖掘冲突样本；提出可见性条件可靠性门控（linear model），依据建筑可见性特征、逐视角校准置信度及不一致性决定信任哪个视角；并开展控制性视场角实验。
AI.result: 冲突样本占数据10-33%；简单的"信任正确视角"oracle比所有测试的融合方法准确率高0.37-0.41，且该差距在更长训练、校准和骨干网络变化下依然存在；在野火数据上门控是唯一显著优于校准概率平均（冲突样本+0.051，p=0.0001）和端到端融合（+0.072，p<10^-4）的方法，在全景数据集上与之持平；将全景图裁剪向建筑方向可使融合收益翻倍，而随机裁剪无效；冲突的空间密度可无标签预测瓦片级损毁（Spearman r=0.615，p=0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 挖掘冲突样本将"融合是否有帮助"这一问题转化为"在何处、为何应信任哪个视角"，可见性条件门控部分恢复了oracle上界收益。

title: Bidirectional Preference Synthesis: Learning Prompt-Conditioned Preferences from Boundary Failures
summary: Correction-based offline preference pipelines commonly treat model failures only as rejected responses under the original prompt. This supervision is incomplete for boundary failures: responses that violate the given instruction yet coherently satisfy a nearby intent or constraint setting. We introduce Bidirectional Preference Synthesis (BPS), a data-construction method for standard Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) that makes this missing prompt dependence explicit. For each validated boundary failure, BPS keeps the conventional forward pair under the original prompt and adds a reverse pair under a synthesized achieved prompt, so the same response is rejected where it is wrong and chosen where it is right, without changing the DPO objective, training a reward model, or requiring online sampling. On Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, BPS preserves original-side pairwise ranking while raising achieved-side ranking accuracy from 6.8% to 62.3% on held-out crossed anchors, with a similar shift under a Kimi-K2.6 cross-teacher probe. A blind human audit supports the intended reverse preference direction, and downstream evaluations show the clearest separation from Forward-DPO in multilingual multi-turn instruction following, with consistent capability-retention patterns on agentic, tool-use, and code checks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双向偏好合成（BPS），一种针对标准DPO的数据构造方法，通过为边界失败样本同时保留原提示下的正向偏好对，并新增合成"已达成提示"下的反向偏好对，使同一回答在其错误处被拒绝、在其正确处被选择。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于纠正的离线偏好流程通常只把模型失败视为原提示下的被拒回答，这种监督对于"边界失败"是不完整的：即那些违反给定指令、却连贯地满足了相近意图或约束设定的回答。该问题本质上源于缺失了对提示依赖性的显式建模。
AI.method: BPS是一种数据构造方法，可直接用于标准DPO，无需修改DPO目标、不训练奖励模型、也不需要在线采样。对每个经校验的边界失败样本，BPS在保留原提示下传统正向偏好对的同时，额外构建一个合成"已达成提示"下的反向偏好对。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507上，BPS在保持原侧成对排序能力的同时，将留出的交叉锚点上的达成侧排序准确率从6.8%提升至62.3%；在Kimi-K2.6跨教师探针下观察到类似变化。盲测人工审核支持预期的反向偏好方向；下游评测显示其与Forward-DPO的区分在多语言多轮指令遵循上最为明显，并在智能体、工具使用和代码检查中表现出一致的能力保持模式。
AI.conclusion: BPS通过显式建模提示依赖性，弥补了边界失败监督中的缺失环节，在不改动DPO目标的前提下显著改善了达成侧偏好排序，同时保持原有能力，是一种简洁有效的离线偏好数据构造方案。

title: Do Tool Calls Execute as Intended? Measuring and Repairing Intent-Execution Correspondence in LLM Agents
summary:
Agents built on large language models (LLMs) build and run software through tool calls. A call reaches its program through several hops, and any hop can change the call without notice. When the changed call fails, the agent retries a correct call, which costs users time and money. Benchmarks and failure analyses do not see the change, because they read the call and its result but not what a hop received. We define intent-execution correspondence (IEC) as the property that the executed action matches the action the emitted call denotes under the tool contract. Our protocol observes what each hop received without executing the call, and names the first hop that changed it by the receiver's own parser. IntAct then delivers the call in a form that this hop cannot alter, or refuses the call. We build IEC-Bench from the changes observed in real-world use, with chains of dependent calls under the execution paths of 4 widely-used harnesses.
  In 47,828 shell calls within production sessions, Claude Code's Bash tool changes 12.0% of the calls that carry code, escape sequences, or long text. For 80.7% of the calls whose backslashes are changed, the wrong action runs without any reported error. All 10 measured harnesses change a call. Trajectory-based judgment attributes 95.1% of the production failures to the LLM, although the path caused more than half of them. On IEC-Bench, the path raises the token cost per passed task 2.4 times (up to 12.3 times). A hop that changes a call also hides the changes after it, so 55.1% of the failures on one path appear only after its first hop is repaired. IntAct, deployed in a commercial product, recovers 79.2% of the failures with a changed call. Harnesses should therefore be designed and tested hop-by-hop to ensure a correct call executes as intended or is refused.

AI.tldr: LLM智能体通过工具调用构建和运行软件，但调用在多个传输环节（hop）中可能被悄然篡改导致失败。本文定义"意图-执行对应（IEC）"，提出逐环节观测协议IntAct，并构建IEC-Bench。实测显示Claude Code的Bash工具在12.0%含代码/转义/长文本的调用中发生改变，10个被测harness全部会改变调用，现有轨迹判断将95.1%失败归咎于LLM实则过半由路径引起。IntAct在商用产品中恢复79.2%的失败调用。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体通过工具调用执行软件操作，调用需经多个环节（hop）传递，任一环节都可能在不通知的情况下篡改调用。当被改变的调用失败时，智能体只能重试，浪费用户时间和金钱。然而现有基准测试与失败分析只读取调用及其结果，看不到中间环节接收到什么，因此无法发现篡改问题，也无法正确归因失败责任。
AI.method: 定义意图-执行对应（IEC）为：执行动作与所发出调用在工具契约下所指代的动作相匹配。提出观测协议：在不执行调用的前提下观测每个环节接收到的内容，并用接收方自身的解析器命名第一个改变调用的环节。IntAct据此以该环节无法更改的形式投递调用，或直接拒绝调用。基于真实使用中观测到的改变构建IEC-Bench，包含4个广泛使用harness执行路径下的依赖调用链。
AI.result: 在生产会话的47,828次shell调用中，Claude Code的Bash工具改变了12.0%携带代码、转义序列或长文本的调用；在反斜杠被改变的调用中，80.7%会运行错误动作却不上报任何错误。全部10个被测harness都会改变调用。基于轨迹的判断将95.1%的生产失败归因于LLM，而实际上路径造成了一半以上。在IEC-Bench上，路径使每通过一个任务的token成本升高2.4倍（最高达12.3倍）。改变调用的环节还会隐藏其后的改变，因此某路径上55.1%的失败只有在修复其第一个环节后才显现。IntAct在商用产品中部署，恢复79.2%的失败调用。
AI.conclusion: harness应逐环节（hop-by-hop）进行设计与测试，以确保正确的调用按意图执行或被拒绝，而非被静默篡改后执行错误动作。这要求改变现有以结果为中心的评测与归因方式，转向对传输路径的逐环节验证。

title: Grammar-Guided Code Watermarking with Green Temperature
summary: Large language model watermarking embeds detectable statistical signals during decoding, but the resulting changes to token probabilities can degrade generation quality. This trade-off is particularly important for code, where small changes in token selection can break syntax or alter program behavior. Existing code watermarking methods mitigate this risk through entropy-based insertion or syntax-aware token selection, but they do not directly construct the watermark over the set of continuations admitted by the current grammar state. We propose Grammar-Guided Code Watermarking with Green Temperature (GTCW), which integrates grammar-constrained decoding with probability-aware watermarking. At each decoding step, GTCW restricts the candidate set to grammar-admissible tokens and partitions this support into keyed green and red subsets. At eligible high-entropy positions, green temperature reweights the green tokens according to the model's relative preferences, strengthening the watermark signal while retaining the grammar constraint. Across five models and five benchmarks spanning four programming languages, GTCW achieves a mean AUROC of 73.61%, compared with 67.83% for the strongest baseline, while maintaining a mean Pass@1 of 59.18% versus 59.58% for unwatermarked generation. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/hyundong98/GTCW .

AI.tldr: 提出语法引导的代码水印方法GTCW，在语法约束解码下结合概率感知水印。
AI.motivation: 现有代码水印方法通过熵插入或语法感知选词降低风险，但未直接在语法状态允许的延续集合上构造水印，且需缓解水印对代码质量的损害。
AI.method: 每步解码将候选限制为语法允许词，并划分为带密钥的green/red子集；在高熵位置用green temperature按模型偏好重加权green词。
AI.result: 5个模型、5个基准、4种语言上平均AUROC 73.61%（最强基线67.83%），平均Pass@1 59.18%（无水印59.58%）。
AI.conclusion: GTCW在增强水印检测性的同时基本保持代码生成质量。

title: Verb-ICL: Rethinking In-Context Learning for Structured Prediction
summary: Structured prediction tasks pose unique challenges for in-context learning (ICL): their compositional outputs require modeling fine-grained, token-level patterns that sentence-level approaches fail to capture, and their task-specific annotation conventions are human-defined artifacts that cannot be acquired through pretraining alone. We propose Verb-ICL, a selective annotation framework for ICL-based structured prediction that addresses both challenges. Verb-ICL first selects representative examples using a token-level coverage strategy that captures local semantic patterns critical for structured prediction, then generates actionable error feedback that codifies task-specific annotation guidelines and incorporates this feedback into ICL demonstrations. We evaluate Verb-ICL on six structured prediction datasets spanning information extraction and semantic parsing. Experiments with recent LLMs show that Verb-ICL consistently outperforms strong selective annotation baselines under low-resource settings and continues to provide gains as the annotation budget increases. Extended analyses demonstrate that the generated feedback is predominantly useful across a four-category quality taxonomy, generalizes as task-level guidance beyond instance-specific corrections, and improves performance regardless of the underlying selection strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Verb-ICL，一个用于基于上下文学习（ICL）的结构化预测的选择性标注框架，通过 token 级覆盖策略选取代表性示例，并生成可操作的错误反馈以编码任务特定的标注规范，从而提升低资源场景下的性能。
AI.motivation: 结构化预测任务对 ICL 构成独特挑战：其组合式输出需要建模细粒度的 token 级模式，而句子级方法无法捕捉；同时任务特定的标注约定是人为定义的产物，无法仅靠预训练获得。
AI.method: Verb-ICL 首先使用 token 级覆盖策略选择代表性示例，以捕捉结构化预测关键的局部语义模式；然后生成可操作的错误反馈，将任务特定的标注指南编码其中，并将该反馈融入 ICL 演示中。
AI.result: 在涵盖信息抽取和语义解析的六个结构化预测数据集上，使用近期 LLM 的实验表明，Verb-ICL 在低资源设置下持续优于强选择性标注基线，并且随着标注预算增加仍持续带来增益。扩展分析显示，生成的反馈在四类质量分类体系下大多有用，可作为任务级指导泛化（而非仅实例级纠正），并且无论底层选择策略如何都能提升性能。
AI.conclusion: Verb-ICL 有效解决了结构化预测中 ICL 的细粒度建模与标注规范获取难题，在多个数据集和标注预算下稳定提升效果，且其错误反馈具有泛化性与策略无关性。

title: Synthetic-to-Real ViT-Based Pose Estimation of a Noncooperative UAV
summary: Remote pose estimation of noncooperative Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) from imagery is critical, as they cannot be influenced or instrumented in advance. Deep-learning-based approaches offer a promising solution; however, their development is constrained by the cost and difficulty of acquiring large-scale real-world datasets with accurate pose labels. Synthetic imagery provides an alternative, but models trained on synthetic data must overcome the synthetic-to-real domain gap to generalize to real-world imagery. This work investigates the inherent synthetic-to-real generalization capability of a Vision Transformer (ViT)-based model for monocular UAV pose estimation. The proposed approach employs a self-supervised DINOv2 backbone and is trained exclusively on labeled synthetic imagery while being evaluated on labeled real-world imagery. Pose ambiguity-aware strategies are incorporated during training and inference to address ambiguities arising from the projection of a three-dimensional target onto a two-dimensional image plane and from target symmetries. An $α$-$β$ filter is further integrated during inference to improve pose estimations. To assess the model under operational requirements, it is evaluated in terms of Mean Angular Error (MAE) and inference time, both before and after filtering, using a real-world dataset containing 77,077 labeled UAV images. Before filtering, the model achieves an MAE of $19.18^{\circ}$ and an inference time of $13.25$ ms, whereas after filtering, these values are $8.74^{\circ}$ and $13.42$ ms, respectively.

AI.tldr: 该工作研究基于ViT的模型在单目无人机姿态估计中的合成到真实泛化能力，仅用合成图像训练、真实图像评估，结合姿态歧义处理与α-β滤波，取得MAE 8.74°、推理时间13.42 ms。
AI.motivation: 非合作无人机的远程姿态估计无法预先干预或加装设备。深度学习方法虽有前景，但获取大规模带精确姿态标签的真实数据集成本高、难度大。合成图像是替代方案，但需克服合成到真实的域差异以实现真实场景泛化。
AI.method: 采用自监督DINOv2骨干的ViT模型，仅在带标签的合成图像上训练，在带标签的真实图像上评估。训练和推理阶段引入姿态歧义感知策略，以应对三维目标投影到二维图像平面及目标对称性带来的歧义。推理阶段进一步集成α-β滤波器以改进姿态估计。
AI.result: 在包含77,077张带标签无人机图像的真实数据集上评估。滤波前MAE为19.18°，推理时间13.25 ms；滤波后MAE为8.74°，推理时间13.42 ms。
AI.conclusion: 基于DINOv2的ViT模型具备一定的合成到真实泛化能力，通过姿态歧义感知策略和α-β滤波可显著提升单目无人机姿态估计精度，同时保持较低的推理时间，满足操作需求。

title: Suppressing Pressure, Amplifying Evidence: Self-Guided Attention Steering to Mitigate Sycophancy and Stubbornness
summary: Reliable language models should resist unsupported user pressure while effectively using objective contextual information. However, models may exhibit sycophancy by yielding to unsupported user pressure or contextual stubbornness by failing to update their answers when relevant contextual information warrants revision. Evaluating interventions for these failures separately can obscure whether mitigating one failure exacerbates the other. To assess this trade-off, we introduce CoPE-Bench with six conditions per question: a neutral baseline, correct or incorrect user pressure, contextual information consistent with or conflicting with the neutral answer, and a joint condition combining incorrect claims with conflicting contextual information. To regulate the influence of user pressure and contextual information, we propose SPAE (Suppressing Pressure, Amplifying Evidence), a training-free framework that uses the model's own judgments to identify relevant tokens, suppressing user pressure and amplifying contextual information through token-level attention steering. On average across five backbones, SPAE reduces pressure following by 18.8 percentage points and increases joint-condition updating by 5.5 percentage points relative to the strongest baseline in the main comparison. In two-turn dialogue, it improves joint-condition updating by an average of 13.2 percentage points over the strongest prompting baseline. The source data and codes can be found at https://github.com/03Grant/sycophancy-and-stubbornness.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CoPE-Bench 基准与免训练框架 SPAE，用于同时评估和缓解语言模型在用户压力下迎合与在语境信息下固执之间的权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 可靠的语言模型应能在缺乏依据的用户压力下坚持立场，同时有效利用客观语境信息。然而模型可能因迎合而屈服于无依据的用户压力，或因语境固执而在相关语境信息需修正答案时未能更新。分别评估这两种失败会掩盖"缓解一种失败是否会加剧另一种失败"的权衡。
AI.method: 提出 CoPE-Bench，每题含六种条件：中性基线、正确或错误的用户压力、与中性答案一致或冲突的语境信息、以及将错误主张与冲突语境结合的联合条件。为调控用户压力与语境信息的影响，提出免训练框架 SPAE，利用模型自身判断识别相关 token，通过 token 级注意力引导抑制用户压力、放大语境信息。
AI.result: 在五个骨干模型上平均，相较主对比中最强基线，SPAE 将跟随压力比例降低 18.8 个百分点，并将联合条件下的更新比例提高 5.5 个百分点。在两轮对话中，相比最强提示基线，联合条件更新平均提升 13.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: SPAE 能同时缓解迎合与固执的权衡问题，在单轮与两轮对话中均有效提升模型对语境证据的利用并抵抗无依据压力。源码与数据已公开。

title: What Does a Harness Buy? Tokens, Mostly
summary: A coding agent is a language model wrapped in a harness: the system prompt, the tool set, and the context management that turn a chat model into something that can work inside a repository. Production harnesses ship releases daily, vendors advertise pass-rate gains from harness changes, and leaderboards mix harnesses freely. What is rarely measured is how much the harness itself moves the score when the model is held fixed. We run five models through three production harnesses, Claude Code, mini-SWE-agent, and OpenCode, on SWE-bench Verified, and rerun the same configurations to calibrate how much a score moves when nothing changes but the run. On 447 tasks and the two models we ran there, Claude Code and mini-SWE-agent, the heaviest and the lightest harness, are equivalent within five points. On a 45-task hard subset and five models, swapping the harness flips as many tasks as rerunning the same harness, 13% in both cases, and the tasks a harness wins in one run are not the tasks it wins in the next. The one harness effect that clears the noise is a loss, not a gain: OpenCode trails by up to 9 points on the large pool, and on one model half of that gap sits in runs its output cap cut short. What the harness does decide is the bill. With the same model, the same tasks, and one price list, cost per task differs by up to 3x across harnesses. The gap is set at the first call, by the preamble of system prompt and tool schemas each harness sends with every step, and scaled by the number of steps; per-step growth and per-call tool output differ far less. The provider's price for cached input scales the bill and does not reorder it. The rerun data also give the resolution a harness comparison needs: at the discordance we observe, 45 tasks catch a 13-point gap only half the time and no gap with 80% power, and 447 tasks resolve 5 points, still coarser than the gains many harness changes claim.

AI.tldr: 在模型固定的前提下，该研究测量了编码智能体"框架"（harness）本身对 SWE-bench 成绩、任务成败与成本的影响。结果表明：框架对通过率的真实影响大多淹没在运行噪声中，唯一稳定且显著的框架效应是"成本"差异（最高达 3 倍）。
AI.motivation: 生产级编码框架每天都在迭代，厂商常宣称框架改动能带来通过率提升，排行榜也随意混用不同框架。然而在模型保持不变时，框架本身究竟能多大程度改变得分，却很少被严格测量。作者希望把框架效应与运行噪声分离，并厘清框架真正决定的因素。
AI.method: 用 5 个模型 × 3 个生产框架（Claude Code、mini-SWE-agent、OpenCode）在 SWE-bench Verified 上运行；重复相同配置以校准"仅重跑"带来的分数波动。在 447 个任务（两个模型）和 45 个困难子集（五个模型）上比较；并统一价目表核算每任务成本，分析成本差异来自系统提示词前导、工具 schema、步数与缓存输入定价等因素。
AI.result: 在 447 任务、两模型上，最重与最轻框架（Claude Code vs mini-SWE-agent）差距在 5 分内。在 45 任务子集、五模型上，替换框架与重跑同一框架翻转的任务数相同（均为 13%），且某框架一次运行胜出的任务在下次并不相同。唯一超出噪声的框架效应是"损失"：OpenCode 在大池子上最多落后 9 分，其中某模型一半差距源于其输出上限截断运行。成本上，同模型、同任务、同价目表下每任务成本跨框架相差最高 3 倍。
AI.conclusion: 框架对通过率的影响大多被运行噪声淹没，其对成本的决定作用则真实而显著；成本差距主要由每步发送的系统提示词前导与工具 schema 决定，并随步数放大，而非每步增长或单次工具输出。重跑数据还给出框架比较所需的分辨率：在观察到的差异率下，45 任务仅半数时候能捕捉 13 分差距、无法以 80% 功效检出无差距，447 任务才勉强分辨 5 分，仍粗于许多框架改动所宣称的增益。

title: StateSync-GKR: Machine-Checking the Trust Chain from Sparse-Merkle State Transitions to GKR Verification
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Software artifact: https://github.com/Oraclizer/statesync-gkr (v1.1.0; archived source DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23136385)
summary: GKR soundness bounds false output claims about arithmetic circuits, but an application also needs assurance that its circuit encodes the intended state transition. We machine-check this connection for sparse-Merkle membership, non-membership, and update in Isabelle/HOL. A compiler model relates circuit acceptance to transition validity in both directions. A reusable protocol model assembles layer reduction, wiring-predicate extensions, and imported sumcheck soundness into a bound on an explicit chain event. Their composition transfers semantic invalidity to that bound, with the witness fixed before the challenge experiment. Concrete interpretations and premise activations expose vacuous assumption sets that a clean build alone would miss. A further development constructs the exact degree-four KoalaBear extension, lifts the base-field circuit objects, and establishes the assembly bound with denominator $p^4$ under its stated challenge assumptions. An executable Rust prover accompanies the model. Creusot/Why3 contracts provide a partial implementation connection, and a conditional theorem relates successful verifier traces to the model event under an undischarged value-correspondence premise. Neither the transcript's online challenge distribution nor a multi-round Fiat--Shamir reduction is established. The contribution is the composition, within one proof assistant, of compiler correctness with a GKR assembly model, together with an explicit account of the remaining implementation and cryptographic obligations.

AI.tldr: 论文在Isabelle/HOL中机器验证了稀疏Merkle成员/非成员/更新电路与状态转移的有效性连接，并将编译器正确性与GKR装配模型组合，明确列出剩余实现与密码学义务。
AI.motivation: GKR可靠性界仅说明对算术电路的虚假输出声明，但应用还需保证电路确实编码了预期的状态转移；这一连接通常未被机器验证，且可能存在空洞假设。
AI.method: 在Isabelle/HOL中建立编译器模型（双向关联电路接受与转移有效性）；构建可复用协议模型，组装层归约、布线谓词扩展与导入的sumcheck可靠性，得到显式链事件界；构造四度KoalaBear扩域并提升基域电路对象；配套可执行Rust证明器与Creusot/Why3契约做部分实现连接。
AI.result: 在所述挑战假设下，装配界分母为p^4；组合将语义无效性转移到该界（见证在挑战实验前固定）；具体解释与前提激活暴露了仅靠干净构建会遗漏的空洞假设集；得到条件定理将成功验证器轨迹关联到模型事件（值对应前提未证明）。
AI.conclusion: 贡献是在单一证明助手内组合编译器正确性与GKR装配模型，并明确说明剩余实现与密码学义务；未建立在线的挑战分布或多轮Fiat-Shamir归约。

title: More Value per Key: Asymmetric Sparse Attention for Faster LLM Decoding
summary: utoregressive generation in Large Language Models (LLMs) is constrained by the memory and computational demands of attention mechanisms. Sparse attention methods mitigate this cost by selecting only high-probability entries of the attention matrix. We observe that in many such methods, this renders the probability-value multiplication negligible, shifting the bottleneck to the query-key step. Key heads can therefore be reduced to accelerate inference, while retaining more value heads preserves capacity with limited additional decoding cost. We introduce Sparse Asymmetric Group-Query Attention (SAGA), which decouples key and value head counts to exploit this principle, and pair it with approximate top-N (Atop-N) attention, a simple sparse attention method designed to study the interaction between sparsity and head-count asymmetry. We formalize the benefits of this asymmetry theoretically and validate them empirically through latency measurements and quality evaluations on models up to 1.5B parameters. Together, SAGA and Atop-N achieve end-to-end decoding speedups exceeding $2\times$ over our full-attention GQA baseline at long contexts. Models trained from scratch with SAGA nearly match the quality of comparable GQA variants on the evaluated benchmarks. To facilitate adoption, we introduce an efficient fine-tuning method that converts pretrained models to the SAGA architecture, enabling practitioners to benefit from our approach without costly retraining.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SAGA（稀疏非对称分组查询注意力），通过解耦键头与值头数量并结合近似top-N稀疏注意力，在长上下文下实现超过2倍的端到端解码加速，并保持接近GQA的质量。
AI.motivation: 自回归生成受限于注意力机制的内存与计算开销。稀疏注意力虽能降低成本，但作者观察到在多种稀疏方法中，概率-值相乘变得可忽略，瓶颈转移到query-key计算步骤，因此可通过减少键头来加速推理，同时保留更多值头以维持容量且解码代价有限。
AI.method: 提出Sparse Asymmetric Group-Query Attention（SAGA），解耦键头与值头的数量以利用上述原理；并搭配近似top-N（Atop-N）注意力这一简单稀疏注意力方法，用于研究稀疏性与头数非对称性之间的相互作用。作者从理论上形式化了该非对称性的收益，并在最多1.5B参数的模型上通过时延测量和质量评估进行实证验证。此外提出一种高效微调方法，将预训练模型转换为SAGA架构，无需昂贵重训练。
AI.result: SAGA与Atop-N结合，在长上下文下相比完整注意力的GQA基线实现超过2倍的端到端解码加速。从头训练使用SAGA的模型在评估基准上质量几乎与可比的GQA变体相当。所提出的微调方法可让实践者无需重训练即可受益。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦键/值头数并结合稀疏注意力，可在保持质量的同时显著加速长上下文解码；提出的微调转换方法便于实际采用。

title: A differentiable Lagrangian-coupled 3D Gaussian Splatting-SPH model for forward simulation and inverse analysis in solid mechanics
summary: Recent advances in generative world models have increased interest in digital models that reproduce both the appearance of real objects and their response to physical interaction. Three-dimensional reconstruction techniques, including 3D Gaussian Splatting, capture detailed surface geometry and appearance from images and videos. However, extending these representations beyond plausible animation to mechanically interpretable models for constitutive behavior, boundary conditions, and inverse parameter identification remains less explored. In this work, a differentiable Lagrangian-coupled 3DGS-smoothed particle hydrodynamics (SPH) model is proposed for forward simulation and inverse analysis of deformable solids. The observed object is first reconstructed from multi-view calibrated visual dataset as a 3DGS rendering model. An envelope-based procedure then generates an independent SPH support for the solid-mechanics model, avoiding the direct use of rendering primitives as mechanical particles. A reference-configuration Lagrangian transfer maps SPH deformation to Gaussian positions and covariances, thereby coupling the physical model and the image observation model while preserving a differentiable computational path. The SPH formulation supports linear elastic, hyperelastic, and Kelvin--Voigt viscoelastic responses, together with fixed, free, and Robin-type boundary conditions. Numerical studies validate the SPH response against finite-element results, assess accuracy and efficiency against a conventional model using Gaussian centers as surface SPH particles, and demonstrate forward simulations on beam, bridge, and liver-shaped examples. Inverse analyses further estimate constitutive and boundary parameters from rendered deformation observations, including noisy cases, demonstrating the feasibility of the proposed model for mechanics-based parameter identification from image data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可微拉格朗日耦合的3DGS-SPH模型，用于可变形固体的正向仿真与逆向分析，实现了从图像数据出发的本构与边界参数识别。
AI.motivation: 现有3D重建技术（如3D高斯泼溅）能捕获物体的几何与外观，但将其从视觉动画扩展到具有力学可解释性的模型（本构行为、边界条件、逆向参数识别）仍较少探索。
AI.method: 先从多视角标定视觉数据集重建3DGS渲染模型；采用基于包络的流程生成独立的SPH力学支撑，避免将渲染基元直接作为力学粒子；通过参考构型拉格朗日传递将SPH变形映射到高斯的位置与协方差，从而在保持可微计算路径下耦合物理模型与图像观测模型。SPH公式支持线弹性、超弹性和开尔文-沃伊特粘弹性响应，以及固定、自由和Robin型边界条件。
AI.result: 数值研究验证了SPH响应与有限元结果的一致性，评估了相较于以高斯中心作为表面SPH粒子的传统方法的精度与效率，并在梁、桥及肝形示例上完成正向仿真；逆向分析从渲染变形观测中估计本构与边界参数，包括含噪声情形。
AI.conclusion: 该模型展示了从图像数据进行基于力学的参数识别的可行性。

title: ShadowMiner v1 - An Experience Report on Implementing and Measuring a Problem-and-Hypothesis Discovery Engine
summary: ShadowMiner v1 is a system that automatically discovers research problems and generates hypotheses from AI papers. It is a nine-stage pipeline. It structures documents into a knowledge graph and finds graph gaps in it - structural blind spots in research. These graph gaps are included in the LLM generation prompt. Each generated hypothesis is then verified by checking whether it is already covered by existing research, scoring its quality, and checking that the facts it relies on are accurately drawn from its sources. This report does not propose a new generation or evaluation technique. It describes our experience of implementing and applying ideas from prior work, and measuring whether each one actually contributed.

AI.tldr: ShadowMiner v1 是一个九阶段流水线，可从 AI 论文中自动发现研究问题并生成假设。
AI.motivation: 探索如何将已有工作的思路落地应用，并衡量每一项思路是否真正带来贡献，而非提出新的生成或评估技术。
AI.method: 将文档结构化为知识图谱，识别其中的图间隙（研究中的结构性盲点），并将其纳入 LLM 生成提示；随后对每个生成假设进行验证：检查是否已被现有研究覆盖、评估其质量、核验其所依赖事实是否准确来源于原始文献。
AI.result: 本报告不提出新的生成或评估技术，而是描述实现与应用先前工作思路的经验，并测量各思路的实际贡献。
AI.conclusion: ShadowMiner v1 通过知识图谱间隙驱动假设生成，并配套多重验证机制，其价值在于对各组成部分贡献的实证检验。

title: AutoDP-LLM: Automating Data Pre-processing for Intrusion Detection Systems using Large Language Models
summary: The increasing complexity and scale of modern cyber-attacks demand intelligent and computationally efficient Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS). However, designing effective data pre-processing pipelines traditionally involves substantial trial-and-error effort and repeated evaluation of alternative configurations. For large, high-dimensional network traffic data, this process can create a significant computational burden. In this work, we propose AutoDP-LLM, an automated pre-processing framework designed to reduce manual pipeline development and computational overhead. Specifically, AutoDP-LLM leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to autonomously generate and validate executable data pre-processing pipelines. The framework combines deterministic host-side planning with LLM-based specialist agents to formulate data-processing strategies, synthesize executable code, and adaptively determine retained feature sets using semantic reasoning and training-derived statistical evidence, without requiring a predefined feature budget. Focusing on multiclass intrusion detection, we evaluate AutoDP-LLM on the UNSW-NB15 and NSL-KDD benchmark datasets using multiple downstream classifiers. Comparative experiments against conventional feature-selection methods show that AutoDP-LLM achieves competitive detection performance while automating the generation of compact and executable pre-processing pipelines. Component-level ablation experiments further demonstrate the complementary contributions of the semantic and statistical feature-reduction components. The repeated generation, validation, execution, and assessment of candidate pipelines are amenable to parallel execution, highlighting the potential of scalable computing environments, including high-performance computing (HPC) systems, to support automated IDS pipeline development.

AI.tldr: 提出AutoDP-LLM，利用大语言模型自动生成并验证可执行的数据预处理流水线，在UNSW-NB15和NSL-KDD数据集上实现有竞争力的多分类入侵检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现代网络攻击的复杂性和规模不断增长，需要智能且计算高效的入侵检测系统（IDS）。然而，设计有效的数据预处理流水线通常需要大量试错和反复评估不同配置，对大规模高维网络流量数据而言，这一过程会带来显著的计算负担。因此，本文旨在减少人工流水线开发的成本和计算开销。
AI.method: 提出AutoDP-LLM自动化预处理框架。它利用大语言模型（LLM）自主生成并验证可执行的数据预处理流水线：将确定性的主机端规划与基于LLM的专家智能体相结合，用于制定数据处理策略、合成可执行代码，并借助语义推理和训练导出的统计证据自适应地确定保留的特征集，无需预设特征预算。
AI.result: 在多分类入侵检测任务上，于UNSW-NB15和NSL-KDD基准数据集上使用多种下游分类器进行评估。与传统特征选择方法相比，AutoDP-LLM在自动化生成紧凑且可执行预处理流水线的同时，取得了有竞争力的检测性能。组件级消融实验进一步证明了语义和统计特征约简组件的互补贡献。候选流水线的重复生成、验证、执行和评估适合并行执行。
AI.conclusion: AutoDP-LLM通过LLM自动化预处理流水线开发，在保持检测性能的同时降低了人工与计算成本。其流程适合并行执行，显示出可扩展计算环境（含高性能计算HPC系统）在支持自动化IDS流水线开发方面的潜力。

title: How Do People Challenge Racial Stereotypes Online? Counter-Story Detection Across Reddit Communities
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 28 pages, 12 figures, 24 tables. Content warning: this paper contains examples of racial stereotypes that may be upsetting or offensive. Code: https://github.com/UmaGunturi/counter_story_detection
summary: Counter-storytelling is a powerful mechanism people use to challenge dominant narratives. Unlike other forms of counterspeech that have been widely studied in computational social science, counter-storytelling has largely been overlooked.
