Counter-stories are difficult to detect automatically; they are relational (defined with respect to expressions of racial stereotypes) and structurally diverse (drawing on stories that describe lived experiences, witnessed events, exemplars, and hypotheticals). We introduce a first framework for detecting and characterizing counter-storytelling against racial stereotypes at scale. This includes (1) a three-dimensional taxonomy grounded in narratology and Critical Race Theory and (2) a multi-stage pipeline that identifies relational pairs of stereotypes and counter-stories in noisy Reddit discourse. Using this pipeline, we annotate 25,549 Reddit posts across 615 communities and identify 1,312 counter-stories. Our analysis shows that speaker identity and post context shape how counter-stories are told. For example, in-group writers favor first-person testimony, often adopting the role of self-reflective insiders. Our work shows how computational methods can scale qualitative approaches to identify and characterize counter-storytelling as a contextual narrative practice, with implications for content moderation, narratology, and racial discourse analysis.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次提出大规模检测与刻画针对种族刻板印象的"反叙事"（counter-storytelling）的框架，结合叙事学与批判种族理论构建三维分类体系，并通过多阶段流水线在Reddit话语中识别刻板印象与反叙事的关系对，最终标注25,549条帖子并识别出1,312条反叙事。
AI.motivation: 反叙事是人们挑战主流叙事的有力机制，但相较于其他形式的内容反击（counterspeech），它在计算社会科学中被严重忽视。反叙事难以自动检测：它具有关系性（需相对于种族刻板印象的表达来定义）和结构多样性（涵盖亲身经历、目睹事件、范例和假设情形等故事）。因此需要新方法来大规模识别与刻画反叙事。
AI.method: （1）构建一个根植于叙事学和批判种族理论的三维分类体系；（2）设计一个多阶段流水线，用于在嘈杂的Reddit话语中识别刻板印象与反叙事的关系对。基于该流水线对615个社区的25,549条Reddit帖子进行标注。
AI.result: 在标注的25,549条Reddit帖子中识别出1,312条反叙事。分析发现，说话者身份与帖子语境会影响反叙事的讲述方式，例如群内写作者更偏好第一人称证词，常扮演自我反思的内部人角色。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了计算方法如何将定性方法规模化，以识别和刻画作为一种语境化叙事实践的反叙事，对内容审核、叙事学和种族话语分析具有启示意义。

title: Any-scale Object Detection using Arbitrary-scaled Images
summary: This paper proposes any-scale object detection using arbitrary-scale super-resolution for continuously rescaling object images, while general multi-scale object detection uses discretely rescaled appearance representations. However, a naive usage of super-resolution produces many false-positive detections if many super-resolution images are independently fed into an object detector. Our method suppresses these false positives by predicting scale proposal maps, each of which represents a set of pixels appropriate for each super-resolution scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出任意尺度目标检测方法，利用任意尺度超分辨率对目标图像进行连续缩放，并通过预测尺度建议图来抑制因独立输入多张超分图像而产生的假阳性检测。
AI.motivation: 通用多尺度目标检测仅使用离散缩放的外观表示，无法实现连续尺度变化。若直接使用超分辨率生成多张图像并独立送入检测器，会引入大量假阳性检测。
AI.method: 采用任意尺度超分辨率对目标图像进行连续缩放；预测尺度建议图（scale proposal maps），每张图表示适合某一超分尺度的像素集合，以此抑制假阳性。
AI.result: 通过尺度建议图有效抑制了直接使用超分辨率所带来的假阳性检测，实现了任意尺度目标检测。
AI.conclusion: 任意尺度超分辨率结合尺度建议图可支持连续尺度的目标检测，并缓解多尺度超分图像独立检测时的假阳性问题。

title: Backdooring Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are increasingly used not only to interpret language models but also to intervene on their internal representations. We show that this creates a supply-chain attack surface: a maliciously modified SAE can induce attacker-chosen behavior when inserted into the forward pass of an otherwise unchanged language model. We introduce a decoder-only SAE backdoor that leaves both the underlying LLM and the SAE encoder frozen, restricting the attack to a single auxiliary component at a single insertion layer. Using code generation as a case study, we demonstrate high rates of unsolicited code insertion across three language models and a wide range of insertion layers, as well as trigger-dependent behavior conditioned on a prompt cue. We further evaluate the modified SAEs using HumanEval and selected SAEBench metrics. While attack effectiveness varies across models and layers, strong backdoor behavior can coexist with relatively small changes in several conventional SAE quality measures. These results establish that SAEs can carry behavioral backdoors without modifying the language model itself and should therefore be treated as security-sensitive components.

AI.tldr: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）不仅能解释语言模型，还能干预其内部表示，这带来了供应链攻击面：恶意修改的仅解码器SAE可在不改动语言模型本身的情况下植入行为后门。
AI.motivation: SAE日益被用于干预语言模型内部表示，但将其视为安全敏感组件的研究不足；作者想揭示SAE插入前向传播时可成为供应链攻击入口。
AI.method: 提出一种仅修改解码器的SAE后门，保持底层LLM与SAE编码器冻结，攻击仅限单层单个辅助组件；以代码生成为案例，在三个语言模型及多种插入层上测试，并评估触发提示依赖行为。
AI.result: 在三个模型和广泛插入层上实现高比例的未经请求代码插入，并可依提示线索触发；用HumanEval和部分SAEBench指标评估发现，强后门行为可与常规SAE质量指标的较小变化共存。
AI.conclusion: SAE可在不修改语言模型本身的情况下携带行为后门，因此应被视为安全敏感组件，供应链安全需覆盖SAE。

title: The Poisoned Conversation: Privacy-Leaking Watermarks in Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Multimodal models are increasingly shifting toward unified architectures that understand and generate text, images, and other modalities within a shared conversational context. This design enables fluid interaction across modalities, but it also changes the privacy threat model: Information revealed in one part of a conversation may remain accessible when the model later generates content in another modality. This risk is particularly concerning in settings where users rely on locally deployed models for privacy, assuming that sensitive interactions remain confined to their device. We introduce Privacy-Leaking Watermarks (PLWs): invisible, trigger-dependent watermarks that a malicious model provider can condition on prior chat history. With this adversarial intervention, the usual separation breaks: a sensitive keyword or semantic cue mentioned earlier in the conversation can cause a later, unrelated image to carry a hidden yet detectable watermark. PLWs pose a novel threat to users of unified multimodal models: A poisoned model can retain utility while covertly turning image generation into a channel for privacy leakage, even when deployed locally. Across 13 sensitive-attribute triggers and two model families, PLWs reach up to 100.0% TPR at 1% FPR. For example, across all tested conversational separations, OmniGen2 detects every prior disclosure of depression while falsely flagging only 1% of images generated without such a disclosure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"隐私泄露水印"(PLWs)：恶意模型提供方可在统一多模态模型中植入触发式隐形水印，使得对话历史中的敏感信息会诱发后续图像携带可检测水印，从而在本地部署场景下隐秘泄露隐私。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态架构允许文本、图像等在同一对话上下文中理解与生成，信息在不同模态间流动。这种设计改变了隐私威胁模型：早前对话中透露的信息可能在后续其他模态生成时被利用。尤其在用户依赖本地部署模型以保护隐私、假设敏感交互仅停留在设备内部的场景下，这一风险更值得关注。
AI.method: 作者引入隐私泄露水印(PLWs)：由恶意模型提供方植入的、不可见且依赖触发条件的水印，可依据先前的聊天历史进行条件化触发。当对话早前出现特定敏感关键词或语义线索时，后续生成的无关图像会被嵌入隐藏但可检测的水印，打破了常规的模态隔离。
AI.result: 在13种敏感属性触发器与两个模型家族上测试，PLWs在1%假阳性率(FPR)下真阳性率(TPR)最高达100.0%。例如在所有测试的对话分隔情形中，OmniGen2能检测出每一次此前的抑郁披露，而对未含该披露所生成图像的误报率仅为1%。
AI.conclusion: PLWs对统一多模态模型用户构成新型威胁：被投毒的模型可在保持正常效用的同时，将图像生成秘密变为隐私泄露通道，即便在本地部署下也无法幸免。

title: LoCoSplat: Real-Time Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Minimal 3D Reasoning
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) increasingly aggregates multi-view evidence with heavy learned 3D networks. We propose LoCoSplat (Local-Context Splatting), motivated by the observation that a Gaussian is a local primitive: once depth is predicted, what the 3D stage must add (scale, rotation, opacity) depends on the point cloud around each anchor, and a fixed local average of that neighbourhood is enough to supply it, no heavy network required. LoCoSplat realises exactly this average: it splats a 16-d linear projection of the point features into a fine and a coarse grid and reads both back at each anchor with a 0.14M-parameter pointwise MLP; with no learned 3D network and no dynamic sparse computation, its whole encoder runs as one fp16 CUDA graph. On RealEstate10K, LoCoSplat outperforms every prior feed-forward method on PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS at 6, 12, and 24 views, with a margin that widens as views densify (+3.3 PSNR over VolSplat, the prior voxel-aligned state of the art, at 24 views) and grows further under zero-shot transfer to ACID and fine-tuning on ScanNet. It reconstructs a 6-view scene in 33 ms on one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU, the fastest of seven feed-forward methods and $4.2\times$ faster than the previous state of the art, trains $2.7\times$ faster ($5.9\times$ at 24 views), and uses $6.7\times$ less inference memory.

AI.tldr: LoCoSplat提出一种轻量级前馈3D高斯泼溅方法，利用高斯作为局部基元的特性，仅用局部上下文的固定平均即可替代重型3D网络，实现更快、更省内存且精度更高的新视角合成。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈3DGS方法依赖重型学习式3D网络来聚合多视角证据，计算开销大。作者观察到高斯是局部基元：一旦预测出深度，3D阶段所需的属性（尺度、旋转、不透明度）仅依赖每个锚点周围的点云，固定的局部平均足以提供这些信息，无需重型网络。
AI.method: LoCoSplat将点特征的16维线性投影泼溅到细粒度和粗粒度两个网格中，并在每个锚点处读回两者，通过一个仅0.14M参数的点式MLP处理。整个编码器不含学习式3D网络和动态稀疏计算，可作为单个fp16 CUDA图运行。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10K上，LoCoSplat在6、12、24视角下于PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS三项指标均超越所有先前前馈方法，且随视角加密优势扩大（24视角时较SOTA VolSplat提升+3.3 PSNR），在ACID零样本迁移和ScanNet微调下优势进一步增长。单张RTX PRO 6000 GPU上重建6视角场景仅需33ms，是七种前馈方法中最快的，比前SOTA快4.2倍，训练快2.7倍（24视角下5.9倍），推理内存减少6.7倍。
AI.conclusion: LoCoSplat证明以局部上下文的简单平均替代重型3D网络即可高效实现高质量前馈3DGS，在精度、速度和内存效率上全面领先，为轻量高效的新视角合成提供了新思路。

title: Security Is More Than a Library Call: How Security Features Live in Code
summary:
Implementing security features---functionalities that protect sensitive data or prevent malicious actions by attackers---is important for ensuring the security and integrity of software systems. Correctly implementing access control, cryptography, or other security features is challenging as they require substantial domain expertise, careful design, and custom implementation to integrate them within the software system.
  Previous work has thoroughly studied security awareness, perception, practices, and expertise via surveys, interviews, and experiments. While they have shown that the implementation of security features are often supported by security libraries and frameworks, they have also shown that developers rarely are security experts, and make mistakes that introduce vulnerabilities into software when using them. Despite this extensive knowledge of security practices and developer behavior, we still lack a comprehensive understanding of how security features actually manifest at the code level across full software systems.
  We close this gap by conducting a mining study of security features in 9 popular and large open-source Java systems. We manually inspected 2,127,761 lines of code across 19,121 files, identifying and annotating 183,395 lines implementing 561 security features corresponding to 54 security features in our taxonomy. We analyzed the characteristics of the identified security features, such as their size, scattering, tangling, common implementation patterns, and the use of internal and external functionalities. Our findings show that security features are far more than mere calls to external libraries. Security features, such as access control, can grow large in size, scatter across the whole codebase, and frequently tangle with each other. External security libraries are commonly used, but they require substantial amounts of code for integration.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过对9个大型开源Java系统进行挖掘研究，手动检查了2,127,761行代码（19,121个文件），识别并标注了183,395行实现561个安全特性的代码，揭示了安全特性在代码层面的真实表现特征。
AI.motivation: 安全特性（如访问控制、加密等）的正确实现对软件安全至关重要，但实现难度大，需要深厚领域知识和定制化开发。以往研究虽通过调查、访谈、实验探讨了开发者的安全意识和实践，并发现开发者常依赖安全库但仍会犯错引入漏洞，然而学界仍缺乏对安全特性在完整软件系统代码层面如何实际呈现的全面理解。
AI.method: 对9个流行的、大型开源Java系统开展挖掘研究。手动检查19,121个文件中的2,127,761行代码，识别并标注了实现561个安全特性的183,395行代码，这些特性对应分类体系中的54种安全特性。分析其规模、分散程度、纠缠情况、常见实现模式以及内部与外部功能的使用情况。
AI.result: 研究发现安全特性远不只是对外部库的调用。诸如访问控制等安全特性可能规模庞大、分散在整个代码库中，并且经常彼此纠缠。外部安全库虽被普遍使用，但需要大量代码来进行集成。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了安全特性在完整软件系统代码层面表现理解上的空白，表明安全特性的实现比单纯调用外部库复杂得多，其规模、分散性和纠缠性对软件系统的设计、维护和安全实践具有重要含义。

title: Beyond Monolithic Perturbation: Heterogeneous Mechanism Design for Multi-Attribute Metric Differential Privacy
comment: IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (S&P), 2027
summary:
Multi-attribute user records are inherently heterogeneous, often combining continuous, categorical, and binary attributes, and they frequently exhibit strong cross-attribute dependencies. Designing high-utility metric differential privacy (mDP) mechanisms for such records is challenging. Simple predefined mechanisms, such as distance-based noise, may be poorly aligned with task-specific utility loss, whereas fully optimization-based mechanisms can be computationally prohibitive for multi-attribute records.
  We propose Dependency-aware Heterogeneous Data Perturbation (DepHDP)}, a framework for multi-attribute mDP that combines dependency-aware attribute grouping with heterogeneous perturbation design. Rather than applying a one-size-fits-all mechanism, DepHDP selects an appropriate perturbation strategy for each attribute or attribute group, choosing between efficient predefined mechanisms, such as Laplace or Exponential mechanisms, and optimization-based designs. This selection is guided by both domain size and a predefined-noise adequacy criterion, which quantifies whether task-induced utility loss can be well explained by perturbation magnitude. To support scalable end-to-end optimization, DepHDP estimates group-level utility loss through sampling and lightweight surrogate modeling, and jointly optimizes privacy-budget allocation and group-wise mechanism design under a global $\ell_p$-metric mDP constraint. Across three case studies, DepHDP improves privacy--utility trade-offs over uniform baselines at lower computational cost than full-record OPT on evaluated domains.

AI.tldr: DepHDP 提出一种面向多属性记录的度量差分隐私框架，结合依赖感知分组与异构扰动设计，在隐私-效用权衡上优于统一基线且计算成本低于全记录优化。
AI.motivation: 多属性用户记录兼具连续、类别、二元属性且存在强跨属性依赖，简单预定义机制与任务效用损失不匹配，而全优化机制计算成本过高。
AI.method: DepHDP 先进行依赖感知的属性分组，再为每个属性或属性组选择扰动策略（Laplace、Exponential 等预定义机制或基于优化的设计），选择依据为域大小和预定义噪声充分性准则；通过采样与轻量代理模型估计组级效用损失，并在全局 ℓ_p 度量 mDP 约束下联合优化隐私预算分配与组级机制设计。
AI.result: 在三个案例研究中，DepHDP 相较统一基线改善了隐私-效用权衡，且计算成本低于全记录 OPT。
AI.conclusion: 将依赖感知分组与异构扰动选择结合，可在保持可扩展性的同时提升多属性 mDP 的效用表现。

title: Cluster Validation Indices as Self-Supervised Objectives for Text Representation Learning
summary: Self-supervised fine-tuning refines the embedding space of a pretrained language encoder without labels. However, the commonly used approaches are computationally expensive. Specifically, contrastive learning-based methods need multiview data and in-batch negative examples, while negative-free approaches require auxiliary graphs/networks. An interesting question arises: can self-supervised fine-tuning be done without relying on either additional negatives or graph data? To answer this question, we introduce SilK (Silhouette-guided K-means), which trains on a Cluster Validation Index, an internal measure of cluster quality without using labels. SilK clusters the corpus and then regresses a simplified silhouette toward a target value. Each document is compared only against the k cluster centroids, never against other documents, so the method needs no augmentation, no negative pairs and one view per document. On BERT-base, SilK trains 1.46x faster per epoch than the fastest baseline we evaluate and uses 45.4% less peak GPU memory than the leanest one. Under frozen-encoder linear probing, SilK stays competitive with the best baselines on three downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 SilK（Silhouette-guided K-means），一种无需负样本、无需图数据、仅单视图的自监督微调方法，通过聚类并用简化轮廓系数作为训练目标。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督微调方法计算开销大：对比学习需要多视图数据与批内负样本，无负样本方法又需要辅助图或网络。作者希望探索能否在不依赖额外负样本或图数据的情况下完成自监督微调。
AI.method: SilK 基于聚类验证指标（无需标签的内部聚类质量度量）进行训练：先对语料聚类，然后将简化轮廓系数回归到目标值。每篇文档只与 k 个聚类中心比较，而不与其他文档比较，因此无需数据增强、无需负样本对、每篇文档只需一个视图。
AI.result: 在 BERT-base 上，SilK 每轮训练比评估中最快的基线快 1.46 倍，峰值 GPU 显存比最节省的基线少 45.4%。在冻结编码器的线性探测下，SilK 在三个下游任务上与最佳基线保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 自监督微调可以不依赖额外负样本或图数据，仅通过聚类验证指标（轮廓系数）即能实现高效且具竞争力的嵌入空间优化。

title: SelectOccFlow: Selective Spatiotemporal Aggregation for 3D Occupancy and Scene Flow Prediction
summary: Comprehensive 3D scene understanding for autonomous driving requires modeling geometry, semantics, and motion. However, camera-based occupancy and scene flow prediction are sensitive to unreliable spatial and temporal aggregation, caused by semantically incompatible image features, misaligned historical observations, and incomplete voxel structures. To address this issue, we propose SelectOccFlow, a selective spatiotemporal aggregation framework that progressively refines contextual evidence across image, temporal, and voxel domains. To obtain semantically compatible image evidence, we design Semantic-Guided Sampling (SGS) to regulate feature sampling with semantic priors. Since reliable image evidence alone cannot resolve temporal inconsistency, we then present State-Conditioned Temporal Aggregation (SCTA) to selectively retrieve historical evidence according to voxel states. To further enhance the structural completeness of voxel representations, we introduce Extent-Aware Spatial Aggregation (ESA), which exploits directional structural support to refine foreground geometry. Experiments on OpenOcc demonstrate that SelectOccFlow achieves a state-of-the-art OccScore of 44.9, improving the previous best by +4.2%. It also maintains competitive occupancy performance on Occ3D-nus and improves the mean OccScore under nuScenes-C corruptions by +11.1%, demonstrating improved robustness to visual corruptions. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/muchen1021/SelectOccFlow.

AI.tldr: 提出SelectOccFlow，一种选择性时空聚合框架，通过在图像、时序和体素域逐步精炼上下文证据，提升自动驾驶占据预测与场景流估计的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 基于相机的占据与场景流预测对不可靠的时空聚合敏感，原因包括语义不兼容的图像特征、未对齐的历史观测以及不完整的体素结构。
AI.method: 设计语义引导采样（SGS）以语义先验调控特征采样；提出状态条件时序聚合（SCTA）依据体素状态选择性检索历史证据；引入程度感知空间聚合（ESA）利用方向性结构支撑精炼前景几何。
AI.result: 在OpenOcc上达到SOTA的OccScore 44.9，较此前最佳提升+4.2%；在Occ3D-nus上保持有竞争力的占据性能；nuScenes-C损坏下平均OccScore提升+11.1%。
AI.conclusion: SelectOccFlow通过跨图像、时序与体素域的选择性聚合，有效提升占据预测精度与对视觉损坏的鲁棒性，代码将开源。

title: AgentPersonaBench: Benchmarking Persona-Driven User Simulation
summary: We introduce AgentPersonaBench (APB), a benchmark evaluating whether persona conditioning faithfully steers downstream agent behavior. While language models are increasingly deployed for persona-driven user simulation, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate conversational styling or self-reports rather than authentic behavioral fidelity. APB evaluates latent persona adherence one trait at a time, embedding each target trait within a complete synthetic profile without explicitly naming the trait or disclosing the test. Ground-truth adherence is verified strictly from observable actions across four interaction surfaces of increasing realism: survey, chat, web (interactive web environments), and app (desktop software environments). APB comprises 2,460 tasks spanning 867 traits, verified through automated audits and expert review. Our evaluation of 20 frontier model arms demonstrates that high-fidelity user simulation is already attainable: leading models achieve up to 84.7% full-pass adherence under unprompted conditions. At the same time, APB identifies clear behavioral boundaries: adherence drops across interaction modalities (only 37.9-64.3% pass all four surfaces), multi-attribute demands degrade retention, and competing model families exhibit pronounced behavioral divergence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgentPersonaBench (APB)，一个评估人格条件化（persona conditioning）是否忠实驱动下游智能体行为的基准，通过四个真实度递增的交互界面从可观察行为验证人格一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要评估对话风格或自我报告，而非真实的行为保真度，无法判断人格条件化是否真正忠实引导智能体行为，因此需要一个新的行为级评估基准。
AI.method: APB 每次评估一个潜在人格特质，将目标特质嵌入完整的合成画像中（不明示特质、不披露测试）；通过 survey、chat、web（交互式网页环境）、app（桌面软件环境）四个真实度递增的交互界面，从可观察动作严格验证真值一致性。基准包含 2,460 个任务、覆盖 867 个特质，并经自动审计与专家复核。
AI.result: 对 20 个前沿模型变体的评估显示：领先模型在无提示条件下可达最高 84.7% 的完全通过一致性；但跨交互模态一致性下降到仅 37.9%–64.3% 能通过全部四个界面；多属性要求会降低特质保持；不同模型家族表现出显著的行为差异。
AI.conclusion: 高保真用户模拟已可实现，但存在明确的行为边界；APB 为人格条件化的行为忠实度提供了严格且可扩展的评估手段。

title: Where Did the Repair First Go Wrong? Localizing the Origins of Silent Failures in Agentic Vulnerability Repair
summary: Localizing where an LLM-based agent first fails to uphold security during a repair can show which stage of its workflow needs an additional safeguard. This is difficult for silent failures, which are patches that pass syntactic and functional checks but still contain a security vulnerability. Because such patches give no observable failure signal, existing failure attribution methods, which rely on observed task failures and labelled failure steps, are less suited to them. We propose Security Awareness Gap Evaluation (SAGE), a trace-based method that combines an assessment of the security reasoning recorded at each turn with the reconstructed code history to identify the earliest turn at which a repair diverges from the task's security intent. We evaluate SAGE on 95 confirmed silent failures drawn from 3,684 repair traces produced by six agent frameworks and six base models on SecurityEval and CVEfixes. SAGE assigned an origin in 93 cases. Most origins were an unaddressed security requirement or an inadequate defence choice, and only five coincided with the code change itself. When the agent introduced the vulnerable code, the origin preceded the write in 14 of 19 cases. Repeated scoring and a second judge reproduced the origin type more consistently than the exact turn, and agreement was lowest for traces that kept only the final file.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGE，一种基于轨迹的方法，通过结合各轮安全推理评估与重建的代码历史，定位LLM修复过程中最早偏离安全意图的轮次，用以归因无观测失败信号的"静默失败"。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在代码修复中的安全失败往往是"静默"的：补丁通过了语法与功能检查，却仍含安全漏洞，缺乏可观测的失败信号，导致依赖任务失败与已标注失败步骤的现有归因方法难以适用。定位首次失守的轮次可指出工作流中哪一阶段需要额外防护。
AI.method: SAGE（Security Awareness Gap Evaluation）为轨迹型方法，将每一轮记录的安全推理评估与重建的代码历史相结合，识别修复过程最早偏离任务安全意图的那一轮。在SecurityEval与CVEfixes上，取自6个智能体框架、6个基础模型产生的3,684条修复轨迹中的95个已确认静默失败上评测，并进行了重复评分与第二位评审者的复现检验。
AI.result: SAGE在93例中给出了起源归因。多数起源为"未处理的安全需求"或"防御选择不当"，仅5例与代码改动本身重合。当智能体引入漏洞代码时，19例中有14例起源早于该次写入。重复评分与第二位评审者对起源类型的复现一致性高于对精确轮次的一致性，且在仅保留最终文件的轨迹上一致性最低。
AI.conclusion: 安全失败的根源多不在代码写入本身，而在于更早的安全需求处理与防御选择阶段，故防护应前移。起源类型比精确轮次更稳健可复现，轨迹保真度（是否保留中间历史）会影响归因一致性。

title: AgentDoxx: Agentic Re-identification of Anonymized Text with Web Search
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) gain tool use capabilities such as web search, they can retrieve and cross-reference public information, creating privacy risks beyond memorization. One manifestation is re-identification: linking an anonymized interview transcript to a named individual. Yet without ground-truth identities, the coverage of such attacks and the protection offered by a defense cannot be reliably measured. We introduce AgentDOXX, an evaluation suite of 822 synthetic interview transcripts grounded in public information about real individuals with known identities. We evaluate fifteen configurations of open-weight and proprietary models, isolating the effect of web search, and analyze their search trajectories to distinguish retrieval-driven from parametric identifications. Ground-truth identities reveal that re-identification risk is distributed across an agent's execution: retrieval and parametric recall both contribute, with open-weight models identifying 15-28% of transcripts without search; identification succeeds in over 88% of cases once the target appears in a retrieved result; entity masking leaves at least one attacker successful on 85.3% of a stratified sample; and privacy instructions suppress naming but not retrieval, with configurations scoring 0% accuracy yet retrieving the subject in up to 62% of transcripts. We further show that observed attack trajectories can provide supervision for localizing identifying spans, offering a path toward attack-informed anonymization.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 AgentDOXX 评测套件，用 822 份基于公开信息构建的合成访谈文本评估 LLM 智能体在具备网络搜索能力时的再识别（去匿名化）风险，发现检索与参数化记忆共同导致风险，且现有防御手段效果有限。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 获得网络搜索等工具使用能力，它们能检索并交叉比对公开信息，从而产生超越单纯记忆的隐私风险，典型表现是将匿名访谈文本关联到具名个人（再识别）。但缺乏真实身份标注，使得此类攻击的覆盖范围与防御效果难以被可靠衡量。
AI.method: 提出 AgentDOXX 评测套件，包含 822 份合成访谈文本，文本以真实个体的公开信息为根基且身份已知。对 15 种开源与闭源模型配置进行评测，分离网络搜索的影响，并分析其搜索轨迹以区分检索驱动的识别与参数化识别。
AI.result: 再识别风险分布于智能体的整个执行过程：检索与参数化回忆均有贡献，开源模型在无搜索情况下可识别 15–28% 的文本；一旦目标出现在检索结果中，识别成功率超过 88%；实体掩码在分层样本中仍使至少一个攻击者成功 85.3%；隐私指令能抑制命名但不能抑制检索，部分配置准确率为 0% 却仍在多达 62% 的文本中检索到目标对象。
AI.conclusion: 真实身份标注揭示了去匿名化风险的普遍性与防御的不足。此外，观测到的攻击轨迹可为定位身份识别性片段提供监督信号，为"攻击信息驱动的匿名化"提供了可行路径。

title: No Hindsight for LLM Fact-Checkers: Measuring Leakage Channels in Misinformation Detection
summary: As automated fact-checking scales on social media, large language model (LLM) verdict scores can look stronger than warranted. One reason is that evaluations mix in information that was not knowable at claim time. Two channels are easy to conflate: outcomes memorized in pre-training and retrieved evidence published after the claim. Yet standard benchmarks rarely separate the two. In this study we measure both channels on AVeriTeC and QuanTemp++ by reconstructing point-in-time evidence conditions and probing for outcome information encoded in model representations. We find substantial evidence of parametric leakage, that can be hidden by the aggregate accuracy, while a simple representation bottleneck reduces this future leakage more efficiently than a mutual-information-based training penalty. We also find that allowing post-claim evidence inflates zero-shot accuracy by 6.3 points in AVeriTeC while the effect is negligible in QuanTemp++, where retrieval provides little post-claim evidence. These results show that misinformation benchmarks can overstate fact-checking performance when they do not account for what information was actually available at claim time.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示自动化事实核查基准存在"未来信息泄漏"问题：模型表现被预训练记忆的结果信息和声明发布后检索到的证据所虚高，标准基准很少区分这两条通道。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型在社交媒体事实核查中规模化应用，其判决分数可能高于实际合理水平。原因之一是评估中混入了在声明发布时无法获知的信息：一是预训练中记忆的结果，二是声明发布后发表的检索证据。而主流基准很少区分这两条通道，导致误判模型真实核查能力。
AI.method: 在 AVeriTeC 和 QuanTemp++ 两个数据集上，通过重建"时点证据"条件，并探测模型表征中编码的结果信息，分别测量参数化泄漏（预训练记忆）与检索后置证据这两条通道。
AI.result: 发现显著的参数化泄漏，且这种泄漏可被总体准确率掩盖；一个简单的表征瓶颈比基于互信息的训练惩罚更有效地减少未来泄漏。允许使用声明后证据会使 AVeriTeC 的零样本准确率虚高 6.3 个百分点，而在 QuanTemp++ 中影响可忽略，因为其检索几乎无法提供声明后证据。
AI.conclusion: 若基准不考量声明发布时实际可获取的信息，会高估模型的事实核查性能。因此误导性信息检测基准需纳入时点性信息控制，才能反映真实核查能力。

title: TRIM-ReID: Duplication-Aware Token Reduction and Modality-Aligned Interaction for Multi-Modal Object Re-Identification
summary: Multi-modal object re-identification exploits complementary RGB, near-infrared (NIR), and thermal-infrared (TIR) observations to retrieve target objects. However, existing methods commonly employ visual encoders optimized for global image-text alignment and select tokens using learned importance scores. Such designs fail to preserve fine-grained identity cues or explicitly account for token redundancy, resulting in underrepresented local evidence and duplicated tokens that lead to noisy and costly cross-modal interaction. To address this gap, we propose TRIM-ReID, a compact framework that unifies dense feature extraction, intra-modal token reduction, and inter-modal aligned interaction. Specifically, semantically rich and spatially coherent patch features are extracted by Dense Identity Representation (DIR), which leverages DINOv3 to preserve fine-grained identity information. We then introduce Token Diversity Mining (TDM) to identify complementary local evidence and construct compact modality-specific token sets by suppressing repetitive patches while preserving informative diversity. Retained tokens are subsequently fused by Modal Relational Interaction (MRI) to enable effective information exchange across modalities, while a triangular alignment loss explicitly regularizes their joint relationships to maintain cross-modal semantic consistency under independent token selection. Extensive experiments on RGBNT201, RGBNT100, and MSVR310 demonstrate that TRIM-ReID achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRIM-ReID框架，通过密集特征提取、模态内token削减与模态间对齐交互，实现高效的多模态目标重识别，并在三个数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态目标重识别方法使用面向全局图文对齐优化的视觉编码器，并基于学习的重要性分数选择token。这类设计无法保留细粒度身份线索，也未显式处理token冗余，导致局部证据表征不足、token重复，进而引发跨模态交互噪声大且计算开销高。
AI.method: 提出TRIM-ReID紧凑框架，统一三部分：1) Dense Identity Representation (DIR)，基于DINOv3提取语义丰富且空间连贯的patch特征，保留细粒度身份信息；2) Token Diversity Mining (TDM)，识别互补局部证据，抑制重复patch，构建紧凑的模态特定token集合；3) Modal Relational Interaction (MRI)，融合保留的token实现跨模态信息交换，并用三角对齐损失显式正则化其联合关系，在独立token选择下维持跨模态语义一致性。
AI.result: 在RGBNT201、RGBNT100和MSVR310三个数据集上的大量实验表明，TRIM-ReID达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: TRIM-ReID通过整合密集特征提取、模态内token削减与模态间对齐交互，有效解决了细粒度身份线索丢失和token冗余问题，提升了多模态目标重识别的性能与效率。

title: Correct Verdicts, Flawed Reasoning: Structured Auditing of LLM-based Vulnerability Reasoning
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for automated software vulnerability analysis. Binary classification alone is insufficient; practitioners need explanations to triage bugs and engineer patches. Standard practice relies on Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting, but free-form reasoning allows models to obscure logical leaps, hallucinated execution steps, and internal inconsistencies behind plausible prose. Our manual audit reveals that approximately 60% of correct vulnerability verdicts are accompanied by fabricated or unverifiable claims, and free-form explanations allow reasoning errors to evade LLM-as-a-judge evaluation.
  We present Vulnerability Explanation Reasoning Auditor (VERA), an automated framework for auditing LLM vulnerability reasoning. Rather than accepting free-form text, VERA asks models to output a Structured Reasoning Record (SRR) encoding tracked pointers, memory operations, and state transitions in machine-readable fields. A multi-stage judge audits each SRR against eight reasoning failure modes using deterministic checks, with LLM calls reserved for semantic interpretation. The standardized SRR schema also enables automated mutation testing to benchmark judges at scale without human annotation. Our evaluation shows reasoning flaws occur in correct verdicts just as frequently as incorrect ones, and VERA exposes 87% of reasoning errors that free-form LLM-as-judge systematically miss.

AI.tldr: VERA是一个自动化审计框架，通过结构化推理记录（SRR）和多阶段审核机制，揭示LLM漏洞分析中正确答案背后的推理错误。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地用于自动化软件漏洞分析，但仅靠二元分类不足，实践者需要解释来分诊缺陷和编写补丁。常用的思维链（CoT）提示允许自由推理，使模型能够用看似合理的文字掩盖逻辑跳跃、幻觉执行步骤和内部不一致。人工审计发现约60%正确的漏洞判定伴随捏造或不可验证的主张，且自由形式的解释能让推理错误逃避LLM-as-a-judge评估。
AI.method: 提出VERA框架。它不直接接受自由文本，而是要求模型输出结构化推理记录（SRR），以机器可读字段编码受跟踪指针、内存操作和状态转换。一个多阶段评判器使用确定性检查对每个SRR进行八种推理失败模式的审计，LLM调用仅用于语义解释。标准化的SRR模式还支持自动化变异测试，无需人工标注即可大规模基准测试评判器。
AI.result: 评估显示，推理缺陷在正确判定中出现的频率与在错误判定中一样频繁。VERA暴露了自由形式LLM-as-a-judge系统性地遗漏的87%推理错误。
AI.conclusion: 结论是VERA通过结构化推理记录和确定性审计，能有效发现自由形式评判遗漏的推理错误，提升LLM漏洞分析的可靠性。

title: SimpleMark: Fast Multi-Bit Text Watermarking under f -Divergence Constraints
summary: We introduce a framework for multi-bit text watermarking with security defined directly through $f$-divergence from the base language model distribution. Unlike prior approaches that focus on average-key distortion-freeness or a particular statistical distance, our formulation supports general $f$-divergences, including total variation and KL divergence, and enforces the guarantee for each realized key and embedded message. We develop a coding-based watermarking scheme that optimally biases next-token distributions subject to a prescribed divergence budget, and characterize the resulting tradeoff between embedding rate, decoding reliability, and statistical security. Experimentally, we compare our method against prior multi-bit watermarking schemes across modern language models and payload regimes. Our approach achieves substantially lower watermark detectability while maintaining competitive message-recovery performance and generation quality. Our results provide a unified view of secure multi-bit watermarking and recover several commonly used security notions as special cases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多比特文本水印框架，以f-散度直接定义安全性，支持一般散度并对每个密钥与消息提供保证，实验表明其检测性更低且保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有水印方法多关注平均密钥下的失真无关性或特定统计距离，缺乏对一般散度、且对每个具体密钥和嵌入消息都成立的安全保证。
AI.method: 提出基于编码的水印方案，在给定散度预算下最优地偏置下一词分布，并刻画嵌入率、解码可靠性与统计安全性之间的权衡。
AI.result: 在现代语言模型与多种载荷设置下与既有方案对比，本方法显著降低水印可检测性，同时保持有竞争力的消息恢复性能与生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为安全多比特水印提供统一视角，并将若干常用安全概念作为特例纳入其中。

title: A Systematic Analysis of the Predictive Power of LM Surprisal in Reading Chinese
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures. Hongao Zhu and Muxiaoqiao Xu contributed equally. Correspondence to: hai.hu@polyu.edu.hk
summary: This study analyzes the predictive power of LM-derived, token-level surprisal on Mandarin Chinese reading times. We first propose the Shortest Matching Sequence (SMS), an alignment scheme that maps between the word segmentation assumed by eye-tracking corpora and the LMs' subword tokenization, as the two tokenizations often disagree in the context of Mandarin Chinese. Then, using a suite of Chinese-Pythia models (14M-1.4B) trained on scratch with 30B tokens, we examine how well surprisal predicts first fixation duration, gaze duration, and total reading time in three paragraph-level eye-tracking corpora of Mandarin Chinese (GECO-CN, HKP, and MECO). Contrary to previous null findings, our results show that surprisal is predictive of Chinese reading times. However, whether predictive power scales with model size and the amount of training is corpus-specific: bigger models predict better in GECO-CN, whereas inverse scaling emerges in HKP and, at the largest sizes, in MECO. Subsequently, we tested one possible explanation for the inverse scaling in HKP and found that checkpoints whose surprisal remains closer to $n$-gram statistics are better predictors of reading. All in all, the predictive power of surprisal on Chinese reading time measurements is corpus-specific, which cautions against drawing scaling conclusions from a single corpus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SMS对齐方案解决中文分词与LM子词不一致问题，用中文Pythia模型（14M-1.4B）检验surprisal对中文阅读时间的预测力，发现surprisal确实有预测性，但缩放趋势因语料库而异（GECO-CN正向，HKP与MECO出现逆缩放）。
AI.motivation: 以往关于surprisal预测中文阅读时间的研究多为零结果，且中文的分词方式与语言模型子词切分常不一致，导致对齐困难；同时模型规模与预测力的关系尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出最短匹配序列（SMS）对齐方案，映射眼动语料词切分与LM子词切分；使用在30B token上从头训练的中文Pythia模型（14M-1.4B），在GECO-CN、HKP、MECO三个段落级中文眼动语料上检验surprisal对首次注视时长、凝视时长和总阅读时间的预测力，并考察逆缩放的潜在解释。
AI.result: surprisal对中文阅读时间具有预测力，与以往零结果相反；但缩放规律因语料库而异：GECO-CN中模型越大预测越好，HKP中呈逆缩放，MECO在最大规模时也出现逆缩放；surprisal更接近n-gram统计的检查点预测阅读效果更好。
AI.conclusion: surprisal对中文阅读时间的预测力具有语料库特异性，不能仅凭单一语料库得出缩放规律结论。

title: Beyond Plausibility: Verifiable Fine-Grained Image Editing on Structured Assets
summary: Fine-grained image editing requires more than producing a visually plausible result: an editor must execute the requested attribute change precisely while leaving everything else intact. However, existing benchmarks leave a critical gap between realism and verifiability: benchmarks built on realistic images typically rely on human or vision--language model judgments, while deterministic evaluation has largely focused on synthetic shape canvases, with application-oriented extensions primarily limited to charts. This makes it difficult to determine precisely how much of a requested edit was executed, where unintended changes occurred, and whether small differences between models reflect genuine editing capability or evaluator uncertainty. To bridge this gap, we present VeriEdit-Bench, a benchmark for fine-grained, instruction-faithful image editing across realistic structured assets with deterministic, four-axis evaluation. Its 1,740 cases are compiled from the source code of 153 Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) graphics, charts, web interfaces, and presentation slides. Controlled source-code edits preserve the original visual context while yielding exact target images, pixel-level edit masks, and explicit edit specifications, enabling reproducible scoring along four axes: edit fidelity, preservation, localization, and magnitude. Evaluating eleven editors, we find that even the strongest model remains far from full credit; rankings for the same recoloring operation reverse between charts and SVG graphics; and outputs with similar pixel-accuracy profiles can still differ substantially in localization and change magnitude. This decomposition yields graded, verifiable feedback and exposes model-specific capability and failure profiles that holistic scores or evaluator-dependent judgments may obscure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VeriEdit-Bench，一个基于真实结构化素材源代码构建的细粒度图像编辑基准，包含1,740个案例，采用确定性四轴评估（编辑保真度、保持性、定位、幅度），揭示了现有基准在真实性与可验证性之间的空白。
AI.motivation: 细粒度图像编辑不仅要求视觉上合理，还需精确执行属性改变同时保持其余部分不变。然而现有基准存在鸿沟：基于真实图像的基准依赖人工或视觉语言模型判断，缺乏确定性；而确定性评估主要局限于合成形状画布，应用扩展也仅限于图表。这导致难以精确判断编辑执行程度、意外改变位置，以及模型间微小差异是真实能力体现还是评估不确定性。
AI.method: 构建VeriEdit-Bench基准，其1,740个案例从153个SVG图形、图表、网页界面和演示幻灯片的源代码编译而来。通过受控的源代码编辑，在保持原始视觉上下文的同时生成精确目标图像、像素级编辑掩码和明确的编辑规范，从而支持沿四个轴进行可复现评分：编辑保真度、保持性、定位和幅度。
AI.result: 评估了十一个编辑器，发现即使最强模型也远未达到满分；同一重着色操作在图表和SVG图形间的排名会发生反转；具有相似像素精度特征的输出在定位和变化幅度上仍可能差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 这种分解式评估产生分级、可验证的反馈，并揭示出整体分数或依赖评估者的判断可能掩盖的模型特定能力与失败特征。

title: TimeNet: An Extensible Unified Data Infrastructure for Next-Generation Temporal Foundation Models
summary: Temporal Foundation Models (TFMs) aim to generalize across domains, datasets, and tasks. Yet, their development remains constrained by fragmented, task-specific data formats, annotations, and processing pipelines. We introduce TimeNet, an open-source data standard and scalable infrastructure that decouples temporal data from task definitions and represents signals, metadata, annotations, and supervision in a shared, extensible data model. TimeNet supports multimodal signals with regular, irregular, or ordinal time axes and expresses different task families (including classification, forecasting, temporal localization, question answering, generation, and editing) as reusable views over the same recordings. This shared representation enables heterogeneous time-series datasets to be combined for large-scale model training across domains, modalities, and tasks. We demonstrate TimeNet by transcoding datasets with 1.5M task instances spanning diverse domains, modalities, temporal scales, and forms of supervision, while retaining practical I/O performance relative to native formats. TimeNet enables an existing TFN training pipeline to support joint training on a configurable number of heterogeneous datasets through configuration changes alone. We show this capability by training TFM across multiple datasets and tasks, obtaining a 14% F1 score improvement compared with models trained on individual datasets. These results show that TimeNet provides the data and systems foundation needed to move beyond task- and dataset-specific TFMs toward models that can learn jointly across heterogeneous domains, modalities, temporal scales, and forms of supervision from a common data model.

AI.tldr: TimeNet 是一个开源时序数据标准与可扩展基础设施，通过统一数据模型解耦时序数据与任务定义，支持异构数据集联合训练时序基础模型，实现 14% 的 F1 提升。
AI.motivation: 时序基础模型（TFM）旨在跨领域、数据集和任务泛化，但其发展受限于碎片化、任务特定的数据格式、标注和处理流程。因此需要一个统一的开放数据标准与基础设施来支撑大规模联合训练。
AI.method: 提出 TimeNet，一种开源数据标准与可扩展基础设施。它解耦时序数据与任务定义，用共享可扩展的数据模型表示信号、元数据、标注和监督；支持规则、不规则或序数时间轴的多模态信号，并将分类、预测、时序定位、问答、生成、编辑等任务族表达为同一记录上的可复用视图。
AI.result: 通过转码包含 150 万个任务实例、跨越多样领域、模态、时间尺度与监督形式的数据集来验证 TimeNet，同时保持相对原生格式的实用 I/O 性能。仅通过配置变更即可让现有 TFN 训练流程支持在可配置数量的异构数据集上联合训练；跨多数据集与多任务训练 TFM，相比在单一数据集上训练的模型获得 14% 的 F1 提升。
AI.conclusion: TimeNet 提供了所需的数据与系统基础，使 TFM 能够超越任务与数据集特定的限制，从统一数据模型出发，跨异构领域、模态、时间尺度与监督形式进行联合学习。

title: Online AutoML: Evaluating Poisoning Attacks on Adversarial Training Defense Strategy in IoT Networks
comment: Accepted and to appear in IEEE CASCON 2026. Code is available at: https://github.com/ChiNonsoHenry16/Label-Flip-NoiseInjection_OnAutoML
summary: Machine learning (ML)-powered poisoning attack vectors are adversarial maneuvers whereby an attacker intentionally inserts, corrupts, or alters training data to distort an ML model's learning process. The objective is to diminish model efficacy, instill biases, induce misclassifications, or include concealed backdoors that may be attacked during implementation. In streaming contexts, poisoning attacks pose significant risks since models perpetually update based on incoming streams of data. An assailant may incrementally introduce harmful samples into this data stream, leading the model to assimilate erroneous features over time without timely identification. Therefore, this study is aimed at evaluating the efficacy of the adversarial training (AT) defense approach against poisoning attacks (label flip and noise injection) using an online AutoML pipeline for Internet of Things (IoT) networks. Specifically, poisoning attacks (label flip and noise injection) were applied to streaming-capable AutoML learners (Hoeffding Tree (HT), Leveraging Bagging (LB), Adaptive Random Forest (ARF), Hoeffding Adaptive Tree (HAT), and Streaming Random Patches (SRP)). Under the strongest poisoning rate (PR = 1.0), AT-SRP achieved the highest F1-score against label flip poisoning (0.904), while AT-LB achieved the highest F1-score against noise-injection poisoning (0.933). Finally, several drift detection methods were used for rolling accuracy and prequential evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了对抗训练(AT)防御方法在IoT在线AutoML管道中抵御投毒攻击(标签翻转与噪声注入)的效果。
AI.motivation: ML驱动的投毒攻击通过插入、破坏或篡改训练数据来扭曲模型学习过程，可降低模型效能、引入偏差、诱导误分类或植入隐蔽后门。在流式场景中，模型持续基于数据流更新，攻击者可逐步注入有害样本，使模型逐渐吸收错误特征而难以被及时发现，因此需要评估防御手段的有效性。
AI.method: 在面向IoT网络的在线AutoML管道中应用投毒攻击(标签翻转和噪声注入)，并采用对抗训练(AT)作为防御方法。测试对象为具备流式学习能力的AutoML学习器：Hoeffding Tree (HT)、Leveraging Bagging (LB)、Adaptive Random Forest (ARF)、Hoeffding Adaptive Tree (HAT)和Streaming Random Patches (SRP)。同时使用多种漂移检测方法进行滚动准确率与前序评估。
AI.result: 在最强的投毒率(PR = 1.0)下，AT-SRP在标签翻转投毒中取得最高F1分数(0.904)，而AT-LB在噪声注入投毒中取得最高F1分数(0.933)。研究还采用了多种漂移检测方法进行滚动准确率与前序评估。
AI.conclusion: 对抗训练(AT)防御方法结合合适的流式AutoML学习器可有效抵御投毒攻击：AT-SRP对标签翻转、AT-LB对噪声注入表现最佳，表明针对不同攻击类型选择匹配的防御-学习器组合至关重要。

title: Rewrite What Matters: Adaptive Multilingual Query Rewriting for Reasoning via Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: In multilingual scenarios, queries with equivalent semantics but in different languages could guide the model into different reasoning trajectories, leading to performance disparities. To mitigate this gap, previous studies typically apply a one-size-fits-all query rewriting strategy, such as translation, which overlooks the fact that different scenarios require diverse types of semantic transformations. In this paper, we propose mRewriter-R1, an agentic multilingual query rewriting framework with reinforcement learning. Unlike single-turn rewriting, mRewriter-R1 formulates multilingual query rewriting as a multi-turn sequential decision-making process, where the model dynamically performs multi-aspect optimization through adaptive operator selection. Experimental results demonstrate that mRewriter-R1 outperforms all strong multilingual rewriting baselines on different large reasoning backbones. Further analyses show that the learned policy can adaptively decide on rewriting operators according to query characteristics, exhibiting strong generalization ability across diverse reasoning tasks, and plug-and-play compatibility with heterogeneous reasoning language models.

AI.tldr: 提出mRewriter-R1，一个基于强化学习的智能体式多语言查询改写框架，将多语言查询改写建模为多轮序贯决策过程，通过自适应算子选择实现多维度优化，性能超越所有强基线。
AI.motivation: 多语言场景下，语义等价但语言不同的查询会引导模型走向不同的推理轨迹，导致性能差异。现有研究通常采用"一刀切"的改写策略（如翻译），忽略了不同场景需要不同类型的语义变换这一问题。
AI.method: mRewriter-R1是一个基于强化学习的智能体式多语言查询改写框架。与单轮改写不同，它将多语言查询改写建模为多轮序贯决策过程，模型通过自适应算子选择动态执行多方面优化。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，在不同的大型推理骨干模型上，mRewriter-R1均优于所有强多语言改写基线。
AI.conclusion: 进一步分析显示，所学策略能够根据查询特征自适应地决定改写算子，在多样推理任务上展现出强泛化能力，并能即插即用兼容异构推理语言模型。

title: Detecting Defects that Matter: An Application-Driven Benchmark for Anomaly Detection in Manufacturing and Retail Logistics (VAND 4.0 Challenge)
summary: Existing Anomaly Detection benchmarks are saturated and often unrealistic. As part of the VAND 4.0 Challenge, we introduce a hidden-test, application-driven benchmark across two deployment-critical domains: industrial manufacturing and retail logistics. In the Industrial Track (MVTec AD 2), the results reveal that unsupervised anomaly segmentation remains challenging: the best regular-setting method achieves only ~57\% pixel-level $SegF_1$, indicating substantial room for improvement. Zero-shot approaches trail by ~15 $SegF_1$ points, confirming that task-specific training on normal data remains essential for precise defect localization. Robustness to distribution shifts remains a key open challenge and DINOv3-backbones clearly dominate this track. In the Retail Track (Kaputt 2), the results reveal that (1) supervised defect detection is approaching saturation for common defect types; (2) the best off-the-shelf VLM approach trails specialized models by ~28 AP, confirming that currently VLMs cannot replace fine-tuned detectors, (3) reference images did not prove helpful for top-performing approaches. Performance collapses on rare defects (spillage ~53 AP, missing units ~27 AP), where the supervised ceiling is bounded by data availability. To drive future progress in this domain, we provide a new low-prevalence retail AD dataset (Kaputt-Rare). Across both tracks, computational efficiency is assessed as a first-class metric combining performance, throughput, memory, and power consumption. We introduce a novel metric for measuring efficiency and reveal that that top-performing methods rely on heavy architectures while efficiency is largely neglected. Overall, we conclude that the community needs (a) more efficiency-aware method development, and (b) true anomaly detection approaches for rare defects and shifting conditions. https://sites.google.com/view/vand4-cvpr2026/challenge

AI.tldr: VAND 4.0 挑战赛提出面向工业制造与零售物流的隐藏测试基准：工业轨（MVTec AD 2）无监督分割仍困难（最优约57% SegF1），零售轨（Kaputt 2）监督检测趋于饱和但罕见缺陷性能崩塌，且效率被普遍忽视。
AI.motivation: 现有异常检测基准已趋于饱和且不够真实，缺乏面向实际部署场景、覆盖分布偏移与效率约束的评测，因此需要应用驱动、隐藏测试的基准来反映真实挑战。
AI.method: 作为 VAND 4.0 挑战赛的一部分，构建覆盖工业制造（MVTec AD 2）与零售物流（Kaputt 2）两个部署关键领域的隐藏测试基准，涵盖常规与零样本设定、监督与VLM对比、参考图像使用，并首次将计算效率（性能、吞吐、内存、功耗）作为一等指标并提出新效率度量；同时发布低发生率零售数据集 Kaputt-Rare。
AI.result: 工业轨最优常规方法仅约57%像素级SegF1，零样本落后约15点，分布偏移鲁棒性仍是开放难题，DINOv3骨干明显占优；零售轨监督检测对常见缺陷接近饱和，最优现成VLM落后专用模型约28 AP，参考图像对顶尖方法无帮助，罕见缺陷性能崩塌（溢出约53 AP、缺件约27 AP）；顶尖方法多依赖重型架构，效率被忽视。
AI.conclusion: 社区需要（a）更注重效率的方法研发，以及（b）面向罕见缺陷与条件漂移的真正异常检测方法。

title: CORE-RL: Confidence-Oriented Reliability Evaluation of Black-Box Reinforcement Learning Policies
summary: The deployment of Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents in critical domains must be preceded with a pipeline to evaluate the alignment of the RL agent with complex multi-objective specifications and robustness under real-world environmental drift. However, to protect intellectual property, the RL agent may be delivered for evaluation as opaque executable or remote API, which makes traditional evaluation techniques based on the internals of the policies infeasible. To address this gap, CORE-RL: Confidence-Oriented Reliability Evaluation of black box RL policy is proposed in this paper. The CORE-RL pipeline introduces a Unified Reliability Metric that formally integrates early task termination and safety constraint violations, preventing unsafe policies from masking failures through premature episode halts. By subjecting the policy to a noise certification envelope of perceptual noise, actuation noise and change in environment dynamics, the pipeline computes the finite-sample Clopper-Pearson bounds on unified reliability metric and Hoeffdings' lower bound on reward and safety cost. The pipeline then defines safe operational design domain to report high-confidence certificates for safety and expected performance. Experiments on continuous control tasks demonstrate the CORE-RL pipeline's ability to automatically reject non-compliant policies and map the safe Operational Design Domain (ODD) of safety-aware policies. Thus CORE-RL provides an evaluation framework towards a quantitative, transparent and reproducible, statistical rationale necessary to safely evaluate, compare, and deploy black box RL solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CORE-RL，一个面向黑箱强化学习策略的置信导向可靠性评估框架，通过统一可靠性指标与统计界限，量化评估策略在噪声扰动下的安全性与性能。
AI.motivation: 在关键领域部署RL智能体前需评估其与多目标规范的符合度及环境漂移下的鲁棒性。但由于知识产权保护，RL策略可能以不透明的可执行文件或远程API形式交付，导致基于策略内部信息的传统评估方法不可行。
AI.method: 提出CORE-RL流水线：引入统一可靠性指标，将早期任务终止与安全约束违反统一形式化，防止不安全的策略通过提前终止掩盖失败；对策略施加包含感知噪声、执行噪声和环境动力学变化的噪声认证包络；计算统一可靠性指标的有限样本Clopper-Pearson界，以及奖励与安全代价的Hoeffding下界；据此定义安全运行设计域（ODD）。
AI.result: 在连续控制任务上的实验表明，CORE-RL流水线能自动拒绝不合规策略，并绘制出具备安全意识的策略的安全运行设计域（ODD）。
AI.conclusion: CORE-RL为黑箱RL解决方案提供了定量、透明、可复现且具统计学依据的评估框架，支撑其安全评估、比较与部署。

title: Bounded Provisional Visibility: Controlling Poisoning Exposure in Continuously Ingested RAG Vector Stores
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Accepted at IEEE CBDCom 2026. Author accepted manuscript. Reproducibility artifact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23152010
summary: Continuous ingestion can expose new retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) content to retrieval before vetting completes, creating a temporal attack surface that conventional admission decisions do not capture. We present a fail-closed provisional-visibility protocol that admits new content under a deadline, hides items whose verification has not committed in time, and supports lineage-scoped containment. The protocol bounds unvetted exposure by the configured visibility budget plus query-path enforcement delay; poisoning exposure remains conditional on verifier correctness. We evaluate the design on five workloads of encoded natural-language documents using an exact backend and Milvus. Under verifier backlog, the deadline reduced median poisoned retrievals from 34 (29--34) to 7 (6--7) relative to asynchronous admission without a deadline, with the same reduction in displaced clean results. Verify-before-visible avoided provisional exposure but delayed clean first visibility to 6.3 s, whereas provisional admission made content visible within 3 ms; expired clean items could nevertheless experience temporary availability gaps. Replaying decisions from a recipe-specific detector illustrated the protocol boundary: false promotions left poison visible, while false refusals excluded clean content from retrieval. Standalone Milvus tests characterized enforcement delay and concurrent HNSW retrieval on one node. These results clarify which guarantees come from the protocol and which outcomes depend on detector quality, while quantifying the freshness and availability trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 提出一种失败关闭(fail-closed)的临时可见性协议，用于连续数据摄取场景下的RAG检索准入，通过截止时间隐藏未完成校验的内容并对未审核暴露施加预算约束。
AI.motivation: 持续摄取的新内容可能在审查完成前就进入检索，形成传统准入决策无法捕获的时间性攻击面，即未审核内容被提前检索暴露的风险。
AI.method: 设计带截止时间的临时可见性协议：在时限内临时准入新内容，对未按时完成校验的条目进行隐藏，并支持沿数据血缘的范围化隔离；在五个编码自然语言文档工作负载上用精确后端与Milvus进行评估，并回放特定检测器的决策。
AI.result: 在验证器积压时，带截止时间使中毒检索的中位数从34(29–34)降至7(6–7)，被挤占的干净结果减少幅度相同；先验证后可见避免了临时暴露但干净内容首次可见延迟达6.3 s，而临时准入在3 ms内可见，过期干净条目可能出现短暂可用性缺口；假放行使毒物可见，假拒绝剔除干净内容；单独Milvus测试刻画了执行延迟与单节点并发HNSW检索。
AI.conclusion: 该协议将未审核暴露限定为配置的可见性预算加查询路径执行延迟，而中毒暴露仍取决于验证器正确性，需明确区分协议保证与检测器质量决定的结果，并量化了新鲜度与可用性的权衡。

title: Scaling Verifiable Environments for Long-horizon Work Agents
summary: Work agents operate over digital artifacts to execute professional knowledge-intensive work, requiring training environments that support long-horizon interaction and trustworthy verification. However, hand-crafted environments incur prohibitive engineering overhead that prevents environment scaling, whereas synthesis methods sacrifice workspace complexity, realism, or grounded verifiability. To bridge this gap, we introduce WorkForge, a scalable synthesis framework for constructing verifiable work-agent environments from real-world resources. Starting from expert workflows, WorkForge first identifies the resources, decisions, and deliverables required by each workflow. It then retrieves relevant real-world files and organizes them into a workspace. WorkForge inspects the workspace to extract concrete, checkable facts about its content. These factual anchors fix which task types the workspace can support and how their outcomes can be verified. Therefore, WorkForge derives each task's instructions, solution plan, and complementary programmatic and semantic verifiers directly from these factual anchors, keeping verification traceable to observable workspace evidence. Furthermore, we construct 16.7K verifiable environments across 40 professional domains, with workspaces collectively covering 60 file types. Post-training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base improves GDPVal from 45.5 to 73.6 and APEX Score from 5.0 to 21.3, while enabling Qwen3.5-27B to achieve highly competitive performance and outperform strong competitors. Our analyses confirm the efficacy of the proposed method and reveal consistent scaling behaviors across both data volume and interaction horizons.

AI.tldr: 提出可扩展的合成框架 WorkForge，从真实资源自动构建可验证的工作型智能体环境，并构建大规模数据集提升模型专业任务表现。
AI.motivation: 工作型智能体需在数字工件上执行长周期、知识密集的专业任务，训练环境需支持长程交互与可信验证。但人工构建环境工程成本过高、难以扩展，而现有合成方法又在工作区复杂度、真实性或可验证性上有所牺牲。因此需要一个兼顾规模化与可验证性的环境合成框架。
AI.method: WorkForge 从专家工作流出发，识别所需资源、决策与交付物，检索真实文件并组织为工作区；随后检查工作区以抽取具体、可核查的事实锚点。这些锚点决定工作区可支持的任务类型及其结果验证方式，据此推导任务指令、解决方案计划，以及配套的程序化与语义验证器，使验证可追溯到工作区中可观察的证据。
AI.result: 基于该方法构建了 16.7K 个可验证环境，覆盖 40 个专业领域、60 种文件类型。后训练 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base 使 GDPVal 从 45.5 提升至 73.6，APEX Score 从 5.0 提升至 21.3；同时使 Qwen3.5-27B 达到极具竞争力的表现并超越强基线。分析验证了方法有效性，并显示数据量与交互时长上均存在一致的扩展规律。
AI.conclusion: WorkForge 通过事实锚点驱动的方式实现了工作型智能体环境的可扩展合成与可追溯验证，显著提升模型专业任务能力，并展现出良好的规模扩展性。

title: AgroGround: Multi-Granularity Grounded Recognition in Agriculture
summary: Agricultural visual models are typically evaluated for either recognition or localization, but reliable diagnosis requires identifying what is present and localizing the evidence. Agricultural visual question answering (VQA) datasets carry rich semantic labels but rarely link them to image regions, and adding such annotations by hand is costly at scale. We introduce AgroGround, a large-scale dataset for grounded agricultural recognition: identifying plant diseases and other agricultural targets and localizing their image regions. An automated pipeline converts the labels of eight agricultural VQA datasets into annotations for disease lesions and whole objects, producing 794,850 instruction examples. Healthy images provide negative supervision for disease queries, teaching the model to return empty predictions. We fine-tune a shared vision-language model on known-target grounding instructions combined with instructions requiring both recognition and localization. We evaluate predicted identities, regions, joint correctness, and healthy-image abstention on 1,480 human-verified images disjoint from all training data. Grounding-only fine-tuning reduces recognition accuracy from 51.8\% to 29.1\%, while adding recognition-and-localization instructions raises it to 72.6\%. With images and annotations held fixed, combining the two formats raises joint accuracy from 19.2\% to 43.3\% at comparable grounding. Healthy negatives raise abstention on healthy images to 95.0\%, and reinforcement learning improves lesion-level grounding. The resulting 2B model exceeds its annotation teacher in grounding F1 on our benchmark and on the external PlantSeg test set. AgroGround establishes a benchmark for grounded agricultural recognition, measuring joint correctness of identity and localization along with abstention on healthy images. The code is available at https://github.com/AB-Abdulla/AgroGround.

AI.tldr: AgroGround构建了一个大规模农业视觉定位识别数据集，通过自动化流程将8个农业VQA数据集标签转化为病害病灶与整目标的定位标注，共794,850条指令样本，并验证了"识别+定位"联合指令对模型性能的关键提升。
AI.motivation: 农业视觉模型通常只评估识别或定位单一方面，但可靠诊断需同时回答"有什么"和"在哪里"。现有农业VQA数据集虽含丰富语义标签，却极少与图像区域关联，而人工标注区域成本高昂、难以规模化。
AI.method: 提出自动化流水线，将8个农业VQA数据集的标签转换为病害病灶和整目标的定位标注，生成794,850条指令样本；健康图像提供负监督以教会模型返回空预测。在已知目标定位指令与"识别+定位"指令组合上微调共享视觉语言模型，并在1,480张人工校验、与训练集不重叠的图像上评估识别、区域、联合正确性及健康图像拒答，另结合强化学习提升病灶级定位。
AI.result: 仅定位微调使识别准确率从51.8%降至29.1%，加入"识别+定位"指令后回升至72.6%；在图像与标注固定下，两种格式结合使联合准确率从19.2%提升至43.3%，定位性能相当。健康负样本使健康图像拒答率达95.0%，强化学习改善病灶级定位。所得2B模型在本基准及外部PlantSeg测试集上定位F1超过其标注教师模型。
AI.conclusion: AgroGround为"接地式"农业识别建立了基准，同时衡量身份与定位的联合正确性以及健康图像的拒答能力，代码已开源。

title: Asking Earns Nothing: Scoring the Decision to Act in BFCL Multi-Turn
summary: An agent that lacks the information it needs should ask rather than act, and the task definitions of agent leaderboards say so. BFCL multi-turn builds two of its four categories around a turn on which the model is supposed to ask, and its scorer never looks at that turn: the gold trajectory there is empty, the checker skips it, and the scripted user cannot answer, so asking earns nothing, guessing costs nothing on that turn, and asking twice loses the item. The benchmark also contains the control experiment for that decision. A should-ask item is a base item with one piece of information removed from one turn, so the same request appears twice at the same turn index, once complete and once not: on the first the model should make the call that changes the world, on the second it should ask. We score one decision per pair, whether the model attempted a world-changing call on that turn, read off the stored trajectories with no LLM judge; acting always and asking always both score 50. On the 223 pairs that pose this decision, gpt-5.4 attempts the call on 83.4% of the complete turns and holds back on 78.0% of the incomplete ones, the best decision accuracy of seven models at 80.7%; on the same items the official score ranks it sixth and puts first a model that lands in the middle here. One added line telling gpt-5.4 not to ask pushes it toward acting on both sides of the pair, so its decision accuracy shows no detectable change, while its official score rises by 13.5 to 23.5 points on the two should-ask categories and on the base twins; the opposite line, telling gemma-4-31B-it to ask first, improves its decision by 4.5 points and gains no official score. The score moves with the push toward action, not with the decision. We release the pairs, a turn-level scorer that runs on any BFCL output directory without an API key, and 31 manually verified bad items.

AI.tldr: BFCL 多轮基准的"应当提问"类别中，提问回合的评分被跳过，导致提问无收益、猜测无代价；作者用配对条目构造该决策的对照实验并发现官方分数与决策质量脱节。
AI.motivation: 智能体在信息不足时应提问而非行动，BFCL 多轮榜单的任务定义也如此规定。但其四个类别中有两个围绕"模型应提问"的回合构建，评分器却完全不检查该回合：金标准轨迹为空、检查器跳过该回合、脚本用户无法作答。结果提问得不到任何分数，猜测在该回合无代价，而问两次反而丢分。基准中恰好包含这一决策的对照实验（同一请求出现两次，一次信息完整一次缺失），作者希望借此直接度量"该行动还是该提问"的决策能力，并检验官方分数是否真的在奖励这一行为。
AI.method: 将"应提问"条目定义为基准条目去掉某一回合的一条信息，使同一请求在同一回合索引上出现两次（一次完整、一次不完整）。对完整版模型应发出改变世界的调用，对不完整版应提问。每对条目只评一个决策：模型在该回合是否尝试了改变世界的调用，直接从存储轨迹读取，不使用 LLM 评判。行动恒定与提问恒定的策略各得 50 分。此外还加入提示词干预实验（告诉 gpt-5.4 不要提问、告诉 gemma-4-31B-it 先提问）以观察分数变化来源。
AI.result: 在 223 对构成该决策的条目上，gpt-5.4 在 83.4% 的完整回合尝试调用，在 78.0% 的不完整回合选择按兵不动，决策准确率 80.7%，为七个模型中最优；但在同一批条目上官方分数只把它排到第六，并把一个在此处表现居中者排到第一。加入"不要提问"一行提示后，gpt-5.4 在配对两侧都更倾向行动，决策准确率无可检出变化，而官方分数在两类"应提问"类别及基座孪生条目上升 13.5 至 23.5 分；相反提示 gemma-4-31B-it"先提问"使决策提升 4.5 分，官方分数却无增益。可见分数随"倾向于行动"移动，而非随决策质量移动。并发布配对数据、可在任意 BFCL 输出目录运行且无需 API key 的回合级评分器，以及 31 条人工核验的问题条目。
AI.conclusion: BFCL 多轮中"应提问"类别的评分存在结构性缺陷：评分器忽略本应决定成败的提问回合，使官方分数实际上奖励"更多地行动"而非"更正确地决策"。作者提出的配对设计提供了无需 LLM 评判的决策度量，并可复用于任何 BFCL 输出；其结果表明该基准当前的排序可能误导对智能体信息寻求行为的评估，提示词导致的分数上升并不代表决策能力提升。

title: Adaptive-Shot Hybrid Quantum Anomaly Detection for Tactile Internet Security: Reliability-Aware Measurement Allocation Under Resource Constraints
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Secure and Trustworthy Quantum Machine Learning (SaTQuML). Presentation: Short Oral Presentation. Code: https://github.com/msudipto/AdaptiveShot_HybridQAD_Framework
summary: Tactile Internet (TI) security analytics must balance reliable thresholded decisions with constrained computational and measurement resources. We study this tension for finite-shot hybrid quantum anomaly inference and introduce the Adaptive-Shot Variational Quantum Circuit (AS-VQC) policy. This validation-calibrated policy begins each record at 128 shots and cumulatively escalates through 256, 512, and 1024 shots only when the finite-shot anomaly score remains close to a validation-selected security threshold. The quantum scorer is evaluated as an off-path security analytics component rather than part of the haptic critical path. Using a 4,875-record CESNET-TimeSeries24-derived aggregate-flow benchmark, leakage-safe random, entity-group-disjoint, and temporal holdouts, and five trained quantum neural network (QNN) checkpoints per holdout, the primary AS-VQC-95 (beta = 0.95) policy averages 129.2, 276.9, and 131.2 shots per record, saving 87.4%, 73.0%, and 87.2% of the uniform 1024-shot baseline (Fixed-1024), respectively. The decision disagreement with analytic (exact-expectation) inference is 0.771%, 0.409%, and 0.635%, lower than both the uniform 128-shot baseline (Fixed-128) and a matched-budget shuffled-allocation control. Fixed-1024 remains more decision-stable, establishing a measurable reliability-resource trade-off rather than cost-free equivalence. A more conservative AS-VQC-99 (beta = 0.99) further reduces disagreement while using fewer than 512 average shots across all holdouts. These results show that finite quantum measurements can be treated as an inference resource and concentrated on boundary-sensitive TI-security decisions while exposing checkpoint-dependent escalation under unseen-entity conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应镜头变分量子电路(AS-VQC)策略，将有限量子测量视为推理资源，在触觉互联网安全分析中以少量镜头达到接近解析推理的决策可靠性。
AI.motivation: 触觉互联网(TI)安全分析需在可靠阈值决策与受限计算/测量资源之间取得平衡，尤其涉及有限次测量(finite-shot)的混合量子异常推理这一矛盾。
AI.method: AS-VQC为验证校准策略：每条记录从128镜头起步，仅当有限镜头异常得分接近验证集选定的安全阈值时，才依次累积升级至256、512、1024镜头。量子评分器作为离线安全分析组件而非触觉关键路径的一部分。在基于CESNET-TimeSeries24的4,875条聚合流基准上，采用泄漏安全的随机、实体组不相交和时间三类留出，每类留出训练5个QNN检查点。
AI.result: AS-VQC-95(β=0.95)平均每记录为129.2、276.9、131.2镜头，相比统一1024镜头基线分别节省87.4%、73.0%、87.2%。与解析(精确期望)推理的决策不一致率为0.771%、0.409%、0.635%，低于统一128镜头基线和匹配预算的乱序分配对照。Fixed-1024决策更稳定，说明存在可度量的可靠性-资源权衡而非无代价等价。更保守的AS-VQC-99(β=0.99)进一步降低不一致率，且所有留出平均镜头数均低于512。
AI.conclusion: 有限量子测量可作为推理资源，集中用于边界敏感的TI安全决策，并揭示了未见实体条件下依赖检查点的升级行为。

title: From Overloaded to Guaranteed: High-Throughput Multi-SLO Enforcement for LoRA-Assisted On-Premise LLM Deployment
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become essential in privacy-sensitive sectors like hospitals and government agencies, the on-premise LLM servers offer a cost-effective and secure alternative to public cloud services. However, these resource-constrained servers struggle to guarantee heterogeneous Service Level Objectives (SLOs) when serving multiple LoRA-adapted services simultaneously. Existing serving frameworks suffer from severe SLO violations due to the computational overhead of LoRA layers and the rigid nature of batch scheduling. To address this, we propose HALO, a scheduling method tailored for LoRA-assisted on-premise LLM deployment. HALO introduces two key innovations: a spatial multiplexing strategy that overlaps Base and LoRA computations by partitioning GPU Streaming Multiprocessors (SMs), and an SLO-aware scheduler that decouples request execution based on "request-level slack." By prioritizing urgent tasks and utilizing idle budget for traffic shaping, HALO significantly mitigates resource contention. Our evaluation demonstrates that HALO minimizes SLO violations while improving throughput compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: HALO是一种面向LoRA辅助的本地LLM部署的调度方法，通过空间复用与SLO感知调度来减少SLO违规并提升吞吐。
AI.motivation: 在隐私敏感领域，本地部署LLM服务器成本低且安全，但资源受限，在多LoRA服务并发时难以保证异构SLO。现有服务框架因LoRA层计算开销大和批调度僵化，导致严重的SLO违规。
AI.method: HALO包含两项创新：(1) 空间复用策略，通过划分GPU流多处理器（SM）让Base与LoRA计算重叠；(2) SLO感知调度器，基于"请求级slack"解耦请求执行，优先处理紧急任务并利用空闲预算进行流量整形，以缓解资源争用。
AI.result: 与最先进的基线相比，HALO在最小化SLO违规的同时提升了吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: HALO有效解决了LoRA辅助的本地LLM服务中的SLO保障与吞吐问题。

title: Video2World: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Interactive World Modeling from Embodied Videos
summary: Building interactive simulators from real-world observations is a promising way to scale embodied data, but current pipelines still rely heavily on manual environment construction and calibration. We study whether frontier foundation models and coding agents can automate this process end to end. We formulate \emph{autonomous video-to-simulation} as a software engineering task in which an agent observes an embodied video, constructs the corresponding simulated environment and robot behavior, and iteratively refines the result through execution feedback. To evaluate this capability, we introduce \textbf{Video2World}, a benchmark comprising 222 reconstruction instances derived from 189 robot and human demonstration videos. Video2World measures reconstructed worlds along geometric fidelity, dynamic fidelity, and functional correctness, capturing spatial perception, physical reasoning, and executable interaction. Evaluating 9 frontier coding-agent systems reveals a sharp improvement in Task success beginning with Claude Opus 5, rising from below 5\% to over 15\%, while substantial gaps to human-assisted reconstruction remain. We further find that worlds that look better could work worse: better visual fidelity does not always lead to higher task success. This echoes the broader gap between perceptual realism and factual correctness observed in generative models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"自主视频到仿真"（autonomous video-to-simulation）任务，发布Video2World基准（222个重建实例），评估9个前沿编码智能体系统，发现任务成功率从低于5%提升到超过15%，但与人工辅助重建仍有明显差距，且视觉保真度更高并不一定带来任务成功率更高。
AI.motivation: 从真实世界观测构建交互式仿真器有助于扩展具身数据规模，但现有流程严重依赖人工环境搭建与标定。作者希望探究前沿基础模型与编码智能体能否端到端地自动化这一过程。
AI.method: 将"自主视频到仿真"形式化为一个软件工程任务：智能体观察具身视频，构建相应的仿真环境与机器人行为，并通过执行反馈迭代改进。同时提出Video2World基准，包含来自189个机器人与人演示视频的222个重建实例，从几何保真度、动态保真度和功能正确性三个维度进行评估，涵盖空间感知、物理推理与可执行交互。
AI.result: 评估9个前沿编码智能体系统显示，从Claude Opus 5开始任务成功率出现明显跃升，由不足5%升至超过15%，但与人工辅助重建之间仍存在较大差距。此外发现"看起来更好的世界可能效果更差"：更高的视觉保真度并不总能带来更高的任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示视觉逼真度与功能正确性之间存在鸿沟，这与生成模型中感知真实性与事实正确性之间的差距相呼应，表明自主视频到仿真仍需进一步提升，且评价应关注功能正确性而非仅视觉质量。

title: MERCI Cards: An LLM Evaluation and Deployment Framework for High-Stakes Domains
summary: As LLMs are increasingly deployed in high-stakes professional workflows, engineers and researchers require principled protocols to systematically track, monitor, and improve model performance across deployment cycles. We present a mathematical framework for iterative LLM evaluation and deployment, and demonstrate its application to AI systems used in criminal justice. Our framework formalizes LLM integration in high-stakes, high-risk, and resource-constrained domains across model selection, rubric design, evaluations and deployment via a weighted multi-objective optimization. We demonstrate that MERCI Cards can guide improvements of the system across deployment iterations, direct developer attention toward under-performing areas, and focus user attention on validation and error-correction in the LLM's outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个用于迭代式LLM评估与部署的数学框架，并通过刑事司法领域的AI系统加以演示，采用加权多目标优化方法，并证明MERCI Cards能指导系统在多轮部署中的改进。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在高风险专业工作流中的部署日益增多，工程师和研究者需要系统性追踪、监控并改进模型性能的规范化协议。
AI.method: 提出一个迭代式LLM评估与部署的数学框架，将LLM在高风险、资源受限领域中的整合（涵盖模型选择、评分标准设计、评估与部署）形式化为加权多目标优化问题，并借助MERCI Cards实施。
AI.result: MERCI Cards能够指导系统在多轮部署迭代中的改进，引导开发者关注表现不佳的领域，并使使用者聚焦于LLM输出的验证与纠错。
AI.conclusion: 该数学框架与MERCI Cards为高风险场景下的LLM迭代评估与部署提供了规范化、可操作的协议。

title: Compromise Is Not Consequence: Evaluating Task-Scoped Authorization in LLM Agents with Paired Replay
summary: A tool-using model can follow a malicious instruction even when its credentials are valid. We study whether task-scoped authorization contains the resulting tool execution. Our paired-replay testbed samples a model request once and submits the same action, resource, and arguments to broad bearer, scoped JWT, sender-constrained, and Open Policy Agent conditions. The frozen main experiment uses 128 scenarios across four tool domains and five local model configurations. Among valid attacked post-exposure decisions, broad-bearer harmful execution ranges from 8.9% to 37.8% across models; all three scoped conditions record zero. The policy changes execution, not the frozen model decision. These results support containment of the tested cross-action and cross-resource consequences under researcher-supplied task authority, not prevention of prompt injection. A bounded six-task AgentDojo extension preserves native scoring and records 11/24 injected broad-policy attack flags versus 0/24 scoped flags, with utility of 5/24 and 6/24. Low exposure, invalid decisions, and purposive task selection limit that comparison. The primary experiment measures safe continuation rather than final-answer correctness. An empirical-bank fresh-sampling comparison finds no estimation advantage from pairing when scoped outcomes are constant zero. The contribution is a controlled measurement of compromise, enforcement, and continuation, with explicit limits on what each observation establishes.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过配对重放测试台，测量任务范围授权（scoped JWT、sender-constrained、OPA）能否遏制恶意指令导致的工具执行。在128个场景、四个工具域、五种本地模型配置下，宽泛bearer令牌的有害执行率为8.9%–37.8%，而三种范围化条件均为0。政策改变的是执行结果，而非模型决策。
AI.motivation: 工具使用模型即便凭证有效，也可能遵循恶意指令。作者关心的是：任务范围授权能否限制由此产生的工具执行后果，以及这种遏制到底证明了什么、又不能证明什么。
AI.method: 采用配对重放测试台：对同一模型请求只采样一次，把相同的动作、资源和参数分别提交到宽泛bearer、scoped JWT、sender-constrained和Open Policy Agent四种条件。主实验冻结使用128个场景、四个工具域、五种本地模型配置，并附一个六任务AgentDojo扩展（保留原生评分）及经验库新鲜采样对比。
AI.result: 在有效受攻击的暴露后决策中，宽泛bearer的有害执行为8.9%–37.8%，三种范围化条件均为0，政策改变执行但不改变冻结的模型决策。AgentDojo扩展中，宽泛策略注入攻击标记为11/24，范围化策略为0/24，效用分别为5/24与6/24。在范围化结果恒为0时，配对相比新鲜采样没有估计优势。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在研究者提供的任务授权下，对测试所覆盖的跨动作与跨资源后果实现遏制，而非防止提示注入本身。主要实验衡量的是安全延续而非最终答案正确性；低暴露、无效决策和任务选择的目的性限制了AgentDojo比较。贡献在于对失陷、执行与延续的受控测量，并明确界定每种观察所能确立的边界。

title: Building LLM Agent Systems the Deep Learning Way: From Modular Design to Architecture Search
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized AI research and enabled exciting agent systems. To build a complex LLM agent system, most existing research relies on insights from other domains or heuristics to manually build the agent system. However, this approach often requires heavy hand-engineering and fails to fully optimize for the downstream task of interest. Inspired by the tremendous success of deep learning, we propose to construct LLM agent systems in a modular manner, similar to building a deep neural network. Our key insight is to make analogies between LLM building blocks, such as retrievals, memories, and prompting strategies, and the successful deep learning modules, such as MLPs, attention, and recurrent modules. We further design forward inference and feedback mechanisms for LLMs, where prompts in LLMs are considered as the weights in deep models, and the prompt optimization from feedback is analogous to the back-propagation algorithm. We additionally leverage a search algorithm to search for the best configuration of LLM agent systems, similar to the neural architecture search (NAS) in deep learning research. Comprehensive experimental results demonstrate that the proposed deep learning recipe for LLM agent systems is highly effective, in particular: (1) Organizing LLM modules into deep-learning-style architectures yields noticeable performance gain; (2) Automatic prompt optimization, equivalent to backpropagation, is efficient in incorporating feedback from the task of interest and achieves at least 5% performance improvement; (3) NAS equivalent algorithm works well for further optimizing the LLM agent system architecture with 11% performance gain compared with randomly designed architectures. Overall, our research demonstrates the exciting opportunity of transferring the success of deep learning to building LLM agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出借鉴深度学习的思路，以模块化方式构建LLM智能体系统，将检索、记忆、提示等组件类比为深度学习模块，并设计前向推理、反馈优化与架构搜索机制，实验证明该方法显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体系统多依赖其他领域的经验或启发式规则手工搭建，需要大量人工工程且难以针对下游任务充分优化。受深度学习巨大成功的启发，作者希望将深度学习的构建范式迁移到LLM智能体系统构建中。
AI.method: 将LLM构建块（检索、记忆、提示策略等）类比为深度学习模块（MLP、注意力、循环模块等），以模块化方式搭建智能体架构；设计前向推理与反馈机制，把提示视为深度模型中的权重，将基于反馈的提示优化类比为反向传播；并引入搜索算法寻找最佳智能体系统配置，类似深度学习中的神经架构搜索（NAS）。
AI.result: 实验表明：(1) 将LLM模块组织成深度学习风格的架构可带来明显性能提升；(2) 等价于反向传播的自动提示优化能高效利用下游任务反馈，取得至少5%的性能提升；(3) 等价于NAS的算法能进一步优化智能体架构，相比随机设计的架构获得11%的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 研究展示了将深度学习的成功经验迁移到LLM智能体系统构建中的巨大潜力，为自动化、模块化地设计LLM智能体提供了有效范式。

title: Multi-Crop Leaf Disease Recognition: A Unified Benchmark and Cross-Region Study
summary: Deep learning models for crop leaf disease recognition routinely report near-perfect accuracy yet are typically trained and evaluated on a single dataset collected under controlled laboratory conditions, leaving their behavior under realistic cross-region domain shift poorly understood. We introduce MLD (Multi-crop Leaf Disease) dataset, a unified multi-region benchmark that combines six public crop-disease datasets from the USA, Asia, and Africa into a shared hierarchical taxonomy spanning 18 crops, 56 crop-disease classes (including one healthy class per crop) making 167,427 images. We define standardized single-source and pooled multi-source evaluation protocols that explicitly probe cross-region generalization. We also investigate whether exploiting the inherent crop-to-disease dependency via a hierarchical formulation (HiLeaD) that conditions disease prediction on the predicted crop improves recognition under cross-region shift. Under the HiLeaD, the model trained on PlantVillage achieves 99.07% in-domain disease F1 but collapses to 12.88% when tested on PlantDoc, exposing a severe cross-region domain gap. The model trained on the pooled MLD dataset partly recovers cross-region disease F1 from 12.88% to 39.64% on PlantDoc (HiLeaD), achieving a 26.76 percentage point improvement. The hierarchical formulation provides a consistent additional gain, ranging from 1.71 to 4.88 percentage points in disease F1 over the flat baseline under the MLD dataset indicating that progress in this area is currently limited more by data coverage and diversity than by model design.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MLD多区域多作物叶片病害基准数据集（18种作物、56个作物-病害类别、167,427张图像），并设计跨区域评估协议及层次化方法HiLeaD，揭示深度模型在跨区域域偏移下性能严重下降，指出数据覆盖与多样性比模型设计更关键。
AI.motivation: 现有作物叶片病害识别模型虽报告近乎完美的准确率，但通常在受控实验室条件下的单一数据集上训练与评估，其在真实跨区域域偏移下的表现尚不清楚。作者希望建立统一的跨区域基准并探究层次化建模能否缓解该问题。
AI.method: 构建MLD数据集，整合来自美国、亚洲和非洲的六个公开作物病害数据集，形成共享层次分类体系（18种作物、56个作物-病害类别、167,427张图像）；定义标准化的单源与多源汇集评估协议以检验跨区域泛化；并提出层次化公式HiLeaD，将病害预测条件化于预测的作物类别之上。
AI.result: 在HiLeaD下，仅用PlantVillage训练的模型域内病害F1达99.07%，但在PlantDoc上骤降至12.88%，暴露严重跨区域域差距；在汇聚MLD数据集上训练后，PlantDoc上跨区域病害F1由12.88%恢复至39.64%，提升26.76个百分点；层次化公式在MLD数据集上相较扁平基线持续带来1.71至4.88个百分点的病害F1增益。
AI.conclusion: 层次化公式能带来稳定但有限的性能提升，表明该领域的进展目前更多受限于数据的覆盖范围与多样性，而非模型设计。

title: Runaway Reaction: When Benign Skills Compose into Malicious Behavior
summary: Agent skills package task-specific knowledge and procedures that can be composed to support complex agent tasks, while public marketplaces provide a growing pool of reusable skills. Existing security vetting, however, largely evaluates skills in isolation, leaving composition-induced risks underexplored. Such risks arise because composing benign skills expands the agent's capability space, enabling behaviors unavailable to any skill alone. Interestingly, we find that directly composing benign skills can already induce malicious behaviors, even when every individual skill passes security vetting. We further find that some target malicious behaviors remain difficult to realize through direct composition, even when the selected skills collectively provide the required capabilities. To systematically instantiate these attacks, we present Compositional Risk Induction via Multi skill Execution (CRIME). CRIME first uses the Malicious Plot Casting (MPC) module to decompose a target malicious behavior into complementary requirements and identify suitable benign skill compositions from public skill repositories. For compositions that cannot directly realize the target behavior, the Runaway Reaction Steering (RRS) module uses execution feedback to iteratively refine the selected skills toward the target while requiring each skill to remain benign under standalone vetting. The resulting composition is then passed to the Skill Reaction Chamber (SRC) module, where the skill pair is executed in a sandbox and the resulting environmental consequences are examined to determine whether the target behavior has occurred. Unsuccessful cases are returned to RRS for further refinement. Furthermore, we construct a benchmark of 4,000 public skills across eight cybersecurity behaviors for systematic evaluation of composition-induced vulnerabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRIME方法，系统性地研究并实例化由良性技能组合引发的恶意行为风险，并构建了包含4,000个公开技能、覆盖八类网络安全行为的基准。
AI.motivation: 现有技能安全审查大多孤立评估单个技能，忽视了技能组合带来的风险。良性技能组合会扩展智能体的能力空间，产生任何单一技能都不具备的行为，甚至直接组合良性技能即可诱发恶意行为；而某些目标恶意行为即使技能集合具备所需能力也难以直接组合实现，因此需要系统化的攻击实例化方法。
AI.method: CRIME包含三个模块：1）恶意情节选角（MPC）将目标恶意行为分解为互补需求，并从公开技能库中挑选合适的良性技能组合；2）失控反应引导（RRS）对无法直接实现目标的组合，利用执行反馈迭代优化所选技能，同时要求每个技能在单独审查下仍保持良性；3）技能反应室（SRC）在沙箱中执行技能对并检查环境后果，判断目标行为是否发生，未成功案例返回RRS继续优化。
AI.result: 直接组合良性技能即可诱发恶意行为，即使每个技能均通过安全审查；对于难以直接组合实现的目标行为，RRS可通过执行反馈迭代优化实现；研究构建了覆盖八类网络安全行为、包含4,000个公开技能的基准用于系统性评估组合引发的漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 技能组合会带来被现有孤立审查所忽视的安全风险，需要通过组合层面的系统性评估来识别和防范此类漏洞。

title: TrajLong: Co-Designing Agentic and Long-Context Supervision for Mid-Training
summary: LLM agents for coding, search, and workplace tasks increasingly rely on long-context capabilities to effectively aggregate and reason over extended interaction histories. Recent work has incorporated agent trajectories into mid-training stage, drawing on their naturally long and interaction-rich structure. Yet how to organize the information within these trajectories into effective mid-training supervision remains underexplored. In this work, we investigate the relationship between long-context and agent atomic capabilities and introduce TrajLong, a novel framework that compiles trajectories into long-context training tasks with dense supervision, targeting three representative atomic capabilities: evidence grounding, cross-evidence aggregation, and temporal state maintenance. We mid-train Qwen3-14B-Base and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base with data compiled by TrajLong, followed by supervised fine-tuning. Experiments on 6 long-context and 12 agent benchmarks demonstrate broad performance gains, with controlled ablations showing improvements over raw and masked trajectory baselines. Capability-level analyses further reveal task-dependent associations between long-context and agent atomic capabilities. These findings suggest that the shared capability demands of long-context reasoning and agent execution provide a principled basis for designing mid-training data to develop downstream agent capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TrajLong 框架，将智能体轨迹编译为带密集监督的长上下文训练任务，中训阶段提升长上下文与智能体原子能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在编程、搜索等任务中依赖长上下文聚合与推理，已有工作将智能体轨迹用于中训阶段，但如何组织轨迹信息形成有效的中训监督仍缺乏探索。
AI.method: 提出 TrajLong 框架，将轨迹编译为长上下文训练任务并配以密集监督，针对三种代表性原子能力：证据定位、跨证据聚合、时序状态维护。对 Qwen3-14B-Base 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base 进行中训，随后进行监督微调。
AI.result: 在 6 个长上下文与 12 个智能体基准上取得广泛性能提升；受控消融显示优于原始轨迹与掩码轨迹基线；能力层面分析揭示长上下文与智能体原子能力之间随任务而变的关联。
AI.conclusion: 长上下文推理与智能体执行的共享能力需求，为设计中训数据以发展下游智能体能力提供了原则性依据。

title: RPFQ-ViT: Rotated Phase-Frame Quantization for Extremely Low-Bit Weights in Vision Transformers
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Current preprint version; camera-ready revision forthcoming
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) achieve strong performance on image recognition and mobile vision applications, but their high-dimensional linear projections and attention computations still impose substantial storage and inference costs. Extremely low-bit quantization is a promising solution, yet ViTs often suffer severe accuracy degradation because conventional real-valued scalar codebooks are poorly matched to the directional geometry of Transformer projections. We present RPFQ-ViT, a Rotated Phase-Frame Quantization method that quantizes paired channels in two-dimensional phase planes, enabling low-bit codes to better preserve projection directions while recovering magnitude with lightweight scaling. RPFQ-ViT serves as a drop-in QAT replacement for nn.Linear and does not modify the standard real-valued attention, normalization, or activation computation graph. On ImageNet-1K, RPFQ-ViT-B/16 reaches 79.33% Top-1 / 94.48% Top-5 under W2/A4, Swin-T reaches 79.30% Top-1 / 94.79% Top-5 under W2/A8, and DeiT-S reaches 77.41% Top-1 / 93.11% Top-5 under W2/A8. Ablations, phase-geometry analysis, and direction-preservation metrics show that channel pairing, learnable rotation, phase-anchor learning, and residual phase refinement each improve quantization quality. We further deploy RPFQ-ViT image-classification models on native iOS and Android runtime stacks; with 2-bit packed weights, model size shrinks by roughly $5.4$-$7.1\times$ relative to FP32 and end-to-end on-device latency drops by $1.4$-$1.6\times$. All ImageNet results trained in our codebase use a matched 300-epoch recipe and are reported as mean accuracies over three independent runs.
