These results show that RPFQ-ViT provides a favorable trade-off among accuracy, compression, and practical mobile deployment for extremely low-bit ViTs.

AI.tldr: RPFQ-ViT 提出旋转相位框架量化，对成对通道在二维相位平面上量化，在极低位宽下更好地保持投影方向，实现高精度与移动端部署。
AI.motivation: ViT 的高维线性投影和注意力计算带来巨大存储与推理开销。极低位量化虽有潜力，但传统实值标量码本与 Transformer 投影的方向几何不匹配，导致精度严重下降。
AI.method: 将成对通道在二维相位平面内量化，用低位码保持投影方向、轻量缩放恢复幅度；作为 nn.Linear 的即插即用 QAT 替代，不改变实值注意力、归一化或激活计算图。采用通道配对、可学习旋转、相位锚学习、残差相位细化。
AI.result: ImageNet-1K 上，W2/A4 下 ViT-B/16 达 79.33% Top-1/94.48% Top-5；Swin-T 在 W2/A8 下 79.30%/94.79%；DeiT-S 在 W2/A8 下 77.41%/93.11%。消融与方向保持指标验证各组件有效。移动端 2-bit 打包权重大小缩减约 5.4–7.1 倍，端到端延迟降低 1.4–1.6 倍。
AI.conclusion: RPFQ-ViT 在精度、压缩和实际移动端部署之间取得良好折衷，适用于极低位 ViT。

title: CRAFT: An Agentic Spreadsheet Form Filling System with Template Awareness
summary: Spreadsheet form filling requires agents to consolidate external evidence, ground values to precise cells, and preserve irregular template structure. Errors in early edits can overwrite labels or misalign fields, undermining later decisions. We propose CRAFT, a template-aware agent framework that connects reflective validation to constrained local repair. Instead of treating reflection as a free-form request to regenerate the workbook, CRAFT grounds detected errors to spreadsheet regions, restores corrupted template state when necessary, and re-grounds plausible writable slots before subsequent edits. A Rectangle-Aware Slot Grounder (RASG) proposes writable cells, while label-slot hints and protected regions constrain subsequent edits. We introduce FormFillBench, with 327 forms across Instruction-Only and Multi-File tracks. Compared with the strongest baselines, CRAFT improves pair accuracy by 8.51 and 23.38 percentage points on these tracks, respectively. Component-removal experiments support structural adjudication and slot re-grounding within the pipeline, and the framework retains its relative advantage among the methods evaluated with a second backbone. The code and benchmark FormFillBench are available at https://github.com/Glllllly/CRAFT.

AI.tldr: 提出模板感知智能体框架CRAFT，通过反思验证与受限局部修复解决电子表格填表问题，并发布FormFillBench基准。
AI.motivation: 电子表格填表需整合外部证据、将值精确落到单元格、并保持不规则模板结构。早期编辑错误会覆盖标签或错位字段，进而破坏后续决策。
AI.method: CRAFT将反思验证连接至受限局部修复：不把反思视为自由重生成工作簿的请求，而是将检测到的错误定位到表格区域，必要时恢复受损模板状态，并在后续编辑前重新定位可写槽位。矩形感知槽定位器（RASG）提出可写单元格，标签-槽提示与保护区域约束后续编辑。
AI.result: 在FormFillBench（327个表单，含Instruction-Only与Multi-File两个赛道）上，相比最强基线，CRAFT的配对准确率分别提升8.51和23.38个百分点。组件移除实验支持结构裁决与槽位重定位的作用，且在使用第二个骨干模型时仍保持相对优势。
AI.conclusion: CRAFT通过结构感知的反思与局部修复机制有效提升电子表格填表准确率，FormFillBench与代码已开源。

title: H-CRSPV: Preventing Semantic Omission in Late-Bound Large Language Model Releases
summary: Large-language-model release pipelines increasingly combine commitments, signatures, provenance records, and heterogeneous verification backends. Yet validating every submitted object does not establish that a release realizes every requirement of its registered transformation. An untrusted realization proposer may omit a required relation, propose an unauthorized evidence-sharing assignment, or bind valid evidence to the wrong object. This verification-boundary failure is termed Semantic Omission under Valid Evidence (SOVE). Hybrid Cryptographic Relation-based Semantic Plan Verification (H-CRSPV) is a replicated admission layer that enforces required-set completeness before release consumption. Before evidence selection, an authorized registration entity commits an authenticated authority record. Validators independently derive the required-obligation multiset, check exact entry-occurrence coverage, validate proposal-induced evidence sharing, and bind admissible groups one-to-one to keeper-resolved objects. Evidence remains provisional until the challenge window closes and an atomic finalizer activates the release. The analysis establishes structural exactness and conditional semantic guarantees under explicit assumptions. Across 36 omission artifacts, submitted-object validation accepts all 36 because every submitted object passes its backend-specific verifier. H-CRSPV rejects all 36 while accepting all six honest releases. The prototype also validates six restricted source-to-RelationIR bindings and rejects all 60 tested mutations. In a continuous four-validator Qwen2.5-1.5B workflow, the same authority record remains fixed across three legal releases with different post-registration availability states. These results show that per-object validity does not establish complete, correctly bound, and finalized release evidence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"有效证据下的语义遗漏"(SOVE)问题,即每个提交对象虽通过验证,但发布版本可能遗漏必需关系或错误绑定。作者提出H-CRSPV机制,在发布消费前强制要求集完整性,实验表明可拒绝全部36个遗漏工件并接受6个诚实发布。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型发布流水线结合了承诺、签名、溯源记录和异构验证后端。然而,验证每个提交对象并不能保证发布版本实现了其注册转换的所有要求。不可信的实现提案者可能遗漏必需关系、提出未授权的证据共享分配,或将有效证据绑定到错误对象。这一验证边界失效即SOVE问题。
AI.method: H-CRSPV是一种可复制的准入层,在发布消费前强制要求集完整性。在证据选择之前,授权注册实体提交经认证的权威记录;验证者独立推导所需义务多重集,检查精确的条目出现覆盖,验证提案诱导的证据共享,并将可接受组与保管者解析对象一一绑定。证据在挑战窗口关闭前保持临时状态,由原子最终器激活发布。
AI.result: 在36个遗漏工件上,提交对象验证接受了全部36个(因每个对象都通过其后端专属验证器),而H-CRSPV拒绝了全部36个,同时接受了全部6个诚实发布。原型还验证了6个受限的source-to-RelationIR绑定,并拒绝了全部60个测试变异。在持续的四验证者Qwen2.5-1.5B工作流中,同一权威记录在三个合法发布中保持固定,且注册后可用状态各不相同。
AI.conclusion: 分析确立了结构精确性和在明确假设下的条件语义保证。结果表明,单对象有效性并不能确立完整、正确绑定且最终化的发布证据。

title: IREA: Intermediate Representation-based Embedding Alignment for Normative RAG
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance across various tasks, but they still struggle with questions involving ethical judgment. Previous studies have attempted to train LLMs on ethical standards, but the diversity and relativity of ethical norms make them difficult to fully internalize in model parameters. As an alternative, we introduce normative RAG, a retrieval-augmented approach that supports ethical judgment using external normative knowledge. Normative retrieval involves a distinct asymmetry between context rich narrative queries and generalized normative statements. Existing factual retrieval methods rely on query-only expansion into a document-like form, making them insufficient for resolving this asymmetry. Therefore, we propose Intermediate Representation-based Embedding Alignment (IREA), a bidirectional alignment method that maps both text types into a shared situation-behavior representation. This representation captures ethically salient contextual and behavioral information in a normalized form, reducing surface-level discrepancies and improving alignment in the embedding space. Experimental results show that IREA improves normative retrieval and downstream ethical judgment across multiple settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of bidirectional alignment for normative RAG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出规范性检索增强生成（Normative RAG），并设计双向对齐方法IREA，将叙事性查询与概括性规范映射到共享的"情境-行为"表征空间，从而改进规范性检索与伦理判断性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在伦理判断类问题上表现不佳。以往通过训练让模型内化伦理标准，但伦理规范多样且具有相对性，难以完全固化到模型参数中。因此转向外部规范知识的检索增强方案，但存在叙事性查询与概括性规范之间的不对称难题。
AI.method: 提出Intermediate Representation-based Embedding Alignment（IREA）——一种双向对齐方法，将两种文本类型（情境丰富的叙事查询与泛化规范陈述）映射到共享的situation-behavior表示。该表示以规范化形式捕捉伦理相关的情境与行为信息，减少表层差异，改善嵌入空间中的对齐。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，IREA在多种设置下提升了规范性检索效果及下游伦理判断性能。
AI.conclusion: 双向对齐对规范性RAG是有效的，可作为提升LLM伦理判断能力的可行路径。

title: Homogeneous Semantic Alignment and Hierarchical Expert Routing for Radiology Report Generation
summary: Radiology report generation (RRG) aims to convert medical images into diagnostic texts to assist in clinical decision-making and alleviate the workload of physicians. Although existing methods have made extensive progress in cross-modal interaction and the incorporation of external priors, the distribution shift of underlying representations and the undifferentiated rigid coupling of heterogeneous information cause weak visual abnormality cues to be easily diluted by massive text priors and generation inertia during decoding. To overcome this bottleneck, inspired by cognitive science, we propose a novel two-stage Homogeneous Semantic Alignment and Hierarchical Expert Routing (HSA-HER) framework. First, the model introduces an explicit homogeneous distribution constraint in the underlying latent space to effectively eliminate the cross-modal distribution shift between visual and textual features, thereby extracting purified visual features as semantic anchors that accurately align with diseases. Second, for heterogeneous clinical evidence composed of visual features, local entities, and global retrievals, we design a hierarchical expert routing mechanism guided by these disease semantic anchors. This mechanism abandons the undifferentiated rigid coupling paradigm. Specifically, it dynamically activates expert networks to perform targeted mining and semantic reconstruction on multi-source evidence, and adaptively allocates fusion weights. Extensive experiments on three mainstream benchmark datasets demonstrate that HSA-HER achieves state-of-the-art performance, accurately depicting complex imaging details and key diagnostic information.

AI.tldr: 提出HSA-HER两阶段框架，通过同质语义对齐消除跨模态分布偏移，并用分层专家路由实现异构证据的动态融合，在三个主流基准上取得SOTA的放射报告生成性能。
AI.motivation: 放射报告生成需将医学图像转为诊断文本以辅助临床决策并减轻医生负担。现有方法虽在跨模态交互和引入外部先验上有进展，但存在底层表征的分布偏移以及异构信息无差别刚性耦合的问题，导致微弱的视觉异常线索在解码时容易被海量文本先验和生成惯性稀释。
AI.method: 受认知科学启发，提出两阶段HSA-HER框架。第一步：在底层潜在空间引入显式的同质分布约束，消除视觉与文本特征间的跨模态分布偏移，提取纯净视觉特征作为与疾病精准对齐的语义锚点。第二步：针对由视觉特征、局部实体和全局检索构成的异构临床证据，设计以疾病语义锚点引导的分层专家路由机制，摒弃无差别刚性耦合范式，动态激活专家网络对多源证据进行针对性挖掘与语义重构，并自适应分配融合权重。
AI.result: 在三个主流基准数据集上的大量实验表明，HSA-HER达到最新（SOTA）性能，能准确描述复杂影像细节与关键诊断信息。
AI.conclusion: HSA-HER通过同质语义对齐与分层专家路由，有效缓解分布偏移与异构信息刚性耦合问题，提升放射报告生成的准确性与临床可用性。

title: RAGrasp: Geometry-Semantic Template Retrieval and Grasp Transfer
summary: We present RAGrasp, a retrieval-augmented pipeline for planar parallel-jaw grasping from a compact set of locally collected, grasp-annotated RGB-D (color and depth) templates. Unlike task-specific predictors trained primarily on large public or synthetic grasp datasets, RAGrasp requires no end-to-end retraining for a new deployment.Its template memory is constructed from observations collected with the deployment camera, robot, and gripper in the target workspace, thereby aligning stored examples with the local sensing and embodiment conditions. The system uses self-supervised DINOv2 visual fea- tures together with appearance and depth cues to prompt the Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2), which isolates the query object. A two-stage geometry-semantic retrieval cascade then selects a template, and a confidence gate chooses one of two grasp- transfer estimators. The transferred grasp is refined using mask- support and silhouette-contact constraints before calibrated 2D- to-3D conversion. In real-world trials, RAGrasp achieves 20/20 successful grasps on seen objects and 19/20 on unseen objects. Within the evaluated setting, the results demonstrate deployment- specific grasp adaptation from limited local annotation and tolerance to the tested viewpoint and illumination changes.

AI.tldr: RAGrasp 是一个基于检索增强的平面平行夹爪抓取流水线，仅需少量本地采集的带抓取标注 RGB-D 模板即可部署，无需端到端重训练，在真实场景中实现对已见目标 20/20、未见目标 19/20 的抓取成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有抓取预测器多依赖大规模公开或合成数据集进行任务特定训练，迁移到新部署环境时需重新训练，且与本地相机、机器人、夹爪的实际感知和本体条件不匹配。作者希望实现面向特定部署环境、仅用少量本地标注即可适配的抓取方法。
AI.method: 1) 模板记忆由部署所用相机、机器人和夹爪在目标工作空间采集的观测构建；2) 利用自监督 DINOv2 视觉特征结合外观与深度线索提示 SAM2，分割出查询物体；3) 采用两阶段“几何-语义”检索级联选出模板；4) 通过置信度门控在两个抓取迁移估计器中选择其一；5) 利用掩码支撑与轮廓接触约束对迁移抓取进行精化，再进行标定后的 2D 转 3D 转换。
AI.result: 真实世界试验中，RAGrasp 对已见物体达到 20/20 抓取成功，对未见物体达到 19/20 成功。在所评估的设定下，结果验证了基于有限本地标注的部署特定抓取适配能力，以及对测试视角与光照变化的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: RAGrasp 表明，结合检索增强与本地模板记忆可以在无需端到端重训练的情况下实现部署特定的抓取适配，并具备对视角与光照变化的容忍度，为受限标注条件下的真实抓取部署提供了可行方案。

title: When LLMs Sit Above Diagnostic Tools: Unrealized Complementarity in Industrial Fault Diagnosis
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as integration layers above specialized tools, but a stronger component does not necessarily produce a stronger combined system. Across five diagnostic datasets (bearing vibration, process monitoring, semiconductor equipment), we study whether an LLM can reliably use external diagnostic information; paired repeat calls separate advice effects from output instability. In all five, conflicting external information overturned initially correct LLM judgments. Among the four datasets with direct integration comparisons, none showed a consistent advantage for implicit LLM integration over the stronger standalone source. On a Tennessee Eastman confirmation set whose protocol was fixed before evaluation, unaided accuracy was 64.67%, implicit LLM-specialist integration 77.43%, and the specialist alone 83.33%. Specialist information improved the LLM by 12.8 points (95% interval 9.7 to 15.9), yet the integrated output stayed 5.9 points below the specialist (95% interval -12.0 to -0.7). A two-source selector oracle reached 92.76%, indicating complementarity that the integrated output did not fully realize. The integrated output missed 140 of 295 specialist corrections (47.5%) but lost 15 of 99 initially correct LLM judgments (15.2%). The deficit remained under prompt and specialist sensitivity analyses. Among CWRU cases solved under both evidence presentations, task-aligned physical evidence yielded lower estimates of susceptibility to incorrect advice in six of seven models (five intervals excluding zero); higher reasoning effort gave no reliable reduction in five models, and a separate four-model TEP analysis gave no clear evidence that it resolves the integration problem. Source quality and integration quality should be evaluated separately: an integration layer should be compared with its stronger standalone component, not only with the unaided LLM.

AI.tldr: 本文通过五个诊断数据集研究LLM作为外部诊断信息集成层是否可靠，发现冲突信息会推翻LLM原本正确的判断，且隐式LLM-专家集成相比更强的独立专家组件并无优势。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型日益被用作专业工具之上的集成层，但更强的组件未必带来更强的组合系统。作者希望检验LLM能否可靠地利用外部诊断信息，并区分"来源质量"与"集成质量"两个维度。
AI.method: 在五个诊断数据集（轴承振动、过程监控、半导体设备等）上评测LLM使用外部诊断信息的能力；采用配对重复调用以分离建议效应与输出不稳定；将隐式LLM-专家集成与更强的独立专家对比；在协议事先固定的田纳西伊士曼确认集上开展验证；并进行提示词、专家、推理努力等敏感性分析，以及CWRU物理证据与四模型TEP分析。
AI.result: 五个数据集中，冲突外部信息均推翻了LLM原本正确的判断；四个可直接比较的数据集里，隐式LLM集成都未持续优于更强的独立来源。田纳西伊士曼确认集上：无辅助LLM 64.67%，隐式集成77.43%，专家单独83.33%；专家信息使LLM提升12.8点（95%区间9.7~15.9），但集成输出仍比专家低5.9点；双来源选择器理论上限达92.76%。集成输出漏掉295个专家修正中的140个（47.5%），却丢失99个原本正确判断中的15个（15.2%）。CWRU中任务对齐的物理证据在7个模型中的6个降低了误信错误建议的估计（5个区间不含零）；提高推理努力在5个模型中未带来可靠改善，四模型TEP分析也未显示能解决集成问题。
AI.conclusion: 来源质量与集成质量应分开评估：集成层应与更强的独立组件对比，而不能只与无辅助LLM对比。当前LLM作为集成层尚不能可靠利用外部诊断信息，存在明显的集成缺陷。

title: Localization Lens for Improving Medical Vision-Language Models
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention (MICCAI)
summary: Medical Vision-Language Models (Med-VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in clinical tasks. However, they often struggle to understand anatomical structures and spatial positioning, which are crucial for medical reasoning. To address this, we propose a localization-aware enhancement to the Med-VLM pipeline, introducing improvements at three levels: data,architecture, and alignment. First, we introduce localization lens, a set of expert-validated representations that provide richer anatomical and positional context. However, as these representations increase input complexity, we integrate pixel shuffle within the model architecture to filter and refine representations, enhancing spatial information processing while preserving anatomical continuity. Lastly, to effectively align the localization lens representations with textual features, we incorporate decoupled contrastive loss (DCL) alongside the standard loss function. This ensures better feature discrimination and robustness, particularly in data limited medical settings. Through extensive evaluations on medical visual question answering (Med-VQA) datasets, we show that our methodology improves localization-driven performance across different Med-VLM architectures. Our analysis of localization-based questions further reveals that improvements in anatomy and spatial reasoning directly enhance the overall accuracy of Med-VQA upto 6.2%. The proposed approach is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into existing Med-VLM pipelines. The dataset, code, and trained models will be made publicly available at https://github.com/CVLABLUMS/localizationlens.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向医学视觉语言模型的定位感知增强方法，从数据、架构与对齐三个层面改进，在Med-VQA任务上最高提升6.2%的准确率，且与模型无关、易于集成。
AI.motivation: 医学视觉语言模型（Med-VLM）在临床任务中表现良好，但在理解解剖结构和空间定位方面存在不足，而这两者对医学推理至关重要。因此需要一种能增强定位、解剖与空间理解能力的方法。
AI.method: 提出三层次改进：1）数据层面，引入"定位镜头"（localization lens），即一组经专家验证的表征，提供更丰富的解剖与位置上下文；2）架构层面，由于输入复杂度提升，集成pixel shuffle对表征进行过滤与精炼，在保留解剖连续性的同时增强空间信息处理；3）对齐层面，在标准损失基础上加入解耦对比损失（DCL），以更好对齐定位镜头表征与文本特征，提升特征判别力与鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在多个Med-VQA数据集上评估，方法在多种Med-VLM架构上均提升了定位驱动的性能；对定位类问题的分析表明，解剖与空间推理的改善直接使Med-VQA整体准确率最高提升6.2%。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法是模型无关的，可无缝集成到现有Med-VLM流程中；数据集、代码与训练模型将公开于 https://github.com/CVLABLUMS/localizationlens。

title: Causally Fair Generation with Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate, complete, and transform information in settings where their outputs can shape consequential decisions, raising concerns about their impact on demographic disparities. In this context, causal inference provides a principled basis for assessing fairness, because it attributes observed disparities to the mechanisms that generated them, which a purely statistical approach cannot do even with infinite data. In LLM generation, a query may request several causally related variables, each of which is both an outcome of interest and a possible cause of other outputs, and the information supplied in the prompt need not follow a topological or a temporal order. This calls for methods that can analyze and selectively remove disparities from such a flexible generation process. In this paper we introduce Causally Fair Generation with LLMs (CFG, for short). CFG extracts relevant concepts, grounds generation in a reference population and causal diagram, and removes user-selected causal effects. CFG also allows pathways deemed justifiable for the task's utility to be retained, which is known in legal literature as business necessity. Further, we provide formal guarantees for our method when eliminating all discriminatory causal effects in the adapted population model, under appropriate causal assumptions. We evaluate CFG with four LLMs in three real-world settings based on population data and on a synthetic dataset with a known causal ground truth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CFG（Causally Fair Generation with LLMs），一种基于因果推断的方法，用于在LLM生成过程中识别并选择性移除用户指定的因果效应，同时保留符合"业务必要性"的合法路径，并在适当因果假设下提供形式化保证。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地用于生成、补全和转换信息，其输出会影响重大决策，引发对人口统计差异（demographic disparities）的担忧。因果推断为评估公平性提供原则性基础，因为可将观察到的差异归因于其生成机制，而纯统计方法即便有无限数据也无法做到。LLM生成中，一个查询可能涉及多个因果相关变量，每个变量既是感兴趣的结果又可能是其他输出的原因，且提示中提供的信息不必遵循拓扑或时间顺序，因此需要能分析并选择性移除这种灵活生成过程中差异的方法。
AI.method: 提出CFG（Causally Fair Generation with LLMs）：1）提取相关概念；2）将生成锚定到参考人群和因果图；3）移除用户选定的因果效应；4）允许保留对任务效用而言可正当化的路径（法律文献中称为"业务必要性"）；5）在适当的因果假设下，为在适应后的人群模型中消除所有歧视性因果效应提供形式化保证。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界场景（基于人口数据）以及一个具有已知因果真值的合成数据集上，使用四种LLM对CFG进行了评估。
AI.conclusion: CFG能够在LLM灵活生成过程中对因果相关的多个变量进行公平性分析与选择性去偏，兼顾任务效用（业务必要性），并在合理因果假设下提供形式化保证，具备在真实场景与合成数据上的可行性。

title: Efficient HQC Implementations on RISC-V: A Cross-Layer Design Space Exploration
summary:
RISC-V-based hardware/software co-design has become an established methodology for implementing post-quantum cryptography (PQC) on embedded devices. Its software programmability, extensible instruction-set architecture, and optional dedicated accelerators create a broad design space that offers the flexibility required for crypto-agility and post-deployment updates. For HQC, a PQC key-encapsulation mechanism selected for standardization, several RISC-V-based implementations have already been published. However, these works explore only a small subset of this design space.
  We present, to the best of our knowledge, the most comprehensive exploration of RISC-V-based HQC. Our exploration is centered around a new, parametrizable architecture framework on which we characterize 29,920 distinct architectural configurations across all three HQC security levels on FPGA. The Pareto-optimal configurations from this framework outperform the state-of-the-art RISC-V-based HQC implementation, ranging from 4.8x lower LUT utilization at 17% lower latency to 69.6x lower latency at 30% lower LUT utilization, while also requiring up to 10.6x fewer block RAMs.

AI.tldr: 本文对基于RISC-V的HQC（一种后量子密钥封装机制）实现进行了最全面的设计空间探索，提出可参数化架构框架，在FPGA上表征29,920种配置，其Pareto最优配置全面超越现有最优实现。
AI.motivation: RISC-V软硬件协同设计已成为嵌入式设备上实现后量子密码（PQC）的主流方法，其软件可编程性、可扩展指令集和可选专用加速器为密码敏捷性和部署后更新提供了灵活性。对于被选为标准化的HQC，已有若干RISC-V实现，但仅探索了设计空间的很小一部分，缺乏系统性探索。
AI.method: 提出一种新的可参数化架构框架，围绕该框架在FPGA上对HQC全部三个安全级别进行设计空间探索，共表征29,920种不同的架构配置，并从中筛选Pareto最优配置。
AI.result: Pareto最优配置优于现有最先进的RISC-V HQC实现：在延迟降低17%的同时LUT利用率降低4.8倍，或在LUT利用率降低30%的同时延迟降低69.6倍，同时最多减少10.6倍的块RAM使用。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了目前最全面的RISC-V HQC设计空间探索，验证了可参数化架构框架在性能与资源效率上的显著优势，为嵌入式PQC实现提供了灵活且高效的方案。

title: Causal Improvement Graph for Agentic Harness Optimization
summary: Agentic Harness is the runtime that constructs task context and controls execution flow, thereby shaping overall agent performance. Given a fixed model and external evaluation, automated Harness optimization seeks to improve this runtime through an iterative proposal--evaluation loop to better solve target tasks. Existing meta-harness methods mainly adopt proposer-centric discovery, in which an LLM-based proposer integrates accumulated experimental findings to determine subsequent Harness revisions. This places the burden of maintaining the evolving improvement state on the proposer as history expands and its underlying experimental logic becomes harder to discern. In this paper, we introduce the Causal Improvement Graph (CIG), a graph-governed meta-harness framework that externalizes the evolving improvement state in a persistent graph, allowing prior findings to directly govern subsequent Harness optimization through local proposer operations. CIG grows and links Evidence, Hypothesis, Intervention, and Outcome nodes to represent what was observed, how it may be explained, how to test that explanation, and what the evaluation reveals. Their structural relations preserve how the improvement state changes across iterations, allowing local proposers to build directly on relations among prior findings rather than recover them from raw history. Across various agent tasks, CIG discovers stronger Harnesses than previous meta-harness baselines and remains robust to the choice of task solver and proposer. Structural ablations further support the design of an explicit improvement state with graph-governed evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出因果改进图（CIG），一个以图结构治理的元Harness框架，将演化中的改进状态外化为持久图，通过局部提议操作直接指导Harness优化，在多类智能体任务上超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有元Harness方法采用"提议者中心"的发现模式，由LLM提议者整合累积实验发现来决定后续Harness修改。随着历史增长，实验逻辑愈发难以辨识，维护演化改进状态的负担全压在提议者身上，成为瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出因果改进图（CIG）：将改进状态外部化到持久图中，构建并链接Evidence（证据）、Hypothesis（假设）、Intervention（干预）、Outcome（结果）四类节点，分别表示观察到什么、如何解释、如何检验、评估揭示什么。利用节点间的结构关系保存改进状态跨迭代的变化，使局部提议者可直接基于既有发现间的关系进行构建，而无需从原始历史中重新恢复信息。
AI.result: 在多种智能体任务上，CIG发现的Harness优于先前的元Harness基线；对任务求解器（task solver）和提议者（proposer）的选择具有鲁棒性；结构消融实验进一步支持"显式改进状态+图治理演化"的设计。
AI.conclusion: 通过将改进状态外化为图结构并由图治理演化，CIG缓解了提议者中心的负担问题，验证了显式改进状态与图治理机制的有效性，为自动化Harness优化提供了新范式。

title: EgoExo-Next:Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Visual-Option Next-State and Cross-View Reasoning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly evaluated for egocentric and cross-view video reasoning, yet existing benchmarks largely focus on semantic event understanding, temporal relations, or correspondence between already observed views, leaving their ability to reason directly about future visual states underexplored. We introduce EgoExo-Next, a visual-option benchmark for dynamic visual-state reasoning, where models must identify how an observed action trajectory subsequently appears rather than predict only an action label or textual description. EgoExo-Next contains 2,503 human-curated four-choice questions from six public egocentric and ego--exo video sources and comprises four interconnected subtasks that evaluate egocentric next-state prediction, bidirectional ego--exo state correspondence, exocentric next-state prediction, and their composition in Ego-to-Exo Next-State. Extensive evaluation of proprietary, open-source, and spatial reasoning VLMs reveals a substantial human--model gap, with the best model achieving 43.81\% average accuracy compared with 98.55\% for humans, and the largest degradation occurring on the composed Ego-to-Exo task. These results suggest that current VLMs remain substantially limited in dynamic visual-state reasoning, particularly when temporal progression and cross-view reasoning must be composed. The benchmark is publicly available at \url{https://huggingface.co/datasets/yutongli2024/EgoExo-Next}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EgoExo-Next基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在动态视觉状态推理上的能力，包含2503道四选一题目，涵盖自我中心与跨视角的下一状态预测任务。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型基准多聚焦于语义事件理解、时序关系或已观测视角间的对应关系，忽视了模型直接推理未来视觉状态的能力，这一能力在动态视觉状态推理中尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 构建EgoExo-Next基准，从六个公开的自我中心及自我-外中心视频源中人工策划2503道四选一视觉选项题目，设置四个相互关联的子任务：自我中心下一状态预测、双向自我-外中心状态对应、外中心下一状态预测，以及两者组合的Ego-to-Exo下一状态任务。
AI.result: 对专有、开源及空间推理视觉语言模型的广泛评估显示人机差距显著，最佳模型平均准确率为43.81%，而人类为98.55%，且在组合的Ego-to-Exo任务上性能下降最大。
AI.conclusion: 当前视觉语言模型在动态视觉状态推理方面仍存在明显局限，尤其是当需要组合时序推进与跨视角推理时，基准已公开可用。

title: Understanding Generative AI Use in Programming MOOCs: The Role of Course Context and Learner Characteristics
summary: The increasing availability of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools, such as ChatGPT and code-completion assistants, raises questions about how learners integrate these tools into learning activities, particularly in MOOCs that attract diverse participant populations. This study examines the use of GenAI in two programming MOOCs taught in Estonian that differ in duration, workload, topic complexity, and assignment volume: About Programming (4 weeks, 26 expected hours, n = 187) and Introduction to Programming (8 weeks, 78 expected hours, n = 182). Post-course questionnaire data were analyzed using non-parametric statistical methods to examine self-reported adoption, usage frequency, and purposes of GenAI use across courses and learner backgrounds. The results show that GenAI adoption was widespread in both MOOCs, with no statistically significant differences by gender, age, education level, or prior programming experience. However, participants in the longer, more extensive MOOC reported significantly higher usage frequency and were more likely to use GenAI for debugging and idea generation. Reported usage frequency for code explanation and debugging was also higher in the longer course. Exploratory analyses found limited relationships between GenAI use and learning-related outcomes. The findings suggest that course context may play a greater role than learner characteristics in shaping how GenAI tools are used. These results provide implications for instructional design and guidance in programming education.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了两门爱沙尼亚语编程MOOC中学习者使用生成式AI的情况，发现AI使用普遍，且课程情境比学习者背景更能影响使用频率和用途。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI工具（如ChatGPT）日益普及，学习者如何将其整合进学习活动尚不清楚，尤其在参与者背景多样的MOOC情境中。研究旨在探讨不同课程与学习者背景下的GenAI采用、使用频率与用途。
AI.method: 对两门时长、工作量、主题复杂度和作业量不同的编程MOOC（《关于编程》4周、26小时、n=187；《编程导论》8周、78小时、n=182）进行课后问卷分析，采用非参数统计方法，考察自我报告的GenAI采用情况、使用频率与用途。
AI.result: 两门课程中GenAI采用均较普遍，在性别、年龄、教育水平或编程经验上无显著差异。但较长课程的学习者使用频率显著更高，更常用于调试和构思，代码解释与调试的使用频率也更高。探索性分析发现GenAI使用与学习相关结果关系有限。
AI.conclusion: 课程情境可能比学习者特征在塑造GenAI使用方式上发挥更大作用。研究结果为编程教育中的教学设计与指导提供了启示。

title: PRA-TLS: Attestation of a Client Application for TEE
summary: Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) are secure foundations for protecting sensitive information and executing computations over confidential data. Processing in an isolated execution environment (enclave) is invoked by an untrusted application in the Rich Execution Environment (REE). Then the enclave returns the execution results to the untrusted application. Even if the enclave has been attested, the boundary between the enclave and the untrusted application poses risks, such as tampering with input arguments or return values and manipulating the order in which the application invokes functions. Therefore, it is necessary to establish the authenticity and integrity of not only the enclave itself but also the application and its execution environment. In this study, we propose an attestation protocol, Portable Remote Attestation TLS (PRA-TLS), for a client application that invokes an enclave. We introduce a daemon that acts as an attester. PRA-TLS uses a trusted Attester Daemon to measure the state of the host environment and application code at runtime, providing these measurements as attestation evidence for verification by a remote Verifier. This mechanism allows the enclave to proceed only when the software environment is in the expected state and the application code is verified as legitimate. We define attack models and security requirements for the proposed protocol and formally evaluate its security using the Tamarin Prover. Furthermore, we implement a prototype of PRA-TLS using Intel SGX and evaluate its performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PRA-TLS远程认证协议，通过引入Attester Daemon在运行时测量宿主环境与应用代码状态，为调用enclave的客户端应用提供认证证据，从而保障enclave与不可信应用间交互的完整性与真实性，并用Tamarin Prover进行形式化验证及Intel SGX原型性能评估。
AI.motivation: TEE虽能保护enclave内的敏感数据与计算，但enclave与REE中不可信应用之间的边界仍存在风险：输入参数或返回值可能被篡改，函数调用顺序可能被操纵。即便enclave本身通过了认证，仍需确保应用及其执行环境的真实性与完整性。
AI.method: 提出PRA-TLS认证协议，引入作为attester的守护进程（Attester Daemon），在运行时测量宿主环境状态与应用代码，并将测量结果作为认证证据供远程Verifier验证。只有当软件环境处于预期状态且应用代码被验证为合法时，enclave才继续执行。定义了攻击模型与安全需求，并使用Tamarin Prover进行形式化安全评估，同时基于Intel SGX实现原型。
AI.result: 使用Tamarin Prover对协议进行了形式化安全评估，并基于Intel SGX实现了PRA-TLS原型，对其性能进行了评测。
AI.conclusion: PRA-TLS将认证范围从enclave自身扩展到客户端应用及其执行环境，通过运行时测量与远程验证机制提升enclave调用的安全性，为TEE边界风险提供了可形式化验证的解决方案。

title: AraYoungVoices: A Diverse L1/L2 Corpus of Arabic Child and Adolescent Speech
summary: State-of-the-art ASR systems primarily target native adult speech, leading to substantial performance gaps for children, adolescents, and L2 speakers. We introduce AraYoungVoices, a 151.72-hour Arabic read-speech corpus from 286 speakers aged 7--18, comprising AraKids (7--12) and AraTeens (13--18). The corpus includes 146 native Arabic (L1) and 140 second-language (L2) speakers, with native speakers spanning Egyptian, Gulf, Levantine, and North African dialectal backgrounds and L2 speakers representing diverse linguistic backgrounds across the Americas, Asia, Africa, and Europe. We benchmark four pretrained ASR models under zero-shot and fine-tuned settings using unseen-speaker-$\&$-unseen-prompt (USUP) and unseen-speaker-$\&$-seen-prompt (USSP) evaluations. Results show that L2 speech remains substantially more challenging than L1 speech, with the largest errors observed mainly for younger L2 speakers. Age-specific fine-tuning improves the matched age group, while joint fine-tuning provides a stronger balance across populations. ASR hypotheses are also consistently closer to the standard reading prompt than to the verbatim transcription, particularly for L2 speech, suggesting partial normalization of reading deviations.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 AraYoungVoices，一个151.72小时、涵盖286名7-18岁说话者的阿拉伯语朗读语音语料库，用于评估ASR系统在儿童、青少年和L2说话者上的表现。
AI.motivation: 当前最先进的ASR系统主要针对母语成人语音，导致在儿童、青少年和二语（L2）说话者上存在明显性能差距，因此亟需针对这些群体的语音资源和评测基准。
AI.method: 构建了151.72小时的阿拉伯语朗读语音语料库 AraYoungVoices，包含286名7-18岁说话者，分为 AraKids（7-12岁）和 AraTeens（13-18岁）；含146名母语（L1）和140名二语（L2）说话者，母语者覆盖埃及、海湾、黎凡特和北非方言背景。对四个预训练ASR模型在零样本和微调设置下，采用 USUP 和 USSP 两种评测方式进行基准测试。
AI.result: L2 语音显著比 L1 语音更具挑战性，最大误差主要出现在年龄较小的 L2 说话者中；年龄特定微调提升了匹配年龄组的表现，而联合微调在各人群间提供了更好的平衡。ASR 假设持续更接近标准朗读提示而非逐字转写，尤其在 L2 语音中，表明朗读偏差存在部分归一化。
AI.conclusion: AraYoungVoices 为阿拉伯语青少年及 L2 说话者的 ASR 评测提供了新资源，揭示了年龄和语言背景对识别性能的显著影响，并说明微调策略与归一化现象在改善此类场景识别中的重要作用。

title: TAME:Topology-Aware Text-Driven Motion Editing across Heterogeneous Humanoid Skeletons
summary: Text-driven motion editing modifies an existing motion sequence according to a text instruction while preserving the content of the source motion. Existing methods are typically built for a single, fixed skeletal topology, which limits their use in animation pipelines where characters differ in joint count and skeletal hierarchy. We present Topology-Aware Motion Editor (TAME), a flow-matching transformer that edits motions on humanoid skeletons of varying topology. TAME represents motion as per-joint, per-frame tokens and models interactions among joints, across frames, and with the text instruction through skeletal, temporal, and text cross-attention layers. To make the skeletal attention follow each character's hierarchy, TAME replaces full joint attention with Topology-Constrained Skeletal Propagation (TCSP), which restricts attention to one-hop kinematic neighbors in the skeleton's adjacency matrix. We further introduce Edit-Focused Representation Alignment (EFRA), a self-distilled representation alignment strategy that aligns student features with cleaner EMA-teacher features exclusively on edit-relevant joint-time tokens, making edits faithful to the instruction. To make this setting trainable and comparable, we construct TopoMotionFix, a multi-topology extension of MotionFix with seen- and unseen-topology evaluation protocols. TAME outperforms previous methods in edit alignment and source preservation on MotionFix and reliably edits motions on unseen skeletons in TopoMotionFix.

AI.tldr: 提出TAME，一种拓扑感知的流匹配Transformer，可对不同拓扑的人形骨架进行文本驱动的动作编辑，并构建多拓扑基准TopoMotionFix。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动动作编辑方法通常针对单一固定骨架拓扑构建，受限于关节数量和骨架层级固定的假设，难以应用于角色骨架结构各异的实际动画流程。因此需要一种能适应不同拓扑骨架的动作编辑方法。
AI.method: TAME将动作表示为逐关节、逐帧的token，通过骨骼、时间和文本交叉注意力层建模关节间、帧间以及与文本指令的交互。为让骨骼注意力遵循各角色的层级结构，提出拓扑约束骨骼传播（TCSP），将注意力限制在骨架邻接矩阵中的一跳运动学邻居。同时提出编辑聚焦表示对齐（EFRA），一种自蒸馏表示对齐策略，仅在编辑相关的关节-时间token上将学生特征与更干净的EMA教师特征对齐，使编辑更忠实于指令。此外构建TopoMotionFix，即MotionFix的多拓扑扩展，包含已见和未见拓扑的评测协议。
AI.result: TAME在MotionFix上的编辑对齐和源动作保持方面优于先前方法，并能在TopoMotionFix中的未见骨架上可靠地编辑动作。
AI.conclusion: 通过拓扑约束的骨骼传播和编辑聚焦表示对齐，TAME实现了跨不同骨架拓扑的文本驱动动作编辑，并在多拓扑基准上验证了其有效性与泛化能力。

title: Trinity: Self-Evolving Vision-Language Models with a Self-Verifier
comment: NeurIPS'26 Workshop on Agentic AI for Biological Discovery (AgenticLS)
summary: Self-evolving vision-language models (VLMs), a form of self-improvement in which a model generates its own training data from unlabeled images, are a promising route toward agents that expand their reasoning capability in an unsupervised manner, without relying on ever-larger annotation budgets. Existing methods pair a Questioner that proposes problems with a Solver that answers them, but reward both roles mainly by agreement among sampled answers. Agreement is a weak proxy for truth: it cannot tell whether a question is grounded in the image, whether the proposed reference answer is right, or whether a confident majority is wrong in the same way. We present Trinity, in which one VLM plays three roles, Questioner, Solver, and Verifier, and the Verifier is a self-verifier: an exponential moving average (EMA) of the policy itself, requiring neither labels nor an external judge. The Verifier screens every generated question for image grounding and answer correctness before it becomes supervision, scores Solver reasoning against the image, and adjudicates disputes between the reference answer and a strong Solver consensus, correcting the reference and penalizing the Questioner when the consensus is right. Trained on images alone, Trinity improves Qwen3-VL-8B on mathematical visual reasoning and on science benchmarks with biology content, for example, +8.6 points on the biology split of SciVQR and +12.8 on MathVerse, and its reward dynamics behave as a healthy self-play curriculum should. These results suggest that a self-evolving multimodal agent can strengthen its scientific reasoning from unlabeled scientific images alone, with the model itself serving as the verifier.

AI.tldr: Trinity 让同一个 VLM 分别扮演出题者、解题者和验证者，用策略自身的 EMA 作为自验证器，在无标注图像上自我进化，从而提升视觉推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化 VLM 方法依赖采样答案之间的一致性作为奖励，但一致性是"真值"的弱代理：无法判断问题是否扎根于图像、参考答案是否正确，也无法识别"多数自信却同错"的情况。
AI.method: 一个 VLM 承担三种角色：Questioner 生成问题，Solver 作答，Verifier 由策略的指数移动平均（EMA）构成，无需标签或外部评判。Verifier 在生成的问题成为监督信号前，筛查其图像扎根性与答案正确性；对 Solver 的推理依据图像打分；并在参考答案与强 Solver 共识发生冲突时进行裁决——若共识正确则修正参考答案并惩罚 Questioner。
AI.result: 仅用图像训练，Trinity 提升了 Qwen3-VL-8B 的数学视觉推理与含生物学内容的科学基准表现：SciVQR 生物学子集 +8.6 分，MathVerse +12.8 分，且奖励动态符合健康自博弈课程的预期。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，自进化的多模态智能体可以仅凭无标注科学图像增强其科学推理能力，模型自身即可充当验证者。

title: Usage-Modulated Sentiment Representations in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (main conference). 18 pages, 3 figures, including appendices
summary: Prior work suggests that sentiment can often be captured by approximately linear directions in LLM activation spaces, but a single direction may not fully capture sentiment representations. In natural communication, sentiment is shaped not only by polarity but also by usage factors, such as tone and audience adaptation. We test whether these factors systematically modulate sentiment representations beyond a shared sentiment direction. We construct a controlled paired dataset that holds event content fixed while varying sentiment polarity and usage factors, and analyze Llama, Mistral, and Gemma. We identify a shared sentiment direction, remove it, and test the residual structure through erasure and generation-time tone steering. Across models, the shared direction is robust (median cosine 0.953-0.975), yet removing it leaves 0.833-0.909 of the original positive-negative representation-difference norm. The residuals contain compact, reproducible usage-conditioned structure. Targeted erasure weakens held-out usage metrics more than random and label-shuffled controls. On Llama, outputs steered along residualized tone components are preferred in 92.8% of blind target-tone comparisons while preserving the requested sentiment polarity in 98.7% of evaluated outputs.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验了LLM激活空间中情感表征是否仅由单一线性方向刻画，发现共享情感方向之外仍存在可复现的、由使用因素（语气、受众适配）调节的紧凑残差结构，并可用于生成时的语气引导。
AI.motivation: 既有研究认为情感可由激活空间中的近似线性方向捕捉，但单一方向可能无法完整刻画情感表征。自然交流中情感不仅由极性决定，还受语气、受众适配等使用因素影响，因此需要检验这些因素是否系统性地调节情感表征。
AI.method: 构建事件内容固定、仅变化情感极性与使用因素的受控配对数据集；分析Llama、Mistral、Gemma；识别共享情感方向并将其移除，再通过擦除（erasure）与生成时语气引导（tone steering）检验残差结构，并设置随机与标签打乱的对照。
AI.result: 共享情感方向稳健（中位余弦0.953–0.975），但移除后仍保留原始正负表征差异范数的0.833–0.909；残差包含紧凑可复现的使用条件结构；定向擦除比随机和打乱对照更能削弱留出使用指标；在Llama上沿残差化语气成分引导的输出，在盲测目标语气比较中92.8%被偏好，同时在98.7%的评估输出中保持了所要求的情感极性。
AI.conclusion: 情感表征不能仅由单一线性方向完全解释，使用因素在共享方向之外留下了可系统识别与操控的残差结构，为更精细的情感与语气控制提供了依据。

title: FASTER: Fast Adjoint Stochastic Transport for Endpoint Refinement in Reward-Guided Image Editing
summary: Reward-guided image editing at test time seeks to improve a specified reward while preserving source content and visual plausibility. Many existing approaches optimize candidates through pretrained generation processes, making repeated adjustment depend on costly large-model execution and, in some cases, backbone backpropagation. We develop a theoretical framework that jointly accounts for reward, source preservation, and pretrained-prior preferences, allowing the desired output distribution to be specified separately from the dynamics used to realize it. Based on this framework, we introduce FASTER, which trains a small network for each source and objective to perform inexpensive editing, while pretrained and reward models provide feedback on candidate outputs. By reusing each candidate and its feedback across multiple small-network updates, FASTER reduces repeated sampling and supervision queries without placing the pretrained generative backbone inside the inner optimization loop. On SD3, FASTER leads all four target metrics and several validation metrics among the evaluated methods. Compared with the evaluated baseline that optimizes controls along pretrained generation trajectories, FASTER achieves editing-time speedups of up to \({6.91\times}\) on Stable Diffusion 3 and \({24.14\times}\) on Stable Diffusion 1.5.

AI.tldr: 本文提出理论框架与FASTER方法，用小型网络实现测试时奖励引导图像编辑，在保持内容与真实感的同时大幅提速。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时奖励引导图像编辑方法依赖预训练生成过程优化候选样本，反复调整需调用昂贵的大模型执行，有时还需对主干网络反向传播，效率低。
AI.method: 提出一个联合考虑奖励、源内容保持与预训练先验偏好的理论框架，将目标输出分布与实现该分布的动态过程分离。基于此框架设计FASTER：为每个源图像与目标训练一个小型网络执行低成本编辑，预训练模型与奖励模型对候选输出提供反馈；通过跨多次小网络更新复用候选及其反馈，减少重复采样与监督查询，且不将预训练生成主干置于内层优化循环中。
AI.result: 在SD3上，FASTER在四项目标指标及多项验证指标上领先所评估方法。相比沿预训练生成轨迹优化控制量的基线，编辑速度在Stable Diffusion 3上最高提升6.91倍，在Stable Diffusion 1.5上最高提升24.14倍。
AI.conclusion: FASTER通过解耦输出分布与实现动态，并借助小型编辑网络，实现了高效且高质量的奖励引导图像编辑。

title: Reactivating Alignment: Defending LLMs from Jailbreaks via Intention-Aware Input-Output Matching
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that conceal harmful intent within complex adversarial prompts. Existing defenses primarily rely on input perturbation or harmful-output suppression, but they rarely model where malicious intent resides, resulting in brittle protection and excessive over-refusal.
  We propose SENTINEL, a plug-and-play, generation-time jailbreak defense that reframes mitigation as an intent extraction problem. Our key insight is that instruction-tuned LLMs exhibit strong input--output semantic consistency: regardless of jailbreak complexity, generated outputs tend to align with the attacker's true intent. SENTINEL exploits this property by matching semantically aligned input--output regions to extract intention-revealing subsequences, scores these subsequences using refusal-direction projections to estimate harmfulness, and halts generation when necessary. Experiments on HarmBench across multiple LLMs show that SENTINEL reduces jailbreak success rates to close to 5\% while maintaining low over-refusal. We further demonstrate robustness to adaptive attacks and provide a mechanistic interpretation: SENTINEL re-distributes jailbreak features from alignment blind spots to aligned regions.

AI.tldr: 提出SENTINEL，一种即插即用的生成时越狱防御方法，将防护重构为意图提取问题，在HarmBench上将越狱成功率降至约5%并保持低过度拒绝。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型仍易受越狱攻击，攻击者将有害意图隐藏在复杂对抗提示中。现有防御多依赖输入扰动或有害输出抑制，很少建模恶意意图所在的位置，导致防护脆弱且过度拒绝严重。
AI.method: 基于指令微调LLM具有强输入—输出语义一致性的洞察，SENTINEL匹配语义对齐的输入—输出区域以提取能揭示意图的子序列，利用拒绝方向投影对这些子序列打分以估计有害性，并在必要时中止生成。
AI.result: 在HarmBench上跨多个LLM的实验显示，SENTINEL将越狱成功率降至接近5%，同时保持较低过度拒绝；对自适应攻击也具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SENTINEL提供了机制性解释：它将越狱特征从对齐盲区重新分配到已对齐区域，从而在生成过程中有效拦截越狱行为。

title: Self-Generated Feedback Destabilizes Test-Time Training: A Causal Decomposition of Long-Horizon Adaptation
summary: Test-time training (TTT) lets a model store information in its weights during inference. When the model learns from its own output, however, each update also changes the model that generates the next training example. Across 128K-token streams, retaining generated-text updates worsens prediction on independent human-written text with three TTT-E2E model configurations (labeled 125M, 760M, and 3B). The same failure occurs when Adam updates Qwen3-4B's existing weights. The same update mechanisms can improve on real text, so writing itself is not the failure. Three matched comparisons trace the causal pathway. Fixed Generation removes over 98% of the damage at 125M and 760M by using a frozen model to generate training chunks. Recorded Replay separates the loss caused by reading degraded text from the additional loss stored by updating on it. A paired one-update comparison then shows the local conflict: an update predicts its source better but new real text worse. This cost grows after Closed Loop adaptation, with a few trajectories accounting for most large failures. Finally, Settlement evaluates the candidate state on independent real text before commitment. It leaves mean endpoint gaps of 0.07 and -0.02 nats at 125M and 760M while retaining real-text adaptation. These results motivate checking prediction on independent evidence before retaining an update.

AI.tldr: 测试时训练(TTT)在自我生成文本上更新权重会损害对独立人类文本的预测，且损害随闭环迭代放大；用冻结模型生成、记录回放与在独立真实文本上评估后提交，可消除大部分损害并保留真实文本适应能力。
AI.motivation: TTT允许模型在推理阶段把信息存入权重，但当模型从自身输出学习时，每次更新都会改变生成下一批训练样本的模型，形成闭环。作者希望弄清这种自生成更新是否以及如何损害对独立真实文本的预测，并定位其因果路径。
AI.method: 在128K token流上，用125M、760M、3B三种TTT-E2E配置对比保留生成文本更新与不保留的效果，并对Qwen3-4B现有权重做Adam更新验证普适性。通过三组匹配对照追踪因果：(1) Fixed Generation 用冻结模型生成训练块；(2) Recorded Replay 分离读取退化文本造成的损失与在其上更新所存储的额外损失；(3) 配对单次更新比较局部冲突。最后提出 Settlement，在提交前用独立真实文本评估候选状态。
AI.result: 保留生成文本更新在三种配置下均恶化对独立人类文本的预测，Adam更新Qwen3-4B同样失败，而在真实文本上同一机制可带来改进。Fixed Generation在125M和760M上消除了超过98%的损害；Recorded Replay厘清了读取退化文本与更新存储两种损失；单次更新显示对来源预测更好、对新真实文本预测更差。Closed Loop适应后代价增大，少数轨迹贡献了大多数大失败。Settlement在125M和760M上端点的平均差距仅为0.07和-0.02 nats，同时保留了真实文本适应。
AI.conclusion: 自我生成文本上的TTT更新会系统性损害对独立真实文本的预测，该损害通过闭环适应放大，可归因于生成与更新的耦合。建议在保留更新前，先在独立证据上检查预测表现。

title: EagleDepth: Efficient Fine-Grained Depth Estimation via Pixel Diffusion Decoder
summary: Recovering detailed geometry from high-resolution images is critical for precise perception of the surroundings and objects. However, existing methods which use latent-space modeling and VAE reconstruction can compromise geometric details. Furthermore, decoding from latent codes introduces substantial inference overhead. To address those issues, we present EagleDepth, an efficient framework for high-resolution monocular depth estimation that combines the geometric priors of latent diffusion with fine-grained pixel-space generation. Our key idea is to retain depth-aware latent representations as guidance while generating the final depth map directly in pixel space. We train the latent and pixel components sequentially: first, we fine-tune a pretrained latent diffusion model using paired RGB--depth supervision; then, we adapt a pretrained pixel diffusion decoder, PiD, to predict depth conditioned on the learned features. Training of the pixel component starts at 1024 resolution and continues across multiple resolutions up to 4K. The latent branch processes resized, lower-resolution RGB images, while the pixel branch generates depth at the target resolution, bypassing the original VAE decoder. This design preserves learned geometric knowledge without requiring the latent backbone to operate at the output resolution. On five commonly used depth estimation datasets and the high-resolution Synth4K dataset, our framework achieves state-of-the-art depth estimation performance, with faster inference and better preservation of fine structures and object boundaries.

AI.tldr: EagleDepth：结合潜空间扩散几何先验与像素空间生成的高分辨率单目深度估计框架，在多数据集上达到SOTA，推理更快且细节保留更好。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率图像恢复精细几何对感知至关重要。但现有基于潜空间建模与VAE重建的方法会损害几何细节，且从潜码解码带来大量推理开销。
AI.method: 核心思想是保留深度感知的潜表示作为引导，同时直接在像素空间生成最终深度图。顺序训练潜分量与像素分量：先用成对RGB-深度监督微调预训练潜扩散模型；再改造预训练像素扩散解码器PiD，以学习到的特征为条件预测深度。像素分量训练从1024分辨率开始，逐步到4K。潜分支处理下采样低分辨率RGB，像素分支在目标分辨率生成深度，绕过原VAE解码器。
AI.result: 在五个常用深度估计数据集及高分辨率Synth4K数据集上达到SOTA深度估计性能，推理更快，精细结构与物体边界保留更好。
AI.conclusion: 保留潜扩散几何先验并直接在像素空间生成深度，可兼顾精度、效率与细节保真，为高分辨率单目深度估计提供有效方案。

title: Semantic Causal-Factor Inference from Aviation Incident Narratives Using A Variational Autoencoder with Cosine-Similarity-Based Reconstruction
summary: Aviation accident and incident investigations generate extensive unstructured textual information containing evidence relevant to the causes and contributing factors of safety occurrences. Automatically extracting such information is challenging because causal evidence may be distributed across long and complex investigation narratives. This study proposes a semantic causal-factor inference framework combining natural language processing with a variational autoencoder (VAE) to learn the relationship between aviation investigation narratives and expert-reported probable causes. Investigation narratives and their corresponding probable causes are transformed into numerical representations, after which the encoder maps narrative representations to a probabilistic latent space. The decoder estimates representations of the corresponding probable causes and is trained using an objective that combines Kullback-Leibler divergence with cosine-similarity-based semantic reconstruction. The framework was evaluated using 20,919 finalized U.S. National Transportation Safety Board investigation reports from 2005 to 2020. On the held-out test set, the predicted and expert-reported probable-cause representations achieved a mean cosine similarity of 0.786 (SD = 0.120). The predicted representations also yielded interpretable terms associated with causal information in the reports. The results demonstrate the potential of probabilistic latent representation learning for AI-assisted extraction of causal information from aviation safety narratives while retaining expert investigation as the basis for formal causal determination.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出结合自然语言处理与变分自编码器（VAE）的语义因果因子推断框架，用于从航空事故调查叙述中自动提取与专家报告的可能原因相关的因果信息，并在20,919份NTSB报告上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 航空事故与事件调查产生大量非结构化文本，其中包含与安全事件原因及促成因素相关的证据；但因果证据常分散在冗长复杂的调查叙述中，自动提取困难。因此需要一种能够学习调查叙述与专家报告可能原因之间关系的方法。
AI.method: 将调查叙述及其对应的可能原因转化为数值表示；编码器把叙述表示映射到概率潜在空间；解码器估计对应可能原因的表示；训练目标结合Kullback-Leibler散度与基于余弦相似度的语义重构。使用2005至2020年间20,919份已定稿的美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）调查报告进行评估。
AI.result: 在留出测试集上，预测的可能原因表示与专家报告的可能原因表示之间的平均余弦相似度为0.786（SD = 0.120）；预测表示还能产生与报告中因果信息相关的可解释术语。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，概率潜在表示学习在AI辅助从航空安全叙述中提取因果信息方面具有潜力，同时正式因果判定仍应以专家调查为基础。

title: DP-ES: Differentially Private Evolution Strategies for Prompt Optimization
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). Code: https://github.com/StephCpa/dp-es
summary: Token-level differentially private (DP) prompt optimization methods such as DP-OPT can become unstable under tight privacy budgets: on GSM8K, DP-OPT obtains $49.5\pm28.5\%$ across 30 runs, and a logged search trajectory reveals prompt-template drift and noise-sensitive irreversible choices. We diagnose these as structural consequences of greedy token-by-token construction over privately aggregated counts. We then propose DP-ES (Differentially Private Evolution Strategies), a structurally cleaner alternative that maintains a population of full prompts, mutates them via LLM calls that never access the private dataset, and spends privacy only on sampled-Gaussian evaluation; deterministic or Gumbel-smoothed selection is post-processing. Under a conservative $(\varepsilon\leq1.0,δ=10^{-5})$ guarantee, DP-ES achieves 88.1% on GSM8K (+38.6 pp over DP-OPT, approximately 9 times lower standard deviation), 99.7% on MedQA, 73.5% on BANKING77, and 86.8% on Alpaca. It is also 2.5 times faster in wall-clock time and uses 3.3 times fewer logged private-data call groups than DP-OPT. Selection and population ablations, implementation-level noise checks, and a 200-profile exact-match memorization stress test complement the formal guarantee. Scope: Our experiments establish optimization robustness under DP noise, especially where prompt structure is critical; end-to-end validation on genuinely sensitive, non-saturated deployment data remains future work.

AI.tldr: 该论文诊断了DP-OPT等逐token差分隐私提示优化在紧隐私预算下不稳定（GSM8K上30次运行得49.5±28.5%）的结构性原因，并提出基于进化策略的DP-ES方法。
AI.motivation: DP-OPT等逐tokenDP提示优化方法在紧隐私预算下极不稳定，GSM8K上30次运行方差高达±28.5%，且存在提示模板漂移和噪声敏感导致的不可逆选择问题，需要从结构层面改进优化范式。
AI.method: DP-ES维护完整提示的种群，通过不访问私有数据集的LLM调用进行变异，隐私预算仅用于采样高斯评估，确定或Gumbel平滑的选择作为后处理，在(ε≤1.0, δ=10^-5)约束下运行。
AI.result: DP-ES在GSM8K达88.1%（比DP-OPT高38.6个百分点，标准差约低9倍），MedQA 99.7%，BANKING77 73.5%，Alpaca 86.8%；墙钟时间快2.5倍，私有数据调用组少3.3倍；并通过选择与种群消融、噪声检查及200个档案的精确匹配记忆压力测试予以验证。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明DP-ES在DP噪声下具有更强的优化鲁棒性，尤其在提示结构关键的任务上；但在真实敏感、非饱和部署数据上的端到端验证仍属未来工作。

title: Towards cross-cultural study of folksong lyrics with machine translation
summary: Music is universally present in human societies. Ethnomusicologists have long been documenting the diverse expressions of human musicality, and comparative musicology has recently brought several studies of folksong to a more global scale. Such cross-cultural research has not been conducted on lyrics: the language barrier has so far prevented work with multi-lingual data. However, Natural Language Processing (NLP) technologies have reached a stage where this language barrier may no longer be prohibitive. Combining folksong lyrics corpora across five languages, we machine-translate them to a pivot language with a pre-trained neural topic model, and we examine the relationship between content and social function within each language, and across languages for wedding songs. As expected, human evaluation of translation results shows that non-Indo-European languages suffer from overall worse translation quality. Experiments with topic models then indicate that the content of lyrics is at best partially related to the social function of folksongs across all languages. These experiments are just first steps into cross-cultural folk musics lyrics analysis; however, they do indicate that a previously unobserved web of cross-cultural relationships beyond ethnomusicological typologies may be uncovered through the study of what people sing across the world's diverse folk musics.

AI.tldr: 本文跨越五种语言的民歌歌词语料，利用机器翻译将歌词译为枢纽语言，并用预训练神经主题模型分析歌词内容与社会功能之间的关系，探索跨文化音乐歌词分析的可能性。
AI.motivation: 民族音乐学长期记录人类音乐性的多样表达，比较音乐学也把民歌研究推广到全球尺度，但歌词的跨文化研究一直缺失，主要障碍是多语言数据的语言壁垒。作者认为NLP技术已发展到可能突破这一壁垒的阶段，因此希望首次开展跨文化民歌歌词分析。
AI.method: 作者汇集五种语言的民歌歌词语料，先用预训练神经主题模型将其机器翻译到一种枢纽语言，再分别在各语言内部以及跨语言（以婚礼歌曲为对象）检验歌词内容与社会功能之间的关系；同时通过人工评估翻译质量。
AI.result: 人工评估显示，非印欧语言的翻译质量整体较差。主题模型实验表明，在所有语言中，歌词内容至多与社会功能存在部分关联。
AI.conclusion: 这些实验只是跨文化民歌歌词分析的初步尝试，但表明通过研究世界各地不同民歌中人们所唱的内容，可能揭示出超越民族音乐学类型学的、此前未被观察到的跨文化关系网络。

title: Frozen in a Frame: The Velocity Blind Spot in JEPA World Models
comment: 32 pages, 17 figures, 12 tables. Code, model checkpoints, and project page are available via links in the paper
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) for world modeling train an encoder so a predictor maps a current embedding and action to the next frame's embedding, always from a single rendered frame. This has a structural blind spot: a renderer without motion blur draws a scene from configuration alone, so a single-frame embedding carries no velocity information, for any encoder, including the official released LeWM weights. We confirm this on official checkpoints across four real benchmarks (PushT, Reacher, Cube, TwoRoom): every linear velocity probe sits at or below chance while position probes reach R^2 about 0.95. We introduce RateIdent, a three-stage diagnostic protocol, and TI-JEPA, a lightweight fix splitting the latent into a pose code and an explicit finite-difference motion code, predicted jointly. Across three physically grounded environments, TI-JEPA gives a significant, seed-robust gain on a stop-at-goal planning task over a matched-memory baseline, e.g. 55% lower final distance on Pendulum (p=3.2x10^-10) and 64% on CartPole (p=5.1x10^-15). We reproduce this at official ViT-Tiny plus AdaLN-transformer scale, then push the same recipe onto real dm_control Reacher photographs trained from scratch, where TI-JEPA's branch separation exceeds the memory-having baseline's by roughly 38x, the paper's largest margin. Against a same-footprint recurrent RSSM-style predictor, TI-JEPA matches or beats its rollout accuracy on two of three environments, stays separately probeable for pose and motion, and wins outright on the most coupled one. A checkable formal argument and six evaluated environments show single-frame targets are the wrong object to predict when velocity matters, and a small, interpretable structural change fixes it with no privileged supervision. Code, checkpoints, and the project page are linked below the title.

AI.tldr: 单帧JEPA世界模型存在结构性盲区：无运动模糊的渲染帧无法编码速度，任何编码器都不行。作者提出RateIdent诊断协议与TI-JEPA（将潜变量拆分为姿态码与显式有限差分运动码联合预测），在多个环境显著提升规划任务表现。
AI.motivation: JEPA类世界模型用预测器把当前帧嵌入与动作映射到下一帧嵌入，但训练始终基于单帧渲染。由于无运动模糊的渲染器仅依据配置绘制场景，单帧嵌入在结构上不含速度信息，任何编码器（含官方LeWM权重）都无法避免。作者在官方检查点上跨四个真实benchmark验证：线性速度探针接近或低于随机水平，而位置探针R²约0.95，说明速度信息确实缺失，这构成预测目标选择上的根本性问题。
AI.method: 提出RateIdent三阶段诊断协议用于检测该盲区；提出TI-JEPA轻量修复方案，将潜变量拆分为姿态码（pose code）与显式有限差分运动码（motion code）并联合预测。在三个物理环境验证，并在官方ViT-Tiny+AdaLN-transformer规模复现，进一步迁移到真实dm_control Reacher照片从零训练。同时与同规模循环RSSM式预测器对比，并给出可检验的形式化论证。
AI.result: 在stop-at-goal规划任务上，TI-JEPA相对匹配记忆基线取得显著且种子鲁棒的提升：Pendulum最终距离降低55%（p=3.2e-10），CartPole降低64%（p=5.1e-15）。在真实Reacher照片上，TI-JEPA的分支分离度超基线约38倍，为全文最大差距。与RSSM式预测器相比，TI-JEPA在三个环境中的两个上匹配或超越其rollout精度，姿态与运动可分别探测，并在耦合最强的环境上取胜。六个环境的评估均支持结论。
AI.conclusion: 当速度重要时，单帧目标是错误的预测对象；这一结构性缺陷可通过一个小而可解释的结构改动修复，且无需特权监督。形式化论证与六个环境的实验共同验证了该结论。

title: InferOpt: Constrained Multi-Objective Search for LLM Inference Configurations
summary: Serving an LLM means setting dozens of inference-time knobs, from per-layer KV retention to per-layer expert counts. Practice sets them with mechanism-specific heuristics that return a single operating point and do not scale to layer-wise search spaces. We recast inference configuration as constrained multi-objective black-box optimization and build InferOpt, a reusable search framework that requires only variable bounds, a deterministic resource cost, and an evaluation hook. InferOpt searches on a frozen sampled proxy set, rejects over-budget candidates before any model call, tightens the budget adaptively, and re-validates Pareto representatives on full-scale dataset. One pipeline covers a 28-dimensional continuous KV space (Qwen2.5-7B) and a 26-dimensional discrete MoE space (DeepSeek-V2-Lite). On KV, post-prefill pruning cuts the 16K cache by 64.4% and TPOT by 22.9--48.5%, and the searched layer-wise budget by InferOpt beats a matched uniform budget by 7.3% and 14.0% of the Full KV reference points. On MoE, a searched top-k schedule by InferOpt removes 43.0% of routed token--expert pairs while staying within 0.59 points of the default, closer than the matched-budget baselines. Against Random Search, NSGA-II, and MOTPE, InferOpt leads on both spaces, taking the best proxy hypervolume and the lowest retention on KV and staying closest to the uncompressed reference at the lowest experts on MoE.

AI.tldr: 本文将LLM推理配置重构成受约束的多目标黑盒优化问题，提出可复用搜索框架InferOpt，在KV缓存与MoE两个高维空间上均优于Random Search、NSGA-II和MOTPE。
AI.motivation: LLM推理时需设置大量推理期参数（如逐层KV保留率、逐层专家数量），现有方法依赖机制专用启发式，只能给出单一工作点，难以扩展到逐层搜索空间。
AI.method: 将推理配置建模为受约束多目标黑盒优化，构建InferOpt框架，仅需变量边界、确定性资源代价与评估钩子；在冻结的采样代理集上搜索，先拒绝超预算候选，再自适应收紧预算，最后在全规模数据集上重新验证Pareto代表点。
AI.result: 一条流水线覆盖28维连续KV空间（Qwen2.5-7B）与26维离散MoE空间（DeepSeek-V2-Lite）。KV上预填充后剪枝减少64.4%的16K缓存，TPOT降低22.9–48.5%，逐层预算优于匹配的均匀预算7.3%和14.0%；MoE上top-k调度减少43.0%的token–expert对，仅差默认0.59个点。相比Random Search、NSGA-II和MOTPE，InferOpt在两个空间上均领先。
AI.conclusion: InferOpt作为通用搜索框架，能有效处理高维逐层推理配置，在两个不同机制的空间上取得更优的代理超体积与更低保留率，表明将推理配置视为受约束多目标优化是可行且可扩展的方向。

title: SatBleed: Security of Commoditized Communication Modules in Satellites
summary: Substantial reduction in launch and manufacturing costs has resulted in the accelerated deployment of small satellite missions, with commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) components becoming the prevailing standard for specific subsystems. However, this modular architecture introduces critical security risks, most notably in the Communication Subsystem (COM), which is continuously exposed by design and implicitly trusted as the entry point for command and control. We construct a tailored threat taxonomy for attacks targeting the COM subsystem and analyze representative COM systems from various vendors. Our findings uncover severe vulnerabilities across firmware, protocols, and architectural designs. This work presents the first in-depth security evaluation of widely deployed COTS COM modules employed in small satellites, identifying vulnerabilities affecting dozens of missions. To assess the real-world impact, we correlate our discoveries with open-source telemetry data, inferring at least 28 vulnerable missions in orbit that are susceptible to hostile takeover. Our work reveals that satellite COM subsystems form an attractive and dangerously neglected attack surface, necessitating urgent attention from the community.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对小型卫星广泛使用的商用现货（COTS）通信子系统（COM）模块进行深入安全评估，构建了针对COM子系统的威胁分类法，发现了固件、协议和架构设计上的严重漏洞，并结合开源遥测数据推断至少有28个在轨任务面临被恶意接管的风险。
AI.motivation: 发射与制造成本的大幅下降推动了小型卫星任务的加速部署，COTS组件成为特定子系统的普遍标准。然而这种模块化架构带来了严重的安全风险，尤其是按设计持续暴露且被默认信任为指令控制入口的通信子系统（COM），该攻击面极具吸引力却被严重忽视，亟需社区关注。
AI.method: 作者针对COM子系统构建了定制化的威胁分类法，并据此分析了来自多个厂商的代表性COM系统，从固件、协议和架构设计三个层面对其安全性进行评估；同时将发现的漏洞与开源遥测数据进行关联，以推断其在真实在轨任务中的影响。
AI.result: 在多个厂商的代表性COM系统中发现固件、协议和架构设计层面的严重漏洞，影响数十个任务；通过与开源遥测数据关联，推断至少有28个在轨任务易受恶意接管威胁。
AI.conclusion: 卫星COM子系统构成一个极具吸引力且危险地被忽视的攻击面，本文的工作表明该领域急需社区的紧急关注与改进。

title: How Much Do LLM-as-a-Judge Design Choices Matter? A Systematic Comparison of Prompt Designs, Rating Scales, and Models
summary: Researchers increasingly use Large Language Models as judges (LLM-as-a-judge) to evaluate model outputs. Yet there are no standards for how to design these judges. Typically, researchers choose the prompt, rating scale, and model intuitively. If these choices change the judge's verdicts, two studies can reach different conclusions about the same facts. To address this risk and to provide an empirical basis for judge designs, we evaluate 10 reasoning models across multiple designs on two tasks: a scalar rating of sentence sentiment and toxicity (over 500 items per category), as well as a binary accuracy classification of question-answer pairs (n=600). For the rating tasks, despite judges showing significant disagreements with the human ground truth, the practical size of differences is small enough to consider most judges reliable (mean absolute deviation of 0.11 points on a 1 - 7 scale); toxicity judges even outperform standard classifiers. Judges are also highly accurate on average (96.5%) for the accuracy classification task. However, design choices can produce shifts: changing the rating scale alone can shift measured bias by up to 0.93 points (rating task), and while accuracy levels are rarely impacted, design choices consistently impact judge leniency (classification task; leniency drop of 28.9 percentage points when using detailed prompts, and up to 56.1 percentage points when switching models). Counterintuitively, lower reasoning effort affects neither accuracy nor leniency. Across both tasks, model identity is the dominant source of variance. These findings suggest that while LLM judges are broadly trustworthy in aggregate, design choices can be meaningful sources of variance. Given the growing reliance on automated evaluation in LLM research, we intend this study as a methodological reference for designing more robust and replicable LLM-as-a-judge pipelines.

AI.tldr: 研究系统评估了10个推理模型在多种"大模型作为评判者"设计下的表现，发现多数评判者整体可靠，但设计选择会显著影响评判偏差与宽松度，其中模型身份是方差的主要来源。
AI.motivation: 研究者日益使用大模型作为评判者来评估模型输出，但缺乏评判者的设计标准，通常凭直觉选择提示词、评分量表和模型。若这些选择改变了评判结果，两项看似相同的研究可能得出关于同一事实的不同结论。为应对这一风险并为评判者设计提供实证依据，作者开展了本研究。
AI.method: 在两个任务上评估10个推理模型、多种评判设计：(1)句子情感与毒性的标量评分（每类超过500个条目）；(2)问答对的二分类准确性判定（n=600）。
AI.result: 评分任务中，尽管评判者与人类真值存在显著分歧，但差异的实际幅度较小（1-7量表上平均绝对偏差0.11分），多数评判者可靠，毒性评判者甚至优于标准分类器。准确性分类任务平均准确率达96.5%。但设计选择会产生偏移：仅改变评分量表即可使测量的偏差偏移多达0.93分；准确性水平很少受影响，但设计选择会持续影响评判宽松度（使用详细提示词时宽松度下降28.9个百分点，切换模型时下降多达56.1个百分点）。反直觉的是，较低的推理努力既不影响准确性也不影响宽松度。两个任务中，模型身份都是方差的主导来源。
AI.conclusion: 大模型评判者整体上是值得信赖的，但设计选择可能是方差的重要来源。鉴于大模型研究中日益依赖自动化评估，本文旨在作为方法论参考，帮助设计更稳健、可复现的"大模型作为评判者"流程。

title: WASP: Weakly Aligned Spatiotemporal Pairs for Fetal Brain MRI-Ultrasound Learning
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 21 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Code: https://github.com/miccunifi/WASP
summary: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is widely regarded as the optimal sensor for fetal brain analysis due to its superior soft-tissue contrast and anatomical detail. However, its high cost and operational burden make it invasive and difficult to obtain at scale. Ultrasound (US), in contrast, is cheap, safe, and routinely acquired, and as a result it has produced substantially larger datasets and a growing ecosystem of pretrained models. This asymmetry raises a natural question: Can we teach a US-only model to understand fetal MRI from only a limited set of examples? The standard recipe, training a foundation model on subject-to-subject paired MRI-US scans, is not viable since no such paired fetal dataset is publicly available. In this paper we address this gap with Weakly Aligned Spatiotemporal Pairs (WASP), a framework that formulates cross-modal correspondence as an entropic Optimal Transport problem driven by clinical metadata, in particular Gestational Age (GA) and diagnostic planes, enabling the fitting of a lightweight alignment module that lifts MRI representations into the US latent space, without fine-tuning the backbone. Empirically, WASP yields its largest gains when MRI is unseen by the model during pretraining (on USFM, GA estimation error drops from 21.9 to 17.4 days and standard plane classification accuracy climbs from 61.9% to 69.0%), while providing smaller, backbone-dependent refinements for backbones pretrained on both modalities (e.g., BioMedParse GA estimation error from 6.5 to 6.0 days and SAM-Med2d plane accuracy from 83.3% to 88.1%). Code is available at https://github.com/miccunifi/WASP.

AI.tldr: WASP 框架通过将跨模态对应建模为由临床元数据（孕周和诊断切面）驱动的熵最优传输问题，训练一个轻量对齐模块，把 MRI 表征提升到 US 潜空间，无需微调主干网络，从而用少量示例让仅用超声预训练的模型理解胎儿 MRI。
AI.motivation: 胎儿脑部分析中 MRI 软组织对比度好、解剖细节清晰，被视为最优传感器，但成本高、操作负担重，难以大规模获取；而超声便宜、安全、常规采集，因此积累了更大规模的数据集和预训练模型生态。这一不对称引出一个问题：能否用少量示例教会一个仅用超声的模型理解胎儿 MRI？标准做法是用受试者配对的 MRI-US 扫描训练基础模型，但公开数据中不存在此类配对胎儿数据集。
AI.method: 提出弱对齐时空配对（WASP）框架，将跨模态对应表述为熵最优传输问题，由临床元数据（尤其是孕周 GA 和诊断切面）驱动，从而拟合一个轻量对齐模块，将 MRI 表征提升到 US 潜空间，且不微调主干网络。
AI.result: 当模型预训练时未见 MRI 时，WASP 增益最大：在 USFM 上孕周估计误差从 21.9 天降至 17.4 天，标准切面分类准确率从 61.9% 提升至 69.0%。对同时在两种模态上预训练的主干则带来较小且依赖主干的改进，例如 BioMedParse 孕周估计误差从 6.5 天降至 6.0 天，SAM-Med2d 切面准确率从 83.3% 提升至 88.1%。代码已开源于 https://github.com/miccunifi/WASP。
AI.conclusion: WASP 无需配对胎儿 MRI-US 数据集，也无需微调主干，即可用少量示例让仅超声预训练的模型理解胎儿 MRI，尤其在预训练未见 MRI 时效果显著；同时也为已在双模态上预训练的主干提供补充性改进。

title: VCLMU: Mechanism-Centric Virtual Cell World Modeling for Perturbation Response
comment: This paper was accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 workshop on AI for drug discovery
summary: Predicting cellular responses to genetic perturbations is a central capability for virtual cells and a key step toward computational modeling of biological interventions. Most existing models directly map an unperturbed molecular profile and perturba- tion to the resulting observation without explicitly representing the latent cellular transition induced by the intervention. We introduce a mechanism-centric virtual cell world model that represents cellular state as a set of Latent Mechanism Units (LMUs) and treats genetic perturbations as actions on these latent states. Each LMU combines a reusable identity grounded in multimodal biological evidence with an observation-specific state, allowing a perturbation to induce mechanism- specific stochastic transitions before decoding the resulting transcriptional response. We train VCLMU through two-stage pretraining, first on around 200K pseudo-bulk perturbation profiles and then on gene-aligned single-cell perturbation data. Across six perturbation-disjoint benchmarks, VCLMU consistently improves perturbation- specific response recovery over strong baselines while maintaining competitive global response accuracy. We further analyze learned LMUs through enrichment between perturbation responses and LMU gene sets and show that they capture structured biological response programs. These results support mechanism-level latent state transition as a useful formulation for virtual cell models that aim to predict and interpret cellular responses to biological interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VCLMU，一种以机制为中心（mechanism-centric）的虚拟细胞世界模型，将细胞状态表示为潜在机制单元（LMUs），并把基因扰动视为在这些潜在状态上的动作，通过两阶段预训练预测扰动后的转录响应。
AI.motivation: 预测细胞对基因扰动的响应是虚拟细胞的核心能力，也是生物干预计算建模的关键步骤。但多数现有模型直接把未扰动的分子谱与扰动映射到观测结果，没有显式地表示干预所诱导的潜在细胞转移，因而缺乏机制层面的可解释性。
AI.method: 提出机制中心的虚拟细胞世界模型 VCLMU：将细胞状态表示为若干潜在机制单元（LMUs），每个 LMU 结合由多模态生物证据支撑的可复用身份（identity）与观测特定的状态；把基因扰动视为作用在这些潜在状态上的动作，先诱导机制特异性的随机转移，再解码得到转录响应。训练采用两阶段预训练：先在大约 20 万条伪批量（pseudo-bulk）扰动谱上预训练，再在基因对齐的单细胞扰动数据上训练。
AI.result: 在六个扰动不相交（perturbation-disjoint）的基准上，VCLMU 在扰动特异性响应恢复方面持续优于强基线，同时保持有竞争力的全局响应精度。此外，通过对扰动响应与 LMU 基因集之间的富集分析，发现 LMUs 捕获了结构化的生物学响应程序。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将机制层面的潜在状态转移作为虚拟细胞模型的一种有用建模范式，用于预测和解释细胞对生物干预的响应。

title: Cryptanalysis of a Class of Ideal Secret Sharing Schemes Based on the CRT for Polynomial Rings
summary: Based on the CRT for polynomial rings, Yang, Zhu, Fu and Xia (ISIT 2026) proposed a compartmented secret sharing scheme for the compartmented access structure with lower bounds, claiming it can be ideal. We exhibit three families of unauthorized subsets that reconstruct the secret. The scheme is therefore insecure, except for a degenerate choice of parameters in which the only authorized subset is the whole participant set. The flaw in the security analysis is that it does not take all published polynomials into account. Similar flaws appear in the same first author's hierarchical schemes (ISIT 2024, 2026).

AI.tldr: Yang 等人（ISIT 2026）基于多项式环的中国剩余定理提出的带下界隔间秘密共享方案被证明不安全，存在三类非授权子集可重构秘密。
AI.motivation: 检验 Yang、Zhu、Fu 和 Xia（ISIT 2026）声称理想化的带下界隔间访问结构秘密共享方案的安全性。
AI.method: 基于多项式环上的中国剩余定理（CRT），构造并展示三类非授权子集，证明它们能够重构秘密，从而给出攻击。
AI.result: 发现三类非授权子集均可重构秘密，方案除退化参数外并不安全；退化参数下唯一授权子集为全体参与者集合。
AI.conclusion: 该方案存在安全缺陷，根源在于安全分析未考虑所有公开多项式；同一第一作者的分层方案（ISIT 2024、2026）也存在类似缺陷。

title: vMF Sentence LDA: A Spherical Topic Model over Sentence Embeddings
summary: Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) and models derived from it remain widely used topic models. LDA observes each document as a bag-of-words and models each topic by a categorical distribution over the vocabulary, so that it uses neither the internal structure of the document nor the similarity in meaning between words. Earlier work has responded to this limitation in two ways: many models have introduced embeddings, and some have assigned topics to sentences rather than to words. Their combination, a topic model that observes sentence embeddings, remains little explored. We propose vMF Sentence LDA (vSLDA), which keeps the admixture structure of LDA, observes each sentence as its L2-normalized embedding and models each topic by a von Mises-Fisher (vMF) distribution, which matches the cosine geometry of sentence embeddings. Its per-topic parameter count and per-iteration cost are linear in the embedding dimension, versus quadratic for the full-covariance Gaussian distribution in the existing model over sentence embeddings. We evaluate vSLDA where the limitation is expected to matter most, among topics that share much of their vocabulary: the topics that subdivide the one subject of a collection, and the narrow topics that result when a corpus is divided into a large number of topics. On two corpora, vSLDA attains the best mean rank against eight baselines when the fine categories within each coarse category are classified from the document-topic distributions. On the whole corpus, its advantage appears or widens as the number of topics grows. Weighting the word frequencies of each sentence by its topic posterior yields expected topic-word counts of the same form as those of LDA, so that the standard topic coherence and diversity measures apply to models that assign topics to sentences. On their product, topic quality, vSLDA leads in most within-category conditions of both corpora.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 vMF Sentence LDA（vSLDA），一种以句子嵌入为观测、以 von Mises-Fisher 分布建模主题的 LDA 变体，在词汇重叠高的细分主题上优于八个基线。
AI.motivation: LDA 以词袋方式观测文档，忽略文档内部结构和词间语义相似性。已有工作分别从引入嵌入、把主题分配到句子两个方向改进，但"以句子嵌入为观测的主题模型"这一结合方式仍少有探索。且已有句子嵌入模型采用全协方差高斯分布，参数与每轮迭代代价随嵌入维度呈二次增长。作者希望在词汇大量共享的主题（同一主题下的细分主题、大量主题数下的窄主题）这一最需要改进的场景中加以评估。
AI.method: vSLDA 保留 LDA 的混合（admixture）结构：每个句子作为其 L2 归一化嵌入被观测，每个主题由 von Mises-Fisher（vMF）分布建模，与句子嵌入的余弦几何相匹配。相比已有句子嵌入模型的全协方差高斯，其每主题参数数量和每轮迭代代价随嵌入维度线性增长。此外，用句子主题后验对句中词频加权，可得到与 LDA 相同形式的话题-词期望计数。
AI.result: 在两个语料上，当从文档-主题分布对每个粗类下的细类进行分类时，vSLDA 对八个基线取得最佳平均排名；在整个语料上，其优势随主题数增加而显现或扩大。在主题质量（主题一致性与多样性的乘积）上，vSLDA 在两个语料的多数类内条件下领先。
AI.conclusion: 以句子嵌入为观测、用 vMF 分布建模主题的 vSLDA 有效匹配嵌入的余弦几何，计算代价随嵌入维度线性增长，并在细分主题和高主题数场景中表现最佳；其话题-词计数形式与 LDA 一致，使标准主题一致性与多样性指标同样适用于句子级主题模型。

title: Organize Primitives into Semantic Parts: Reinforcement Reasoning for 3D Segmentation
summary: Primitive-based 3D segmentation offers a compact and explicit alternative to dense surface prediction, naturally supporting structural abstraction and boundary localization. However, geometric decomposition alone does not determine how primitives should be organized into semantic parts: a single part may span multiple primitives, while geometrically similar or touching primitives may belong to different parts. We therefore introduce RePart (Reinforcement Part Reasoning), which formulates primitive-to-part organization as a finite-horizon Markov decision process and learns semantic organization through trajectory-level reinforcement reasoning. RePart constructs a Composable Primitive Workspace from fine-grained superquadrics and applies a merge-and-stop policy whose decisions are optimized by their downstream effects on the resulting partition rather than local primitive compatibility. The inferred part identities are then mapped back to the original mesh through Boundary-Aware Surface Labeling, preserving accurate surface boundaries beyond the primitive approximation. On PartNet, RePart achieves the strongest results across all four aggregate partition metrics; on 3DCoMPaT++, it obtains the highest RI and SC without target-dataset fine-tuning. These results demonstrate that reinforcement reasoning provides an effective mechanism for organizing geometric primitives into semantic parts while retaining dense segmentation accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/EngineeringAI-LAB/RePart.

AI.tldr: RePart将图元到语义部件的组织建模为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程，通过轨迹级强化学习实现合并与停止策略，并结合边界感知表面标注，在PartNet与3DCoMPaT++上取得领先的分割性能。
AI.motivation: 基于图元的三维分割虽紧凑且支持结构抽象与边界定位，但仅靠几何分解无法决定图元如何组织成语义部件：一个部件可能跨越多个图元，而几何相似或相接的图元可能属于不同部件。因此需要学习语义层面的组织方式。
AI.method: 提出RePart：将图元到部件的组织建模为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程，进行轨迹级强化推理。构建由细粒度超二次曲面组成的可组合图元工作区，采用合并-停止策略，其决策以下游最终划分效果为优化目标而非局部图元兼容性；随后通过边界感知表面标注将推断的部件身份映射回原始网格。
AI.result: 在PartNet上，RePart在全部四项聚合划分指标上均取得最优结果；在3DCoMPaT++上，无需目标数据集微调即取得最高的RI与SC。
AI.conclusion: 强化推理为将几何图元组织为语义部件提供了有效机制，同时保持稠密分割精度，证明了图元抽象与语义组织相结合的有效性。

title: ManifoldCache: Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration via Constraint Manifold Caching
summary: Diffusion models for structured scientific generation must produce samples satisfying hard geometric constraints imposed by physics, chemistry, or biology, yet inference in these settings is prohibitively slow, demanding hundreds to thousands of neural-function evaluations per sample. We unify eight state-of-the-art models spanning medical volumetrics, molecular conformations, protein backbone design, crystal structure prediction, and multi-view 3D scenes under a single abstraction, Constraint-Manifold Diffusion Models (CMDMs), in which the target distribution is supported on a manifold defined by an externally specified constraint map. All existing acceleration families fail on this class: quantization exhausts memory on high-dimensional volumetric operators; pruning breaks constraint fidelity; fast ODE solvers allow trajectories to drift off the constraint manifold; and feature-caching heuristics are blind to constraint geometry, inducing mode confusion in the high-noise regime. We introduce ManifoldCache, the first training-free, data-free accelerator designed from first principles for CMDMs. The key insight is that the conditional score decomposes orthogonally into a normal component, which enforces constraint satisfaction, and a tangential component, which navigates within the manifold. Exploiting this structure, we prove that the noise-schedule midpoint is a sharp safe-caching boundary: caching before it incurs provably bounded error, while caching after it guarantees a strictly positive fraction of trajectories suffer mode confusion, a gap that persists up to the boundary. We further prove that deeper network blocks admit provably larger certified cache strides within the safe phase, as a consequence of the score decomposition propagating through block Jacobians. The resulting schedule requires no calibration data, along with zero training overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出首个免训练、免数据的加速器 ManifoldCache，为约束流形扩散模型（CMDMs）实现安全高效采样。
AI.motivation: 结构化科学生成（医学体数据、分子构象、蛋白质骨架、晶体结构、多视角3D场景）要求满足物理/化学/生物的硬几何约束，但扩散模型推理极慢，每样本需数百至上千次神经函数评估。现有加速方法（量化、剪枝、快速ODE求解器、特征缓存）在该类任务上全部失效：量化内存溢出、剪枝破坏约束保真度、快求解器轨迹漂移、缓存对约束几何无感知导致高噪声区模式混淆。
AI.method: 将八种SOTA模型统一为 Constraint-Manifold Diffusion Models (CMDMs) 抽象，目标分布支撑于外部约束映射定义的流形上。核心洞察：条件分数正交分解为法向分量（强制满足约束）与切向分量（流形内导航）。基于此证明噪声调度中点是一个清晰的安全缓存边界，并证明更深网络块在安全阶段可获得更大的认证缓存步长。
AI.result: 证明中点之前缓存误差有界，中点之后缓存保证严格正比例轨迹发生模式混淆，且该间隙持续至边界；更深块可获更大认证缓存步长。方法无需校准数据与训练开销。
AI.conclusion: ManifoldCache 是首个从第一性原理为 CMDMs 设计的免训练免数据加速器，通过分数正交分解与安全缓存边界理论，兼顾约束保真度与推理加速。

title: Watermarking: from Impossibility to Auditable Compliance
summary: Article 50 (2) of the EU Artificial Intelligence Act requires providers of generative systems to make synthetic outputs machine-readable and detectable, while qualifying the effectiveness, interoperability, robustness, and reliability by technical feasibility, cost, content-specific limits, and the state of the art. For free-form text, one important implementation route is the implementation of a generative watermarking procedure, which poses a compliance problem that is hard to address. Strong watermarking is impossible against adaptive removal, while ordinary edits attenuate statistical evidence, and unmarked human text may overlap distributionally with machine output. This article develops an auditable alternative. First, it defines a description-length robustness profile. A finite-sample bound shows that detectable bias decays and that the required sample size grows with the inverse square of the decay rate. This replaces an unidentified Shannon-entropy constant with collision entropy. Second, it constructs label-conditional conformal prediction sets with separate false-attribution and false-exclusion levels, reporting ``watermark supported,'' ``not supported,'' or ``inconclusive''. Coverage is obtained as a finite-sample result and is class-conditional under exchangeability. A small reproducible simulation of a tournament watermark confirms both claims and shows that the surviving-token rule overstates the tolerable edit rate roughly twofold. The resulting premarket certificate, signed detector report, and postmarket recalibration protocol operationalize the Commission's 2026 Code of Practice without claiming universal robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文针对欧盟《人工智能法案》第50(2)条对生成式系统合成输出可检测性的要求，提出一种可审计的替代性水印合规方案：定义描述长度稳健性剖面，用碰撞熵替代不可识别的香农熵常数，并构建标签条件共形预测集以三态判定水印支持情况。
AI.motivation: 欧盟《人工智能法案》第50(2)条要求生成式系统提供者使合成输出可机器读取和检测，同时以技术可行性、成本、内容特定限制和现有技术水平限定其有效性、互操作性、稳健性和可靠性。对自由形式文本而言，生成式水印是重要实现路径，但存在难以解决的合规问题：强水印无法抵御自适应移除，普通编辑会削弱统计证据，未标记的人类文本可能与机器输出在分布上重叠。因此需要一种可审计的替代方案。
AI.method: 第一，定义描述长度稳健性剖面，通过有限样本界表明可检测偏差会衰减，所需样本量随衰减率的平方倒数增长，并以碰撞熵替代不可识别的香农熵常数。第二，构建标签条件共形预测集，分别设定误归因和误排除水平，输出“水印支持”“不支持”或“不确定”三种判定；覆盖率作为有限样本结果获得，在可交换性下为类条件成立。
AI.result: 一个关于锦标赛水印的小型可复现模拟验证了上述两项论断，并显示幸存令牌规则将可容忍编辑率大约高估了两倍。
AI.conclusion: 由此形成的上市前证书、签名检测器报告和上市后再校准协议，可在不声称具有普遍稳健性的前提下，落实欧盟委员会2026年实践准则。

title: Small Agents with Semantic Search: Efficient Multilingual Code Localization
summary: Locating relevant files from natural-language requests is a core subtask for agents operating over code repositories. We investigate whether this task can be delegated to compact, specialized models to enable on-device search while reducing the token usage, latency, and inference cost of larger agents. We show that semantic search improves file localization, with gains in accuracy, cross-language transfer, and inference efficiency. To study this setting, we introduce a training framework for file-localization agents built around ColGREP, a local semantic search tool based on late-interaction retrieval models. Our recipe combines weighted supervised fine-tuning on teacher trajectories, assigning turn-level credit based on retrieval outcomes, with reinforcement learning on localization quality. We train three model families with fewer than two billion parameters to formulate search queries, inspect retrieved content, and identify relevant files. On localization tasks derived from SWE-bench Lite and Multi-SWE-bench Flash, ColGREP-equipped agents substantially improve over their base models and outperform corresponding GREP-based agents.
