In addition to improving localization accuracy, ColGREP reduces mean end-to-end trajectory latency by 44.1\% on CPU while using 29.1\% fewer tokens, and enables better generalization to programming languages unseen during fine-tuning. These results suggest that compact, tool-specialized localization agents can provide an efficient interface between natural-language requests and large codebases.

AI.tldr: 本文将代码仓库中的文件定位任务交给小于二十亿参数的紧凑专用模型，引入基于晚期交互检索的本地语义搜索工具 ColGREP，结合加权监督微调与强化学习训练，在提升定位精度的同时显著降低延迟与token消耗。
AI.motivation: 在代码仓库上运行的智能体需要从自然语言请求中定位相关文件，这是一项核心子任务。作者希望探索能否将该任务委托给紧凑的专用模型，从而实现端侧搜索，并降低大型智能体的token用量、延迟与推理成本。
AI.method: 提出面向文件定位智能体的训练框架，核心是 ColGREP——一个基于晚期交互（late-interaction）检索模型的本地语义搜索工具。训练配方包含两部分：在教师轨迹上进行加权监督微调，依据检索结果分配轮级信用；以及在定位质量上进行强化学习。共训练三个参数量小于二十亿的模型族，用于生成搜索查询、检查检索内容并识别相关文件。
AI.result: 在源自 SWE-bench Lite 与 Multi-SWE-bench Flash 的定位任务上，配备 ColGREP 的智能体较其基座模型有显著提升，并优于对应的基于 GREP 的智能体。除定位精度提高外，ColGREP 在 CPU 上将平均端到端轨迹延迟降低44.1%，同时减少29.1%的token用量，并对微调阶段未见的编程语言展现出更好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，紧凑的、工具专用的定位智能体能够在自然语言请求与大型代码库之间提供一种高效的接口。

title: ConEx: Human-Interpretable Saliency Maps via Concept-Aware Attribution
summary: Many visual explanation methods in computer vision highlight pixel importance but struggle to link these low-level cues to semantically meaningful concepts, limiting their interpretability and trustworthiness. We introduce Concept-based Explanations (ConEx), a novel framework that bridges saliency visualization with concept-based reasoning to provide both faithfulness and interpretability. ConEx automatically discovers class-specific concepts and represents them through concept activation vectors (CAVs), learned without manual supervision using an architecture-specific masking mechanism that reduces noise introduced by the segmentation masks to enhance concept purity. ConEx generates faithful saliency maps that reveal where each concept appears in the image and how it contributes to the prediction. To evaluate the reliability of these learned concepts, we propose two complementary metrics, Vector-Concept Match (VCM) and Concept-Class Match (CCM), that quantify concept alignment and enable direct comparison with existing methods. Extensive experiments across diverse settings demonstrate that ConEx achieves state-of-the-art performance on faithfulness, segmentation, and concept-quality benchmarks. Overall, ConEx advances the field toward truly interpretable and concept-grounded explanations in vision models.

AI.tldr: 提出ConEx框架，将显著性可视化与基于概念的推理结合，自动发现类别相关概念并通过概念激活向量（CAVs）表示，实现忠实且可解释的视觉解释。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉解释方法虽能突出像素重要性，却难以将低层线索与语义概念关联，限制了可解释性和可信度。因此需要一种兼顾忠实性与可解释性的方法。
AI.method: ConEx自动发现类别特定概念，用概念激活向量（CAVs）表示；通过架构特定的掩码机制在无需人工监督下学习CAV，减少分割掩码噪声以提升概念纯度；生成揭示每个概念出现位置及其对预测贡献的忠实显著性图；并提出Vector-Concept Match（VCM）与Concept-Class Match（CCM）两个度量评估概念可靠性并对齐。
AI.result: 在多种设置下的大量实验中，ConEx在忠实性、分割和概念质量基准上均达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: ConEx推动了视觉模型向真正可解释、以概念为依据的解释方向发展。

title: Explicit Nonlinear Functions beyond the Fourier bound
summary:
We study the problem of constructing highly nonlinear vectorial maps $F: \mathbb F_2^n \to \mathbb F_2^m$. Concretely, we want an $F$ and an $A = A(m,n)> 0$ as small as possible, so that for every affine map $L: \mathbb F_2^n \to \mathbb F_2^m$ (of the form $L(x) = M x + b $) we have:
  $$\mathrm{agree}(F, L) := |\{ x \in \mathbb F_2^n \mid F(x) = L(x) \}| \leq A.$$
  Such questions have been studied by Nyberg (1991,1993), Carlet and Ding (2004,2007), Liu, Mesnager and Chen (2017), Nagy (2025), and Biryukov, Turecek, and Udovenko (2026).
  There is a classical method of constructing such functions from bent-functions and Fourier analytic ideas; the best bound achievable by this method is: $$ A(m,n) = Θ(2^{n-m} + 2^{n/2}),$$
  and in particular, is never smaller than $2^{n/2}$.
  In this work, we show how to construct highly nonlinear functions beyond this Fourier bound. Concretely, we show how to construct for every $γ>0$, a function $F: \mathbb F_2^n \to \mathbb F_2^m$ with $m = O_γ(n)$, achieving $$ A(m,n) \leq (1 + γ)^n.$$
  Surprisingly, we even achieve the same quantitative behavior for the much harder question of having low agreement with $m$-tuples of degree $d$ polynomials $Q: \mathbb F_2^n \to \mathbb F_2^m$, with $m = O_{γ, d}(n)$. Here the previously best bounds were of the form $A(m,n) = O( 2^{-\frac{n}{2^{d+1}}} \cdot 2^n )$ of Ben-Sasson and Kopparty (2010), based on Gowers-norm-type arguments.
  All our results generalize to all finite fields $\mathbb F_q$ in place of $\mathbb F_2$.
  Our methods are based on a new connection to classical results on counting solutions to systems of polynomial equations via algebraic methods. This connection brings us to basic questions in combinatorics, about graphs and hypergraphs with simultaneously a small number of edges and independent sets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究构造与所有仿射映射（或低次多项式组）一致点数极少的向量布尔函数，突破经典傅里叶/Bent函数方法的 $2^{n/2}$ 下界，对任意 $\gamma>0$ 构造出 $A(m,n)\le(1+\gamma)^n$ 的高非线性函数。
AI.motivation: 高非线性向量函数在密码学等领域有重要应用，即要求函数与任何仿射映射一致的点数尽量少。经典基于Bent函数和傅里叶分析的方法给出的最优界为 $A(m,n)=\Theta(2^{n-m}+2^{n/2})$，永远不小于 $2^{n/2}$，构成难以逾越的障碍。作者希望突破这一傅里叶下界，并进一步解决与低次多项式组一致点数更少这一更难的问题。
AI.method: 作者建立了一种新的联系：将高非线性函数构造问题与用代数方法计数多项式方程组解这一经典结果相关联。这一联系进而引出关于图与超图的组合问题——同时具有少量边和少量独立集的图/超图。基于此，作者对任意 $\gamma>0$ 且 $m=O_\gamma(n)$ 构造出满足 $A(m,n)\le(1+\gamma)^n$ 的函数，并推广到与 $m$ 元 $d$ 次多项式组低一致的情形（$m=O_{\gamma,d}(n)$），以及所有有限域 $\mathbb F_q$。
AI.result: 突破了经典傅里叶方法 $2^{n/2}$ 的下界：对任意 $\gamma>0$，当 $m=O_\gamma(n)$ 时构造出 $A(m,n)\le(1+\gamma)^n$ 的函数；对于与 $m$ 元 $d$ 次多项式组低一致这一更难问题，在 $m=O_{\gamma,d}(n)$ 下也达到相同量级，超越了Ben-Sasson和Kopparty(2010)基于Gowers范数得到的 $O(2^{-n/2^{d+1}}\cdot 2^n)$ 界；所有结果可推广到有限域 $\mathbb F_q$。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出了一种全新的代数方法，通过将高非线性函数构造与多项式方程组解计数的经典结果及关于稀疏边与独立集的图/超图组合问题相联系，成功构造出超越经典傅里叶界的高非线性函数，并统一推广到低次多项式组及任意有限域，推动了Nyberg、Carlet-Ding、Ben-Sasson-Kopparty等一系列工作的进展。

title: InstMoE: Adaptive Multimodal Routing with Specialized Experts
summary: Multimodal inputs are inherently heterogeneous, not only across modalities but also in the information pathways required for effective prediction. To address this limitation, we propose InstMoE, an adaptive expert routing framework for multimodal learning. InstMoE dynamically routes each input to specialized unimodal and cross-modal experts, allowing the model to adapt its information pathways to the characteristics of the input. However, routing can be misled when modality-specific variations obscure task-relevant semantics. Such irrelevant variations may distort routing decisions, causing inputs to be assigned to inappropriate experts. We therefore introduce a Contrastive Semantic Alignment module, which encourages semantically similar inputs to share task-relevant representations while suppressing irrelevant modality-specific variations. Experiments on multimodal sentiment analysis benchmarks demonstrate that InstMoE achieves state-of-the-art performance on CMU-MOSEI and CH-SIMS v2 while using substantially fewer parameters than competitive baselines. Further analysis shows that different inputs exhibit distinct expert preferences, demonstrating that InstMoE moves beyond fixed fusion toward adaptive multimodal computation.

AI.tldr: 提出InstMoE自适应专家路由框架，为多模态学习动态分配单模态与跨模态专家，并引入对比语义对齐模块抑制无关模态变化，在多模态情感分析基准上以更少参数达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 多模态输入具有异质性，不仅体现在模态之间，还体现在有效预测所需的信息通路上。现有方法难以针对输入特征自适应地选择信息路径。
AI.method: InstMoE框架动态地将每个输入路由到专门的单模态专家和跨模态专家，使模型能根据输入特性自适应调整信息通路。同时引入对比语义对齐模块，促使语义相似的输入共享任务相关表示，同时抑制无关的模态特定变化，以避免路由被误导。
AI.result: 在多模态情感分析基准上，InstMoE在CMU-MOSEI和CH-SIMS v2上取得SOTA性能，且参数量显著少于竞争基线。进一步分析显示不同输入表现出不同的专家偏好。
AI.conclusion: InstMoE超越了固定融合方式，实现了自适应的多模态计算。

title: Sparse-View 4D Gaussian Splatting via Spatiotemporal Priors and Generative Assistance
comment: 4 pages, 5 figures, Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Workshops (SA Workshops '26)
summary: We present a 4D Gaussian Splatting framework for the Sparse-View Track of the SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Volumetric Video Challenge, which requires dynamic scene reconstruction from only six cameras with wide baselines. To achieve robust dynamic reconstruction under such sparse views, our framework integrates three components. (1) Region-adaptive spatial priors: We use foreground masks to guide Gaussian initialization and mask voting to control densification separately for the dynamic foreground and static background. Background geometry is regularized using monocular depth aligned to metric scale. (2) Motion-consistent temporal priors: We provide supervision at intermediate times through frame interpolation and constrain projected Gaussian motion with estimated optical flow. (3) Generative assistance: We place virtual cameras in the widest angular gaps and restore their rendered images using a diffusion-based model conditioned on camera poses. The restored images are iteratively incorporated into training as pseudo-supervision. On the validation set, our framework improves full-frame PSNR from 25.60 dB for the baseline to 29.75 dB. On the official test benchmark, it achieves 30.04 dB full-frame PSNR and 27.88 dB foreground PSNR, ranking first overall in the Sparse-View Track.

AI.tldr: 面向SIGGRAPH Asia 2026体视频挑战赛稀疏视角赛道，提出4D高斯泼溅框架，用区域自适应空间先验、运动一致时间先验和扩散模型生成辅助三组件，实现仅6台宽基线相机的动态场景重建，验证集全帧PSNR从25.60 dB提升到29.75 dB，官方测试达30.04 dB并排名第一。
AI.motivation: 挑战任务要求在仅6台宽基线相机条件下进行动态场景重建，视角极度稀疏导致初始化与优化不稳定、动态与静态区域难以兼顾、中间帧监督缺失、宽角度间隙缺乏观测，因此需要引入空间、时间与生成式先验来提升重建鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出4D高斯泼溅框架，集成三类组件：(1)区域自适应空间先验，用前景掩码引导高斯初始化并对动态前景与静态背景分别用掩码投票控制稠密化，背景几何用对齐到度量尺度的单目深度正则化；(2)运动一致时间先验，通过帧插值提供中间时刻监督，并用估计光流约束投影高斯运动；(3)生成式辅助，在最宽角度间隙放置虚拟相机，用基于相机位姿条件的扩散模型恢复渲染图像，作为伪监督迭代加入训练。
AI.result: 验证集上全帧PSNR由基线25.60 dB提升至29.75 dB；官方测试基准上取得30.04 dB全帧PSNR与27.88 dB前景PSNR，在稀疏视角赛道总排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 将区域自适应空间先验、运动一致时间先验与扩散生成辅助相结合，可有效应对宽基线稀疏视角下的动态场景重建，显著提升PSNR并在官方挑战赛稀疏视角赛道中取得最优成绩。

title: EvoCast: Reliable Autonomous Research Agents for Iterative Forecasting Architecture Evolution
comment: 26 pages, 11 figures, including references and appendices. Code: https://github.com/18e0-x/EvoCast
summary: Deep time-series forecasting models have rapidly diversified, yet adapting them to a specific task still requires extensive expert effort in model selection, mechanism diagnosis, architecture design, implementation, and evaluation. Existing AutoML methods are constrained by predefined search spaces, while general-purpose LLM research agents lack reliable control over experimental protocols and model promotion. We introduce EvoCast, a fully autonomous research-agent system for iterative forecasting architecture evolution. EvoCast first establishes and diagnoses a task-specific baseline through executed mechanism ablations, then generates evidence-grounded research directions from dataset characteristics, diagnostic results, prior rounds, and failure records. Its central design, cognition-authority separation, assigns open-ended hypothesis generation and code implementation to LLM agents, while deterministic program authorities control source-edit boundaries, canonical evaluation, and promotion decisions. Experimental outcomes are accumulated as evidence to guide subsequent rounds. Results show that EvoCast completes complex architecture modifications with higher implementation success and lower agent-side token/time cost, and develops task-specific architectures that outperform selected baselines, strong forecasting models, and agent baselines in three real-world forecasting cases. The code is available at https://github.com/18e0-x/EvoCast.

AI.tldr: EvoCast是一个全自主研究智能体系统，通过诊断机制消融、生成基于证据的研究方向，并采用"认知-权威分离"设计，实现时间序列预测架构的迭代演化。
AI.motivation: 深度时间序列预测模型多样化，但适配特定任务仍需大量专家工作（模型选择、机制诊断、架构设计、实现与评估）；现有AutoML方法受限于预设搜索空间，通用LLM研究智能体缺乏对实验协议和模型晋升的可靠控制。
AI.method: EvoCast首先通过执行机制消融建立并诊断任务特定基线；再结合数据集特征、诊断结果、前序轮次和失败记录生成有证据支撑的研究方向。其核心设计"认知-权威分离"将开放式假设生成与代码实现交给LLM智能体，而由确定性程序权威控制源码编辑边界、规范评估与晋升决策；实验结果作为证据累积以指导后续轮次。
AI.result: EvoCast能完成复杂架构修改，实现成功率更高，智能体端token/时间成本更低；在三个真实世界预测案例中，其开发的特定任务架构优于所选基线、强预测模型和智能体基线。
AI.conclusion: EvoCast通过认知与权威分离的自主研究智能体框架，有效提升了时间序列预测架构演化的成功率与效率，并能产出超越现有基线的任务特定架构。

title: Belief-Trajectory Energy: Measuring the Path to a Prediction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) progressively revise their predictions across Transformer layers, yet we typically observe only the final output, discarding the trajectory through which it is formed. We introduce Belief-Trajectory Energy(BTE), a model-grounded measure that characterizes an input through the layerwise predictive revisions it induces in a model. By mapping intermediate states into a shared predictive space, BTE provides a principled measure of belief change that can be summarized as either a scalar or a structured depth profile. Theoretically, we show that local BTE corresponds to predictive revision under the Fisher-Rao geometry, while the sequence of revisions captures information beyond the initial-to-final belief change. Empirically, scalar BTE provides a model-relative signal of difficulty across diverse reasoning tasks, while richer BTE representations support human-LLM review detection and fine-grained generator attribution, reaching up to $0.998$ macro-AUROC and $95.6\%$ eight-way attribution accuracy. Further analysis shows that BTE develops throughout pretraining and is selectively reshaped by targeted training, demonstrating that the resulting measurement reflects what the scoring model has learned. Together, our results establish belief trajectories as a principled model-grounded signal and suggest a broader perspective in which learned models can themselves serve as instruments for characterizing the data they process. More demonstrations can be found at https://yingjiahao14.github.io/BTE-web/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Belief-Trajectory Energy（BTE），一种基于模型内部的度量方法，通过刻画输入在 Transformer 各层引发的预测修正轨迹来表征该输入，可用于难度评估、人机文本审查检测与生成器归因。
AI.motivation: LLM 在 Transformer 各层逐步修正其预测，但通常只观测到最终输出，丢弃了预测形成的中间轨迹。作者希望利用这一被忽略的层间预测修正过程，构建一种模型内在的信号来表征输入本身。
AI.method: 提出 Belief-Trajectory Energy（BTE）：将模型的中间层状态映射到共享的预测空间，从而度量每层的信念变化；该度量可汇总为标量或结构化的深度剖面（depth profile）。理论上证明局部 BTE 对应 Fisher-Rao 几何下的预测修正，且修正序列包含的信息超出初始到最终信念变化。
AI.result: 标量 BTE 在多种推理任务上提供模型相对难度信号；更丰富的 BTE 表示支持人机审查检测与细粒度生成器归因，宏 AUROC 最高达 0.998，八分类归因准确率 95.6%。分析还显示 BTE 在预训练过程中逐步形成，并被针对性训练选择性重塑。
AI.conclusion: 信念轨迹是一种有原理支撑、基于模型的信号，表明学习到的模型本身可作为刻画其所处理数据的工具，为模型内在表征分析提供了更广的视角。

title: Task-Sensitive Geometry of Representation Transfer for Object Detection under Image Degradation
summary: Object detection under image degradation can benefit from clean-image supervision, but aggregate gains do not imply that transferred representation changes are uniformly useful. We study how clean task knowledge affects degraded-image representations and whether local responses to structured representation directions can be characterized geometrically. Using paired clean and Gaussian-degraded BDD100K images, we show that clean-teacher distillation improves observed detection accuracy while producing heterogeneous object-level transfer. We isolate a representation component complementary to direct clean-teacher alignment and map it into the distilled student space through an orthogonal bridge. Controlled interventions rescue 13.22% of objects lost under the distilled representation, versus 4.30% under norm-matched random perturbations, with very low harm on preserved objects. We introduce task-sensitive geometry, a gradient-derived channel-space geometry constructed from normalized detection-loss gradients. On a reserved cohort, mapped-complement orientation within this frozen geometry is positively associated with local intervention-response magnitude after controlling for intervention magnitude (partial Spearman $ρ$ = 0.242, 95% CI [0.108, 0.359]). The relationship eplicates on independent data ($ρ$ = 0.180) and with RT-DETR-L ($ρ$ = 0.227), but not for the direct clean-teacher residual family, and it weakens for large interventions. Routing rules and specialized distillation objectives based on these signals do not yield statistically reliable gains over CLEANKD. These results support a local, direction-family-dependent task-sensitive geometry while showing that converting such structure into improved global training remains an open problem.

AI.tldr: 本文研究干净图像知识蒸馏如何影响退化图像表征，发现干净教师蒸馏虽提升精度但带来异质的目标级迁移；作者分离出一个补充表征成分，并通过正交桥映射到学生空间，且提出"任务敏感几何"框架来解释局部干预响应的方向依赖性。
AI.motivation: 图像退化下的目标检测可受益于干净图像监督，但总体增益并不代表迁移的表征变化一致有用。作者希望探究干净任务知识如何影响退化图像表征，以及局部响应于结构化表征方向能否被几何化地刻画。
AI.method: 使用配对的干净与高斯退化BDD100K图像；采用干净教师蒸馏并观察目标级迁移的异质性；分离出一个与直接干净教师对齐互补的表征成分，通过正交桥映射到蒸馏学生空间；提出任务敏感几何（由归一化检测损失梯度构建的通道空间几何）；在保留队列上进行干预实验并与范数匹配的随机扰动对照。
AI.result: 受控干预挽救了蒸馏表征下13.22%的丢失目标，而范数匹配随机扰动仅4.30%，且对保留目标伤害极低。在冻结几何中，映射互补方向与局部干预响应幅度正相关（偏Spearman ρ=0.242，95% CI [0.108, 0.359]），在独立数据（ρ=0.180）和RT-DETR-L（ρ=0.227）上可复现，但对直接干净教师残差族不成立，且在大干预下减弱。基于这些信号的路由规则与专门蒸馏目标相比CLEANKD未取得统计可靠增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一种局部的、依赖方向族的任务敏感几何，同时表明将此类结构转化为全局训练性能提升仍是待解问题。

title: Action-Consequence Alignment for Reliable Planning and Self-Improving in Latent World Models
summary: Latent world models learn to predict observed transitions, yet low prediction error alone does not guarantee reliable planning. Inspired by self tickling experiments in neuroscience showing that disrupting motor sensory correspondence increases prediction mismatch, we examine whether learned world models preserve an analogous action consequence correspondence.The results show nearby alternatives can receive lower prediction errors despite producing physical outcomes farther from the recorded target. With that future treated as a goal, this reveals a concrete prediction planning mismatch: the model assigns a lower cost to an action that achieves the target less accurately. To mitigate this gap, we introduce Action Consequence Alignment (ACA), a training objective that complements forward prediction by penalizing the prediction error advantage of locally searched alternatives over factual actions without additional model components or environment interactions during training. The same principle can also guide additional data collection for self improvement. We demonstrate that across diverse environments and evaluation settings, ACA improves planning performance and reduces real goal error, while ACA guided data collection outperforms random local sampling. These results support action consequence alignment as a practical principle for bridging predictive learning and reliable planning.

AI.tldr: 论文受神经科学"自我挠痒"实验启发，揭示潜世界模型存在"动作-后果对应"缺失问题：邻近替代动作可能获得更低预测误差，导致预测-规划不匹配。作者提出动作后果对齐（ACA）训练目标，在无需额外模型组件或环境交互的前提下惩罚替代动作的误差优势，实验证明ACA提升规划性能并降低真实目标误差。
AI.motivation: 潜世界模型通常以预测观测转移为目标，但低预测误差并不能保证可靠规划。神经科学中的"自我挠痒"实验表明，当运动-感觉对应关系被破坏时预测误差会增大。作者据此提出疑问：学习到的世界模型是否保留了类似的动作后果对应关系。研究发现，附近的替代动作虽然物理结果偏离目标更远，却能获得更低的预测误差；若将该未来视为目标，则模型会给"更不准地实现目标"的动作分配更低代价，暴露出具体的预测-规划不匹配问题。
AI.method: 提出动作后果对齐（Action Consequence Alignment, ACA）训练目标。它在正向预测的基础上，惩罚局部搜索得到的替代动作相对于真实动作所获得的预测误差优势，无需引入额外模型组件，也无需在训练中与环境交互。同一原则还可指导额外的数据采集以实现自我改进。
AI.result: 在多种环境和评估设定下，ACA 提升了规划性能并降低了真实目标误差；同时，ACA 引导的数据采集优于随机局部采样。
AI.conclusion: 动作后果对齐是连接预测学习与可靠规划的一条实用原则，有助于弥补二者之间的差距。

title: RAISED: Self-Distillation for Robustness to Prompt Injection in LLM Agents
summary: Tool-using language-model agents are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection because they must act on untrusted external content. Existing training-time defenses can reduce attack success rates, but often at the cost of general capabilities. We show that training-based defenses induce substantial drift in the model's output distribution, altering its behavior even in benign settings and providing a potential mechanism for utility degradation. We further identify a failure mode of these defenses: On benign tool-use tasks, the model refrains from a step needed to finish an authorized task, particularly when that step is indicated by a tool output. To address these limitations, we introduce RAISED (Robust Attack Invariance through Self-Distillation), a training framework that combines self-generation and self-distillation. The model first generates its own tool-use scenarios, with an emphasis on cases where task completion requires acting on legitimate guidance from tool outputs. Then, through self-distillation, the student is trained to match the teacher's clean-context behavior on both clean and injected variants of the same trajectory. RAISED substantially reduces the attack success rate of prompt injections in tool responses while, unlike prior training-based defenses, preserving utility on both agentic and general-purpose benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出RAISED框架，通过自生成与自蒸馏训练，降低工具型语言模型智能体遭受间接提示注入的攻击成功率，同时保持通用与智能体任务效用。
AI.motivation: 工具型语言模型智能体需处理不可信外部内容，因此易受间接提示注入攻击。现有训练时防御虽能降低攻击成功率，但往往损害通用能力，并会导致输出分布显著漂移、在良性场景下行为改变；还存在一个失败模式：在良性工具使用任务中，模型会拒绝执行完成授权任务所需的步骤，尤其当该步骤由工具输出指示时。
AI.method: RAISED（Robust Attack Invariance through Self-Distillation）结合自生成与自蒸馏：先让模型生成自己的工具使用场景，重点覆盖任务完成需要依据工具输出中的合法指导采取行动的情况；再通过自蒸馏，训练学生模型在相同轨迹的干净版本与注入版本上都匹配教师模型在干净上下文中的行为。
AI.result: RAISED显著降低工具响应中提示注入的攻击成功率，并且与先前基于训练的防御不同，在智能体基准和通用基准上均保持效用。
AI.conclusion: 通过让模型在自生成场景中学习对合法工具输出指导保持服从，同时以自蒸馏对齐干净上下文行为，RAISED在不牺牲通用能力的前提下提升了抗间接提示注入的鲁棒性。

title: Selecting Repetition Counts Across Model Scales in Data-Constrained Pretraining
summary: The repetition count that works best for a small language model may not remain best at a larger scale. We study this effect in pretraining with a finite target corpus mixed with generic data at a fixed target fraction. On Wikipedia-derived data and Proof-Pile-2, the ranking of measured repetition counts changes with model size, and a 520M Proof-Pile-2 experiment confirms that reducing repetition from sixteen to eight improves loss while using fewer training tokens. We use loss curves from several smaller models to retain a short list of promising repetition counts for evaluation at a larger scale. On PubMed and Caselaw, candidate sets fixed before target-model training retain the lowest-loss measured count on the original evaluation grids at both 200M and 520M. This supports candidate retention as a practical alternative to exact point prediction. We also relate the pruning regression to an empirical scaling model with two opposing repetition-dependent loss terms. A first-order expansion in log model size yields the linear form used by the selection rule, providing a scaling-based interpretation of the candidate-selection procedure.

AI.tldr: 最优重复次数随模型规模变化，本文提出用较小模型筛选候选重复次数集，再在更大规模上评估，验证其可行性与缩放解释。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型上的最优重复次数可能在大规模时不再最优，直接精确预测最优值困难，需要一种更实用的选择方法。
AI.method: 在固定目标比例的预训练语料（Wikipedia派生数据、Proof-Pile-2、PubMed、Caselaw）中，用多个小模型的损失曲线筛出少量有前景的重复次数候选集，再在200M和520M模型上评估；并构建含两个相反重复相关损失项的缩放模型，通过对数模型尺寸的一阶展开得到线性选择规则。
AI.result: 在Proof-Pile-2上，520M模型将重复次数从16降到8可降低损失且使用更少训练token；在PubMed和Caselaw上，训练前固定的候选集在200M与520M的原始评估网格上均保留最低损失的重复次数。
AI.conclusion: 候选保留可作为精确点预测的实用替代；其剪枝回归可由含两个相反重复相关损失项的缩放模型一阶展开解释，为候选选择过程提供缩放视角。

title: FLASHSWIN: Unlocking Large Windows and Dense Tokens in Swin Vision Transformers with Memory Efficient Attention
summary: High-resolution vision backbones have long been forced to trade away local token density to afford larger receptive fields. Hierarchical Swin transformers impose this compromise because standard windowed attention materializes an $M^2\times M^2$ score matrix per window, incurring $O(M^4)$ memory as windows or token grids grow. Furthermore, Swin adds a learned relative-position bias elementwise to attention scores, requiring full materialization of the score matrix and its gradient. This keeps Swin and SwinV2 trapped in a small-window($M=8,16$), coarse-token regime with patch size $4\times4$ ($p=4$), limiting performance for fine-grained tasks. We introduce FLASHSWIN, which replaces standard windowed attention with a FlashAttention implementation that computes exact softmax attention without materializing the score matrix, reducing per-window memory from $O(M^4)$ to $O(M^2)$. This enables higher token density and larger receptive fields without inflating memory overhead. Training memory is flat across window sizes: at a $32\times32$ window, FLASHSWIN-T requires only $12.4$\,GB, unchanged from $8\times8$, compared to $70/90$\,GB for SwinV2/V1-T. However, applying FlashAttention directly to Swin creates a trade-off: bypassing the score matrix precludes Swin's additive relative-position bias, forfeiting spatial information in exchange for memory efficiency. FLASHSWIN restores position information as window-local learnable 2D RoPE, making large windows and dense token grids both affordable and accurate. At matched scale, FLASHSWIN-T outperforms Swin variants. With dense tokens and wide windows ($p=2,M=32$), the same Tiny model reaches $84.1\%$ ImageNet-1K, $44.1$ COCO box AP, and $47.28$ ADE20K mIoU---gains of $+1.3$, $+5.1$, and $+1.82$ over SwinV2-T at $M=16$, respectively. At fixed $M=32$, halving the patch size yields roughly $3\times$ larger gains in boundary quality than in mIoU.

AI.tldr: FlashSWin 用 FlashAttention 替代 Swin 的标准窗口注意力，将每窗口内存从 O(M^4) 降到 O(M^2)，并用窗口内可学习 2D RoPE 恢复位置信息，从而支持更大窗口和更密 token，在分类、检测、分割上超越 SwinV2。
AI.motivation: Swin 类分层视觉骨干为获得更大感受野，长期被迫牺牲局部 token 密度。其标准窗口注意力会产生每窗口 M^2×M^2 的分数矩阵，内存随窗口增大呈 O(M^4) 增长；同时其学习式相对位置偏置需逐元素加到分数矩阵上，必须完整物化分数矩阵及其梯度。这使 Swin/SwinV2 被困在小窗口（M=8,16）、粗 token（patch 4×4）的机制中，限制了细粒度任务的表现。
AI.method: 提出 FlashSWin：用 FlashAttention 实现替换标准窗口注意力，在不物化分数矩阵的情况下计算精确 softmax 注意力，将每窗口内存从 O(M^4) 降至 O(M^2)，从而在不增加内存开销的前提下支持更高 token 密度与更大感受野。由于绕过分数矩阵会丧失 Swin 的加性相对位置偏置，作者将位置信息恢复为窗口内可学习的 2D RoPE，使大窗口与密 token 网格既可行又精确。
AI.result: 训练内存随窗口大小保持平坦：在 32×32 窗口下 FlashSWin-T 仅需 12.4 GB，与 8×8 相同，而 SwinV2/V1-T 需 70/90 GB。同规模下 FlashSWin-T 优于各 Swin 变体：在密 token 与大窗口（p=2, M=32）下，同一 Tiny 模型达到 ImageNet-1K 84.1%、COCO box AP 44.1、ADE20K mIoU 47.28，相比 M=16 的 SwinV2-T 分别提升 +1.3、+5.1、+1.82。固定 M=32 时，patch 减半带来的边界质量提升约为 mIoU 提升的 3 倍。
AI.conclusion: 将 FlashAttention 与窗口内可学习 2D RoPE 结合，可突破 Swin 在窗口大小与 token 密度上的限制，在保持内存效率的同时提升细粒度任务性能，尤其对边界质量收益显著。

title: Autonomous Structuring of Radiology Reports Across Modalities at Archive Scale Using an Open-Weight Large Language Model
summary: Purpose: To develop and evaluate an open-weight large language model (LLM) pipeline that converts an entire archive of free-text radiology reports into structured reports without human oversight. Materials and Methods: In this retrospective study, a pipeline with 150 hierarchically organized templates was developed at one center and tested at a second center on reports from 2010 to 2025. The open-weight model gpt-oss-120B selects the template in three constrained-decoding steps and fills it on one local graphics processing unit. Template selection was scored against expert labels on 914 randomly sampled reports of five modalities, structuring quality on 920 radiography and CT reports corrected field by field by five residents. The pipeline then processed the complete archive of the second center. Proportions are reported with Wilson 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Results: An optimal template set was selected for 74.4% of reports (680 of 914; 95% CI: 71.5%, 77.1%) and an appropriate set for 82.3% (752 of 914; 95% CI: 79.7%, 84.6%), 87.7% for single-region and 54.1% for multi-region reports. Macro semantic textual similarity between output and corrected reference was 0.95 for radiography and 0.97 for CT, residents left 88.7% of 24,638 fields unchanged, and unsupported content was flagged in 1.0% and 1.5% of reports. Of 2,186,982 archive reports, 96.5% received structured output, 2,401,544 structured reports, at 1,258 reports per hour on one graphics processing unit. Conclusion: An open-weight LLM pipeline structured a complete multimodality report archive without human oversight with high content fidelity. Multi-region reports remained the main source of template errors.

AI.tldr: 开发并评估一种基于开源权重LLM的流水线，可在无人工干预下将整个自由文本放射报告档案转为结构化报告。
AI.motivation: 自由文本放射报告档案规模庞大，人工结构化成本高；需要验证开源权重LLM能否在无人工监督下全量、高质量完成结构化。
AI.method: 回顾性研究：在一个中心开发含150个层级模板的流水线，在第二中心2010–2025年报告上测试。开源模型gpt-oss-120B经三步约束解码选择模板并在单块本地GPU上填充。对914份随机抽样报告（5种模态）评分模板选择，由5名住院医师逐字段校正920份X线与CT报告评估结构化质量，随后处理全部档案。比例用Wilson 95%CI表示。
AI.conclusion: 开源权重LLM流水线可在无人工监督下以高内容保真度结构化完整多模态报告档案；多区域报告仍是模板错误的主要来源。

title: An Evaluation of the Semantic Understanding Capabilities of Large Language Models for Web Attack Payloads
comment: Accepted at the 6th International Conference on Computer Vision, Application and Algorithm (CVAA 2026). 16 pages
summary: Computer vision services delivered through Web interfaces and APIs process textual requests for image-resource acquisition, inference-task configuration, and result management, making Web attack-payload analysis relevant to their deployment security. Large language models (LLMs) can identify payload types and explain attack intent. However, existing studies generally treat payload analysis as a single-layer classification task and lack both a systematic assessment of how deeply LLMs understand payloads and an evaluation benchmark dedicated to the depth of semantic understanding of Web attack payloads. We construct PayloadSemBench, a four-layer semantic evaluation benchmark that operationalizes payload understanding across measurable tasks and comprises 240 payloads. Its ground truth was established through two rounds of anchor calibration and re-verified by a fourth independent expert. Two experiments, a semantic-understanding benchmark and an analysis mapping semantic understanding to detection performance, yielded three main findings: (1) type identification and intent understanding were generally strong, whereas severity assessment was the principal weakness; (2) the effects of obfuscation varied across models and layers, with intent explanation and reconstruction of specific obfuscation techniques more susceptible to degradation, while performance did not degrade synchronously across all layers; and (3) semantic understanding and detection decisions were partially decoupled, with only 12.5% to 50% of missed detections attributable to semantic-understanding failures. External re-evaluation on an independent 180-record dataset comprising production WAF alert streams and real application requests reproduced the non-uniform four-layer capability profile and the layer-specific differences on obfuscated payloads.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了PayloadSemBench——一个包含240条载荷、面向Web攻击载荷语义理解深度的四层评估基准，发现LLM在类型识别与意图理解上表现较强，但严重性评估是主要短板，且语义理解与检测决策存在部分解耦。
AI.motivation: Web接口与API形式的计算机视觉服务需要处理文本请求，使Web攻击载荷分析对其部署安全至关重要。LLM虽能识别载荷类型并解释攻击意图，但现有研究多将载荷分析视为单层分类任务，既缺乏对LLM理解深度的系统性评估，也缺少专门衡量Web攻击载荷语义理解深度的评估基准。
AI.method: 构建PayloadSemBench四层语义评估基准，将载荷理解操作化为可测量任务，共含240条载荷；其真值经两轮锚点校准并由第四位独立专家复核。开展两项实验：语义理解基准测试，以及将语义理解映射到检测性能的分析实验。并在独立的180条记录数据集（含生产WAF告警流与真实应用请求）上进行外部再评估。
AI.result: 三项主要发现：(1) 类型识别与意图理解总体较强，严重性评估是主要弱点；(2) 混淆的影响因模型和层级而异，意图解释与特定混淆技术重构更易退化，且各层性能并非同步下降；(3) 语义理解与检测决策部分解耦，仅12.5%至50%的漏检可归因于语义理解失败。外部再评估复现了非均匀的四层能力画像及混淆载荷上的层级差异。
AI.conclusion: Web攻击载荷的LLM语义理解呈现非均匀的四层能力分布，严重性评估为薄弱环节；混淆效应具有模型与层级特异性；语义理解与检测决策部分解耦。该基准及结论在独立真实数据上得到复现，可为Web攻击载荷语义理解与检测评估提供系统性依据。

title: Verification Trap: Understanding Test-Time Selection Failures under False Premises in Code Generation
summary: Test-time compute has become a central way to improve code generation: systems sample multiple candidate programs and use verifier-visible evidence to select the final output. This paradigm implicitly assumes that the verifier provides a corrective signal independent from the generator. We challenge this assumption under misleading task premises. When the generator and verifier share a false premise, they become coupled through a mistaken belief: the generator produces premise-consistent shortcuts, while the verifier supplies evidence that fails to expose them. Consequently, the selector may choose a hidden-test-wrong candidate even when a hidden-test-correct program exists in the pool. We call this failure mode Verification Trap. Across three code-generation benchmarks and five code models, false premises consistently degrade first-sample correctness, reduce selector-chosen correctness after 64-sample test-time selection, and amplify recoverable mis-selection. Mechanistically, verifier-written tests inherit the premise-level blind spot, reshaping verifier-visible candidate space away from hidden-test correctness. These traces make Verification Trap predictable before hidden execution: a lightweight gold-free predictor using verifier-visible features reaches 0.846 AUROC. Our results identify decoupled evidence as a key mitigation axis: coupled scaling provides limited recovery, whereas premise-agnostic robustness auditors recover substantial oracle headroom.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"Verification Trap"失败模式：当生成器与验证器共享错误前提时，二者被错误信念耦合，导致测试时选择器选中隐藏测试错误的候选程序。
AI.motivation: 测试时计算（采样多候选+验证器选择）隐含假设验证器提供独立于生成器的纠错信号。作者质疑这一假设，研究在误导性任务前提下生成器与验证器耦合所带来的问题。
AI.method: 在三个代码生成基准和五个代码模型上进行实验，考察虚假前提对首样本正确率、64样本测试时选择后正确率的影响，并分析验证器编写测试如何继承前提层面的盲点。同时构建轻量级、无需金标准、仅用验证器可见特征的预测器。
AI.result: 虚假前提一致性地降低首样本正确率、降低64样本测试时选择后的正确率，并放大可恢复的误选。验证器编写的测试继承前提盲点，使验证器可见候选空间偏离隐藏测试正确性。该失败模式可在隐藏执行前预测，预测器达0.846 AUROC。
AI.conclusion: 解耦证据是关键缓解方向：耦合式扩展（coupled scaling）恢复有限，而前提无关的鲁棒性审计器（premise-agnostic robustness auditors）能恢复大量oracle余量。

title: COMPASS: Comet Object Measurement Pipeline with Automated Selection and Scoring
summary:
Summary: The single-cell gel electrophoresis ('comet') assay is a widely used technique for quantifying DNA damage at the individual cell level. However, image analysis often relies on manual inspection or semi-automated software, which can be labor-intensive, difficult to reproduce, and sensitive to image quality and comet morphology. COMPASS automates comet assay image analysis by combining deep learning-based comet segmentation with damage measurement and automated comet selection. The pipeline produces standardized DNA damage measurements while offering robust detection, reducing manual effort and improving reproducibility through transparent selection and optional manual review.
  Availability and implementation: COMPASS is implemented in Python and is freely available at https://github.com/ rsinghlab/COMPASS. Installation instructions, pretrained weights, and example usage are provided in the repository.
  Contact: jack_roberts2@brown.edu, ritsingh@illinois.edu
  Supplementary information: Available onlime upon publication.

AI.tldr: COMPASS是一个自动化彗星实验图像分析工具，结合深度学习分割与损伤测量，提高可重复性并减少人工。
AI.motivation: 传统彗星实验图像分析依赖人工检测或半自动软件，工作量大、难以复现，且对图像质量和彗星形态敏感。
AI.method: 将基于深度学习的彗星分割与损伤测量、自动彗星筛选相结合的流程，使用Python实现并提供预训练权重。
AI.result: 提供标准化的DNA损伤测量，具备稳健检测能力，减少人工投入，并通过透明筛选和可选人工复核提升可重复性。
AI.conclusion: COMPASS是一款免费可用的自动化彗星实验分析工具，代码与示例已公开，便于使用与推广。

title: Decide, Ask, or Defer: Clinical LLMs under Incomplete Evidence
comment: Preprint. Accepted to the Main Track of the NeurIPS 2026 GenAI4Health Workshop
summary: Clinical LLMs must decide not only what diagnosis to produce, but also whether the available evidence is sufficient for autonomous decision making. Binary DECIDE/ABSTAIN formulations merge distinct non decision states and do not explicitly evaluate information acquisition. We introduce a DECIDE/ASK/DEFER formulation together with a blinded protocol that prevents models from using evidence completeness metadata. We evaluate Qwen, Gemini, and GPT on 200 matched clinical evidence states constructed from DDXPlus. The models show substantial differences in action selection under identical evidence, with disagreement in 137 of 200 states. For Qwen, a matched targeted versus random analysis shows that selected information changes the likelihood of a subsequent autonomous decision more clearly than diagnostic correctness. Its matched DECIDE/ABSTAIN baseline further reveals a safety autonomy tradeoff: the three action policy rescues some erroneous autonomous decisions but also removes some correct autonomous deci sions. These results show that separating information acquisition from clinician deferral exposes behavior that binary abstention hides, without yielding a uniformly improved decision policy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DECIDE/ASK/DEFER 三态决策框架与盲化协议，评估临床大模型在证据不足时的行为，发现三态划分揭示出二元弃权所掩盖的行为差异，但并未产生一致更优的策略。
AI.motivation: 临床大模型不仅要给出诊断，还需判断现有证据是否足以支撑自主决策。二元 DECIDE/ABSTAIN 表述混淆了不同的非决策状态，且未显式评估信息获取过程。
AI.method: 提出 DECIDE/ASK/DEFER 三态表述，并设计盲化协议以阻止模型利用证据完整性元数据。基于 DDXPlus 构建 200 个匹配的临床证据状态，评估 Qwen、Gemini 和 GPT；对 Qwen 进行匹配的定向与随机信息获取对比，以及与 DECIDE/ABSTAIN 基线的比较。
AI.result: 相同证据下模型动作选择差异显著，200 个状态中有 137 个出现分歧。对 Qwen 而言，所选信息对后续自主决策可能性的影响比诊断正确性更明显；其匹配基线显示存在安全—自主权衡：三态策略挽回部分错误自主决策，同时也去除了部分正确自主决策。
AI.conclusion: 将信息获取与临床医生转诊分离，能揭示二元弃权所隐藏的行为，但并不能得到普遍更优的决策策略。

title: GCTAuto-encoder: A Cross modal Framework for Security Flaw Detection in IoT Networks
summary: IoT encompasses diverse physical entities, from smart home devices to autonomous vehicles, creating a complex environment with heterogeneous security models. This heterogeneity makes IoT sub-systems vulnerable to various network attacks. Modern security systems must therefore be more robust to ensure security and privacy for IoT applications. A highly secure IoT system also demands real time insight, requiring data collection at the edge of the computing layer. This diversity calls for a unified security model applied at the foundational level. Edge intelligence offers a direct approach to handling device diversity. A key goal of edge intelligence in IoT is to extract insight from local data; security models can then use this data to build local node protections, and integrating AI models yields an advanced security solution. This research proposes a novel deep learning algorithm for effective intrusion detection at the edge, supported by a cloud-based IoT framework. We evaluate the proposed cross modal deep learning algorithm against baseline models. The contribution is a cross domain Deep Neural Network (DNN) algorithm for intrusion detection. The objective is to assess a multi-method deep learning model to detect intrusions in IoT systems at the edge via community detection with modeled attention. We evaluate GCT auto-encoder, a novel framework integrating edge intelligence to identify security flaws. The model significantly improves performance and efficiency. On a network intrusion IoT dataset covering multiple attack scenarios, it achieved 0.908 accuracy, reduced learning loss to 0.00156, and outperformed existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种面向物联网边缘的跨模态深度神经网络入侵检测算法（GCT自编码器），在多种攻击场景数据集上取得0.908准确率，学习损失降至0.00156，性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 物联网涵盖智能家居、自动驾驶等多样物理实体，形成异构安全模型的复杂环境，这种异构性使各子系统易受多种网络攻击。现代安全系统需更稳健以保障物联网应用的安全与隐私，同时要求实时洞察，需在计算层边缘进行数据收集。这种多样性呼唤在基础层面应用统一的安全模型，而边缘智能为应对设备多样性提供了直接途径。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的深度学习算法用于边缘端高效入侵检测，并由云基物联网框架支撑。核心贡献是一种跨域深度神经网络（DNN）算法，目标是通过社区检测与建模注意力机制，评估多方法深度学习模型在边缘端检测物联网入侵。具体评估了GCT自编码器这一集成边缘智能的新框架以识别安全缺陷。
AI.result: 在覆盖多种攻击场景的网络入侵物联网数据集上，模型显著提升性能与效率，达到0.908的准确率，学习损失降至0.00156，并优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究验证了跨模态/跨域深度学习结合边缘智能在物联网入侵检测中的有效性，GCT自编码器框架在性能与效率上均具优势，为物联网边缘安全提供了可行的先进解决方案。

title: FORGE: Verification-Gated Behavioral Repair for Generative Language Models
summary: Generative large language models (LLMs) inherit undesirable behaviors from pre-training, including demographic bias and toxic generation, that often emerge only after deployment and affect a small subset of inputs. A repair should eliminate the identified defect, preserve the model's overall functionality and, ideally, provide correctness guarantees. Existing approaches address this only partially: gradient-based fine-tuning lacks per-instance guarantees and becomes unstable with few defect samples; model editing assumes explicit knowledge replacement rather than behavioral correction; and constraint-based repair is largely restricted to discriminative models with unique target outputs. We present FORGE, a framework for targeted behavioral repair of generative language models that separates defect localization, weight editing, and behavioral verification into independent stages. Its core is a repair abstraction that converts localized defective generation into explicit optimization objectives, enabling verification-oriented repair techniques to operate on autoregressive generation. FORGE is editing-mechanism agnostic: we instantiate it with (1) a constraint-based quadratic optimization method that provides per-sample repair certificates and (2) a null-space projection editor that minimizes interference with the original model distribution, both under the same localization and verification protocol. On five open-source LLMs, FORGE consistently achieves larger reductions in bias and toxicity than gradient-based fine-tuning with minor perplexity degradation. The two backends exhibit complementary performance across architectures, which a lightweight causal probe traces to where toxicity-related signals concentrate. FORGE also remains effective with only a handful of defective examples, where conventional fine-tuning often oscillates or fails to converge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FORGE，一个用于生成式语言模型定向行为修复的框架，将缺陷定位、权重编辑与行为验证分离为独立阶段，并在五个开源 LLM 上实现比梯度微调更优的偏见与毒性降低效果。
AI.motivation: 生成式大模型会从预训练中继承人口统计偏见与有害生成等不良行为，这些问题常在上线后才暴露且仅影响少量输入。理想的修复应消除缺陷、保持整体功能，并尽可能提供正确性保证。然而现有方法只能部分满足：梯度微调缺乏逐样本保证且在小样本缺陷下不稳定；模型编辑假设的是显式知识替换而非行为纠正；约束式修复大多局限于具有唯一目标输出的判别模型。
AI.method: FORGE 将缺陷定位、权重编辑和行为验证拆分为独立阶段。其核心是一种修复抽象，把定位到的缺陷生成转化为显式优化目标，使面向验证的修复技术能够作用于自回归生成。该框架与编辑机制无关，实例化了两种后端：(1) 基于约束的二次优化方法，提供逐样本修复证书；(2) 零空间投影编辑器，最小化对原始模型分布的干扰，两者均在相同的定位与验证协议下运行。
AI.result: 在五个开源 LLM 上，FORGE 在偏见和毒性降低方面持续优于梯度微调，且困惑度仅有轻微退化。两种后端在不同架构上表现出互补性能，轻量级因果探针将其追溯到毒性相关信号的集中位置。在仅有少量缺陷样本时，FORGE 仍保持有效，而传统微调常常振荡或无法收敛。
AI.conclusion: FORGE 通过将定位、编辑与验证解耦，为生成式语言模型提供了可验证、机制无关的定向行为修复方案，在效果、稳定性与小样本场景下均优于常规微调，并揭示了不同架构中缺陷信号分布的差异。

title: Decouple, Purify and Unite: Semantic-Structural Prototype Learning for Federated Medical Segmentation
summary: Federated learning enables medical institutions to train a global model without sharing data, yet feature heterogeneity from diverse scanners or protocols remains challenging. Existing representation-based methods face two limitations: 1) Incomplete Contextual Representation Learning: single-layer or coupled representations overlook multi-level structural cues and entangle regional semantics with boundary details. 2) Layerwise Style and Aggregation Biases: domain-specific style discrepancies across intermediate layers degrade prototypes, while aggregation that overlooks client distribution shifts can further amplify bias. We propose FedBCS+, federated decoupled contextual alignment with style-purified aggregation. We employ Frequency-domain Style Recalibration (FSR) in prototype construction to decouple content-style representations and extract style-purified prototypes. Built upon these purified features, Decoupled Contextual Prototype Alignment (DCPA) explicitly decouples multi-level features into semantic and structural prototypes and aligns regional semantics and fine-grained anatomical structures separately. Style-purified Semantic Prototype Aggregation (S2PA) measures each client's purified prototype divergence from the global consensus and adaptively reweights aggregation toward under-represented clients to reduce consensus bias. On five heterogeneous medical segmentation benchmarks spanning histopathology, MRI, ultrasound, and colonoscopy, FedBCS+ achieves the highest mean Dice among the compared methods. A convergence analysis further characterizes how aggregation and alignment affect the optimization bound.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FedBCS+，通过频域风格重校准与解耦上下文原型对齐，结合风格净化语义原型聚合，缓解联邦医学分割中的特征异质性，在五个基准上取得最高平均 Dice。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习可在不共享数据的前提下训练全局模型，但来自不同扫描仪或协议的特征异质性仍是难题。现有基于表示的方法存在两点不足：一是单层或耦合表示忽略多层级结构线索，并将区域语义与边界细节纠缠；二是逐层风格与聚合偏差，中间层的域特定风格差异会降低原型质量，而忽视客户端分布偏移的聚合会进一步放大偏差。
AI.method: 提出 FedBCS+。采用频域风格重校准（FSR）构建原型，解耦内容与风格表示并提取风格净化原型；在此基础上，解耦上下文原型对齐（DCPA）将多层特征显式分解为语义与结构原型，分别对齐区域语义和细粒度解剖结构；风格净化语义原型聚合（S2PA）度量各客户端净化原型与全局共识的偏差，并向代表性不足的客户端自适应重加权聚合。
AI.result: 在涵盖组织病理学、MRI、超声与结肠镜的五个异质医学分割基准上，FedBCS+ 在所比较方法中取得最高平均 Dice。收敛性分析进一步刻画了聚合与对齐如何影响优化界。
AI.conclusion: FedBCS+ 通过风格净化与原型解耦对齐、偏差感知聚合，有效缓解联邦医学分割中的特征异质性，并具备可分析的收敛性质。

title: Label Agreement Does Not Measure Authorization
summary: Many groups now delegate label ontology and metadata harmonization to agentic LLM pipelines. We built one and audited it. Our aggregate scores looked healthy, but the pipeline kept failing in ways they did not show, so we set out to find what they hid. Label agreement asks whether a proposed label matches a reference. It does not ask whether the agent was entitled to propose it, whether the output was complete enough to act on, or whether the label moved when the evidence moved. We measured those three separately on COBRE and FBIRN, two schizophrenia and control neuroimaging cohorts from different consortia, and they come apart, from label agreement and from each other. Showing the agent an upstream proposal barely moves label agreement, 0.857 to 0.870, while agreement on the chosen action doubles, 0.409 to 0.830. Output that parses as JSON still drops a required field on 10% of one model's cases and 33% of the other's. And an agent that replays its first answer scores perfectly on original cases and zero once we change the evidence that decides them. Downstream, a row-order error that none of these metrics reports erases most of the diagnostic signal. So we measure these properties apart, pair each with a control, and gate commitment on the result, which makes failures visible and easy to route to a person. None of this prevents failure. Our reference labels are rule-derived, so agreement with them means consistency, not correctness. Code is available at https://github.com/amir-sbg/Label-Agreement-Does-Not-Measure-Authorization.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建并审计了一个用于标签本体与元数据协调的LLM智能体流水线，发现聚合分数掩盖了三类失败模式，提出将授权性、完整性与证据敏感性三项指标分开测量并加控制项，以门槛式提交使失败可见且易于人工分流。
AI.motivation: 当前许多团队将标签本体与元数据协调交由LLM智能体流水线完成，但聚合指标看似健康却掩盖了实际失败。标签一致性只问标签是否匹配参考，无法回答智能体是否有权提出该标签、输出是否完整到可执行、以及证据改变时标签是否随之改变，因此需要拆开测量这些被隐藏的问题。
AI.method: 作者自行构建并审计了一条智能体流水线，在COBRE与FBIRN两个来自不同联盟的精神分裂症与对照神经影像队列上，分别独立测量三项属性：授权性（是否被允许提出该标签）、完整性（输出是否足以支持行动）、证据敏感性（证据变化时标签是否随之变化），并为每项属性配对相应的控制条件，将最终提交以这些测量结果为门槛。
AI.result: 三项指标彼此分离且与标签一致性也分离。向智能体展示上游提议几乎不改变标签一致性（0.857升至0.870），但所选行动的一致性翻倍（0.409升至0.830）。可解析为JSON的输出仍会丢失必填字段：一个模型10%的案例、另一个模型33%的案例。重放首个答案的智能体在原始案例上得分完美，但在改变决定性证据后得分为零。下游一个未被任何指标报告的航序错误抹去了大部分诊断信号。
AI.conclusion: 将授权性、完整性与证据敏感性分开测量并各自配对控制项，再以结果为门槛决定提交，可使失败可见且易于分流给人工处理。但这一做法并不能防止失败；参考标签由规则推导，因此与其一致只代表一致性而非正确性。

title: Does AI Help Cyber Attackers or Defenders? Evidence from Nonpublic Vulnerabilities and Subsequent Attacks
summary: The release decision for frontier AI systems increasingly relies on cyber capability benchmarks, yet public vulnerability benchmarks can expose agents to previously published advisories, exploits, and fixes, making it difficult to distinguish prior exposure from capability on unseen vulnerabilities. We evaluate open-weight and proprietary AI models on exploit generation, vulnerability repair and subsequent attacks in five nonpublic software environments, including vulnerabilities we privately disclosed while they remained unpatched. Researcher-developed and reviewed deterministic graders, not LLM judges, determine task scores. Comparisons with 209 disclosed vulnerabilities and cryptographic challenges reveal substantial variation across systems and vulnerability types. Repair scores exceed attack scores in two nonpublic environments and fall below them in three. Passing an initial security test is also insufficient: another exploit succeeds in 92 of 524 non-independent defender test intervals after the initial exploit is stopped. These results motivate vulnerability-specific attack-repair comparisons and subsequent resistance tests.

AI.tldr: 该论文在5个非公开软件环境中评估AI模型的漏洞利用生成、修复及后续攻击能力，通过确定性评分器揭示系统与漏洞类型间的显著差异，并强调需要针对具体漏洞的攻击-修复对比与后续抗性测试。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI系统发布决策日益依赖网络能力基准，但公开漏洞基准会让智能体接触到已发布的通告、利用代码和修复方案，导致难以区分"先前暴露"与"对未见漏洞的真实能力"。
AI.method: 在5个非公开软件环境中评估开源权重与专有AI模型，涵盖漏洞利用生成、漏洞修复及后续攻击；包含私下披露且当时尚未修复的漏洞；采用研究者开发并审查的确定性评分器（而非LLM评判）确定任务分数，并与209个已披露漏洞及密码学挑战进行对比。
AI.result: 各系统与漏洞类型间存在显著差异；在2个非公开环境中修复分数高于攻击分数，在3个环境中低于攻击分数；初始安全测试通过并不充分——在524个非独立防御测试区间中，初始利用被阻止后仍有92个区间出现另一次成功利用。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持开展针对具体漏洞的攻击-修复对比以及后续抗性测试，以更可靠地评估前沿AI系统的网络安全能力。

title: Inductive Claims Extraction at Scale
summary: A large part of political discourse on social media is built and expressed at a level of claims: i.e. declarative, typically single-clause statements, which convey a particular interpretation of reality and can range from factual to evaluative. Moreover, rather than occurring randomly, claims coalesce, recur in patterns, and come to be associated with different world views. When paired with structural computational tools such as Social Network Analysis, claims can be a powerful unit of analysis to study political phenomena such as echo chambers or polarisation. In this paper, we present a pipeline that uses a large language model (LLM) to inductively extract and catalogue claims from large social media corpora, and apply it to two different Twitter datasets: one relating to the 2020 US presidential election and the other to the 2022 FIFA World Cup. We comprehensively evaluate the approach by measuring the pipeline's recall and precision against manually annotated samples, run ablation studies isolating the contribution of its various components, and perform a qualitative error analysis. We discuss the value of the approach in the context of Computational Social Science research, and illustrate its capabilities by presenting the claims catalogue obtained from each dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的流水线，从大规模社交媒体语料中归纳式抽取并编目"主张（claims）"，并在两个推特数据集上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体上的政治话语很大程度上以"主张"形式构建和表达，即陈述性、通常为单句的表述，从事实性到评价性不等。这些主张并非随机出现，而是聚类、重复出现并与不同世界观相关联。结合社会网络分析等结构化计算工具，主张可成为研究回声室、极化等政治现象的有力分析单元。然而，如何从大规模语料中高效抽取和编目主张仍是一个挑战。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个使用大语言模型（LLM）的流水线，归纳式地从大规模社交媒体语料中抽取并编目主张。该流水线应用于两个不同的推特数据集：一个关于2020年美国总统选举，另一个关于2022年FIFA世界杯。评估方式包括：以人工标注样本为基准测量流水线的召回率和精确率；运行消融研究以隔离各组成部分的贡献；并进行定性错误分析。
AI.result: 通过人工标注样本评估了流水线的召回率和精确率，消融研究揭示了各组件的作用，定性错误分析识别了方法的局限性。作者还展示了从两个数据集中获得的主张目录，以说明该方法的能力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，基于LLM的主张抽取与编目流水线在计算社会科学研究中具有重要价值，为研究政治现象提供了有效的分析工具。

title: Knossos and Ariadne: Benchmarking and Learning Complete Diagram Topology Extraction with Vision-Language Models
summary: Structural diagrams are widely used to represent complex systems and relational information across scientific, engineering, procedural, and spatial domains. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have become increasingly capable of recognizing diagram elements and reasoning about their content, while complete diagram topology extraction remains comparatively underexplored. In this paper, we study diagram-to-graph topology extraction: extracting all diagram entities and the complete relations among them. To enable large-scale supervised training and systematic evaluation of this task, we introduce Knossos, a benchmark of 19,200 diagrams across six diverse domains, with 245,179 nodes and 439,740 edges. Its symbolic generation process provides exact alignment between rendered diagrams and annotations of complete topology, relation types, and connector geometry. To address the modeling challenge of complete topology extraction, we also present Ariadne, a structured framework that decomposes the task into node inventory extraction and source-conditioned edge prediction. Extensive experiments show that training on Knossos substantially improves complete topology extraction in smaller open-source VLMs. Ariadne further improves over one-step extraction under matched supervision, demonstrating the additional benefit of structured decomposition. It achieves the highest average Edge F1 among the evaluated methods on Knossos, while both backbone variants also improve over their unadapted counterparts on the real-world external benchmark. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/bangwayne/knossos_Ariadne_Public.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"图到图拓扑提取"任务，即从结构图中提取全部实体及其完整关系。为此提出大规模基准 Knossos（19,200 张图、6 个领域、245,179 个节点、439,740 条边）和结构化框架 Ariadne，将任务分解为节点清单提取与源条件边预测。实验表明，Knossos 训练显著提升小型开源 VLM 的完整拓扑提取能力，Ariadne 在匹配监督下优于一步式提取，平均 Edge F1 最高，并在真实世界外部基准上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 结构图广泛用于表示复杂系统和关系信息，近年 VLM 已能识别图元素并推理其内容，但完整的图拓扑提取（提取所有实体及完整关系）研究相对不足。同时，该任务缺乏大规模监督训练与系统评测的数据资源，且完整拓扑提取在建模上具有挑战性。
AI.method: 构建基准 Knossos：通过符号化生成流程渲染 19,200 张图，覆盖六个领域，包含 245,179 个节点和 439,740 条边，渲染图与完整拓扑、关系类型及连接线几何的标注精确对齐。提出框架 Ariadne：将任务分解为节点清单提取和源条件边预测两个子任务。
AI.result: 在 Knossos 上训练显著提升小型开源 VLM 的完整拓扑提取能力；Ariadne 在匹配监督下优于一步式提取，取得所评估方法中最高的平均 Edge F1；两种骨干变体在真实世界外部基准上也优于未适配版本。
AI.conclusion: Knossos 与 Ariadne 证明了大规范监督数据和结构化任务分解对完整图拓扑提取的有效性，为该任务提供了数据、方法与评测基础，代码与基准已公开。

title: $\mathrm{TRIZ}^{a}$: Guiding Agent Evolution from Pattern Recognition to Solution Invention
summary: We propose $\mathrm{TRIZ}^{a}$ (TRIZ exponentiated by an agent), a general R\&D automation paradigm that combines TRIZ inventive theory with LLM-driven agent evolutionary search. TRIZ's 40 inventive principles and contradiction matrix provide structured, explainable directions for solution generation, replacing random or untyped mutation with theory-guided ideation. Functional information (FI), operationalized under a frozen reference contract, is combined with TRIZ Ideality to measure useful and harmful function on a commensurable information scale, while hard gates keep promotion distinct from metric improvement. We validate $\mathrm{TRIZ}^{a}$ in cybersecurity--an adversarial and rapidly evolving domain--on PowerDuck GOOSE, CICIoT2023, and CIC-DDoS2019. Under paired-rerun protocols with protocol fingerprinting and hard-gate validation, the legacy experiments yield absolute F1 improvements of $+2.88$, $+4.23$, and $+0.15$ percentage points, respectively. A completed 45-activity CICIoT2023 campaign further increases macro-F1 from $0.8325$ to $0.8483$, but does not pass its frozen promotion gate. Every result remains traceable from contradiction identification and TRIZ principle selection to code transformation, evaluation metrics, and promotion decision.

AI.tldr: 提出TRIZ^a范 式，将TRIZ发明理论与LLM智能体进化搜索结合，用于R&D自动化，并在网络安全任务上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有研发自动化中解决方案生成多依赖随机或无类型变异，缺乏结构化、可解释的方向；本文希望用TRIZ发明原理与矛盾矩阵提供理论指导的构思，替代随机变异。
AI.method: 将TRIZ 40条发明原理与矛盾矩阵同LLM驱动的智能体进化搜索结合，形成TRIZ^a。以冻结参照契约操作功能信息(FI)，并与TRIZ理想度结合，在同度量信息尺度上衡量有用与有害功能；用硬门控将“提升”与“指标改善”区分开。
AI.result: 在网络安全领域的PowerDuck GOOSE、CICIoT2023、CIC-DDoS2019上，采用配对重跑、协议指纹与硬门控验证，遗留实验F1绝对提升分别为+2.88、+4.23、+0.15个百分点；45项活动的CICIoT2023战役将macro-F1从0.8325提升至0.8483，但未通过冻结的晋升门控。
AI.conclusion: TRIZ^a能实现从矛盾识别、TRIZ原理选择到代码变换、评估指标与晋升决策的全链路可追溯，提供理论引导且可解释的R&D自动化路径，但部分增益未达晋升门槛。

title: TranScope: What the Software Hides About LLM Training Data, the Hardware Reveals at Scale, and Accelerators Magnify
summary: Membership is the root privacy primitive in machine learning: to date, no hardware-based out-of-distribution detection on black-box models has been demonstrated against constant-time, static neural networks with masked confidence. This paper performs the first cycle-level examination of how large language models and vision transformers interact with various modern microarchitecture components, including integrated accelerators, as LLMs scale in size and answers the question of whether the data that a model was trained on affects its execution footprint even without any input-dependent branch, dynamic optimization, or early exit and in constant-time models. The results confirm that the answer is yes and identify which modern hardware components, such as TLBs or on-core accelerators, reveal or amplify that effect. The results also answer whether the signal is informative enough to reliably classify the in-/vs/out-of-distribution property of membership. To understand why, we perform a systematic root cause analysis and find that the transformer's tokenization steps, which happen during training, alter the locality of the accesses the model makes to fetch the vocabulary token later during inference and, as a result, change the page table access patterns and TLB in a previously unknown data-dependent way, causing microarchitectural state to vary significantly based on whether or not the input was in the distribution of the transformer training data. Building on the above observation, we introduce TranScope: the first microarchitecture tool for detecting membership information with low cost, no need for a surrogate model, and significantly higher robustness, e.g., 0.6 AUC for PETAL (best previously reported) vs 0.9 AUC (ours). This reintroduces hardware as both an opportunity, e.g., a tool for checking copyright violation for the first time, and a new channel for inferring membership (MIA).

AI.tldr: 本文首次在周期级别考察大语言模型和视觉Transformer与现代微架构组件（含集成加速器）的交互，发现即使模型是常数时间、静态、无输入相关分支，训练数据仍会影响执行足迹，并据此提出TranScope，用于高效检测成员信息。
AI.motivation: 成员关系（membership）是机器学习中的根隐私原语。迄今为止，尚无针对黑盒模型、常数时间静态神经网络且置信度被掩码的场景，基于硬件的分布外检测被证明可行。作者希望回答：在无输入相关分支、无动态优化、无早退的常数时间模型中，训练数据是否仍会影响执行足迹，以及该信号是否足以可靠区分成员与非成员。
AI.method: 本文对大语言模型和视觉Transformer与多种现代微架构组件（包括集成加速器）的交互进行周期级分析，并进行系统性根因分析，聚焦tokenization步骤如何改变推理时词表token获取的访问局部性，进而改变页表访问模式和TLB行为。基于该观察提出TranScope，一种无需代理模型、低成本且更鲁棒的成员信息检测微架构工具。
AI.result: 结果确认训练数据会影响执行足迹，并识别出TLB、片上加速器等会揭示或放大该效应的现代硬件组件。信号足以可靠分类成员的分布内/外属性。TranScope显著提升鲁棒性：AUC达0.9，而此前最佳结果PETAL为0.6。
AI.conclusion: 训练阶段的tokenization会以未知的数据依赖方式改变推理时的页表与TLB访问模式，使微架构状态因输入是否属于训练分布而显著变化。TranScope首次将硬件同时作为机会（如版权违规检查工具）和新的成员推断攻击（MIA）信道引入，重新确立了硬件在隐私安全中的重要性。

title: When Verifiable Counts Depend on Wording: Auditing Wording Robustness in Instruction Following
summary: Verifiable instruction-following benchmarks often express each constraint through one fixed template. We test whether scores remain stable when the operational requirement is unchanged but its wording varies. We introduce WISE, a matched evaluation suite and reporting protocol instantiated on exact word count, keyword inclusion exactly once, and an inclusive 8--12 word range. Across 100 matched tasks, up to thirteen models from seven providers, and repeated generations scored over the complete visible output, wording alone produces substantial compliance shifts. In an avoidance-family panel, five avoidance and exclusion forms fall below the positive baseline, while constructional controls also shift compliance substantially: in the nine-model control panel, compliance is 54.9% for the original positive form, 48.2% for a longer positive form, 36.7% when the target appears later, and 33.8% for AVOID1. A strict JSON-structure probe shows wording sensitivity beyond counting, with a different direction of effect. Effect sizes, failure directions, weakest forms, and model rankings vary across realizations. Under the most disruptive exclusion form, the top-ranked model changes and 24.1% of strictly ordered model pairs reverse. Human validation further shows that unanimous agreement on an exact-count interpretation can coexist with substantially different model behavior. WISE supplements conventional scores with mean and worst-form compliance, wording gaps, failure profiles, and ranking stability.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出WISE评估套件，检验指令遵循基准在操作要求不变、仅措辞变化时得分是否稳定，发现措辞会显著影响合规率与模型排名。
AI.motivation: 现有可验证的指令遵循基准通常用固定模板表达每条约束，可能掩盖模型对措辞的敏感性，因此需要检验仅改变措辞时评分是否仍稳定。
AI.method: 引入WISE匹配评估套件与报告协议，实例化于精确词数、关键词恰好一次、8–12词包容区间三类要求；在100个匹配任务、至多来自7家提供方的13个模型及重复生成上进行评估，并对避免类、构造性对照及严格JSON结构探测进行分析。
AI.result: 仅措辞变化即造成显著合规波动：九模型对照面板中原始正向形式合规率54.9%，较长正向形式48.2%，目标后置36.7%，AVOID1为33.8%；JSON探测显示计数之外的措辞敏感性且方向不同；最干扰排除形式下排名首位模型改变，24.1%严格有序模型对发生反转；人工验证显示精确计数解释上的一致同意可与模型行为差异共存。
AI.conclusion: WISE在传统分数之外补充均值与最差形式合规、措辞差距、失败画像和排名稳定性，表明仅靠固定模板的指令遵循评分可能高估稳定性，需报告措辞鲁棒性。

title: NAMVIS: Next-Scale Autoregressive Multi-View Image Synthesis
summary: Sparse-view novel view synthesis is a central problem in 3D content creation, but diffusion-based approaches remain limited by iterative denoising, making multi-view generation expensive at inference time. We introduce NAMVIS, a diffusion-free framework that reformulates multi-view image synthesis as geometry-conditioned next-scale autoregression. Instead of generating target views through repeated denoising, NAMVIS predicts discrete visual tokens through a small number of coarse-to-fine scale steps, while sampling all tokens within each scale and across target views in parallel. To anchor this generation process to explicit camera geometry, we propose Multi-scale Projective Pose Encoding, which injects source and target camera transformations into both target-view self-attention and source-to-target cross-attention at every resolution. NAMVIS further combines global conditioning with dense geometry-aware cross-attention, enabling the model to preserve source-view appearance while maintaining target-view consistency. Across Objaverse, GSO, and OmniObject3D, NAMVIS outperforms diffusion-based baselines in PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, while running over 3 times faster than the evaluated diffusion baselines under the same evaluation setting. These results suggest that geometry-conditioned next-scale autoregression is a promising and efficient alternative to diffusion for sparse-view multi-view synthesis. Additional qualitative results, videos, and resources are available at https://corl-team.github.io/namvis/

AI.tldr: NAMVIS 提出无扩散的多视角合成框架，将多视角图像生成重构为几何条件化的下一尺度自回归，在少量粗到细尺度步骤中预测离散视觉 token，比扩散基线快3倍以上且质量更优。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角新视角合成是3D内容创作的核心问题，但基于扩散的方法受制于迭代去噪，导致多视角生成推理成本高昂。
AI.method: 将多视角图像合成重构为几何条件化的下一尺度自回归：通过少量粗到细尺度步骤预测离散视觉 token，每个尺度内及跨目标视角的 token 并行采样。提出多尺度投影姿态编码（Multi-scale Projective Pose Encoding），在每个分辨率下将源与目标相机变换注入目标视角自注意力和源到目标交叉注意力；结合全局条件与密集几何感知交叉注意力。
AI.result: 在 Objaverse、GSO 和 OmniObject3D 上，NAMVIS 在 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 上均优于基于扩散的基线，且在相同评测设置下运行速度超过所评估扩散基线的3倍。
AI.conclusion: 几何条件化的下一尺度自回归是稀疏视角多视角合成中替代扩散的高效且具前景的方案。

title: Recursive Improvement of a Differentiable Scientific Software Ecosystem
summary: Differentiable programming connects scientific computation with gradient-based inference, learning and design. Extending these capabilities across a heterogeneous software ecosystem requires specialized effort to implement derivatives, integrate interfaces and evaluate quality. AI coding agents can accelerate this transformation, but translating their capabilities into useful scientific software requires identifying research needs and evaluating how well implementations meet them. We present an environment for agent-driven evolution of differentiable scientific software that connects demand identification, development and quality evaluation. A unified differentiation interface exposes reusable derivative rules alongside existing numerical routines, allowing research tasks to share these capabilities. Research requirements guide development, with implementations assessed through independent derivative checks, workflow tests and performance evaluation. Validated software, research programs and tests become shared resources for subsequent studies. We construct and validate automatic differentiation extensions across 20 packages spanning physical, chemical and biological modeling, with research workflows demonstrating reuse across tasks. Benchmarks demonstrate computational savings over finite differences in gradient evaluation and complete parameter estimation. Research-driven revisions make previously unsupported workflows differentiable, correct derivatives of scientific observables and eliminate redundant computation. Quantum-control and thermal-design studies revise objectives in response to physical evaluation, improving designs while reusing existing derivatives. This work provides a practical approach to expanding differentiable programming across established scientific software and organizing AI agents around the recursive improvement of a shared computational ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向AI编程智能体的可微分科学软件演化环境，将需求识别、开发与质量评估相连，在20个跨物理、化学、生物的软件包中构建并验证自动微分扩展，实现任务间能力复用并在量子控制与热设计研究中改进设计。
AI.motivation: 可微分编程将科学计算与基于梯度的推断、学习和设计连接起来，但要在异构软件生态中推广需大量工作，包括实现导数、集成接口和评估质量。AI编程智能体虽可加速这一转变，但需识别研究需求并评估实现质量，才能转化为有用的科学软件。
AI.method: 构建一个智能体驱动的可微分科学软件演化环境：统一微分接口暴露可复用导数规则并与现有数值例程并行；以研究需求指导开发，通过独立导数校验、工作流测试和性能评估来验证实现；验证后的软件、研究程序和测试成为共享资源。在20个覆盖物理、化学、生物建模的软件包中构建并验证自动微分扩展。
AI.result: 基准测试显示梯度评估和完整参数估计相比有限差分具有计算节省；研究驱动的修订使原本不支持的流程变为可微分、修正了科学观测量的导数并消除冗余计算；量子控制和热设计研究根据物理评估修订目标，在复用现有导数的同时改进设计。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提供了一种在既有科学软件中扩展可微分编程并围绕共享计算生态的递归改进来组织AI智能体的实用方法。

title: Red-TTT: Test-Time Training for Automated Jailbreaking Large Language Models
summary: Large language models remain vulnerable to jailbreaks, and automated red teaming is the standard way to find jailbreaks in large language models at scale. Current methods either draw more samples at test time through search, rewriting, and tree expansion, or train a stronger attacker offline with reinforcement learning. Both share a limitation: once an attack on a specific target behavior begins, the attacker's weights are frozen. Any signal it gathers about the behavior stays in its context window and is discarded afterward. The attacker never adapts its proposal distribution mid-attack, so success depends almost entirely on the sampling budget, and under a budget affordable at scale, many behaviors remain unbroken. We propose Red-TTT, which updates the attacker's parameters during the attack on each behavior. At each round, the attacker samples a group of candidates, scores them against the victim's replies, and takes a policy-gradient step before drawing the next group, so what it discovers about the current victim is consolidated into weights rather than accumulated as context. We also adapt the training objective to red teaming, where success is judged by the single best sample rather than the average. Red-TTT requires only sampling access to the victim and integrates into existing attack pipelines with no other changes. Against the Best-of-N baseline, Red-TTT raises attack success rate from 55.9\% to 72.4\% on average at a budget of 120 samples, improving over the baseline in every configuration and cracking many behaviors previous method cannot. The code is available at https://github.com/SaFo-Lab/Red-TTT

AI.tldr: 提出 Red-TTT，在攻击过程中在线更新攻击者参数，将发现的攻击信息固化到权重中，显著提升越狱攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化红队攻击方法（测试时的搜索/改写/树扩展，或离线强化学习训练攻击者）存在共同局限：一旦开始针对某目标行为的攻击，攻击者权重就被冻结，收集到的信息只留在上下文窗口中并在攻击后丢弃，攻击者无法在攻击过程中调整其提议分布，导致成功率几乎完全依赖采样预算，预算有限时许多行为无法攻破。
AI.method: 提出 Red-TTT，在针对每个行为的攻击过程中更新攻击者参数。每轮中攻击者采样一组候选，依据受害者回复进行打分，在下一次采样前进行策略梯度更新，从而将当前受害者的信息整合进权重而非累积在上下文中。同时调整训练目标以适应红队任务——成功由单个最佳样本而非平均表现来评判。Red-TTT 仅需对受害者的采样访问，可无缝集成到现有攻击流程中。
AI.result: 在 120 样本预算下，相比 Best-of-N 基线，Red-TTT 将平均攻击成功率从 55.9% 提升至 72.4%，在所有配置上均优于基线，并攻破了先前方法无法攻破的多种行为。
AI.conclusion: 通过对攻击者进行测试时参数更新，Red-TTT 突破了现有方法权重冻结的局限，以较低采样预算显著提升红队攻击效果，为自动化大规模越狱检测提供了更有效且易集成的方案。

title: Investigating Spatiotemporal Redundancy in Video Transformer for Collision Anticipation
summary: In worker-equipment proximity monitoring, video transformers are widely used for collision anticipation and have demonstrated strong performance. However, their accuracy comes with substantial computational demands, creating a tension with the need for low-latency inference on mobile robots and the pursuit of lower-carbon computation in construction. To address this, this study investigates where computation within an established video transformer is redundant and whether that redundancy can be removed without materially degrading predictive performance. Using VideoMAEv2-Base on the Nexar Collision Prediction dataset, we first examine how collision-relevant information evolves across network depth and then investigate two complementary forms of redundancy: structured capacity redundancy in multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) and spatiotemporal redundancy in the token stream. Linear probes show that interpretable motion cues, including flow magnitude, looming, and approach versus retreat, are most accessible at intermediate layers, whereas collision-label discrimination strengthens toward the final layer. Token redundancy is axis-specific: adjacent temporal-token similarity reaches 0.970 in later layers, while spatial similarity falls to 0.297, indicating substantially greater redundancy across time than across space. Exploiting this asymmetry, temporal token merging reduces backbone computation from 356.99 to 178.50 GFLOPs and latency from 12.69 to 7.21 ms per clip, a 1.76x speedup, while mean average precision changes only from 0.7478 to 0.7443. Importance-guided retention of 50% of MLP units preserves an AUC of 0.753, compared with 0.529 under matched random retention, and reveals that pruning alters score calibration before discriminative ranking collapses. These findings establish a new pathway for pursuing faster algorithms through targeted temporal token compression and neuron pruning.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对工人-设备 proximity 监测中视频 Transformer 的高计算开销问题，分析 VideoMAEv2-Base 在碰撞预测任务中的冗余结构，并通过时间 token 合并与 MLP 神经元剪枝实现加速而不显著损失预测性能。
AI.motivation: 视频 Transformer 在碰撞预测中性能强，但计算需求大，与移动机器人低延迟推理及低碳计算需求存在矛盾。因此需要探究模型内部哪些计算是冗余的，以及能否在不显著降低预测性能的前提下移除这些冗余。
AI.method: 使用 VideoMAEv2-Base 在 Nexar Collision Prediction 数据集上开展分析。首先用线性探针考察碰撞相关信息随网络深度的变化；然后研究两类冗余：MLP 中的结构化容量冗余和 token 流中的时空冗余；据此采用时间 token 合并与重要性引导的 MLP 单元保留。
AI.result: 线性探针显示，流幅值、looming、接近/远离等可解释运动线索在中间层最易获取，而碰撞标签判别在最后层增强。Token 冗余具有轴向差异：后层相邻时间 token 相似度达 0.970，空间相似度降至 0.297。时间 token 合并将主干计算从 356.99 GFLOPs 降至 178.50 GFLOPs，延迟从 12.69 ms 降至 7.21 ms，加速 1.76 倍，mAP 仅从 0.7478 变为 0.7443。重要性引导保留 50% MLP 单元时 AUC 为 0.753，而随机保留为 0.529，并表明剪枝先改变分数校准，随后判别排序才崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了通过针对性时间 token 压缩和神经元剪枝来追求更快算法的新路径，说明视频 Transformer 中的时间冗余和 MLP 容量冗余可在较小性能损失下被有效利用。

title: Strong Helps Weak: Directional Cross-Modal Alignment Transfer in Multi-modal LLMs
summary: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong modality understanding by pairing a large language model (LLM) with an encoder for a target modality such as vision, video, or audio. However, improving an MLLM's capability for a given modality typically requires additional training on large modality-specific datasets, incurring substantial data collection and compute costs. Model merging offers an alternative, but it is often infeasible for data-scarce, large per-sample size, or domain-specific modalities (\textit{e.g.}, audio and video), where same-modality model variants are rarely available. In this work, we characterize an intriguing asymmetric phenomenon: merging a well-aligned, data-rich source-modality MLLM into a data-scarce target-modality MLLM substantially improves the target on its own benchmarks. Our theoretical and empirical analyses show that this gain stems from enhanced alignment between modality-specific and textual tokens, induced by the stronger donor modality. Specifically, we derive a mutual-information lower bound that is monotonic in alignment-related quantities and strongly correlated with downstream MLLM performance. Building on this principle, we propose Directional Cross-modal Alignment Transfer (DCAT), a novel framework that transfers textual alignment from a strong, well-aligned source (donor) modality to a weak target (recipient) modality, boosting target-modality performance without further fine-tuning. We further show that the alignment-enhancing objective admits a closed-form weight-space solution computed from only a small calibration set. DCAT outperforms existing model-merging methods, offering an efficient path toward cross-modal alignment transfer. Project page with code is available at \url{https://seohoiki3215.github.io/DCAT_project_page}

AI.tldr: 提出方向性跨模态对齐迁移框架DCAT，无需额外微调即可将数据丰富源模态MLLM的对齐能力迁移至数据稀缺目标模态，提升目标模态性能。
AI.motivation: 提升MLLM某模态能力通常需大量模态特定数据训练，成本高；模型合并方法在数据稀缺、大单样本或领域特定模态（如音频、视频）上不可行，因缺乏同模态变体。
AI.method: 发现非对称现象：将良好对齐的数据丰富源模态MLLM合并进数据稀缺目标模态MLLM可提升目标性能。基于互信息下界（与对齐量单调且与下游性能强相关）分析其机理，提出DCAT，从强对齐源（donor）向弱目标（recipient）迁移文本对齐；目标函数存在闭式权重空间解，仅需小校准集。
AI.result: 理论分析与实验表明增益源于源模态增强的模态-文本token对齐；DCAT优于现有模型合并方法，无需进一步微调即可提升目标模态性能。
AI.conclusion: DCAT提供了一条高效的跨模态对齐迁移路径，为数据稀缺模态的MLLM能力提升提供了新思路。

title: RubricArmor: Adversarial Evolution Improves LLM-Based Rubric Generation
summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) provides interpretable rewards for aligning large language models (LLMs) by evaluating responses against query-specific evaluation criteria. To construct rubrics at scale, a straightforward approach to LLM-based rubric generation is to prompt an LLM to generate a rubric directly from the query. However, rubrics directly generated by LLMs are vulnerable to reward hacking, since omitted or underspecified criteria allow the policy to obtain high rubric rewards with low-quality responses. Existing LLM-based rubric generation methods improve the granularity and coverage of the generated criteria but do not proactively guard against reward hacking. To address this limitation, we propose RubricArmor, an adversarial framework that exposes and mitigates potential reward hacking at the rubric generation stage before it occurs in subsequent RL. Specifically, RubricArmor performs adversarial evolution, in which an attack step and a repair step alternate over multiple rounds. The attack step simulates the reward hacking of the policy by constructing adversarial responses that satisfy the current rubric but fail to properly complete the task. The repair step then revises the rubric to detect the response defects exposed by the attack step while preserving other valid criteria. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RubricArmor outperforms competitive rubric generation baselines and translates into more effective downstream rubric-based RL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RubricArmor，一个对抗式框架，在评分标准（rubric）生成阶段就暴露并缓解潜在的奖励黑客问题，通过攻击与修复交替的对抗演化提升评分标准质量及下游RL效果。
AI.motivation: 基于评分标准的强化学习为LLM对齐提供可解释奖励，但LLM直接生成的评分标准易被奖励黑客利用：遗漏或描述不清的标准使策略能以低质量回答获取高评分。现有方法虽提升标准的粒度与覆盖度，却未主动防范奖励黑客。
AI.method: RubricArmor 采用对抗演化：攻击步骤模拟策略的奖励黑客行为，构造满足当前评分标准但未正确完成任务的对抗性回答；修复步骤据此修订评分标准，使其能识别攻击暴露的缺陷，同时保留其他有效标准。两者多轮交替进行。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 RubricArmor 优于竞争性的评分标准生成基线，并能转化为更有效的下游基于评分标准的强化学习。
AI.conclusion: 在评分标准生成阶段引入对抗式攻防，可提前暴露并缓解奖励黑客，从而生成更稳健的评分标准，提升后续RL对齐效果。

title: Probabilistic Pedestrian Forecasts from a Handheld Phone: World-Frame Heat Maps, Visual-Inertial Height Drift, and Evaluation without Ground Truth
summary: A pedestrian with a phone could be shown where nearby people will be in the next few seconds, if the forecast stays on the ground while the phone moves, is calibrated, and needs only a monocular camera and visual-inertial odometry (VIO). We build and evaluate such a system. People are detected, lifted onto the floor by ray-plane intersection, tracked in a gravity-aligned metric frame, and forecast as per-step probability maps by a small U-Net trained with a negative log-likelihood (NLL) loss on bird's-eye (SDD) and first-person (EgoTraj-Bench) trajectories. On handheld ADVIO recordings, vertical VIO drift and the user's own changes of level silently rescale monocular ground positions (by 87% within 90 s on one clip; on another, all tracks are lost for the last 31% of the clip); keeping the camera's height above the floor constant under a low-pass-filtered altitude avoids this, though it lags on escalators. On the SDD and EgoTraj-Bench test splits, the final forecaster lowers the NLL at 4.8 s by 1.51 and 1.37 nats relative to a fitted constant-velocity Gaussian. Lacking ground truth for people in handheld video, we score forecasts against the tracker's own later raw measurements. In an internally pre-registered evaluation on seven held-out clips, the final forecaster's NLL is lower than the benchmark-fitted baseline's at 1.2, 2.4 and 4.8 s (by 0.17, 0.23 and 0.47 nats; 95% intervals over people exclude zero), but by less than half as much as on the development clips. Exploratory analyses cut both ways: resampling clips instead of people widens the intervals to include zero at 1.2 and 2.4 s, and once both forecasters are recalibrated on the development clips the network is significantly better only at 1.2 s; but two clips run with ADVIO's reference poses favour the network much more when re-run with the phone's own poses. We discuss what such self-consistency scores can and cannot show.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并评估了一套仅用单目相机与视觉惯性里程计的手持设备行人未来位置预测系统：将检测到的行人通过射线-平面交投影到地面、在重力对齐度量坐标系中跟踪，并用小型U-Net输出逐步骤概率图；通过保持相机离地高度恒定避免垂直漂移导致的尺度失真，在公开数据集上显著优于常速高斯基线，但自一致性评估显示实际增益小于开发集且部分分析结论不稳定。
AI.motivation: 手持手机的用户若能预知附近行人未来几秒的位置将很有用，但现有预测通常依赖固定地面视角或多传感器配置。本文希望验证一种"预测保持在地面、手机可自由移动"的设想是否可行：只用单目相机和VIO，且预测在手机运动时仍能校准到地面坐标系。同时，手持视频中缺乏行人真值，如何评估此类系统本身也是待解决问题。
AI.method: 检测行人后通过射线-平面交将其抬升到地面，在重力对齐的度量帧中跟踪；用小型U-Net以负对数似然（NLL）损失在鸟瞰（SDD）和第一人称（EgoTraj-Bench）轨迹上训练，输出逐步概率图作为预测。利用低通滤波后的高度保持相机离地高度恒定，以避免单目地面位置的静默尺度失真。在无真值的手持视频中，用跟踪器自身后续原始测量作为评分依据，并做了内部预注册的留出片段评估与多种探索性分析。
AI.result: 在手持ADVIO录制中，垂直VIO漂移和用户自身的高度变化会静默地重新缩放单目地面位置（某片段90秒内缩放到87%，另一片段最后31%的所有轨迹丢失）；保持相机离地高度恒定可避免此问题，但在自动扶梯上会有滞后。在SDD和EgoTraj-Bench测试集上，最终预测器在4.8秒处相较拟合的常速高斯基线分别降低NLL 1.51和1.37 nats。在七个留出片段的预注册评估中，最终预测器在1.2、2.4和4.8秒处NLL均低于基线（分别低0.17、0.23、0.47 nats，95%区间不含零），但增益不到开发片段的一半。探索性分析结果不一：按片段而非按人重采样会使1.2和2.4秒区间包含零；两个预测器在开发片段上重新校准后，网络只在1.2秒显著更优；但用ADVIO参考位姿的两个片段在改用手机自身位姿重跑后更有利于网络。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭单目相机与VIO、将预测约束在地面并保持相机离地高度恒定的手持行人预测系统在受控数据集上有效，但实际手持场景中的自一致性增益明显弱于开发集，且结论对评估方式（按人还是按片段重采样、是否重新校准、使用参考位姿还是手机位姿）敏感。作者进一步讨论了这类自一致性评分能够和不能够证明什么，强调此类评估的局限。

title: Bounds, Decompositions and Null Behaviour of KRATOS: A Mathematical Specification of a Recognition-Comparability Diagnostic
summary: KRATOS is a group-structured bibliometric diagnostic that compares the distribution of documents (participation) with the distribution of citation weight (recognition) over a fixed, finite universe of analytical groups. This note gives its complete mathematical specification and derives the properties that govern its interpretation. Beyond bounds and equality conditions for each component, we show that the recognition-alignment score depends on citation data only through ratios of group mean citation rates to the corpus mean; that the composition ceiling of the participation--recognition factor is an affine function of the total variation distance to the uniform reference; and that the factor itself satisfies Fréchet-type bounds in terms of this ceiling and a participation-weighted recognition score. We establish an exact logarithmic decomposition of the composite index, an ordering between the primary and a reciprocal-symmetric recognition score, invariance properties, and closed-form first and second moments of the recognition ratios under global and stratified permutation nulls. These results explain why composite orderings can be sensitive to small groups, heavy-tailed citation distributions and metadata reassignment. All results are verified numerically with an accompanying script. The specification concerns measurement structure only; it does not define a measure of epistemic change or justice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KRATOS——一种按分析组划分的组结构文献计量诊断工具，完整给出其数学规范，并推导出支配其解释的各项性质，包括界限、等式条件、Fréchet型界、对数分解、排序关系、不变性以及置换零假设下的矩。
AI.motivation: 现有文献计量指标往往混合参与度与认可度，且其行为对小组、重尾引用分布和元数据重新分配较敏感，缺乏清晰的测量结构说明。本文旨在为一种组结构诊断工具提供完整的数学规范并厘清其可解释性边界。
AI.method: KRATOS在固定的有限组集合上，比较文献分布（参与度）与引用权重分布（认可度）。作者推导各分量的界限与等式条件，证明认可对齐分数仅通过组均引用率与语料均值的比依赖引用数据；给出参与–认可因子构成上限为到均匀参照的总变差距离的仿射函数；推导Fréchet型界；建立复合指数的精确对数分解，给出主认可分数与倒数对称认可分数之间的排序、不变性，以及全局与分层置换零假设下认可比的闭式一阶、二阶矩。
AI.result: 各分量有明确界限与等式条件；认可对齐分数仅通过组均值比依赖引用数据；构成上限是总变差距离的仿射函数；因子满足以该上限和参与加权认可分数表示的Fréchet型界；存在精确对数分解；主分数与倒数对称分数之间有确定排序；获得置换零假设下的一阶、二阶矩闭式解。全部结果经数值脚本验证。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果解释了为何复合排序会对小组、重尾引用分布和元数据重新分配敏感。KRATOS的规范仅涉及测量结构，不构成对认知变迁或正义的度量。

title: Penumbra: Sample-Efficient Adversarial Search for Regulatory Obligations
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems (EvoRobust) at NeurIPS 2026. Workshop papers are non-archival. 12 pages (4 content pages plus references and appendices)
summary: Agents are entering finance, healthcare and law, sectors where a violation leaves no lexical signature and carries real penalties. Whether an omission is material, or a disclosure sufficient, depends on what the response left out. Probing such an obligation means finding responses one minimal edit from flipping compliance, and every probe costs a generation and two adjudications, so the binding constraint on regulatory red-teaming is sample efficiency, not volume. We introduce Penumbra, an adversarial search that walks from a verified anchor under an expanding edit budget until a two-evaluator committee changes its verdict, and emits the two adjacent responses that straddle the change. Allocation is adaptive, and the objective is coverage of the defeat surface: distinct (obligation x defeat mode) cells resolved per candidate.
