During stochastic rendering, our history-based spatial resampling scheme drastically accelerates image convergence, while temporal importance resampling ensures coherence under camera movement. During training, a color regularizer implicitly reduces the variance along view rays in the 3DGS models. With these properties, our optimized, Vulkan-based renderer effectively mitigates output noise at low and high sample counts, achieving a substantial 13~dB PSNR increase in quality over previous stochastic methods at 1 sample per pixel and quickly converging to sorted 3DGS with an average L1 error of less than $10^{-4}$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于随机顺序无关透明渲染的方法，通过空间重采样、时间重要性重采样和颜色正则化，显著降低3D高斯泼溅渲染的噪声并加速收敛。
AI.motivation: 随机顺序无关透明渲染能高效渲染3D高斯泼溅等模型，但输出存在明显的高频噪声，导致其实用性受限。作者希望从表示和图像合成两个层面解决噪声来源问题。
AI.method: 1）渲染时采用基于历史的空域重采样加速图像收敛；2）采用时间重要性重采样保证相机运动下的时序一致性；3）训练时引入颜色正则化项，隐式降低3DGS模型沿视线的方差；4）实现基于Vulkan的优化渲染器。
AI.result: 在1样本每像素下，相比先前随机方法PSNR提升约13 dB；可快速收敛到排序3DGS，平均L1误差低于1e-4；在低和高采样数下均能有效抑制噪声。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过对表示与合成层面的噪声抑制，使随机顺序无关透明渲染在质量和效率上接近排序3DGS，提升了其实用性。

title: MESH-Harness: Self-Improving Agent Harnesses via Bandit-Guided Compositional Evolution
summary: An agent harness is the code that organizes context, maintains state, and coordinates tool calls for a language model. We study how to improve the harness under a limited evaluation budget while keeping model weights fixed. Our method, MESH-Harness, organizes each harness into functional modules with explicit role-specific interfaces, allowing alternative implementations of each module to be substituted and recombined. It uses shared module representations and full-covariance LinUCB to score candidate combinations based on predicted performance and exploration value. Mixed-start coordinate ascent selects complete configurations for evaluation without enumerating the combinatorial space. Validation traces then guide local code edits, and the resulting candidates are incorporated into fixed-capacity role-specific pools for subsequent recombination. On text tasks, retrieval-augmented mathematical reasoning, code generation, and interactive scientific tasks, MESH-Harness outperforms Meta-Harness by 5.70, 7.01, 2.00, and 5.00 points, respectively, under matched candidate-evaluation budgets. Iterative harness optimization improves MESH-Harness by 5.63-7.79 points over its first-round configurations. For the reported configurations, aggregate test-time cost is 44.2% lower than that of Meta-Harness, while total cost including search is 14.6% lower. These results show that combining module-level design reuse with feedback-driven compositional search can systematically improve agent harnesses while keeping overall optimization cost under control.

AI.tldr: MESH-Harness通过模块化设计与反馈驱动的组合搜索，在固定模型权重和有限评估预算下系统化优化智能体harness。
AI.motivation: 智能体harness负责组织上下文、维护状态和协调工具调用。研究希望在模型权重固定的前提下，用有限的评估预算改进harness。
AI.method: 将harness组织为具有明确角色接口的功能模块，允许模块的替代实现被替换与重组；使用共享模块表示和全协方差LinUCB对候选组合打分；采用混合起点坐标上升选择完整配置；再用验证轨迹指导局部代码编辑，并将候选纳入固定容量的角色专属池中进行后续重组。
AI.result: 在文本任务、检索增强数学推理、代码生成和交互式科学任务上，MESH-Harness在匹配候选评估预算下分别比Meta-Harness高出5.70、7.01、2.00和5.00分；迭代优化使其较首轮配置提升5.63–7.79分；报告配置的聚合测试时成本比Meta-Harness低44.2%，含搜索的总成本低14.6%。
AI.conclusion: 模块级设计复用与反馈驱动的组合搜索相结合，可在控制总体优化成本的同时系统化改进智能体harness。

title: ufakzeka-karar: An Open Turkish Typed-Decision Model with Order-Invariant Option Scoring
comment: 9 pages (text on pages 1 to 8, references on pages 8 and 9). Model, code, benchmark and demo: https://huggingface.co/ufakai/ufakzeka-karar, https://github.com/ufakai/ufakzeka-karar, https://huggingface.co/datasets/ufakai/HakemBench, https://karar.ufakzeka.com
summary: ufakzeka-karar is an open Turkish decision model with 182,494,466 parameters. Given a Turkish text and questions of a fixed answer type (a choice, a level on an ordered scale, or yes or no), it returns a temperature-scaled probability for every option and an expected error that serves as a "not sure" signal, without generating text and in one CPU forward pass for up to ten options. Built on the lab's ufakzeka-1-base, its head scores each option blind to the others at shared positions, so the answer does not depend on option order. A sequential head trained with shuffled options was about as accurate but changed 2.3 to 2.8 percent of its answers when only the option order changed; REINFORCE lost 10.2 points (0.102) of macro F1 to cross-entropy. On the open set of HakemBench v1.0 (4,275 questions, 7 tracks) the released model ranks 7th of 16 rows with a composite of 0.660 (95% interval 0.642 to 0.677). Temperature scaling lowers calibration error (smooth ECE) on the development set but raises it on held-out support questions, from 0.027 to 0.045 for the first scored run, which never trained on them; the released model later trained on them, so its 0.036 to 0.064 is not an unseen-question test. The released model is the last of three runs scored on HakemBench, and its numbers are not blind. The second run's new training data was aimed at the first run's errors on the full test set in guardrails, moderation and customer support, and the released run was trained after the second run's guardrail results on the full test set were read, under a protocol fixed in writing before any of its data, code or runs. All its numbers come after these readings; its guardrail, moderation and customer support numbers carry the flag "shaped by reading the test results". With every model scored on the other four tracks only, its composite is 0.678, 6th of 16. Weights and code are under Apache-2.0.

AI.tldr: ufakzeka-karar 是一个 18.2 亿参数的开放土耳其语决策模型，对固定答案类型的问题输出温度缩放概率与"不确定"信号，单次 CPU 前向即可处理最多十个选项，在 HakemBench v1.0 上排名 7/16（综合分 0.660），但部分赛道成绩受测试集读取影响。
AI.motivation: 土耳其语缺乏开放、可审计的决策/评分模型；作者希望构建一个不生成文本、答案与选项顺序无关、并能给出"不确定"信号的判别式模型，同时公开说明其评测过程中的数据泄露与测试集读取问题。
AI.method: 基于 ufakzeka-1-base 训练 182,494,466 参数模型；对每个选项在共享位置独立盲打分（不依赖选项顺序），输出温度缩放概率和期望误差作为"不确定"信号；采用交叉熵训练，并对比了顺序头、打乱选项训练与 REINFORCE 方案。评估使用 HakemBench v1.0（4,275 题、7 个赛道）。
AI.result: HakemBench v1.0 上发布模型综合分 0.660（95% 区间 0.642–0.677），16 行中排第 7；仅按其余四赛道计分时综合分 0.678，排第 6。顺序头精度相近但换序会改变 2.3%–2.8% 答案；REINFORCE 相较交叉熵损失 10.2 个点的宏 F1。温度缩放降低开发集平滑 ECE，但在留出题上从 0.027 升至 0.045；发布模型因在留出题上训练过，其 0.036–0.064 不构成未见题检验。
AI.conclusion: 模型以 Apache-2.0 开源权重与代码，具备顺序无关与单次 CPU 推理的实用优势；但其 HakemBench 数字并非盲测，guardrail、moderation 与客户支持三项成绩带有"受读取测试结果影响"的标记，评测协议的透明披露是该工作的重要部分。

title: Generating the Wild: Individual-Consistent Image-to-Video Generation for Wildlife
summary: Individual-level wildlife identification often suffers from data scarcity, as varying observations of the same animal under diverse poses, viewpoints, and motions are rarely available. Image-to-video (I2V) generation offers a promising way to mitigate this limitation by synthesizing additional observations from a single reference image. However, existing I2V models mainly emphasize global layout, semantics, and motion, and therefore often fail to preserve fine-grained local appearance cues that distinguish one wildlife individual from another, such as fur texture, stripe boundaries, spot configurations, and contour transitions. We observe that these identity-critical cues are closely related to high-frequency information. To address this challenge, we propose WildIcon, a high-frequency-guided I2V framework for wildlife individual consistency. Specifically, WildIcon introduces a frequency-aware identity encoding branch that extracts individual-specific high-frequency cues from the reference image. Combined with isolated foreground information, the resulting identity tokens are then injected into cross-attention blocks as identity conditioning. Building on a frozen backbone with lightweight identity adaptation, WildIcon preserves fine-grained identity cues visible in the reference image while retaining the motion controllability and semantic fidelity of the base I2V model. In addition, to support the training and evaluation of wildlife individual-consistent I2V, we construct WildlifeVid, a wildlife-centric video dataset with high-quality, temporally coherent clips and individual-level identity labels. Experiments on I2V generation and downstream animal re-identification (ReID) show that WildIcon achieves stronger individual consistency than existing baselines, and that its filtered outputs can serve as useful candidate training augmentations for downstream ReID.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WildIcon，一种高频引导的图像到视频生成框架，用于野生动物个体一致性识别，并构建WildlifeVid数据集。
AI.motivation: 野生动物个体识别常受数据稀缺困扰，同一动物在多样姿态、视角和运动下的观测难以获取；现有I2V模型偏重全局布局与语义，难以保留区分个体的细粒度局部外观线索（毛发纹理、条纹边界、斑点分布、轮廓过渡），而这些线索与高频信息密切相关。
AI.method: 提出WildIcon高频引导I2V框架：引入频率感知的身份编码分支，从参考图像提取个体特定高频线索，结合孤立前景信息生成身份token，并注入交叉注意力块作为身份条件；基于冻结骨干网络进行轻量身份适配，在保留细粒度身份线索的同时维持基础I2V模型的运动可控性与语义保真度；构建WildlifeVid野生动物视频数据集，含高质量时序连贯片段与个体级身份标签。
AI.result: 在I2V生成与下游动物再识别（ReID）实验中，WildIcon相比现有基线实现更强的个体一致性，其筛选后的输出可作为下游ReID的有效候选训练增强数据。
AI.conclusion: 高频引导的身份条件注入与轻量适配可在不牺牲运动与语义能力的前提下提升野生动物个体一致性，并为下游ReID提供数据增强支持。

title: AgentDiscover: Autonomous Discovery with Minimal Search Scaffolding
summary: Frameworks that use large language models for scientific discovery typically rely on a fixed, human-designed algorithm that decides what the model sees at each step, leaving the model only the role of proposer. The model knows nothing of the search beyond what it is shown. As models grow more capable, a question arises: does a search strategy chosen by a human before the run scale better than promoting the model from proposer to planner and letting it own the search? The Bitter Lesson suggests that choosing the strategy in advance is the kind of hand-designed structure that general methods eventually outscale. We introduce AgentDiscover, in which a coding agent plans the search using its context as working memory, runs experiments, and records every attempt in a database of ideas, candidates, and their relations. This database serves as the agent's long-term memory and is structured so that the selection rules of classical algorithms such as MAP-Elites and Monte Carlo tree search each reduce to a single query, which the agent is free to use, combine, or replace. A server maintains the database and steers the agent after every submission, keeping it on course over long runs. In our experiments, AgentDiscover is more cost-efficient than existing frameworks, reaching better scores at lower cost. On tasks in kernel engineering, biology, algorithm design, and mathematics, AgentDiscover outperforms prior discovery frameworks. Its programs would have placed first among human competitors in seven past AtCoder heuristic contests, and on eleven mathematical and systems optimization tasks it matches or exceeds every baseline that uses the same model. Our code is available at https://github.com/mhdfb/AgentDiscover.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgentDiscover，将大模型从"提议者"提升为"规划者"，用结构化数据库作为长期记忆，让搜索策略可查询、可组合、可替换，在多项发现任务上更省成本且性能更优。
AI.motivation: 现有科学发现框架依赖人类预先设计的固定搜索算法，模型只负责提议，无法得知展示内容之外的搜索全貌。随着模型能力提升，需检验：预先人类设定的搜索策略是否优于让模型自己主导搜索。受 Bitter Lesson 启发，手工设计结构终将被通用方法超越。
AI.method: AgentDiscover 让编码智能体以自身上下文为工作记忆来规划搜索、运行实验，并把每次尝试记录进一个由想法、候选及关系构成的数据库。该数据库作为长期记忆，结构上使 MAP-Elites、蒙特卡洛树搜索等经典算法的选择规则都归约为单条查询，智能体可自由使用、组合或替换。服务器维护数据库并在每次提交后引导智能体，保证长程运行不偏航。
AI.result: 相比现有框架更具成本效益，以更低成本达到更好分数。在内核工程、生物、算法设计与数学任务上优于既有发现框架；其程序在七个往届 AtCoder 启发式竞赛中可位列人类选手第一，在十一个数学与系统优化任务上持平或超越使用相同模型的所有基线。
AI.conclusion: 把搜索主导权交给模型本身（提议者升级为规划者），并辅以结构化长期记忆与服务端引导，是一条比固定人工算法更可扩展、更高效的发现框架路径。代码已开源。

title: Balancing Memory Pathways: Analyzing and Improving Memory Utilization in Hybrid LMs
summary: Recurrent-attention hybrid language models (LMs), which interleave attention and recurrent layers, are increasingly used to combine the efficiency of the recurrent layers with the strong performance of attention layers. Prior work suggests that attention and recurrent layers offer complementary pathways to use past information: attention supports precise memory recall from earlier tokens, while recurrent layers support consolidation of disparate information over long contexts. However, we observe that simply having access to both pathways does not mean that hybrid LMs are effectively using them. We find that they rely substantially more on attention than on the recurrent state. Standard supervised fine-tuning improves overall performance but does not improve how the two memory pathways are coordinated: the model becomes more reliant on information propagated by attention layers, while its use of information propagated by recurrent layers remains limited. To encourage better coordination between the two memory pathways, we add an auxiliary loss that limits attention's access to earlier context while the recurrent state propagates through the full sequence. This objective encourages the model to retain and use information through the recurrent pathway alongside attention. It improves overall performance, with particularly strong gains on tasks involving longer contexts or requiring information aggregation, consistent with the strengths of recurrent layers observed in analysis. Crucially, this imbalance and the benefit of our auxiliary loss generalize: they apply to multiple recurrent-attention LMs in question-answering and agentic tasks, as well as to attention-based LMs that combine different forms of memory. Together, our findings show that simply providing multiple memory pathways does not ensure their effective use, and that targeted supervision is needed to better coordinate them.

AI.tldr: 递归-注意力混合语言模型虽同时具备两条记忆通路，但实际更依赖注意力而非递归状态；作者提出辅助损失限制注意力对早期上下文的访问，促使模型同时利用递归通路，从而提升整体性能，尤其在长上下文与信息聚合任务上。
AI.motivation: 混合语言模型结合了递归层的高效性与注意力层的强性能，先前研究认为注意力擅长精确回忆早期词元，而递归层擅长在长上下文中整合零散信息，二者互补。但作者观察到，简单地同时提供两条记忆通路并不意味着模型会有效利用它们——模型实际上更依赖注意力，标准监督微调虽提升整体性能，却使模型更依赖注意力传播的信息，对递归通路的利用仍然有限。因此需要更好的机制来协调两条记忆通路。
AI.method: 作者提出一个辅助损失：在递归状态传播整个序列的同时，限制注意力对早期上下文的访问。该目标鼓励模型在依赖注意力的同时，也通过递归通路保留和使用信息，从而促进两条记忆通路的协调使用。
AI.result: 该方法提升了整体性能，在涉及更长上下文或需要信息聚合的任务上增益尤为显著，这与分析中观察到的递归层优势一致。此外，这种失衡现象及辅助损失的收益具有泛化性：适用于问答与智能体任务中的多种递归-注意力LM，也适用于结合不同记忆形式的基于注意力的LM。
AI.conclusion: 仅提供多条记忆通路并不能保证其被有效利用，需要有针对性的监督来更好地协调这些通路。

title: EchoDino: A pediatric foundation model for transferable echocardiographic analysis across the lifespan
summary: Echocardiography is the most widely used cardiac imaging modality, yet interpretation demands integrating visual evidence across global anatomy, localized structures and dynamic cardiac motion. Machine-learning models have automated individual tasks, but they are typically built for a single purpose and depend on expensively labeled datasets - a barrier particularly acute in pediatric care, where data are scarce and anatomy changes with age. Here we present EchoDino, a self-supervised foundation model for echocardiography, created by adapting the DINOv3 framework to 3.7 million frames from 1.7 million unlabeled pediatric echocardiography videos. With its encoder frozen, EchoDino produces representations that capture global context, local anatomy, and dense spatial detail. We introduce Motion-biased Entropy Maximization Sampling (MEMS) to select the most informative frames for video-level analysis. Across nine pediatric and adult datasets, EchoDino outperformed strong baseline models, raising view-classification accuracy from 0.609 to 0.889 and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve for structural-heart-disease detection from 0.811 to 0.872, while also cutting age-estimation error from 3.857 to 1.389 years, achieving the best segmentation accuracy and lowering ejection-fraction errors. By generalizing from label-free pediatric data to adult echocardiography, EchoDino offers a versatile foundation for cardiac image analysis across the lifespan.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出EchoDino——一个基于DINOv3框架、利用170万段儿童超声心动图视频（370万帧）自监督训练的心脏超声基础模型，并引入MEMS采样策略，在多个儿童与成人数据集上超越强基线，实现跨年龄段的通用心脏影像分析。
AI.motivation: 超声心动图是应用最广泛的心脏成像方式，但其解读需综合全局解剖、局部结构与动态运动信息。现有机器学习模型多针对单一任务，且依赖昂贵标注数据；在儿科场景中，数据稀缺、解剖结构随年龄变化，这一问题尤为突出。
AI.method: 将DINOv3框架适配到170万段无标注儿童超声心动图视频的370万帧上，构建自监督基础模型EchoDino；冻结编码器即可获得捕捉全局上下文、局部解剖与密集空间细节的表征；并提出运动偏置熵最大化采样（MEMS）以筛选信息量最大的帧用于视频级分析。
AI.result: 在九个儿童与成人数据集上，EchoDino优于强基线：视图分类准确率由0.609提升至0.889，结构性心脏病检测AUC由0.811提升至0.872，年龄估计误差由3.857年降至1.389年，并取得最佳分割精度、降低射血分数误差。
AI.conclusion: EchoDino能够从无标注儿童数据泛化到成人超声心动图，为覆盖全生命周期的通用心脏影像分析提供了基础模型。

title: EnGRICH: Enhancing Generative Reward Modeling with Critiques from Humans
summary: Generative reward models (GRMs) are important for LLM optimization. Unlike scalar reward models, GRMs generate natural-language critiques alongside preference judgments, providing finer-grained evaluation signals. Their effectiveness depends heavily on critique reliability. However, existing GRM training typically uses final preference correctness as outcome supervision. Because the preference outcome space is highly constrained, unreliable critiques can still yield correct outcomes and thus be reinforced. Recent work leverages human critiques for process supervision, but such critiques are scarce and are often reduced to scalar rewards, leaving their fine-grained evaluative information underutilized. We argue that evaluative criteria learned from human critiques can be generalized to broader outcome-only preference data. To this end, we propose \textbf{EnGRICH}, a GRM training framework that pairs the GRM with a training-time MetaCritic learned from a small set of human critiques. MetaCritic constructs response-specific rubrics and uses them to evaluate the evidence coverage and correctness of generated critiques. The resulting signals provide both process rewards for fine-grained credit assignment and structured guidance for exploring better critiques. During GRM training, MetaCritic is further optimized to generalize human-grounded evaluative criteria to outcome-only data. At inference, the trained GRM operates independently. Experiments across seven reward-model benchmarks show that EnGRICH consistently improves over competitive baselines, while further analyses validate the effectiveness of its core mechanisms.

AI.tldr: EnGRICH是一个将元评论器（MetaCritic）与生成式奖励模型（GRM）配对训练的框架，用少量人类评论学到的评价标准来监督和引导GRM生成更可靠的评论，在七个基准上优于竞争基线。
AI.motivation: GRM的效果高度依赖评论可靠性，但现有训练多用最终偏好结果作为监督信号；由于偏好结果空间高度受限，不可靠的评论也可能得到正确结果从而被强化。近期用人类评论做过程监督的工作，其评论稀缺且常被简化为标量奖励，细粒度评价信息未被充分利用。作者认为，从人类评论中学到的评价标准可以泛化到更广泛的结果型偏好数据。
AI.method: 提出EnGRICH训练框架：为GRM配一个训练时的MetaCritic，该元评论器从少量人类评论中学习。MetaCritic为每个回答构建特定评分标准（rubric），据此评估生成评论的证据覆盖度与正确性，提供过程奖励用于细粒度信用分配，并结构化引导GRM探索更好的评论。训练中MetaCritic进一步优化，以把有据可依的人类评价标准泛化到仅有结果的数据。推理阶段GRM独立运行。
AI.result: 在七个奖励模型基准上的实验表明，EnGRICH一致优于竞争基线，进一步的分析验证了其核心机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入可泛化的人类评价标准过程监督，EnGRICH有效提升了生成式奖励模型的评论可靠性，且推理时无需额外组件。

title: IdeaLens: Detecting AI Ideas in Long-form Writing
comment: 53 pages (9 main), 7 figures, 50 tables. Code: https://github.com/RishanthRajendhran/IdeaLens Models and data: https://huggingface.co/collections/rishanthrajendhran/idealens-6abee785ce6196fc0be9200f Demo: http://ideadetector.ai/
summary: While modern AI detectors identify who wrote the words, emerging policies on AI use increasingly hinge on a different question: who came up with the ideas? We introduce IdeaLens, a detector that identifies whether a document's ideas came from a human or AI (idea provenance), regardless of who wrote its words. To focus IdeaLens on ideas rather than prose, we represent documents as outlines: lists of items that each pair a discourse role with a brief, paraphrased description of the content, minimizing word-level overlap with the raw text. We train IdeaLens on 1M FineWeb documents with silver labels from Pangram, a prose provenance detector. Since the outlines are largely stripped of surface-level information, the labels must be fit mainly through the ideas. In a controlled study, IdeaLens's AI flag rate drops from 95% to 7% as models write from increasingly detailed human plans, while Pangram 4 still flags 92%; from AI-derived plans, IdeaLens stays above 96%. Conversely, on a new dataset of 50 stories that human authors wrote from AI-generated plans, IdeaLens flags 68% of the stories as AI, compared to 8% for Pangram 4. On a comprehensive suite of 19 existing detection benchmarks, we show that IdeaLens maintains strong detection rates at low false positive rates, suggesting that ideas themselves provide a powerful discriminative signal, and its performance holds across domains, formats, and languages. Finally, we examine 90K predictions from IdeaLens to characterize systematic differences between human and AI ideation. We release our models and labeled datasets to facilitate future research on idea provenance detection.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 IdeaLens，一个识别文档"思想来源"（人类还是 AI 构思）的检测器，独立于文字由谁撰写。它将文档表示为大纲（话语角色+内容简述）以剥离表层措辞，并用 100 万 FineWeb 文档及 silver 标签训练。实验表明其能有效区分人类与 AI 构思，并揭示两者构思的系统性差异。
AI.motivation: 现代 AI 检测器主要判断"谁写了文字"，但新兴 AI 使用政策更关注"谁提出了想法"。现有检测方法聚焦于文本表层特征，无法有效解决思想来源（idea provenance）问题。
AI.method: 将文档表示为大纲（大纲项=话语角色+内容简述的改写），以最小化与原文的词级重叠，使模型聚焦于思想而非文风；利用 Pangram（散文来源检测器）为 100 万 FineWeb 文档生成 silver 标签进行训练；并通过受控研究与新数据集（人类依据 AI 计划写作的故事）进行验证。
AI.result: 受控研究中，随人类计划细化，IdeaLens 的 AI 标记率从 95% 降至 7%，而 Pangram 4 仍标记 92%；对 AI 生成计划，IdeaLens 保持在 96% 以上。在 50 篇人类依据 AI 计划写作的故事上，IdeaLens 标记 68% 为 AI，Pangram 4 仅 8%。在 19 个现有检测基准上，IdeaLens 在低误报率下保持强检测率，并跨领域、格式和语言稳健。
AI.conclusion: 思想本身提供了强大的判别信号，可用于思想来源检测；通过对 9 万条预测的分析刻画了人类与 AI 构思的系统性差异；论文公开模型与标注数据集以推动后续研究。

title: Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation
comment: Technical report on the open-source T2AV model. GitHub: https://github.com/kandinskylab/kandinsky-6
summary: We present Kandinsky 6.0 Video, a family of foundation diffusion models for synchronized text-to-audio-video generation, comprising Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite (3B parameters) and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro (29B parameters). Both models generate 5-second video clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio, including lip-sync, in text-to-audio-video (T2AV) and image-to-audio-video (I2AV) modes; a built-in super-resolution model raises the output resolution to Full-HD (1920$\times$1080). Building on the video generation capabilities of Kandinsky 5.0, Kandinsky 6.0 Video employs a dual-stream CrossDiT architecture that connects a pretrained video stream and a newly trained audio stream through bidirectional cross-attention for temporal and semantic alignment. Our continuous pretraining strategy first trains the audio stream from scratch on large-scale audio corpora and then trains both streams jointly on paired audio-video data while preserving unimodal fidelity; pretraining is followed by supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement-learning-based post-training, and distillation. In side-by-side human evaluation, Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro clearly outperforms its predecessor, Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro, and remains competitive with leading audio-video generation models, particularly in speech quality. To accelerate open research and deployment in multimedia generation, we release the code, model checkpoints, and diffusers integration under the MIT license.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Kandinsky 6.0 Video 系列音视频同步生成基础扩散模型（Lite 3B 与 Pro 29B），支持 T2AV/I2AV 生成 5 秒 44kHz 同步音频视频，并可超分至 Full-HD，通过双流 CrossDiT 架构与连续预训练策略实现性能提升并开源。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型多以单模态为主，缺乏高质量、音频与视频在时间与语义上同步的联合生成能力；同时高质量音视频生成模型多未开源，限制了多媒体生成领域的开放研究与部署。因此作者希望构建一个兼具同步音频、高清输出与开源特性的音视频生成模型家族。
AI.method: 基于 Kandinsky 5.0 的视频生成能力，采用双流 CrossDiT 架构，将预训练视频流与新训练音频流通过双向交叉注意力连接以实现时序与语义对齐。训练采用连续预训练策略：先在大型音频语料上从零训练音频流，再在配对音视频数据上联合训练两个流并保持单模态保真度；后续依次进行监督微调、基于强化学习的后训练与蒸馏。内置超分模型将输出提升至 1920×1080。
AI.result: 模型可生成 5 秒、44kHz 同步音频（含唇形同步）的视频，支持 T2AV 与 I2AV 模式；超分后达 Full-HD。在人工并排评测中，Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro 明显优于前代 Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro，并与领先的音视频生成模型保持竞争力，尤其在语音质量方面表现突出。
AI.conclusion: Kandinsky 6.0 Video 通过双流 CrossDiT 架构与连续预训练、后训练及蒸馏流程，实现了高质量同步音视频生成，并在人评中验证了其相对前代与同类领先模型的竞争力。作者以 MIT 许可证开源代码、模型权重及 diffusers 集成，以促进多媒体生成领域的开放研究与部署。

title: Learning Field Reconstruction from Incomplete Data by Globally Correcting Local Estimates
summary: Reconstructing physical fields from training samples that are always incomplete requires learning spatial structure from fragmented observations.Existing context--query work establishes how held-out observations provide valid training targets, but this does not make the complete-field distribution identifiable when every training field is incomplete.With finite data, weak evidence of sharp transitions and localized variations can further favor averaged predictions that attenuate local detail.A structural prior is therefore needed to favor plausible completions; local spatial relationships offer one grounded in the observations.We propose a locally constructed, globally revisable estimator that explicitly learns local field estimates and subsequently corrects them using full-domain observations.A shared coordinate-conditioned predictor learns from incomplete patches, allowing relatively well-observed neighborhoods to provide direct supervision of local structure.Its overlapping predictions are reconciled into an observation-conditioned consensus field.A full-domain estimator retains the original observations and learns a residual correction around this frozen field estimate, allowing locally constructed structure to be revised by broader evidence.The local estimate serves as both an explicit input, accompanied by its discrepancies with the observations, and a prediction starting point that the global model can revise.On three real-world ocean datasets with authentic observation gaps, our estimator achieves the lowest MSE and highest PSNR on withheld source-supported values, reducing MSE by 28.9\%--34.5\% against the strongest external baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对训练样本始终不完整、难以重建完整物理场的问题，提出一种“局部构建、全局修正”的估计器，先在局部学习场估计，再用全域观测对其进行残差修正，在三个真实海洋数据集上取得最低MSE和最高PSNR。
AI.motivation: 现有context-query方法虽能利用留出观测提供训练目标，但当每个训练场都不完整时，完整场分布不可辨识；有限数据下，尖锐过渡与局部变化的弱证据会偏向平均化预测，抹平局部细节。因此需要一种基于观测的局部空间关系结构先验，来引导合理的场补全。
AI.method: 提出局部构建、全局可修正的估计器：共享的坐标条件预测器在不完整patch上学习局部场估计，将重叠预测整合为受观测约束的一致性场；随后冻结该局部场估计，由全域估计器保留原始观测并在其周围学习残差修正，使局部结构可被更广证据修正。局部估计既作为显式输入（连同与观测的差异）也作为预测起点。
AI.result: 在三个具有真实观测缺口的真实海洋数据集上，该方法在留出的有源支撑值上取得最低MSE和最高PSNR，相较最强外部基线MSE降低28.9%–34.5%。
AI.conclusion: 局部构建的估计结合全局残差修正，可有效缓解不完整训练数据导致的分布不可辨识与细节衰减问题，在真实缺测场景下显著优于现有基线。

title: T-Search: An Open Agentic Retriever and Playground for Hard Multi-Step Search
summary: We present T-Search, an open-weight agentic retriever for hard multi-step search. Given a question and a search tool over a fixed corpus, it runs a bounded multi-round search and returns a ranked list of evidence chunks with short justifications, leaving answer generation to a downstream model, so backend and generator can be swapped without retraining. T-Search is built on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and trained on adversarially filtered synthetic search tasks with round-sliced supervised fine-tuning followed by GSPO on a recall reward. Averaged over seven English and Russian benchmarks with gold evidence annotations, it reaches 56.0 Recall@10 with one rollout, 14.4 points above its base, and 61.3 with three fused rollouts, outperforming larger open models. We release the model, harness, live demo, and three benchmarks, including TRuST, the first native-Russian hard-search benchmark.

AI.tldr: T-Search是一个开源权重的智能体检索器，面向困难多步搜索任务，通过多轮搜索返回带简要理由的证据块排名列表，将答案生成留给下游模型。
AI.motivation: 困难多步搜索需要多轮检索与证据整合，且希望检索后端与生成模型可灵活替换而不需重新训练。
AI.method: 基于Qwen3.6-35B-A3B构建，在对抗性过滤的合成搜索任务上训练，采用按轮切片的监督微调，随后用GSPO在召回奖励上优化。
AI.result: 在七个英俄基准上平均达到56.0 Recall@10（单次 rollout，比基座高14.4点），三次融合 rollout 达61.3，超过更大的开源模型。
AI.conclusion: T-Search提供可解耦的高性能多步检索方案，并开源模型、框架、演示及三个基准（含首个原生俄语困难搜索基准TRuST）。

title: StageVLN: Spatial and Trajectory Auxiliary Guidance for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) policies increasingly benefit from strong semantic priors provided by large vision-language models (VLMs). However, standard action supervision does not explicitly encourage intermediate representations to preserve scene geometry, relative orientation, or global episode progress. Incorporating depth estimators, explicit maps, point clouds, or geometry foundation models at inference can provide such structure but introduces additional computation, memory overhead, and architectural dependence during deployment. We introduce StageVLN, a training framework that shapes navigation representations through privileged spatial and trajectory guidance while preserving the original inference pathway. A frozen geometry foundation model provides multi-level spatial guidance to hierarchical navigator states, while relative-heading and expert-route progress objectives provide complementary trajectory-state supervision. All auxiliary components are used only during training and removed at deployment. On R2R-CE validation-unseen, StageVLN achieves 56.3\% SR and 51.4\% SPL with a 4B-parameter backbone, without an additional geometry encoder at inference. On RxR-CE, it achieves 54.3\% SR without additional navigation training data or a geometry encoder at inference.

AI.tldr: StageVLN是一个训练框架，通过特权空间与轨迹引导塑造导航表征，推理时移除所有辅助组件，在R2R-CE上以4B骨干达到56.3% SR和51.4% SPL。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言导航（VLN）策略日益依赖大型视觉语言模型（VLM）提供的强语义先验，但标准动作监督并未显式鼓励中间表征保留场景几何、相对朝向或全局episode进度。若在推理阶段引入深度估计器、显式地图、点云或几何基础模型可提供此类结构，却会带来额外计算、内存开销与架构依赖。
AI.method: 提出StageVLN训练框架：由冻结的几何基础模型为分层导航器状态提供多层级空间引导；同时采用相对朝向与专家路线进度目标提供互补的轨迹状态监督。所有辅助组件仅在训练时使用，部署时全部移除，保持原始推理路径不变。
AI.result: 在R2R-CE验证未见集上，使用4B参数骨干取得56.3% SR与51.4% SPL，且推理时无需额外几何编码器；在RxR-CE上取得54.3% SR，且无需额外导航训练数据或推理期几何编码器。
AI.conclusion: 通过仅在训练阶段引入特权空间与轨迹监督，可在不改变推理架构、不增加部署开销的前提下显著提升VLN性能，验证了训练时引导、推理时轻量化的有效性。

title: Sibyl: An Efficient Small-large Model Collaboration Framework for Long-horizon Tasks
summary: Small language models (SLMs) offer a promising foundation for on-device agents through low-latency, resource-efficient inference, yet limited reasoning and planning capabilities constrain their performance on long-horizon tasks requiring multi-step interaction with the environment. Step-level collaboration between SLMs and larger cloud-hosted models can bridge this gap, but identifying states that warrant cloud assistance remains challenging: the contribution of each cloud call is entangled with subsequent actions and can be assessed only from the final task outcome. Compounding this challenge, the SLM must balance two competing objectives: maximizing task success and minimizing cloud calls. To address this, we propose Sibyl, an algorithm that trains SLM agents to selectively consult cloud models at the step level and internalize their guidance for subsequent decisions, achieving strong task performance with minimal cloud reliance. Sibyl follows a three-stage training pipeline that (1) builds a robust base policy through consultation-free self-evolving reinforcement learning (RL); (2) cold-starts consultation behavior via decisive-disagreement state mining; and (3) jointly optimizes consultation decisions and guidance internalization through consultation-aware RL. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate that Sibyl, using only a 0.6B-parameter model, outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, including agent training and routing methods, by 95.2% and 80.4% in success rate while averaging only 0.8 and 3.9 cloud calls per trajectory, respectively.

AI.tldr: Sibyl通过三阶段训练让小规模语言模型智能体在长视野任务中选择性地向云端大模型求助，并以极少云端调用实现高成功率。
AI.motivation: 小型语言模型适合端侧部署，但推理与规划能力有限，难以完成需要多步与环境交互的长视野任务。步骤级地向云端大模型求助可弥补差距，但难点在于：如何判断哪些状态值得求助，因为单次云端调用的价值与后续动作纠缠，只能从最终任务结果评估；同时智能体还需权衡"最大化成功率"与"最小化云端调用"两个冲突目标。
AI.method: 提出Sibyl算法，训练SLM智能体在步骤级别选择性地咨询云端模型，并将云端指导内化以用于后续决策。采用三阶段训练流程：(1) 通过无咨询的自进化强化学习构建稳健的基础策略；(2) 通过"决定性分歧"状态挖掘对咨询行为进行冷启动；(3) 通过咨询感知强化学习联合优化咨询决策与指导内化。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上，仅使用0.6B参数的模型，Sibyl在成功率上比最先进基线（包括智能体训练与路由方法）分别高出95.2%和80.4%，同时每条轨迹平均仅需0.8次和3.9次云端调用。
AI.conclusion: Sibyl表明，通过步骤级选择性咨询与指导内化的训练，小模型智能体能够以极低的云端依赖取得优异的长视野任务表现，为端侧智能体提供了高效可行的方案。

title: PlotGround: Grounding Plot Digitization in Real Scientific Figures and Their Source Data
summary: Scientific figures often encode quantitative results that are not readily available in machine-readable form, making accurate plot digitization important for verifying and reusing published findings. Yet it remains unclear how accurately current models recover plotted values from real scientific figures, as existing benchmarks rely largely on synthetic charts or cover only a limited range of chart types. We introduce PlotGround, an automated pipeline for building plot digitization benchmarks from real scientific figures and their author-released source data. PlotGround maps figures to source tables, identifies reconstructable panels, and generates quantitative questions with source-grounded reference values. We use PlotGround to construct PlotGround-1k, a human-verified benchmark of 1,119 questions from 1,066 bioRxiv preprints. Across sixteen multimodal models, the best reaches 87.5% accuracy at a $\pm 5\%$ relative-error tolerance. Tightening the tolerance to $\pm 2\%$ lowers every model's accuracy by 11-24 percentage points, revealing a gap between approximate visual reading and precise quantitative recovery. PlotGround's paired figure-source structure lets us compare how accurately the same values are recovered from figures and from source tables. Providing source tables instead of figures raises a coding agent's accuracy from 90.0% to 97.4% while cutting cost by 72%.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PlotGround自动化流水线，利用真实科学图表及其作者公开的源数据构建图表数字化基准，并构建了含1,119个问题的PlotGround-1k基准。
AI.motivation: 科学图表常编码了无法机器读取的定量结果，准确数字化图表对验证和复用已发表成果很重要。但现有基准多依赖合成图表或仅覆盖有限图表类型，无法判断当前模型从真实科学图表中恢复数值的准确度。
AI.method: PlotGround将图表与其源数据表映射，识别可重建的面板，并生成带源数据参考值的定量问题。基于此构建PlotGround-1k，即来自1,066篇bioRxiv预印本、经人工验证的1,119个问题基准。由于采用图表-源表配对结构，可对比同一数值从图表和源表恢复的准确度。
AI.result: 在十六个多模态模型中，最佳模型在±5%相对误差容忍度下达到87.5%准确率；容忍度收紧至±2%时，所有模型准确率下降11-24个百分点。用源表替代图表可使编码智能体准确率从90.0%提升至97.4%，同时降低成本72%。
AI.conclusion: 当前模型在真实科学图表上仍存在"近似视觉读取"与"精确定量恢复"之间的差距。PlotGround的配对结构有助于揭示该差距，并表明源数据在准确度和成本上均优于图表读取。

title: Difference Feature Map Distillation: Transferring Inter-Sample Relational Knowledge Towards Efficient Transformer-Based Tracking
comment: Published in the 2026 IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium (IV)
summary: In autonomous driving perception, visual object tracking systems must satisfy stringent latency and power constraints while remaining robust in complex and dynamic environments. Although transformer-based trackers achieve state-of-the-art accuracy, their substantial computational and memory overheads hinder deployment on real-time, resource-constrained platforms. To move toward this goal, we propose Difference Feature Map Knowledge Distillation (DFM-KD), a novel relational distillation framework tailored for transformer-based visual object tracking. Unlike conventional feature distillation methods that minimize point-wise discrepancies (e.g., mean squared error) between teacher and student feature representations, DFM-KD transfers knowledge through inter-sample feature differences, explicitly aligning the relational structure of the feature space. By distilling how the teacher models appearance variation and consistency across samples, rather than enforcing similarity in absolute activations, DFM-KD enables the student to better capture the structural dynamics of visual changes within a batch. As a result, the distilled model exhibits enhanced feature robustness and improved tracking performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DFM-KD consistently outperforms conventional feature-level distillation methods in both tracking precision and success rates.

AI.tldr: 提出DFM-KD关系型蒸馏框架，通过样本间特征差异迁移知识，用于transformer跟踪器的轻量化。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶感知中，视觉目标跟踪需满足严格的延迟与功耗约束，同时要在复杂动态环境中保持鲁棒。基于transformer的跟踪器虽达到最优精度，但计算和内存开销大，难以部署在实时、资源受限平台。
AI.method: 提出差异特征图知识蒸馏（DFM-KD），一种面向transformer视觉目标跟踪的关系型蒸馏框架。与传统逐点（如MSE）特征蒸馏不同，DFM-KD通过样本间特征差异传递知识，显式对齐特征空间的关系结构，蒸馏教师模型对样本间外观变化与一致性的建模方式，而非强制绝对激活相似。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，DFM-KD在跟踪精度和成功率上均稳定优于传统特征级蒸馏方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过蒸馏样本间关系结构，学生模型能更好捕捉批内视觉变化的结构动态，获得更强的特征鲁棒性与跟踪性能，为资源受限平台部署transformer跟踪器提供了有效途径。

title: MMPostTrainBench: Benchmarking Autonomous Research for Multimodal Post-Training
summary: Autonomous research seeks sustained model improvements through iterative experimentation and feedback. LLM agents show promise in automating machine learning and language-model post-training, but their ability to sustain multimodal improvement remains unclear. We introduce MMPostTrainBench, a benchmark spanning eight tasks in image, audio, video, and joint audio-video understanding and image-grounded software repair. Agents operate from a common base model within fixed budgets, using development feedback before independent evaluation of their submitted models. Evaluation covers target and non-target model outcomes, iterative model improvement and selection, and research integrity. Across all eight tasks, 52.1% of model--task means fall below the base, and evaluated submissions also exhibit non-target regressions. Model performance does not consistently improve across research iterations, and agents do not reliably select the best evaluated candidate for submission; final submissions trail that candidate by up to 5.38 percentage points. Extending autonomous research from text-only to multimodal tasks introduces additional sources of error in perception, cross-modal alignment, and temporal grounding. The observed regressions and selection gaps highlight the need to balance targeted improvements with non-target capability preservation and to retain gains across research iterations. These requirements motivate MMResearch, a multimodal research framework that connects media-grounded evidence to hypotheses and interventions, carries findings across rounds through hierarchical memory, and retains candidates using development evaluation. Added to existing code-agent runtimes, it improves submitted-model accuracy by up to 7.75 percentage points for Claude Opus 4.8 with Claude Code and 2.33 points for GPT-5.6-sol with Codex.

AI.tldr: 论文提出多模态后训练基准 MMPostTrainBench，发现自主研究智能体在多模态任务上普遍出现性能回退与候选选择偏差，并提出 MMResearch 框架以改进。
AI.motivation: 自主研究在文本任务上已有进展，但其能否持续推动多模态模型改进尚不清楚。多模态任务引入感知、跨模态对齐和时间定位等额外误差来源，需要系统性评估。
AI.method: 构建 MMPostTrainBench 基准，覆盖图像、音频、视频及联合音视频理解与图像相关软件修复共八项任务；智能体在固定预算下基于同一基座模型迭代，先用开发反馈再用独立评测；评测涵盖目标与非目标结果、迭代改进与选择、研究完整性。进一步提出 MMResearch 框架，将媒体证据与假设和干预相连接，通过分层记忆跨轮传递发现，并利用开发评测保留候选。
AI.result: 八项任务中 52.1% 的模型—任务均值低于基座，提交模型存在非目标能力回退；性能未随迭代稳定提升，智能体也未能可靠选出最佳候选，最终提交比最佳候选低最多 5.38 个百分点。加入 MMResearch 后，Claude Opus 4.8 配合 Claude Code 的提交准确率提升最多 7.75 个百分点，GPT-5.6-sol 配合 Codex 提升 2.33 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 自主研究从纯文本扩展到多模态会带来新的误差来源；需在针对性改进与非目标能力保持之间取得平衡，并在迭代中保留增益。MMResearch 通过证据—假设—干预连接、分层记忆和候选保留机制有效缓解上述问题。

title: CLIFT: Conformal Self-Verification for Web Agent Training and Test-Time Scaling
summary: Open-source web agents are now strong enough to execute realistic browser tasks, but training them with reinforcement learning still depends on weak supervision: binary task success is too sparse for credit assignment, while frontier-language-model judges are too expensive to call at every step and cannot be assumed available at deployment. We introduce CLIFT, a training and test-time scaling method built around conformal self-verification. During training, the agent answers natural-language verification questions about its own rollouts; a Compositional Conformal Certifier keeps only question signals whose URL-conditional evidence agrees with a training-time judge, assigns signed trust weights through polarity-aware lift, and blends the resulting verifier score into per-step rewards in a way that never subtracts from the judge baseline. At test time, the same certified bank is frozen and reused as structured evidence for Conformal Trajectory Selection (CTS): the agent samples a greedy rollout and one or more diverse retries, the self-verifier summarises each URL trace, and a conservative majority-vote rule chooses whether to swap away from the current incumbent without calling any external judge. This single mechanism supports three settings. On WebArena Infinity, CLIFT achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source web agents. On VisualWebArena, a bank trained with the open model transfers to GPT-5.5 at test time and reaches state-of-the-art performance under the canonical harness. On Online Mind2Web, without training an agent on the benchmark, translating the certified question bank improves a live-web agent in zero-shot evaluation. Together these results position conformal self-verification as a way to turn costly judge feedback into a reusable training signal and a judge-free test-time scaling signal.

AI.tldr: CLIFT通过保形自验证（conformal self-verification）将昂贵的外部评判反馈转化为可复用的训练信号与无需评判者的测试时扩展信号，在WebArena Infinity、VisualWebArena、Online Mind2Web三个基准上取得开源网络智能体的最优性能或零样本提升。
AI.motivation: 开源网络智能体已能执行真实的浏览器任务，但用强化学习训练它们仍依赖弱监督：二元任务成功信号过于稀疏，难以进行信用分配；而前沿语言模型评判者逐步调用成本过高，且无法保证部署时可获得。因此需要一个既能提供密集训练信号、又能在部署时无需外部评判者的方案。
AI.method: 提出CLIFT，围绕保形自验证构建训练与测试时扩展方法。训练阶段，智能体对自己的轨迹回答自然语言验证问题；组合保形认证器（Compositional Conformal Certifier）仅保留其URL条件证据与训练时评判者一致的问答信号，通过极性感知提升分配带符号信任权重，并将验证器得分以永不削减评判者基线的方式混入每步奖励。测试阶段，冻结并复用同一认证问题库作为结构化证据，用于保形轨迹选择（CTS）：智能体采样一条贪心轨迹和若干多样化重试，自验证器汇总每条URL轨迹，采用保守多数投票规则决定是否替换当前最优轨迹，全程不调用外部评判者。该单一机制支持三种设置。
AI.result: 在WebArena Infinity上，CLIFT在开源网络智能体中达到最优性能；在VisualWebArena上，用开放模型训练的问题库可在测试时迁移到GPT-5.5，在标准测试框架下达到最优性能；在Online Mind2Web上，无需在该基准上训练智能体，仅迁移认证问题库即可在零样本评测中提升在线网络智能体。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果将保形自验证确立为一种途径：把昂贵的评判反馈转化为可复用的训练信号，以及一种无需评判者的测试时扩展信号。

title: Rotated, but How Far? Diagnosing and Improving Object-Rotation Reasoning in VLMs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can detect that an object has rotated across views, but cannot reliably tell by how much. We introduce OR-Bench, a fine-grained benchmark for object-rotation reasoning with eight tasks covering rotation detection, rotation magnitude estimation, and multi-view rotation reasoning. Across 12 VLMs, the gap is stark: the strongest models approach 100% accuracy on detection, yet even coarse magnitude estimation is near chance. When asked for exact angles, models place 91.8--100% of their predictions on just $0^\circ$, $90^\circ$, and $180^\circ$, a failure we term canonical-angle collapse. This collapse persists even without visual input. Representation probing shows that missing information is only part of the explanation. Although rotation information becomes less recoverable at finer granularity, substantial coarse-grained information remains, and a simple linear probe outperforms the models' generated answers. This suggests that VLMs underuse rotation information they already encode. We therefore propose RotationCue, a lightweight decoder that recovers coarse rotation information from the VLM's own frozen representations and feeds it back to the model as intermediate textual context. Across three VLMs, RotationCue improves every model--task combination on OR-Bench, raising macro-average accuracy by 7.9--12.6 points while preserving general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OR-Bench 细粒度物体旋转推理基准，揭示视觉语言模型的“规范化角度崩塌”失败模式，并提出 RotationCue 轻量解码器，通过复用模型自身冻结表示提升旋转推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型虽能检测物体在多视角下发生旋转，却无法可靠估计旋转幅度。作者希望系统性地量化这一能力缺口，并探究其根源究竟是信息缺失，还是模型未充分利用已编码的信息。
AI.method: 构建 OR-Bench，包含八项任务，覆盖旋转检测、旋转幅度估计与多视角旋转推理；评测 12 个 VLM，并进行表征探测分析与无视觉输入的对照实验。基于发现提出 RotationCue：从 VLM 自身冻结表征中恢复粗粒度旋转信息，并作为中间文本上下文反馈给模型。
AI.result: 最强模型在旋转检测上接近 100% 准确率，但粗粒度幅度估计近乎随机；要求精确角度时，91.8%–100% 的预测集中在 0°、90°、180°，即“规范角度崩塌”，且无视觉输入时依然存在。线性探测器的表现优于模型生成答案，说明模型编码了未被利用的旋转信息。RotationCue 在三个 VLM 的全部模型–任务组合上均有提升，宏平均准确率提高 7.9–12.6 个百分点，同时保持通用能力。
AI.conclusion: VLM 的旋转推理缺陷主要不是信息缺失，而是对已编码旋转信息的利用不足。通过将冻结表征中的粗粒度旋转线索以文本形式回馈模型，可有效且低成本地改善细粒度旋转推理，同时不损害通用性能。

title: CASE: Cost-Aware Stopping for Efficient Long-Video Agents
summary: Long-video agents can actively gather question-relevant evidence, but they typically leave a central decision implicit: when has the agent seen enough to answer? We propose CASE, a plug-in termination framework that frames this decision as policy-conditioned sequential stopping. At each causal checkpoint, CASE combines an auxiliary multiple-choice assessment of accumulated evidence with the host agent's execution state. From complete native trajectories, we construct a cost-aware target that compares answering now with stopping later along the same search path, accounting jointly for answer correctness and the full cost of continued reasoning. A lightweight Ridge regressor learns this decision gap and produces STOP/CONTINUE decisions. We evaluate three vision-language models with VideoSeek and AVP. On Video-MME, end-to-end accuracy changes by +0.67 percentage points on average while CASE reduces model-token use by 53.63%. The same frozen policies then transfer zero-shot to LongVideoBench and MLVU, with end-to-end accuracy changes of +3.38 and +4.58 points while saving 58.78% and 51.28% of model tokens, respectively. Across all agent-model-benchmark combinations, CASE attains the highest accuracy-efficiency Pareto-frontier coverage among the compared stopping methods (83.3%) at the selected operating points. Online execution preserves this favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off and additionally reduces measured runtime by 54.1% on average. CASE provides a plug-in termination framework for long-video reasoning agents, enabling them to decide when further evidence acquisition is no longer worthwhile.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CASE，一种可插拔的终止框架，将长视频智能体"何时停止收集证据"建模为策略条件下的序贯停止问题，在显著降低 token 与运行成本的同时保持或提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 长视频智能体能主动收集与问题相关的证据，但"何时已看够可以回答"这一核心决策通常被隐式处理，缺乏明确的终止机制，导致推理成本高、效率低。
AI.method: 在每个因果检查点，结合对已积累证据的辅助选择题评估与宿主智能体的执行状态；从完整原生轨迹构建成本感知目标，比较"现在回答"与"继续搜索后停止"的差异（兼顾正确性与继续推理的完整成本）；用轻量 Ridge 回归器学习该决策差距，输出 STOP/CONTINUE。
AI.result: 在三个视觉语言模型上以 VideoSeek 与 AVP 评估：Video-MME 上端到端准确率平均 +0.67 个百分点，模型 token 减少 53.63%；冻结策略零样本迁移到 LongVideoBench 与 MLVU，准确率分别 +3.38、+4.58 个百分点，token 节省 58.78% 与 51.28%；在所有组合中准确率-效率 Pareto 前沿覆盖率最高（83.3%）；在线执行平均降低运行时间 54.1%。
AI.conclusion: CASE 提供了长视频推理智能体的可插拔终止框架，使其能判断何时继续获取证据已不再值得，在保持甚至提升准确率的同时大幅节省 token 与时间成本。

title: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents
summary: Memory has become integral to the LLM agent ecosystem, supporting information retention and reuse across interactions. However, most existing agent memory systems construct memory in a query-agnostic manner, which can incur unnecessary preprocessing cost and discard details that later prove essential. Recent studies have begun shifting memory processing toward runtime adaptation, but typically specialize in particular operations or fixed processing schemes, leaving flexible control over performance, cost, and latency largely underexplored. To address this challenge, we present \textbf{MemPilot}, a flexible framework that orchestrates on-demand memory curation under different performance--cost--latency preferences. Specifically, we optimize a multi-step LLM policy via reinforcement learning to iteratively choose between retrieving from query-agnostic memory and delegating query-specific curation of raw multimodal history to heterogeneous LLMs and VLMs. The policy jointly controls evidence amount, curation instructions, model selection, and visual access, enabling fine-grained allocation of runtime computation. To optimize this policy under competing objectives, we adapt objective-wise advantage decoupling by separately estimating each objective's advantage before aggregation. Moreover, we introduce prefix-based marginal utility estimation for fine-grained credit assignment across multi-step rollouts. Experiments on five multimodal agent-memory benchmarks demonstrate favorable performance--cost--latency trade-offs across optimization preferences, with preference sweeps yielding broader frontiers than existing trade-off-aware baselines.

AI.tldr: MemPilot 是一个可灵活编排按需记忆整理的框架，通过强化学习优化多步 LLM 策略，在不同性能—成本—延迟偏好下实现更优权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体记忆系统多以查询无关（query-agnostic）方式构建记忆，导致不必要的预处理开销，并可能丢弃后续关键信息；虽有研究转向运行时自适应，但往往局限于特定操作或固定处理方案，对性能、成本与延迟的灵活控制仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 将多步 LLM 策略用强化学习优化，使其在“从查询无关记忆检索”和“将原始多模态历史委托给异构 LLM/VLM 做查询特定整理”之间迭代选择；策略联合控制证据量、整理指令、模型选择与视觉访问。为在竞争目标下优化，采用目标级优势解耦（分别估计各目标优势后再聚合），并引入基于前缀的边际效用估计以实现多步 rollout 的细粒度信用分配。
AI.result: 在五个多模态智能体记忆基准上实验表明，在不同优化偏好下均取得良好的性能—成本—延迟权衡，且偏好扫描得到的边界优于现有权衡感知基线。
AI.conclusion: MemPilot 通过按需、可编排的多模态记忆整理与多目标 RL 优化，实现了灵活且细致的运行时计算分配，拓展了性能—成本—延迟的可行边界。

title: T-JEPA: A Temporal Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Learning Better Remote Sensing Representations
summary: Earth observation (EO) data provide rich temporal supervision, yet existing remote sensing foundation models mainly exploit sequential observations through imposing predefined pairwise relations or aggregating holistic reconstruction context. We seek to further exploit the sparse and nonuniform temporal sampling inherent in EO sequences as supervisory signals. To this end, we propose T-JEPA, a temporal joint-embedding predictive architecture that learns time-gap-conditioned latent transitions. A shared single-frame encoder processes each observation, while a temporal predictor estimates the complete target latent field from a masked source latent representation and the actual elapsed time. Across multiple temporal intervals, these predictive constraints organize observed states into structured latent trajectories. Asymmetric metadata injection mitigates shortcut learning, and direct supervision across multiple temporal scales proves more effective than recursively rolling out intermediate states. In parallel, masked pixel reconstruction provides complementary supervision for preserving spatial details. Under matched pre-training data and throughput, T-JEPA achieves leading transfer performance on both static and temporal tasks. Analyses further reveal that T-JEPA learns representations with time-gap-dependent transition predictability and coherent latent dynamics, while maintaining strong cross-period consistency, representation diversity, and semantic discriminability.

AI.tldr: T-JEPA：一种时间联合嵌入预测架构，利用地球观测序列中稀疏、非均匀的时间采样作为监督信号，学习以时间间隔为条件的潜在状态转移，在静态与时间任务上均取得领先的迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感基础模型主要通过对齐预定义的成对关系或聚合整体重建上下文来利用序列观测，未能充分挖掘地球观测序列中固有稀疏、非均匀时间采样所蕴含的监督信息。
AI.method: 提出 T-JEPA 时间联合嵌入预测架构：共享单帧编码器处理每个观测；时间预测器由被掩码的源潜在表示与实际流逝时间估计完整目标潜在场；跨多个时间间隔的预测约束将观测状态组织为结构化潜在轨迹；采用非对称元数据注入抑制捷径学习；在多时间尺度上直接监督，并辅以掩码像素重建以保留空间细节。
AI.result: 在匹配预训练数据与吞吐量的条件下，T-JEPA 在静态与时间任务上均取得领先的迁移性能；分析表明其表示具有依赖时间间隔的转移可预测性与连贯的潜在动态，并保持较强的跨周期一致性、表示多样性与语义可区分性。
AI.conclusion: 利用时间间隔条件的潜在转移预测可作为有效的自监督信号，多尺度直接监督优于递归展开中间状态，且与像素重建互补；该方法为遥感基础模型的时间建模提供了新范式。

title: PharmAgent: Constraint-Aware Search with Frozen Language Models for Molecular Optimization
summary: Molecular optimization must improve target activity and satisfy developability constraints within limited evaluation budgets. Classical methods require tailored rules or training to incorporate chemical instructions and property feedback. Frozen language models can condition edits on this information, but need explicit constraint control and relevant experience. We therefore present PharmAgent, a constraint-aware molecular search method driven by adaptive external state. Its Lagrangian controller translates violations in accepted states into accumulated constraint pressure, keeping this history separate from current property measurements. Structure-indexed replay complements this feedback with relevant evaluated transitions that guide subsequent proposals. As a curriculum progressively activates constraints, candidates and the incumbent are compared under the same current objective, and the accepted state determines the next multiplier update. We derive an exact identity that characterizes how accepted-state violations accumulate in the controller's multipliers. Across five tasks with five independent runs, PharmAgent achieves a summed area under the target-score curves (AUC) of 3.9208 in target-only search, improving over MOLLEO by 37.3%. With online constraints, it achieves a property-adjusted AUC of 0.7076, improving over the strongest online baseline, ExLLM, by 53.8%. These results rank first among all evaluated methods in both target-only and constraint-aware search. The online comparison covers all five baseline frameworks. The full system leads every ablation variant in target quality, property-adjusted performance, and Pareto hypervolume. All five molecular cases reach feasible final states, documenting target gains and trade-offs.

AI.tldr: PharmAgent：一种由自适应外部状态驱动的约束感知分子优化方法，利用拉格朗日控制器与结构索引回放，在有限预算下兼顾目标活性与可开发性约束。
AI.motivation: 分子优化须在有限评估预算内提升目标活性的同时满足可开发性约束。经典方法需定制规则或额外训练才能融入化学指令与性质反馈；冻结语言模型虽可条件化编辑，但缺乏显式约束控制与相关经验，难以有效平衡目标与约束。
AI.method: 提出PharmAgent，以自适应外部状态驱动搜索。拉格朗日控制器把已接受状态的违规转化为累积约束压力，并将其与当前性质测量分离保存；结构索引回放提供相关已评估转移引导后续提议；课程学习逐步激活约束；候选与现任在相同当前目标下比较，并以接受状态决定下一乘子更新；推导出刻画已接受状态违规如何累积于乘子的精确恒等式。
AI.result: 在五项任务各五次独立运行中，仅目标搜索的累计目标分数曲线下面积（AUC）达3.9208，较MOLLEO提升37.3%；带在线约束时性质调整AUC为0.7076，较最强在线基线ExLLM提升53.8%。两类搜索均排名第一，在线比较覆盖全部五个基线框架；完整系统在目标质量、性质调整性能与Pareto超体积上均优于所有消融变体；五个分子案例均达到可行最终状态。
AI.conclusion: PharmAgent通过自适应外部状态与约束感知控制，在有限预算内有效平衡目标活性与可开发性约束，在目标-only与约束感知搜索中均优于现有方法，且消融与可行性结果验证了各组件贡献。

title: HLA-WM: Hybrid Linear Attention for Long-Horizon Video World Models
summary: Long-horizon video world models require persistent memory to preserve scene consistency over extended rollouts. Softmax attention retains the full generation history through a growing KV cache, whereas recurrent linear attention compresses history into fixed-size states with substantially lower memory cost. However, we identify severe long-range forgetting in Gated DeltaNet (GDN), where information from distant but relevant scenes is progressively attenuated by subsequent state updates. To address this limitation, we propose HLA-WM, a training-free hybrid linear-attention framework that combines coarse-grained geometry-guided retrieval with fine-grained recurrent linear-state computation. HLA-WM exploits the affine structure of GDN to cache compact chunk-wise transition summaries, retrieve scene-relevant historical chunks using camera geometry, and recompose them into query-specific recurrent states. On the $60$-second SANA-WM-Bench, HLA-WM improves all six aggregate revisit-consistency and camera-control metrics of the base autoregressive generator without additional training, including a $0.74$ dB PSNR gain and a $28.5\%$ reduction in rotation error. The improvements persist after downstream refinement and generalize to MBench-A, where HLA-WM consistently improves all three revisit-consistency metrics across all four subsets and all evaluated inference modes over $547$ samples. At a $60$-second context, HLA-WM reduces historical-state memory by $12\times$ relative to full KV caching while incurring at most a $1.6\%$ reduction in inference throughput. These results demonstrate that selectively addressable recurrent memory can improve long-range scene recall while preserving the efficiency advantages of GDN. Project page: https://caesarhhh.github.io/hla-wm/

AI.tldr: 论文提出 HLA-WM，一种免训练的混合线性注意力框架，通过几何引导的粗粒度检索与细粒度循环线性状态计算相结合，解决 Gated DeltaNet 在长时视频世界模型中的远距离遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 长时程视频世界模型需要持久记忆来维持场景一致性。Softmax 注意力靠不断增长的 KV 缓存保留完整历史，内存开销大；循环线性注意力（如 GDN）将历史压缩为固定大小状态，内存低但存在严重的远距离遗忘——来自遥远但相关场景的信息会被后续状态更新逐步衰减。
AI.method: HLA-WM 利用 GDN 的仿射结构缓存紧凑的分块转移摘要；用相机几何检索与场景相关的历史分块；将这些分块重组为针对查询的循环状态，从而把粗粒度几何引导检索与细粒度循环线性状态计算结合，且无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在 60 秒的 SANA-WM-Bench 上，无需训练即提升基础自回归生成器全部六项重访一致性与相机控制指标，包括 0.74 dB PSNR 增益和 28.5% 旋转误差降低；经过下游精修后提升依然存在，并泛化到 MBench-A，在 547 个样本上一致提升全部四个子集和所有评估推理模式的三项重访一致性指标。60 秒上下文下，历史状态内存相比完整 KV 缓存减少 12 倍，推理吞吐最多仅下降 1.6%。
AI.conclusion: 可选择性寻址的循环记忆能改善远距离场景召回，同时保留 GDN 的效率优势。

title: TeleTune: Evolving Agent Skills From Offline Telemetry
summary: Computer-use agents need to capture procedural knowledge of how people use software. User telemetry offers a scalable source of this knowledge. However, learning reusable skills from these logs requires addressing three challenges: (1) Goal Underspecification, since logs do not record the goal behind each action; (2) Non-Replayability, since past activity cannot be replayed to evaluate skill updates; and (3) Interleaved Trajectories, since logs may mix several tasks without marking their boundaries. To address these, we introduce TeleTune, a framework for learning a textual skill library from offline logs without recorded goals, cannot be replayed during optimization, and may interleave tasks. TeleTune uses action-prediction errors on logged trajectories to propose library edits and keep only those that improve held-out action-prediction accuracy, which we call skill-guided progress. The learned workflows also enable retrieval of demonstrations that cover the subgoals of a new task. At test time, the agent is provided with the learned library and the workflow-based retrieved demonstrations. Experiments on WorkArena and Online-Mind2Web show that TeleTune outperforms random retrieval, Agent Workflow Memory (AWM), and their combination. We find that the best baseline varies by setting, whereas TeleTune achieves average success rates of 77.1% and 80.6%, respectively, improving over the strongest baseline on each benchmark by 6.7% and 7.7%. Under the heaviest perturbation of the WorkArena training data,TeleTune keeps the highest average success rate at 68.5%, 6.3% above the strongest baseline. Our analyses show (1) skill optimization and workflow-based retrieval are complementary, (2) optimizing on fixed logs costs 5 to 75 times fewer tokens than validating the same edits with live episodes, (3) skill-guided progress tracks the live success rate.

AI.tldr: 提出TeleTune框架，从无目标记录、不可回放且任务交错的离线用户日志中学习文本技能库，用于计算机使用智能体。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用智能体需要软件操作的程序性知识，用户遥测日志是可扩展来源，但从这些日志学习可复用技能面临三大挑战：目标欠明确、不可回放、轨迹交错。
AI.method: TeleTune利用已记录轨迹上的动作预测误差来提议技能库编辑，并只保留能提升留出集动作预测准确率（称为skill-guided progress）的编辑；所学工作流还能检索覆盖新任务子目标的演示。测试时向智能体提供所学技能库与基于工作流检索的演示。
AI.result: 在WorkArena和Online-Mind2Web上，TeleTune优于随机检索、Agent Workflow Memory（AWM）及其组合，平均成功率分别为77.1%和80.6%，比各基准最强基线提升6.7%和7.7%；在最重扰动训练数据下仍保持最高平均成功率68.5%，高出最强基线6.3%。
AI.conclusion: 技能优化与基于工作流的检索具有互补性；在固定日志上优化比用实时回合验证同样编辑节省5至75倍token；skill-guided progress与实时成功率保持一致。

title: Robust Local Optimization Done Right
summary: RANSAC scoring and local optimization (LO) impose different robustness requirements, motivating the separation of hypothesis selection from refinement. We systematically isolate the effects of robust-loss shape, incorrectly specified inlier scales, and optimization strategy on essential matrix, fundamental matrix, and homography estimation. A profile-marginal score marginalizes the nuisance inlier scale and selects an inlier partition, from which we estimate the scale that sets the LO loss width; this makes LO robust to an inlier scale specified too large, whereas one specified too small degrades selection itself. Refinement needs gradient from correspondences the seed currently rejects: optimizers that reweight from current residuals stay pinned to their seed, whereas methods with broad basins recover strongly perturbed seeds yet degrade accurate score-selected hypotheses, so basin size alone is insufficient to assess RANSAC LO. Joint half-quadratic optimization balances the two and is the most consistent strategy across model classes. An optimizer matched to the profile-marginal score, which never decreases it, does not reach the best accuracy, challenging the prescription that scoring and refinement objectives should match. Composed from these findings, our RANSAC reduces the median essential-matrix pose error of a state-of-the-art RANSAC on PhotoTourism from 2.23 degrees to 1.58 degrees with a correctly specified inlier scale and from 38 degrees to 6.2 degrees when it is grossly misspecified (128x too large).

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了RANSAC假设选择与局部优化的分离，分析了鲁棒损失形状、内点尺度误设、优化策略对基础矩阵、本质矩阵和单应估计的影响，并提出改进的RANSAC流程。
AI.motivation: RANSAC的评分与局部优化对鲁棒性的需求不同，因此需要将假设选择与精化分离；作者希望厘清鲁棒损失形状、内点尺度误设及优化策略各自的影响，以改进LO的稳健性与精度。
AI.method: 提出一种profile-marginal评分，边缘化 nuisance 内点尺度并选择内点划分，由此估计设定LO损失宽度的尺度；并比较不同优化策略（从当前残差重加权、宽吸引域方法、联合半二次优化）对种子精化的影响。
AI.result: LO对过大的内点尺度具有鲁棒性，但过小的尺度会损害选择本身；仅靠吸引域大小不足以评估RANSAC LO，联合半二次优化在不同模型类别中最一致；与profile-marginal评分匹配且单调不减的优化器并未达到最佳精度。最终方法在PhotoTourism上将本质矩阵中位位姿误差从2.23度降至1.58度（尺度正确时），并从38度降至6.2度（尺度放大约128倍时）。
AI.conclusion: 评分与精化目标不应简单匹配；分离假设选择与精化、采用profile-marginal评分与联合半二次优化，可显著提升RANSAC在尺度误设下的鲁棒性和估计精度。

title: AI Safety via Debate is Compromised by Cognitive Biases
summary: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has played a central role in making large language models responsive to human instructions. However, human evaluators often favor flattering or persuasive responses over truthful ones, creating incentives for models to appeal to evaluators at the expense of accuracy. AI safety via debate has been proposed as a way to improve the supervision of language models: in this paradigm, two agents argue opposing positions and challenge each other's claims, potentially exposing falsehoods to the adjudicator. A central premise of AI safety via debate is that truthful arguments are easier to defend than false ones under adversarial scrutiny. In this work, we investigate whether this advantage persists when debaters use rhetorical strategies that exploit biases in human judgment. Inspired by competitive debate, we construct 68 LLM-generated dialogues about detective mysteries with known culprits, spanning four interventions: anchoring, fallacy oversight, pro-jargon, and verbosity. We apply each intervention to either the side advocating for the true culprit or the side advocating for an innocent suspect, allowing us to distinguish influence on adjudication from correctness. In a study with 369 participants, we find that, pooled across bias types, these interventions significantly shift judgments toward the manipulated side. These findings expose a vulnerability in debate-based supervision: human adjudication is sensitive to manipulative rhetorical strategies.

AI.tldr: 研究检验了AI辩论监督中“真实论证更易辩护”的前提：当辩手使用利用人类判断偏误的修辞策略时，人类裁决者会显著偏向被操纵一方。
AI.motivation: RLHF使大模型听从人类指令，但人类评估者常偏好奉承或有说服力的回答而非真实回答，激励模型为取悦评估者而牺牲准确性。AI安全辩论被视为改进监督的方式，其核心前提是真实论证在对抗审视下更易辩护。作者希望检验当辩手使用利用人类判断偏误的修辞策略时，这一优势是否仍然存在。
AI.method: 受竞技辩论启发，构建了68个由LLM生成的侦探悬疑对话，真凶已知，涵盖四种干预手段：锚定（anchoring）、谬误监督（fallacy oversight）、专业术语倾向（pro-jargon）和冗长（verbosity）。每种干预分别施加于主张真凶一方或主张无辜嫌疑人一方，以区分对裁决的影响与正确性。随后开展369名参与者的人类研究。
AI.result: 在汇总各类偏误后，这些干预显著地将参与者的判断推向被操纵的一方。研究揭示，人类裁决对操纵性修辞策略敏感，暴露了基于辩论的监督方式的脆弱性。
AI.conclusion: 基于辩论的AI监督存在漏洞：当辩手利用人类判断偏误时，人类裁决者的判断会被显著操纵，从而削弱“真实论证在对抗中更有优势”这一核心前提，提示需要防范修辞操纵对辩论式监督的破坏。

title: A new design of a fall detection system integrating landmark identification and deep learning techniques
summary: This article introduces an innovative system that integrates landmark identification with deep learning to enhance fall detection accuracy and reliability. By utilizing advanced computer vision techniques, such as Media Pipe for spatial recognition, the system effectively differentiates between routine movements and actual falls. The integration of landmarks with a deep learning prediction algorithm minimizes false alarms, ensuring timely responses to genuine falls. Comprehensive experimentation underscores the system's versatility across various scenarios, emphasizing its potential to improve safety and independence for older adults. The training process demonstrates a steady increase in accuracy, stabilizing by the 40th cycle, while error rates decline significantly during the initial cycles. Real-time experiments, involving both male and female participants aged 8 to 50, recorded a remarkable 95% detection rate of falls, demonstrating the system's effectiveness and promising future applications in elder care and smart health monitoring environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种融合地标识别与深度学习的跌倒检测系统，通过MediaPipe等计算机视觉技术区分日常动作与真实跌倒，实时实验检测率达95%，有望应用于老年照护与智能健康监测。
AI.motivation: 提升跌倒检测的准确性与可靠性，减少误报，从而为老年人提供更及时的安全响应，并增强其独立生活能力。
AI.method: 将地标识别与深度学习预测算法相结合，利用MediaPipe进行空间识别，区分常规动作与真实跌倒，并通过大量实验验证系统在不同场景下的适用性。
AI.result: 训练过程中准确率稳步上升并在第40个周期趋于稳定，误差率在初期显著下降；实时实验中8至50岁男女参与者取得95%的跌倒检测率。
AI.conclusion: 该系统具有较高的检测效果与通用性，在老年照护和智能健康监测领域具有广阔的应用前景。

title: Hallucination Across the Reasoning Lifecycle: Interface Visibility, Causal Evidence, and Release Control in Large Reasoning Models
comment: 35 pages, 8 figures, 9 tables. Electronic supplementary materials S1-S7 are included as ancillary files
summary: Reasoning errors can propagate into later decisions and memory. This survey synthesizes 312 papers and first-party reports on text-based reasoning hallucinations around three questions: what evidence is observable, what study designs establish, and which corrective actions the evidence supports. UIPCA records unsupported premises (U), invalid inferences (I), dependent reuse (P), visible answer-trace consistency (C), and action-policy failures (A). Across 58 reviewed sources, no comparison establishes that a specified intervention improves reasoning while reducing factual reliability under matched conditions. The synthesis connects diagnosis to verification, repair, selective release, and persistent-state control across memory, tools, and training feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文综述312篇论文与一手报告，围绕文本推理幻觉的可观察证据、研究设计可确立的结论及证据支持的纠正措施展开，提出UIPCA框架并指出缺乏匹配条件下干预提升推理且不损事实可靠性的比较证据。
AI.motivation: 推理错误会传播到后续决策与记忆中，因此需要系统梳理文本推理幻觉的证据、研究设计与纠正措施，为诊断与治理提供依据。
AI.method: 综述312篇论文和一手报告；采用UIPCA框架记录无支撑前提（U）、无效推理（I）、依赖复用（P）、可见答案—轨迹一致性（C）与行动策略失败（A）；并审查58个来源。
AI.result: 在58个被审查来源中，没有比较能证明在匹配条件下某一特定干预在提升推理的同时降低事实可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 该综述将诊断与验证、修复、选择性发布及跨记忆、工具与训练反馈的持久状态控制相连接。

title: Vision-enabled detection of safety helmet compliance in construction zones
summary: In the rapidly evolving field of construction management, worker safety remains a top priority. This paper introduces an innovative vision-based system for real-time detection of helmet compliance, specifically designed for construction sites, utilizing advanced computer vision techniques and machine learning algorithms within the YOLO (you only look once) framework. Our system leverages high-resolution video feeds from strategically positioned cameras to monitor adherence to safety regulations regarding helmet usage. By employing deep learning methodologies, the system effectively identifies individuals not wearing helmets, thereby significantly mitigating the risk of head injuries among workers. Our training and validation results revealed an impressive precision exceeding 97% at mAP@0.5 for both helmeted and non-helmeted individuals. Furthermore, our experiments demonstrate exceptional detection accuracy, demonstrating the system's resilience under varying lighting conditions and diverse worker movements. The consistent decrease in loss and improvement in metrics throughout training validates the effectiveness of the YOLOv8 model in enhancing recognition performance. The implications of this research extend beyond mere regulatory compliance, opening avenues for innovative applications in occupational safety management. This study highlights the critical role of technology in protecting lives and lays the groundwork for future advancements in smart construction environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于YOLOv8框架的视觉实时安全帽佩戴检测系统，用于建筑工地工人安全监管，验证集mAP@0.5精度超过97%。
AI.motivation: 在建筑管理领域，工人安全始终是首要任务，头部受伤风险较高，需要有效手段监控安全帽佩戴合规情况，以减少工伤事故。
AI.method: 利用布置在工地的摄像头采集高分辨率视频，采用YOLO框架结合计算机视觉与深度学习算法，实时识别佩戴与未佩戴安全帽的人员。
AI.result: 训练与验证结果显示，佩戴和未佩戴安全帽两类目标的mAP@0.5精度均超过97%；在不同光照条件和多样工人动作下检测准确率优异，训练过程中损失持续下降、指标不断提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究验证了YOLOv8模型在安全帽识别任务中的有效性，其意义超越合规监管，为职业安全管理创新应用与智能建筑环境发展奠定基础。

title: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Stable Temporal Abstraction for Language Model Agents
summary: Hierarchical reinforcement learning improves long-horizon control by organizing primitive actions around persistent subgoals and assigning credit at multiple temporal scales. Recent hierarchical language agents bring these benefits to interactive tasks by explicitly separating subgoal planning from action execution. We observe, however, that an explicit hierarchy does not by itself determine how stable the resulting temporal abstraction is: the learned boundary policy may replace the subgoal almost every turn, making it effectively transient, or retain a subgoal after it has stopped being appropriate. We call this temporal abstraction instability. We propose Stable Temporal Abstraction via Constrained Optimization (STAC), a constrained boundary-policy optimization method that represents premature replanning and stale persistence as constraint costs. STAC applies the resulting Lagrangian costs only to the sampled boundary decision, leaving the underlying algorithm's rewards, critic targets, subgoal advantages, and primitive-action advantages unchanged. Across two backbones and two benchmarks, STAC improves success over a strong hierarchical baseline by $8.1$ and $7.9$ points on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen3-0.6B, and by $23.5$ and $15.8$ points with Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出STAC方法，通过约束优化解决分层语言智能体中的"时间抽象不稳定性"问题，在ALFWorld和WebShop上显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 分层强化学习通过子目标组织动作、多时间尺度分配信用，能改善长时程控制；近期分层语言智能体将子目标规划与动作执行分离。但作者观察到显式分层本身并不能保证时间抽象的稳定性：边界策略可能每步都替换子目标（导致子目标瞬变），或在子目标不再合适时仍保留（陈旧持续）。这种"时间抽象不稳定性"是核心问题。
AI.method: 提出STAC（Stable Temporal Abstraction via Constrained Optimization），一种约束边界策略优化方法。将过早重规划（premature replanning）和陈旧持续（stale persistence）表示为约束代价，用拉格朗日代价仅作用于被采样的边界决策，而不改变底层算法的奖励、critic目标、子目标优势和原始动作优势。
AI.result: 在两种骨干网络和两个基准上，STAC相较强分层基线均有提升：Qwen3-0.6B下ALFWorld和WebShop分别提升8.1和7.9个点；Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct下分别提升23.5和15.8个点。
AI.conclusion: 显式分层不足以确保稳定的时间抽象；将过早重规划与陈旧持续建模为约束代价，并仅作用于边界决策的约束优化，能有效稳定时间抽象并大幅提升长时程交互任务成功率，且与底层算法解耦、兼容多种骨干。

title: A Three-Dimensional Reverse-Projection Method for Sparse Point Cloud Completion and Its Application to High-Speed Train Nose Reconstruction
summary: Holes in LiDAR scans of environments with glass windows remain an unresolved problem in three-dimensional reconstruction. This study presents a pipeline for point cloud acquisition, filtering, completion, and surface reconstruction to address sparse sampling and missing window regions in scans of a high-speed train nose. FAST-LIVO2 provides the initial point cloud through multisensor odometry and mapping, and moving least squares (MLS) smooths the observations. We then introduce three-axis projection-based subdivision and interpolation with reverse hole boundary identification, referred to as three-axis reverse completion. The method interpolates missing regions from observations around each hole. Greedy projection triangulation, Poisson surface reconstruction, and a Marching Cubes-based pipeline generate meshes from the completed point cloud. Experiments on a proportionally scaled display model of a high-speed train nose show that the proposed method fills missing point cloud regions around the glass windows. Under the evaluation setting used in this study, greedy projection triangulation yields lower geometric distance errors than the other two reconstruction pipelines. The pipeline supports non-contact digital modeling of train nose geometry and provides a practical approach to reconstructing objects with glass windows.

AI.tldr: 针对高速列车车头含玻璃窗扫描中点云稀疏与缺失问题，提出"三轴反向补全"点云补全与表面重建流水线，实验证明该方法能填补窗户周边缺失区域，且贪心投影三角化误差最低。
AI.motivation: 含玻璃窗环境的LiDAR扫描存在孔洞，是三维重建中尚未解决的问题；高速列车车头扫描也面临采样稀疏与窗区点云缺失，需要非接触式数字建模手段。
AI.method: 构建点云获取—滤波—补全—表面重建流水线：用FAST-LIVO2通过多传感器里程计与建图获得初始点云，用移动最小二乘（MLS）平滑观测；提出基于三轴投影的细分与插值及反向孔洞边界识别（三轴反向补全），利用每个孔洞周围的观测插值缺失区域；随后用贪心投影三角化、泊松表面重建与基于Marching Cubes的流程从补全点云生成网格。
AI.result: 在按比例缩放的列车车头展示模型实验中，所提方法成功填补玻璃窗周围的缺失点云区域；在本研究评价设置下，贪心投影三角化的几何距离误差低于另外两种重建流程。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线支持车头几何的非接触数字建模，为含玻璃窗物体的重建提供了实用途径。

title: CodeForge-MA: Execution-Verified Multi-Agent Learning with Language-Conditioned LoRA for Multilingual Code Generation
summary: Large language models for code generation often fail on execution, multilingual coverage, and contamination control, especially under frozen backbone constraints. We present CodeForge-MA, a unified framework that improves code synthesis through a multi-agent data forge, execution verified reinforced instruction tuning, and a language conditioned mixture of LoRA adapters. Four specialized agents, Composer, Reviewer, Executor, and Curator, iteratively refine instruction code pairs, validate them with tests, and filter duplicates and benchmark leakage. During training, we combine masked supervised fine tuning with a test driven reinforcement objective to align generations with executable correctness. For the larger model, we use sparse expert routing over low rank adapters to improve cross language transfer while keeping the base model unchanged at inference. Experiments show that joint data, objective, and adapter design yields robust gains across programming languages.

AI.tldr: 提出CodeForge-MA统一框架，通过多智能体数据锻造、执行验证强化指令微调及语言条件LoRA适配器混合，在冻结主干模型条件下提升代码生成质量。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在代码生成中常面临执行失败、多语言覆盖不足和污染控制困难等问题，尤其在冻结主干模型约束下更为突出。
AI.method: 框架包含三部分：(1)多智能体数据锻造，由Composer、Reviewer、Executor、Curator四个专门智能体迭代精炼指令-代码对，通过测试验证并过滤重复项与基准泄漏；(2)训练阶段结合掩码监督微调与测试驱动的强化目标，使生成结果对齐可执行正确性；(3)较大模型采用低秩适配器上的稀疏专家路由，提升跨语言迁移能力，同时推理时保持基础模型不变。
AI.result: 实验表明，数据、目标函数与适配器的联合设计在多种编程语言上带来稳健的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化数据构建、训练目标与适配器结构可有效改善冻结主干条件下的代码生成表现，实现跨语言的稳健增益。

title: Controllable Road Marking Generation
summary: Lane and road markings provide critical guidance for vehicle navigation and multi-agent coordination, yet authoring them at scale remains a manual workflow that limits quantitative analysis and scenario testing. We introduce Controllable Road Marking Generation, which synthesizes a missing center-region marking layout from a drivable-area mask, optional outer-ring markings, and a textual description. Our benchmark uses deterministic, metadata-derived prompts and three output channels: lane dividers, road dividers, and pedestrian crossings. We develop a conditional bird's-eye-view (BEV) pipeline that combines (i) a text-conditioned latent rectified-flow DiT trained with a topology-aware auxiliary loss, (ii) Gaussian-blurred training targets that stabilize learning of thin, sparse markings, and (iii) Structured Gaussian Render (SGR), a training-free post-process that recovers crisp divider geometry by extracting polylines, fitting cubic Bézier curves, and re-rendering them as anisotropic super-Gaussian primitives. On 4,597 Argoverse~2 test tiles, our system achieves Buffered F1 of 80.8 and clDice of 50.2, compared with 38.8 and 24.6 for an adapted state-of-the-art mask-refinement baseline. On Waymo dataset, it yields 88.0 Buffered F1 and 66.2 clDice. Component ablations show complementary connectivity gains from topology-aware supervision and SGR. Text-editing experiments reveal that stronger guidance improves edit success but also increases changes to non-target structures. We see this framework as a step toward simulation-ready road-marking variation, automated map completion, and early-stage infrastructure design exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出可控道路标线生成任务与条件BEV流水线，从可行驶区域掩码、外围标线和文本描述合成中心区域标线布局，在Argoverse 2和Waymo上大幅超越基线。
AI.motivation: 车道与道路标线对车辆导航和多智能体协同至关重要，但大规模标注仍是人工流程，限制了定量分析和场景测试，因此需要自动生成标线的能力。
AI.method: 任务设定为从可行驶区域掩码、可选外围标线及文本描述合成缺失的中心区域标线布局，输出车道分隔线、道路分隔线和人行横道三通道；基准采用确定性、元数据派生的提示。方法为条件BEV流水线，包含：(i) 文本条件隐空间rectified-flow DiT，配合拓扑感知辅助损失；(ii) 高斯模糊训练目标以稳定稀疏细标线的学习；(iii) 无训练的后处理SGR（Structured Gaussian Render），通过提取折线、拟合三次贝塞尔曲线并以各向异性超高斯基元重渲染，恢复清晰的分隔线几何。
AI.result: 在4,597个Argoverse 2测试图块上，Buffered F1为80.8、clDice为50.2，而适配的SOTA掩码精修基线仅为38.8和24.6；在Waymo上达到88.0 Buffered F1和66.2 clDice。组件消融显示拓扑感知监督与SGR在连通性上具有互补增益。文本编辑实验表明更强引导提升编辑成功率，但也会增加对非目标结构的改动。
AI.conclusion: 该框架是迈向仿真可用的道路标线变化、自动化地图补全与早期基础设施设计探索的一步。

title: SkillGATE: Gate-Aware Monte Carlo Tree Search for Skill Retrieval
summary: Skill Retrieval (SR) aims to identify the most relevant skills from external skill libraries, and becomes increasingly challenging as libraries grow in scale and diversity. Existing methods either rank skills independently or rely on predefined graph propagation and hierarchical routing, making them vulnerable to semantic distractors, local trapping, and early routing errors. We formulate SR as an adaptive information-foraging process that coordinates region-level navigation with skill-level selection according to the utility and uncertainty observed during search. Based on this formulation, we propose SkillGATE, a graph-guided hierarchical retrieval framework with Gate-Aware Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS). SkillGATE constructs a graph-preserving hierarchical index and performs adaptive retrieval through selection, expansion, simulation, and backpropagation. G-PUCT guides action selection, expansion explores new regions, simulation evaluates candidate skills, and backpropagation updates search statistics. Experiments on six SR benchmarks show that SkillGATE consistently improves diverse retrieval and reranking backbones, achieving a 16.3\% improvement in overall R@1 over the strongest retriever-based baseline. Our code is available at https://github.com/Edwinbe/SkillGATE-v1/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SkillGATE，将技能检索(SR)建模为自适应信息觅食过程，用门控感知的蒙特卡洛树搜索在层级索引上进行区域导航与技能选择。
AI.motivation: 技能库规模与多样性增长使技能检索日益困难。现有方法要么独立对技能排序，要么依赖预定义的图传播与层级路由，容易受到语义干扰项、局部陷阱和早期路由错误的影响。
AI.method: 将SR形式化为协调区域级导航与技能级选择的自适应信息觅食过程；提出SkillGATE——图引导的层级检索框架，结合门控感知MCTS(G-PUCT)：构建保图层级索引，通过选择、扩展、模拟与回溯进行自适应检索；G-PUCT指导动作选择，扩展探索新区域，模拟评估候选技能，回溯更新搜索统计。
AI.result: 在六个SR基准上，SkillGATE一致提升多种检索与重排骨干，整体R@1相比最强检索器基线提升16.3%。
AI.conclusion: SkillGATE通过自适应信息觅食与门控感知MCTS有效缓解语义干扰、局部陷阱与早期路由错误，显著提升技能检索性能，代码已开源。

title: InteractionBench: A Real-Time Interaction Benchmark for Streaming Video Systems
summary: A video assistant must speak when its instruction warrants a response and stay silent otherwise. We introduce a benchmark that evaluates this decision for the complete system of model, memory, and response controller. InteractionBench covers query responses, event triggers, and ongoing updates in 1,060 interactions over 812 videos, with 69 negative streams and 53 suites that pair counted events with look-alike near misses. It scores content accuracy, timing accuracy, and silence compliance on the video clock. Timely speech costs silence across systems. Polled Qwen3-VL-8B reaches 77.8 timing accuracy but 10.9 silence compliance. A native real-time interaction system reaches 29.2 silence compliance at 66.8 timing accuracy, yet emits on 89.9% of negative streams. No open-weight system clears a third of the near-miss suites. Fewer replies help only when chosen, as random deletion merely trades timing for silence. Offline scores miss these failures and mispredict online behavior. Adding restraint is costly, as the native system's controller adds little by itself and agentic systems add it only at about 30 s per poll.Project page: https://www.enxinsong.com/projects/interactionbench/ Code: https://github.com/Espere-1119-Song/InteractionBench Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/InteractionBench/InteractionBench

AI.tldr: 本文提出了InteractionBench，一个评估视频助手"该说时说、不该说时保持沉默"能力的基准，覆盖查询响应、事件触发与持续更新三类任务。
AI.motivation: 视频助手需要在指令要求响应时发言、否则保持沉默，但现有评测缺乏对"何时说、何时不说"这一决策的完整系统级评估。
AI.method: 构建包含812个视频、1,060次交互的基准，涵盖69个负面流和53个将计数事件与相似"近失误"配对的套件；在视频时钟上评分内容准确性、时序准确性和沉默合规性。
AI.result: 及时发言以牺牲沉默为代价：轮询式Qwen3-VL-8B时序准确率77.8%但沉默合规仅10.9%；原生实时交互系统沉默合规29.2%、时序准确率66.8%，却在89.9%的负面流上误触发；无开源权重系统能通过三分之一的近失误套件。
AI.conclusion: 减少回复仅在主动选择时有帮助（随机删除只是以时序换沉默）；离线分数掩盖这些失败并错误预测在线行为；增加"克制"代价高昂，原生系统控制器单独作用有限，智能体系统每次轮询约需30秒。

title: The Functional Structure of Post-Compression Recovery in Low-Rank LLMs
summary: Different low-rank compression methods can produce compressed LLMs that respond differently to the same post-compression recovery procedure, and relative advantages observed between methods at the compression endpoint may shrink, grow, or even reverse after recovery. We ask whether this recovery heterogeneity reflects functional structure beyond scalar loss evolution, and how that structure evolves throughout recovery. Our results establish that this heterogeneity reflects a reproducible compression-induced functional structure, which we formalize as recovery pressure. To characterize this structure consistently throughout recovery, we develop a standardized functional characterization within each backbone that is applicable across heterogeneous low-rank methods. The primary backward characterization reveals reproducible module-wise structure across independent probes, while a complementary forward-only characterization recovers related structure without loss or backpropagation.
